plugin.name: cirrus_data_tracker
plugin.author: Cirrus + Claude
plugin.purpose: Comprehensive data tracker for XP, gold, levels, quests, CPs, GQs, and estimation
plugin.description:
Cirrus Data Tracker v4.5.0 (patch releases put their third number into the plugin `version` attribute as a decimal digit -- 3.8.1 was 3.81 -- because MushClient parses it as a number.)
GMCP-first comprehensive tracker for XP, gold, QP, TP, levels, powerups, quests, campaigns, global quests, class usage, and earning estimation. Data persisted in cirrus_tracker.db (SQLite).
Type 'cdt help' for commands.

local BLOOT_SET = {} BLOOT_RANK = {} for i, t in ipairs(BLOOT_TIERS) do BLOOT_SET[t] = true; BLOOT_RANK[t] = i end
local REWARD_TYPE_MAP = { ["experience"] = "xp", ["quest point"] = "qp", ["quest points"] = "qp", ["gold coin"] = "gold", ["gold coins"] = "gold", ["trivia point"] = "tp", ["trivia points"] = "tp", ["training session"] = "trains", ["training sessions"]= "trains", ["practice"] = "pracs", ["practices"] = "pracs", }

local config = {} local default_config = { -- Shaman only: which element gaias fury/revenge are focused into. -- '' means unfocused, treated as an even mix of the four elements. gaias_focus = "", -- Your own 'wail' lines: void sermon (harmer, negative) and sonic weapons share the -- word. "weapon" (all sonic melee), "sermon" (all void sermon) or "both" (told apart -- by your mana dropping by a cast's cost). wail_mode = "weapon", -- Automatic reports: whether each prints, where it goes, and for level-ups and -- powerups which number the line shows. events = { level = {on = true, channel = "echo", count = "remort"}, powerup = {on = true, channel = "echo", count = "remort"}, quest = {on = true, channel = "echo"}, cp = {on = true, channel = "echo"}, gq = {on = true, channel = "echo"}, double = {on = true, channel = "echo"}, milestone = {on = true, channel = "echo"}, goal = {on = true, channel = "echo"}, session = {on = true, channel = "echo"}, wrapup = {on = true, channel = "echo"}, }, gag_channel_echo = true, -- Tell the player when the plugin file on disk differs from the one that loaded (4.4.9). -- Off: the 5-minute check does not run. update_notice = true, -- Look for a newer public version once, 20 seconds after CDT loads (4.5.0). Off: no web request. update_check = false, -- The day the "weekly" level/powerup count starts on (aardweekly is always Monday). week_start = "monday", -- How dates are typed and shown: "mdy" (M/D/Y), "dmy" (D/M/Y) or "ymd" (Y/M/D). date_format = "mdy", gags = { xp = false, gold = false, loot = false, sac = false, tax = false, groupdmg = false, groupheal = false, allheal = false, enemydmg = false, }, xpmeter_active = false, meter = { intervals = {300, 900, 3600}, show_intervals = {true, true, false}, rows = {"pup_avg", "xp_rate"}, font_name = "Verdana", font_size = 9, font_bold = 0, }, listen = {ftalk = false, gtell = false, spouse = false, clantalk = false}, listen_allow = {cirrus = true}, debug_mode = false, auto_milestone_qp = AUTO_MILESTONE_QP_INTERVAL, auto_milestone_pup = AUTO_MILESTONE_PUP_INTERVAL, auto_milestone_mob = AUTO_MILESTONE_MOB_INTERVAL, track_retention = 20, }
local state = {} local function default_state() return { session = { id = 0, start_time = 0, active_start = 0, total_active_secs = 0, afk = false, xp = 0, qp = 0, tp = 0, gold = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, kills = 0, solo_levels = 0, group_levels = 0, solo_pups = 0, group_pups = 0, quests_done = 0, quests_fail = 0, cps_done = 0, cps_fail = 0, gqs_joined = 0, gqs_won = 0, -- What the game's worth updates showed gained: the yardstick every recorded -- QP/TP/train/prac is checked against (cdt db verify). worth_qp = 0, worth_tp = 0, worth_trains = 0, worth_pracs = 0, -- Heals on you this session, by healer ("@self" = your own): the damage meter's -- Healing category diffs these like it diffs damage. heals = {}, -- Your heals on other players this session, by target: the detail view's -- Healing list on your row. heals_given = {}, -- Groupmates' heals that don't land on you, by healer: casts seen in their -- mana, and heal scrolls read in your room. group_heals = {}, xp_rare = 0, xp_bonus = 0, -- XP by where it came from (xp_bonus above is double + blessing together) xp_kill = 0, xp_double = 0, xp_blessing = 0, xp_honor = 0, xp_cp = 0, bloot = {}, combat = { vorpal=0, deathblow=0, assassinate=0, slit=0, disintegrate=0, banishment=0, }, gold_sources = {}, dmg = { damage_dealt = 0, damage_received = 0, combat_secs = 0, hits = 0, misses = 0, crits = 0, -- hits counts damage LINES; phits counts real hits within them phits = 0, recv_phits = 0, recv_lines = 0, dodges_by_mob = 0, dodges_by_me = 0, attacks = {}, }, group_dmg = {}, }, current = { class = "", subclass = "", race = "", level = 0, tier = 0, remort = 0, area = "", room_id = 0, opk = -1, hardcore = -1, double_active = false, double_start_time = 0, double_until = 0, dbl_awaiting_bonus = false, dbl_consec_bonus = 0, dbl_consec_normal = 0, dbl_last_flip = 0, }, level_tracking = { start_time = 0, start_timer = 0, type = "level", level_num = 0, xp_at_start = 0, kills_at_start = 0, hp = 0, mp = 0, mv = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, bonus_trains = 0, blessing_trains = 0, instinct_trains = 0, bonus_stats = {}, pending = false, grouped = false, bonus_kills = 0, }, player_totals = { qp_earned = 0, pups = 0, mobs_killed = 0, whois_seeded = false, }, quest_tracking = { active = false, start_time = 0, start_timer = 0, mob_name = "", mob_area = "", mob_room = "", }, cp_tracking = { active = false, start_time = 0, start_timer = 0, end_time = 0, duration = 0, deadline = 0, rewards = {}, }, gq_tracking = { active = false, start_time = 0, start_timer = 0, gq_num = 0, closed_id = 0, mob_qp = 0, rewards = {}, }, tracked = { active = false, db_id = 0, name = "", start_time = 0, max_duration = 0, xp = 0, qp = 0, tp = 0, gold = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, kills = 0, quests = 0, cps = 0, gqs = 0, }, tracked_auto = { active = false, db_id = 0, name = "", start_time = 0, max_duration = 0, xp = 0, qp = 0, tp = 0, gold = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, kills = 0, quests = 0, cps = 0, gqs = 0, }, goal = { type = "", target = 0, start_count = 0 }, worth_last = { gold = -1, bank = -1, qp = -1, tp = -1, trains = -1, pracs = -1 }, worth_pending_credits = { qp = 0, tp = 0, gold = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0 }, } end
local xp_events = {} local xp_history_size = 3600 local monitor_start = 0
local METER_METRICS = { pup_avg = {label = "Pup avg", type = "avg_time", source = "pups"}, lvl_avg = {label = "Lvl avg", type = "avg_time", source = "levels"}, xp_rate = {label = "XP/min", type = "rate", source = "xp"}, gold_rate = {label = "Gold/min", type = "rate", source = "gold"}, qp_rate = {label = "QP/min", type = "rate", source = "qp"}, kill_rate = {label = "Kills/min", type = "rate", source = "kills"}, pup_rate = {label = "Pups/min", type = "rate", source = "pups"}, lvl_rate = {label = "Lvls/min", type = "rate", source = "levels"}, xp_total = {label = "XP", type = "total", source = "xp"}, gold_total = {label = "Gold", type = "total", source = "gold"}, qp_total = {label = "QP", type = "total", source = "qp"}, kill_total = {label = "Kills", type = "total", source = "kills"}, pup_total = {label = "Pups", type = "total", source = "pups"}, lvl_total = {label = "Levels", type = "total", source = "levels"}, }
local METER_METRIC_ORDER = { {header = "XP", keys = {"xp_rate", "xp_total"}}, {header = "Gold", keys = {"gold_rate", "gold_total"}}, {header = "QP", keys = {"qp_rate", "qp_total"}}, {header = "Kills", keys = {"kill_rate", "kill_total"}}, {header = "Pups", keys = {"pup_avg", "pup_rate", "pup_total"}}, {header = "Levels", keys = {"lvl_avg", "lvl_rate", "lvl_total"}}, }
local win = "win_cdt_meter_" .. GetPluginID() local font = "font_cdt_" .. GetPluginID() local meter_fixed_w = 0 local meter_fixed_h = 0 local meter_label_w = 0 local meter_col_w = 0 local meter_session_id = 0 local meter_track_range = nil
local kill_buffer = {}
local area_rates = {}
-- ============================================================================= -- HELPERS -- ============================================================================= function Now() if utils and utils.timer then return utils.timer() end return os.time() end
function GetMonitorUptime() if monitor_start == 0 then return 0 end return Now() - monitor_start end
function IsGrouped() local ok, group_data = pcall(gmcp, "group") if not ok or type(group_data) ~= "table" then return false end if not group_data.groupname or group_data.groupname == "" then return false end if not group_data.members then return false end local my_name = "" local ok2, base = pcall(gmcp, "char.base") if ok2 and base then my_name = (base.name or ""):lower() end for _, member in ipairs(group_data.members) do if member.info and member.info.here == "1" then if my_name == "" or (member.name or ""):lower() ~= my_name then return true end end end return false end
function IsGroupMemberHere(player_name) local ok, group_data = pcall(gmcp, "group") if not ok or type(group_data) ~= "table" or not group_data.members then return false end local pname_lower = player_name:lower() for _, member in ipairs(group_data.members) do if (member.name or ""):lower() == pname_lower then return member.info and member.info.here == "1" end end return false end
function comma_value(amount) local formatted = tostring(amount) while true do formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2') if k == 0 then break end end return formatted end
function short_value(amount) local n = tonumber(amount) if not n then return "0" end if n >= 1000000000 then return string.format("%.1fb", n / 1000000000) elseif n >= 1000000 then return string.format("%.1fm", n / 1000000) elseif n >= 1000 then return string.format("%.1fk", n / 1000) else return tostring(n) end end
function parse_number(s) if not s then return 0 end return tonumber((tostring(s):gsub(",", ""))) or 0 end
-- ============================================================================= -- TABLE GRID -- -- Every column is declared once and both the header and the rows are rendered -- from that single spec, so they cannot drift apart. Values are guaranteed to -- fit their column: text truncates, numbers step down through progressively -- shorter representations. A column width is a hard limit, not a minimum. -- =============================================================================
function FitText(s, w) s = tostring(s or "") if #s <= w then return s end if w <= 3 then return s:sub(1, w) end return s:sub(1, w - 3) .. "..." end
-- 1,234,567 -> 1.2m -> 1.2t -> 1e+15, whichever fits first. short_value stops -- at billions, so anything past that is handled here rather than rendering -- nonsense like "1000000.0b". function FitNum(n, w) n = tonumber(n) if not n then return "" end local s = comma_value(math.floor(n)) if #s <= w then return s end local a = math.abs(n) if a >= 1e12 then s = string.format("%.1ft", n / 1e12) else s = short_value(n) end if #s <= w and not s:find("%d%d%d%d%d") then return s end s = string.format("%.0e", n) if #s <= w then return s end return string.rep("#", w) end
function PadCell(s, w, align) s = tostring(s or "") if #s > w then s = FitText(s, w) end local pad = w - #s if align == "r" then return string.rep(" ", pad) .. s end if align == "c" then local l = math.floor(pad / 2) return string.rep(" ", l) .. s .. string.rep(" ", pad - l) end return s .. string.rep(" ", pad) end
-- Formats one cell's value according to its column spec. function FormatCell(col, v) if v == nil or v == "" then return col.blank or "" end if col.fmt == "num" then if col.blank and (tonumber(v) or 0) == 0 then return col.blank end return FitNum(v, col.w) elseif col.fmt == "pct" then return string.format("%.1f%%", tonumber(v) or 0) elseif type(col.fmt) == "string" and col.fmt:find("%%") then return string.format(col.fmt, v) elseif type(col.fmt) == "function" then return col.fmt(v) end return tostring(v) end
function TableWidth(cols, indent) local w = (indent or 0) for i, c in ipairs(cols) do w = w + c.w if i < #cols then w = w + 1 end end return w end
function RenderTableHeader(cols, indent, color) local pre = string.rep(" ", indent or 0) local parts = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do parts[#parts + 1] = PadCell(c.title, c.w, c.align or "l") end ColourNote(color or "gray", "", pre .. table.concat(parts, " ")) end
-- Rows are arrays of values matching the column order, or maps keyed by col.key. function RenderTableRow(cols, row, indent) local pre = string.rep(" ", indent or 0) local args = {} if pre ~= "" then args[#args + 1] = "silver"; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = pre end for i, c in ipairs(cols) do local v = (c.key and row[c.key] ~= nil) and row[c.key] or row[i] local text = FormatCell(c, v) local coded = type(text) == "string" and text:find(CODED_END, 1, true) if coded and CodedLen(text) <= c.w then CodedArgs(CodedPad(text, c.w, c.align == "r") .. (i < #cols and " " or ""), c.color or "silver", args) else if coded then text = CodedPlain(text) end local cell = PadCell(text, c.w, c.align or "l") if i < #cols then cell = cell .. " " end args[#args + 1] = c.color or "silver" args[#args + 1] = "" args[#args + 1] = cell end end ColourNote(unpack(args)) end
function RenderTable(cols, rows, opts) opts = opts or {} local indent = opts.indent or 0 local width = math.max(TableWidth(cols, indent), tonumber(opts.width) or 0) if opts.title then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", width)) ColourNote("gold", "", " " .. opts.title) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", width)) RenderTableHeader(cols, indent, opts.header_color) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", width)) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do RenderTableRow(cols, r, indent) end if not opts.no_bottom then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", width)) end if opts.footer then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. opts.footer) end return width end
function FormatTime(secs) secs = math.floor(tonumber(secs) or 0) if secs < 0 then secs = 0 end local d = math.floor(secs / 86400) local h = math.floor((secs % 86400) / 3600) local m = math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60) local s = secs % 60 if d > 0 then return string.format("%dd %02dh %02dm", d, h, m) elseif h > 0 then return string.format("%dh %02dm %02ds", h, m, s) elseif m > 0 then return string.format("%dm %02ds", m, s) else return string.format("%ds", s) end end
function FormatTimeShort(secs) secs = math.floor(tonumber(secs) or 0) if secs < 0 then secs = 0 end local h = math.floor(secs / 3600) local m = math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60) local s = secs % 60 if h > 0 then return string.format("%dh %02dm %02ds", h, m, s) elseif m > 0 then return string.format("%dm %02ds", m, s) else return string.format("%ds", s) end end
function FormatTimePrecise(secs) secs = tonumber(secs) or 0 if secs < 0 then secs = 0 end local d = math.floor(secs / 86400) local h = math.floor((secs % 86400) / 3600) local m = math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60) local s = secs % 60 -- A duration measured on the whole-second clock has no fraction to show: printing -- it as 20.00s would claim a precision that was never recorded. local whole = (s == math.floor(s)) if d > 0 then return string.format("%dd %02dh %02dm", d, h, m) elseif h > 0 then return string.format(whole and "%dh %02dm %02ds" or "%dh %02dm %05.2fs", h, m, s) elseif m > 0 then return string.format(whole and "%dm %02ds" or "%dm %05.2fs", m, s) elseif whole then return string.format("%ds", s) else return string.format("%.2fs", s) end end
-- Durations are stored as seconds, fractional when a high-resolution start was -- available. Kept to milliseconds so the column holds 19.6 rather than the -- 19.599999904633 that tostring() would write. function DurationSql(secs) secs = tonumber(secs) or 0 if secs < 0 then secs = 0 end if secs == math.floor(secs) then return string.format("%d", secs) end return string.format("%.3f", secs) end
function GetActiveTime() local total = state.session.total_active_secs or 0 if not state.session.afk and state.session.active_start > 0 then total = total + (os.time() - state.session.active_start) end return total end
local aard_colors = { ['r'] = "red", ['R'] = "red", ['g'] = "lime", ['G'] = "lime", ['y'] = "yellow", ['Y'] = "yellow", ['b'] = "blue", ['B'] = "blue", ['m'] = "magenta", ['M'] = "magenta", ['c'] = "cyan", ['C'] = "cyan", ['w'] = "silver", ['W'] = "white", ['D'] = "dimgray", ['x'] = "silver" }
function PrintColoredString(str) local parts = {} local last_end = 1 local s, e = str:find("@", 1, true) while s do if s > last_end then table.insert(parts, {text = str:sub(last_end, s - 1), color = nil}) end local code = str:sub(s + 1, s + 1) last_end = s + 2 local ns, ne = str:find("@", last_end, true) local text if ns then text = str:sub(last_end, ns - 1) else text = str:sub(last_end) end if text ~= "" then table.insert(parts, {text = text, color = aard_colors[code] or "silver"}) end last_end = ns or (#str + 1) s, e = ns, ne end if last_end <= #str then table.insert(parts, {text = str:sub(last_end), color = nil}) end for _, p in ipairs(parts) do ColourTell(p.color or "silver", "", p.text) end Note("") end
-- Text with Aardwolf colour codes, for CDT's own tables. CODED_END ends a coloured -- piece: what follows is back in the row's own colour. A cell holding it is padded -- by what shows, not by its length. CODED_END = "\1"
function CodedPlain(s) return ((tostring(s):gsub("@.", "")):gsub("\1", "")) end
function CodedLen(s) return #CodedPlain(s) end
function CodedPad(s, w, right) local pad = string.rep(" ", math.max(0, w - CodedLen(s))) return right and (pad .. s) or (s .. pad) end
-- ColourNote arguments for coded text, appended to args: text before the first -- code, and after each CODED_END, is in base. function CodedArgs(s, base, args) args = args or {} local colour, from = base, 1 local function add(text) if text ~= "" then args[#args + 1] = colour; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = text end end while true do local at = s:find("[@\1]", from) if not at then add(s:sub(from)); break end add(s:sub(from, at - 1)) if s:sub(at, at) == "\1" then colour, from = base, at + 1 else colour, from = aard_colors[s:sub(at + 1, at + 1)] or base, at + 2 end end return args end
-- A bloot tier as the game shows it: green brackets up to Brilliant, red up to -- Eternal, yellow up to Divine, and Godly in red inside white double brackets; -- names in white. here: for CDT's own tables (ends with CODED_END); without it, -- for a channel. function BlootCode(tier, here) local rank = BLOOT_RANK[tier] local s if tier == "Godly" then s = "@W((@RGodly@W))" elseif rank then local c = rank <= 10 and "@G" or rank <= 15 and "@R" or "@Y" s = c .. "(@W" .. tier .. c .. ")" else s = tostring(tier or "?") end return here and (s .. CODED_END) or s end
-- Channels a report may be sent to. Anything else used to go to the game as a -- command with the report as its argument -- "cdt gains report qp daily" ran the -- game's own daily command, invisibly, because gag_channel_echo hides what is sent. -- Kept deliberately short: the channels a tracker report belongs on. Anything not -- listed is refused rather than guessed at, so a mistyped scope can never become a -- game command. CHANNELS = { echo = true, gtell = true, gt = true, clantalk = true, ct = true, ftalk = true, ft = true, spouse = true, spo = true, } CHANNEL_LIST = "echo, gtell (gt), clantalk (ct), ftalk (ft), spouse (spo)"
-- The words people reach for that are neither a channel nor a scope. CHANNEL_HINTS = { daily = "day (yours) or aardday (Aardwolf's); 7day for a table", today = "day (your day) or aardday (Aardwolf's)", weekly = "week or aardweek", monthly = "month or aardmonth", yearly = "year or aardyear", lifetime = "all", total = "all", alltime = "all", overall = "all", now = "session", current = "session", }
-- Returns the channel, or nil after saying why not. -- The ones you have added with cdt config channels add, as lowercase name -> the -- spelling to send. Typing it in any case finds it; the game gets it as you added it. function ExtraChannels() local raw = type(config.extra_channels) == "table" and config.extra_channels or {} local out = {} for k, v in pairs(raw) do local name = type(v) == "string" and v or k out[name:lower()] = name end return out end
function SetExtraChannels(map) local out = {} for _, name in pairs(map) do out[name:lower()] = name end config.extra_channels = out end
function ChannelListText() local extra = {} for _, name in pairs(ExtraChannels()) do extra[#extra + 1] = name end table.sort(extra) if #extra == 0 then return CHANNEL_LIST end return CHANNEL_LIST .. "; yours: " .. table.concat(extra, " ") end
-- The same, printed as one line or two so neither runs past 80 columns. function ShowChannelList(indent) indent = indent or " " local extra = {} for _, name in pairs(ExtraChannels()) do extra[#extra + 1] = name end table.sort(extra) ColourNote("silver", "", indent .. "Channels: " .. CHANNEL_LIST) if #extra > 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", indent .. "Yours: " .. table.concat(extra, " ")) end end
function CheckChannel(ch, usage) if not ch or ch == "" then return "echo" end local key = ch:lower() if CHANNELS[key] then return key end -- Yours is found whatever case you type; the game gets the spelling you added. if ExtraChannels()[key] then return ExtraChannels()[key] end ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. ch .. " is not a channel, so nothing was sent.") if CHANNEL_HINTS[key] then ColourNote("silver", "", " Did you mean the scope " .. CHANNEL_HINTS[key] .. "?") end ShowChannelList(" ") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config channels add " .. ch .. " adds it to that list.") if usage then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. usage) end return nil end
-- The first word of every cdt command, for "did you mean" on a typo. CDT_COMMANDS = { "gains", "dmg", "tier", "redo", "build", "instinct", "mastery", "snapshot", "dtrack", "listen", "archive", "export", "config", "gag", "events", "flags", "db", "rebuild", "reset", "unstick", "reload", "update", "debug", "version", "help", "toggle", "heal", }
-- Channels of your own go the same way as the built-in ones, so cdt config -- gag_channel_echo hides the command for them too. That means the game sees the -- line, not the command processor: a channel that is a mud-side alias (the fake -- tracker plugin's, say) works; one that is a client-side alias would not. -- The longest line CDT sends to a channel, the channel word and colour codes -- included. A heal report line of 5,000 to 10,000 characters got the client -- disconnected, on the PC and in the container; Aardwolf doesn't document its limit. -- A longer report goes on to the next line, up to CHANNEL_MAX_LINES; past those the -- last line is cut, ending "...". CHANNEL_LINE_MAX = 999 CHANNEL_MAX_LINES = 3 local CHANNEL_CONT = "@D[@CCDT@D] " -- a follow-on line says whose it is
-- Where a too-long line breaks, best first: between a report's sections or healers -- (" @D| "), before a group heal row (" @D2."), before a numbered entry (" @w2."), -- after a comma ("@D, "), at a space. -- {pattern, plain, chars dropped at the break}. A break in the first third of the -- line is passed over for the next kind, so a line isn't left nearly empty. local CHANNEL_BREAKS = {{" @D| ", true, 5}, {" @D%d", false, 1}, {" @w%d", false, 1}, {"@D, ", true, 4}, {" ", true, 1}}
local function LastFind(text, pat, plain) local last, i = nil, 1 while true do local a = text:find(pat, i, plain) if not a then return last end last, i = a, a + 1 end end
-- msg as the lines to send on channel, each within CHANNEL_LINE_MAX, leaving -- reserve characters at the end of each (for the closing $C). function ChannelLines(channel, msg, reserve) reserve = reserve or 0 local room = CHANNEL_LINE_MAX - #(channel or "") - 1 - reserve local lines = {} while #msg > room do if #lines == CHANNEL_MAX_LINES - 1 then local cut = msg:sub(1, room - 6) cut = cut:match("^(.*%S)%s") or cut cut = cut:gsub("@+$", "") -- never end on half a colour code lines[#lines + 1] = cut .. " @D..." return lines end local head, at, drop = msg:sub(1, room), nil, 0 for _, b in ipairs(CHANNEL_BREAKS) do local a = LastFind(head, b[1], b[2]) if a and a > room / 3 then at, drop = a, b[3] break end end if not at then at, drop = room + 1, 0 end lines[#lines + 1] = (msg:sub(1, at - 1):gsub("@+$", "")) msg = CHANNEL_CONT .. msg:sub(at + drop) room = CHANNEL_LINE_MAX - #(channel or "") - 1 - reserve end lines[#lines + 1] = msg return lines end
-- The last lines CDT sent to a channel, so a disconnect just after can say what they -- were (too long a line gets you disconnected): see OnPluginDisconnect. last_channel_send = nil CHANNEL_DROP_SECS = 10
-- Each line CDT sends ends with a colour reset, so a report's last colour doesn't -- bleed into what follows. $C puts one of the game's channels back to its own colour -- (help colors), but only those channels take it: anywhere else it shows as "$C". -- say takes @C, its bright cyan; everything else (echo, tells, a channel of your own -- from cdt config channels add) gets @w, plain grey. CHANNEL_RESET = "$C" local CHANNEL_RESET_ON = { gtell = true, gt = true, clantalk = true, ct = true, ftalk = true, ft = true, spouse = true, spo = true, } local CHANNEL_RESET_SAY = "@C" local CHANNEL_RESET_OTHER = "@w"
function ChannelReset(channel) local cmd = ((channel or ""):match("^%s*(%S+)") or ""):lower() if CHANNEL_RESET_ON[cmd] then return CHANNEL_RESET end if cmd == "say" then return CHANNEL_RESET_SAY end return CHANNEL_RESET_OTHER end
-- Sends msg on a channel (a raw game command), a line at a time. function SendChannelLines(channel, msg, no_echo) local reset = ChannelReset(channel) local lines = ChannelLines(channel, msg, #reset) local lens = {} for _, line in ipairs(lines) do line = line .. reset lens[#lens + 1] = #channel + 1 + #line if no_echo then SendNoEcho(channel .. " " .. line) else Send(channel .. " " .. line) end end last_channel_send = {t = os.time(), channel = channel, lens = lens, start = StripAardColors(lines[1] or ""):sub(1, 60)} end
-- Called on a disconnect: if CDT had just sent to a channel, say so, with how long -- each line was. Always shown (and in the debug and group logs when they're on). function NoteChannelSendBeforeDrop() local ls = last_channel_send last_channel_send = nil if not ls then return end local ago = os.time() - ls.t if ago > CHANNEL_DROP_SECS then return end local msg = string.format("Disconnected %ds after CDT sent %d line%s to %s (%s characters, cap %d): %s...", ago, #ls.lens, #ls.lens == 1 and "" or "s", ls.channel, table.concat(ls.lens, ", "), CHANNEL_LINE_MAX, ls.start) ColourNote("orange", "", "[CDT debug] " .. msg) if double_log and double_log.file then DoubleLogWrite("DBG ", msg) end GroupLog("channel_drop", {channel = ls.channel, lens = ls.lens, ago = ago, cap = CHANNEL_LINE_MAX}) end
function Report(channel, msg) if not channel or channel == "" or channel == "echo" then PrintColoredString(msg .. ChannelReset("echo")) return end SendChannelLines(channel, msg, config.gag_channel_echo) end
function EchoLocal(msg) PrintColoredString(msg) end
-- ============================================================================= -- EVENTS - the automatic reports (cdt events) -- ============================================================================= EVENT_ORDER = {"level", "powerup", "quest", "cp", "gq", "double", "milestone", "goal", "session", "wrapup"} EVENT_INFO = { level = "level-ups", powerup = "powerups", quest = "quest completions", cp = "campaign completions", gq = "GQ results", double = "double XP starting and ending", milestone = "milestones reached", goal = "a goal reached", session = "a tracked session's summary when it ends", wrapup = "the day's totals when Aardwolf's day ends", } -- Which number a level-up or powerup line shows, and its label in the line. EVENT_COUNTS = { level = { order = {"remort", "total", "daily", "aarddaily", "weekly", "aardweekly"}, remort = "your level", total = "total levels across every tier, redo and remort", daily = "level-ups today (your timezone)", aarddaily = "level-ups today (Aardwolf's day, US Eastern)", weekly = "level-ups this week, from your week start day (your timezone)", aardweekly = "level-ups this week from Monday (US Eastern, Aardwolf's week)", }, powerup = { order = {"remort", "lifetime", "daily", "aarddaily", "weekly", "aardweekly"}, remort = "this remort's powerup number", lifetime = "lifetime powerups (from whois)", daily = "powerups today (your timezone)", aarddaily = "powerups today (Aardwolf's day, US Eastern)", weekly = "powerups this week, from your week start day (your timezone)", aardweekly = "powerups this week from Monday (US Eastern, Aardwolf's week)", }, } COUNT_LABELS = {remort = "remort", total = "total", lifetime = "lifetime", daily = "today", aarddaily = "aard day", weekly = "week", aardweekly = "aard week"}
-- True when mode is one of the number settings an event takes. function IsCountMode(evt, mode) for _, m in ipairs((EVENT_COUNTS[evt] or {}).order or {}) do if m == mode then return true end end return false end
function EventSettings(evt) local e = config.events and config.events[evt] if type(e) ~= "table" then e = {on = true, channel = "echo"} end return e end function EventOn(evt) return EventSettings(evt).on ~= false end function EventChannel(evt) local ch = EventSettings(evt).channel return (ch and ch ~= "") and ch or "echo" end
-- Saved settings from before cdt events kept a toggle and a channel per event, and -- powerups shared level's. They carry over once; the old tables are then dropped. function MigrateEventConfig(saved) if type(saved) ~= "table" then saved = {} end local toggles = type(saved.toggles) == "table" and saved.toggles or {} local channels = type(saved.channels) == "table" and saved.channels or {} if type(saved.events) ~= "table" then for _, evt in ipairs(EVENT_ORDER) do local old = evt == "powerup" and "level" or evt local e = config.events[evt] if toggles["report_" .. old] ~= nil then e.on = toggles["report_" .. old] and true or false end if type(channels[old]) == "string" and channels[old] ~= "" then e.channel = channels[old] end end end if saved.gag_channel_echo == nil and toggles.gag_channel_echo ~= nil then config.gag_channel_echo = toggles.gag_channel_echo and true or false end config.toggles, config.channels = nil, nil for evt, counts in pairs(EVENT_COUNTS) do if not IsCountMode(evt, config.events[evt].count) then config.events[evt].count = "remort" end end end
-- ============================================================================= -- LISTEN MODE - respond to channel queries -- ============================================================================= local LISTEN_CHANNELS = { ftalk = "ft", gtell = "gt", spouse = "spouse", clantalk = "ct", say = "say", }
local listen_clan_players = {}
function LoadClanAllowlist() listen_clan_players = {} if not config.listen_clan_rosters then return end for _, members in pairs(config.listen_clan_rosters) do for pname in pairs(members) do listen_clan_players[pname] = true end end end
local roster_capture = { clan = nil, names = {}, active = false, }
function OnRosterLine(name, line, wildcards) if not roster_capture.active then return end local pname = wildcards[2] if pname and pname ~= "Name" and pname ~= "---" then roster_capture.names[#roster_capture.names + 1] = pname end DoAfterSpecial(1.5, "FinalizeRosterCapture()", sendto.script) end
-- No roster came back (a misspelt clan, or the game refused): stop listening for -- roster lines. Left running, the next numbered line from anything else would be -- read as a member and allowlisted under that clan. function RosterCaptureTimeout(clan) if not roster_capture.active or roster_capture.clan ~= clan or #roster_capture.names > 0 then return end roster_capture.active = false EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_roster_cap", false) ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No roster came back for '" .. clan .. "' - nothing was allowlisted.") ColourNote("silver", "", " Check the clan name and try again.") end
function FinalizeRosterCapture() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_roster_cap", false) if not roster_capture.active or not roster_capture.clan then return end roster_capture.active = false
local clan = roster_capture.clan:lower() local names = roster_capture.names
if #names == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No roster data captured for '" .. clan .. "'.") return end
if not config.listen_clan_rosters then config.listen_clan_rosters = {} end local members = {} for _, pname in ipairs(names) do members[pname:lower()] = true end config.listen_clan_rosters[clan] = members state_save()
LoadClanAllowlist()
ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Clan '", "white", "", clan, "cyan", "", "' allowlisted: ", "white", "", tostring(#names), "cyan", "", " players loaded.") end
function StripAardColors(str) str = str:gsub("@x%d%d%d", "") str = str:gsub("@[A-Za-z]", "") str = str:gsub("@@", "@") return str end
function FormatInstinctCostReply(from, to, skill_query, wis) if from < 0 or from > 200 or to < 0 or to > 200 or from >= to then return nil end local trains, gold = InstinctRangeCost(from, to) local result = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @wInst @C%d@D->@C%d@D: @W%s @wtr @D/ @W%s @wgold", from, to, comma_value(trains), short_value(gold)) if skill_query and skill_query ~= "" then skill_query = skill_query:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if skill_query ~= "" then local matches = FindInstinctMatch(skill_query) for _, skill in ipairs(matches) do local ben_before = InstinctBenefitStrColor(skill, from, wis) local ben_after = InstinctBenefitStrColor(skill, to, wis) if ben_before or ben_after then result = result .. string.format(" @D| @w%s @D[%s @D-> %s@D]", skill, ben_before or "@Dn/a", ben_after or "@Dn/a") end end end end return result end
function FormatMasteryCostReply(from, to) if from < 0 or from > 1039 or to < 0 or to > 1039 or from >= to then return nil end local qp, gold = MasteryRangeCost(from, to) local pct_before = MasteryToDmgPct(from) local pct_after = MasteryToDmgPct(to) return string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @wMastery @C%d@D->@C%d@D: @W%s @wQP @D/ @W%s @wgold @D| @Y%.1f%%@D->@Y%.1f%% @wdmg", from, to, comma_value(qp), short_value(gold), pct_before, pct_after) end
function HandleListenQuery(chan, player, msg) if not config.listen or not config.listen[chan] then return end local send_cmd = LISTEN_CHANNELS[chan] if not send_cmd then return end
local pname = (player or ""):lower() local allowed = (config.listen_allow and config.listen_allow[pname]) or listen_clan_players[pname] if not allowed then return end
local stripped = StripAardColors(msg) -- Extract spoken text from channel format: -- Most channels: Name tells ... 'message' (quoted) -- Spouse: (Spouse): message local spoken = stripped:match("'([^']*)'%s*$") or stripped:match("^%(.-%):%s*(.*)") or stripped spoken = (spoken:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "") local lower = spoken:lower()
local inst_lo, inst_hi, inst_skill = lower:match("^cdt instinct%s+(%d+)%s+(%d+)%s+(.*)") if not inst_lo then inst_lo, inst_hi = lower:match("^cdt instinct%s+(%d+)%s+(%d+)") end if inst_lo then local wis = nil if inst_skill then local wis_num = inst_skill:match("(%d+)wis") if wis_num then wis = tonumber(wis_num) inst_skill = inst_skill:gsub("%d+wis", "") end inst_skill = inst_skill:gsub("[^%a%s]", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end local lo, hi = tonumber(inst_lo), tonumber(inst_hi) if lo and hi then local reply = FormatInstinctCostReply(lo, hi, inst_skill, wis) if reply then SendChannelLines(send_cmd, reply, true) end end return end
local mast_lo, mast_hi = lower:match("^cdt mastery%s+(%d+)%s+(%d+)") if mast_lo then local lo, hi = tonumber(mast_lo), tonumber(mast_hi) if lo and hi then local reply = FormatMasteryCostReply(lo, hi) if reply then SendChannelLines(send_cmd, reply, true) end end return end
local meter_allowed = (chan == "say" or chan == "gtell" or chan == "spouse")
local custom_rest = lower:match("^cdt customreport%s+(.*)") if custom_rest then custom_rest = custom_rest:gsub("[^%a%s%+]", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if meter_allowed and custom_rest ~= "" then DmgMeterCustomReport("customreport " .. custom_rest .. " " .. send_cmd, send_cmd) end return end
-- cdt heal report player <name>: the meter's count, one line, on this channel. local heal_rest = lower:match("^cdt heal report%s*(.*)") if heal_rest then if meter_allowed and db and DbTableExists("main", "heal_log") then local words = {"report"} for w in heal_rest:gsub("[^%w%s]", ""):gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end HealReportCommand(words, send_cmd) end return end
local report_rest = lower:match("^cdt report%s+(.*)") if report_rest then report_rest = report_rest:gsub("[^%a%s]", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if meter_allowed and report_rest ~= "" then DmgMeterReport("report " .. report_rest .. " " .. send_cmd, send_cmd) end return end
if lower:find("^cdt help") then local help = "@D[@CCDT@D] @wCommands: " .. "@Ccdt instinct <from> <to> @D(@wcost only@D) @D| " .. "@Ccdt instinct <from> <to> <skill> [<N>wis] @D(@wcost + benefit@D) @D| " .. "@Ccdt mastery <from> <to> @D(@wcost + benefit@D)" if meter_allowed then help = help .. " @D| @Ccdt report <sort> @D(@wdps/dmg/crit/healedme/healedall/healedgrp@D)" .. " @D| @Ccdt report healedme|healedall|healedgrp castsonly" .. " @D| @Ccdt report player <name>" .. " @D| @Ccdt customreport <dps+dmg+crit+avg+healedme+healedall> player <name>" .. " @D| @Ccdt heal report player <name>" end SendChannelLines(send_cmd, help, true) return end end
function CmdListen(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if raw == "" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " CDT Listen Mode") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) for _, ch in ipairs({"gtell", "say", "spouse", "ftalk", "clantalk"}) do local on = config.listen and config.listen[ch] ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-10s ", ch), on and "lime" or "dimgray", "", on and "ON" or "OFF") end ColourNote("yellow", "", " Allowed Players") if config.listen_allow then local names = {} for n in pairs(config.listen_allow) do names[#names + 1] = n end table.sort(names) ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. (#names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "(none)")) else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " (none)") end ColourNote("yellow", "", " Allowed Clans") if config.listen_clan_rosters then local clans = {} for c in pairs(config.listen_clan_rosters) do clans[#clans + 1] = c end table.sort(clans) if #clans > 0 then for _, c in ipairs(clans) do local count = 0 for _ in pairs(config.listen_clan_rosters[c]) do count = count + 1 end ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %s ", c), "dimgray", "", string.format("(%d player%s)", count, count == 1 and "" or "s")) end else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " (none)") end else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " (none)") end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt listen <channel> [on|off]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt listen allow <name> - add player") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt listen remove <name> - remove player") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt listen clanallow <clan> - allowlist clan roster") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt listen clanremove <clan> - remove clan") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) return end
local ch, toggle = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(%S*)") ch = (ch or ""):lower() toggle = (toggle or ""):lower()
if ch == "allow" then local pname = toggle if pname == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt listen allow <player name>") return end if not config.listen_allow then config.listen_allow = {} end config.listen_allow[pname] = true ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Listen allow added: ", "white", "", pname) state_save() return end
if ch == "remove" then local pname = toggle if pname == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt listen remove <player name>") return end if config.listen_allow then config.listen_allow[pname] = nil end ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Listen allow removed: ", "white", "", pname) state_save() return end
if ch == "clanallow" then local clan = toggle if clan == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt listen clanallow <clan name>") return end roster_capture.clan = clan roster_capture.names = {} roster_capture.active = true EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_roster_cap", true) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Fetching roster for '", "white", "", clan, "cyan", "", "'...") SendNoEcho("roster " .. clan .. " 1") DoAfterSpecial(5, string.format("RosterCaptureTimeout(%q)", clan), sendto.script) return end
if ch == "clanremove" then local clan = toggle if clan == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt listen clanremove <clan name>") return end if config.listen_clan_rosters then config.listen_clan_rosters[clan:lower()] = nil end state_save() LoadClanAllowlist() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Clan '", "white", "", clan, "cyan", "", "' removed from listener allowlist.") return end
if not LISTEN_CHANNELS[ch] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown listen command: " .. ch) ColourNote("silver", "", " Channels: ftalk, gtell, spouse, clantalk, say") ColourNote("silver", "", " Or: cdt listen allow/remove/clanallow/clanremove") return end
if not config.listen then config.listen = {} end if toggle == "on" then config.listen[ch] = true elseif toggle == "off" then config.listen[ch] = false else config.listen[ch] = not config.listen[ch] end
local on = config.listen[ch] ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Listen " .. ch .. ": ", on and "lime" or "dimgray", "", on and "ON" or "OFF") state_save() end
function BuildSessionSummary(title, elapsed, d) local parts = {} table.insert(parts, "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@wSession: @W" .. title) table.insert(parts, "@D| @w" .. FormatTimeShort(elapsed)) if d.xp > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @w" .. short_value(d.xp) .. " xp") end if d.qp > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. comma_value(d.qp) .. "@wqp") end if d.gold > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @Y" .. short_value(d.gold) .. "@wg") end if d.levels > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. d.levels .. "@w lvl") end if d.pups > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. d.pups .. "@w pup") end if d.kills > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. comma_value(d.kills) .. "@w kills") end table.insert(parts, "@D]") return table.concat(parts, " ") end
function BuildReportSummary() local active = GetActiveTime() local s = state.session local parts = {} table.insert(parts, "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@wSession @D(@w" .. FormatTimeShort(active) .. "@D)") if s.xp > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @w" .. short_value(s.xp) .. " xp") end if s.qp > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. comma_value(s.qp) .. "@wqp") end if s.gold > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @Y" .. short_value(s.gold) .. "@wg") end if s.trains > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. s.trains .. "@wtr") end if s.levels > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. s.levels .. "@w lvl") end if s.pups > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. s.pups .. "@w pup") end if s.kills > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. comma_value(s.kills) .. "@w kills") end if s.quests_done > 0 then table.insert(parts, "@D| @W" .. s.quests_done .. "@wq") end table.insert(parts, "@D]") return table.concat(parts, " ") end
-- Hides the line a trigger just matched (cdt gag). DeleteLines(1) deletes whatever is -- last in the output, and MUSHclient runs trigger scripts only after lines that other -- triggers hid (omit_from_output) are already gone. So if another plugin hid this line -- first - the ASCII map's capture hides every line while it waits for <MAPEND> - the -- delete took the visible line above it instead: one per damage line, in a big group a -- steady stream, eating the output from the bottom. Now it deletes only when the last -- line in the output really is this one, all of its rows if it wrapped. HIDE_MAX_ROWS = 20 skipped_hides = 0
function HideMatchedLine(line) local last = GetLinesInBufferCount() or 0 -- MUSHclient starts an empty line after a finished one; DeleteLines takes it too if last > 0 and (GetLineInfo(last, 2) or 0) == 0 and not GetLineInfo(last, 3) then last = last - 1 end if last < 1 then return SkippedHide(line, "") end -- the rows of the last line: back to just after the previous hard line break local first = last while first > 1 and last - first < HIDE_MAX_ROWS and not GetLineInfo(first - 1, 3) do first = first - 1 end local parts = {} for i = first, last do -- a note or your own typing isn't a line from the game if GetLineInfo(i, 4) or GetLineInfo(i, 5) then return SkippedHide(line, GetLineInfo(i, 1) or "") end parts[#parts + 1] = GetLineInfo(i, 1) or "" end local text = table.concat(parts) if text ~= line then local a = text:gsub("%s+", "") local b = tostring(line):gsub("%s+", "") if a ~= b then return SkippedHide(line, text) end end DeleteLines(last - first + 1) return true end
function SkippedHide(line, last_text) skipped_hides = skipped_hides + 1 if skipped_hides == 1 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] A line to hide (cdt gag) was already gone from the output - " .. "another plugin hid it first - so CDT left the output alone. Shown once per session.") end DebugNote("Hide skipped: wanted '" .. tostring(line) .. "', last line is '" .. tostring(last_text) .. "'") return false end
function DebugNote(msg) if double_log and double_log.file then DoubleLogWrite("DBG ", msg) end if config.debug_mode then ColourNote("orange", "", "[CDT] " .. msg) end end
-- ============================================================================= -- DATABASE LAYER -- ============================================================================= function db_open() if db then return true end local path = GetInfo(58):gsub("^%.\\", GetInfo(56)) db_path = path .. "\\cirrus_tracker.db" local ok, err = pcall(function() db = sqlite3.open(db_path) end) if not ok or not db then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Failed to open database: " .. tostring(err)) return false end db:exec("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;") db:exec("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL;") -- SQLite's default page cache is 2 MB. The meter's queries alone read more than -- that, and every page that falls out comes back through the file system, which -- on a network drive costs real time on each read. 16 MB keeps them in memory. db:exec("PRAGMA cache_size=-16000;") return true end
function db_close() if db then pcall(function() db:close() end) db = nil end end
function db_exec(sql) if not db then return false end -- After a failed migration the schema may be half-rewritten. Reads still -- work (so 'cdt db' can report state), but nothing gets written until the -- user restores or explicitly chooses to keep the database as-is. if migration_blocked then return false end local ok, err = pcall(function() db:exec(sql) end) if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT DB] " .. tostring(err)) ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT SQL] " .. sql:sub(1, 200)) return false end return true end
function db_query(sql) if not db then return {} end local rows = {} local ok, err = pcall(function() for row in db:nrows(sql) do table.insert(rows, row) end end) if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT DB Query] " .. tostring(err)) ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT SQL] " .. sql:sub(1, 200)) end return rows end
function db_query_one(sql) local rows = db_query(sql) return rows[1] end
function fixsql(s) if s then return "'" .. (tostring(s):gsub("'", "''")) .. "'" else return "NULL" end end
-- Whether a column already exists. Migrations run in sequence, and a table -- created by an earlier step may already carry a column a later step wants to -- add - ALTER would then fail noisily even though the end state is correct. function ColumnExists(tbl, col) if not db then return false end local found = false pcall(function() for row in db:nrows(string.format("PRAGMA table_info(%s);", tbl)) do if row.name == col then found = true end end end) return found end
function AddColumnIfMissing(tbl, col, decl) if ColumnExists(tbl, col) then return false end db_exec(string.format("ALTER TABLE %s ADD COLUMN %s %s;", tbl, col, decl)) return true end
-- ============================================================================= -- MIGRATION SAFETY -- -- Migrations rewrite tables in place, and db_exec deliberately swallows errors -- so one bad statement never kills the plugin. That combination means a failed -- migration could otherwise commit a half-finished schema. So: back the file up -- first, drop a marker while work is in flight, and refuse to touch anything on -- the next load if that marker survived. -- =============================================================================
function DbMarkerPath() return db_path .. ".migrating" end
function DbBackupPath(target_version) return string.format("%s.pre-v%d.bak", db_path, target_version or 0) end
function DbFileExists(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then f:close(); return true end return false end
function DbFileSize(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if not f then return nil end local n = f:seek("end") f:close() return n end
-- Chunked so a large database never has to sit in memory as one string. -- The copy is size-verified afterwards: a short write (disk full part-way) -- otherwise reports success and leaves a truncated backup, which is worse -- than no backup because it looks like one. function DbFileCopy(src, dst) local fin = io.open(src, "rb") if not fin then return false, "cannot read " .. src end local fout = io.open(dst, "wb") if not fout then fin:close(); return false, "cannot write " .. dst end local written = 0 local ok, err = pcall(function() while true do local chunk = fin:read(1024 * 256) if not chunk or #chunk == 0 then break end fout:write(chunk) written = written + #chunk end end) fin:close() fout:close() if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
local src_size = DbFileSize(src) local dst_size = DbFileSize(dst) if src_size and dst_size and dst_size ~= src_size then return false, string.format("copy is %s bytes but source is %s - backup incomplete", comma_value(dst_size), comma_value(src_size)) end if src_size and written ~= src_size then return false, string.format("wrote %s of %s bytes", comma_value(written), comma_value(src_size)) end return true end
-- Runs before any migration. Checkpoints the WAL so the copy is complete, -- writes the backup, then drops the in-flight marker. function BeginMigrationGuard(from_v, to_v) if db_path == "" then return false, "no database path" end pcall(function() db:exec("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);") end)
local backup = DbBackupPath(to_v) local ok, err = DbFileCopy(db_path, backup) if not ok then return false, "backup failed: " .. tostring(err) end
local m = io.open(DbMarkerPath(), "w") if not m then return false, "could not write migration marker" end m:write(string.format("from=%d\nto=%d\nbackup=%s\ntime=%d\n", from_v or 0, to_v or 0, backup, os.time())) m:close() local sz = DbFileSize(backup) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Pre-migration backup: %s (%s bytes, verified)", backup:match("[^\\/]+$") or backup, comma_value(sz or 0))) return true end
function EndMigrationGuard() os.remove(DbMarkerPath()) end
-- A pre-migration backup is a full copy of the database, made automatically, one -- per version upgraded to. The newest few are worth keeping; older ones are of no -- use once later upgrades have happened. Backups you make yourself with -- cdt db backup are timestamped, kept separately and never removed by this. DB_BACKUPS_KEPT = 3
function PruneMigrationBackups(report) local marker = ReadMigrationMarker() local found = {} for v = 2, DB_VERSION do local path = DbBackupPath(v) if DbFileExists(path) then found[#found + 1] = path end end local removed = {} for i, path in ipairs(found) do local newest = i > #found - DB_BACKUPS_KEPT local in_use = marker and marker.backup == path if not newest and not in_use and os.remove(path) then removed[#removed + 1] = path:match("[^\\/]+$") or path end end if #removed > 0 then ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Removed %d older automatic backup%s, keeping the newest %d.", #removed, #removed == 1 and "" or "s", DB_BACKUPS_KEPT)) for _, name in ipairs(removed) do ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. name) end elseif report then ColourNote("silver", "", string.format("[CDT] Nothing to remove: %d automatic backup%s, the newest %d are kept.", #found, #found == 1 and "" or "s", DB_BACKUPS_KEPT)) end return #removed end
-- Reads a marker left behind by a migration that never finished. function ReadMigrationMarker() local f = io.open(DbMarkerPath(), "r") if not f then return nil end local info = {} for line in f:lines() do local k, v = line:match("^(%w+)=(.*)$") if k then info[k] = v end end f:close() return info end
function RestoreDbFromBackup(backup_path) if not DbFileExists(backup_path) then return false, "backup file not found: " .. backup_path end db_close() -- Stale WAL/SHM would otherwise be replayed over the restored file. os.remove(db_path .. "-wal") os.remove(db_path .. "-shm") local ok, err = DbFileCopy(backup_path, db_path) if not ok then return false, err end os.remove(DbMarkerPath()) return true end
-- Collapses consecutive instinct/mastery snapshots that hold identical values -- down to the earliest one in each run. Repeated identical snapshots (the login -- auto-capture, mostly) carry no new information and, left in place, would keep -- resetting the damage baseline and discarding usable data. function DedupeSnapshots() if not db then return 0 end local removed = 0 local types = { {t = "instinct", tbl = "instinct_detail", k = "attack_name", v = "instinct_count"}, {t = "mastery", tbl = "mastery_detail", k = "skill_name", v = "mastery_pct"}, } for _, spec in ipairs(types) do local heads = db_query(string.format( "SELECT h.id FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN %s d ON d.header_id = h.id " .. "WHERE h.type = %s GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id ASC", spec.tbl, fixsql(spec.t))) if #heads > 1 then local rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT header_id, %s AS k, %s AS v FROM %s", spec.k, spec.v, spec.tbl)) local by_head = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local tt = by_head[r.header_id] if not tt then tt = {}; by_head[r.header_id] = tt end tt[tostring(r.k):lower()] = tonumber(r.v) or 0 end local function same(a, b) if not a or not b then return false end local na, nb = 0, 0 for kk, vv in pairs(a) do na = na + 1 if b[kk] ~= vv then return false end end for _ in pairs(b) do nb = nb + 1 end return na == nb end local doomed = {} local anchor = heads[1].id for i = 2, #heads do local id = heads[i].id if same(by_head[anchor], by_head[id]) then doomed[#doomed + 1] = id else anchor = id end end if #doomed > 0 then db_exec("BEGIN;") for _, id in ipairs(doomed) do db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM %s WHERE header_id = %d", spec.tbl, id)) db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM snapshot_dmg_baseline WHERE header_id = %d", id)) db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM snapshot_headers WHERE id = %d", id)) removed = removed + 1 end db_exec("COMMIT;") end end end return removed end
-- Most recent race recorded alongside `cls` in the gains tables. Those carry -- both a timestamp and a race, so the race a class was played as can be inferred -- from real data rather than assumed from whoever is logged in right now. function InferRaceForClass(cls) if not db then return nil end local where_cls = cls and cls ~= "" and (" AND class = " .. fixsql(cls)) or "" local row = db_query_one(string.format([[ SELECT race FROM ( SELECT race, time FROM kills WHERE race != ''%s UNION ALL SELECT race, time FROM gold_log WHERE race != ''%s UNION ALL SELECT race, time FROM earnings WHERE race != ''%s ) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1]], where_cls, where_cls, where_cls)) if row and row.race and row.race ~= "" then return row.race end return nil end
-- v18: damage is kept per character level, tier, remort and redo, and per 30-minute -- slice, so every damage table needs all of them in its primary key. SQLite cannot change a primary key -- in place, so each table is copied into a replacement with the new key, the copy -- is checked against the original (row count and damage total), and only then -- swapped in. All five go in one transaction, so a failure anywhere leaves the -- database as it was. Existing rows get level 0, slice 0 and tier/remort/redo -1, -- all meaning "unknown": none of it was ever stored, so there is nothing to split -- them by. -1 rather than NULL because these are key columns. DAMAGE_SLICE_TABLES = { {tbl = "attack_stats", total = "total_damage", cols = "attack_name, damtype, category, class, race, total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits, total_crits, min_hit, max_hit, precise_hits, precise_damage", ddl = [[CREATE TABLE %s ( attack_name TEXT NOT NULL, damtype TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', category TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', class TEXT NOT NULL, race TEXT DEFAULT '', total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, total_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_crits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, min_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, precise_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, precise_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (attack_name, class, race, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start) )]]}, {tbl = "damtype_stats", total = "total_damage", cols = "damtype, class, total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits", ddl = [[CREATE TABLE %s ( damtype TEXT NOT NULL, class TEXT NOT NULL, total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, total_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (damtype, class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start) )]]}, {tbl = "area_combat_stats", total = "total_damage", cols = "area, class, grouped, total_damage, total_received, combat_secs", ddl = [[CREATE TABLE %s ( area TEXT NOT NULL, class TEXT NOT NULL, grouped INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_received INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (area, class, grouped, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start) )]]}, {tbl = "player_profiles", total = "total_damage", cols = "player, total_damage, combat_secs, melee_damage, spell_damage, total_hits, total_crits, sessions_seen, first_seen, last_seen", ddl = [[CREATE TABLE %s ( player TEXT NOT NULL, total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, melee_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, spell_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_crits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, sessions_seen INTEGER DEFAULT 0, first_seen INTEGER NOT NULL, last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (player, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start) )]]}, {tbl = "player_attack_stats", total = "total_damage", cols = "player, attack_name, damtype, category, total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits, total_crits, min_hit, max_hit, precise_hits, precise_damage, last_seen", ddl = [[CREATE TABLE %s ( player TEXT NOT NULL, attack_name TEXT NOT NULL, damtype TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', category TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, total_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_crits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, min_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, precise_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, precise_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (player, attack_name, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start) )]]}, }
-- Estimated pre-v3.9 damage, in the same 30-minute slices as new data. LEGACY_DAMAGE_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS legacy_damage ( slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL, window_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', attack_name TEXT NOT NULL, damtype TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', category TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', damage REAL DEFAULT 0, est_combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (slice_start, window_start, level, tier, remort, redo, class, race, attack_name) )]]
-- Pre-v3.9 damage was only kept as running totals, but every instinct/mastery -- snapshot copied those totals, so the damage dealt between two consecutive -- snapshots is known. Each such stretch is spread evenly over the time you were -- online during it (from the sessions table; offline time gets nothing), in the -- same 30-minute slices that new data uses. Level, subclass and race come from -- the snapshot that opens the stretch. Combat time was never copied, so DPS uses -- each attack's average over all pre-v3.9 combat. Runs once, inside v18. function BuildLegacyDamage(now) if not db_exec(LEGACY_DAMAGE_DDL .. ";") then error("could not create legacy_damage") end db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_legacy_damage_slice ON legacy_damage(slice_start);") db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_legacy_damage_window ON legacy_damage(window_start);")
-- Readings: every snapshot's copied totals, oldest first, then the totals now. local heads = db_query( "SELECT h.id, h.time, h.level, h.tier, h.remort, h.class, h.race FROM snapshot_headers h " .. "WHERE h.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT header_id FROM snapshot_dmg_baseline) ORDER BY h.time, h.id") if #heads == 0 then return 0 end local by_head = {} for _, r in ipairs(db_query( "SELECT header_id, attack_name, damtype, category, total_damage FROM snapshot_dmg_baseline")) do local t = by_head[r.header_id] if not t then t = {}; by_head[r.header_id] = t end t[r.attack_name] = {d = tonumber(r.total_damage) or 0, dt = r.damtype, cat = r.category} end local readings = {} for _, h in ipairs(heads) do -- Snapshots recorded tier and remort but never redo, so redo stays unknown. readings[#readings + 1] = {time = tonumber(h.time) or 0, level = tonumber(h.level) or 0, tier = tonumber(h.tier) or -1, remort = tonumber(h.remort) or -1, class = h.class or "", race = h.race or "", totals = by_head[h.id] or {}} end local final, secs_per_dmg = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(db_query( "SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS dt, MAX(category) AS cat, SUM(total_damage) AS td, " .. "SUM(combat_secs) AS cs FROM attack_stats GROUP BY attack_name")) do local td = tonumber(r.td) or 0 final[r.attack_name] = {d = td, dt = r.dt, cat = r.cat} if td > 0 then secs_per_dmg[r.attack_name] = (tonumber(r.cs) or 0) / td end end readings[#readings + 1] = {time = now, totals = final}
-- Online intervals, oldest first. A session with no end (a crash, a force-quit, -- a session reset) is taken to end when the next one starts, and no session may -- run past the start of the next. local online = {} local sess = db_query("SELECT start_time, end_time FROM sessions WHERE start_time > 0 ORDER BY start_time") for i, r in ipairs(sess) do local st = tonumber(r.start_time) or 0 local en = tonumber(r.end_time) or 0 local next_start = sess[i + 1] and tonumber(sess[i + 1].start_time) or now if en <= 0 or en > next_start then en = next_start end if en > st then online[#online + 1] = {st, en} end end
-- Each row also records when its stretch opened (the snapshot's time), so a -- "since snapshot X" window can take exactly the stretches that began in it. local acc, order = {}, {} local function add(slice, rd, attack, info, dmg) local key = table.concat({slice, rd.time, rd.level, rd.tier, rd.remort, rd.class, rd.race, attack}, "\1") local row = acc[key] if not row then row = {slice = slice, window = rd.time, level = rd.level, tier = rd.tier, remort = rd.remort, class = rd.class, race = rd.race, attack = attack, dt = info.dt or "unknown", cat = info.cat or "unknown", dmg = 0} acc[key] = row order[#order + 1] = key end row.dmg = row.dmg + dmg end
local oi = 1 for k = 1, #readings - 1 do local A, B = readings[k], readings[k + 1] if B.time > A.time then local diffs, any = {}, false for attack, b in pairs(B.totals) do local d = b.d - ((A.totals[attack] and A.totals[attack].d) or 0) if d > 0 then diffs[attack] = {d = d, info = b}; any = true end end if any then while online[oi] and online[oi][2] <= A.time do oi = oi + 1 end local pieces, total = {}, 0 local j = oi while online[j] and online[j][1] < B.time do local from = math.max(online[j][1], A.time) local to = math.min(online[j][2], B.time) while from < to do local slice = from - from % DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS local stop = math.min(to, slice + DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS) pieces[slice] = (pieces[slice] or 0) + (stop - from) total = total + (stop - from) from = stop end j = j + 1 end if total <= 0 then -- No session covers this stretch: place it all where it began. pieces = {[A.time - A.time % DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS] = 1} total = 1 end for slice, secs in pairs(pieces) do local share = secs / total for attack, x in pairs(diffs) do add(slice, A, attack, x.info, x.d * share) end end end end end
-- Every share is kept, however small: a stretch spread over many attacks and -- slices produces fractions that add up, and dropping them loses real damage. local written = 0 for _, key in ipairs(order) do local r = acc[key] if r.dmg > 0 then if not db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO legacy_damage (slice_start, window_start, level, tier, remort, redo, " .. "class, race, attack_name, damtype, category, damage, est_combat_secs) " .. "VALUES (%d, %d, %d, %d, %d, -1, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %.3f, %.3f)", r.slice, r.window, r.level, r.tier, r.remort, fixsql(r.class), fixsql(r.race), fixsql(r.attack), fixsql(r.dt), fixsql(r.cat), r.dmg, r.dmg * (secs_per_dmg[r.attack] or 0))) then error("could not write legacy_damage") end written = written + 1 end end return written end
-- Your deaths, stamped like every other event. DEATHS_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deaths ( death_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, time INTEGER NOT NULL, mob_name TEXT DEFAULT '', area TEXT DEFAULT '', room_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, level_num INTEGER DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER DEFAULT -1, class TEXT DEFAULT '', race TEXT DEFAULT '', grouped INTEGER DEFAULT 0, session_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, opk INTEGER DEFAULT -1, hardcore INTEGER DEFAULT -1 )]]
-- Fights that ended without the mob dying: you fled, recalled, or it escaped. UNFINISHED_FIGHTS_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS unfinished_fights ( fight_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, time INTEGER NOT NULL, mob_name TEXT DEFAULT '', area TEXT DEFAULT '', room_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, level_num INTEGER DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER DEFAULT -1, class TEXT DEFAULT '', race TEXT DEFAULT '', grouped INTEGER DEFAULT 0, session_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, rounds INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, reason TEXT DEFAULT '' -- see SaveUnfinishedFight )]]
-- Kill columns filled by the fight tracker. fight_tracked = 1 marks kills it saw -- from start to finish; only those have damage, rounds and combat time. KILL_FIGHT_COLUMNS = { {"mob_name", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"}, {"room_id", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"}, {"damage", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"}, {"rounds", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"}, {"combat_secs", "REAL DEFAULT 0"}, {"mob_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT -1"}, {"fight_tracked", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"}, }
-- Event tables that carry tier/remort/redo, and the column that says when each -- row happened (levels and quests span a start and an end; the later counts). PROGRESS_STAMP_TABLES = { {tbl = "kills", time = "time"}, {tbl = "levels", time = "MAX(start_time, end_time)"}, {tbl = "quests", time = "MAX(start_time, end_time)"}, {tbl = "campaigns", time = "MAX(start_time, end_time)"}, {tbl = "gquests", time = "MAX(start_time, end_time)"}, {tbl = "earnings", time = "time"}, }
function MigrateProgressStamps() for _, spec in ipairs(PROGRESS_STAMP_TABLES) do for _, col in ipairs({{"tier", "INTEGER DEFAULT -1"}, {"remort", "INTEGER DEFAULT -1"}, {"redo", "INTEGER DEFAULT -1"}, {"stamp_estimated", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"}}) do AddColumnIfMissing(spec.tbl, col[1], col[2]) if not ColumnExists(spec.tbl, col[1]) then error(spec.tbl .. ": could not add column " .. col[1]) end end if not db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_" .. spec.tbl .. "_session ON " .. spec.tbl .. "(session_id);") then error(spec.tbl .. ": could not index session_id") end end for _, col in ipairs(KILL_FIGHT_COLUMNS) do AddColumnIfMissing("kills", col[1], col[2]) if not ColumnExists("kills", col[1]) then error("kills: could not add column " .. col[1]) end end if not db_exec(UNFINISHED_FIGHTS_DDL .. ";") then error("could not create unfinished_fights") end db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_unfinished_fights_time ON unfinished_fights(time);") AddColumnIfMissing("sessions", "redo", "INTEGER DEFAULT -1") if not ColumnExists("sessions", "redo") then error("sessions: could not add column redo") end if not db_exec(DEATHS_DDL .. ";") then error("could not create deaths") end db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_deaths_time ON deaths(time);") return EstimateProgressStamps() end
-- Old event rows never recorded tier or remort, but each carries a session_id and -- sessions recorded both when they started. A row takes its session's values, -- marked stamp_estimated. A remort partway through a session shows up as your -- level falling from 200+ to single digits: rows from that moment take the values -- of the next session that recorded them, which is what the remort led to. -- Redo was never recorded anywhere, so it stays unknown. Only rows still at -1 are -- touched, so running this twice changes nothing. function EstimateProgressStamps() local sessions = db_query("SELECT session_id, start_time, tier, remort FROM sessions ORDER BY start_time, session_id") -- A session's values count only if remort is set: 0 means GMCP had not sent -- them yet when the session began. local function values(i) local r = sessions[i] if r and (tonumber(r.remort) or 0) > 0 then return tonumber(r.tier) or -1, tonumber(r.remort) end return nil end local stamped, remorts_seen = 0, 0 for i, sess in ipairs(sessions) do local sid = tonumber(sess.session_id) or 0 if sid > 0 then local before_tier, before_remort = values(i) local after_tier, after_remort for j = i + 1, #sessions do after_tier, after_remort = values(j) if after_tier then break end end local drop_at, prev = nil, nil for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format( "SELECT time AS t, level_num AS lv FROM kills WHERE session_id = %d UNION ALL " .. "SELECT end_time AS t, level_num AS lv FROM levels WHERE session_id = %d AND type = 'level' " .. "ORDER BY t", sid, sid))) do local lv = tonumber(r.lv) or 0 if lv > 0 then if prev and prev >= 200 and lv <= 10 then drop_at = tonumber(r.t) break end prev = lv end end if drop_at then remorts_seen = remorts_seen + 1 end for _, spec in ipairs(PROGRESS_STAMP_TABLES) do local function stamp(tier, remort, extra) if not tier then return end if not db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE %s SET tier = %d, remort = %d, stamp_estimated = 1 " .. "WHERE session_id = %d AND tier = -1 AND remort = -1%s", spec.tbl, tier, remort, sid, extra)) then error(spec.tbl .. ": could not estimate tier/remort for session " .. sid) end local c = db_query_one("SELECT changes() AS n") stamped = stamped + (c and tonumber(c.n) or 0) end if drop_at then stamp(before_tier, before_remort, string.format(" AND %s < %d", spec.time, drop_at)) stamp(after_tier, after_remort, string.format(" AND %s >= %d", spec.time, drop_at)) else stamp(before_tier, before_remort, "") end end end end return stamped, remorts_seen end
function MigrateDamageSlices() if not db then return "" end local function fail(msg) db_exec("ROLLBACK;") error(msg) end if not db_exec("BEGIN;") then error("could not start a transaction") end local kept = 0 for _, spec in ipairs(DAMAGE_SLICE_TABLES) do local t, tmp = spec.tbl, spec.tbl .. "_sliced" local count_sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(" .. spec.total .. "), 0) AS d FROM " local pre = db_query_one(count_sql .. t) if not pre then fail(t .. ": could not read the original table") end if not db_exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS " .. tmp .. ";") or not db_exec(string.format(spec.ddl, tmp) .. ";") then fail(t .. ": could not create the replacement table") end if not db_exec("INSERT INTO " .. tmp .. " (" .. spec.cols .. ", level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start) SELECT " .. spec.cols .. ", 0, -1, -1, -1, 0 FROM " .. t .. ";") then fail(t .. ": copy failed, original left untouched") end local post = db_query_one(count_sql .. tmp) if not post or tonumber(post.n) ~= tonumber(pre.n) or tonumber(post.d) ~= tonumber(pre.d) then fail(string.format("%s: copy mismatch (%s rows / %s damage -> %s rows / %s damage)", t, tostring(pre.n), tostring(pre.d), tostring(post and post.n), tostring(post and post.d))) end if not db_exec("DROP TABLE " .. t .. ";") or not db_exec("ALTER TABLE " .. tmp .. " RENAME TO " .. t .. ";") then fail(t .. ": could not swap in the replacement table") end if not db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_" .. t .. "_slice ON " .. t .. "(slice_start);") then fail(t .. ": could not index the replacement table") end kept = kept + (tonumber(pre.n) or 0) end if not db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_attack_player ON player_attack_stats(player);") then fail("could not recreate the player_attack_stats index") end local ok_legacy, legacy_or_err = pcall(BuildLegacyDamage, os.time()) if not ok_legacy then fail("could not estimate pre-v3.9 damage: " .. tostring(legacy_or_err)) end -- Kills, levels, quests, campaigns, GQs and rewards get tier/remort/redo too, -- plus the deaths table, in the same transaction. local ok_stamps, stamped, remorts_seen = pcall(MigrateProgressStamps) if not ok_stamps then fail("could not add tier/remort/redo to event records: " .. tostring(stamped)) end if not db_exec("COMMIT;") then fail("commit failed") end return comma_value(kept) .. " existing rows kept, with level and time unknown; " .. comma_value(legacy_or_err) .. " estimated slices of pre-v3.9 damage built from snapshots; " .. comma_value(stamped or 0) .. " older event records given an estimated tier/remort (" .. tostring(remorts_seen or 0) .. " mid-session remorts detected)" end
-- Rebuilds attack_stats with a race column and stamps existing rows per class. -- Guarded on there being no race-tagged rows yet, so it cannot collide with the -- new (attack_name, class, race) primary key. function MigrateAttackStatsRace() if not db then return "" end
-- Row/damage counts from before the rebuild, to verify the copy landed -- intact before anything irreversible happens. local pre = db_query_one("SELECT COUNT(*) as n, COALESCE(SUM(total_damage),0) as d FROM attack_stats") local pre_n = (pre and pre.n) or 0 local pre_d = (pre and pre.d) or 0
db_exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS attack_stats_new;") db_exec("BEGIN;") if not db_exec([[CREATE TABLE attack_stats_new ( attack_name TEXT NOT NULL, damtype TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', category TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', class TEXT NOT NULL, race TEXT DEFAULT '', total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, total_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_crits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, min_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (attack_name, class, race) );]]) then db_exec("ROLLBACK;") error("attack_stats rebuild: could not create replacement table") end if not db_exec([[INSERT OR REPLACE INTO attack_stats_new (attack_name, damtype, category, class, race, total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits, total_crits, min_hit, max_hit) SELECT attack_name, damtype, category, class, '', total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits, total_crits, min_hit, max_hit FROM attack_stats;]]) then db_exec("ROLLBACK;") error("attack_stats rebuild: copy failed, original left untouched") end
-- Only drop the original once the copy is provably complete. local post = db_query_one("SELECT COUNT(*) as n, COALESCE(SUM(total_damage),0) as d FROM attack_stats_new") local post_n = (post and post.n) or 0 local post_d = (post and post.d) or 0 if post_n ~= pre_n or post_d ~= pre_d then db_exec("ROLLBACK;") error(string.format( "attack_stats rebuild: copy mismatch (%d rows/%s dmg -> %d rows/%s dmg), original left untouched", pre_n, tostring(pre_d), post_n, tostring(post_d))) end
db_exec("DROP TABLE attack_stats;") db_exec("ALTER TABLE attack_stats_new RENAME TO attack_stats;") db_exec("COMMIT;")
local final = db_query_one("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM attack_stats") if not final or (final.n or 0) ~= pre_n then error("attack_stats rebuild: row count wrong after rename") end
local classes = db_query("SELECT DISTINCT class FROM attack_stats") local fallback = InferRaceForClass(nil) or state.current.race if fallback == "" then fallback = nil end local counts, unresolved = {}, 0 db_exec("BEGIN;") for _, c in ipairs(classes) do local r = InferRaceForClass(c.class) or fallback if r and r ~= "" then db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE attack_stats SET race = %s WHERE class = %s AND race = ''", fixsql(r), fixsql(c.class))) counts[r] = (counts[r] or 0) + 1 else unresolved = unresolved + 1 end end db_exec("COMMIT;")
local parts = {} for r, n in pairs(counts) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s x%d", r, n) end table.sort(parts) local summary if #parts > 0 then summary = string.format("backfilled race for %d class%s (%s)", #classes - unresolved, (#classes - unresolved) == 1 and "" or "es", table.concat(parts, ", ")) else summary = "no race data available to backfill" end if unresolved > 0 then summary = summary .. string.format(", %d left unresolved", unresolved) end return summary end
-- ============================================================================= -- AARDWOLF'S DAY -- Daily resets (the first campaign of the day, daily bonuses) follow midnight US -- Eastern, whatever timezone MUSHclient runs in. Plain arithmetic on Unix time, so -- it doesn't depend on the computer's timezone or on the C library's tz database. -- ============================================================================= -- Days since 1970-01-01 for a calendar date (Howard Hinnant's algorithm). function DaysFromCivil(y, m, d) if m <= 2 then y = y - 1 end local era = math.floor(y / 400) local yoe = y - era * 400 local mp = (m + 9) % 12 -- March = 0 local doy = math.floor((153 * mp + 2) / 5) + d - 1 local doe = yoe * 365 + math.floor(yoe / 4) - math.floor(yoe / 100) + doy return era * 146097 + doe - 719468 end
-- The day number of the nth Sunday of a month. function NthSundayDay(y, m, nth) local first = DaysFromCivil(y, m, 1) local wday = (first + 4) % 7 -- 0 = Sunday; 1970-01-01 was a Thursday return first + (7 - wday) % 7 + (nth - 1) * 7 end
-- -4 during US daylight saving (2am on the second Sunday of March to 2am on the -- first Sunday of November, local), -5 otherwise. function EasternOffsetHours(ts) local y = tonumber(os.date("!%Y", ts)) local dst_start = NthSundayDay(y, 3, 2) * 86400 + 7 * 3600 -- 02:00 EST = 07:00 UTC local dst_end = NthSundayDay(y, 11, 1) * 86400 + 6 * 3600 -- 02:00 EDT = 06:00 UTC return (ts >= dst_start and ts < dst_end) and -4 or -5 end
-- "2026-08-27" for a Unix time: the Aardwolf day it fell on. function EasternDate(ts) ts = tonumber(ts) or 0 return os.date("!%Y-%m-%d", ts + EasternOffsetHours(ts) * 3600) end
-- The Unix time the Aardwolf day holding ts began, or with week set, the Monday -- that began its week.
