The offset is read at 05:00 UTC that day, which is before -- either DST change (07:00 and 06:00 UTC), so it is the offset in force at midnight. function EasternDayStart(ts, week) ts = tonumber(ts) or os.time() local day = math.floor((ts + EasternOffsetHours(ts) * 3600) / 86400) if week then day = day - (day + 3) % 7 end -- 1970-01-01 was a Thursday: (day + 3) % 7 is days since Monday local midnight_utc = day * 86400 return midnight_utc - EasternOffsetHours(midnight_utc + 5 * 3600) * 3600 end
-- ============================================================================= -- TIMEZONE -- Times are stored as Unix time. Shown, and typed into date filters, they use the -- computer's timezone, or a fixed offset set with cdt config timezone. A fixed offset has -- no daylight saving: whoever sets one changes it when their clocks change. -- ============================================================================= -- The override in seconds east of UTC, or nil for the computer's own timezone. function TZOffsetSeconds() local m = tonumber(config and config.tz_offset_minutes) return m and m * 60 or nil end
-- "UTC-8", "UTC+5:30"; nil without an override. function TZLabel(minutes) local m = tonumber(minutes or (config and config.tz_offset_minutes)) if not m then return nil end local sign = m < 0 and "-" or "+" m = math.abs(m) local label = string.format("UTC%s%d", sign, math.floor(m / 60)) if m % 60 > 0 then label = label .. string.format(":%02d", m % 60) end return label end
-- os.date, in the override timezone when one is set. function TZDate(fmt, ts) fmt = fmt or "%c" ts = tonumber(ts) or os.time() local off = TZOffsetSeconds() if not off then return os.date(fmt, ts) end local shifted = math.max(0, ts + off) if fmt:sub(1, 2) == "*t" then return os.date("!*t", shifted) end return os.date("!" .. fmt:gsub("%%Z", TZLabel()), shifted) end
-- The date order set with cdt config dateformat. Every form keeps the same width -- (10 characters with the year, 5 without), so tables line up whichever is chosen. DATE_FORMATS = { mdy = {label = "M/D/Y", full = "%m/%d/%Y", short = "%m/%d", typed = "M/D/YYYY", example = "2/3/2026", example2 = "2/4/2026", short_example = "02/03"}, dmy = {label = "D/M/Y", full = "%d/%m/%Y", short = "%d/%m", typed = "D/M/YYYY", example = "3/2/2026", example2 = "4/2/2026", short_example = "03/02"}, ymd = {label = "Y/M/D", full = "%Y/%m/%d", short = "%m/%d", typed = "YYYY/M/D", example = "2026/2/3", example2 = "2026/2/4", short_example = "02/03"}, } function DateFormatKey() return DATE_FORMATS[config and config.date_format or ""] and config.date_format or "mdy" end function DateFormat() return DATE_FORMATS[DateFormatKey()] end
-- A display format with its date part put in the chosen order: %Y-%m-%d and -- %m/%d/%Y become the full date, a bare %m/%d the date without a year. function DateFmt(fmt) local f = DateFormat() fmt = fmt:gsub("%%Y%-%%m%-%%d", "\1"):gsub("%%m/%%d/%%Y", "\1"):gsub("%%m/%%d", "\2") return (fmt:gsub("[\1\2]", function(c) return c == "\1" and f.full or f.short end)) end
-- TZDate for anything shown on screen: the timezone and the date order both apply. -- Names, notes and exports that are saved keep TZDate's fixed ISO dates. function ShowDate(fmt, ts) return TZDate(DateFmt(fmt), ts) end
-- os.time for a calendar table, read in the override timezone when one is set. function TZTime(t) local off = TZOffsetSeconds() if not off then return os.time(t) end return DaysFromCivil(t.year, t.month, t.day) * 86400 + (t.hour or 12) * 3600 + (t.min or 0) * 60 + (t.sec or 0) - off end
-- Lua's day numbers (os.date's wday): 1 is Sunday. WEEK_DAYS = {sunday = 1, monday = 2, tuesday = 3, wednesday = 4, thursday = 5, friday = 6, saturday = 7} WEEK_DAY_ORDER = {"monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday"}
function WeekStartName() local d = type(config.week_start) == "string" and config.week_start:lower() or "" return WEEK_DAYS[d] and d or "monday" end
-- The Unix time this day/week/month/year began, in the timezone times are shown in -- (the week starts on the cdt config weeklystart day). function LocalPeriodStart(period, ts) if period == "day" then return LocalDayStart(ts) end if period == "week" then return LocalDayStart(ts, true) end local t = TZDate("*t", tonumber(ts) or os.time()) t.day = 1 if period == "year" then t.month = 1 end t.hour, t.min, t.sec, t.isdst = 0, 0, 0, nil return TZTime(t) end
-- The same by Aardwolf's clock, US Eastern: its day, Monday week, month and year. function EasternPeriodStart(period, ts) ts = tonumber(ts) or os.time() if period == "day" then return EasternDayStart(ts) end if period == "week" then return EasternDayStart(ts, true) end local y, m = os.date("!%Y-%m", ts + EasternOffsetHours(ts) * 3600):match("(%d+)-(%d+)") local mid = DaysFromCivil(tonumber(y), period == "year" and 1 or tonumber(m), 1) * 86400 return mid - EasternOffsetHours(mid + 5 * 3600) * 3600 end
-- The Unix time today began, in the timezone times are shown in, or with week set, -- the start of this week (00:00 on the cdt config weeklystart day). function LocalDayStart(ts, week) local t = TZDate("*t", tonumber(ts) or os.time()) if week then -- os.time/TZTime roll a day of 0 or less back into the month before t.day = t.day - (t.wday - WEEK_DAYS[WeekStartName()]) % 7 end t.hour, t.min, t.sec, t.isdst = 0, 0, 0, nil return TZTime(t) end
-- "UTC-8", "-8", "+5:30", "gmt+1", "0" -> minutes east of UTC; nil if not an offset. function ParseTZOffset(raw) local s = (raw or ""):lower():gsub("%s", "") s = s:gsub("^utc", ""):gsub("^gmt", "") if s == "" or s == "0" or s == "+0" or s == "-0" then return 0 end local sign, h, m = s:match("^([%+%-]?)(%d%d?):?(%d?%d?)$") if not h then return nil end h, m = tonumber(h), tonumber(m ~= "" and m or "0") if h > 14 or m > 59 then return nil end local minutes = h * 60 + m if minutes > 14 * 60 then return nil end return sign == "-" and -minutes or minutes end
function CmdTimezoneMoved(name, line, wildcards) ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] cdt timezone moved to: cdt config timezone [offset|machine]") end
function CmdTimezone(name, line, wildcards) local raw = ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local lower = raw:lower() if lower == "" then local label = TZLabel() if label then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Timezone: ", "cyan", "", label, "silver", "", " (set with cdt config timezone; no daylight saving)") else ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Timezone: ", "cyan", "", "this computer's (" .. os.date("%Z") .. ")") end ColourNote("silver", "", " Now: ", "white", "", ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config timezone UTC-8 | +5:30 | 0 sets a fixed offset;") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config timezone machine goes back to this computer's.") return end if lower == "machine" or lower == "local" or lower == "off" or lower == "reset" then config.tz_offset_minutes = nil state_save() ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Timezone: this computer's (" .. os.date("%Z") .. "). Now: " .. ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) return end local minutes = ParseTZOffset(raw) if not minutes then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] '" .. raw .. "' is not an offset.") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Use e.g. UTC-8, -5, +5:30 or 0 (between -14 and +14), or") ColourNote("yellow", "", " 'cdt config timezone machine' for this computer's timezone.") return end config.tz_offset_minutes = minutes state_save() ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Timezone set to " .. TZLabel() .. ". Now: " .. ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " A fixed offset has no daylight saving: change it when your clocks change.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Stored times don't change, only how they read and how dates are typed.") end
-- v26: session rows held running totals. Session counters were never zeroed when a -- session started, so each row carried everything since the last cdt reset session -- (or since the database began). Each ended session becomes the difference from -- the ended session before it; where a count went down, the counters had been -- reset, and the row is taken as it is. QP is recounted from the session's own -- quest, campaign, GQ and other records instead, because the v22 and v25 QP -- corrections were applied to single rows of those running totals. Unended rows -- (a crash, or a reset mid-session) never had totals written; what they earned -- lands in the next ended session, as the counters did. Daily totals are then -- rebuilt from the corrected sessions. Returns counts, or nil after a rollback. -- Every heal on you: another player's ("You feel ... healed by <player>'s <spell>. -- [N]") or your own ("You are ... healed by your <spell>. [N]", self = 1, healer = -- your name). One row per heal, for cdt heal report/history. The healer's level, the -- tier/remort/redo stamps and the 30-minute slice let the cdt dmg player filters apply. HEAL_LOG_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heal_log ( heal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, time INTEGER NOT NULL, healer TEXT NOT NULL, self INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, spell TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, session_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )]]
-- Damage taken, by who was hit (you, or a groupmate), who hit them and with what. -- Yours carries your subclass and race; a groupmate's subclass and race aren't sent -- by the game, so theirs stay blank. Same level/tier/30-minute slice columns as the -- other damage tables, so the cdt dmg filters apply. grouped (v38): 0 you were solo -- when it hit you, 1 you were grouped (always, for a groupmate's), -1 not known. DAMAGE_TAKEN_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS damage_taken ( victim TEXT NOT NULL, is_self INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, attacker TEXT NOT NULL, attack_name TEXT NOT NULL, damtype TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', area TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, grouped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, lines INTEGER DEFAULT 0, hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, crits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (victim, attacker, attack_name, class, race, area, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start, grouped) )]]
-- Your heals on other players ("Bob is greatly healed by your magic touch. [N]"). -- Kept apart from heal_log, which is heals on you. level and the tier/remort/redo -- stamps are yours, as the caster; target_level is theirs when they're grouped. HEAL_GIVEN_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heal_given ( heal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, time INTEGER NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, spell TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, target_level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, session_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )]]
-- Groupmates' heals that don't land on you, so no heal line shows them. source 'cast': -- a cast seen as an exact mana drop in the group data, the target guessed. For -- incomplete healing amount is 0 (it is worked out from the healer's own heal size); -- for regeneration (v39) it is the guessed target's hp gain, or 4,600 when nothing -- could be measured. source 'scroll': a heal scroll read in your room, target from the -- recite line, the target's hp gain (incomplete healing: at most 3,400 a heal), or -- 3,400 / 4,600 a heal when it couldn't be measured. spell (v39): incomplete healing -- or regeneration. heals: how many. level: the healer's. rise: for an incomplete -- healing cast whose guessed target was the only member whose hp jumped, and wasn't -- then at full hp, that jump: a sample of the healer's heal size. GROUP_HEALS_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS group_heals ( heal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, time INTEGER NOT NULL, healer TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', source TEXT NOT NULL, heals INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, amount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rise INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, session_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, spell TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'incomplete healing' )]]
function EnsureGroupHeals() if not db_exec(GROUP_HEALS_DDL .. ";") then return false end db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_group_heals_healer ON group_heals(healer, time);") db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_group_heals_time ON group_heals(time);") return true end
function EnsureHealGiven() if not db_exec(HEAL_GIVEN_DDL .. ";") then return false end db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_heal_given_target ON heal_given(target, time);") db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_heal_given_time ON heal_given(time);") return true end
function EnsureDamageTaken() if not db_exec(DAMAGE_TAKEN_DDL .. ";") then return false end db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_damage_taken_victim ON damage_taken(is_self, victim);") return true end
-- v38: solo or group is part of the key of the three tables that hold damage by -- attack, by damage type and by who hit whom, so cdt dmg can show one without the -- other. The same method as v18: each table is copied into one with the new key, -- the copy is checked (rows and damage) and swapped in, all in one transaction. -- grouped is 0 solo, 1 group, -1 not known. These are the v37 columns, in order; -- the DDL here is the v38 shape. damage_taken is made new with grouped by -- EnsureDamageTaken on a database that never had it, and is then left alone. DAMAGE_GROUPED_TABLES = { {tbl = "attack_stats", cols = "attack_name, damtype, category, class, race, total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits, total_crits, min_hit, max_hit, precise_hits, precise_damage, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start", ddl = [[CREATE TABLE %s ( attack_name TEXT NOT NULL, damtype TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', category TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', class TEXT NOT NULL, race TEXT DEFAULT '', total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, total_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_crits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, min_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max_hit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, precise_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, precise_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, grouped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, PRIMARY KEY (attack_name, class, race, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start, grouped) )]], index = "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attack_stats_slice ON attack_stats(slice_start);"}, {tbl = "damtype_stats", cols = "damtype, class, total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start", ddl = [[CREATE TABLE %s ( damtype TEXT NOT NULL, class TEXT NOT NULL, total_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0, combat_secs REAL DEFAULT 0, total_hits INTEGER DEFAULT 0, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, remort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, redo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, slice_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, grouped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, PRIMARY KEY (damtype, class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start, grouped) )]], index = "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_damtype_stats_slice ON damtype_stats(slice_start);"}, {tbl = "damage_taken", cols = "victim, is_self, attacker, attack_name, damtype, class, race, area, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start, total_damage, lines, hits, crits, max_hit", ddl = (DAMAGE_TAKEN_DDL:gsub("IF NOT EXISTS damage_taken", "%%s", 1)), -- the same DDL, under the name given index = "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_damage_taken_victim ON damage_taken(is_self, victim);"}, }
-- Returns a one-line summary for the upgrade message, or raises with the reason -- after rolling back (the database is then as it was). function MigrateDamageGrouped() if not db then return "" end local function fail(msg) pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) error(msg) end -- db_exec only says no when a Lua error is raised; DbRun checks SQLite's own code. local function run(sql, what) local ok, err = DbRun(sql) if not ok then fail(what .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end end run("BEGIN;", "could not start a transaction") local rebuilt = {} for _, spec in ipairs(DAMAGE_GROUPED_TABLES) do local t, tmp = spec.tbl, spec.tbl .. "_grouped" if DbTableExists("main", t) and not ColumnExists(t, "grouped") then local count_sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(total_damage), 0) AS d FROM " local pre = db_query_one(count_sql .. t) if not pre then fail(t .. ": could not read the original table") end -- Any index on it goes with the old table; make them again on the new one. local saved = db_query("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'index' AND tbl_name = " .. fixsql(t) .. " AND sql IS NOT NULL") run("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS " .. tmp .. ";", t .. ": could not clear the replacement table") run(string.format(spec.ddl, tmp) .. ";", t .. ": could not create the replacement table") run("INSERT INTO " .. tmp .. " (" .. spec.cols .. ", grouped) SELECT " .. spec.cols .. ", -1 FROM " .. t .. ";", t .. ": copy failed, original left untouched") local post = db_query_one(count_sql .. tmp) if not post or tonumber(post.n) ~= tonumber(pre.n) or tonumber(post.d) ~= tonumber(pre.d) then fail(string.format("%s: copy mismatch (%s rows / %s damage -> %s rows / %s damage)", t, tostring(pre.n), tostring(pre.d), tostring(post and post.n), tostring(post and post.d))) end run("DROP TABLE " .. t .. ";", t .. ": could not swap in the replacement table") run("ALTER TABLE " .. tmp .. " RENAME TO " .. t .. ";", t .. ": could not swap in the replacement table") for _, ix in ipairs(saved) do run(ix.sql .. ";", t .. ": could not recreate an index") end run(spec.index, t .. ": could not index the replacement table") rebuilt[t] = true end end
-- Label what was there. area_combat_stats has always kept solo and group apart, -- per slice: a slice that was all one or the other gives that to every row filed -- under it. One that mixed both, or has no slice (before v3.9), stays -1. run("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp.slice_purity;", "could not clear the slice table") run([[CREATE TEMP TABLE slice_purity AS SELECT class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start, CASE WHEN MIN(COALESCE(grouped, 0)) = MAX(COALESCE(grouped, 0)) AND slice_start > 0 THEN MIN(COALESCE(grouped, 0)) ELSE -1 END AS g FROM area_combat_stats GROUP BY class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start;]], "could not work out which slices were pure") run("CREATE INDEX temp.idx_slice_purity ON slice_purity (class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start);", "could not index the slice table") local function pure(t) -- the slice's label for each row of table t local on = {} for _, c in ipairs({"class", "level", "tier", "remort", "redo", "slice_start"}) do on[#on + 1] = string.format("p.%s = %s.%s", c, t, c) end return "COALESCE((SELECT p.g FROM slice_purity p WHERE " .. table.concat(on, " AND ") .. "), -1)" end if rebuilt.attack_stats then run("UPDATE attack_stats SET grouped = " .. pure("attack_stats") .. ";", "could not label attack damage") -- the group's combined attack only happens in a group run("UPDATE attack_stats SET grouped = 1 WHERE category = 'epic';", "could not label the combined attack") end if rebuilt.damtype_stats then run("UPDATE damtype_stats SET grouped = " .. pure("damtype_stats") .. ";", "could not label damage types") end if rebuilt.damage_taken then -- a groupmate is only hit while grouped with you run("UPDATE damage_taken SET grouped = CASE WHEN is_self = 0 THEN 1 ELSE " .. pure("damage_taken") .. " END;", "could not label damage taken") end run("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp.slice_purity;", "could not drop the slice table")
local function tally(t, where) local c = {[0] = 0, [1] = 0, [-1] = 0} if DbTableExists("main", t) then for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT grouped AS g, COALESCE(SUM(total_damage), 0) AS d FROM " .. t .. " WHERE " .. where .. " GROUP BY grouped")) do c[tonumber(r.g) or -1] = tonumber(r.d) or 0 end end return c end local a = tally("attack_stats", "category != 'epic'") local d = tally("damage_taken", "1 = 1") run("COMMIT;", "commit failed") return string.format("solo / group / not split: your damage %s / %s / %s, damage taken %s / %s / %s " .. "(a slice that mixed solo and group, or from before v3.9, can't be split)", short_value(a[0]), short_value(a[1]), short_value(a[-1]), short_value(d[0]), short_value(d[1]), short_value(d[-1])) end

GQ_JOINS_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gq_joins ( join_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, time INTEGER NOT NULL, gq_num INTEGER DEFAULT 0, session_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )]]
-- v27: level-up and powerup trains (and pracs) were also booked as 'other' earnings, -- because the worth update arrived before the level said it had credited them. An -- 'other' trains/pracs row that equals one level-up or powerup's amount and landed -- from 3 seconds before to 5 seconds after it is that duplicate (checked on real -- data: they land 1-2 seconds before). Each level is matched once. The rows are -- removed, their sessions' totals come down, and daily totals are rebuilt. function FixLevelTrainDoubles(levels_only) local out = {trains = 0, pracs = 0, rows = 0} -- levels_only (v30 on): powerups come seconds apart, too close to tell a copy from a -- real gain, so their rows are left alone. v27 matched them, one copy per powerup. local levels = db_query("SELECT level_id, end_time, trains_gain + bonus_trains + blessing_trains + " .. "instinct_trains AS trains, pracs_gain AS pracs FROM levels" .. (levels_only and " WHERE type = 'level'" or "") .. " ORDER BY end_time") local per_session = {} if not db_exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION;") then return nil end for _, cur in ipairs({"trains", "pracs"}) do local used, i = {}, 1 for _, e in ipairs(db_query("SELECT earning_id, time, amount, session_id FROM earnings " .. "WHERE source = 'other' AND currency = '" .. cur .. "' ORDER BY time")) do local t, amt = tonumber(e.time) or 0, tonumber(e.amount) or 0 while i <= #levels and (tonumber(levels[i].end_time) or 0) < t - 3 do i = i + 1 end local j, match = i, nil while j <= #levels and (tonumber(levels[j].end_time) or 0) <= t + 5 do local l = levels[j] if amt > 0 and not used[l.level_id] and (tonumber(l[cur]) or 0) == amt then match = l; break end j = j + 1 end if match then used[match.level_id] = true if not db_exec("DELETE FROM earnings WHERE earning_id = " .. e.earning_id) then pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) return nil end local sid = tonumber(e.session_id) or 0 per_session[sid] = per_session[sid] or {trains = 0, pracs = 0} per_session[sid][cur] = per_session[sid][cur] + amt out[cur] = out[cur] + amt out.rows = out.rows + 1 end end end for sid, d in pairs(per_session) do if not db_exec(string.format("UPDATE sessions SET total_trains = MAX(0, total_trains - %d), " .. "total_pracs = MAX(0, total_pracs - %d) WHERE session_id = %d", d.trains, d.pracs, sid)) then pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) return nil end end if out.rows > 0 and not RebuildDailyTotalsFromSessions() then pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) return nil end if not db_exec("COMMIT;") then pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) return nil end return out end
-- v31: a quest, campaign or GQ's TP, trains and pracs were also booked as 'other' -- earnings -- v29's fault, which v29 cleared for QP only. The worth update arrived a -- moment before the reward line; the old code then dropped the reward's claim on it. -- On real data every such copy -- 668 of 669 QP copies too -- was booked 0-2 seconds -- before the reward was saved, so an 'other' row is a copy when it is the same size as -- one of the reward's QP/TP/trains/pracs and booked from REWARD_DOUBLE_BEFORE seconds before -- the reward to REWARD_DOUBLE_AFTER after it. A trivia TP won just after a campaign -- comes later than that and is left alone. Each reward cancels at most one row per -- currency, the nearest. cdt db verify counts with the same rule; the migration removes. REWARD_DOUBLE_BEFORE = 3 REWARD_DOUBLE_AFTER = 1
-- The rewards one currency's copies can match: {key, t, amt}, oldest first. A campaign -- offers its QP three ways (with and without the first-of-the-day bonus, and the -- bonus alone), each able to cancel one row. local function RewardAmounts(cur, since) local list, from = {}, since - REWARD_DOUBLE_AFTER local function add(key, t, amt) amt = tonumber(amt) or 0 if amt > 0 then list[#list + 1] = {key = key, t = tonumber(t) or 0, amt = amt} end end if cur == "qp" then for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT rowid AS id, end_time AS t, totqp FROM quests WHERE failed = 0 AND end_time >= " .. from)) do add("q:" .. tostring(r.id), r.t, r.totqp) end for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT rowid AS id, end_time AS t, qp, daily_qp FROM campaigns WHERE failed = 0 AND end_time >= " .. from)) do local qp, daily = tonumber(r.qp) or 0, tonumber(r.daily_qp) or 0 add("c:" .. tostring(r.id), r.t, qp) if daily > 0 then add("c-base:" .. tostring(r.id), r.t, qp - daily) add("c-daily:" .. tostring(r.id), r.t, daily) end end for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT rowid AS id, end_time AS t, qp_win FROM gquests WHERE end_time >= " .. from)) do add("g:" .. tostring(r.id), r.t, r.qp_win) end else for _, src in ipairs({{"quests", "failed = 0"}, {"campaigns", "failed = 0"}, {"gquests", "1 = 1"}}) do for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format("SELECT rowid AS id, end_time AS t, %s AS amt FROM %s " .. "WHERE %s AND %s > 0 AND end_time >= %d", cur, src[1], src[2], cur, from))) do add(src[1] .. ":" .. tostring(r.id), r.t, r.amt) end end end table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end) return list end
function MatchRewardDoubles(since, currencies) since = tonumber(since) or 0 local found = {} for _, cur in ipairs(currencies or {"tp", "trains", "pracs"}) do local rewards = RewardAmounts(cur, since) local used, i = {}, 1 for _, e in ipairs(db_query(string.format("SELECT earning_id, time, amount, session_id FROM earnings " .. "WHERE source = 'other' AND currency = '%s' AND amount > 0 AND time >= %d ORDER BY time", cur, since))) do local t, amt = tonumber(e.time) or 0, tonumber(e.amount) or 0 -- the row may be booked up to BEFORE seconds before its reward, AFTER after it while i <= #rewards and rewards[i].t < t - REWARD_DOUBLE_AFTER do i = i + 1 end local best, j = nil, i while j <= #rewards and rewards[j].t <= t + REWARD_DOUBLE_BEFORE do local r = rewards[j] if not used[r.key] and r.amt == amt and (not best or math.abs(r.t - t) < math.abs(best.t - t)) then best = r end j = j + 1 end if best then used[best.key] = true found[#found + 1] = {id = e.earning_id, currency = cur, amount = amt, session_id = tonumber(e.session_id) or 0} end end end return found end
-- Removes what MatchRewardDoubles finds, with the session totals that counted it, and -- rebuilds daily totals. Returns the amounts removed, or nil after a rollback. function FixRewardOtherDoubles(currencies) local out = {qp = 0, tp = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, rows = 0} local found = MatchRewardDoubles(0, currencies) if #found == 0 then return out end local col = {qp = "total_qp", tp = "total_tp", trains = "total_trains", pracs = "total_pracs"} local per_session = {} if not db_exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION;") then return nil end local function fail() pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) return nil end for _, f in ipairs(found) do if not db_exec("DELETE FROM earnings WHERE earning_id = " .. f.id) then return fail() end per_session[f.session_id] = per_session[f.session_id] or {qp = 0, tp = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0} per_session[f.session_id][f.currency] = per_session[f.session_id][f.currency] + f.amount out[f.currency] = out[f.currency] + f.amount out.rows = out.rows + 1 end for sid, d in pairs(per_session) do for cur, v in pairs(d) do if v > 0 and not db_exec(string.format("UPDATE sessions SET %s = MAX(0, %s - %d) WHERE session_id = %d", col[cur], col[cur], v, sid)) then return fail() end end end if not RebuildDailyTotalsFromSessions() then return fail() end if not db_exec("COMMIT;") then return fail() end return out end
-- v28: every level-up and powerup saved 0 (or a kill or two) for the XP and kills -- earned during it. Rebuilt from the kills and campaigns between its start and end. -- A row whose kills were archived keeps what it had. function FixLevelDuringCounts() if not db_exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kills_time ON kills(time);") then return nil end local before = db_query_one("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(kills_during), 0) AS k FROM levels") or {} local ok = db_exec([[UPDATE levels SET kills_during = MAX(kills_during, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kills k WHERE k.time > levels.start_time AND k.time <= levels.end_time)), xp_during = MAX(xp_during, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(k.xp + k.xp_rare + k.xp_bonus), 0) FROM kills k WHERE k.time > levels.start_time AND k.time <= levels.end_time) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.xp), 0) FROM campaigns c WHERE c.failed = 0 AND c.end_time > levels.start_time AND c.end_time <= levels.end_time)) WHERE start_time > 0 AND end_time > start_time;]]) if not ok then return nil end local after = db_query_one("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(kills_during), 0) AS k FROM levels") or {} return {kills = (tonumber(after.k) or 0) - (tonumber(before.k) or 0)} end

Reports note where older records can't have them. function MarkReportSplit() return db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO player_totals (key, value, updated_time) VALUES ('report_split_since', %d, %d)", os.time(), os.time())) end
SESSION_TOTAL_COLS = {"total_xp", "total_tp", "total_gold", "total_trains", "total_pracs", "levels", "pups", "quests_done", "quests_fail", "cps_done", "cps_fail", "gqs_joined", "gqs_won", "active_secs"}
function SessionQPFromRecords() local qp = {} local function add(sql) for _, r in ipairs(db_query(sql)) do local sid = tonumber(r.sid) if sid then qp[sid] = (qp[sid] or 0) + (tonumber(r.v) or 0) end end end add("SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(totqp) AS v FROM quests WHERE failed = 0 GROUP BY session_id") add("SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(qp) AS v FROM campaigns WHERE failed = 0 GROUP BY session_id") add("SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(qp_mobs + qp_win) AS v FROM gquests GROUP BY session_id") add("SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(amount) AS v FROM earnings WHERE currency = 'qp' GROUP BY session_id") return qp end
function RebuildDailyTotalsFromSessions() local days, order = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE end_time > 0 ORDER BY start_time")) do local date = TZDate("%Y-%m-%d", r.start_time) local d = days[date] if not d then d = {xp = 0, qp = 0, tp = 0, gold = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, quests = 0, campaigns = 0, gquests = 0, active_secs = 0, class = "", start = LocalDayStart(r.start_time)} days[date] = d order[#order + 1] = date end d.xp = d.xp + (tonumber(r.total_xp) or 0); d.qp = d.qp + (tonumber(r.total_qp) or 0) d.tp = d.tp + (tonumber(r.total_tp) or 0); d.gold = d.gold + (tonumber(r.total_gold) or 0) d.trains = d.trains + (tonumber(r.total_trains) or 0); d.pracs = d.pracs + (tonumber(r.total_pracs) or 0) d.levels = d.levels + (tonumber(r.levels) or 0); d.pups = d.pups + (tonumber(r.pups) or 0) d.quests = d.quests + (tonumber(r.quests_done) or 0); d.campaigns = d.campaigns + (tonumber(r.cps_done) or 0) d.gquests = d.gquests + (tonumber(r.gqs_joined) or 0); d.active_secs = d.active_secs + (tonumber(r.active_secs) or 0) if (r.primary_class or "") ~= "" then d.class = r.primary_class end end if not db_exec("DELETE FROM daily_totals;") then return nil end for _, date in ipairs(order) do local d = days[date] local next_start = LocalDayStart(d.start + 26 * 3600) local k = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM kills WHERE time >= %d AND time < %d", d.start, next_start)) or {} if not db_exec(string.format([[INSERT OR REPLACE INTO daily_totals (date, xp, qp, tp, gold, trains, pracs, levels, pups, quests, campaigns, gquests, kills, active_secs, primary_class) VALUES (%s, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %s)]], fixsql(date), d.xp, d.qp, d.tp, d.gold, d.trains, d.pracs, d.levels, d.pups, d.quests, d.campaigns, d.gquests, tonumber(k.n) or 0, d.active_secs, fixsql(d.class))) then return nil end end return #order end
function FixCumulativeSessions() local out = {sessions = 0, resets = 0, days = 0} local qp = SessionQPFromRecords() if not db_exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION;") then return nil end local prev for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE end_time > 0 ORDER BY session_id")) do local cur = {} for _, c in ipairs(SESSION_TOTAL_COLS) do cur[c] = tonumber(r[c]) or 0 end -- Counts that only ever grow: if one fell, the counters were reset in between. local reset = not prev if prev then for _, c in ipairs({"active_secs", "total_xp", "levels", "pups", "quests_done", "cps_done", "gqs_joined"}) do if cur[c] < prev[c] then reset = true end end if reset then out.resets = out.resets + 1 end end local sets = {} for _, c in ipairs(SESSION_TOTAL_COLS) do local v = reset and cur[c] or (cur[c] - prev[c]) if c ~= "total_gold" and v < 0 then v = 0 end -- gold can fall (clan tax) sets[#sets + 1] = string.format("%s = %.0f", c, v) end sets[#sets + 1] = string.format("total_qp = %.0f", qp[tonumber(r.session_id)] or 0) if not db_exec(string.format("UPDATE sessions SET %s WHERE session_id = %d", table.concat(sets, ", "), r.session_id)) then pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) return nil end prev = cur out.sessions = out.sessions + 1 end local days = RebuildDailyTotalsFromSessions() if not days then pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) return nil end out.days = days if not db_exec("COMMIT;") then pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) return nil end return out end
-- v25: the first-campaign-of-the-day QP bonus the plugin missed before v24. Its -- worth update was booked as an "other" earning within seconds of the campaign: -- merged - before v22's fix, campaign QP + bonus in one row, and the campaign's -- part was also counted by the campaign itself; -- separate - after it, the bonus alone. -- Each is moved onto the first campaign of its Eastern day, and for the merged -- kind the duplicated campaign QP comes back out of its session and day totals. -- Returns the counts, or nil if it failed (and rolled back). CP_BONUS_MAX = 25 CP_BONUS_WINDOW = 10
function BackfillCampaignDailyBonus() local firsts, seen = {}, {} for _, c in ipairs(db_query("SELECT cp_id, end_time, qp, daily_qp, session_id FROM campaigns " .. "WHERE failed = 0 AND end_time > 0 ORDER BY end_time, cp_id")) do local day = EasternDate(c.end_time) if not seen[day] then seen[day] = true if (tonumber(c.daily_qp) or 0) == 0 then firsts[#firsts + 1] = c end end end
local out = {days = 0, merged = 0, separate = 0, bonus = 0, duplicate = 0} local ok = db_exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION;") for _, c in ipairs(firsts) do if not ok then break end local qp, t = tonumber(c.qp) or 0, tonumber(c.end_time) or 0 local e = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT earning_id, amount FROM earnings WHERE source = 'other' AND currency = 'qp' " .. "AND ABS(time - %d) <= %d AND ((amount - %d) BETWEEN 1 AND %d OR (amount BETWEEN 1 AND %d AND amount < %d)) " .. "ORDER BY ABS(time - %d) LIMIT 1", t, CP_BONUS_WINDOW, qp, CP_BONUS_MAX, CP_BONUS_MAX, qp, t)) if e then local amount = tonumber(e.amount) or 0 local merged = (amount - qp) >= 1 and (amount - qp) <= CP_BONUS_MAX local bonus = merged and (amount - qp) or amount ok = ok and db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE campaigns SET daily_qp = %d, qp = qp + %d WHERE cp_id = %d", bonus, bonus, tonumber(c.cp_id) or 0)) ok = ok and db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM earnings WHERE earning_id = %d", tonumber(e.earning_id) or 0)) if merged then ok = ok and db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE sessions SET total_qp = MAX(0, total_qp - %d) WHERE session_id = %d", qp, tonumber(c.session_id) or 0)) ok = ok and db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE daily_totals SET qp = MAX(0, qp - %d) WHERE date = %s", qp, fixsql(os.date("%Y-%m-%d", t)))) out.merged, out.duplicate = out.merged + 1, out.duplicate + qp else out.separate = out.separate + 1 end out.days, out.bonus = out.days + 1, out.bonus + bonus end end if not (ok and db_exec("COMMIT;")) then db_exec("ROLLBACK;") return nil end return out end

";") local kills = tonumber((db_query_one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM kills") or {}).n) or 0 if kills > 0 then RebuildAreaStats() ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format( "[CDT] Created the missing area_stats table and rebuilt it from %s recorded kills", comma_value(kills))) end end

-- Which of the abilities above are skills; the rest are spells. Tagged by hand -- (a physical damage type doesn't make an ability a skill: spasm, ballistic attack, -- bone-crunching force and razor-sharp talon are spells). local SEED_SKILLS = {} for _, name in ipairs({"bash", "bodycheck", "uppercut", "kicked dirt", "hammering blow", "sap", "kick", "stunning blow", "stomp", "gouge", "mighty assault", "scalp", "spinning blade", "backstab", "spiralling force", "counter strike"}) do SEED_SKILLS[name] = true end function SeedAbilityCategory(name) return SEED_SKILLS[name] and "skill" or "spell" end

-- A dtrack snapshot taken while the in-game tracker was reset holds nothing but -- zeros. Consumers already filter them out, but they clutter every listing and -- can be paired in a comparison, so clear any that predate the insert guard. -- Safe to run every load: they carry no detail or baseline rows of their own. function PurgeZeroDtrackSnapshots() if not db then return 0 end local row = db_query_one( "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM dtrack_hits_summary WHERE rounds = 0 AND swings = 0") local n = row and tonumber(row.n) or 0 if n <= 0 then return 0 end db_exec("DELETE FROM snapshot_headers WHERE id IN " .. "(SELECT header_id FROM dtrack_hits_summary WHERE rounds = 0 AND swings = 0)") db_exec("DELETE FROM dtrack_hits_summary WHERE rounds = 0 AND swings = 0") ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format( "[CDT] Removed %d empty dtrack snapshot%s (tracker had been reset when they were taken).", n, n == 1 and "" or "s")) return n end
function SeedDamtypeMap() if not db then return end local insert_sql = "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO damtype_map (attack_name, damtype, category, source) VALUES (%s, %s, 'auto', 'seed')" for atk, dt in pairs(SEED_MELEE_MAP) do db_exec(string.format(insert_sql, fixsql(atk), fixsql(dt))) end local spell_insert = "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO damtype_map (attack_name, damtype, category, source) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, 'seed')" for atk, dt in pairs(SEED_SPELL_MAP) do db_exec(string.format(spell_insert, fixsql(atk), fixsql(dt), fixsql(SeedAbilityCategory(atk)))) end db_exec("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO damtype_map (attack_name, damtype, category, source) VALUES ('group''s combined attack', 'special', 'epic', 'seed')") db_exec("UPDATE attack_stats SET category = 'epic', damtype = 'special' WHERE attack_name = 'group''s combined attack'") LoadDamtypeCache() end
-- v32: spells and skills used to share the category 'skill', and backstab and spiral -- (spiralling force) had no mapping at all. The plugin's own mappings are brought up -- to date -- a mapping you made with cdt dmg map is left as it is -- and re-applied -- to the damage already recorded under those names; damage type totals are rebuilt. -- Runs inside the caller's transaction. Returns the number of mappings changed. function ApplySeedAbilities() local changed = 0 for atk, dt in pairs(SEED_SPELL_MAP) do local cat = SeedAbilityCategory(atk) if not db_exec(string.format("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO damtype_map (attack_name, damtype, category, source) " .. "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, 'seed')", fixsql(atk), fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat))) then return nil end changed = changed + db:changes() if not db_exec(string.format("UPDATE damtype_map SET damtype = %s, category = %s WHERE attack_name = %s " .. "AND source = 'seed' AND (damtype <> %s OR category <> %s)", fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat), fixsql(atk), fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat))) then return nil end changed = changed + db:changes() end LoadDamtypeCache() for atk in pairs(SEED_SPELL_MAP) do local dt, cat = LookupDamtype(atk) for _, tbl in ipairs({"attack_stats", "player_attack_stats", "legacy_damage"}) do if DbTableExists("main", tbl) and ColumnExists(tbl, "category") then if not db_exec(string.format("UPDATE %s SET damtype = %s, category = %s WHERE attack_name = %s COLLATE NOCASE " .. "AND (COALESCE(damtype, '') <> %s OR COALESCE(category, '') <> %s)", tbl, fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat), fixsql(atk), fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat))) then return nil end end end end if not RebuildDamtypeStats() then return nil end return changed end
-- Rebuilds the damage type totals from attack_stats. Runs inside the caller's -- transaction. Returns true, or nil when a statement failed. function RebuildDamtypeStats() if not db_exec("DELETE FROM damtype_stats;") then return nil end -- Older migrations (the v32 seed) run this before v38 adds solo/group. local g = (ColumnExists("attack_stats", "grouped") and ColumnExists("damtype_stats", "grouped")) and ", grouped" or "" if not db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO damtype_stats (damtype, class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start%s, total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits) SELECT damtype, class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start%s, SUM(total_damage), MAX(combat_secs), SUM(total_hits) FROM attack_stats WHERE COALESCE(damtype, 'unknown') <> 'unknown' GROUP BY damtype, class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start%s;]], g, g, g)) then return nil end return true end
-- Runs on every load, once the database is open and migrated. A built-in mapping -- added in a newer version used to reach only a new database (or the one-off v9/v32 -- migrations), so an existing one kept showing that attack as unknown. Every built-in -- mapping missing from damtype_map is added (source 'seed'); a row already there -- -- your own cdt dmg map, or an earlier seed -- is never touched. For each mapping -- added, damage already recorded under that name as unknown is filed under the new -- type, and the damage type totals are rebuilt if anything moved. Silent unless -- recorded damage was re-filed. Returns the number of mappings added. function SyncSeedMappings() if not db or migration_blocked then return 0 end local tables = {"attack_stats", "player_attack_stats", "legacy_damage"} local have = {} for _, row in ipairs(db_query("SELECT attack_name FROM damtype_map")) do have[row.attack_name] = true end local wanted = {} for atk, dt in pairs(SEED_MELEE_MAP) do if not have[atk] then wanted[#wanted + 1] = {atk, dt, "auto"} end end for atk, dt in pairs(SEED_SPELL_MAP) do if not have[atk] then wanted[#wanted + 1] = {atk, dt, SeedAbilityCategory(atk)} end end if #wanted == 0 then return 0 end -- Melee first, as SeedDamtypeMap inserts them, so a name in both keeps the melee row. table.sort(wanted, function(a, b) if a[1] ~= b[1] then return a[1] < b[1] end return a[3] == "auto" and b[3] ~= "auto" end)
local inserted, rows, filed = 0, 0, {} local function write() for _, w in ipairs(wanted) do local atk, dt, cat = w[1], w[2], w[3] if not db_exec(string.format("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO damtype_map (attack_name, damtype, category, source) " .. "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, 'seed')", fixsql(atk), fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat))) then return nil end if db:changes() > 0 then inserted = inserted + 1 if dt ~= "unknown" then local name_rows, name_hits = 0, 0 for _, tbl in ipairs(tables) do if DbTableExists("main", tbl) and ColumnExists(tbl, "attack_name") and ColumnExists(tbl, "damtype") then local where = string.format("attack_name = %s COLLATE NOCASE AND COALESCE(damtype, 'unknown') IN ('unknown', '')", fixsql(atk)) local sum = ColumnExists(tbl, "total_hits") and "COALESCE(SUM(total_hits), 0)" or "0" local row = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c, %s AS h FROM %s WHERE %s", sum, tbl, where)) local c = row and tonumber(row.c) or 0 if c > 0 then local set = "damtype = " .. fixsql(dt) if ColumnExists(tbl, "category") then set = set .. ", category = " .. fixsql(cat) end if not db_exec(string.format("UPDATE %s SET %s WHERE %s", tbl, set, where)) then return nil end name_rows = name_rows + c name_hits = name_hits + (tonumber(row.h) or 0) end end end if name_rows > 0 then rows = rows + name_rows filed[#filed + 1] = {name = atk, dt = dt, hits = name_hits} end end end end if rows > 0 then if not RebuildDamtypeStats() then return nil end end return true end
local ok = false if db_exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION;") then ok = write() if ok then ok = db_exec("COMMIT;") end if not ok then pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) end end if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Could not add the new damage type mappings.") return 0 end if inserted > 0 then LoadDamtypeCache() end if #filed > 0 then local parts, total = {}, 0 for _, f in ipairs(filed) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s (%s)", f.name, f.dt) total = total + f.hits end local msg = string.format("[CDT] New damage type mappings: %s; %s recorded hits re-filed.", table.concat(parts, ", "), comma_value(total)) if #msg <= 80 then ColourNote("cyan", "", msg) else ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] New damage type mappings:") local line = " " for i, part in ipairs(parts) do local piece = part .. (i < #parts and "," or "") if line ~= " " and #line + #piece + 1 > 80 then ColourNote("cyan", "", line) line = " " end line = line .. (line == " " and "" or " ") .. piece end ColourNote("cyan", "", line) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] %s recorded hits re-filed.", comma_value(total))) end end return inserted end
function LoadDamtypeCache() damtype_cache, damtype_cache_lower = {}, {} if not db then return end pcall(function() for row in db:nrows("SELECT attack_name, damtype, category FROM damtype_map") do local entry = {damtype = row.damtype, category = row.category} damtype_cache[row.attack_name] = entry local low = (row.attack_name or ""):lower() -- a mapping that is itself lower case wins the lower-case slot if not damtype_cache_lower[low] or row.attack_name == low then damtype_cache_lower[low] = entry end end end) end
-- Damtype for an attack, honouring the shaman's gaias focus. Gaias fury and -- gaias revenge print the same verb whatever element they are focused on, so -- the element can only come from config; unfocused damage gets the sentinel. function ResolveDamtypeForCapture(attack_name, is_group) local dt, cat = LookupDamtype(attack_name) local spell = LookupSpellForVerb(attack_name) if spell and GAIAS_SPELLS[spell] then -- Another player's focus is unknowable, so group gaias damage is always -- recorded as indeterminate. if is_group then return GAIAS_DAMTYPE, cat end local focus = (config.gaias_focus or ""):lower() for _, e in ipairs(GAIAS_ELEMENTS) do if focus == e then return e, cat end end return GAIAS_DAMTYPE, cat end return dt, cat end
function LookupDamtype(attack_name) local entry = damtype_cache[attack_name] or damtype_cache_lower[(attack_name or ""):lower()] if entry then return entry.damtype, entry.category end return "unknown", "unknown" end
-- ============================================================================= -- COMBAT BUFFER -- ============================================================================= local current_combat = nil local group_combat = {} local last_group_dmg_line = nil local last_self_recv_line = nil local combat_idle_threshold = 60
local DAMAGE_VERBS = {} for _, v in ipairs({ "tickles","bruises","scratches","grazes","nicks","scars","hits","injures", "wounds","mauls","maims","mangles","mars","decimates","devastates","rends", "incinerates","lacerates","obliterates","massacres","disembowels","extirpates", "eradicates","dismembers","mutilates","blasts","demolishes","shreds","destroys", "pulverizes","vaporizes","atomizes","asphyxiates","ravages","fissures", "liquidates","evaporates","sunders","wastes","cremates","annihilates","implodes", "exterminates","shatters","slaughters","ruptures","nukes","glaciates","meteorites", "supernovas","damages","misses", "tears into", "does unspeakable things to","does unthinkable things to", "does unimaginable things to","does unbelievable things to", }) do DAMAGE_VERBS[v] = true end
function ExtractDamageInfo(line) local damage = tonumber(line:match("%[(%d+)%]%*?$")) or 0 local is_crit = line:sub(1, 1) == "*" or line:match("%]%*$") ~= nil return damage, is_crit end
-- Aardwolf groups identical hits onto one line: the LEADING bracket is how many -- hits it represents, the trailing one is their combined damage. -- "[4] Your anguish does UNBELIEVABLE things to X! [14386]" -> 4 hits, 14386 -- Ungrouped lines have no leading bracket and count as a single hit. function ExtractHitCount(line) return tonumber(line:match("^%*?%[(%d+)%]%s")) or 1 end
function StripVerbDecorations(text) return text:gsub("[%-%=<>%*%[%]:\\+%.]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^ ", ""):gsub(" $", "") end
-- The attack name is everything before the damage verb. Take the EARLIEST verb -- in the line, as a whole word: the old version took whichever verb pairs() -- happened to reach first, anywhere in the line, so a later match could leave -- "mind force does UNBELIEVABLE things to an insectoid" stored as an attack. -- The verb straight after the attack name always comes before anything in the -- target, so earliest-wins cannot cut into it. Longest verb breaks a tie. function FindEarliestVerb(lower) local best_pos, best_len = nil, 0 for verb in pairs(DAMAGE_VERBS) do local from = 1 while true do local s, e = lower:find(verb, from, true) if not s then break end local before_ok = s > 1 and not lower:sub(s - 1, s - 1):match("%a") local after_ok = not lower:sub(e + 1, e + 1):match("%a") if before_ok and after_ok then if not best_pos or s < best_pos or (s == best_pos and #verb > best_len) then best_pos, best_len = s, #verb end break end from = s + 1 end end return best_pos, best_len end
function ExtractAttackName(text) local stripped = StripVerbDecorations(text) local best_pos = FindEarliestVerb(stripped:lower()) if not best_pos then return nil end local before = stripped:sub(1, best_pos - 1):match("^(.-)%s+$") if before and #before > 0 then return before end return nil end
-- The target is whatever follows that verb: -- "anguish does UNBELIEVABLE things to a Void Titan" -> "a Void Titan" -- Stripping the verb decorations also blanks the hyphens and dots inside a name -- ("an upside-down man"), so the name is taken from the end of the original text: -- the shortest run of its last words that strips to the same thing. function ExtractDamageTarget(text) local stripped = StripVerbDecorations(text) local pos, len = FindEarliestVerb(stripped:lower()) if not pos then return nil end local target = stripped:sub(pos + len):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if not target or target == "" then return nil end local words = {} for w in text:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end for k = 1, #words do local candidate = table.concat(words, " ", #words - k + 1) local cs = StripVerbDecorations(candidate) if cs == target then return candidate end if #cs > #target then break end end return target end
-- Used only by the v17 repair, which runs before v18 adds level -- so the -- keys below are the pre-v18 ones and must not be reused on a v18 schema. -- Tables that store an attack by name, with how each column combines when two -- names turn out to be the same attack. Damage and counts add; combat_secs takes -- the larger side, because both names were nearly always hit in the same fights -- and summing would count that time twice; min/max stay min/max. ATTACK_MERGE_TABLES = { {tbl = "attack_stats", keys = {"class", "race"}, sum = {"total_damage", "total_hits", "total_crits", "precise_hits", "precise_damage"}, max = {"combat_secs", "max_hit"}, min = {"min_hit"}}, {tbl = "player_attack_stats", keys = {"player"}, sum = {"total_damage", "total_hits", "total_crits", "precise_hits", "precise_damage"}, max = {"combat_secs", "max_hit", "last_seen"}, min = {"min_hit"}}, {tbl = "snapshot_dmg_baseline", keys = {"header_id"}, sum = {"total_damage"}, max = {}, min = {}}, }
-- Moves every row stored under `broken` onto `fixed`, in every table above, and -- corrects the two aggregates that sorted damage by its (wrong) damtype. -- Returns false on the first failed statement; the caller rolls back. function MergeAttackName(broken, fixed) local B, F = fixsql(broken), fixsql(fixed) for _, spec in ipairs(ATTACK_MERGE_TABLES) do local t = spec.tbl local key_cols = table.concat(spec.keys, ", ") local match = {} for _, k in ipairs(spec.keys) do match[#match + 1] = "b." .. k .. " = " .. t .. "." .. k end match = table.concat(match, " AND ")
-- 1. a target row for every key the broken name has local cols, vals = {}, {} for _, c in ipairs(spec.sum) do cols[#cols + 1] = c; vals[#vals + 1] = "0" end for _, c in ipairs(spec.max) do cols[#cols + 1] = c; vals[#vals + 1] = "0" end for _, c in ipairs(spec.min) do cols[#cols + 1] = c; vals[#vals + 1] = "999999999" end local extra_cols = #cols > 0 and (", " .. table.concat(cols, ", ")) or "" local extra_vals = #vals > 0 and (", " .. table.concat(vals, ", ")) or "" local map_dt = "(SELECT m.damtype FROM damtype_map m WHERE m.attack_name = " .. F .. " COLLATE NOCASE)" local map_cat = "(SELECT m.category FROM damtype_map m WHERE m.attack_name = " .. F .. " COLLATE NOCASE)" if not db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO %s (attack_name, %s, damtype, category%s) " .. "SELECT %s, %s, COALESCE(%s, damtype), COALESCE(%s, category)%s FROM %s WHERE attack_name = %s", t, key_cols, extra_cols, F, key_cols, map_dt, map_cat, extra_vals, t, B)) then return false end
-- 2a. damtype_stats. The flush never writes 'unknown' there, so damage -- stored under a broken name was simply never counted: add it to the real -- damtype, and only take it away from the old one if that was a real one. if t == "attack_stats" then local moves = db_query(string.format( "SELECT b.class AS class, b.damtype AS bdt, g.damtype AS gdt, " .. "SUM(b.total_damage) AS td, SUM(b.total_hits) AS th " .. "FROM attack_stats b JOIN attack_stats g ON g.attack_name = %s " .. "AND g.class = b.class AND g.race = b.race " .. "WHERE b.attack_name = %s AND COALESCE(b.category, '') <> 'epic' " .. "AND b.damtype <> g.damtype AND g.damtype <> 'unknown' " .. "GROUP BY b.class, b.damtype, g.damtype", F, B)) for _, mv in ipairs(moves) do local td, th = tonumber(mv.td) or 0, tonumber(mv.th) or 0 local C = fixsql(mv.class) if mv.bdt ~= "unknown" then if not db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE damtype_stats SET total_damage = MAX(0, total_damage - %d), " .. "total_hits = MAX(0, total_hits - %d) WHERE damtype = %s AND class = %s", td, th, fixsql(mv.bdt), C)) then return false end end if not db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO damtype_stats (damtype, class, total_damage, combat_secs, total_hits) " .. "VALUES (%s, %s, 0, 0, 0)", fixsql(mv.gdt), C)) or not db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE damtype_stats SET total_damage = total_damage + %d, " .. "total_hits = total_hits + %d WHERE damtype = %s AND class = %s", td, th, fixsql(mv.gdt), C)) then return false end end end
-- 2b. player_profiles. The flush files unknown damtypes as spell damage, -- so a physical attack under a broken name landed in the wrong column. if t == "player_attack_stats" then local moves = db_query(string.format( "SELECT b.player AS player, b.damtype AS bdt, g.damtype AS gdt, SUM(b.total_damage) AS td " .. "FROM player_attack_stats b JOIN player_attack_stats g " .. "ON g.attack_name = %s AND g.player = b.player " .. "WHERE b.attack_name = %s GROUP BY b.player, b.damtype, g.damtype", F, B)) for _, mv in ipairs(moves) do local was = DAMTYPE_BROAD[mv.bdt] or "magic" local now = DAMTYPE_BROAD[mv.gdt] or "magic" if was ~= now then local td = tonumber(mv.td) or 0 local from_col = was == "physical" and "melee_damage" or "spell_damage" local to_col = now == "physical" and "melee_damage" or "spell_damage" if not db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE player_profiles SET %s = MAX(0, %s - %d), %s = %s + %d WHERE player = %s", from_col, from_col, td, to_col, to_col, td, fixsql(mv.player))) then return false end end end end
-- 3. add the broken row's figures into the target local function sub(c, default) return string.format("(SELECT COALESCE(b.%s, %s) FROM %s b WHERE b.attack_name = %s AND %s)", c, default, t, B, match) end local sets = {} for _, c in ipairs(spec.sum) do sets[#sets + 1] = string.format("%s = COALESCE(%s, 0) + %s", c, c, sub(c, "0")) end for _, c in ipairs(spec.max) do sets[#sets + 1] = string.format("%s = MAX(COALESCE(%s, 0), %s)", c, c, sub(c, "0")) end for _, c in ipairs(spec.min) do sets[#sets + 1] = string.format("%s = MIN(COALESCE(%s, 999999999), %s)", c, c, sub(c, "999999999")) end if not db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE %s SET %s WHERE attack_name = %s AND EXISTS " .. "(SELECT 1 FROM %s b WHERE b.attack_name = %s AND %s)", t, table.concat(sets, ", "), F, t, B, match)) then return false end
-- 4. and the broken row goes if not db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM %s WHERE attack_name = %s", t, B)) then return false end end return true end
-- Finds every stored attack name the extractor would now cut shorter, and folds -- it into the name it should have been. Returns how many names were folded, or -- nil if anything failed (in which case everything is rolled back). function RepairBrokenAttackNames() if not db then return nil end local names = {} for _, spec in ipairs(ATTACK_MERGE_TABLES) do for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT DISTINCT attack_name FROM " .. spec.tbl)) do local fixed = r.attack_name and ExtractAttackName(r.attack_name) if fixed and fixed ~= r.attack_name then names[r.attack_name] = fixed end end end if next(names) == nil then return 0 end if not db_exec("BEGIN;") then return nil end local count = 0 for broken, fixed in pairs(names) do if not MergeAttackName(broken, fixed) then db_exec("ROLLBACK;") return nil end count = count + 1 end if not db_exec("COMMIT;") then db_exec("ROLLBACK;") return nil end return count end
-- The same repair for the running session, which is saved as plugin state rather -- than in the database, so the meter and session reports drop the old names too. function FoldBrokenSessionAttacks() local folded = 0 local function fold(atks) if type(atks) ~= "table" then return end local moves = {} for name in pairs(atks) do local fixed = ExtractAttackName(name) if fixed and fixed ~= name then moves[#moves + 1] = {name, fixed} end end for _, mv in ipairs(moves) do local b, target = atks[mv[1]], atks[mv[2]] if not target then atks[mv[2]] = b else for _, k in ipairs({"dmg", "hits", "crits", "phits", "pdmg"}) do target[k] = (target[k] or 0) + (b[k] or 0) end if b.min and (not target.min or b.min < target.min) then target.min = b.min end if b.max and (not target.max or b.max > target.max) then target.max = b.max end end atks[mv[1]] = nil folded = folded + 1 end end fold(state.session.dmg and state.session.dmg.attacks) for _, sg in pairs(state.session.group_dmg or {}) do fold(sg.attacks) end if folded > 0 then state_save() end return folded end
local combat_round_threshold = 10
function ResetCombat() current_combat = { damage_dealt = 0, damage_received = 0, hits = 0, misses = 0, crits = 0, phits = 0, recv_phits = 0, dodges_by_mob = 0, dodges_by_me = 0, attacks = {}, combat_secs = 0, last_hit_time = os.time(), } end
function GetOrStartCombat() local now = os.time() RollDamageSlice(now) if not current_combat or (now - (current_combat.last_hit_time or 0)) > combat_idle_threshold then FlushCombatBuffer() ResetCombat() else local gap = now - current_combat.last_hit_time if gap > 0 and gap <= combat_round_threshold then current_combat.combat_secs = current_combat.combat_secs + gap state.session.dmg.combat_secs = state.session.dmg.combat_secs + gap end end current_combat.last_hit_time = now return current_combat end
-- `hits` is the true number of hits this line represents (the leading bracket). -- `.hits` counts LINES, as it always has, so history stays consistent; -- `.phits` / `.pdmg` are the accurate figures used for average-per-hit. function RecordSelfDamageDealt(attack_name, damage, is_crit, hits, target) hits = hits or 1 local _, cat = LookupDamtype(attack_name) local is_epic = (cat == "epic") -- Every hit counts toward the fight with the mob it names, epic ones included. if target then AddFightDamage(target, damage) end
local combat = GetOrStartCombat() if not is_epic then combat.damage_dealt = combat.damage_dealt + damage combat.hits = combat.hits + 1 combat.phits = (combat.phits or 0) + hits if is_crit then combat.crits = combat.crits + 1 end end
local atk = combat.attacks[attack_name] if not atk then atk = {dmg = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, min = damage, max = damage, phits = 0, pdmg = 0} combat.attacks[attack_name] = atk end atk.dmg = atk.dmg + damage atk.hits = atk.hits + 1 atk.phits = (atk.phits or 0) + hits atk.pdmg = (atk.pdmg or 0) + damage if is_crit then atk.crits = atk.crits + 1 end if damage < atk.min then atk.min = damage end if damage > atk.max then atk.max = damage end
local sd = state.session.dmg if is_epic then sd.epic_damage = (sd.epic_damage or 0) + damage sd.epic_hits = (sd.epic_hits or 0) + 1 sd.epic_phits = (sd.epic_phits or 0) + hits else sd.damage_dealt = sd.damage_dealt + damage sd.hits = sd.hits + 1 sd.phits = (sd.phits or 0) + hits if is_crit then sd.crits = sd.crits + 1 end end if not sd.attacks then sd.attacks = {} end local sa = sd.attacks[attack_name] if not sa then sa = {dmg = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, phits = 0, pdmg = 0} sd.attacks[attack_name] = sa end sa.dmg = sa.dmg + damage sa.hits = sa.hits + 1 sa.phits = (sa.phits or 0) + hits sa.pdmg = (sa.pdmg or 0) + damage if is_crit then sa.crits = sa.crits + 1 end DmgMeterQueueDraw() end
function RecordSelfDamageReceived(attack_name, damage, hits) hits = hits or 1 local combat = GetOrStartCombat() combat.damage_received = combat.damage_received + damage combat.recv_phits = (combat.recv_phits or 0) + hits local sd = state.session.dmg sd.damage_received = sd.damage_received + damage sd.recv_phits = (sd.recv_phits or 0) + hits sd.recv_lines = (sd.recv_lines or 0) + 1 end
function RecordSelfMiss() local combat = GetOrStartCombat() combat.misses = combat.misses + 1 state.session.dmg.misses = state.session.dmg.misses + 1 end
function RecordMobDodge() local combat = GetOrStartCombat() combat.dodges_by_mob = combat.dodges_by_mob + 1 state.session.dmg.dodges_by_mob = state.session.dmg.dodges_by_mob + 1 end
function RecordSelfDodge() local combat = GetOrStartCombat() combat.dodges_by_me = combat.dodges_by_me + 1 state.session.dmg.dodges_by_me = state.session.dmg.dodges_by_me + 1 end
function RecordGroupDamage(player_name, attack_name, damage, is_crit, hits) hits = hits or 1 local now = os.time() RollDamageSlice(now) local pc = group_combat[player_name] if not pc then pc = {damage = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, phits = 0, attacks = {}, combat_secs = 0, last_hit_time = now} group_combat[player_name] = pc end local reset_group = false if (now - pc.last_hit_time) > combat_idle_threshold then pc.damage = 0; pc.hits = 0; pc.crits = 0; pc.attacks = {}; pc.combat_secs = 0 pc.phits = 0 pc.level = nil reset_group = true else local gap = now - pc.last_hit_time if gap > 0 and gap <= combat_round_threshold then pc.combat_secs = (pc.combat_secs or 0) + gap local sg = state.session.group_dmg[player_name] if sg then sg.combat_secs = sg.combat_secs + gap end end end pc.last_hit_time = now -- Filed under the groupmate's own level. If they have levelled since this -- buffer started, what they did at the old level is flushed first. local glvl = GroupMemberLevel(player_name) if glvl and glvl > 0 then if (tonumber(pc.level) or 0) > 0 and pc.level ~= glvl and pc.hits > 0 then FlushCombatBuffer() end pc.level = glvl end pc.damage = pc.damage + damage pc.hits = pc.hits + 1 pc.phits = (pc.phits or 0) + hits if is_crit then pc.crits = pc.crits + 1 end
local atk = pc.attacks[attack_name] if not atk then atk = {dmg = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, min = damage, max = damage, phits = 0, pdmg = 0} pc.attacks[attack_name] = atk end atk.dmg = atk.dmg + damage atk.hits = atk.hits + 1 atk.phits = (atk.phits or 0) + hits atk.pdmg = (atk.pdmg or 0) + damage if is_crit then atk.crits = atk.crits + 1 end if damage < atk.min then atk.min = damage end if damage > atk.max then atk.max = damage end
local sg = state.session.group_dmg[player_name] if not sg then sg = {damage = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, phits = 0, combat_secs = 0, attacks = {}} state.session.group_dmg[player_name] = sg end sg.damage = sg.damage + damage sg.hits = sg.hits + 1 sg.phits = (sg.phits or 0) + hits if is_crit then sg.crits = sg.crits + 1 end if not sg.attacks then sg.attacks = {} end local sa = sg.attacks[attack_name] if not sa then sa = {dmg = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, phits = 0, pdmg = 0} sg.attacks[attack_name] = sa end sa.dmg = sa.dmg + damage sa.hits = sa.hits + 1 sa.phits = (sa.phits or 0) + hits sa.pdmg = (sa.pdmg or 0) + damage if is_crit then sa.crits = sa.crits + 1 end DmgMeterQueueDraw() end
-- Damage is stored per character level (1-200, with superhero as 201) so it can -- be compared as a character levels. 0 means unknown: everything recorded before -- v3.9, whose level was never saved.
-- Damage is also saved in 30-minute slices, so views can be filtered by date. A -- slice only exists if something was fought in it: rows are written from the -- combat buffers, and an idle half hour has nothing buffered. Slices start on the -- hour and half hour; a level change or an instinct/mastery snapshot starts a new -- one at that moment. DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS = 1800
function DamageSliceStart() local start = tonumber(state.current.dmg_slice_start) or 0 if start <= 0 then local now = os.time() start = now - now % DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS state.current.dmg_slice_start = start end return start end
-- Called before a hit is buffered. If the clock has moved into a new half hour -- since the slice began, everything buffered belongs to the old slice: save it -- under that slice, then start the new one. function RollDamageSlice(now) now = now or os.time() local half_hour = now - now % DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS local start = tonumber(state.current.dmg_slice_start) or 0 if start <= 0 then state.current.dmg_slice_start = half_hour elseif half_hour > start then FlushCombatBuffer() state.current.dmg_slice_start = half_hour end end
function LevelLabel(level) level = tonumber(level) or 0 if level <= 0 then return "unknown" end if level >= 201 then return "superhero" end return tostring(level) end
-- Tier, remort and redo go through here, as level does through SetCurrentLevel: -- a change saves the buffered combat under the old values and starts a new damage -- slice, so no slice ever mixes two of them. Values GMCP did not send are kept. function SetProgress(tier, remort, redo) local new_tier = tonumber(tier) or state.current.tier local new_remort = tonumber(remort) or state.current.remort local new_redo = tonumber(redo) or state.current.redo if state.current.progress_known and (new_tier ~= state.current.tier or new_remort ~= state.current.remort or new_redo ~= state.current.redo) then FlushCombatBuffer() state.current.dmg_slice_start = os.time() end state.current.tier, state.current.remort, state.current.redo = new_tier, new_remort, new_redo state.current.progress_known = true end
-- Your tier, remort and redo for stamping a record, or -1 while GMCP has not yet -- sent them this load (so a default of 0 is never recorded as if it were real). -- Your PK flags, from the whois header. -1 until a whois has been read this load, -- so rows recorded before that say "unknown" rather than "no". function StampOPK() local v = tonumber(state.current.opk) return (v == 0 or v == 1) and v or -1 end function StampHardcore() local v = tonumber(state.current.hardcore) return (v == 0 or v == 1) and v or -1 end
function StampTier() return state.current.progress_known and (tonumber(state.current.tier) or -1) or -1 end function StampRemort() return state.current.progress_known and (tonumber(state.current.remort) or -1) or -1 end function StampRedo() return state.current.progress_known and (tonumber(state.current.redo) or -1) or -1 end
-- A groupmate's own level from GMCP group data, or nil when they are not listed. function GroupMemberLevel(player_name) local ok, g = pcall(gmcp, "group") if not ok or type(g) ~= "table" or type(g.members) ~= "table" then return nil end local wanted = (player_name or ""):lower() for _, m in ipairs(g.members) do if (m.name or ""):lower() == wanted then local info = type(m.info) == "table" and m.info or {} return tonumber(info.lvl or info.level) end end return nil end
-- Every level change goes through here. A new level flushes the buffered combat -- first, so the fight that earned the level is filed under the level it was -- fought at rather than the one it reached. function SetCurrentLevel(level) level = tonumber(level) if not level or level <= 0 then return end local old = tonumber(state.current.level) or 0 if old > 0 and level ~= old then FlushCombatBuffer() state.current.dmg_slice_start = os.time() -- the new level starts a new slice now end state.current.level = level end
function FlushCombatBuffer() -- wail hits still waiting for a mana update go in first, as weapon hits if wail_pending and #wail_pending > 0 then ResolveWailPending("flush") end if not db then return end local now = os.time() local slice = DamageSliceStart() -- Your tier/remort/redo stamp every row of your own damage. Groupmates' are not -- in GMCP group data, so their rows carry -1 (unknown). local stamp_tier, stamp_remort, stamp_redo = StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo()
if current_combat and current_combat.combat_secs > 0 and (current_combat.hits > 0 or current_combat.misses > 0) then local csecs = current_combat.combat_secs local cls = fixsql(state.current.subclass or state.current.class or "") local rce = fixsql(state.current.race or "") local area = fixsql(state.current.area or "") local grouped = IsGrouped() and 1 or 0 local lvl = tonumber(state.current.level) or 0
db_exec("BEGIN;") local damtype_time_added = {} for atk_name, atk in pairs(current_combat.attacks) do if atk.hits > 0 then local dt, cat = ResolveDamtypeForCapture(atk_name, false) local fa = fixsql(atk_name) db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO attack_stats (attack_name,damtype,category,class,race,level,tier,remort,redo,slice_start,grouped,total_damage,combat_secs,total_hits,total_crits,min_hit,max_hit,precise_hits,precise_damage) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,0,0,0,0,999999999,0,0,0)", fa, fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat), cls, rce, lvl, stamp_tier, stamp_remort, stamp_redo, slice, grouped)) db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE attack_stats SET total_damage=total_damage+%d, combat_secs=combat_secs+%.1f, total_hits=total_hits+%d, total_crits=total_crits+%d, min_hit=MIN(min_hit,%d), max_hit=MAX(max_hit,%d), precise_hits=COALESCE(precise_hits,0)+%d, precise_damage=COALESCE(precise_damage,0)+%d, damtype=%s, category=%s WHERE attack_name=%s AND class=%s AND race=%s AND level=%d AND tier=%d AND remort=%d AND redo=%d AND slice_start=%d AND grouped=%d", atk.dmg, csecs, atk.hits, atk.crits, atk.min, atk.max, atk.phits or 0, atk.pdmg or 0, fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat), fa, cls, rce, lvl, stamp_tier, stamp_remort, stamp_redo, slice, grouped))
if dt ~= "unknown" then local fd = fixsql(dt) local dt_secs = damtype_time_added[dt] and 0 or csecs damtype_time_added[dt] = true db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO damtype_stats (damtype,class,level,tier,remort,redo,slice_start,grouped,total_damage,combat_secs,total_hits) VALUES (%s,%s,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,0,0,0)", fd, cls, lvl, stamp_tier, stamp_remort, stamp_redo, slice, grouped)) db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE damtype_stats SET total_damage=total_damage+%d, combat_secs=combat_secs+%.1f, total_hits=total_hits+%d WHERE damtype=%s AND class=%s AND level=%d AND tier=%d AND remort=%d AND redo=%d AND slice_start=%d AND grouped=%d", atk.dmg, dt_secs, atk.hits, fd, cls, lvl, stamp_tier, stamp_remort, stamp_redo, slice, grouped)) end end end
db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO area_combat_stats (area,class,grouped,level,tier,remort,redo,slice_start,total_damage,total_received,combat_secs) VALUES (%s,%s,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,0,0,0)", area, cls, grouped, lvl, stamp_tier, stamp_remort, stamp_redo, slice)) db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE area_combat_stats SET total_damage=total_damage+%d, total_received=total_received+%d, combat_secs=combat_secs+%.1f WHERE area=%s AND class=%s AND grouped=%d AND level=%d AND tier=%d AND remort=%d AND redo=%d AND slice_start=%d", current_combat.damage_dealt, current_combat.damage_received, csecs, area, cls, grouped, lvl, stamp_tier, stamp_remort, stamp_redo, slice)) db_exec("COMMIT;")
current_combat.damage_dealt = 0 current_combat.damage_received = 0 current_combat.hits = 0 current_combat.misses = 0 current_combat.crits = 0 current_combat.phits = 0 current_combat.recv_phits = 0 current_combat.dodges_by_mob = 0 current_combat.dodges_by_me = 0 current_combat.attacks = {} current_combat.combat_secs = 0 end
if next(group_combat) then db_exec("BEGIN;") for player_name, pc in pairs(group_combat) do if pc.hits > 0 and (pc.combat_secs or 0) > 0 then local csecs = pc.combat_secs local melee_dmg, spell_dmg = 0, 0 local fp = fixsql(player_name) local plvl = tonumber(pc.level) or 0 for atk_name, atk in pairs(pc.attacks) do local dt, cat = ResolveDamtypeForCapture(atk_name, true) local broad = DAMTYPE_BROAD[dt] or "magic" if broad == "physical" then melee_dmg = melee_dmg + atk.dmg else spell_dmg = spell_dmg + atk.dmg end
local fa = fixsql(atk_name) db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO player_attack_stats (player,attack_name,damtype,category,level,tier,remort,redo,slice_start,total_damage,combat_secs,total_hits,total_crits,min_hit,max_hit,precise_hits,precise_damage,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,-1,-1,-1,%d,0,0,0,0,999999999,0,0,0,%d)", fp, fa, fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat), plvl, slice, now)) db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE player_attack_stats SET total_damage=total_damage+%d, combat_secs=combat_secs+%.1f, total_hits=total_hits+%d, total_crits=total_crits+%d, min_hit=MIN(min_hit,%d), max_hit=MAX(max_hit,%d), precise_hits=COALESCE(precise_hits,0)+%d, precise_damage=COALESCE(precise_damage,0)+%d, damtype=%s, category=%s, last_seen=%d WHERE player=%s AND attack_name=%s AND level=%d AND tier=-1 AND remort=-1 AND redo=-1 AND slice_start=%d", atk.dmg, csecs, atk.hits, atk.crits, atk.min, atk.max, atk.phits or 0, atk.pdmg or 0, fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat), now, fp, fa, plvl, slice)) end
db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO player_profiles (player,level,tier,remort,redo,slice_start,total_damage,combat_secs,melee_damage,spell_damage,total_hits,total_crits,sessions_seen,first_seen,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%d,-1,-1,-1,%d,0,0,0,0,0,0,1,%d,%d)", fp, plvl, slice, now, now)) db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE player_profiles SET total_damage=total_damage+%d, combat_secs=combat_secs+%.1f, melee_damage=melee_damage+%d, spell_damage=spell_damage+%d, total_hits=total_hits+%d, total_crits=total_crits+%d, last_seen=%d WHERE player=%s AND level=%d AND tier=-1 AND remort=-1 AND redo=-1 AND slice_start=%d", pc.damage, csecs, melee_dmg, spell_dmg, pc.hits, pc.crits, now, fp, plvl, slice))
pc.damage = 0; pc.hits = 0; pc.crits = 0; pc.attacks = {} pc.phits = 0 pc.combat_secs = 0 pc.level = nil -- looked up again on the next hit end end db_exec("COMMIT;") local stale = {} for pname, pc in pairs(group_combat) do if pc.hits == 0 and (now - pc.last_hit_time) > combat_idle_threshold then stale[#stale + 1] = pname end end for _, pname in ipairs(stale) do group_combat[pname] = nil end end end
function OnCombatFlush(name) FlushCombatBuffer() end
-- Re-applies the current damage type mappings to every recorded attack, then -- recalculates the damage type totals from the attack totals. Nothing is emptied: -- attack totals, area combat and groupmates keep their numbers. Your own gaias -- damage keeps the element it was tagged with when it happened. A backup is made -- first. Returns true when it finished. function RebuildDamageStats() if not db then return false end if migration_blocked then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] The database is blocked after a failed upgrade; see cdt db.") return false end FlushCombatBuffer() pcall(function() db:exec("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);") end) local backup = string.format("%s.before-rebuild-%s.bak", db_path, os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")) local copied, copy_err = DbFileCopy(db_path, backup) if not copied then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Rebuild cancelled: couldn't make a backup first (" .. tostring(copy_err) .. ").") return false end
local before = db_query_one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(total_damage),0) AS td FROM damtype_stats") or {} local ok = db_exec("BEGIN;") local remapped, group_remapped, legacy_remapped = 0, 0, 0
local function remap(tbl, is_group, keep_gaias) local changed = 0 for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT DISTINCT attack_name FROM " .. tbl)) do if not ok then break end local spell = LookupSpellForVerb(r.attack_name) if not (keep_gaias and spell and GAIAS_SPELLS[spell]) then local dt, cat = ResolveDamtypeForCapture(r.attack_name, is_group) ok = db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE %s SET damtype = %s, category = %s WHERE attack_name = %s AND " .. "(COALESCE(damtype, '') <> %s OR COALESCE(category, '') <> %s)", tbl, fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat), fixsql(r.attack_name), fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat))) if ok then changed = changed + db:changes() end end end return changed end
if ok then remapped = remap("attack_stats", false, true) end if ok then group_remapped = remap("player_attack_stats", true, false) end if ok and ColumnExists("legacy_damage", "damtype") then legacy_remapped = remap("legacy_damage", false, true) end if ok then ok = RebuildDamtypeStats() end if ok then ok = db_exec("COMMIT;") else pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) end if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Damage rebuild failed and was undone; nothing changed.") return false end
local after = db_query_one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(total_damage),0) AS td FROM damtype_stats") or {} ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Damage types re-applied: rows changed %s yours, %s groupmates', %s old.", comma_value(remapped), comma_value(group_remapped), comma_value(legacy_remapped))) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Damage type totals: %s rows, %s damage (was %s rows, %s).", comma_value(after.n or 0), short_value(after.td or 0), comma_value(before.n or 0), short_value(before.td or 0))) ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Backup: " .. (backup:match("[^\\/]+$") or backup)) return true end
-- ============================================================================= -- STATE MANAGEMENT -- ============================================================================= function state_load() state = default_state() local saved = GetVariable("cdt_state") if saved then local f = loadstring("return " .. saved) if f then local loaded = f() if type(loaded) == "table" then deep_merge(state, loaded) end end end state.tracked = NewTrackedState() state.tracked_auto = NewTrackedState()
config = {} deep_merge(config, default_config) local saved_cfg = GetVariable("cdt_config") local loaded_cfg if saved_cfg then local f = loadstring("return " .. saved_cfg) if f then local loaded = f() if type(loaded) == "table" then deep_merge(config, loaded) loaded_cfg = loaded end end end MigrateEventConfig(loaded_cfg) end
function deep_merge(base, overlay) for k, v in pairs(overlay) do if type(v) == "table" and type(base[k]) == "table" then deep_merge(base[k], v) else base[k] = v end end end
