function state_save() -- Every handler that credits a reward saves straight afterwards, so a credit is -- timed from when it was made rather than from when something next looked. if NoteWorthCredits then NoteWorthCredits() end if DmgMeterSaveSettings then DmgMeterSaveSettings() end SetVariable("cdt_state", serialize.save_simple(state)) SetVariable("cdt_config", serialize.save_simple(config)) end
-- ============================================================================= -- SESSION MANAGEMENT -- ============================================================================= -- A session's counters start from zero. They used to carry on from the session -- before, so each session row held running totals since the last cdt reset. -- What measures progress against them (the level being worked on, a goal) keeps -- its progress by moving its baseline down by the old count. function StartSession() local old = state.session or {} local meter_before = DmgMeterBeforeSessionReset and DmgMeterBeforeSessionReset() state.session = default_state().session if DmgMeterAfterSessionReset then DmgMeterAfterSessionReset(meter_before) end local lt = state.level_tracking if lt then lt.xp_at_start = (tonumber(lt.xp_at_start) or 0) - (tonumber(old.xp) or 0) lt.kills_at_start = (tonumber(lt.kills_at_start) or 0) - (tonumber(old.kills) or 0) end local g = state.goal if g and g.type and g.type ~= "" then local counts = {pup = old.pups, level = old.levels, quest = old.quests_done, kill = old.kills} g.start_count = (tonumber(g.start_count) or 0) - (tonumber(counts[g.type]) or 0) end state.session.start_time = os.time() state.session.active_start = os.time() state.session.afk = false state.level_tracking.start_time = os.time() state.level_tracking.start_timer = Now() state.level_tracking.bonus_kills = 0
if db then db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO sessions (start_time, primary_class, tier, remort, redo, opk, hardcore) " .. "VALUES (%d, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", os.time(), fixsql(state.current.subclass), state.current.tier, state.current.remort, StampRedo(), StampOPK(), StampHardcore())) local row = db_query_one("SELECT last_insert_rowid() as id") if row then state.session.id = row.id end end
monitor_start = Now() xp_events = {} DebugNote("Session started (id=" .. tostring(state.session.id) .. ")") end
function EndSession() if state.session.active_start > 0 and not state.session.afk then state.session.total_active_secs = state.session.total_active_secs + (os.time() - state.session.active_start) state.session.active_start = 0 end
SweepFights(true) -- a disconnect ends every open fight FlushCombatBuffer() FlushTakenBuffer() FlushKillBuffer() UpdateDailyTotals()
-- The game's double carries on through a reload, a disconnect or cdt reset -- session, so it isn't ended here: its record stays open, and DoubleResume -- looks at it when play resumes. if state.current.double_active then DoubleLogEvent("the session ended (a disconnect, plugin reload or cdt reset session): double kept on") end
if db and state.session.id > 0 then db_exec(string.format([[UPDATE sessions SET end_time=%d, active_secs=%d, total_xp=%d, total_qp=%d, total_tp=%d, total_gold=%d, total_trains=%d, total_pracs=%d, levels=%d, pups=%d, quests_done=%d, quests_fail=%d, cps_done=%d, cps_fail=%d, gqs_joined=%d, gqs_won=%d, primary_class=%s, worth_qp=%d, worth_tp=%d, worth_trains=%d, worth_pracs=%d WHERE session_id=%d]], os.time(), state.session.total_active_secs, state.session.xp, state.session.qp, state.session.tp, state.session.gold, state.session.trains, state.session.pracs, state.session.levels, state.session.pups, state.session.quests_done, state.session.quests_fail, state.session.cps_done, state.session.cps_fail, state.session.gqs_joined, state.session.gqs_won, fixsql(state.current.subclass), tonumber(state.session.worth_qp) or 0, tonumber(state.session.worth_tp) or 0, tonumber(state.session.worth_trains) or 0, tonumber(state.session.worth_pracs) or 0, state.session.id)) end
state_save() DebugNote("Session ended") end
-- ============================================================================= -- TRACKED SESSION HELPERS -- ============================================================================= function CreditTracked(field, amount) if state.tracked.active then state.tracked[field] = state.tracked[field] + (amount or 1) end if state.tracked_auto.active then state.tracked_auto[field] = state.tracked_auto[field] + (amount or 1) end end
function CreditTrackedMulti(fields) for field, amount in pairs(fields) do CreditTracked(field, amount) end end
-- ============================================================================= -- XP ENGINE -- ============================================================================= function AddXP(amount) amount = tonumber(amount) if not amount or amount <= 0 then return end state.session.xp = state.session.xp + amount xp_events[#xp_events + 1] = {t = Now(), xp = amount}
CreditTracked("xp", amount) end
-- ============================================================================= -- COMBAT DAMAGE TRIGGER HANDLERS -- ============================================================================= function StripCombatLine(line) local s = line:gsub("^%*", ""):gsub("^%[%d+%] ", "") s = s:gsub("^%b[] ", ""):gsub("^%b[] ", ""):gsub("^%b[] ", "") return s:gsub("^%*", ""):gsub("%s*%[%d+%]%*?$", "") end
-- A heal prints like a hit -- "You feel greatly healed by Bob's magic. [4760]" -- -- so the damage patterns catch it. It is no one's damage: it is only hidden (or -- not) by the groupheal and allheal gags. function IsHealLine(line) local s = StripCombatLine(line):lower() return s:find("healed by ", 1, true) ~= nil or s:find(" heals ", 1, true) ~= nil end
-- Is this player in your group right now (by GMCP's group list)? function IsGroupMember(player_name) local ok, g = pcall(gmcp, "group") if not ok or type(g) ~= "table" or type(g.members) ~= "table" then return false end local wanted, me = (player_name or ""):lower(), (state.current.name or ""):lower() for _, m in ipairs(g.members) do local nm = (m.name or ""):lower() if nm ~= "" and nm == wanted and nm ~= me then return true end end return false end
function LogHeal(healer, is_self, spell, amount, level) local hs = state.session.heals if type(hs) ~= "table" then hs = {}; state.session.heals = hs end local key = is_self and "@self" or (healer or ""):lower() local h = hs[key] if not h then h = {name = healer, amount = 0, casts = 0, spells = {}}; hs[key] = h end h.amount, h.casts = h.amount + amount, h.casts + 1 local sp = h.spells[spell] if not sp then sp = {amount = 0, casts = 0}; h.spells[spell] = sp end sp.amount, sp.casts = sp.amount + amount, sp.casts + 1 if not is_self and spell == "incomplete healing" then healer_cast_amount[key] = amount end if not db then return end db_exec(string.format("INSERT INTO heal_log (time, healer, self, spell, amount, level, tier, remort, redo, " .. "slice_start, session_id) VALUES (%d, %s, %d, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", os.time(), fixsql(healer), is_self and 1 or 0, fixsql(spell), amount, tonumber(level) or 0, is_self and StampTier() or -1, is_self and StampRemort() or -1, is_self and StampRedo() or -1, HealSliceStart(), tonumber(state.session.id) or 0)) end
-- Incomplete healing is the only heal that names its caster: "your magic touch" when -- it's yours, "<player>'s magic" when it's theirs. Recorded under the spell's name. HEAL_SPELL_BY_NOUN = {["magic touch"] = "incomplete healing", ["magic"] = "incomplete healing"} function HealSpellName(noun) noun = (noun or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") return HEAL_SPELL_BY_NOUN[noun:lower()] or noun end
-- Your own heal on yourself: "You are greatly healed by your magic touch. [2093]". function OnSelfHealed(name, line, wildcards) local spell = ScrollSpell("@self", HealSpellName(wildcards.spell)) local amount = tonumber(wildcards.amount) or 0 if spell == "" or amount <= 0 then return end LogHeal(state.current.name ~= "" and state.current.name or "you", true, spell, amount, state.current.level) GroupLog("heal", {healer = "@self", target = "@self", spell = spell, amount = amount}) DebugNote(string.format("Self heal %s: %d", spell, amount)) end
-- "Ranger Bob" -> "Bob": the game can put a title before a name. When a -- groupmate's name is the whole target or its last word(s), use their name. function GroupMemberInName(text) local ok, g = pcall(gmcp, "group") local low = (text or ""):lower() if ok and type(g) == "table" and type(g.members) == "table" then for _, m in ipairs(g.members) do local nm = m.name or "" local l = nm:lower() if l ~= "" and (low == l or low:sub(-(#l + 1)) == " " .. l) then return nm end end end return text end
-- A player as a heal line names them: Aardwolf names are one word, and a pretitle can put -- words in front ("Dark Lord Bob", "Ranger Alice"). A groupmate is matched against -- the group list; anyone else is the last word, unless the text reads like a mob's ("a", -- "an" or "the" first). ignore_group: for records from the past, when the group then -- isn't known. function PlayerName(text, ignore_group) text = (text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if not ignore_group then local member = GroupMemberInName(text) if member ~= text then return member end end if not text:find("%s") then return text end local first = text:match("^(%S+)"):lower() if first == "a" or first == "an" or first == "the" then return text end return text:match("(%S+)$") end
-- Heal records go under the half hour they happened in. (The damage tables' running -- slice only moves on with damage, so it can be an earlier half hour by then.) function HealSliceStart(t) t = t or os.time() return t - t % DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS end
-- 4.4.1: heal records from before keep a player's pretitle, and some were filed under an -- earlier half hour. Put right at every load; once done, it finds nothing to change. function RepairHealRecords() if not db then return end local function rename(tbl, col, extra) if not DbTableExists("main", tbl) then return end for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format("SELECT DISTINCT %s AS n FROM %s WHERE %s LIKE '%% %%'%s", col, tbl, col, extra or ""))) do local new = PlayerName(r.n, true) if new ~= r.n then db_exec(string.format("UPDATE %s SET %s = %s WHERE %s = %s%s", tbl, col, fixsql(new), col, fixsql(r.n), extra or "")) end end end rename("heal_log", "healer", " AND self = 0") rename("heal_given", "target") rename("group_heals", "healer") rename("group_heals", "target") for _, tbl in ipairs({"heal_log", "heal_given", "group_heals"}) do if DbTableExists("main", tbl) then db_exec(string.format("UPDATE %s SET slice_start = time - time %% %d WHERE time > 0 AND " .. "slice_start <> time - time %% %d", tbl, DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS, DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS)) end end end
-- Your heal on another player: "Ranger Bob is greatly healed by your magic touch. [4061]". function OnHealedOther(name, line, wildcards) RecordHealGiven(PlayerName(wildcards.target), ScrollSpell("@self", HealSpellName(wildcards.spell)), tonumber(wildcards.amount) or 0) end
-- Your regeneration on another player: "A great healing power courses through the -- veins of Invite Bob leaving him greatly regenerated. [5403]". function OnRegenOther(name, line, wildcards) RecordHealGiven(PlayerName(wildcards.target), ScrollSpell("@self", "regeneration"), tonumber(wildcards.amount) or 0) end
function RecordHealGiven(target, spell, amount) if target == "" or spell == "" or amount <= 0 then return end local hg = state.session.heals_given if type(hg) ~= "table" then hg = {}; state.session.heals_given = hg end local key = target:lower() local h = hg[key] if not h then h = {name = target, amount = 0, casts = 0}; hg[key] = h end h.amount, h.casts = h.amount + amount, h.casts + 1 GroupLog("heal", {healer = "@self", target = target, spell = spell, amount = amount}) DebugNote(string.format("Healed %s with %s: %d", target, spell, amount)) if not db or not DbTableExists("main", "heal_given") then return end db_exec(string.format("INSERT INTO heal_given (time, target, spell, amount, level, target_level, tier, remort, " .. "redo, slice_start, session_id) VALUES (%d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", os.time(), fixsql(target), fixsql(spell), amount, tonumber(state.current.level) or 0, GroupMemberLevel(target) or 0, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo(), HealSliceStart(), tonumber(state.session.id) or 0)) end
-- ============================================================================= -- Groupmates' healing that no heal line shows you (4.4) -- ============================================================================= -- A heal of each spell when nothing could be measured (no group data for its target): -- a scroll read on someone else, or a groupmate's regeneration whose target no hp jump -- points to. Stats change a heal, scrolls' too, so a measured one is used when there is one. HEAL_FALLBACK = {["incomplete healing"] = 3400, ["regeneration"] = 4600} SCROLL_IH_CAP = 3400 -- most an incomplete healing scroll's heal is counted at scroll_pending = nil
-- Right after a recite line, the heal lines its scroll casts on you (or yours, on -- anyone) are the scroll's: their spell gets " (scroll)", apart from cast heals. function ScrollSpell(healer_key, spell) local p = scroll_pending if not p then return spell end if p.left <= 0 or Now() - p.t > 2 then scroll_pending = nil return spell end if p.healer ~= healer_key or (p.spell and p.spell ~= spell) then return spell end p.left = p.left - 1 if p.left <= 0 then scroll_pending = nil end return spell .. " (scroll)" end
-- Who read the scroll a regeneration line on you came from, if one was just read on -- you: {key, name}, one heal used up. The line itself names no one. function ScrollReader(spell) local p = scroll_pending if not p or p.spell ~= spell or p.left <= 0 or Now() - p.t > 2 then return nil end p.left = p.left - 1 if p.left <= 0 then scroll_pending = nil end return {key = p.healer, name = p.name} end
-- Scrolls read on someone else, waiting for the next group update to measure their -- target's hp gain. Recorded then, or with HEAL_FALLBACK when nothing can be measured. scroll_watch = {} SCROLL_WATCH_SECS = 8 -- longest a scroll waits for a group update
-- Records waiting scrolls. With rows (a group update): each by its target's hp gain in -- it, capped for incomplete healing; the gain is used up, so a cast guess doesn't count -- it again. Without (the timer, nothing came): by HEAL_FALLBACK. function ResolveScrollWatch(rows) if #scroll_watch == 0 then return end local list = scroll_watch scroll_watch = {} for _, w in ipairs(list) do local hp for _, r in ipairs(rows or {}) do if r.key == w.target:lower() then local gain = r.left or r.rise if gain and gain > 0 then hp = w.spell == "incomplete healing" and math.min(gain, w.heals * SCROLL_IH_CAP) or gain r.left = gain - hp end end end local measured = hp ~= nil hp = hp or w.heals * HEAL_FALLBACK[w.spell] RecordGroupHeals(w.reader, w.target, "scroll", w.heals, hp, nil, w.spell) DebugNote(string.format("Scroll by %s on %s: %d %s, %s hp (%s)", w.reader, w.target, w.heals, w.spell, comma_value(hp), measured and "their hp gain" or "not measured")) end end
heal_wait_seq = 0 -- ids for scrolls and regeneration lines waiting on a group update
-- No group update came for scroll id: recorded by HEAL_FALLBACK. function ScrollWatchTimeout(id) local keep, due = {}, {} for _, w in ipairs(scroll_watch) do if w.id == id then due[#due + 1] = w else keep[#keep + 1] = w end end if #due == 0 then return end scroll_watch = due ResolveScrollWatch(nil) scroll_watch = keep end
-- Regeneration lines on you waiting for their caster: the next group update shows whose -- mana dropped by its cost (yours first: your own mana is exact). Not explained by a -- second update: "unknown". Solo, it's yours. regen_on_you = {} REGEN_COST = 1100 -- regeneration's mana cost; an Eldar's 825 REGEN_WAIT_SECS = 8 -- longest a line waits when no group update comes
function MyName() return state.current.name ~= "" and state.current.name or "you" end
function LogRegenOnYou(p, healer, is_self) LogHeal(is_self and MyName() or healer, is_self, "regeneration", p.amount, is_self and state.current.level or (GroupMemberLevel(healer) or 0)) GroupLog("heal", {healer = is_self and "@self" or healer, target = "@self", spell = "regeneration", amount = p.amount}) DebugNote(string.format("Regeneration on you by %s: %d", is_self and "you" or healer, p.amount)) end
-- "A great healing power courses through your veins leaving you greatly regenerated. [N]" function OnRegenOnYou(name, line, wildcards) if config.gags.allheal then HideMatchedLine(line) end local amount = tonumber(wildcards.amount) or 0 if amount <= 0 then return end local reader = ScrollReader("regeneration") if reader then local mine = reader.key == "@self" LogHeal(mine and MyName() or reader.name, mine, "regeneration (scroll)", amount, mine and state.current.level or (GroupMemberLevel(reader.name) or 0)) return end if not IsGrouped() then LogRegenOnYou({amount = amount}, nil, true) return end heal_wait_seq = heal_wait_seq + 1 regen_on_you[#regen_on_you + 1] = {amount = amount, t = Now(), scans = 0, id = heal_wait_seq} DoAfterSpecial(REGEN_WAIT_SECS, string.format("RegenOnYouTimeout(%d)", heal_wait_seq), 12) end
-- No group update came for line id: yours if you're no longer grouped, else unknown. function RegenOnYouTimeout(id) for i, p in ipairs(regen_on_you) do if p.id == id then table.remove(regen_on_you, i) if IsGrouped() then LogRegenOnYou(p, "unknown", false) else LogRegenOnYou(p, nil, true) end return end end end
-- Your regeneration casts in a drop of your own mana: an exact cost (with an incomplete -- healing alongside, or two), or failing that one if the drop is at least the cost. function MyRegenCasts(drop) local eldar = (state.current.race or ""):lower() == "eldar" local hit = HEAL_CAST_DROPS[drop] if hit and hit[1] == (eldar and "eldar" or "full") then return hit[3] end if hit then return 0 end return drop >= (eldar and REGEN_COST * 0.75 or REGEN_COST) and 1 or 0 end
-- Gives the waiting regeneration lines on you their casters from this update: you, -- then groupmates whose drop included a regeneration (each used up). The hp a line -- explains comes off your own jump, so a cast guess doesn't count it again. function ClaimRegenOnYou(rows, casts_by) if #regen_on_you == 0 then return end local me_row for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if r.me then me_row = r end end local function claim(healer, is_self) local p = table.remove(regen_on_you, 1) LogRegenOnYou(p, healer, is_self) if me_row and me_row.rise then me_row.left = (me_row.left or me_row.rise) - p.amount end end if me_row and me_row.drop then for _ = 1, MyRegenCasts(me_row.drop) do if #regen_on_you == 0 then break end claim(nil, true) end end for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local c = casts_by[r] while c and c.regen > 0 and #regen_on_you > 0 do c.regen = c.regen - 1 claim(r.name, false) end end for _, p in ipairs(regen_on_you) do p.scans = p.scans + 1 end while #regen_on_you > 0 and regen_on_you[1].scans >= 2 do claim("unknown", false) end end
local SCROLL_SELF_TARGETS = {himself = true, herself = true, itself = true, themselves = true, themself = true, yourself = true}
-- "Alice recites a scroll of 3*incomplete healing on you." / "... on herself." / -- "... on Bob." function OnScrollRecite(name, line, wildcards) local who = (wildcards.who or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local target = (wildcards.target or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local heals = tonumber(wildcards.n) or 1 local spell = (wildcards.spell or "incomplete healing"):lower() if who == "" or target == "" or heals < 1 then return end local mine = who:lower() == "you" local reader = mine and "@self" or PlayerName(who) local tl = target:lower() GroupLog("scroll", {reader = reader, target = target, heals = heals, spell = spell}) if mine or tl == "you" then scroll_pending = {healer = mine and "@self" or reader:lower(), name = reader, spell = spell, left = heals, t = Now()} DebugNote(string.format("Scroll by %s on %s: %d %s", reader, target, heals, spell)) return end -- Someone else's scroll on anyone but you: measured by the target's hp gain in the -- next group update. heal_wait_seq = heal_wait_seq + 1 scroll_watch[#scroll_watch + 1] = {reader = reader, target = SCROLL_SELF_TARGETS[tl] and reader or PlayerName(target), spell = spell, heals = heals, t = Now(), id = heal_wait_seq} DoAfterSpecial(SCROLL_WATCH_SECS, string.format("ScrollWatchTimeout(%d)", heal_wait_seq), 12) end
-- spell: "incomplete healing" (default) or "regeneration". A regeneration cast's amount -- is its measured hp, like a scroll's; an incomplete healing cast's is 0 (worked out -- from the healer's heal size). function RecordGroupHeals(healer, target, source, heals, amount, rise, spell) spell = spell or "incomplete healing" local gh = state.session.group_heals if type(gh) ~= "table" then gh = {}; state.session.group_heals = gh end local key = healer:lower() local h = gh[key] if not h then h = {name = healer, casts = 0, scroll_heals = 0, scroll_hp = 0, regen_casts = 0, regen_hp = 0}; gh[key] = h end if source == "cast" and spell == "regeneration" then h.regen_casts, h.regen_hp = (h.regen_casts or 0) + heals, (h.regen_hp or 0) + (amount or 0) elseif source == "cast" then h.casts = h.casts + heals else h.scroll_heals, h.scroll_hp = h.scroll_heals + heals, h.scroll_hp + amount end GroupLog("group_heal", {healer = healer, target = target, source = source, heals = heals, amount = amount, spell = spell}) DebugNote(string.format("%s: %s %d %s%s", healer, source, heals, spell, target ~= "" and (" on " .. target) or "")) if not db or not DbTableExists("main", "group_heals") then return end if (tonumber(rise) or 0) > 0 and spell == "incomplete healing" then healer_size_est[key] = nil end db_exec(string.format("INSERT INTO group_heals (time, healer, target, source, heals, amount, level, rise, " .. "slice_start, session_id, spell) VALUES (%d, %s, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s)", os.time(), fixsql(healer), fixsql(target or ""), fixsql(source), heals, math.floor(amount or 0), GroupMemberLevel(healer) or 0, math.floor(tonumber(rise) or 0), HealSliceStart(), tonumber(state.session.id) or 0, fixsql(spell))) end
-- Incomplete healing costs 950 mana; an Eldar's costs 25% less, 712.5, which the game -- rounds to 712 or 713. The group data doesn't say who is an Eldar, so either cost -- counts, and each player's is learned: once one cost has 3 casts and the other none, -- a lone drop of the other is taken as some other spell. A player can change race, -- so the learned cost is dropped when their level falls (a remort), and two drops in -- a row at the other cost switch it: both count. Two casts in one update (3 s) show -- as twice the cost. -- Regeneration costs 1,100 (an Eldar's 825); one of each in an update shows as the sum. -- Each drop: {cost kind, incomplete healing casts, regeneration casts}. HEAL_CAST_DROPS = {[950] = {"full", 1, 0}, [1900] = {"full", 2, 0}, [712] = {"eldar", 1, 0}, [713] = {"eldar", 1, 0}, [1424] = {"eldar", 2, 0}, [1425] = {"eldar", 2, 0}, [1426] = {"eldar", 2, 0}, [1100] = {"full", 0, 1}, [2200] = {"full", 0, 2}, [2050] = {"full", 1, 1}, [825] = {"eldar", 0, 1}, [1650] = {"eldar", 0, 2}, [1537] = {"eldar", 1, 1}, [1538] = {"eldar", 1, 1}} group_mana_prev, group_cast_costs = {}, {} -- The group's leader as of the last group data (nil when not grouped). Only for the -- heal split in the meter and its reports; never saved. group_leader = nil
-- A cast in the same update as a regen tick (-871) or another spell (-1,055) isn't an -- exact cost. For a player whose cost is learned, a drop near it counts too: 850 to -- 1,050 for one cast, 1,800 to 2,000 for two (an Eldar's scaled by 0.75). On the test -- log this found 119 more of the user's own casts for 15 false ones. HEAL_NEAR_DROPS = {full = {{850, 1050, 1}, {1800, 2000, 2}}, eldar = {{638, 788, 1}, {1350, 1500, 2}}}
local function NearCostCasts(cost, drop) for _, band in ipairs(HEAL_NEAR_DROPS[cost] or {}) do if drop >= band[1] and drop <= band[2] then return band[3] end end return 0 end
-- How many incomplete healing and regeneration casts a drop is, and how many of each -- held from a lone earlier drop now turn out to be casts too (a race change): -- heal, regen, held_heal, held_regen. Near a cost counts for incomplete healing only. function HealCastsInDrop(key, drop, level) local seen = group_cast_costs[key] if not seen or (level and seen.level and level < seen.level) then seen = {full = 0, eldar = 0}; group_cast_costs[key] = seen end seen.level = level or seen.level local hit = HEAL_CAST_DROPS[drop] if not hit then -- Not an exact cost: near one only counts once the player's cost is known. return seen.cost and NearCostCasts(seen.cost, drop) or 0, 0, 0, 0 end local kind, heal, regen = hit[1], hit[2], hit[3] if not seen.cost then seen[kind] = seen[kind] + heal + regen local other = kind == "full" and "eldar" or "full" if seen[kind] >= 3 and seen[other] == 0 then seen.cost = kind end return heal, regen, 0, 0 end if kind == seen.cost then seen.held = nil return heal, regen, 0, 0 end if seen.held then -- A second drop at the other cost before any at the learned one: they changed race. local held = seen.held seen.cost, seen.held = kind, nil seen.full, seen.eldar = 0, 0 seen[kind] = held.heal + held.regen + heal + regen return heal, regen, held.heal, held.regen end seen.held = {heal = heal, regen = regen} return 0, 0, 0, 0 end
-- Every GMCP group update (about every 3 s): each groupmate's mana against their last. -- Only an exact cost counts: a regen tick or another spell in the same 3 seconds hides -- a cast (about 1 in 8 in testing), and a wasted heal still costs its mana. Skipped -- after a gap, a max mana change (spellups, a level) or on a member's first update. function GroupHealScan() local ok, g = pcall(gmcp, "group") group_leader = ok and type(g) == "table" and type(g.leader) == "string" and g.leader ~= "" and g.leader or nil if not ok or type(g) ~= "table" or type(g.members) ~= "table" then return end local now, me = os.time(), (state.current.name or ""):lower() local present, rows = {}, {} for _, m in ipairs(g.members) do local mname = m.name or "" local key = mname:lower() local info = type(m.info) == "table" and m.info or {} local mn, mmn = tonumber(info.mn), tonumber(info.mmn) local hp, mhp = tonumber(info.hp), tonumber(info.mhp) if key ~= "" and mn and mmn then present[key] = true local prev = group_mana_prev[key] local fresh = prev and now - prev.t <= 10 rows[#rows + 1] = {name = mname, key = key, me = key == me, here = info.here == "1", level = tonumber(info.lvl), hp = hp, mhp = mhp, drop = (fresh and prev.mmn == mmn) and (prev.mn - mn) or nil, rise = (fresh and prev.hp and hp and prev.mhp == mhp) and (hp - prev.hp) or nil} group_mana_prev[key] = {mn = mn, mmn = mmn, hp = hp, mhp = mhp, t = now} end end for key in pairs(group_mana_prev) do if not present[key] then group_mana_prev[key] = nil end end -- Scrolls read on others take their target's hp gain first: who they healed is known. ResolveScrollWatch(rows) -- Yours are known exactly from your heal lines, so you're never a caster here (your -- mana only names the caster of a regeneration line on you). local casts_by = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if not r.me and not r.drop and r.level then HealCastsInDrop(r.key, 0, r.level) end if not r.me and r.drop then local heal, regen, held, held_regen = HealCastsInDrop(r.key, r.drop, r.level) if held > 0 then RecordGroupHeals(r.name, "", "cast", held, 0) end if held_regen > 0 then RecordGroupHeals(r.name, "", "cast", held_regen, held_regen * HEAL_FALLBACK["regeneration"], nil, "regeneration") end casts_by[r] = {heal = heal, regen = regen} end end ClaimRegenOnYou(rows, casts_by) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local c = casts_by[r] if c then -- regeneration first: the bigger heal, the bigger jump for _ = 1, c.regen do local target, hp = GuessRegenTarget(r, rows) RecordGroupHeals(r.name, target or "", "cast", 1, hp or HEAL_FALLBACK["regeneration"], nil, "regeneration") end if c.heal > 0 then local target, sample = GuessHealTarget(r, rows) RecordGroupHeals(r.name, target or "", "cast", c.heal, 0, c.heal == 1 and sample or nil) end end end end
-- Who a groupmate's regeneration most likely healed, and how much: the member whose hp -- rose the most in the same update (as GuessHealTarget, you left out: one on you shows -- a line), and that rise, all of it used up. nil when no one's hp jumped. function GuessRegenTarget(caster, rows) local best for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local left = r.left or r.rise if not r.me and left and left >= HEAL_GUESS_MIN_RISE and r.here == caster.here then if not best or left > (best.left or best.rise) then best = r end end end if not best then return nil end local jump = best.left or best.rise best.left = 0 return best.name, jump end
HEAL_GUESS_MIN_RISE = 1500
-- Who a cast most likely healed: in the same update, the member whose hp rose the most -- (at least HEAL_GUESS_MIN_RISE), among those in the healer's room as far as the -- group data shows (here, or not here, alike). A best guess: damage, other heals and -- regen land in the same 3 seconds. On the 25-hour test log it named the right player -- for 75% of known heals, the wrong one for 13%, and no one for 11%. A rise given to -- one cast is used up, so two healers don't both claim the same jump. -- Also returns a sample of the healer's heal size: the jump, when the target was the -- only member whose hp jumped and isn't at full hp (a capped jump says nothing). function GuessHealTarget(caster, rows) local best, count = nil, 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local left = r.left or r.rise if left and left >= HEAL_GUESS_MIN_RISE and r.here == caster.here then count = count + 1 if not best or left > (best.left or best.rise) then best = r end end end if not best then return nil end local jump = best.left or best.rise local sample = (count == 1 and not best.left and best.hp and best.mhp and best.hp < best.mhp) and jump or nil best.left = jump - (HealerSize(caster.name) or jump) return best.name, sample end
-- A healer's heal size when they've never healed you: the lower quartile of the hp -- jumps their casts caused (regen and other heals only add to a jump, so the low end -- is nearest the heal: it matched two healers' real sizes exactly in -- testing). Needs HEAL_SIZE_MIN_SAMPLES; until then, 3,400 is assumed (a heal with no -- instinct; not a floor: one healer's heals on the user were 2,695). HEAL_SIZE_MIN_SAMPLES = 5 HEAL_BASE_SIZE = 3400 healer_size_est = {}
function HealerSizeEstimate(name) local key = (name or ""):lower() if healer_size_est[key] == nil then local rises = {} if db and DbTableExists("main", "group_heals") then for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format("SELECT rise FROM group_heals WHERE healer = %s COLLATE NOCASE " .. "AND rise > 0 AND spell = 'incomplete healing' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200", fixsql(name or "")))) do rises[#rises + 1] = tonumber(r.rise) or 0 end end table.sort(rises) healer_size_est[key] = #rises >= HEAL_SIZE_MIN_SAMPLES and rises[math.floor(#rises / 4) + 1] or false end return healer_size_est[key] or nil end
-- A healer's heal size, and where it came from: "known" (their heal on you), "est" (from -- hp jumps) or "assumed" (3,400). function HealerSize(name) local known = HealerCastAmount(name) if known then return known, "known" end local est = HealerSizeEstimate(name) if est then return est, "est" end return HEAL_BASE_SIZE, "assumed" end
function HealerSizeText(name) local size, kind = HealerSize(name) return (kind == "est" and "~" or "") .. comma_value(size) .. (kind == "assumed" and "?" or "") end
-- The size of a healer's cast: their incomplete healing on you, last seen (it carries -- their instinct). nil until they've healed you. healer_cast_amount = {} function HealerCastAmount(name) local key = (name or ""):lower() if healer_cast_amount[key] == nil then local r = db and DbTableExists("main", "heal_log") and db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT amount FROM heal_log WHERE self = 0 AND healer = %s COLLATE NOCASE AND spell = 'incomplete healing' " .. "ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1", fixsql(name or ""))) healer_cast_amount[key] = (r and tonumber(r.amount)) or false end return healer_cast_amount[key] or nil end
function OnHealedBy(name, line, wildcards) -- "Dark Lord Bob" is Bob: a pretitle before a name is dropped. local player = PlayerName(wildcards.player) if config.gags.allheal or (config.gags.groupheal and IsGroupMember(player)) then HideMatchedLine(line) end local spell = ScrollSpell(player:lower(), HealSpellName(wildcards.spell)) local amount = tonumber(wildcards.amount) or 0 if player ~= "" and amount > 0 then GroupLog("heal", {healer = player, target = "@self", spell = spell, amount = amount}) end if player == "" or spell == "" or amount <= 0 or not db then return end LogHeal(player, false, spell, amount, GroupMemberLevel(player) or 0) DebugNote(string.format("Healed by %s's %s: %d", player, spell, amount)) end
-- ============================================================================= -- Your 'wail': the harmer spell void sermon prints its damage as "Your wail ...", the -- same word a sonic weapon uses. cdt wail says which yours is: all one, all the -- other, or "both", where a wail line is held until the next GMCP mana update and -- counts as void sermon if your mana dropped by a cast's cost. Mana given back in -- the meantime (consume, regen) hides a cast, so "both" comes with a warning. -- Groupmates' and mobs' wail is always a sonic weapon. -- ============================================================================= WAIL_SERMON_COST = 80 -- void sermon's base mana cost; Eldar pay 25% less WAIL_HOLD_SECS = 1.5 -- longest a wail line waits for a mana update WAIL_MODES = {weapon = true, sermon = true, both = true} wail_pending = {} -- your held wail hits, in the order they arrived wail_last_mana = nil -- your mana in the last char.vitals wail_seq = 0 -- the newest hold timer; an older one does nothing
function WailMode() local m = config.wail_mode return WAIL_MODES[m] and m or "weapon" end
function WailSermonCost() if (state.current.race or ""):lower() == "eldar" then return WAIL_SERMON_COST * 0.75 end return WAIL_SERMON_COST end
-- Records the held wail hits. mana_now (from a char.vitals) decides them: each drop -- of a cast's cost since the first was held is one void sermon, given to the hits -- with the biggest damage per hit (a spell hits harder than a weapon). Without it -- (timer, flush, mode change) they're weapon hits. The queue is emptied first: -- recording can start a new fight, which flushes. function ResolveWailPending(reason, seq, mana_now) if seq and seq ~= wail_seq then return end if #wail_pending == 0 then return end local held = wail_pending wail_pending = {} wail_seq = wail_seq + 1 local before = held[1].mana_before local drop = (before and mana_now) and (before - mana_now) or 0 local casts = math.max(0, math.floor(drop / WailSermonCost())) local order = {} for i = 1, #held do order[i] = i end table.sort(order, function(a, b) local x, y = held[a].damage / held[a].hits, held[b].damage / held[b].hits if x ~= y then return x > y end return a < b end) local sermon = {} for i = 1, math.min(casts, #held) do sermon[order[i]] = true end for i, h in ipairs(held) do local attack = sermon[i] and "void sermon" or "wail" RecordSelfDamageDealt(attack, h.damage, h.is_crit, h.hits, h.target) DebugNote(string.format("Dmg dealt: %s [%d] x%d%s (wail, %s)", attack, h.damage, h.hits, h.is_crit and " CRIT" or "", mana_now and string.format("mana %+d", -drop) or reason)) end end
-- Every char.vitals: settles held wail hits against the new mana, then remembers it. function WailOnVitals() local ok, v = pcall(gmcp, "char.vitals") if not ok or type(v) ~= "table" then return end local mana = tonumber(v.mana) if not mana then return end if #wail_pending > 0 then ResolveWailPending("vitals", nil, mana) end wail_last_mana = mana end
function OnSelfDamageDealt(name, line, wildcards) local damage, is_crit = ExtractDamageInfo(line) if damage <= 0 then return end local clean = StripCombatLine(line):match("^Your (.+)[%.!]$") if not clean then return end local attack = ExtractAttackName(clean) if not attack then return end local hits = ExtractHitCount(line) if attack:lower() == "wail" then local mode = WailMode() if mode == "sermon" then attack = "void sermon" elseif mode == "both" then wail_pending[#wail_pending + 1] = {damage = damage, is_crit = is_crit, hits = hits, target = ExtractDamageTarget(clean), mana_before = wail_last_mana} if #wail_pending == 1 then DoAfterSpecial(WAIL_HOLD_SECS, string.format("ResolveWailPending('timeout', %d)", wail_seq), 12) end DebugNote(string.format("Dmg dealt: wail [%d] x%d%s, held for the next mana update", damage, hits, is_crit and " CRIT" or "")) return end end RecordSelfDamageDealt(attack, damage, is_crit, hits, ExtractDamageTarget(clean)) DebugNote(string.format("Dmg dealt: %s [%d] x%d%s", attack, damage, hits, is_crit and " CRIT" or "")) end
-- "A Titan's slash maims Bob" -> attacker, attack, target. The attacker ends at the -- last possessive before the verb ("Orzbuk's guard's slash" -> "Orzbuk's guard"). function ParseHitLine(line) local s = StripCombatLine(line):gsub("[%.!]+$", "") local prefix = ExtractAttackName(s) if not prefix then return nil end local attacker, attack = prefix:match("^(.*)'s? (.+)$") if not attacker or attacker == "" then return nil end return attacker, attack, ExtractDamageTarget(s) end
taken_buffer = {}
function BufferTaken(victim, is_self, attacker, attack, damage, hits, is_crit) local cls, race, lvl, tier, remort, redo = "", "", 0, -1, -1, -1 if is_self then cls, race = state.current.subclass or "", state.current.race or "" lvl, tier, remort, redo = tonumber(state.current.level) or 0, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo() else lvl = GroupMemberLevel(victim) or 0 end local area, slice = state.current.area or "", DamageSliceStart() -- Solo or group, as it was when it hit: yours by your own group status, a groupmate's is a group. local grouped = (not is_self or IsGrouped()) and 1 or 0 local key = table.concat({victim:lower(), attacker, attack, cls, race, area, lvl, tier, remort, redo, slice, grouped}, "\1") local r = taken_buffer[key] if not r then r = {victim = victim, is_self = is_self and 1 or 0, attacker = attacker, attack = attack, damtype = (LookupDamtype(attack)), class = cls, race = race, area = area, level = lvl, tier = tier, remort = remort, redo = redo, slice = slice, grouped = grouped, dmg = 0, lines = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, max = 0} taken_buffer[key] = r end r.dmg, r.lines, r.hits = r.dmg + damage, r.lines + 1, r.hits + (hits or 1) if is_crit then r.crits = r.crits + 1 end if damage > r.max then r.max = damage end end
function FlushTakenBuffer() if not db or not next(taken_buffer) then return end if not DbTableExists("main", "damage_taken") then taken_buffer = {} return end db_exec("BEGIN;") for _, r in pairs(taken_buffer) do local keyw = string.format("victim = %s AND attacker = %s AND attack_name = %s AND class = %s AND race = %s " .. "AND area = %s AND level = %d AND tier = %d AND remort = %d AND redo = %d AND slice_start = %d AND grouped = %d", fixsql(r.victim), fixsql(r.attacker), fixsql(r.attack), fixsql(r.class), fixsql(r.race), fixsql(r.area), r.level, r.tier, r.remort, r.redo, r.slice, r.grouped) db_exec(string.format("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO damage_taken (victim, is_self, attacker, attack_name, damtype, class, " .. "race, area, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start, grouped) VALUES (%s, %d, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", fixsql(r.victim), r.is_self, fixsql(r.attacker), fixsql(r.attack), fixsql(r.damtype or "unknown"), fixsql(r.class), fixsql(r.race), fixsql(r.area), r.level, r.tier, r.remort, r.redo, r.slice, r.grouped)) db_exec(string.format("UPDATE damage_taken SET total_damage = total_damage + %d, lines = lines + %d, " .. "hits = hits + %d, crits = crits + %d, max_hit = MAX(max_hit, %d) WHERE %s", r.dmg, r.lines, r.hits, r.crits, r.max, keyw)) end db_exec("COMMIT;") taken_buffer = {} end
function OnSelfDamageReceived(name, line, wildcards) if IsHealLine(line) then return end local damage, is_crit = ExtractDamageInfo(line) if damage <= 0 then return end last_self_recv_line = line local clean = StripCombatLine(line):match("^.+'s? (.+) you") local attack = clean and ExtractAttackName(clean) or "unknown" local hits = ExtractHitCount(line) RecordSelfDamageReceived(attack, damage, hits) local attacker, full_attack = ParseHitLine(line) if attacker then BufferTaken(state.current.name ~= "" and state.current.name or "you", true, attacker, full_attack or attack, damage, hits, is_crit) end DebugNote(string.format("Dmg recv: %s [%d] x%d", attack, damage, hits)) end
function OnGroupDamageDealt(name, line, wildcards) if IsHealLine(line) then -- "healed by <player>'s" lines are OnHealedBy's to record and hide; any other -- heal line is hidden only by allheal if config.gags.allheal and not StripCombatLine(line):lower():find("healed by ", 1, true) then HideMatchedLine(line) end return end local damage, is_crit = ExtractDamageInfo(line) if damage <= 0 then return end
local ok, group_data = pcall(gmcp, "group") if not ok or not group_data or not group_data.members then return end
local stripped = StripCombatLine(line) -- Never let a possessive target claim this line for someone else: fighting -- "Bob's guard" beside a groupmate named Bob would otherwise -- credit the player's own damage to them. if stripped:match("^Your ") then return end local player, after_name for _, member in ipairs(group_data.members) do local mname = member.name if mname and mname ~= (state.current.name or "") then local pat1 = mname .. "'s " local pat2 = mname .. "' " local pos = stripped:find(pat1, 1, true) local pat_len = #pat1 if not pos and mname:sub(-1):lower() == "s" then pos = stripped:find(pat2, 1, true) pat_len = #pat2 end if pos then player = mname after_name = stripped:sub(pos + pat_len) break end end end if not player then return end
last_group_dmg_line = line local clean = after_name:match("(.+)[%.!]$") local attack = clean and ExtractAttackName(clean) or "unknown" local hits = ExtractHitCount(line) RecordGroupDamage(player, attack, damage, is_crit, hits) if config.gags.groupdmg then HideMatchedLine(line) end DebugNote(string.format("Group dmg: %s %s [%d] x%d%s", player, attack, damage, hits, is_crit and " CRIT" or "")) end
function OnEnemyDamage(name, line, wildcards) if IsHealLine(line) then return end if last_group_dmg_line == line then return end if last_self_recv_line == line then return end -- Same possessive-target trap: "[4] Your mind force does UNBELIEVABLE -- things to Orzbuk's right arm! [5816]" matches the enemy pattern and was -- being gagged as enemy damage. A line starting with "Your " is never the -- enemy hitting anything. if StripCombatLine(line):match("^Your ") then return end if config.gags.enemydmg then HideMatchedLine(line) end -- A mob hitting a groupmate: recorded as their damage taken. local damage, is_crit = ExtractDamageInfo(line) if damage <= 0 then return end local attacker, attack, victim = ParseHitLine(line) if attacker and victim and IsGroupMember(victim) then BufferTaken(victim, false, attacker, attack, damage, ExtractHitCount(line), is_crit) end end
-- Another player's attack that did nothing: nothing to record, only to hide. -- Any attacker counts, not just group members -- in a big fight these names are -- often pets or players outside the group. Your own attacks are never hidden. function OnPlayerDeath(name, line, wildcards) fight_tracker.died_at = Now() fights = {} -- your death goes in deaths, not unfinished_fights if not db then return end -- Only trust the remembered enemy if GMCP named it in the last 30 seconds; -- an older one is a previous fight, and a death to a trap names no one. local enemy = "" if (os.time() - (tonumber(state.current.enemy_time) or 0)) <= 30 then enemy = state.current.enemy or "" end db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO deaths (time, mob_name, area, room_id, level_num, tier, remort, redo, class, race, grouped, session_id, opk, hardcore) " .. "VALUES (%d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d)", os.time(), fixsql(enemy), fixsql(state.current.area or ""), tonumber(state.current.room_id) or 0, tonumber(state.current.level) or 0, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo(), fixsql(state.current.subclass or ""), fixsql(state.current.race or ""), IsGrouped() and 1 or 0, tonumber(state.session.id) or 0, StampOPK(), StampHardcore())) DebugNote("Death recorded" .. (enemy ~= "" and (" (" .. enemy .. ")") or "")) end
function OnGroupUnaffected(name, line, wildcards) if StripCombatLine(line):find(" is unaffected by your ", 1, true) then return end if config.gags.groupdmg then HideMatchedLine(line) end end
function OnSelfMiss(name, line, wildcards) RecordSelfMiss() end
function OnMobDodge(name, line, wildcards) RecordMobDodge() end
function OnSelfDodge(name, line, wildcards) RecordSelfDodge() end
-- ============================================================================= -- XP/KILL TRIGGER HANDLERS -- ============================================================================= function OnExpGain(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards.amount or ""):gsub(",", "") if raw == "" then return end local total = 0 for num in raw:gmatch("%d+") do total = total + (tonumber(num) or 0) end -- "You receive 0 experience points." is still a kill: a mob far below you. AddXP(total) state.session.xp_kill = (state.session.xp_kill or 0) + total CountKill()
-- The line just before XP is the mob's death message, which starts with its -- name whoever landed the killing blow. That name picks the fight. local kill = NewKillRecord(total) local fight = ClaimKillFight(PreviousLine(line)) if fight then kill.mob_name, kill.room_id = fight.name, fight.room_id kill.damage = fight.damage kill.rounds = math.max(1, fight.rounds) kill.combat_secs = math.floor((Now() - fight.start_timer) * 10 + 0.5) / 10 kill.fight_tracked = 1 fights[fight.key] = nil fight_tracker.killed[fight.key] = Now() end table.insert(kill_buffer, kill) last_kill_record = kill
if total > 0 then TrackAreaXP(state.current.area, total) -- The kill before this one still has no bonus line: its block of lines is -- over, so judge it now, before this kill takes over the wait. if state.current.dbl_awaiting_bonus then ResolveDoubleCheck() end dbl_check_seq = (dbl_check_seq or 0) + 1 state.current.dbl_awaiting_bonus = true DoubleLogEvent("kill exp " .. total .. ": waiting 0.5s for a bonus line") DoAfterSpecial(0.5, "ResolveDoubleCheck(" .. dbl_check_seq .. ")", 12) CheckGoal() end DebugNote(string.format("Exp +%s%s%s", comma_value(total), raw:find("+", 1, true) and (" (" .. raw .. ")") or "", fight and string.format(" - %s, %s dmg", fight.name, comma_value(fight.damage)) or " - no fight matched")) end
function OnExpRare(name, line, wildcards) local amount = parse_number(wildcards.amount) if amount <= 0 then return end AddXP(amount) state.session.xp_rare = state.session.xp_rare + amount if last_kill_record then last_kill_record.xp_rare = amount end DebugNote("Rare XP +" .. comma_value(amount)) end
function OnExpHonor(name, line, wildcards) local amount = parse_number(wildcards.amount) if amount <= 0 then return end AddXP(amount) state.session.xp_honor = (state.session.xp_honor or 0) + amount if last_kill_record then last_kill_record.xp_bonus = (last_kill_record.xp_bonus or 0) + amount last_kill_record.xp_honor = (last_kill_record.xp_honor or 0) + amount end DebugNote("Honor XP +" .. comma_value(amount) .. " (not counted as kill)") -- In a superhero's double this line is each kill's double bonus. DoubleBonusSeen(amount, "superhero honor line") end
function OnExpBlessing(name, line, wildcards) local amount = parse_number(wildcards.amount) if amount <= 0 then return end AddXP(amount) state.session.xp_bonus = state.session.xp_bonus + amount state.session.xp_blessing = (state.session.xp_blessing or 0) + amount if last_kill_record then last_kill_record.xp_bonus = (last_kill_record.xp_bonus or 0) + amount last_kill_record.xp_blessing = (last_kill_record.xp_blessing or 0) + amount end state.current.dbl_awaiting_bonus = false DoubleLogEvent("daily blessing exp line: neither bonus nor normal") DebugNote("Blessing XP +" .. comma_value(amount) .. " (neutral for double detection)") end
function OnExpBonus(name, line, wildcards) local amount = parse_number(wildcards.amount) if amount <= 0 then return end AddXP(amount) state.session.xp_bonus = state.session.xp_bonus + amount -- "You receive N bonus experience points." is what double XP adds after a kill. state.session.xp_double = (state.session.xp_double or 0) + amount if last_kill_record then last_kill_record.xp_bonus = (last_kill_record.xp_bonus or 0) + amount last_kill_record.xp_double = (last_kill_record.xp_double or 0) + amount end state.level_tracking.bonus_kills = (state.level_tracking.bonus_kills or 0) + 1 DebugNote("Bonus XP +" .. comma_value(amount)) DoubleBonusSeen(amount, "bonus line") end
-- A kill's double bonus showed: "You receive N bonus experience points." in most -- doubles, "... in honor of <player> reaching superhero." in a superhero's double. function DoubleBonusSeen(amount, what) state.current.dbl_awaiting_bonus = false state.current.dbl_last_bonus = os.time()
local was_normal_streak = (state.current.dbl_consec_normal or 0) > 0 state.current.dbl_consec_bonus = (state.current.dbl_consec_bonus or 0) + 1 state.current.dbl_consec_normal = 0
if was_normal_streak then local now = os.time() local last_flip = state.current.dbl_last_flip or 0 if last_flip > 0 and (now - last_flip) < 60 then state.current.dbl_consec_bonus = 0 state.current.dbl_consec_normal = 0 DoubleLogEvent(what .. " +" .. amount .. ": erratic pattern, counts reset") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Warning: erratic bonus exp pattern detected - ignoring for double XP tracking") return end state.current.dbl_last_flip = now end DoubleLogEvent(what .. " +" .. amount .. ": bonus kill")
if not state.current.double_active and state.current.dbl_consec_bonus >= 3 then ActivateDouble(nil, "3 kills in a row with a bonus line") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- GOLD ENGINE -- ============================================================================= function AddGold(source, amount) amount = tonumber(amount) or 0 if amount == 0 then return end state.session.gold = state.session.gold + amount state.session.gold_sources[source] = (state.session.gold_sources[source] or 0) + amount
CreditTracked("gold", amount)
local grouped = IsGrouped() and 1 or 0 local is_mob_gold = (source == "mob" or source == "crumble" or source == "shared")
if db then db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO gold_log (source, amount, area, time, class, race, session_id, grouped) VALUES (%s, %d, %s, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d)", fixsql(source), amount, fixsql(state.current.area), os.time(), fixsql(state.current.subclass), fixsql(state.current.race), state.session.id, grouped))
if is_mob_gold then local g_col = grouped == 1 and "group_gold" or "solo_gold" if state.current.area ~= "" then db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE area_stats SET total_gold=total_gold+%d WHERE area=%s AND grouped=%d", amount, fixsql(state.current.area), grouped)) end if state.current.subclass ~= "" then db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE class_stats SET total_gold=total_gold+%d, %s=%s+%d WHERE class=%s", amount, g_col, g_col, amount, fixsql(state.current.subclass))) end if state.current.race ~= "" then db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE race_stats SET total_gold=total_gold+%d, %s=%s+%d WHERE race=%s", amount, g_col, g_col, amount, fixsql(state.current.race))) end if state.current.subclass ~= "" and state.current.race ~= "" then local combo = state.current.race .. "|" .. state.current.subclass db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE combo_stats SET total_gold=total_gold+%d, %s=%s+%d WHERE combo=%s", amount, g_col, g_col, amount, fixsql(combo))) end end end end
function OnGoldMob(n, l, w) AddGold("mob", parse_number(w.amount)); DebugNote("Gold (mob) +" .. w.amount) end function OnGoldCrumble(n, l, w) AddGold("crumble", parse_number(w.amount)) end function OnGoldSell(n, l, w) AddGold("sell", parse_number(w.amount)); DebugNote("Gold (sell) +" .. w.amount) end function OnGoldFence(n, l, w) AddGold("fence", parse_number(w.amount)) end function OnGoldSac(n, l, w) local amount = parse_number(w.amount) AddGold("sac", amount) -- Sacrificing a corpse pays about half the mob's level in gold: the only -- level estimate the game gives. Sacrificing an item pays too, so skip those. local corpse_of = amount > 0 and l:match(" corpse of (.+)%.$") local key = corpse_of and FightKey(corpse_of) if key then for i = #kill_buffer, math.max(1, #kill_buffer - 20), -1 do local k = kill_buffer[i] if (k.mob_level or -1) < 0 and FightKey(k.mob_name) == key then k.mob_level = amount * 2 break end end end end function OnGoldHaggle(n, l, w) AddGold("haggle", parse_number(w.amount)) end function OnGoldTax(n, l, w) AddGold("tax", -parse_number(w.amount)); DebugNote("Gold (tax) -" .. w.amount) end function OnGoldShared(n, l, w) AddGold("shared", parse_number(w.amount)) end
-- ============================================================================= -- LEVEL / PUP ENGINE -- ============================================================================= function StartLevelTracking(ltype, level_num) local lt = state.level_tracking if lt.start_time > 0 and lt.pending then FinalizeLevelRecord() end if lt.start_time == 0 then lt.start_time = os.time() lt.start_timer = Now() lt.xp_at_start = state.session.xp lt.kills_at_start = state.session.kills end -- The XP and kill baselines were set when the previous level or powerup was saved; -- resetting them here counted only the half second before this one is saved. lt.type = ltype lt.level_num = level_num lt.bonus_kills = 0 lt.hp = 0; lt.mp = 0; lt.mv = 0 lt.trains = 0; lt.pracs = 0 lt.bonus_trains = 0; lt.blessing_trains = 0; lt.instinct_trains = 0 lt.bonus_stats = {} lt.pending = true lt.grouped = IsGrouped()
EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_linfo", true) DoAfterSpecial(1.5, 'FinalizeLevelRecord()', 12) end
function OnLevelUp(name, line, wildcards) local level = tonumber(wildcards.level) or 0 local grouped = IsGrouped() state.session.levels = state.session.levels + 1 if grouped then state.session.group_levels = state.session.group_levels + 1 else state.session.solo_levels = state.session.solo_levels + 1 end SetCurrentLevel(level) CreditTracked("levels", 1) StartLevelTracking("level", level) CheckGoal() DebugNote("Level up to " .. level .. (grouped and " (group)" or " (solo)")) end
function OnPowerup(name, line, wildcards) local pup_num = tonumber(wildcards.pup) or 0 local grouped = IsGrouped() state.session.pups = state.session.pups + 1 if grouped then state.session.group_pups = state.session.group_pups + 1 else state.session.solo_pups = state.session.solo_pups + 1 end CreditTracked("pups", 1) StartLevelTracking("pup", pup_num) CheckGoal() DebugNote("Powerup #" .. pup_num .. (grouped and " (group)" or " (solo)")) end
function OnPowerupSimple(name, line, wildcards) local grouped = IsGrouped() state.session.pups = state.session.pups + 1 if grouped then state.session.group_pups = state.session.group_pups + 1 else state.session.solo_pups = state.session.solo_pups + 1 end CreditTracked("pups", 1) StartLevelTracking("pup", 0) CheckGoal() DebugNote("Powerup (simple)" .. (grouped and " (group)" or " (solo)")) end
-- The worth update paying a level-up's or powerup's trains often arrives a second or -- two before its lines, and waits WORTH_OTHER_WAIT to be claimed. Crediting when the -- record was saved, 1.5s after the level line, was too late whenever the worth update -- came more than 1.5s early: the trains were booked a second time as 'other'. Each -- gains line claims its own amount as it arrives. function CreditLevelWorth(trains, pracs) if (tonumber(trains) or 0) ~= 0 or (tonumber(pracs) or 0) ~= 0 then ClaimWorth(state.level_tracking.type == "pup" and "powerup" or "level", {trains = trains, pracs = pracs}) end end
function OnLevelGains(name, line, wildcards) local lt = state.level_tracking lt.hp = tonumber(wildcards.hp) or 0 lt.mp = tonumber(wildcards.mp) or 0 lt.mv = tonumber(wildcards.mv) or 0 CreditLevelWorth((tonumber(wildcards.trains) or 0) - lt.trains, (tonumber(wildcards.pracs) or 0) - lt.pracs) lt.pracs = tonumber(wildcards.pracs) or 0 lt.trains = tonumber(wildcards.trains) or 0 DebugNote(string.format("Gains: HP+%d MP+%d MV+%d Tr+%d Pr+%d", lt.hp, lt.mp, lt.mv, lt.trains, lt.pracs)) end
function OnLevelGainsInstinct(name, line, wildcards) OnLevelGains(name, line, wildcards) local lt = state.level_tracking CreditLevelWorth((tonumber(wildcards.instinct) or 0) - lt.instinct_trains, 0) lt.instinct_trains = tonumber(wildcards.instinct) or 0 end
function OnPupTrains(name, line, wildcards) CreditLevelWorth((tonumber(wildcards.trains) or 0) - state.level_tracking.trains, 0) state.level_tracking.trains = tonumber(wildcards.trains) or 0 DebugNote("Pup trains: " .. wildcards.trains) end
function OnBonusStat(name, line, wildcards) local stat = wildcards.stat or "" table.insert(state.level_tracking.bonus_stats, stat) DebugNote("Bonus stat: " .. stat) end
function OnLuckyTrains(name, line, wildcards) CreditLevelWorth(wildcards.amount, 0) state.level_tracking.bonus_trains = state.level_tracking.bonus_trains + (tonumber(wildcards.amount) or 0) DebugNote("Lucky trains +" .. wildcards.amount) end
function OnBlessingTrains(name, line, wildcards) CreditLevelWorth(wildcards.amount, 0) state.level_tracking.blessing_trains = state.level_tracking.blessing_trains + (tonumber(wildcards.amount) or 0) end
-- Levels over the whole character: 7 remorts of 201 levels in every tier and redo -- done so far (T0 counts as a tier), then the remorts and level of this one. -- T9+2 R7 level 100 = 201*7*11 + 201*6 + 100 = 16783. nil until GMCP has sent them. function TotalLevels(level) if not state.current.progress_known then return nil end local tier = tonumber(state.current.tier) or -1 local redo = math.max(0, tonumber(state.current.redo) or 0) local remort = tonumber(state.current.remort) or 0 if tier < 0 or remort < 1 then return nil end return 201 * 7 * (tier + redo) + 201 * (remort - 1) + (tonumber(level) or 0) end
-- Level-ups or powerups recorded since a time, including the one just written. function CountLevelRows(ltype, since) if not db then return nil end local r = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM levels WHERE type = %s AND end_time >= %d", fixsql(ltype), since)) return r and tonumber(r.n) or nil end
-- The number and label for a level-up or powerup line, by the event's count setting. function LevelEventCount(lt) local evt = lt.type == "pup" and "powerup" or "level" local mode = EventSettings(evt).count or "remort" local value if mode == "total" then value = TotalLevels(lt.level_num) elseif mode == "lifetime" then value = tonumber(state.player_totals.pups) if value and value <= 0 then value = nil end elseif mode == "daily" then value = CountLevelRows(lt.type, LocalDayStart()) elseif mode == "aarddaily" then value = CountLevelRows(lt.type, EasternDayStart()) elseif mode == "weekly" then value = CountLevelRows(lt.type, LocalDayStart(nil, true)) elseif mode == "aardweekly" then value = CountLevelRows(lt.type, EasternDayStart(nil, true)) end if not value then mode, value = "remort", lt.level_num end return value, COUNT_LABELS[mode] end
function FinalizeLevelRecord() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_linfo", false)
local lt = state.level_tracking if not lt.pending then return end lt.pending = false
local now = os.time() local now_hr = Now() local duration if lt.start_timer > 0 and now_hr > lt.start_timer then duration = now_hr - lt.start_timer else duration = now - lt.start_time if duration < 0 then duration = 0 end end
local evt_source = lt.type == "pup" and "pups" or "levels" local total_trains = lt.trains + lt.bonus_trains + lt.blessing_trains + lt.instinct_trains state.session.trains = state.session.trains + total_trains state.session.pracs = state.session.pracs + lt.pracs CreditTrackedMulti({trains = total_trains, pracs = lt.pracs})
local bonus_stats_str = table.concat(lt.bonus_stats, ",") local xp_during = state.session.xp - lt.xp_at_start local kills_during = state.session.kills - lt.kills_at_start
local is_grouped = lt.grouped and 1 or 0
if db then db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO levels (type, level_num, start_time, end_time, duration, class, race, hp_gain, mp_gain, mv_gain, trains_gain, pracs_gain, bonus_trains, blessing_trains, instinct_trains, bonus_stats, area, session_id, xp_during, kills_during, double_active, grouped, tier, remort, redo, opk, hardcore) VALUES (%s, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)]], fixsql(lt.type), lt.level_num, lt.start_time, now, tostring(duration), fixsql(state.current.subclass), fixsql(state.current.race), lt.hp, lt.mp, lt.mv, lt.trains, lt.pracs, lt.bonus_trains, lt.blessing_trains, lt.instinct_trains, fixsql(bonus_stats_str), fixsql(state.current.area), state.session.id, xp_during, kills_during, state.current.double_active and 1 or 0, is_grouped, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo(), StampOPK(), StampHardcore())) end
UpdateClassStats(state.current.subclass, lt.type, duration, lt.grouped) UpdateRaceStats(state.current.race, lt.type, duration, lt.grouped) UpdateComboStats(state.current.race, state.current.subclass, lt.type, duration, lt.grouped) TrackAreaLevelPup(state.current.area, lt.type, lt.grouped)
if lt.type == "pup" then TrackPlayerPup(lt.level_num) end
local level_evt = lt.type == "pup" and "powerup" or "level" if EventOn(level_evt) then local chan = EventChannel(level_evt) local grp_tag = lt.grouped and "@M grp" or "@w solo" local count, count_label = LevelEventCount(lt) local msg if lt.type == "level" then -- A level or a total is a value; the day and week modes count, so they get a #. local is_count = count_label ~= "remort" and count_label ~= "total" msg = string.format( "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@GLevel @w%s @W%s%s @D| @w%s @D| @wTr:@W%d", count_label, is_count and "#" or "", comma_value(count), FormatTimePrecise(duration), total_trains) local train_notes = {} if lt.bonus_trains > 0 then table.insert(train_notes, "@G" .. lt.bonus_trains .. "lucky") end if lt.blessing_trains > 0 then table.insert(train_notes, "@C" .. lt.blessing_trains .. "bless") end if lt.instinct_trains > 0 then table.insert(train_notes, "@M" .. lt.instinct_trains .. "inst") end if #train_notes > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D(+" .. table.concat(train_notes, "@D+") .. "@D)" end msg = msg .. string.format(" @D| @wHP+@W%d @wMP+@W%d @wMV+@W%d", lt.hp, lt.mp, lt.mv) if bonus_stats_str ~= "" then msg = msg .. " @D| @w+" .. bonus_stats_str end local rc = (state.current.race ~= "" and state.current.race or "?") local sc = (state.current.subclass ~= "" and state.current.subclass or "?") msg = msg .. " @D| @C" .. rc .. " " .. sc msg = msg .. grp_tag .. "@D]" else msg = string.format( "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@GPup @w%s @W#%d @D| @w%s @D| @wTr:@W%d", count_label, count, FormatTimePrecise(duration), total_trains) local train_notes = {} if lt.bonus_trains > 0 then table.insert(train_notes, "@G" .. lt.bonus_trains .. "lucky") end if lt.blessing_trains > 0 then table.insert(train_notes, "@C" .. lt.blessing_trains .. "bless") end if lt.instinct_trains > 0 then table.insert(train_notes, "@M" .. lt.instinct_trains .. "inst") end if #train_notes > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D(+" .. table.concat(train_notes, "@D+") .. "@D)" end local rc = (state.current.race ~= "" and state.current.race or "?") local sc = (state.current.subclass ~= "" and state.current.subclass or "?") msg = msg .. " @D| @C" .. rc .. " " .. sc msg = msg .. grp_tag .. "@D]" end Report(chan, msg) end
DebugNote(string.format("Finalized %s #%d: %s, trains=%d, xp_during=%s", lt.type, lt.level_num, FormatTimePrecise(duration), total_trains, comma_value(xp_during)))
lt.start_time = os.time() lt.start_timer = Now() lt.xp_at_start = state.session.xp lt.kills_at_start = state.session.kills lt.bonus_kills = 0
state_save() end
-- ============================================================================= -- QUEST ENGINE (GMCP comm.quest) -- ============================================================================= -- The OPK and Hardcore quest point bonuses. GMCP's comm.quest sends both on -- completion ("opk" and "hardcore"), and these triggers read the same numbers from -- the mob's tell as a fallback for a game that doesn't. Both are already part of -- totqp, so they are only split out, never added to a total. QUEST_BONUS_WAIT = 1 quest_bonus = {opk = 0, hc = 0, daily = 0, time = 0} quest_pending = nil
function QuestBonusAdd(kind, amount) amount = tonumber(amount) or 0 if amount <= 0 then return end if (os.time() - (quest_bonus.time or 0)) > 30 then quest_bonus.opk, quest_bonus.hc, quest_bonus.daily = 0, 0, 0 -- older than any quest still being written end quest_bonus[kind] = (quest_bonus[kind] or 0) + amount quest_bonus.time = os.time() DebugNote(string.format("Quest %s bonus: %dqp", kind:upper(), amount)) end
function OnQuestBonusOPK(name, line, wildcards) QuestBonusAdd("opk", wildcards.amount) end function OnQuestBonusHC(name, line, wildcards) QuestBonusAdd("hc", wildcards.amount) end function OnQuestBonusDaily(name, line, wildcards) QuestBonusAdd("daily", parse_number(wildcards.amount)) end
-- Writes the quest and reports it a second after GMCP said it was complete, by -- which time the bonus tells have arrived whichever order they came in. function FinalizeQuestRecord() local q = quest_pending if not q then return end quest_pending = nil local opk, hc, blessing = 0, 0, 0 if (os.time() - (quest_bonus.time or 0)) <= 30 then opk, hc, blessing = quest_bonus.opk or 0, quest_bonus.hc or 0, quest_bonus.daily or 0 end quest_bonus.opk, quest_bonus.hc, quest_bonus.daily, quest_bonus.time = 0, 0, 0, 0 -- The daily blessing line marks the quest as a daily one even if GMCP didn't. if blessing > 0 then q.daily = 1 end -- GMCP is authoritative when it sent the fields; the tells fill in otherwise. local from_gmcp = q.gmcp_opk ~= nil or q.gmcp_hc ~= nil if from_gmcp then opk, hc = q.gmcp_opk or 0, q.gmcp_hc or 0 end
if db then db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO quests (start_time, end_time, duration, mob_name, mob_area, qp, totqp, tier_qp, lucky_qp, mccp_qp, opk_qp, hc_qp, gold, tp, trains, pracs, failed, daily, double_xp, level_num, class, race, session_id, tier, remort, redo, opk, hardcore) VALUES (%d, %d, %s, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, 0, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)]], q.start_time, q.end_time, DurationSql(q.duration), fixsql(q.mob_name), fixsql(q.mob_area), q.qp, q.totqp, q.tier_qp, q.lucky_qp, q.mccp_qp, opk, hc, q.gold, q.tp, q.trains, q.pracs, q.daily, q.double, q.level_num, fixsql(q.class), fixsql(q.race), q.session_id, q.tier, q.remort, q.redo, q.opk or -1, q.hardcore or -1)) end
if EventOn("quest") then local chan = EventChannel("quest") local msg = string.format( "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@CQuest @D| @w%s @D| @W%d@wqp", FormatTimePrecise(q.duration), q.totqp) local qp_notes = {} if q.tier_qp > 0 then table.insert(qp_notes, "@G" .. q.tier_qp .. "tier") end if q.lucky_qp > 0 then table.insert(qp_notes, "@Y" .. q.lucky_qp .. "lucky") end if q.mccp_qp > 0 then table.insert(qp_notes, "@M" .. q.mccp_qp .. "mccp") end if opk > 0 then table.insert(qp_notes, "@R" .. opk .. "opk") end if hc > 0 then table.insert(qp_notes, "@r" .. hc .. "hc") end -- GMCP doesn't itemise the daily blessing: it is what totqp has left over. local rest = q.totqp - q.qp - q.tier_qp - q.lucky_qp - q.mccp_qp - opk - hc if rest > 0 then table.insert(qp_notes, (q.daily == 1 and "@C" .. rest .. "daily" or "@w" .. rest .. "other")) end if #qp_notes > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D(+" .. table.concat(qp_notes, "@D+") .. "@D)" end if q.gold > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @Y" .. comma_value(q.gold) .. "@wg" end if q.tp > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @M" .. q.tp .. "@wtp" end if q.trains > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @G" .. q.trains .. "@wtr" end local rc = (q.race ~= "" and q.race or "?") local sc = (q.class ~= "" and q.class or "?") msg = msg .. " @D| @C" .. rc .. " " .. sc .. "@D]" Report(chan, msg) end DebugNote(string.format("Quest written: %dqp (%d opk, %d hc, from %s)", q.totqp, opk, hc, from_gmcp and "GMCP" or "the tells")) end
-- How long the quest took: the high-resolution timer when its start survived, -- otherwise the whole-second clock. Mirrors FinalizeLevelRecord. function QuestDuration(now) local qt = state.quest_tracking if not (qt.active and (qt.start_time or 0) > 0) then return 0 end local start_timer = tonumber(qt.start_timer) or 0 local now_hr = Now() if start_timer > 0 and now_hr > start_timer then return now_hr - start_timer end local duration = now - qt.start_time if duration < 0 then duration = 0 end return duration end
function HandleCommQuest(data) if not data or not data.action then return end local action = data.action
if action == "start" then state.quest_tracking.active = true state.quest_tracking.start_time = os.time() -- os.time() only ticks once a second, so a 9-second quest could be anything -- from 8.1 to 9.9. The high-resolution timer gives the real figure; it is -- lost across a client restart, and then the whole-second clock stands in. state.quest_tracking.start_timer = Now() state.quest_tracking.mob_name = data.targ or "" state.quest_tracking.mob_area = data.area or "" state.quest_tracking.mob_room = data.room or "" local targ, area = data.targ or "", data.area or "" ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Quest started" .. (targ ~= "" and (": " .. targ) or "") .. (area ~= "" and (" in " .. area) or "") .. ".") DebugNote("Quest started: " .. (data.targ or "?") .. " in " .. (data.area or "?"))
elseif action == "comp" then local now = os.time() local duration = QuestDuration(now)
local qp = tonumber(data.qp) or 0 local totqp = tonumber(data.totqp) or 0 local tierqp = tonumber(data.tierqp) or 0 local lucky = tonumber(data.lucky) or 0 local mccp = tonumber(data.mccp) or 0 -- comm.quest sends these on completion; the tells are only a fallback for -- a game version that doesn't. local gmcp_opk = tonumber(data.opk) local gmcp_hc = tonumber(data.hardcore) local gold = tonumber(data.gold) or 0 local tp = tonumber(data.tp) or 0 local trains = tonumber(data.trains) or 0 local pracs = tonumber(data.pracs) or 0 local double = tonumber(data.double) or 0 local daily = tonumber(data.daily) or 0
state.session.quests_done = state.session.quests_done + 1 state.session.qp = state.session.qp + totqp state.session.tp = state.session.tp + tp state.session.gold = state.session.gold + gold state.session.trains = state.session.trains + trains state.session.pracs = state.session.pracs + pracs
ClaimWorth("quest", {qp = totqp, tp = tp, trains = trains, pracs = pracs, gold = gold})
CreditTrackedMulti({qp = totqp, gold = gold, tp = tp, trains = trains, pracs = pracs, quests = 1})
-- The OPK and Hardcore bonuses arrive as tells, which can come either side of -- this message, so the record and the report wait a second for them. quest_pending = { start_time = state.quest_tracking.start_time, end_time = now, duration = duration, mob_name = state.quest_tracking.mob_name, mob_area = state.quest_tracking.mob_area, qp = qp, totqp = totqp, tier_qp = tierqp, lucky_qp = lucky, mccp_qp = mccp, gold = gold, tp = tp, trains = trains, pracs = pracs, daily = daily, double = double, level_num = state.current.level, class = state.current.subclass, race = state.current.race, session_id = state.session.id, tier = StampTier(), remort = StampRemort(), redo = StampRedo(), opk = StampOPK(), hardcore = StampHardcore(), gmcp_opk = gmcp_opk, gmcp_hc = gmcp_hc, } DoAfterSpecial(QUEST_BONUS_WAIT, "FinalizeQuestRecord()", 12)
state.quest_tracking.active = false state.quest_tracking.start_time = 0 state.quest_tracking.start_timer = 0 ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Quest completed" .. (duration > 0 and (" in " .. FormatTimePrecise(duration)) or "") .. ".") CheckGoal() DebugNote(string.format("Quest comp: %dqp, %dg, %dtp, %dtr", totqp, gold, tp, trains))
elseif action == "fail" or action == "timeout" then state.session.quests_fail = state.session.quests_fail + 1 local now = os.time() local duration = QuestDuration(now)
if db then db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO quests (start_time, end_time, duration, mob_name, mob_area, failed, level_num, class, race, session_id, tier, remort, redo, opk, hardcore) VALUES (%d, %d, %s, %s, %s, 1, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)]], state.quest_tracking.start_time, now, DurationSql(duration), fixsql(state.quest_tracking.mob_name), fixsql(state.quest_tracking.mob_area), state.current.level, fixsql(state.current.subclass), fixsql(state.current.race), state.session.id, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo(), StampOPK(), StampHardcore())) end
ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format("[CDT] Quest %s%s.", action == "timeout" and "timed out" or "failed", duration > 0 and (" after " .. FormatTimePrecise(duration)) or "")) state.quest_tracking.active = false state.quest_tracking.start_time = 0 state.quest_tracking.start_timer = 0 DebugNote("Quest failed/timeout")
elseif action == "killed" then DebugNote("Quest mob killed")
elseif action == "ready" then DebugNote("Quest ready") end
state_save() end
-- ============================================================================= -- CAMPAIGN ENGINE (text triggers) -- ============================================================================= -- A campaign was never timed: start_time stayed 0 and duration was written as 0, -- so cdt gains history cp had nothing to show. The giver handing one out starts the -- clock, on the high-resolution timer as quests and levels use.
-- "7 days, 0 hours and 0 minutes", "23 hours and 5 minutes", "1 day" -> seconds. function ParseTimeLeft(text) local secs, seen = 0, false for num, unit in (text or ""):lower():gmatch("(%d+)%s+(%a+)") do local v, u = tonumber(num) or 0, unit:sub(1, 3) if u == "day" then secs = secs + v * 86400; seen = true elseif u == "hou" then secs = secs + v * 3600; seen = true elseif u == "min" then secs = secs + v * 60; seen = true elseif u == "sec" then secs = secs + v; seen = true end end return seen and secs or nil end
-- Time left is shown to the minute, so one campaign's deadline, worked out at two -- different moments, lands within a minute of itself. Two campaigns are hours apart -- (the wait between them alone is longer), so this can't mistake one for the other. CP_DEADLINE_SLACK = 150
function SameDeadline(a, b) a, b = tonumber(a) or 0, tonumber(b) or 0 return a > 0 and b > 0 and math.abs(a - b) <= CP_DEADLINE_SLACK end
-- Takes over the timing of the campaign a display is showing, named by its deadline. function CampaignIdentify(deadline) local ct = state.cp_tracking if ct.active and SameDeadline(ct.deadline, deadline) then DebugNote("campaign display: the same campaign, clock untouched") return end if (os.time() - (cp_assign.time or 0)) <= 15 then local prev = cp_assign.prev -- The giver's line repeated for a campaign already being timed: undo the -- restart it caused. if prev and SameDeadline(prev.deadline, deadline) then ct.start_time, ct.start_timer = prev.start_time, prev.start_timer ct.active, ct.deadline = true, prev.deadline cp_assign.prev = nil DebugNote("campaign display: still the campaign already being timed") state_save() return end -- Taken in the last few seconds: this is the one just handed out, and -- OnCampaignStart has already started its clock. ct.active, ct.deadline = true, deadline cp_assign.prev = nil DebugNote("campaign display: the campaign just taken") state_save() return end -- Being timed, but not identified until now: this display is that campaign. -- Nothing says otherwise, so its clock stands. if ct.active and (tonumber(ct.deadline) or 0) == 0 and (tonumber(ct.start_time) or 0) > 0 then ct.deadline = deadline DebugNote("campaign display: deadline noted for the campaign being timed") state_save() return end -- Otherwise this campaign was running before CDT saw it, or the one being timed -- ended unseen. When it started is unknown, and unknown is what gets recorded. ColourNote("dimgray", "", ct.active and "[CDT] A different campaign is running: its start time is unknown." or "[CDT] Campaign seen in progress; its start time is unknown.") ct.active = true ct.start_time, ct.start_timer, ct.duration, ct.end_time = 0, 0, 0, 0 ct.deadline = deadline state_save() end
function OnCampaignTimeLeft(name, line, wildcards) local left = ParseTimeLeft(wildcards.left) if not left then return end CampaignIdentify(os.time() + left) end
-- When the giver last handed a campaign out, so the deadline that follows can tell -- a campaign just taken from one merely being looked at. cp_assign = {time = 0, timer = 0, prev = nil}
function OnCampaignAssign(name, line, wildcards) cp_assign.time, cp_assign.timer = os.time(), Now() local ct = state.cp_tracking -- The giver's three lines arrive together; only the first of them starts a clock. if ct.active and (tonumber(ct.start_time) or 0) > 0 and (os.time() - ct.start_time) <= 10 then DebugNote("another line from the campaign giver; keeping the first") return end -- Keep what was being timed. If the display that follows turns out to name the -- same campaign, this line was a repeat rather than a campaign handed out, and -- the old clock is put back. cp_assign.prev = {start_time = ct.start_time, start_timer = ct.start_timer, deadline = ct.deadline or 0} OnCampaignStart(name, line, wildcards) end
function OnCampaignStart(name, line, wildcards) -- The commander says both of his lines a moment apart on handing out a campaign, -- so the second must not shave that moment off the first. local running = state.cp_tracking.active and (tonumber(state.cp_tracking.start_time) or 0) > 0 if running and (os.time() - state.cp_tracking.start_time) <= 10 then DebugNote("Campaign start line seen again; keeping the first") return end -- A new campaign: the deadline being held belongs to the last one. state.cp_tracking.deadline = 0 state.cp_tracking.active = true state.cp_tracking.start_time = os.time() state.cp_tracking.start_timer = Now() state.cp_tracking.end_time = 0 state.cp_tracking.duration = 0 ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Campaign started.") DebugNote("Campaign started") state_save() end
-- How long the campaign took, measured when it ended rather than when the rewards -- finish arriving. Returns 0 when no start was seen (one taken before this version, -- or carried across a reconnect), and then no time is claimed anywhere. -- Longer than any campaign's own time limit: a start left over from a campaign -- whose ending was never seen. Better to record nothing than a made-up figure. CP_MAX_SECS = 12 * 3600
function CampaignDuration(now) local ct = state.cp_tracking if not (ct.active and (ct.start_time or 0) > 0) then return 0 end local elapsed = now - ct.start_time if elapsed < 0 or elapsed > CP_MAX_SECS then return 0 end local start_timer = tonumber(ct.start_timer) or 0 local now_hr = Now() if start_timer > 0 and now_hr > start_timer then return now_hr - start_timer end return elapsed end
function CampaignClearTracking() state.cp_tracking.active = false state.cp_tracking.start_time = 0 state.cp_tracking.start_timer = 0 state.cp_tracking.end_time = 0 state.cp_tracking.duration = 0 state.cp_tracking.deadline = 0 end
-- Whose "Reward of ... added." lines these are: "cp" or "gq", whichever finished -- last. The rewards print straight after their own header, so when one kill ends a -- campaign and wins a GQ, each block goes to the right place. Before this, every -- line went to the campaign while both were open, GQ win QP included. reward_owner = nil
