function OnCampaignComplete(name, line, wildcards) state.session.cps_done = state.session.cps_done + 1 -- Measured now: the rewards take another 1.5s to arrive and aren't part of it. state.cp_tracking.end_time = os.time() state.cp_tracking.duration = CampaignDuration(state.cp_tracking.end_time) state.cp_tracking.rewards = {} reward_owner = "cp" EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_cp_rewards", true) DoAfterSpecial(1.5, 'FinalizeCampaign(false)', 12) DebugNote("Campaign complete - collecting rewards") end
function OnCampaignFail(name, line, wildcards) state.session.cps_fail = state.session.cps_fail + 1 local now = os.time() local duration = CampaignDuration(now) if db then db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO campaigns (start_time, end_time, duration, failed, level_num, class, race, session_id, tier, remort, redo, opk, hardcore) " .. "VALUES (%d, %d, %s, 1, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", state.cp_tracking.start_time, now, DurationSql(duration), state.current.level, fixsql(state.current.subclass), fixsql(state.current.race), state.session.id, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo(), StampOPK(), StampHardcore())) end ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Campaign cleared" .. (duration > 0 and (" after " .. FormatTimePrecise(duration)) or "") .. ".") CampaignClearTracking() DebugNote("Campaign failed") state_save() end
function OnCampaignDailyBonus(name, line, wildcards) local amount = parse_number(wildcards.amount) if amount <= 0 then return end local r = state.cp_tracking.rewards r.daily_qp = (r.daily_qp or 0) + amount ClaimWorth("cp", {qp = amount}) DebugNote("CP daily bonus: " .. comma_value(amount) .. " qp") end
function OnCampaignReward(name, line, wildcards) if reward_owner ~= "cp" then return end local amount = parse_number(wildcards.amount) local rtype = wildcards.type or ""
local mapped = nil for pattern, currency in pairs(REWARD_TYPE_MAP) do if rtype:find(pattern, 1, true) then mapped = currency break end end
if mapped then state.cp_tracking.rewards[mapped] = (state.cp_tracking.rewards[mapped] or 0) + amount -- Claimed now, not 1.5s later when the campaign is saved: the worth update can -- arrive before this line, and the gain must not wait out its 3s unclaimed. ClaimWorth("cp", {[mapped] = amount}) DebugNote("CP Reward: " .. comma_value(amount) .. " " .. mapped) end end
function FinalizeCampaign(failed) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_cp_rewards", false) if reward_owner == "cp" then reward_owner = nil end
local r = state.cp_tracking.rewards or {} -- The first-of-the-day bonus is part of what the campaign paid, so it counts in -- qp (session totals, the worth credit) and is also kept on its own. local daily_qp = r.daily_qp or 0 local qp = (r.qp or 0) + daily_qp local gold = r.gold or 0 local tp = r.tp or 0 local trains = r.trains or 0 local pracs = r.pracs or 0 local xp = r.xp or 0
if xp > 0 then AddXP(xp) state.session.xp_cp = (state.session.xp_cp or 0) + xp end
state.session.qp = state.session.qp + qp state.session.tp = state.session.tp + tp state.session.gold = state.session.gold + gold state.session.trains = state.session.trains + trains state.session.pracs = state.session.pracs + pracs
-- The worth claims were made line by line as the rewards arrived (OnCampaignReward).
if not failed then CreditTrackedMulti({qp = qp, gold = gold, tp = tp, trains = trains, pracs = pracs, cps = 1}) end
if db then db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO campaigns (start_time, end_time, duration, qp, gold, tp, trains, pracs, xp, failed, level_num, class, race, session_id, tier, remort, redo, opk, hardcore, daily_qp) VALUES (%d, %d, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)]], state.cp_tracking.start_time, state.cp_tracking.end_time > 0 and state.cp_tracking.end_time or os.time(), DurationSql(state.cp_tracking.duration), qp, gold, tp, trains, pracs, xp, failed and 1 or 0, state.current.level, fixsql(state.current.subclass), fixsql(state.current.race), state.session.id, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo(), StampOPK(), StampHardcore(), daily_qp)) end
if EventOn("cp") and not failed then local chan = EventChannel("cp") local msg = "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@RCP" if (state.cp_tracking.duration or 0) > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @w" .. FormatTimePrecise(state.cp_tracking.duration) end msg = msg .. string.format(" @D| @W%d@wqp", qp) if daily_qp > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D(+@G" .. daily_qp .. "daily@D)" end if gold > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @Y" .. comma_value(gold) .. "@wg" end if tp > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @M" .. tp .. "@wtp" end if trains > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @G" .. trains .. "@wtr" end if xp > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @w" .. short_value(xp) .. " @wxp" end local rc = (state.current.race ~= "" and state.current.race or "?") local sc = (state.current.subclass ~= "" and state.current.subclass or "?") msg = msg .. " @D| @C" .. rc .. " " .. sc .. "@D]" Report(chan, msg) end
ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format("[CDT] Campaign %s%s.", failed and "failed" or "completed", (state.cp_tracking.duration or 0) > 0 and (" in " .. FormatTimePrecise(state.cp_tracking.duration)) or "")) CampaignClearTracking() state.cp_tracking.rewards = {} DebugNote(string.format("CP finalized: %dqp %dg %dtp %dtr %dxp", qp, gold, tp, trains, xp)) state_save() end
-- ============================================================================= -- GQ ENGINE (text triggers) -- ============================================================================= -- A global quest that never finishes is closed after this long, so its mob QP is -- recorded rather than counting as a GQ still running. GQ_TIMEOUT_SECS = 20 * 60
-- The timer carries the number of the GQ it was started for, so a timeout left over -- from an earlier one can't close the current one. function GQTimeout(gq_num) local gt = state.gq_tracking if not gt.active then return end if (tonumber(gq_num) or 0) ~= (tonumber(gt.gq_num) or 0) then return end FinalizeGQ(false, true) end
-- Timers don't survive a reload, so the flush timer checks the clock as well. This -- also closes a GQ left open by an older version, once, on the next load. function GQCheckTimeout() local gt = state.gq_tracking if not gt.active or (gt.start_time or 0) <= 0 then return end if (os.time() - gt.start_time) < GQ_TIMEOUT_SECS then return end FinalizeGQ(false, true) end
function GQResumeAfterTimeout() local gt = state.gq_tracking if gt.active or (tonumber(gt.closed_id) or 0) <= 0 then return end local row = db and db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT gq_id, gq_num, start_time, qp_mobs FROM gquests WHERE gq_id = %d", gt.closed_id)) gt.closed_id = 0 if not row then return end db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM gquests WHERE gq_id = %d", tonumber(row.gq_id) or -1)) gt.active = true gt.gq_num = tonumber(row.gq_num) or 0 gt.mob_qp = tonumber(row.qp_mobs) or 0 gt.start_time = tonumber(row.start_time) or os.time() gt.start_timer = 0 gt.rewards = {} DebugNote("GQ #" .. tostring(gt.gq_num) .. " finished after its timeout: taken up again") end
function OnGQJoin(name, line, wildcards) local num = tonumber(wildcards.num) or 0 -- A global quest carries its own number, so which one this is never has to be -- guessed at. The same number again is the one already being tracked: its clock -- and its mob QP stand. A different number means the last one ended without us -- seeing it, so that one is closed before this starts. if state.gq_tracking.active then if num == (tonumber(state.gq_tracking.gq_num) or 0) then DebugNote("GQ #" .. num .. " joined again; clock and mob QP untouched") return end FinalizeGQ(false, true) end state.session.gqs_joined = state.session.gqs_joined + 1 if db then db_exec(string.format("INSERT INTO gq_joins (time, gq_num, session_id) VALUES (%d, %d, %d)", os.time(), num, tonumber(state.session.id) or 0)) end state.gq_tracking.active = true state.gq_tracking.start_time = os.time() state.gq_tracking.start_timer = Now() state.gq_tracking.gq_num = num state.gq_tracking.mob_qp = 0 state.gq_tracking.rewards = {} DoAfterSpecial(GQ_TIMEOUT_SECS, string.format("GQTimeout(%d)", state.gq_tracking.gq_num), 12) ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Global quest #" .. tostring(state.gq_tracking.gq_num) .. " joined.") DebugNote("GQ joined #" .. tostring(state.gq_tracking.gq_num)) end
function OnGQMobKill(name, line, wildcards) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_gq_mob_rewards", true) DoAfterSpecial(1, 'EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_gq_mob_rewards", false)', 12) end
function OnGQMobReward(name, line, wildcards) local amount = tonumber(wildcards.amount) or 0 state.gq_tracking.mob_qp = state.gq_tracking.mob_qp + amount state.session.qp = state.session.qp + amount ClaimWorth("gq_mob", {qp = amount}) DebugNote("GQ mob QP +" .. amount) end
function OnGQWin(name, line, wildcards) GQResumeAfterTimeout() state.session.gqs_won = state.session.gqs_won + 1 state.gq_tracking.rewards = {} reward_owner = "gq" EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_gq_rewards", true) DoAfterSpecial(1.5, 'FinalizeGQ(true)', 12) DebugNote("GQ won!") end
function OnGQFinish(name, line, wildcards) GQResumeAfterTimeout() if not state.gq_tracking.active then return end DoAfterSpecial(2, 'FinalizeGQ(false)', 12) DebugNote("GQ finished (not winner)") end
function OnGQWinReward(name, line, wildcards) if reward_owner ~= "gq" then return end local amount = parse_number(wildcards.amount) local rtype = wildcards.type or "" for pattern, currency in pairs(REWARD_TYPE_MAP) do if rtype:find(pattern, 1, true) then state.gq_tracking.rewards[currency] = (state.gq_tracking.rewards[currency] or 0) + amount ClaimWorth("gq", {[currency] = amount}) DebugNote("GQ Reward: " .. comma_value(amount) .. " " .. currency) break end end end
-- As for quests and campaigns: the high-resolution timer when its start survived, -- the whole-second clock otherwise. function GQDuration(now) local gt = state.gq_tracking if (gt.start_time or 0) <= 0 then return 0 end local start_timer = tonumber(gt.start_timer) or 0 local now_hr = Now() if start_timer > 0 and now_hr > start_timer then return now_hr - start_timer end local duration = now - gt.start_time if duration < 0 then duration = 0 end return duration end
function FinalizeGQ(won, timed_out) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_gq_rewards", false) if reward_owner == "gq" then reward_owner = nil end
if not state.gq_tracking.active then return end local now = os.time() local duration = GQDuration(now)
local r = state.gq_tracking.rewards or {} local qp_win = r.qp or 0 local gold = r.gold or 0 local tp = r.tp or 0 local trains = r.trains or 0 local pracs = r.pracs or 0
state.session.qp = state.session.qp + qp_win state.session.tp = state.session.tp + tp state.session.gold = state.session.gold + gold state.session.trains = state.session.trains + trains state.session.pracs = state.session.pracs + pracs
-- The worth claims were made line by line as the rewards arrived (OnGQWinReward).
CreditTrackedMulti({qp = state.gq_tracking.mob_qp + qp_win, gold = gold, tp = tp, trains = trains, pracs = pracs, gqs = 1})
if db then db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO gquests (gq_num, start_time, end_time, duration, qp_mobs, qp_win, gold, tp, trains, pracs, won, completed, level_num, class, race, session_id, tier, remort, redo, opk, hardcore) VALUES (%d, %d, %d, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)]], state.gq_tracking.gq_num, state.gq_tracking.start_time, now, DurationSql(duration), state.gq_tracking.mob_qp, qp_win, gold, tp, trains, pracs, won and 1 or 0, timed_out and 0 or 1, state.current.level, fixsql(state.current.subclass), fixsql(state.current.race), state.session.id, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo(), StampOPK(), StampHardcore())) end
-- A timeout is housekeeping, not a result: it says so locally instead of -- announcing a finish on a channel, possibly hours after the fact. if timed_out then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format( "[CDT] Global quest #%s never finished. Closed after %s; its %d mob QP is recorded.", tostring(state.gq_tracking.gq_num), FormatTimeShort(duration), state.gq_tracking.mob_qp)) end
if not timed_out then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format("[CDT] Global quest #%s %s in %s.", tostring(state.gq_tracking.gq_num), won and "won" or "finished", FormatTimePrecise(duration))) end
if EventOn("gq") and not timed_out then local chan = EventChannel("gq") local total_qp = state.gq_tracking.mob_qp + qp_win local msg = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@YGQ @D| @w%s @D| @W%d@wqp @D(@w%dmob+%dwin@D)", FormatTimePrecise(duration), total_qp, state.gq_tracking.mob_qp, qp_win) if gold > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @Y" .. comma_value(gold) .. "@wg" end if tp > 0 then msg = msg .. " @D| @M" .. tp .. "@wtp" end if won then msg = msg .. " @D| @GWON!" end local rc = (state.current.race ~= "" and state.current.race or "?") local sc = (state.current.subclass ~= "" and state.current.subclass or "?") msg = msg .. " @D| @C" .. rc .. " " .. sc .. "@D]" Report(chan, msg) end
if timed_out and db then local row = db_query_one("SELECT last_insert_rowid() AS id") state.gq_tracking.closed_id = row and tonumber(row.id) or 0 else state.gq_tracking.closed_id = 0 end state.gq_tracking.active = false state.gq_tracking.start_timer = 0 state.gq_tracking.rewards = {} DebugNote(string.format("GQ finalized: mob_qp=%d win_qp=%d gold=%d won=%s", state.gq_tracking.mob_qp, qp_win, gold, tostring(won))) state_save() end
-- ============================================================================= -- GMCP HANDLERS -- ============================================================================= -- Connecting is not the same as playing. With MUSHclient's autologin off, the name -- and password prompts come first, and any command sent then is read as the -- character name or the password. So nothing is sent, and no session starts, -- until GMCP reports a character in play: char.status state 3 or above (1 is the -- login screen, 2 the MOTD). game_state = nil -- last char.status state seen this connection game_session_started = false
-- Starts the session and asks the game for data, once per connection. function BeginGameSession() if game_session_started then return end game_session_started = true StartSession() DoubleResume() DmgMeterAutoStart() SendNoEcho("protocol gmcp sendchar") RequestWhois() end
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if id ~= GMCP_HANDLER_ID then return end if config.group_log and (text == "group" or text == "char.vitals") then local ok, data = pcall(gmcp, text) if ok then GroupLog(text, data) end end if text == "char.vitals" then WailOnVitals() end
if text == "char.status" then local ok, data = pcall(gmcp, "char.status") if ok and type(data) == "table" and tonumber(data.state) then game_state = tonumber(data.state) end end -- Start on the first GMCP message of any kind once a character is known to be in -- play: after a reload that is usually group or room data, well before the next -- character update. Start before handling it, so its data lands in the session. if not game_session_started and (tonumber(game_state) or 0) >= 3 then BeginGameSession() end
if text == "char.status" then local ok, data = pcall(gmcp, "char.status") if ok and data then HandleCharStatus(data) end elseif text == "char.base" then local ok, data = pcall(gmcp, "char.base") if ok and data then HandleCharBase(data) end elseif text == "char.worth" then local ok, data = pcall(gmcp, "char.worth") if ok and data then HandleCharWorth(data) end elseif text == "comm.quest" then local ok, data = pcall(gmcp, "comm.quest") if ok and data then HandleCommQuest(data) end elseif text == "room.info" then local ok, data = pcall(gmcp, "room.info") if ok and data then HandleRoomInfo(data) end elseif text == "comm.channel" then local ok, data = pcall(gmcp, "comm.channel") if ok and data then HandleCommChannel(data) end elseif text == "group" then GroupHealScan() DebugNote("Group data updated") end end
function HandleCharStatus(data) -- The last enemy GMCP named, for recording who killed you. "You die." can -- arrive after the enemy field has already been cleared, so the last named -- one is kept with its time rather than overwritten with "". if data.enemy and data.enemy ~= "" then state.current.enemy, state.current.enemy_time = data.enemy, os.time() end if data.enemy ~= nil then TrackFight(data.enemy, data.enemypct) end local curr_level = tonumber(data.level) if curr_level and curr_level > 0 then SetCurrentLevel(curr_level) end end
function HandleCharBase(data) if data.name and data.name ~= "" then state.current.name = data.name end if data.subclass and data.subclass ~= "" then local new_class = data.subclass if new_class ~= state.current.subclass and state.current.subclass ~= "" then DebugNote("Class changed: " .. state.current.subclass .. " -> " .. new_class) end state.current.subclass = new_class end if data.class and data.class ~= "" then state.current.class = data.class end if data.race and data.race ~= "" then local new_race = data.race if new_race ~= state.current.race and state.current.race ~= "" then DebugNote("Race changed: " .. state.current.race .. " -> " .. new_race) end state.current.race = new_race end if data.tier or data.remorts or data.redos then SetProgress(data.tier, data.remorts, data.redos) end if data.level then SetCurrentLevel(data.level) end if data.pups then local pups_val = tonumber(data.pups) if pups_val then state.current.remort_pups = pups_val DebugNote("Remort pups from GMCP: " .. pups_val) end end end
-- Currency that appeared with no known source yet. A quest credits itself as soon -- as GMCP reports it, but a campaign waits 1.5s and a GQ up to 2s while their -- reward lines are captured, so an unexplained gain waits longer than all of them -- before being recorded as coming from somewhere else (voting, a daily blessing). WORTH_OTHER_WAIT = 3 worth_other_pending = {} worth_other_seq = 0
-- A credit waits this long for the worth update that pays it. Before this, any worth -- update in which a currency hadn't changed threw that currency's credits away -- and -- every kill sends one, because the gold changed. A campaign finished mid-fight lost -- its credit to the next kill, so its QP and trains were recorded a second time as -- "other". Credits now go only when nothing has added to them for a while and nothing -- is waiting to be matched against them. WORTH_CREDIT_STALE = 20 worth_credit_seen = {}
-- ============================================================================= -- cdt debug worthtrace: a timeline of worth updates, reward claims and 'other' -- bookings, to the millisecond, for measuring how they race (the 4.2 groundwork). -- Off unless turned on; recording changes nothing about how gains are counted. -- ============================================================================= WORTH_TRACE_DDL = [[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS worth_trace ( trace_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, t REAL NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT DEFAULT '', qp INTEGER DEFAULT 0, tp INTEGER DEFAULT 0, trains INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pracs INTEGER DEFAULT 0, gold INTEGER DEFAULT 0, session_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0 )]] WORTH_TRACE_MAX = 200000 worth_trace_rows, worth_trace_offset = nil, nil
-- Now() is a high-resolution timer, not a clock: shifted once per load onto the -- clock, times keep their fractions and stay comparable within a load. local function TraceTime() if not worth_trace_offset then worth_trace_offset = os.time() - Now() end return Now() + worth_trace_offset end
function WorthTrace(kind, source, amounts) if not config.worth_trace or not db then return end amounts = amounts or {} if not worth_trace_rows then local r = db_query_one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM worth_trace") worth_trace_rows = r and tonumber(r.n) or 0 end if worth_trace_rows >= WORTH_TRACE_MAX then config.worth_trace = false state_save() ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Worth trace stopped at " .. comma_value(WORTH_TRACE_MAX) .. " rows. cdt debug worthtrace report reads it.") return end local function v(k) return math.floor(tonumber(amounts[k]) or 0) end db_exec(string.format("INSERT INTO worth_trace (t, kind, source, qp, tp, trains, pracs, gold, session_id) " .. "VALUES (%.3f, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", TraceTime(), fixsql(kind), fixsql(source or ""), v("qp"), v("tp"), v("trains"), v("pracs"), v("gold"), tonumber(state.session.id) or 0)) worth_trace_rows = worth_trace_rows + 1 end
-- ============================================================================= -- cdt debug grouplog: a raw timeline for working out whether a groupmate's heal on -- someone else shows in GMCP (incomplete healing costs 950 mana, 25% less for an -- Eldar). Every GMCP group and char.vitals message, every line the game shows and -- every command sent, plus the heals CDT recognises (known casts, to check the -- mana drops against), to the millisecond, one JSON object per line, in a file -- next to the database. Off unless turned on; it changes nothing else. Lines a -- gag hides are never drawn, so they aren't in it. -- ============================================================================= GROUP_LOG_MAX_BYTES = 100 * 1024 * 1024 group_log = {file = nil, path = nil, bytes = 0, lines = 0, failed = false}
-- Any Lua value as JSON. A table whose keys are exactly 1..n is an array; any other -- table an object, keys sorted so lines from the same source line up. function JsonEncode(v, depth) depth = depth or 0 if type(v) ~= "table" then return JsonValue(v) end if depth > 20 then return "null" end local count = 0 for _ in pairs(v) do count = count + 1 end if count > 0 and count == #v then local parts = {} for i = 1, count do parts[i] = JsonEncode(v[i], depth + 1) end return "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]" end local keys = {} for k in pairs(v) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end) local parts = {} for _, k in ipairs(keys) do parts[#parts + 1] = JsonString(k) .. ":" .. JsonEncode(v[k], depth + 1) end return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}" end
local function GroupLogOpen(path) local f = io.open(path, "ab") if not f then group_log.failed = true ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Group log: can't write to " .. path .. ". Turned off.") config.group_log = nil return false end f:setvbuf("full") group_log.file, group_log.path, group_log.failed = f, path, false group_log.bytes, group_log.lines = f:seek("end") or 0, 0 return true end
function GroupLogClose() if group_log.file then group_log.file:flush() group_log.file:close() end group_log.file = nil end
function GroupLogFlush() if group_log.file then group_log.file:flush() end end
-- One record: {"t": clock seconds with milliseconds, "k": kind, "d": data}. function GroupLog(kind, data) if not config.group_log then return end if not group_log.file then if group_log.failed or not GroupLogOpen(config.group_log) then return end end local rec = string.format('{"t":%.3f,"k":%s,"d":%s}\n', TraceTime(), JsonString(kind), JsonEncode(data)) group_log.file:write(rec) group_log.bytes, group_log.lines = group_log.bytes + #rec, group_log.lines + 1 if group_log.bytes >= GROUP_LOG_MAX_BYTES then local path = group_log.path GroupLogClose() config.group_log = nil state_save() ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] Group log stopped at %d MB: %s", math.floor(GROUP_LOG_MAX_BYTES / 1048576), path)) end end
-- MUSHclient calls this for every line drawn: 0 = from the game, 1 = a note, 2 = a -- command you sent. Notes (plugins' own output) are left out. function OnPluginScreendraw(kind, log, line) if double_log.file and kind ~= 0 then DoubleLogWrite(kind == 2 and "CMD " or "NOTE", line) end if not config.group_log then return end if kind == 0 then GroupLog("line", line) elseif kind == 2 then GroupLog("cmd", line) end end
local function GroupLogSize(bytes) return string.format("%.1f MB", (tonumber(bytes) or 0) / 1048576) end
function GroupLogCommand(sub) if sub == "on" then if config.group_log then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Group log is already on: " .. config.group_log) return end local folder = (db_path or ""):match("^(.*)[\\/][^\\/]*$") or "." local path = folder .. "\\cdt_grouplog_" .. os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") .. ".jsonl" config.group_log = path if not GroupLogOpen(path) then return end state_save() local ok, g = pcall(gmcp, "group") GroupLog("start", {plugin = PLUGIN_VERSION, name = state.current.name, race = state.current.race, subclass = state.current.subclass, level = state.current.level, group = ok and g or nil}) GroupLogFlush() ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Group log on, writing to:") ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. path) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Every GMCP group and vitals update, game line and command you send.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " It stays on over reloads. cdt debug grouplog off stops it.") elseif sub == "off" then if not config.group_log then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Group log is already off.") return end GroupLog("stop", {}) local path = config.group_log local bytes = group_log.bytes GroupLogClose() config.group_log = nil state_save() ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Group log off (" .. GroupLogSize(bytes) .. "). The file is kept:") ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. path) elseif sub == "" then if config.group_log then if not group_log.file then GroupLog("resume", {}) end ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Group log is ", "lime", "", "on", "silver", "", string.format(": %s, %s records since load.", GroupLogSize(group_log.bytes), comma_value(group_log.lines))) ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. config.group_log) else ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Group log is ", "red", "", "off", "silver", "", ".") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt debug grouplog on | off") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt debug grouplog [on|off]") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- cdt debug double: for finding out why CDT ends a double before the game does. -- Each double, from the moment CDT sees it start until DOUBLE_LOG_TAIL_SECS after -- it decides it ended, goes to its own file next to the database: every game line -- (seen before any plugin's gag), every note and command on screen, every debug -- line (debug mode or not), and CDT's double decisions with the counters behind -- them. Silent: nothing is shown while it records. -- ============================================================================= DOUBLE_LOG_TAIL_SECS = 20 DOUBLE_LOG_MAX_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024 double_log = {file = nil, path = nil, bytes = 0, stop_token = 0, last_path = nil}
local function DoubleLogStamp() local t = TraceTime() return TZDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", math.floor(t)) .. string.format(".%03d", math.floor((t % 1) * 1000)) end
function DoubleLogClose() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_double_log", false) if double_log.file then double_log.file:flush() double_log.file:close() end double_log.file = nil end
-- Tags: LINE a game line, NOTE a note on screen (any plugin's), CMD a command sent, -- DBG a CDT debug line, CDT one of CDT's double decisions. function DoubleLogWrite(tag, text) local f = double_log.file if not f then return end local rec = DoubleLogStamp() .. " " .. tag .. " " .. tostring(text or "") .. "\n" f:write(rec) double_log.bytes = double_log.bytes + #rec if double_log.bytes >= DOUBLE_LOG_MAX_BYTES then f:write(DoubleLogStamp() .. " CDT capture closed: size limit reached\n") DoubleLogClose() end end
-- One of CDT's double decisions, with the state it was made in. function DoubleLogEvent(text) if not double_log.file then return end local c = state.current DoubleLogWrite("CDT ", string.format("%s [double=%s bonus_streak=%d normal_streak=%d waiting=%s]", text, c.double_active and "on" or "off", tonumber(c.dbl_consec_bonus) or 0, tonumber(c.dbl_consec_normal) or 0, c.dbl_awaiting_bonus and "yes" or "no")) end
-- A double started. A double that starts again inside the tail of the last one -- keeps writing to the same file. function DoubleLogStart(source, minutes, line) if not config.double_log then return end double_log.stop_token = double_log.stop_token + 1 -- cancels a pending close if not double_log.file then local folder = (db_path or ""):match("^(.*)[\\/][^\\/]*$") or "." local path = folder .. "\\cdt_doublelog_" .. os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") .. ".log" local f = io.open(path, "ab") if not f then return end f:setvbuf("full") double_log.file, double_log.path, double_log.bytes, double_log.last_path = f, path, 0, path EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_double_log", true) DoubleLogWrite("CDT ", string.format("capture opened: plugin %s, %s, level %s, %s %s", PLUGIN_VERSION, tostring(state.current.name), tostring(state.current.level), tostring(state.current.race), tostring(state.current.subclass))) if line then DoubleLogWrite("LINE", line) end end EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_double_log", true) -- a reconnect turned it off DoubleLogEvent(string.format("double STARTED by %s%s", source or "?", minutes and (", " .. minutes .. " min") or ", length unknown")) end
-- CDT decided the double is over: keep recording DOUBLE_LOG_TAIL_SECS more, then close. function DoubleLogEnded(reason) if not double_log.file then return end DoubleLogEvent("double ENDED: " .. (reason or "?")) double_log.stop_token = double_log.stop_token + 1 DoAfterSpecial(DOUBLE_LOG_TAIL_SECS, "DoubleLogTailDone(" .. double_log.stop_token .. ")", 12) end
function DoubleLogTailDone(token) if token ~= double_log.stop_token or not double_log.file then return end DoubleLogWrite("CDT ", "capture closed " .. DOUBLE_LOG_TAIL_SECS .. " seconds after the end") DoubleLogClose() end
function OnDoubleLogLine(name, line, wildcards) DoubleLogWrite("LINE", line) end
function DoubleLogCommand(sub) if sub == "on" then config.double_log = true state_save() ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Double log on.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Each double is recorded, silently, to a file next to the database: from") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " its start to " .. DOUBLE_LOG_TAIL_SECS .. " seconds after CDT thinks it ended.") if state.current.double_active and not double_log.file then DoubleLogStart("(already running when the log was turned on)", nil) end elseif sub == "off" then config.double_log = false state_save() if double_log.file then DoubleLogWrite("CDT ", "capture closed: cdt debug double off") DoubleLogClose() end ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Double log off. Files already written are kept.") elseif sub == "" then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Double log is ", config.double_log and "lime" or "red", "", config.double_log and "on" or "off", "silver", "", double_log.file and ", recording now." or ".") if double_log.last_path then ColourNote("silver", "", " Last file: " .. double_log.last_path) end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt debug double on | off") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt debug double [on|off]") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- Claims. Every reward that explains a gain -- a quest, each campaign or GQ reward -- line, a GQ mob, a trivia mob, a level-up's or powerup's gains line -- says so here, -- the moment its line arrives. -- -- A gain nothing has claimed waits WORTH_OTHER_WAIT seconds and is then booked as -- 'other'. If its claim turns up after that, the claim takes it back: the 'other' -- row shrinks or goes, and so does the session count it added. Whichever of the -- worth update and the claim comes first, the gain is recorded once. -- ============================================================================= -- A copy is booked WORTH_OTHER_WAIT after its worth update, and in real play the -- claim followed the worth update by 3s at most: 8s covers that with room to spare, -- and keeps a claim from taking back an unrelated gain booked longer ago. WORTH_RECLAIM_SECS = 8 worth_other_booked = {} -- {id, currency, amount, t}, oldest first
local function ReclaimOther(currency, amount, source) local now = Now() local keep = {} for _, b in ipairs(worth_other_booked) do if now - b.t <= WORTH_RECLAIM_SECS and b.amount > 0 then keep[#keep + 1] = b end end worth_other_booked = keep -- The same size first (most likely this claim's own gain), then oldest first. local order = {} for _, b in ipairs(keep) do if b.currency == currency and b.amount == amount then order[#order + 1] = b end end for _, b in ipairs(keep) do if b.currency == currency and b.amount ~= amount then order[#order + 1] = b end end local taken = 0 for _, b in ipairs(order) do if taken >= amount then break end local x = math.min(b.amount, amount - taken) b.amount = b.amount - x taken = taken + x if db and b.id then if b.amount <= 0 then db_exec("DELETE FROM earnings WHERE earning_id = " .. b.id) else db_exec(string.format("UPDATE earnings SET amount = %d WHERE earning_id = %d", b.amount, b.id)) end end end if taken > 0 then state.session[currency] = (tonumber(state.session[currency]) or 0) - taken WorthTrace("reclaim", source, {[currency] = taken}) DebugNote(string.format("Claim (%s) took back %d %s booked as other", source or "?", taken, currency)) end return taken end
function ClaimWorth(source, amounts) WorthTrace("claim", source, amounts) local pc = state.worth_pending_credits for _, c in ipairs({"qp", "tp", "trains", "pracs", "gold"}) do local a = tonumber(amounts[c]) or 0 if a > 0 and c ~= "gold" then a = a - ReclaimOther(c, a, source) end if a ~= 0 then pc[c] = (tonumber(pc[c]) or 0) + a end end NoteWorthCredits() end
-- Called wherever credits may have grown, to remember when that last happened. function NoteWorthCredits() local now = Now() for c, v in pairs(state.worth_pending_credits) do v = tonumber(v) or 0 local seen = worth_credit_seen[c] if not seen then worth_credit_seen[c] = {v = v, t = now} else if v > seen.v then seen.t = now end seen.v = v end end end
-- A credit with no gain to match it would sit there and swallow a real "other" gain -- later on, so it is dropped once it is old enough and nothing is waiting. function ExpireWorthCredits() local now = Now() for c, v in pairs(state.worth_pending_credits) do v = tonumber(v) or 0 local seen = worth_credit_seen[c] if v > 0 and seen and (now - seen.t) > WORTH_CREDIT_STALE then local waiting = false for _, item in ipairs(worth_other_pending) do if item.currency == c then waiting = true break end end if not waiting then state.worth_pending_credits[c] = 0 seen.v = 0 DebugNote(string.format("Dropped a stale %s credit of %s", c, tostring(v))) end end end end
-- Each gain gets its own full wait. A timer judges only the gains queued no later -- than the one that set it: judging the whole queue let a gain that had just come -- in be booked as "other" before its reward was credited (a GQ win straight after -- another GQ mob, a campaign completion just after a kill), counting it twice. -- With no argument (disconnect, unload) everything still waiting is decided. function FlushWorthOther(upto) if #worth_other_pending == 0 then return end NoteWorthCredits() upto = tonumber(upto) or math.huge local queue, keep = {}, {} for _, item in ipairs(worth_other_pending) do if (item.seq or 0) <= upto then queue[#queue + 1] = item else keep[#keep + 1] = item end end worth_other_pending = keep local pc = state.worth_pending_credits for _, item in ipairs(queue) do local pending = pc[item.currency] or 0 local uncredited = item.amount - pending pc[item.currency] = math.max(0, pending - item.amount) if uncredited > 0 then -- The row's id is read straight after its insert: anything written in between -- (the worth trace) would otherwise hand a late claim the wrong row to take back. local booked_id if db and db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO earnings (source, currency, amount, time, class, race, level_num, session_id, tier, remort, redo) " .. "VALUES ('other', %s, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", fixsql(item.currency), uncredited, os.time(), fixsql(state.current.subclass), fixsql(state.current.race), state.current.level, state.session.id, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo())) then local row = db_query_one("SELECT last_insert_rowid() AS id") booked_id = row and tonumber(row.id) end WorthTrace("other", "", {[item.currency] = uncredited}) worth_other_booked[#worth_other_booked + 1] = {id = booked_id, currency = item.currency, amount = uncredited, t = Now()} if item.currency == "qp" then state.session.qp = state.session.qp + uncredited elseif item.currency == "tp" then state.session.tp = state.session.tp + uncredited elseif item.currency == "trains" then state.session.trains = state.session.trains + uncredited elseif item.currency == "pracs" then state.session.pracs = state.session.pracs + uncredited end DebugNote("Worth delta (other): +" .. uncredited .. " " .. item.currency) end end end
function HandleCharWorth(data) local curr_qp = tonumber(data.qp) local curr_tp = tonumber(data.tp) local curr_trains = tonumber(data.trains) local curr_pracs = tonumber(data.pracs) local curr_gold = tonumber(data.gold) local curr_bank = tonumber(data.bank)
local wl = state.worth_last local pc = state.worth_pending_credits NoteWorthCredits()
if wl.qp == -1 then wl.qp = curr_qp or -1 wl.tp = curr_tp or -1 wl.trains = curr_trains or -1 wl.pracs = curr_pracs or -1 wl.gold = curr_gold or -1 wl.bank = curr_bank or -1 return end
local function check_delta(currency, curr, last) if not curr or last == -1 then return end local delta = curr - last if delta > 0 then local key = "worth_" .. currency state.session[key] = (tonumber(state.session[key]) or 0) + delta -- Hold it: the worth update usually arrives BEFORE the quest/CP/GQ message -- that explains it, and crediting it here would both invent an "other" -- earning and count the reward twice. FlushWorthOther decides in a moment. worth_other_seq = worth_other_seq + 1 worth_other_pending[#worth_other_pending + 1] = {currency = currency, amount = delta, seq = worth_other_seq} DoAfterSpecial(WORTH_OTHER_WAIT, string.format("FlushWorthOther(%d)", worth_other_seq), 12) end end
if config.worth_trace then local function d(curr, last) return (curr and last and last >= 0) and (curr - last) or 0 end WorthTrace("worth", "", {qp = d(curr_qp, wl.qp), tp = d(curr_tp, wl.tp), trains = d(curr_trains, wl.trains), pracs = d(curr_pracs, wl.pracs), gold = d(curr_gold, wl.gold)}) end check_delta("qp", curr_qp, wl.qp) check_delta("tp", curr_tp, wl.tp) check_delta("trains", curr_trains, wl.trains) check_delta("pracs", curr_pracs, wl.pracs) ExpireWorthCredits()
if curr_qp and wl.qp >= 0 and curr_qp > wl.qp then local qp_gain = curr_qp - wl.qp state.player_totals.qp_earned = (state.player_totals.qp_earned or 0) + qp_gain SetPlayerTotal("qp_earned", state.player_totals.qp_earned) CheckMilestones("qp", state.player_totals.qp_earned) end
wl.qp = curr_qp or wl.qp wl.tp = curr_tp or wl.tp wl.trains = curr_trains or wl.trains wl.pracs = curr_pracs or wl.pracs wl.gold = curr_gold or wl.gold wl.bank = curr_bank or wl.bank end
function HandleRoomInfo(data) local prev_area = state.current.area local prev_room = tonumber(state.current.room_id) or 0 if data.zone then state.current.area = data.zone end if data.num then state.current.room_id = tonumber(data.num) or 0 end if prev_room > 0 and state.current.room_id ~= prev_room then FightsOnRoomChange(prev_room) end
-- dmg_meter is a file-scope local declared further down, so it is NOT in -- scope here: written inline this read the nil global and the reset silently -- never ran. DmgMeterOnAreaChange is defined alongside the table instead. if prev_area and prev_area ~= "" and state.current.area ~= prev_area then DmgMeterOnAreaChange(state.current.area) end end
-- Is this one of the game's double XP announcements? Returns "start" (with the -- length when it gives one), "end", or nil. Matched from the start of the message: -- anything said on a channel begins with who said it ("Bob gossips '..."), so chat -- that merely mentions double exp can't pass for the real thing. function DoubleAnnouncement(msg) local text = (msg or ""):gsub("@.", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("^INFO:%s*", "") if text:find("^Bonus experience has now expired") then return "end" end local mins = text:match("^%[%s*(%d+) minutes of double exp started courtesy") or text:match("^Double experience for (%d+) minutes courtesy of") or text:match("^For the next (%d+) minutes experience is doubled") or text:match("^For the next (%d+) minutes all experience is doubled") if mins then return "start", tonumber(mins) end -- "You hear a loud roar from X and the world appears calmer for a while. Aardwolf -- rejoices in the death of another MILLION monsters.": the sentence can come late -- in the line. Not a whois history copy ("| ...", "[date] ...") or a player's quote. if text:find("Aardwolf rejoices in the death of another MILLION monsters%.%s*$") and not text:find("^[|%[]") and not text:find("'", 1, true) then return "start", MILLION_DOUBLE_MINS, true -- it replaces any double running end return nil end
function HandleCommChannel(data) if not data or not data.chan then return end local chan = (data.chan or ""):lower() local msg = data.msg or "" local player = data.player or ""
HandleListenQuery(chan, player, msg)
-- Only the game's own announcements count. These used to be found anywhere in any -- channel message, so "is double exp on tonight?" on gossip started a double. local found, mins, overwrite = DoubleAnnouncement(msg) if found == "start" then ActivateDouble(mins, "GMCP " .. chan .. " message: " .. msg:gsub("@.", ""), nil, overwrite) DebugNote("Double XP started (via GMCP comm.channel, chan=" .. chan .. ", " .. (mins or "?") .. " min)") elseif found == "end" then DeactivateDouble("GMCP " .. chan .. " message: " .. msg:gsub("@.", "")) DebugNote("Double XP ended (via GMCP comm.channel, chan=" .. chan .. ")") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- BLOOT / COMBAT / MISC -- ============================================================================= function OnBlootLoot(name, line, wildcards) local tier = wildcards.tier if not BLOOT_SET[tier] then return end
local corpse = wildcards.corpse or "" local my_name = gmcp("char.base.name") or "" if my_name ~= "" and corpse:lower():find(my_name:lower(), 1, true) then return end
state.session.bloot[tier] = (state.session.bloot[tier] or 0) + 1 if db then db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO bloot_log (tier, corpse, area, time, session_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %d, %d)", fixsql(tier), fixsql(corpse), fixsql(state.current.area), os.time(), state.session.id)) end DebugNote("Bloot: " .. tier) end
function OnVorpal(n, l, w) AddKillSpecial("vorpal") end function OnDeathblow(n, l, w) AddKillSpecial("deathblow") end function OnAssassinate(n, l, w) AddKillSpecial("assassinate") end function OnSlit(n, l, w) AddKillSpecial("slit") end function OnDisintegrate(n, l, w) AddKillSpecial("disintegrate") end function OnBanishment(n, l, w) AddKillSpecial("banishment") end
function OnTriviaMob(name, line, wildcards) state.session.tp = state.session.tp + 1 ClaimWorth("trivia_mob", {tp = 1}) if db then db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO earnings (source, currency, amount, time, class, race, level_num, session_id, tier, remort, redo) " .. "VALUES ('trivia_mob', 'tp', 1, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", os.time(), fixsql(state.current.subclass), fixsql(state.current.race), state.current.level, state.session.id, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo())) end DebugNote("Trivia mob TP +1") end
-- ============================================================================= -- AFK -- ============================================================================= function OnAFKOn(name, line, wildcards) if not state.session.afk then state.session.afk = true if state.session.active_start > 0 then state.session.total_active_secs = state.session.total_active_secs + (os.time() - state.session.active_start) end DebugNote("AFK on - pausing active time") end end
function OnAFKOff(name, line, wildcards) if state.session.afk then state.session.afk = false state.session.active_start = os.time() DebugNote("AFK off - resuming active time") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- DOUBLE XP (text trigger fallback) -- ============================================================================= -- overwrite: this double replaces the one running, ending when this one does (the -- million monsters' hour does that to any double on). function ActivateDouble(minutes, source, line, overwrite) if state.current.double_active then -- Another double on top: it runs until the later of the two ends -- or, one -- that overwrites, until its own end -- and so does the double's session (a -- 15-minute superhero double, then the million monsters' hour, used to end -- the session at 15 minutes). local old_until = tonumber(state.current.double_until) or 0 if minutes then local own = os.time() + minutes * 60 state.current.double_until = overwrite and own or math.max(old_until, own) end local new_until = state.current.double_until if new_until ~= old_until then ExtendAutoTrack(new_until, overwrite) DoubleLogEvent("start seen while already on: " .. (source or "?") .. "; now until " .. TZDate("%H:%M:%S", new_until)) DebugNote("Double XP extended to " .. TZDate("%H:%M", new_until) .. " (" .. (source or "?") .. ")") else DoubleLogEvent("start seen while already on: " .. (source or "?")) end return end state.current.double_active = true state.current.double_start_time = os.time() state.current.double_until = minutes and (os.time() + minutes * 60) or 0 state.current.dbl_consec_bonus = 0 state.current.dbl_consec_normal = 0 state.current.dbl_awaiting_bonus = false if db then db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO double_xp_log (start_time, session_id) VALUES (%d, %d)", os.time(), state.session.id)) end if EventOn("double") then if minutes then Report(EventChannel("double"), "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@YDOUBLE XP @GSTARTED @D(@w" .. minutes .. " min@D)]") else Report(EventChannel("double"), "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@YDOUBLE XP @GSTARTED@D]") end end StartAutoTrack("Double XP " .. TZDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), minutes) DoubleLogStart(source, minutes, line) DebugNote("Double XP activated, logged to DB") end
-- end_time: when it ended, if not now. function DeactivateDouble(reason, end_time) if not state.current.double_active then DoubleLogEvent("end seen while already off: " .. (reason or "?")) return end DoubleLogEnded(reason) -- before the state it was decided on is reset state.current.double_active = false state.current.double_until = 0 state.current.dbl_consec_bonus = 0 state.current.dbl_consec_normal = 0 state.current.dbl_awaiting_bonus = false if db then db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE double_xp_log SET end_time = %d WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM double_xp_log WHERE end_time = 0)", tonumber(end_time) or os.time())) end if EventOn("double") then Report(EventChannel("double"), "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@YDOUBLE XP @RENDED@D]") end if state.tracked_auto.active then FinalizeAutoTrack() end DebugNote("Double XP deactivated, logged to DB") end
-- seq: the kill whose 0.5 s wait ran out. Each kill's check judges only that kill: -- one shared check let an earlier kill's timer judge the latest kill a millisecond -- after its exp line, before its bonus line (in the next packet) arrived. Without -- seq, the next kill's exp line arrived first. function ResolveDoubleCheck(seq) if seq and seq ~= dbl_check_seq then return end if not state.current.dbl_awaiting_bonus then return end state.current.dbl_awaiting_bonus = false local why = seq and "no bonus line within 0.5s" or "no bonus line before the next kill"
local was_bonus_streak = (state.current.dbl_consec_bonus or 0) > 0 state.current.dbl_consec_normal = (state.current.dbl_consec_normal or 0) + 1 state.current.dbl_consec_bonus = 0
if was_bonus_streak then local now = os.time() local last_flip = state.current.dbl_last_flip or 0 if last_flip > 0 and (now - last_flip) < 60 then state.current.dbl_consec_normal = 0 state.current.dbl_consec_bonus = 0 DoubleLogEvent(why .. ": erratic pattern, counts reset") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Warning: erratic bonus exp pattern detected - ignoring for double XP tracking") DebugNote("Double XP flip-flop detected, resetting counters") return end state.current.dbl_last_flip = now end DoubleLogEvent(why .. ": normal kill")
if state.current.double_active and state.current.dbl_consec_normal >= 3 then -- The game said how long this double lasts: kills that look normal don't end -- it before then (its own end message still does). local until_t = tonumber(state.current.double_until) or 0 if until_t > os.time() then DoubleLogEvent("3 kills in a row with no bonus line, but the game gave this double until " .. TZDate("%H:%M:%S", until_t) .. ": kept on, count reset") state.current.dbl_consec_normal = 0 return end -- It ended after the last kill that showed a bonus. local last = tonumber(state.current.dbl_last_bonus) or 0 local end_t = (last > 0 and last >= (tonumber(state.current.double_start_time) or 0)) and last or os.time() if seq then -- A timer runs between packets, when a line can be half received; anything -- printed now ends that line there, and the rest arrives as a line of its -- own that no trigger matches. Wait for the next complete line instead. double_end_pending = {reason = "3 kills in a row with no bonus line", end_t = end_t} DoubleLogEvent("end decided: its messages wait for the next complete line") DoAfterSpecial(2, "DoubleEndFlush()", 12) return end DeactivateDouble("3 kills in a row with no bonus line", end_t) DebugNote("Double XP ended (3 consecutive kills without bonus)") end end
double_end_pending = nil
function DoubleEndFlush() local pend = double_end_pending if not pend then return end double_end_pending = nil if not state.current.double_active then return end DeactivateDouble(pend.reason, pend.end_t) DebugNote("Double XP ended (3 consecutive kills without bonus)") end
-- Every complete line from the game, before any trigger sees it. A held double end -- goes out here, unless this line is the bonus it was missing, arriving late. function OnPluginLineReceived(line) if double_end_pending then if line:find("^You receive [%d,]+ bonus experience point") then double_end_pending = nil DoubleLogEvent("held end cancelled: a bonus line arrived late") else DoubleEndFlush() end end return true end
-- Play resumed (a reload, a reconnect, cdt reset session) with a double on: still -- running if the time the game gave it hasn't run out; ended at that time if it -- has. With no length known, the next kills decide (the 3-kill rule), and it ends -- at the last bonus line seen. function DoubleResume() local c = state.current if not c.double_active then return end c.dbl_consec_bonus, c.dbl_consec_normal, c.dbl_awaiting_bonus = 0, 0, false local now, until_t = os.time(), tonumber(c.double_until) or 0 if until_t > 0 and until_t <= now then DeactivateDouble("its time ran out while the plugin was away", until_t) return end local mins = until_t > 0 and math.ceil((until_t - now) / 60) or nil if not state.tracked_auto.active then StartAutoTrack("Double XP " .. TZDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") .. " (resumed)", mins) end DoubleLogStart(mins and "resuming after a reload or reconnect" or "resuming after a reload or reconnect (no length known: the next kills decide)", mins) DebugNote("Double XP resumed" .. (mins and (", " .. mins .. " min left") or ", length unknown")) end
function OnDoubleStart(name, line, wildcards) local mins = tonumber(wildcards.mins) ActivateDouble(mins, "game line: " .. line, line) DebugNote("Double XP started (text trigger, " .. (mins or "?") .. " min)") end
MILLION_DOUBLE_MINS = 60
function OnMillionDouble(name, line, wildcards) ActivateDouble(MILLION_DOUBLE_MINS, "game line: " .. line, line, true) DebugNote("Double XP started (a million monsters, " .. MILLION_DOUBLE_MINS .. " min)") end
function OnDoubleEnd(name, line, wildcards) DeactivateDouble("game line: " .. line) DebugNote("Double XP ended (text trigger)") end

-- ============================================================================= -- AREA RATE TRACKING -- ============================================================================= function TrackAreaLevelPup(area, ltype, grouped) if not area or area == "" then return end if not area_rates[area] then area_rates[area] = { xp = 0, gold = 0, kills = 0, last_kill = 0, active_secs = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, solo_levels = 0, group_levels = 0, solo_pups = 0, group_pups = 0, } end local ar = area_rates[area] if ltype == "level" then ar.levels = (ar.levels or 0) + 1 if grouped then ar.group_levels = (ar.group_levels or 0) + 1 else ar.solo_levels = (ar.solo_levels or 0) + 1 end else ar.pups = (ar.pups or 0) + 1 if grouped then ar.group_pups = (ar.group_pups or 0) + 1 else ar.solo_pups = (ar.solo_pups or 0) + 1 end end
if db then local g = grouped and 1 or 0 local col = ltype == "level" and "levels" or "pups" db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE area_stats SET %s=%s+1 WHERE area=%s AND grouped=%d", col, col, fixsql(area), g)) end end
function TrackAreaXP(area, xp) if not area or area == "" then return end if not area_rates[area] then area_rates[area] = { xp = 0, gold = 0, kills = 0, last_kill = 0, active_secs = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, solo_levels = 0, group_levels = 0, solo_pups = 0, group_pups = 0, } end local ar = area_rates[area] local now = os.time() if ar.last_kill > 0 and (now - ar.last_kill) < 60 then ar.active_secs = ar.active_secs + (now - ar.last_kill) end ar.xp = ar.xp + xp ar.kills = ar.kills + 1 ar.last_kill = now end

and is_group) and 1 or 0) local new_solo_pups = (existing.solo_pups or 0) + ((is_pup and is_solo) and 1 or 0) local new_group_pups = (existing.group_pups or 0) + ((is_pup and is_group) and 1 or 0) existing.avg_group_pup_secs or 0 local fastest_solo_lvl = existing.fastest_solo_lvl or 999999 local fastest_group_lvl = existing.fastest_group_lvl or 999999 local fastest_solo_pup = existing.fastest_solo_pup or 999999 local fastest_group_pup = existing.fastest_group_pup or 999999
if is_level then if new_levels > 0 then avg_lvl = ((existing.avg_lvl_secs * existing.total_levels) + duration) / new_levels end if duration < fastest_lvl then fastest_lvl = duration end if is_solo then if new_solo_levels > 0 then avg_solo_lvl = (((existing.avg_solo_lvl_secs or 0) * (existing.solo_levels or 0)) + duration) / new_solo_levels end if duration < fastest_solo_lvl then fastest_solo_lvl = duration end else if new_group_levels > 0 then avg_group_lvl = (((existing.avg_group_lvl_secs or 0) * (existing.group_levels or 0)) + duration) / new_group_levels end if duration < fastest_group_lvl then fastest_group_lvl = duration end end else if new_pups > 0 then avg_pup = ((existing.avg_pup_secs * existing.total_pups) + duration) / new_pups end if duration < fastest_pup then fastest_pup = duration end if is_solo then if new_solo_pups > 0 then avg_solo_pup = (((existing.avg_solo_pup_secs or 0) * (existing.solo_pups or 0)) + duration) / new_solo_pups end if duration < fastest_solo_pup then fastest_solo_pup = duration end else if new_group_pups > 0 then avg_group_pup = (((existing.avg_group_pup_secs or 0) * (existing.group_pups or 0)) + duration) / new_group_pups end if duration < fastest_group_pup then fastest_group_pup = duration end end end

-- ============================================================================= -- STATS REBUILD (used by migration and manual rebuild) -- ============================================================================= function RebuildAreaStats() if not db then return end db_exec("DELETE FROM area_stats;")
local areas = {}
for row in db:nrows([[SELECT area, grouped, SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) as total_xp, COUNT(*) as kills, MAX(time) as last_kill FROM kills WHERE area != '' GROUP BY area, grouped]]) do local key = row.area .. "|" .. row.grouped areas[key] = {area = row.area, grouped = row.grouped, xp = row.total_xp, gold = 0, kills = row.kills, active = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, last_kill = row.last_kill} end
local GAP = 60 local BURST = 3 local prev_key, prev_time = nil, 0 for row in db:nrows("SELECT area, grouped, time FROM kills WHERE area != '' ORDER BY grouped, area, time") do local key = row.area .. "|" .. row.grouped local delta = BURST if key == prev_key and (row.time - prev_time) >= 0 and (row.time - prev_time) < GAP then delta = row.time - prev_time end if areas[key] then areas[key].active = areas[key].active + delta end prev_key = key prev_time = row.time end
for row in db:nrows([[SELECT area, grouped, SUM(amount) as total FROM gold_log WHERE area != '' AND source IN ('mob','crumble','shared') GROUP BY area, grouped]]) do local key = row.area .. "|" .. row.grouped if areas[key] then areas[key].gold = row.total else areas[key] = {area = row.area, grouped = row.grouped, xp = 0, gold = row.total, kills = 0, active = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, last_kill = 0} end end
for row in db:nrows("SELECT area, grouped, type, COUNT(*) as total FROM levels WHERE area != '' GROUP BY area, grouped, type") do local key = row.area .. "|" .. row.grouped if areas[key] then if row.type == "level" then areas[key].levels = row.total elseif row.type == "pup" then areas[key].pups = row.total end end end
db_exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION;") for _, a in pairs(areas) do db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO area_stats (area, grouped, total_xp, total_gold, total_kills, active_secs, levels, pups, last_kill_time) VALUES (%s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %d, %d, %d)]], fixsql(a.area), a.grouped, a.xp, a.gold, a.kills, tostring(a.active), a.levels, a.pups, a.last_kill)) end db_exec("COMMIT;") end
function RebuildStatsGoldXP() if not db then return end
local class_gold, class_xp = {}, {} for row in db:nrows([[SELECT class, grouped, SUM(amount) as total FROM gold_log WHERE source IN ('mob','crumble','shared') AND class != '' GROUP BY class, grouped]]) do if not class_gold[row.class] then class_gold[row.class] = {solo=0, group=0} end if row.grouped == 1 then class_gold[row.class].group = row.total else class_gold[row.class].solo = row.total end end for row in db:nrows([[SELECT class, grouped, SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) as total FROM kills WHERE class != '' GROUP BY class, grouped]]) do if not class_xp[row.class] then class_xp[row.class] = {solo=0, group=0} end if row.grouped == 1 then class_xp[row.class].group = row.total else class_xp[row.class].solo = row.total end end for row in db:nrows("SELECT class FROM class_stats") do local g = class_gold[row.class] or {solo=0, group=0} local x = class_xp[row.class] or {solo=0, group=0} db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE class_stats SET total_gold=%d, solo_gold=%d, group_gold=%d, solo_xp=%d, group_xp=%d WHERE class=%s", g.solo + g.group, g.solo, g.group, x.solo, x.group, fixsql(row.class))) end
local race_gold, race_xp = {}, {} for row in db:nrows([[SELECT race, grouped, SUM(amount) as total FROM gold_log WHERE source IN ('mob','crumble','shared') AND race != '' GROUP BY race, grouped]]) do if not race_gold[row.race] then race_gold[row.race] = {solo=0, group=0} end if row.grouped == 1 then race_gold[row.race].group = row.total else race_gold[row.race].solo = row.total end end for row in db:nrows([[SELECT race, grouped, SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) as total FROM kills WHERE race != '' GROUP BY race, grouped]]) do if not race_xp[row.race] then race_xp[row.race] = {solo=0, group=0} end if row.grouped == 1 then race_xp[row.race].group = row.total else race_xp[row.race].solo = row.total end end for row in db:nrows("SELECT race FROM race_stats") do local g = race_gold[row.race] or {solo=0, group=0} local x = race_xp[row.race] or {solo=0, group=0} db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE race_stats SET total_gold=%d, solo_gold=%d, group_gold=%d, solo_xp=%d, group_xp=%d WHERE race=%s", g.solo + g.group, g.solo, g.group, x.solo, x.group, fixsql(row.race))) end
local combo_gold, combo_xp = {}, {} for row in db:nrows([[SELECT race, class, grouped, SUM(amount) as total FROM gold_log WHERE source IN ('mob','crumble','shared') AND race != '' AND class != '' GROUP BY race, class, grouped]]) do local key = row.race .. "|" .. row.class if not combo_gold[key] then combo_gold[key] = {solo=0, group=0} end if row.grouped == 1 then combo_gold[key].group = row.total else combo_gold[key].solo = row.total end end for row in db:nrows([[SELECT race, class, grouped, SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) as total FROM kills WHERE race != '' AND class != '' GROUP BY race, class, grouped]]) do local key = row.race .. "|" .. row.class if not combo_xp[key] then combo_xp[key] = {solo=0, group=0} end if row.grouped == 1 then combo_xp[key].group = row.total else combo_xp[key].solo = row.total end end for row in db:nrows("SELECT combo FROM combo_stats") do local g = combo_gold[row.combo] or {solo=0, group=0} local x = combo_xp[row.combo] or {solo=0, group=0} db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE combo_stats SET total_gold=%d, solo_gold=%d, group_gold=%d, solo_xp=%d, group_xp=%d WHERE combo=%s", g.solo + g.group, g.solo, g.group, x.solo, x.group, fixsql(row.combo))) end end
-- ============================================================================= -- KILL BUFFER FLUSH -- ============================================================================= -- ============================================================================= -- FIGHT TRACKER -- Built from the text. GMCP names one enemy at a time and arrives after the text, -- so in group fights with area attacks it pointed at the wrong mob. Instead: -- * each of your damage lines adds to the fight with the target it names; -- * a kill's XP line comes straight after the mob's death message, which starts -- with the mob's name ("A Void Titan feels so desolate ... It is DEAD!", -- "An Ice Titan smoulders ..."), so XP claims the fight with that name -- -- whoever landed the killing blow; -- * GMCP only adds rounds (changes in the named enemy's health %) and starts -- the clock on a mob you are fighting before your first hit lands. -- A fight you hit that sees no kill for FIGHT_STALE_SECS, or that you flee, goes -- to unfinished_fights. Names are compared by FightKey: lower case, without the -- decorations damage lines wrap verbs in. -- ============================================================================= FIGHT_STALE_SECS = 30 fights = {} fight_tracker = {died_at = nil, killed = {}} last_kill_record = nil
-- Kill specials print before the XP line that makes the kill record, so they wait -- here (for up to 10 seconds) and go onto the next kill. pending_specials = {time = 0}
function AddKillSpecial(kind) state.session.combat[kind] = (state.session.combat[kind] or 0) + 1 if os.time() - (pending_specials.time or 0) > 10 then pending_specials = {time = 0} end pending_specials[kind] = (pending_specials[kind] or 0) + 1 pending_specials.time = os.time() end
function NewKillRecord(xp) local rec = NewKillRecordFields(xp) if os.time() - (pending_specials.time or 0) <= 10 then for _, sp in ipairs(KILL_SPECIALS) do rec[sp] = pending_specials[sp] or 0 end end pending_specials = {time = 0} return rec end
function NewKillRecordFields(xp) return { xp = xp or 0, xp_rare = 0, xp_bonus = 0, xp_double = 0, xp_blessing = 0, xp_honor = 0, gold = 0, area = state.current.area, bloot_tier = "", vorpal = 0, deathblow = 0, assassinate = 0, slit = 0, disintegrate = 0, banishment = 0, time = os.time(), class = state.current.subclass, race = state.current.race, double_active = state.current.double_active and 1 or 0, level_num = state.current.level, session_id = state.session.id, grouped = IsGrouped() and 1 or 0, tier = StampTier(), remort = StampRemort(), redo = StampRedo(), opk = StampOPK(), hardcore = StampHardcore(), mob_name = "", room_id = 0, damage = 0, rounds = 0, combat_secs = 0, mob_level = -1, fight_tracked = 0, } end
-- One kill for the session, lifetime and goal counters. function CountKill() state.session.kills = state.session.kills + 1 state.player_totals.mobs_killed = (state.player_totals.mobs_killed or 0) + 1 CreditTracked("kills", 1) if state.player_totals.mobs_killed % 1000 == 0 then SetPlayerTotal("mobs_killed", state.player_totals.mobs_killed) CheckMilestones("mob", state.player_totals.mobs_killed) end end
function FightKey(name) if not name or name == "" then return nil end local key = StripVerbDecorations(tostring(name)):lower() if key == "" then return nil end return key end
function GetFight(name) local key = FightKey(name) if not key then return nil end local f = fights[key] if not f then f = {key = key, name = name, damage = 0, rounds = 0, start_timer = Now(), start_time = os.time(), level_num = state.current.level, area = state.current.area or "", room_id = tonumber(state.current.room_id) or 0} fights[key] = f end f.last_seen = Now() return f end
function AddFightDamage(target, damage) local f = GetFight(target) if f then f.damage = f.damage + (tonumber(damage) or 0) end end
-- Fed every GMCP char.status that carries an enemy field. function TrackFight(enemy, pct) if not enemy or enemy == "" then return end -- GMCP can still name your killer just after you die, or a mob the text has -- already killed; neither is a new fight. if fight_tracker.died_at and (Now() - fight_tracker.died_at) <= 5 then return end local key = FightKey(enemy) local killed_at = key and fight_tracker.killed[key] if killed_at and (Now() - killed_at) <= 2 then return end local f = GetFight(enemy) if not f then return end f.gmcp = true -- GMCP named it as your enemy: a fight of yours f.name = enemy -- and GMCP's spelling of the name is exact pct = tonumber(pct) if pct and pct ~= f.last_pct then if f.last_pct then f.rounds = f.rounds + 1 end f.last_pct = pct end end
-- The line received just before `line`. From inside its trigger GetRecentLines -- includes the line being matched; should it ever not, its last line is already -- the previous one. function PreviousLine(line) local ok, recent = pcall(GetRecentLines, 2) if not ok or type(recent) ~= "string" or recent == "" then return nil end local parts = {} for text in (recent .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\r?\n") do parts[#parts + 1] = text end if parts[#parts] == line then return parts[#parts - 1] end return parts[#parts] end
-- The open fight a death message belongs to: the longest fight name the message -- starts with. Failing that, the longest one it contains as whole words, for the -- messages that name the mob mid-line ("The very fabric of the world rejects a -- Fire Titan ..."). A damage target like "Orzbuk's right arm" also matches as "Orzbuk". function ClaimKillFight(death_line) local dkey = FightKey(death_line) if not dkey then return nil end local padded = " " .. dkey .. " " local best, best_len, best_anywhere, anywhere_len = nil, 0, nil, 0 for key, f in pairs(fights) do for _, k in ipairs({key, key:match("^(.-)'s ") or ""}) do if k ~= "" then if #k > best_len and (dkey == k or dkey:sub(1, #k + 1) == k .. " ") then best, best_len = f, #k elseif #k > anywhere_len and (padded:find(" " .. k .. " ", 1, true) or padded:find(" " .. k .. "'s ", 1, true)) then best_anywhere, anywhere_len = f, #k end end end end return best or best_anywhere end
-- Callers decide which fights were yours (see EndOwnFights and SweepFights) and why -- they ended: -- fled "You flee from combat!" -- retreated "You retreat from the fight!" -- moved you changed rooms mid-fight with no flee or retreat: recall, a portal -- left still alive FIGHT_STALE_SECS after your last hit or GMCP update -- ended you disconnected or the plugin unloaded function SaveUnfinishedFight(f, reason) if not db or not f then return end local secs = math.max(0, (f.last_seen or f.start_timer) - f.start_timer) db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO unfinished_fights (time, mob_name, area, room_id, level_num, tier, remort, redo, " .. "class, race, grouped, session_id, damage, rounds, combat_secs, reason) " .. "VALUES (%d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %.1f, %s)", f.start_time, fixsql(f.name or ""), fixsql(f.area or ""), f.room_id or 0, tonumber(f.level_num) or 0, StampTier(), StampRemort(), StampRedo(), fixsql(state.current.subclass or ""), fixsql(state.current.race or ""), IsGrouped() and 1 or 0, tonumber(state.session.id) or 0, f.damage or 0, f.rounds or 0, secs, fixsql(reason or ""))) DebugNote(string.format("Unfinished (%s): %s, %s dmg", reason or "?", f.name or "?", comma_value(f.damage or 0))) end
-- Fights with no activity for FIGHT_STALE_SECS end; `all` ends every one. Only a -- mob GMCP named as your enemy is saved as unfinished: one your area attacks -- merely splashed and the group left alive was never your fight. function SweepFights(all) local now = Now() for key, f in pairs(fights) do if all or now - (f.last_seen or 0) > FIGHT_STALE_SECS then if f.gmcp then SaveUnfinishedFight(f, all and "ended" or "left") end fights[key] = nil end end for key, t in pairs(fight_tracker.killed) do if now - t > 10 then fight_tracker.killed[key] = nil end end end
-- Leaving a fight saves the one you were in: the mob GMCP named as your enemy, -- or failing that the one you damaged most. Mobs your area attacks only splashed -- are dropped. With `room`, only fights begun in that room end, and the -- most-damaged fallback is skipped: moving on after a fight leaves splashed mobs -- behind, and those were never yours. function EndOwnFights(reason, room) local mine, top = {}, nil for _, f in pairs(fights) do if not room or f.room_id == room then if f.gmcp then mine[#mine + 1] = f end if (f.damage or 0) > 0 and (not top or f.damage > top.damage) then top = f end end end if #mine == 0 and top and not room then mine[1] = top end for _, f in ipairs(mine) do SaveUnfinishedFight(f, reason) end if room then for key, f in pairs(fights) do if f.room_id == room then fights[key] = nil end end else fights = {} end end
function OnPlayerFlee(name, line, wildcards) EndOwnFights("fled") end
function OnPlayerRetreat(name, line, wildcards) EndOwnFights("retreated") end
-- You changed rooms with a fight of yours open: recall, a portal, being moved. -- Flee and retreat change rooms too, but their line arrives just after the new -- room, so wait a second and let them claim the fight first. function FightsOnRoomChange(old_room) for _, f in pairs(fights) do if f.gmcp and f.room_id == old_room then DoAfterSpecial(1, "EndFightsAfterMove(" .. old_room .. ")", 12) return end end end
function EndFightsAfterMove(old_room) EndOwnFights("moved", tonumber(old_room)) end
function FlushKillBuffer() if #kill_buffer == 0 or not db then return end db_exec("BEGIN TRANSACTION;") for _, k in ipairs(kill_buffer) do db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO kills (xp, xp_rare, xp_bonus, gold, area, bloot_tier, vorpal, deathblow, assassinate, slit, disintegrate, banishment, time, class, race, double_active, level_num, session_id, grouped, tier, remort, redo, mob_name, room_id, damage, rounds, combat_secs, mob_level, fight_tracked, opk, hardcore, xp_double, xp_blessing, xp_honor) VALUES (%d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %d, %d, %d, %.1f, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)]], k.xp, k.xp_rare, k.xp_bonus, k.gold, fixsql(k.area), fixsql(k.bloot_tier), k.vorpal, k.deathblow, k.assassinate, k.slit, k.disintegrate, k.banishment, k.time, fixsql(k.class), fixsql(k.race), k.double_active, k.level_num, k.session_id, k.grouped or 0, k.tier or -1, k.remort or -1, k.redo or -1, fixsql(k.mob_name or ""), k.room_id or 0, k.damage or 0, k.rounds or 0, k.combat_secs or 0, k.mob_level or -1, k.fight_tracked or 0, k.opk or -1, k.hardcore or -1, k.xp_double or 0, k.xp_blessing or 0, k.xp_honor or 0)) end
local class_xp, race_xp, combo_xp = {}, {}, {} local area_data = {} for _, k in ipairs(kill_buffer) do local total_xp = k.xp + k.xp_rare + k.xp_bonus local g = (k.grouped or 0) == 1
if k.class and k.class ~= "" then if not class_xp[k.class] then class_xp[k.class] = {solo=0, group=0} end if g then class_xp[k.class].group = class_xp[k.class].group + total_xp else class_xp[k.class].solo = class_xp[k.class].solo + total_xp end end if k.race and k.race ~= "" then if not race_xp[k.race] then race_xp[k.race] = {solo=0, group=0} end if g then race_xp[k.race].group = race_xp[k.race].group + total_xp else race_xp[k.race].solo = race_xp[k.race].solo + total_xp end end if k.class and k.class ~= "" and k.race and k.race ~= "" then local combo = k.race .. "|" .. k.class if not combo_xp[combo] then combo_xp[combo] = {solo=0, group=0} end if g then combo_xp[combo].group = combo_xp[combo].group + total_xp else combo_xp[combo].solo = combo_xp[combo].solo + total_xp end end
if k.area and k.area ~= "" then local akey = k.area .. "|" .. (k.grouped or 0) if not area_data[akey] then area_data[akey] = {area = k.area, grouped = k.grouped or 0, xp = 0, kills = 0, times = {}} end local ad = area_data[akey] ad.xp = ad.xp + total_xp ad.kills = ad.kills + 1 table.insert(ad.times, k.time) end end
for cls, x in pairs(class_xp) do db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE class_stats SET solo_xp = solo_xp + %d, group_xp = group_xp + %d WHERE class = %s", x.solo, x.group, fixsql(cls))) end for race, x in pairs(race_xp) do db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE race_stats SET solo_xp = solo_xp + %d, group_xp = group_xp + %d WHERE race = %s", x.solo, x.group, fixsql(race))) end for combo, x in pairs(combo_xp) do db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE combo_stats SET solo_xp = solo_xp + %d, group_xp = group_xp + %d WHERE combo = %s", x.solo, x.group, fixsql(combo))) end
for _, ad in pairs(area_data) do table.sort(ad.times) local existing = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT last_kill_time FROM area_stats WHERE area = %s AND grouped = %d", fixsql(ad.area), ad.grouped)) local active_delta = 0 local prev_t = existing and existing.last_kill_time or 0 for _, t in ipairs(ad.times) do local gap = t - prev_t if prev_t > 0 and gap >= 0 and gap < 60 then active_delta = active_delta + gap else active_delta = active_delta + 3 end prev_t = t end local last_t = ad.times[#ad.times] if existing then db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE area_stats SET total_xp=total_xp+%d, total_kills=total_kills+%d, active_secs=active_secs+%s, last_kill_time=%d WHERE area=%s AND grouped=%d", ad.xp, ad.kills, tostring(active_delta), last_t, fixsql(ad.area), ad.grouped)) else db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO area_stats (area,grouped,total_xp,total_gold,total_kills,active_secs,levels,pups,last_kill_time) VALUES (%s,%d,%d,0,%d,%s,0,0,%d)", fixsql(ad.area), ad.grouped, ad.xp, ad.kills, tostring(active_delta), last_t)) end end
db_exec("COMMIT;") kill_buffer = {} end
local daily_totals_last_update = 0
-- ============================================================================= -- The day's wrap-up: when Aardwolf's day ends (midnight US Eastern), one line with -- what that day brought -- XP, QP, gold, TP, trains, levels, powerups, kills, -- quests, campaigns, GQs, bloot -- sent where cdt events wrapup says. Offline at -- midnight, it comes the next time the plugin runs, one line for each day since -- the last wrap-up that had something in it: the latest WRAPUP_MAX_LINES of the -- last WRAPUP_LOOKBACK_DAYS, oldest first, so a long break doesn't flood the screen. -- ============================================================================= WRAPUP_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 7 WRAPUP_MAX_LINES = 3
function WrapupLine(day_start, next_start) local label = "Aard day " .. os.date("!" .. DateFmt("%m/%d"), day_start + EasternOffsetHours(day_start) * 3600) local sc = {key = "range", clock = "aard", start = day_start, stop = next_start, label = label, line = label:lower()} local t = ScopeTotals(sc, REPORT_WANT.overview) local earned = (t.xp.total or 0) + (t.qp or 0) + (t.gold.total or 0) + (t.tp or 0) + (t.trains or 0) + (t.level.n or 0) + (t.pup.n or 0) + (t.xp.kills or 0) if earned == 0 then return nil end return BuildGainsReportLine("overview", sc, t, (ScopeActiveSecs(sc))) end
function CheckDayWrapup() local today = EasternPeriodStart("day", os.time()) local last = tonumber(state.wrapup_day) -- First run: there is no finished day this plugin has watched yet. if not last then state.wrapup_day = today return end if last >= today then return end state.wrapup_day = today state_save() if not EventOn("wrapup") then return end -- The kills of the last half minute are still in the buffer: save them first. FlushKillBuffer() if quest_pending then FinalizeQuestRecord() end -- Every day from the one in progress at the last check up to yesterday has now -- finished. Days are stepped by their own starts: US Eastern has 23 and 25 hour days. local d = math.max(last, EasternPeriodStart("day", today - WRAPUP_LOOKBACK_DAYS * 86400)) local lines = {} while d < today do local nxt = EasternPeriodStart("day", d + 30 * 3600) if nxt <= d then break end local line = WrapupLine(d, math.min(nxt, today)) if line then lines[#lines + 1] = line end d = nxt end for i = math.max(1, #lines - WRAPUP_MAX_LINES + 1), #lines do Report(EventChannel("wrapup"), lines[i]) end end
function OnDBFlush(name) GroupLogFlush() if double_log.file then double_log.file:flush() end GQCheckTimeout() FlushTakenBuffer() CheckDayWrapup() NoteWorthCredits() ExpireWorthCredits() SweepFights(false) FlushKillBuffer() if (state.player_totals.mobs_killed or 0) > 0 then SetPlayerTotal("mobs_killed", state.player_totals.mobs_killed) end local now = os.time() if now - daily_totals_last_update >= 300 then daily_totals_last_update = now UpdateDailyTotals() end end
-- ============================================================================= -- RATE CALCULATION -- ============================================================================= function CalculateXPRate(seconds) local now = Now() local cutoff = now - seconds local sum = 0 for i = #xp_events, 1, -1 do if xp_events[i].t < cutoff then break end sum = sum + xp_events[i].xp end local span = math.min(seconds, GetMonitorUptime()) if span < 5 then return 0 end return math.floor((sum / span) * 3600) end
function PruneXPEvents() local cutoff = Now() - xp_history_size local first_valid = nil for i = 1, #xp_events do if xp_events[i].t >= cutoff then first_valid = i break end end if not first_valid then xp_events = {} elseif first_valid > 1 then local new = {} for i = first_valid, #xp_events do new[#new + 1] = xp_events[i] end xp_events = new end end
local meter_cache = {} local meter_cache_time = 0 local METER_CACHE_TTL = 3 -- Stands in the cache for a metric with no value (a pup average over a window with -- no pups), so it isn't asked of the database again on every one-second tick. local METER_NO_VALUE = {}
function OnRateTick(name) PruneXPEvents() if config.xpmeter_active then local now = os.time() if now - meter_cache_time >= METER_CACHE_TTL then meter_cache_time = now meter_cache = {} end DrawMeterWindow() end end
-- ============================================================================= -- XP METER MINIWINDOW -- ============================================================================= function GetThemeColor(key, default_name) if theme_loaded and Theme and Theme[key] then return Theme[key] end return ColourNameToRGB(default_name) end
function FormatMeterTime(secs) secs = math.floor(tonumber(secs) or 0) if secs < 0 then secs = 0 end local h = math.floor(secs / 3600) local m = math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60) local s = secs % 60 if h > 0 then return string.format("%dh%02dm", h, m) elseif m > 0 then return string.format("%dm%02ds", m, s) else return string.format("%ds", s) end end
function FormatIntervalLabel(secs) if secs >= 3600 then return string.format("%dh", secs / 3600) else return string.format("%dm", secs / 60) end end
-- What the meter's session filter is called. The status screen had its own copy -- that only knew 0, -1 and -2, so Current Double read "Session -4". function MeterSessionLabel() if meter_session_id == 0 then return "All Data" end if meter_session_id == -1 then return "Current Session" end if meter_session_id == -2 then return "Current Tracking" end if meter_session_id == -4 then return "Current Double" end if meter_session_id == -3 then return meter_track_range and ("Track #" .. tostring(meter_track_range.track_id)) or "A saved track" end return "Session " .. tostring(meter_session_id) end
function MeterGetSessionId() if meter_session_id == -1 then return state.session.id or 0 end return meter_session_id end
