function MeterSessionFilter(prefix, time_col) time_col = time_col or "time" if meter_session_id == -2 then local t = state.tracked.active and state.tracked.start_time or 0 if t > 0 then return string.format(" %s %s >= %d", prefix, time_col, t) else return string.format(" %s 0", prefix) end end if meter_session_id == -4 then local t = state.tracked_auto.active and state.tracked_auto.start_time or 0 if t > 0 then return string.format(" %s %s >= %d", prefix, time_col, t) else return string.format(" %s 0", prefix) end end if meter_session_id == -3 and meter_track_range then local t1 = meter_track_range.start_time or 0 local t2 = meter_track_range.end_time or 0 if t1 > 0 and t2 > 0 then return string.format(" %s %s >= %d AND %s <= %d", prefix, time_col, t1, time_col, t2) elseif t1 > 0 then return string.format(" %s %s >= %d", prefix, time_col, t1) else return string.format(" %s 0", prefix) end end local sid = MeterGetSessionId() if sid > 0 then return string.format(" %s session_id = %d", prefix, sid) elseif meter_session_id == -1 then return string.format(" %s session_id = 0", prefix) end return "" end
function MeterMatchKill(k, cutoff) if k.time < cutoff then return false end if meter_session_id == 0 then return true end if meter_session_id == -2 then return state.tracked.active and k.time >= state.tracked.start_time end if meter_session_id == -4 then return state.tracked_auto.active and k.time >= state.tracked_auto.start_time end if meter_session_id == -3 and meter_track_range then local t1 = meter_track_range.start_time or 0 local t2 = meter_track_range.end_time or 0 if t1 > 0 then if t2 > 0 then return k.time >= t1 and k.time <= t2 else return k.time >= t1 end end return false end local sid = MeterGetSessionId() return sid == 0 or k.session_id == sid end
function MeterLookbackSum(source, window_secs) local cutoff = os.time() - window_secs if meter_session_id == -3 and meter_track_range then cutoff = meter_track_range.start_time or cutoff end local sf_time = MeterSessionFilter("AND", "time") local sf_end = MeterSessionFilter("AND", "end_time") if source == "xp" then local sum = 0 for _, k in ipairs(kill_buffer) do if MeterMatchKill(k, cutoff) then sum = sum + k.xp + k.xp_rare + k.xp_bonus end end if db then for row in db:nrows(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus), 0) AS s FROM kills WHERE time >= %d%s", cutoff, sf_time)) do sum = sum + row.s end end return sum elseif source == "gold" then if not db then return 0 end -- db_query_one reads to the end: a return from inside a db:nrows loop leaves the -- read open, and the connection then misses other writers and can't write itself. local r = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS s FROM gold_log WHERE time >= %d AND amount > 0%s", cutoff, sf_time)) return r and tonumber(r.s) or 0 elseif source == "kills" then local count = 0 for _, k in ipairs(kill_buffer) do if MeterMatchKill(k, cutoff) then count = count + 1 end end if db then for row in db:nrows(string.format( "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM kills WHERE time >= %d%s", cutoff, sf_time)) do count = count + row.c end end return count elseif source == "qp" then if not db then return 0 end local sum = 0 for row in db:nrows(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(totqp), 0) AS s FROM quests WHERE end_time >= %d AND failed = 0%s", cutoff, sf_end)) do sum = sum + row.s end for row in db:nrows(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qp), 0) AS s FROM campaigns WHERE end_time >= %d AND failed = 0%s", cutoff, sf_end)) do sum = sum + row.s end for row in db:nrows(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qp_mobs + qp_win), 0) AS s FROM gquests WHERE end_time >= %d%s", cutoff, sf_end)) do sum = sum + row.s end return sum elseif source == "pups" or source == "levels" then if not db then return 0 end local ltype = (source == "pups") and "pup" or "level" local r = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM levels WHERE type = '%s' AND end_time >= %d%s", ltype, cutoff, sf_end)) return r and tonumber(r.c) or 0 end return 0 end
function MeterLookbackAvgTime(source, window_secs) if not db then return nil end local cutoff = os.time() - window_secs if meter_session_id == -3 and meter_track_range then cutoff = meter_track_range.start_time or cutoff end local ltype = (source == "pups") and "pup" or "level" local sf = MeterSessionFilter("AND", "end_time") local r = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT AVG(duration) AS a, COUNT(*) AS c FROM levels WHERE type = '%s' AND end_time >= %d AND duration > 0%s", ltype, cutoff, sf)) if r and (tonumber(r.c) or 0) > 0 and r.a then return r.a end return nil end
function CalculateMeterValue(metric_key, window_secs) local cache_key = metric_key .. ":" .. window_secs local cached = meter_cache[cache_key] if cached == METER_NO_VALUE then return nil end if cached ~= nil then return cached end
local def = METER_METRICS[metric_key] if not def then return nil end
local result if def.type == "rate" then local sum = MeterLookbackSum(def.source, window_secs) local divisor = window_secs if meter_session_id == -3 and meter_track_range then local dur = (meter_track_range.end_time or 0) - (meter_track_range.start_time or 0) if dur > 0 then divisor = dur end end if divisor < 5 then result = 0 else result = (sum / divisor) * 60 end elseif def.type == "total" then result = MeterLookbackSum(def.source, window_secs) elseif def.type == "avg_time" then result = MeterLookbackAvgTime(def.source, window_secs) end
if result == nil then meter_cache[cache_key] = METER_NO_VALUE else meter_cache[cache_key] = result end return result end
function FormatMeterValue(metric_key, value) if value == nil then return "--" end local def = METER_METRICS[metric_key] if not def then return "--" end if def.type == "avg_time" then return FormatMeterTime(value) elseif def.type == "total" then return short_value(math.floor(value)) elseif value >= 1000 then return short_value(math.floor(value)) elseif value >= 100 then return tostring(math.floor(value)) elseif value >= 10 then return string.format("%.1f", value) else return string.format("%.2f", value) end end
function MeterMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id, win_name) if ok_bit and bit and bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) ~= 0 then MeterRightClickMenu() end end
function MeterBuildSessionMenu() local items = {} local check_all = (meter_session_id == 0) and "+" or "" items[#items + 1] = check_all .. "All Data" local check_cur = (meter_session_id == -1) and "+" or "" items[#items + 1] = check_cur .. "Current Session" local check_trk = (meter_session_id == -2) and "+" or "" items[#items + 1] = check_trk .. "Current Tracking" local check_dbl = (meter_session_id == -4) and "+" or "" items[#items + 1] = check_dbl .. "Current Double" if db then local has_tracks = false for row in db:nrows( "SELECT track_id, name, start_time FROM tracked_sessions WHERE end_time > 0 ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 10") do if not has_tracks then items[#items + 1] = "-" has_tracks = true end local label = ShowDate("%m/%d %H:%M", row.start_time) local is_sel = (meter_session_id == -3 and meter_track_range and meter_track_range.track_id == row.track_id) local check = is_sel and "+" or "" items[#items + 1] = check .. "Track " .. row.track_id .. ": " .. row.name:sub(1, 20) .. " (" .. label .. ")" end end return table.concat(items, "|") end
function MeterParseSessionChoice(choice) if choice == "All Data" then meter_session_id = 0 meter_track_range = nil elseif choice == "Current Session" then meter_session_id = -1 meter_track_range = nil elseif choice == "Current Tracking" then meter_session_id = -2 meter_track_range = nil elseif choice == "Current Double" then meter_session_id = -4 meter_track_range = nil else local tid = tonumber(string.match(choice, "^Track (%d+):")) if tid and db then local rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT track_id, start_time, end_time FROM tracked_sessions WHERE track_id = %d", tid)) if rows[1] then meter_session_id = -3 meter_track_range = {track_id = rows[1].track_id, start_time = rows[1].start_time, end_time = rows[1].end_time} end else local sid = tonumber(string.match(choice, "Session (%d+)")) if sid then meter_session_id = sid meter_track_range = nil end end end DrawMeterWindow() end
function MeterBuildMetricsMenu() local rows = (config.meter or {}).rows or {} local active = {} for _, rk in ipairs(rows) do active[rk] = true end
local items = {} local label_to_key = {} for gi, group in ipairs(METER_METRIC_ORDER) do if gi > 1 then items[#items + 1] = "-" end for _, key in ipairs(group.keys) do local def = METER_METRICS[key] if def then local check = active[key] and "+" or "" local label = def.label .. " (" .. key .. ")" items[#items + 1] = check .. label label_to_key[label] = key end end end return table.concat(items, "|"), label_to_key end
function MeterToggleMetric(key) if not config.meter then config.meter = {intervals = {300, 900, 3600}, show_intervals = {true, true, false}, rows = {"pup_avg", "xp_rate"}} end local rows = config.meter.rows or {} local found = false for i, rk in ipairs(rows) do if rk == key then table.remove(rows, i) found = true break end end if not found then rows[#rows + 1] = key end config.meter.rows = rows RecalcMeterSize() DrawMeterWindow() state_save() end
function MeterBuildIntervalsMenu() local m = config.meter or {} local intervals = m.intervals or {300, 900, 3600} local show = m.show_intervals or {true, true, false} local items = {} for i = 1, 3 do local secs = intervals[i] or 0 local label if secs >= 3600 then label = string.format("%dh", secs / 3600) else label = string.format("%dm", secs / 60) end local check = show[i] and "+" or "" items[#items + 1] = check .. "Slot " .. i .. ": " .. label end items[#items + 1] = "-" items[#items + 1] = "Set Slot 1 Value..." items[#items + 1] = "Set Slot 2 Value..." items[#items + 1] = "Set Slot 3 Value..." return table.concat(items, "|") end
function MeterParseIntervalChoice(choice) if not config.meter then config.meter = {intervals = {300, 900, 3600}, show_intervals = {true, true, false}, rows = {"pup_avg", "xp_rate"}} end local slot = tonumber(string.match(choice, "Slot (%d)")) if not slot then return false end
if string.find(choice, "Set Slot") then local current_mins = math.floor((config.meter.intervals[slot] or 0) / 60) local input = utils.inputbox( "Enter interval in minutes for slot " .. slot, "Meter Interval", tostring(current_mins)) if input then local mins = tonumber(input) if mins and mins > 0 then config.meter.intervals[slot] = math.floor(mins * 60) RecalcMeterSize() DrawMeterWindow() state_save() end end else config.meter.show_intervals[slot] = not config.meter.show_intervals[slot] RecalcMeterSize() DrawMeterWindow() state_save() end return true end
function MeterRightClickMenu() local session_sub = MeterBuildSessionMenu() local metrics_sub, metric_lookup = MeterBuildMetricsMenu() local intervals_sub = MeterBuildIntervalsMenu() local menu = "Change Font|>Session|" .. session_sub .. "|<|>Metrics|" .. metrics_sub .. "|<|>Intervals|" .. intervals_sub .. "|<|-|Bring to Front|Send to Back|-|Hide Meter" local result = WindowMenu(win, WindowInfo(win, 14), WindowInfo(win, 15), menu) if not result then return end if result == "Change Font" then local m = config.meter or {} local wanted = utils.fontpicker(m.font_name or "Verdana", m.font_size or 9) if wanted then if not config.meter then config.meter = {intervals = {300, 900, 3600}, show_intervals = {true, true, false}, rows = {"pup_avg", "xp_rate"}} end config.meter.font_name = wanted.name config.meter.font_size = wanted.size config.meter.font_bold = wanted.bold ReloadMeterFont() DrawMeterWindow() state_save() end elseif result == "Bring to Front" then CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f", "boostMe", win) elseif result == "Send to Back" then CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f", "dropMe", win) elseif result == "Hide Meter" then CmdMeter(nil, nil, {" off"}) elseif metric_lookup[result] then MeterToggleMetric(metric_lookup[result]) elseif not MeterParseIntervalChoice(result) then MeterParseSessionChoice(result) end end
function ReloadMeterFont() local m = config.meter or {} WindowFont(win, font, m.font_name or "Verdana", m.font_size or 9, m.font_bold or 0, false, false, false, 0) RecalcMeterSize() end
function RecalcMeterSize() local m = config.meter or {} local intervals = m.intervals or {300, 900, 3600} local show = m.show_intervals or {true, true, false} local rows = SortMetricRows(m.rows or {"pup_avg", "xp_rate"})
local active_intervals = {} for i, iv in ipairs(intervals) do if show[i] then active_intervals[#active_intervals + 1] = iv end end
local line_h = WindowFontInfo(win, font, 1) if not line_h or line_h < 5 then line_h = 13 end local pad = 4 local row_h = line_h + 2
local lw = 0 for _, rk in ipairs(rows) do local def = METER_METRICS[rk] if def then local w = WindowTextWidth(win, font, def.label) if w > lw then lw = w end end end meter_label_w = lw + pad
local samples = {"99.9m", "999.9k", "99h59m", "59m59s", "--", "999"} local cw = 0 for _, iv in ipairs(active_intervals) do local hw = WindowTextWidth(win, font, FormatIntervalLabel(iv)) if hw > cw then cw = hw end end for _, s in ipairs(samples) do local sw = WindowTextWidth(win, font, s) if sw > cw then cw = sw end end meter_col_w = cw + pad * 2
meter_fixed_w = meter_label_w + meter_col_w * #active_intervals + pad meter_fixed_h = row_h * (#rows + 1) + pad
if meter_fixed_w < 10 then meter_fixed_w = 10 end if meter_fixed_h < 10 then meter_fixed_h = 10 end
WindowResize(win, meter_fixed_w, meter_fixed_h, GetThemeColor("PRIMARY_BODY", "black")) end
-- Brings a meter above other miniwindows. Only when you turn it on: raising it on -- every redraw made the two meters swap places each tick and blink when they overlap. function BoostMeterWindow(w) if IsPluginInstalled("462b665ecb569efbf261422f") then CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f", "boostMe", w) end end
function InitMeterWindow() local bg = GetThemeColor("PRIMARY_BODY", "black")
local windowinfo = movewindow.install(win, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location, false, nil, {mouseup=MeterMouseUp}) WindowCreate(win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, 10, 10, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, bg) local m = config.meter or {} WindowFont(win, font, m.font_name or "Verdana", m.font_size or 9, m.font_bold or 0, false, false, false, 0)
RecalcMeterSize() movewindow.add_drag_handler(win, 0, 0, 0, 0)
if IsPluginInstalled("462b665ecb569efbf261422f") then CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f", "registerMiniwindow", win) end
if config.xpmeter_active then WindowShow(win, true) EnableTimer("cdt_rate_tick", true) DrawMeterWindow() else WindowShow(win, false) end end
function SortMetricRows(rows) local active = {} for _, rk in ipairs(rows) do active[rk] = true end local sorted = {} for _, group in ipairs(METER_METRIC_ORDER) do for _, key in ipairs(group.keys) do if active[key] then sorted[#sorted + 1] = key end end end return sorted end
function DrawMeterWindow() local m = config.meter or {} local intervals = m.intervals or {300, 900, 3600} local show = m.show_intervals or {true, true, false} local rows = SortMetricRows(m.rows or {"pup_avg", "xp_rate"})
local active_intervals = {} for i, iv in ipairs(intervals) do if show[i] then active_intervals[#active_intervals + 1] = iv end end if #active_intervals == 0 or #rows == 0 then return end
local line_h = WindowFontInfo(win, font, 1) if not line_h or line_h < 5 then line_h = 13 end local pad = 4 local row_h = line_h + 2 local label_w = meter_label_w local col_w = meter_col_w
local bg = GetThemeColor("PRIMARY_BODY", "black") local border = GetThemeColor("BORDER", "gray") local col_label = ColourNameToRGB("silver") local col_header = ColourNameToRGB("dimgray") local col_value = ColourNameToRGB("white") local col_dim = ColourNameToRGB("gray")
WindowRectOp(win, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, bg)
local y = pad / 2 local x = label_w for ci, iv in ipairs(active_intervals) do local lbl = FormatIntervalLabel(iv) local lw = WindowTextWidth(win, font, lbl) WindowText(win, font, lbl, x + (col_w - lw) / 2, y, 0, 0, col_header) x = x + col_w end
for ri, rk in ipairs(rows) do y = pad / 2 + row_h * ri local def = METER_METRICS[rk] if def then WindowText(win, font, def.label, pad / 2, y, 0, 0, col_label) x = label_w for ci, iv in ipairs(active_intervals) do local val = CalculateMeterValue(rk, iv) local txt = FormatMeterValue(rk, val) local tw = WindowTextWidth(win, font, txt) local col = val == nil and col_dim or col_value WindowText(win, font, txt, x + (col_w - tw) / 2, y, 0, 0, col) x = x + col_w end end end
if theme_loaded and Theme and Theme.DrawBorder then Theme.DrawBorder(win) else WindowRectOp(win, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, border) end
CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "BufferedRepaint") end
-- ============================================================================= -- DAMAGE METER MINIWINDOW -- ============================================================================= local dmg_win = "win_cdt_dmg_" .. GetPluginID() local dmg_font = "font_cdt_dmg_" .. GetPluginID() local dmg_meter = { active = false, tab = "group", sort = "dps", detail_player = nil, detail_sort = "dmg", minimalist = false, heal_est = false, -- Healing tab: include estimated heals on others scroll_group = 0, scroll_detail = 0, tracking = false, stopped = false, start_time = 0, stop_time = 0, dirty = true, draw_pending = false, last_draw = 0, w = 280, h = 200, min_w = 220, min_h = 120, data = {}, self_data = nil, baseline = nil, endpoint = nil, group_baseline = {}, group_endpoint = {}, }
local DMG_DRAW_THROTTLE = 0.5
-- DPS over a one- or two-second sample is not a rate, it is a single burst with -- a small number under it, and it outranks everyone who has been fighting -- honestly. Below this many seconds of combat a row has no DPS at all: nil, -- which formats as "--", sorts last, and draws no bar. local DMG_MIN_DPS_SECS = 5
function MeterDps(damage, csecs) csecs = tonumber(csecs) or 0 if csecs < DMG_MIN_DPS_SECS then return nil end return (damage or 0) / csecs end
function MeterDpsStr(dps) if not dps then return "--" end return comma_value(math.floor(dps)) end
-- Average damage per hit, from true hit counts only. Aardwolf groups identical -- hits onto one line ("[4] Your anguish ... [14386]" is four hits), so dividing -- by the LINE count would overstate this roughly fourfold. Rows recorded before -- hit counts were captured have phits = 0 and get "-" rather than a wrong number. function MeterAvgHit(entry) local ph = entry and entry.phits or 0 if ph <= 0 then return nil end return (entry.pdmg or 0) / ph end
function MeterAvgHitStr(entry) local a = MeterAvgHit(entry) if not a then return "-" end return comma_value(math.floor(a)) end
function OnDmgMeterTick(name) if dmg_meter.active and dmg_meter.tracking then dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end end
local DMG_SORT_MODES = {"dps", "dmg", "crit", "heal"} -- A raw hit count says little on its own, so the meter does not offer it. -- Average damage per hit is the useful form, and only in the detail tab: -- comparing your own damage sources against each other is meaningful, whereas -- comparing a warrior's swing to a mage's cast across the group is not. local DMG_SORT_LABELS = {dps = "DPS", dmg = "Total Dmg", crit = "Crit%", heal = "Healing"} local DMG_DETAIL_SORTS = {"dmg", "dps", "avg", "crit", "heal"} local DMG_DETAIL_LABELS = {dmg = "by Damage", dps = "by DPS", crit = "by Crit%", avg = "by Avg/Hit", heal = "by Healing"}
local DMG_BAR_COLORS = { ColourNameToRGB("royalblue"), 0x2d8a5a, 0x8a5a2d, 0x8a2d5a, 0x2d8a7a, 0x5a2d8a, 0x8a8a2d, 0x2d5a8a, }
function DmgMeterSnapshotSelf() local sd = state.session.dmg -- GetOrStartCombat adds the same gap to BOTH state.session.dmg.combat_secs -- and current_combat.combat_secs, so the session figure is already complete. -- Adding current_combat on top double-counted the live combat, and because -- current_combat is zeroed after 60s idle while damage never is, the -- snapshot's clock could run backwards: a baseline taken mid-fight carried a -- stale offset that pinned DPS at 0 until it was repaid, then released it as -- a spike of a minute's damage over a few seconds. Time must be as monotonic -- as the damage it divides. local csecs = sd.combat_secs -- phits/pdmg must be carried through: the meter diffs these snapshots, so -- anything dropped here is invisible to it no matter what capture records. local atk_snap = {} if sd.attacks then for name, a in pairs(sd.attacks) do atk_snap[name] = {dmg = a.dmg, hits = a.hits, crits = a.crits, phits = a.phits or 0, pdmg = a.pdmg or 0} end end local heal_snap = {} for key, h in pairs(state.session.heals or {}) do local spells = {} for sp, v in pairs(h.spells or {}) do spells[sp] = {amount = v.amount or 0, casts = v.casts or 0} end heal_snap[key] = {name = h.name, amount = h.amount or 0, casts = h.casts or 0, spells = spells} end local given_snap = {} for key, h in pairs(state.session.heals_given or {}) do given_snap[key] = {name = h.name, amount = h.amount or 0, casts = h.casts or 0} end local gheal_snap = {} for key, h in pairs(state.session.group_heals or {}) do gheal_snap[key] = {name = h.name, casts = h.casts or 0, scroll_heals = h.scroll_heals or 0, scroll_hp = h.scroll_hp or 0, regen_casts = h.regen_casts or 0, regen_hp = h.regen_hp or 0} end return { heals = heal_snap, heals_given = given_snap, group_heals = gheal_snap, damage_dealt = sd.damage_dealt, damage_received = sd.damage_received, combat_secs = csecs, hits = sd.hits, misses = sd.misses, crits = sd.crits, phits = sd.phits or 0, dodges_by_mob = sd.dodges_by_mob, dodges_by_me = sd.dodges_by_me, attacks = atk_snap, } end
function DmgMeterSnapshotGroup() local snap = {} for pname, sg in pairs(state.session.group_dmg) do local atk_snap = {} if sg.attacks then for name, a in pairs(sg.attacks) do atk_snap[name] = {dmg = a.dmg, hits = a.hits, crits = a.crits, phits = a.phits or 0, pdmg = a.pdmg or 0} end end snap[pname] = {damage = sg.damage, hits = sg.hits, crits = sg.crits, phits = sg.phits or 0, combat_secs = sg.combat_secs, attacks = atk_snap} end return snap end
function DmgMeterStartTracking() dmg_meter.tracking = true dmg_meter.stopped = false dmg_meter.start_time = os.time() dmg_meter.stop_time = 0 dmg_meter.baseline = DmgMeterSnapshotSelf() dmg_meter.group_baseline = DmgMeterSnapshotGroup() dmg_meter.endpoint = nil dmg_meter.group_endpoint = {} dmg_meter.area = state.current.area or "" EnableTimer("cdt_dmg_tick", dmg_meter.active) end
-- cdt dmg meter auto [on|off]: start counting by itself when play begins, after a -- reload, a restart or a reconnect. Saved with the meter's settings. function DmgMeterAutoCmd(arg) config.dmg_meter = config.dmg_meter or {} local dm = config.dmg_meter if arg == "on" then dm.auto = true elseif arg == "off" then dm.auto = false elseif arg == "" then dm.auto = not dm.auto else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt dmg meter auto [on|off]") return end ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Damage meter auto-start " .. (dm.auto and "on" or "off") .. (dm.auto and ": it starts counting when you log in or reload." or ".")) -- Turned on mid-session with the meter idle: start now rather than at next login. if dm.auto and game_session_started and not dmg_meter.tracking and not dmg_meter.stopped then DmgMeterAutoStart() end end
-- A fresh start only: a meter already counting, or one you paused, is left alone. function DmgMeterAutoStart() local dm = config.dmg_meter or {} if not dm.auto or dmg_meter.tracking or dmg_meter.stopped then return end DmgMeterStartTracking() dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Damage meter tracking started (auto).") end
-- Crossing a zone boundary rebaselines the meter so rates stay attributable to -- one area. That silently discarded the running window, which reads as the -- meter breaking, so say so -- but only when something was actually thrown -- away, or walking a corridor of empty rooms would be pure noise. function DmgMeterOnAreaChange(new_area) if not dmg_meter.tracking or dmg_meter.stopped then return end
local snap = DmgMeterSnapshotSelf() local base = dmg_meter.baseline or {} local gbase = dmg_meter.group_baseline or {} local had = ((snap.damage_dealt or 0) - (base.damage_dealt or 0)) > 0 if not had then for pname, sg in pairs(state.session.group_dmg) do local gb = gbase[pname] or {} if ((sg.damage or 0) - (gb.damage or 0)) > 0 then had = true break end end end local secs = os.time() - (dmg_meter.start_time or os.time())
dmg_meter.baseline = snap dmg_meter.group_baseline = DmgMeterSnapshotGroup() dmg_meter.start_time = os.time() dmg_meter.area = new_area or "" dmg_meter.dirty = true
if had then ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format( "[CDT] Area changed to %s - damage meter auto-reset, still tracking (%s of data discarded).", (new_area and new_area ~= "") and new_area or "?", FormatMeterTime(secs))) else DebugNote("[CDT] Area changed to " .. (new_area or "?") .. " - meter rebaselined (nothing to discard)") end if dmg_meter.active then DmgMeterDoDraw() end end
function DmgMeterCollectData() local data = {} local self_name = state.current.name or "You"
if not dmg_meter.tracking and not dmg_meter.stopped then dmg_meter.data = data return end
local cur = dmg_meter.stopped and dmg_meter.endpoint or DmgMeterSnapshotSelf() local base = dmg_meter.baseline or {}
local dealt = (cur.damage_dealt or 0) - (base.damage_dealt or 0) local csecs = (cur.combat_secs or 0) - (base.combat_secs or 0) local hits = (cur.hits or 0) - (base.hits or 0) local crits = (cur.crits or 0) - (base.crits or 0) if dealt < 0 then dealt = 0 end if csecs < 0 then csecs = 0 end if hits < 0 then hits = 0 end
local self_dps = MeterDps(dealt, csecs) local self_crit_pct = hits > 0 and (crits / hits) * 100 or 0 -- Damage taken, per minute of your own combat time. Same snapshot diff and the -- same no-invented-denominator rule as DPS: under DMG_MIN_DPS_SECS it is unknown. local received = (cur.damage_received or 0) - (base.damage_received or 0) if received < 0 then received = 0 end local received_pm = csecs >= DMG_MIN_DPS_SECS and received / csecs * 60 or nil
local self_attacks = {} local cur_atks = cur.attacks or {} local base_atks = base.attacks or {} local self_phits, self_pdmg = 0, 0 for atk_name, ca in pairs(cur_atks) do -- The group's combined attack comes as a "Your ..." line, but it is the whole -- group's: it is already left out of your damage and DPS (epic), so it stays -- out of your attacks too, where it showed as yours and skewed every share. local _, cat = LookupDamtype(atk_name) if cat == "epic" then goto next_attack end local ba = base_atks[atk_name] or {dmg = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, phits = 0, pdmg = 0} local d = (ca.dmg or 0) - (ba.dmg or 0) local h = (ca.hits or 0) - (ba.hits or 0) local c = (ca.crits or 0) - (ba.crits or 0) local ph = (ca.phits or 0) - (ba.phits or 0) local pdm = (ca.pdmg or 0) - (ba.pdmg or 0) if d > 0 or h > 0 then ph = ph > 0 and ph or 0 self_attacks[atk_name] = {dmg = d, hits = h, crits = c, phits = ph, pdmg = pdm > 0 and pdm or 0} self_phits = self_phits + ph self_pdmg = self_pdmg + (pdm > 0 and pdm or 0) end ::next_attack:: end
-- Heals since the meter started, per healer: amount, casts, and by spell. local cur_h, base_h = cur.heals or {}, base.heals or {} -- Either side can lack a healer: a new session starts the counts from empty and -- moves the baseline below zero by what came before, so both are looked at. local function heal_since(key) local c, b = cur_h[key] or {}, base_h[key] or {} local spells, seen = {}, {} local function add(sp) if seen[sp] then return end seen[sp] = true local v, bv = (c.spells or {})[sp] or {}, (b.spells or {})[sp] or {} local a, k = (v.amount or 0) - (bv.amount or 0), (v.casts or 0) - (bv.casts or 0) if a > 0 then spells[#spells + 1] = {name = sp, heal = a, casts = k} end end for sp in pairs(c.spells or {}) do add(sp) end for sp in pairs(b.spells or {}) do add(sp) end local amount = (c.amount or 0) - (b.amount or 0) return amount > 0 and amount or 0, math.max(0, (c.casts or 0) - (b.casts or 0)), spells end local self_heal, self_heal_casts, self_heal_spells = heal_since("@self") local have -- Your heals on others since Start, by target (both sides looked at, as above). local cur_g, base_g = cur.heals_given or {}, base.heals_given or {} local given, given_total, given_casts, seen_g = {}, 0, 0, {} local function add_given(key) if seen_g[key] then return end seen_g[key] = true local c, b = cur_g[key] or {}, base_g[key] or {} local a, k = (c.amount or 0) - (b.amount or 0), math.max(0, (c.casts or 0) - (b.casts or 0)) if a > 0 then given[#given + 1] = {name = c.name or b.name or key, heal = a, casts = k} given_total, given_casts = given_total + a, given_casts + k end end for key in pairs(cur_g) do add_given(key) end for key in pairs(base_g) do add_given(key) end
local self_entry = { name = self_name, is_self = true, heal = self_heal, heal_casts = self_heal_casts, heal_spells = self_heal_spells, heals_given = given, given_total = given_total, given_casts = given_casts, damage = dealt, dps = self_dps, hits = hits, phits = self_phits, pdmg = self_pdmg, crits = crits, crit_pct = self_crit_pct, combat_secs = csecs, received = received, received_pm = received_pm, attacks = self_attacks, } data[#data + 1] = self_entry dmg_meter.self_data = self_entry
local g_cur = dmg_meter.stopped and dmg_meter.group_endpoint or state.session.group_dmg local g_base = dmg_meter.group_baseline or {}
-- A new session empties the counters and moves the baseline below zero, so a -- groupmate can be in the baseline alone until they hit again: list both. local members = {} for pname in pairs(g_base) do members[pname] = true end for pname in pairs(g_cur) do members[pname] = true end for pname in pairs(members) do local sg = g_cur[pname] or {} if not IsGroupMemberHere(pname) then goto continue end local gb = g_base[pname] or {} local p_dmg = (sg.damage or 0) - (gb.damage or 0) local p_hits = (sg.hits or 0) - (gb.hits or 0) local p_crits = (sg.crits or 0) - (gb.crits or 0) local p_csecs = (sg.combat_secs or 0) - (gb.combat_secs or 0) if p_hits < 0 then p_hits = 0 end if p_crits < 0 then p_crits = 0 end if p_dmg <= 0 then goto continue end -- No invented denominator here. Clamping this to 1 gave a groupmate's -- whole burst a one-second divisor while self, which has no such clamp, -- read 0 -- so the meter ranked everyone else 10-100x above the player. if p_csecs < 0 then p_csecs = 0 end local p_dps = MeterDps(p_dmg, p_csecs) local p_crit_pct = p_hits > 0 and (p_crits / p_hits) * 100 or 0
local p_attacks = {} local p_phits, p_pdmg = 0, 0 local sg_atks = sg.attacks or {} local gb_atks = gb.attacks or {} for atk_name, ca in pairs(sg_atks) do local ba = gb_atks[atk_name] or {dmg = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, phits = 0, pdmg = 0} local d = (ca.dmg or 0) - (ba.dmg or 0) local h = (ca.hits or 0) - (ba.hits or 0) local c = (ca.crits or 0) - (ba.crits or 0) local ph = (ca.phits or 0) - (ba.phits or 0) local pdm = (ca.pdmg or 0) - (ba.pdmg or 0) if d > 0 or h > 0 then ph = ph > 0 and ph or 0 p_attacks[atk_name] = {dmg = d, hits = h, crits = c, phits = ph, pdmg = pdm > 0 and pdm or 0} p_phits = p_phits + ph p_pdmg = p_pdmg + (pdm > 0 and pdm or 0) end end
local p_heal, p_heal_casts, p_heal_spells = heal_since(pname:lower()) data[#data + 1] = { name = pname, is_self = false, heal = p_heal, heal_casts = p_heal_casts, heal_spells = p_heal_spells, damage = p_dmg, dps = p_dps, hits = p_hits, phits = p_phits, pdmg = p_pdmg, crits = p_crits, crit_pct = p_crit_pct, combat_secs = p_csecs, attacks = p_attacks, } ::continue:: end
-- A groupmate who healed you but dealt no damage still has a row, for the -- Healing category (DmgMeterSortData keeps it out of the damage ones). have = {} for _, e in ipairs(data) do if not e.is_self then have[e.name:lower()] = true end end local healers = {} for key, h in pairs(base_h) do healers[key] = h.name or healers[key] or key end for key, h in pairs(cur_h) do healers[key] = h.name or healers[key] or key end for key, hname in pairs(healers) do local h = {name = hname} if key ~= "@self" and not have[key] and IsGroupMemberHere(h.name or key) then local amt, casts, spells = heal_since(key) if amt > 0 then data[#data + 1] = {name = h.name or key, is_self = false, heal = amt, heal_casts = casts, heal_spells = spells, damage = 0, dps = nil, hits = 0, phits = 0, pdmg = 0, crits = 0, crit_pct = 0, combat_secs = 0, attacks = {}} end end end
-- Groupmates' heals that don't land on you (estimated casts, scrolls), since Start. local cur_gh, base_gh = cur.group_heals or {}, base.group_heals or {} local function gheal_since(key) local c, b = cur_gh[key] or {}, base_gh[key] or {} local function d(f) return math.max(0, (c[f] or 0) - (b[f] or 0)) end return d("casts"), d("scroll_heals"), d("scroll_hp"), c.name or b.name, d("regen_casts"), d("regen_hp") end have = {} for _, e in ipairs(data) do if not e.is_self then have[e.name:lower()] = true end end local ghealers = {} for key in pairs(base_gh) do ghealers[key] = true end for key in pairs(cur_gh) do ghealers[key] = true end for key in pairs(ghealers) do local casts, sh, _, gname, rc = gheal_since(key) if not have[key] and (casts > 0 or sh > 0 or rc > 0) and IsGroupMemberHere(gname or key) then data[#data + 1] = {name = gname or key, is_self = false, heal = 0, heal_casts = 0, heal_spells = {}, damage = 0, dps = nil, hits = 0, phits = 0, pdmg = 0, crits = 0, crit_pct = 0, combat_secs = 0, attacks = {}} end end for _, e in ipairs(data) do if not e.is_self then local casts, sh, shp, _, rc, rhp = gheal_since(e.name:lower()) local on_you = 0 for _, sp in ipairs(e.heal_spells or {}) do if sp.name == "incomplete healing" then on_you = sp.casts or 0 end end e.casts_est, e.scroll_heals, e.scroll_hp = casts, sh, shp e.regen_casts, e.regen_hp = rc, rhp e.others_est = math.max(0, casts - on_you) e.others_hp_est = e.others_est * HealerSize(e.name) end end
dmg_meter.data = data end
-- Shares DmgMeterSortVal with the detail view and the bar-fill calculation, so -- the ordering and the bar lengths can never disagree about a row's value. function DmgMeterSortData(entries, sort_key, exact) local sorted = {} for _, e in ipairs(entries) do -- Healing lists who healed (you, or with estimates on, anyone); the damage -- categories, who dealt damage. local keep if sort_key == "heal" then keep = DmgMeterHealVal(e, exact) > 0 else keep = e.is_self or (e.damage or 0) > 0 end if keep then sorted[#sorted + 1] = e end end table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return DmgMeterSortVal(sort_key, a, exact) > DmgMeterSortVal(sort_key, b, exact) end) return sorted end
function DmgMeterSortAttacks(attacks, sort_key, combat_secs) -- Per-attack combat time is not tracked, so the player's own combat seconds -- is the denominator: this attack's contribution to their DPS. Without it, -- dps was previously set to raw damage, making "by DPS" identical to -- "by Damage" and displaying a damage total under a DPS heading. local csecs = tonumber(combat_secs) or 0 local sorted = {} for name, atk in pairs(attacks) do sorted[#sorted + 1] = { name = name, dmg = atk.dmg, hits = atk.hits, crits = atk.crits, dps = MeterDps(atk.dmg or 0, csecs), crit_pct = atk.hits > 0 and (atk.crits / atk.hits) * 100 or 0, phits = atk.phits or 0, pdmg = atk.pdmg or 0, } end table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return DmgMeterSortVal(sort_key, a) > DmgMeterSortVal(sort_key, b) end) return sorted end
function DmgMeterCollapseMinor(sorted_atks) local total_dmg = 0 for _, a in ipairs(sorted_atks) do total_dmg = total_dmg + a.dmg end if total_dmg <= 0 then return sorted_atks end local threshold = total_dmg * 0.01 local major = {} -- dps stays absent unless a component actually had one: every attack here -- shares the player's combat_secs, so they are all nil or all numbers. local other = {name = "other", dmg = 0, hits = 0, crits = 0, crit_pct = 0, phits = 0, pdmg = 0} local count = 0 for _, a in ipairs(sorted_atks) do if a.dmg >= threshold then major[#major + 1] = a else other.dmg = other.dmg + a.dmg other.hits = other.hits + a.hits other.crits = other.crits + a.crits if a.dps then other.dps = (other.dps or 0) + a.dps end other.phits = other.phits + (a.phits or 0) other.pdmg = other.pdmg + (a.pdmg or 0) count = count + 1 end end if count > 0 then other.crit_pct = other.hits > 0 and (other.crits / other.hits) * 100 or 0 major[#major + 1] = other end return major end
function DmgMeterQueueDraw() if not dmg_meter.active then return end if not dmg_meter.tracking then return end dmg_meter.dirty = true if dmg_meter.draw_pending then return end local now = os.clock() local elapsed = now - dmg_meter.last_draw if elapsed >= DMG_DRAW_THROTTLE then DmgMeterDoDraw() else dmg_meter.draw_pending = true DoAfterSpecial(DMG_DRAW_THROTTLE, "DmgMeterDoDraw()", 12) end end
function DmgMeterDoDraw() dmg_meter.draw_pending = false dmg_meter.last_draw = os.clock() if not dmg_meter.active then return end if not dmg_meter.dirty then return end dmg_meter.dirty = false DmgMeterCollectData() DrawDmgMeter() end
function DmgMeterFormatVal(sort_key, entry) if sort_key == "dps" then return MeterDpsStr(entry.dps) elseif sort_key == "dmg" then return short_value(math.floor(entry.damage or 0)) elseif sort_key == "crit" then return string.format("%.1f%%", entry.crit_pct or 0) elseif sort_key == "heal" then return (DmgMeterHealIsEstimate(entry) and "~" or "") .. short_value(math.floor(DmgMeterHealVal(entry))) end return "0" end
function DmgMeterFormatAtkVal(sort_key, atk) if sort_key == "dmg" then return short_value(math.floor(atk.dmg or 0)) elseif sort_key == "dps" then return MeterDpsStr(atk.dps) elseif sort_key == "crit" then return string.format("%.1f%%", atk.crit_pct or 0) elseif sort_key == "avg" then return MeterAvgHitStr(atk) elseif sort_key == "heal" then return (atk.est and "~" or "") .. short_value(math.floor(atk.heal or 0)) .. " (" .. comma_value(atk.casts or 0) .. ")" end return "0" end
-- Sort modes persist across sessions, so one removed in an update can still be -- stored. Anything not in the current list falls back to the first entry. function DmgMeterValidSort(cur, list) for _, k in ipairs(list) do if k == cur then return cur end end return list[1] end
-- A row's Healing: their heals on you (yours on yourself, on your row). With -- "Healing: Include Estimates" on, also their heals on others: a groupmate's estimated -- casts on others times their heal size, plus scrolls read on others; yours on others, -- which are exact. mode: true for heals on you only (report healedme), "est" for the -- estimates included (customreport healedall), nil to follow the meter's option. function DmgMeterHealEst(mode) if mode == "est" then return true end if mode then return false end return dmg_meter.heal_est end
function DmgMeterHealVal(entry, mode) local v = entry.heal or 0 if not DmgMeterHealEst(mode) or entry.is_self == nil then return v end if entry.is_self then return v + (entry.given_total or 0) end return v + (entry.others_hp_est or 0) + (entry.scroll_hp or 0) + (entry.regen_hp or 0) end
-- Does this row's Healing include an estimate (shown with ~)? function DmgMeterHealIsEstimate(entry, mode) return DmgMeterHealEst(mode) and entry.is_self == false and ((entry.others_hp_est or 0) > 0 or (entry.regen_hp or 0) > 0 or (entry.scroll_hp or 0) > 0) end
-- A groupmate's heals that didn't land on you since the meter started, by target: -- the target guessed for each cast seen in their mana (the biggest hp jump in their -- room), and each scroll line's own target. {[target lowercased] = {casts, scroll_heals, -- scroll_hp}}; "" for casts with no guess. Kept until their counts change, as the -- window asks on every draw. local heal_target_cache = {} function DmgMeterHealTargets(player) local key = (player.name or ""):lower() local stamp = table.concat({dmg_meter.start_time or 0, player.casts_est or 0, player.scroll_heals or 0, player.regen_casts or 0, dmg_meter.stopped and dmg_meter.stop_time or 0}, ":") local c = heal_target_cache[key] if c and c.stamp == stamp then return c.targets end local targets = {} if db and DbTableExists("main", "group_heals") and (dmg_meter.start_time or 0) > 0 then local to = (dmg_meter.stopped and (dmg_meter.stop_time or 0) > 0) and dmg_meter.stop_time or os.time() for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format("SELECT LOWER(target) AS target, source, spell, SUM(heals) AS heals, " .. "SUM(amount) AS amount FROM group_heals WHERE healer = %s COLLATE NOCASE AND time >= %d AND time <= %d " .. "GROUP BY LOWER(target), source, spell", fixsql(player.name or ""), dmg_meter.start_time, to))) do local t = targets[r.target or ""] or {casts = 0, scroll_heals = 0, scroll_hp = 0, regen_casts = 0, regen_hp = 0} targets[r.target or ""] = t if r.source == "cast" and r.spell == "regeneration" then t.regen_casts = t.regen_casts + (tonumber(r.heals) or 0) t.regen_hp = t.regen_hp + (tonumber(r.amount) or 0) elseif r.source == "cast" then t.casts = t.casts + (tonumber(r.heals) or 0) else t.scroll_heals = t.scroll_heals + (tonumber(r.heals) or 0) t.scroll_hp = t.scroll_hp + (tonumber(r.amount) or 0) end end end heal_target_cache[key] = {stamp = stamp, targets = targets} return targets end
-- Who a player's heals landed on. Each part is {hp, casts, est}, est when it holds -- casts seen only in the healer's mana (times their heal size): -- self - on themselves (on your row, yours on yourself) -- leader - on the group's leader (group_leader), when that's neither them nor you -- you - on you, exact from your heal lines (a groupmate's row only) -- others - on anyone else -- A groupmate's casts are split by the target guessed for each; any difference from -- the meter's own count goes to others (or comes off others first), so the parts add -- up to their Healing with estimates. function DmgMeterHealSplit(player) local function part() return {hp = 0, casts = 0, est = false, c = 0, sc = 0, shp = 0, rc = 0, rhp = 0} end local s = {self = part(), leader = part(), you = part(), others = part()} local me = (state.current.name or ""):lower() local lead = (group_leader or ""):lower() local pname = (player.name or ""):lower() if player.is_self then s.self.hp, s.self.casts = player.heal or 0, player.heal_casts or 0 for _, h in ipairs(player.heals_given or {}) do local p = (lead ~= "" and lead ~= me and (h.name or ""):lower() == lead) and s.leader or s.others p.hp, p.casts = p.hp + (h.heal or 0), p.casts + (h.casts or 0) end return s end s.you.hp, s.you.casts = player.heal or 0, player.heal_casts or 0 local function bucket(target) if target == pname then return s.self end if target ~= "" and target == lead and lead ~= me then return s.leader end return s.others end local got_c, got_sc, got_shp, got_rc, got_rhp = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 for target, t in pairs(DmgMeterHealTargets(player)) do if target ~= me then -- yours are counted exactly, from your heal lines local p = bucket(target) p.c, p.sc, p.shp = p.c + t.casts, p.sc + t.scroll_heals, p.shp + t.scroll_hp p.rc, p.rhp = p.rc + t.regen_casts, p.rhp + t.regen_hp got_c, got_sc, got_shp = got_c + t.casts, got_sc + t.scroll_heals, got_shp + t.scroll_hp got_rc, got_rhp = got_rc + t.regen_casts, got_rhp + t.regen_hp end end -- Square the guesses with the meter's counts: the extra casts go to others; too -- many come off others, then the leader, then self. local diff = (player.others_est or 0) - got_c for _, p in ipairs({s.others, s.leader, s.self}) do if diff >= 0 then p.c = p.c + diff break end local take = math.min(p.c, -diff) p.c, diff = p.c - take, diff + take end s.others.sc = math.max(0, s.others.sc + (player.scroll_heals or 0) - got_sc) s.others.shp = math.max(0, s.others.shp + (player.scroll_hp or 0) - got_shp) s.others.rc = math.max(0, s.others.rc + (player.regen_casts or 0) - got_rc) s.others.rhp = math.max(0, s.others.rhp + (player.regen_hp or 0) - got_rhp) local size = HealerSize(player.name) for _, p in ipairs({s.self, s.leader, s.others}) do p.hp, p.casts, p.est = p.c * size + p.shp + p.rhp, p.c + p.sc + p.rc, p.c > 0 or p.rc > 0 or p.sc > 0 end return s end
-- The detail view's rows by Healing, biggest first, empty ones left out. A groupmate: -- on self, on leader, on others - you (on leader - you when you lead), on others - -- not you. Your row: on self, on leader, on others. function DmgMeterHealRows(player) local s = DmgMeterHealSplit(player) local you_lead = group_leader and group_leader:lower() == (state.current.name or ""):lower() local list if player.is_self then list = {{"on self", s.self}, {"on leader", s.leader}, {"on others", s.others}} else list = {{"on self", s.self}, {"on leader", s.leader}, {you_lead and "on leader - you" or "on others - you", s.you}, {"on others - not you", s.others}} end local rows = {} for _, l in ipairs(list) do if l[2].hp > 0 or l[2].casts > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = {name = l[1], heal = l[2].hp, casts = l[2].casts, est = l[2].est} end end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return (a.heal or 0) > (b.heal or 0) end) return rows end
-- A player's heals in the meter's count as a report shows them: on self, on leader -- and on others -- you're one of the others to whoever reads it (or the leader, when -- you lead). {{label, {hp, casts, est}}, ...}, empty ones left out. function DmgMeterHealParts(player) local s = DmgMeterHealSplit(player) if not player.is_self then local you_lead = group_leader and group_leader:lower() == (state.current.name or ""):lower() local into = you_lead and s.leader or s.others into.hp, into.casts = into.hp + s.you.hp, into.casts + s.you.casts end local out = {} for _, l in ipairs({{"on self", s.self}, {"on leader", s.leader}, {"on others", s.others}}) do if l[2].hp > 0 or l[2].casts > 0 then out[#out + 1] = l end end return out end
-- cdt dmg meter report healedgrp (and healedall, with totals): everyone's heals in -- the meter's count, biggest first. healedgrp reads "1.Bob: self/leader/others", the -- three figures coloured as their words in the header, 0 where there were none, ~ on -- an estimate, and no total. Your own row too. The leader is whoever leads now. -- casts_only: the same line with only the number of casts, no hp, ranked by casts. -- totals (healedall): each healer's total and casts only, no split. function DmgMeterGroupHealLine(channel, casts_only, totals) if not (dmg_meter.tracking or dmg_meter.stopped) then Report(channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wNo heals to report: the damage meter isn't running.") return end DmgMeterCollectData() local label if totals then label = casts_only and "Heal casts w/ estimates" or "Heals w/ estimates" else label = casts_only and "Group heal casts" or "Group heals" end local head = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@M%s @D| @wmeter %s@D] ", label, FormatMeterTime(MeterElapsed())) if not totals then head = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@M%s@D: @Yself@D/@Gleader@D/@Cothers @D| @wmeter %s@D] ", label, FormatMeterTime(MeterElapsed())) end local rows = {} for _, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do local parts = DmgMeterHealParts(e) if casts_only then local kept = {} for _, l in ipairs(parts) do if l[2].casts > 0 then kept[#kept + 1] = l end end parts = kept end local total, casts, est = 0, 0, false for _, l in ipairs(parts) do total, casts, est = total + l[2].hp, casts + l[2].casts, est or l[2].est end if (casts_only and casts or total) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = {name = e.name, parts = parts, total = total, casts = casts, est = est} end end if #rows == 0 then Report(channel, head .. "@wnone") return end if casts_only then table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.casts ~= b.casts then return a.casts > b.casts end if a.total ~= b.total then return a.total > b.total end return a.name < b.name end) else table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.total > b.total end) end local out = {} for i, r in ipairs(rows) do if totals then if casts_only then out[#out + 1] = string.format("@w%d.@W%s @M%s%s @w%s", i, r.name, r.est and "~" or "", comma_value(r.casts), r.casts == 1 and "cast" or "casts") else out[#out + 1] = string.format("@w%d.@W%s @M%s%s @D(@w%s@D)", i, r.name, r.est and "~" or "", short_value(math.floor(r.total)), comma_value(r.casts) .. (r.casts == 1 and " cast" or " casts")) end else local by = {} for _, l in ipairs(r.parts) do by[l[1]] = l[2] end local figs3 = {} for _, k in ipairs({{"on self", "@Y"}, {"on leader", "@G"}, {"on others", "@C"}}) do local part = by[k[1]] local v = part and (casts_only and part.casts or math.floor(part.hp)) or 0 local txt = "0" if v > 0 then txt = (part.est and "~" or "") .. (casts_only and comma_value(v) or short_value(v)) end figs3[#figs3 + 1] = k[2] .. txt end out[#out + 1] = string.format("@D%d.@W%s@D: %s", i, r.name, table.concat(figs3, "@D/")) end end Report(channel, head .. table.concat(out, " ")) end
-- A report's heals section. mode true (the heal figure): their heals on whoever runs -- the report, named. Otherwise on self, on leader and on others -- you're one of the -- others to whoever reads it (or the leader, when you lead) -- with ~ on estimates. function DmgMeterHealText(player, mode) local function casts(c) return comma_value(c) .. (c == 1 and " cast" or " casts") end local function fig(p, label) return string.format("@M%s%s @w%s @D(@w%s@D)", p.est and "~" or "", short_value(math.floor(p.hp)), label, casts(p.casts)) end if mode == true then return "@MHeals@D: " .. fig({hp = player.heal or 0, casts = player.heal_casts or 0}, "on " .. DmgMeterSelfName()) end local parts = {} for _, l in ipairs(DmgMeterHealParts(player)) do parts[#parts + 1] = fig(l[2], l[1]) end return "@MHeals@D: " .. (#parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, "@D, ") or "@wnone") end
function DmgMeterSortVal(sort_key, entry, exact) if sort_key == "heal" then return DmgMeterHealVal(entry, exact) end if sort_key == "crit" then return entry.crit_pct or 0 end if sort_key == "avg" then return MeterAvgHit(entry) or 0 end -- Group rows carry total damage as `damage`, per-attack rows as `dmg`. -- Checking only one left group sorting comparing nil against nil, which -- both scrambled the order and flattened every bar to zero fill. if sort_key == "dmg" then return entry.dmg or entry.damage or 0 end return entry[sort_key] or 0 end
function DrawDmgMeter() local W = dmg_meter.w local H = dmg_meter.h
local bg = GetThemeColor("PRIMARY_BODY", "black") local border_col = GetThemeColor("BORDER", "gray") local col_white = ColourNameToRGB("white") local col_silver = ColourNameToRGB("silver") local col_gray = ColourNameToRGB("gray") local col_dimgray = ColourNameToRGB("dimgray") local col_darkgray = 0x333333 local col_tab_bg = 0x222222 local col_tab_active = 0x5b9bd5 local col_green = 0x66cc66 local col_btn_bg = 0x333333 local col_btn_hi = 0x555555 local col_btn_lo = 0x1a1a1a
local line_h = WindowFontInfo(dmg_win, dmg_font, 1) or 13 local pad = 4 local row_h = line_h + 3
WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, 0, 0, W, H, bg)
local y = 0
if not dmg_meter.minimalist then -- Combined header: tab toggle (left) | elapsed (center) | sort arrows (right) local hdr_h = line_h + 6 WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, 0, 0, W, hdr_h, 0x2a2a2a) WindowLine(dmg_win, 0, hdr_h - 1, W, hdr_h - 1, col_darkgray, 0, 1)
local on_group = dmg_meter.tab == "group" local grp_col = on_group and col_tab_active or col_dimgray local det_col = on_group and col_dimgray or col_tab_active local sep = " | " local tx = pad WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, "Group", tx, 3, W, hdr_h, grp_col) tx = tx + WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, "Group") WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, sep, tx, 3, W, hdr_h, col_darkgray) tx = tx + WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, sep) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, "Detail", tx, 3, W, hdr_h, det_col) tx = tx + WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, "Detail") local tab_lbl_w = tx
if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "tab_toggle", 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, "tab_toggle", 0, 0, tab_lbl_w + 4, hdr_h, "", "", "DmgMeterTabClick", "", "", "Toggle Group/Detail", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, "tab_toggle", "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, "tab_toggle", 0, 0, tab_lbl_w + 4, hdr_h) end
-- Normalise here too, so a stale saved mode is corrected on first draw -- rather than only when the arrows are clicked. local sort_label if dmg_meter.tab == "group" then dmg_meter.sort = DmgMeterValidSort(dmg_meter.sort, DMG_SORT_MODES) sort_label = DMG_SORT_LABELS[dmg_meter.sort] or "DPS" else dmg_meter.detail_sort = DmgMeterValidSort(dmg_meter.detail_sort, DMG_DETAIL_SORTS) sort_label = DMG_DETAIL_LABELS[dmg_meter.detail_sort] or "by Damage" end local arrow_l = "<" local arrow_r = ">" local al_w = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, arrow_l) local ar_w = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, arrow_r) local sl_w = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, sort_label) local sort_x = W - pad - ar_w WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, arrow_r, sort_x, 3, W, hdr_h, col_tab_active) sort_x = sort_x - sl_w - 6 WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, sort_label, sort_x, 3, W, hdr_h, col_silver) sort_x = sort_x - al_w - 6 WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, arrow_l, sort_x, 3, W, hdr_h, col_tab_active)
local sort_area_left = sort_x - 4 local sort_mid = math.floor((sort_area_left + W) / 2) if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "sort_prev", 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, "sort_prev", sort_area_left, 0, sort_mid, hdr_h, "", "", "DmgMeterSortPrev", "", "", "Previous sort", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, "sort_prev", "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, "sort_prev", sort_area_left, 0, sort_mid, hdr_h) end if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "sort_next", 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, "sort_next", sort_mid, 0, W, hdr_h, "", "", "DmgMeterSortNext", "", "", "Next sort", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, "sort_next", "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, "sort_next", sort_mid, 0, W, hdr_h) end
if dmg_meter.tracking or dmg_meter.stopped then local elapsed if dmg_meter.stopped and dmg_meter.stop_time > 0 then elapsed = dmg_meter.stop_time - dmg_meter.start_time else elapsed = os.time() - dmg_meter.start_time end local tstr = FormatMeterTime(elapsed) local tw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, tstr) local time_x = math.floor((pad + tab_lbl_w + 8 + sort_area_left - tw) / 2) if time_x > pad + tab_lbl_w + 10 then WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, tstr, time_x, 3, W, hdr_h, col_dimgray) end end
y = hdr_h end
local content_top = y
if dmg_meter.tab == "group" then DrawDmgMeterParty(y, W, H, row_h, line_h, pad) else DrawDmgMeterDetail(y, W, H, row_h, line_h, pad) end
if not dmg_meter.minimalist then -- Buttons at bottom local btn_h = line_h + 6 local status_h = line_h + 4 local btn_y = H - btn_h - status_h local btn_w = math.floor((W - pad * 4) / 3)
WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, 0, btn_y, W, btn_y + btn_h, 0x1e1e1e) WindowLine(dmg_win, 0, btn_y, W, btn_y, 0x444444, 0, 1)
local btns if dmg_meter.tracking then btns = { {id = "btn_start", label = "Running", active = true}, {id = "btn_pause", label = "Pause", active = false}, {id = "btn_reset", label = "Reset", active = false}, } elseif dmg_meter.stopped then btns = { {id = "btn_start", label = "Resume", active = false}, {id = "btn_pause", label = "Paused", active = true}, {id = "btn_reset", label = "Reset", active = false}, } else btns = { {id = "btn_start", label = "Start", active = false}, {id = "btn_pause", label = "Pause", active = false}, {id = "btn_reset", label = "Reset", active = false}, } end for i, btn in ipairs(btns) do local bx = pad + (i - 1) * (btn_w + pad / 2) local by = btn_y + 3 local bx2 = bx + btn_w local by2 = by + btn_h - 6 if btn.active then WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, bx, by, bx2, by2, 0x2a4a2a) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 1, bx, by, bx2, by2, col_btn_lo) local bl = btn.label local blw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, bl) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, bl, bx + (btn_w - blw) / 2, by + 1, bx2, by2, col_green) else WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, bx, by, bx2, by2, col_btn_bg) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 5, bx, by, bx2, by2, col_btn_hi, col_btn_lo) local bl = btn.label local blw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, bl) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, bl, bx + (btn_w - blw) / 2, by + 1, bx2, by2, col_silver) end
if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, btn.id, 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, btn.id, bx, by, bx2, by2, "", "", "DmgMeterBtnClick", "", "", btn.label, miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, btn.id, "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, btn.id, bx, by, bx2, by2) end end
-- Status bar local st_y = H - status_h WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, 0, st_y, W, H, 0x1e1e1e) WindowLine(dmg_win, 0, st_y, W, st_y, col_darkgray, 0, 1) if dmg_meter.tracking then WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, "Tracking", pad, st_y + 2, W, H, col_green) elseif dmg_meter.stopped then WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, "Paused", pad, st_y + 2, W, H, ColourNameToRGB("yellow")) else WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, "Ready", pad, st_y + 2, W, H, col_gray) end -- The total follows the tab: healing on Healing, damage on the others. local healing = (dmg_meter.tab == "group" and dmg_meter.sort or dmg_meter.detail_sort) == "heal" local total, est = 0, false for _, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do if healing then total = total + DmgMeterHealVal(e) est = est or DmgMeterHealIsEstimate(e) else total = total + (e.damage or 0) end end local total_str = (healing and "Healed: " or "Total: ") .. (est and "~" or "") .. short_value(total) local tsw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, total_str) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, total_str, W - tsw - pad - 10, st_y + 2, W, H, col_gray) end
-- Resize grip WindowLine(dmg_win, W - 3, H - 10, W - 10, H - 3, col_dimgray, 0, 1) WindowLine(dmg_win, W - 3, H - 6, W - 6, H - 3, col_dimgray, 0, 1) WindowLine(dmg_win, W - 3, H - 2, W - 2, H - 3, col_dimgray, 0, 1) if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "resize", 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, "resize", W - 13, H - 13, W, H, "", "", "", "", "DmgMeterResizeRelease", "Resize", miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(dmg_win, "resize", "DmgMeterResizeDrag", "DmgMeterResizeRelease", 0) else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, "resize", W - 13, H - 13, W, H) end
-- Border if theme_loaded and Theme and Theme.DrawBorder then Theme.DrawBorder(dmg_win) else WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 1, 0, 0, W, H, border_col) end
CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "BufferedRepaint") end
function DrawDmgMeterParty(y, W, H, row_h, line_h, pad) if WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "detail_prev", 1) then WindowDeleteHotspot(dmg_win, "detail_prev") end if WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "detail_next", 1) then WindowDeleteHotspot(dmg_win, "detail_next") end local sorted = DmgMeterSortData(dmg_meter.data, dmg_meter.sort) local col_white = ColourNameToRGB("white") local col_silver = ColourNameToRGB("silver") local col_gray = ColourNameToRGB("gray") local col_dimgray = ColourNameToRGB("dimgray")
if #sorted == 0 then -- Your own row is always listed under the damage categories, so an empty -- list there means the meter isn't running. Healing lists only those who -- healed you, so it is empty while tracking until the first heal lands. local msg = dmg_meter.sort == "heal" and "No heal data yet" or "No damage data yet" if not dmg_meter.tracking and not dmg_meter.stopped then msg = "Click Start to begin tracking" end local mw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, msg) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, msg, math.floor((W - mw) / 2), y + row_h, W, H, col_gray) return end
local max_val = 0 for _, e in ipairs(sorted) do local v = DmgMeterSortVal(dmg_meter.sort, e) if v > max_val then max_val = v end end
local btn_h = dmg_meter.minimalist and 0 or (line_h + 6) local status_h = dmg_meter.minimalist and 0 or (line_h + 4) local sb_w = 4 local avail_h = H - y - btn_h - status_h local max_rows = math.floor(avail_h / row_h) local total_items = #sorted local scroll_max = math.max(0, total_items - max_rows) dmg_meter.scroll_group = math.min(dmg_meter.scroll_group, scroll_max) local scroll = dmg_meter.scroll_group local need_scroll = total_items > max_rows
local rank_w = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, "00") + 4 local pct_w = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, "100.0%") + 4 local bar_x = pad + rank_w local bar_w = W - bar_x - pct_w - pad - (need_scroll and sb_w + 2 or 0)
-- The bar is normalised to the largest row and this column to the total, so -- the two can only agree if they measure the SAME thing. Sorted by DPS it -- was printing a damage share, which put "18.3%" beside an empty bar. local total_val = 0 for _, e in ipairs(sorted) do total_val = total_val + DmgMeterSortVal(dmg_meter.sort, e) end
for vi = 1, max_rows do local i = vi + scroll if i > total_items then break end local entry = sorted[i] local ry = y + (vi - 1) * row_h + 1
local rank_str = tostring(i) local rw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, rank_str) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, rank_str, pad + rank_w - rw - 2, ry + 1, W, ry + row_h, col_dimgray)
local bar_fill = max_val > 0 and DmgMeterSortVal(dmg_meter.sort, entry) / max_val or 0 local fill_w = math.max(1, math.floor(bar_w * bar_fill)) local bar_color_idx = entry.is_self and 1 or (((i - 1) % #DMG_BAR_COLORS) + 1) local bar_col = DMG_BAR_COLORS[bar_color_idx] WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, bar_x, ry, bar_x + bar_w, ry + row_h - 1, 0x2a2a2a) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, bar_x, ry, bar_x + fill_w, ry + row_h - 1, bar_col)
local name_str = entry.name if entry.is_self then name_str = name_str .. " (you)" end WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, name_str, bar_x + 3, ry + 1, bar_x + bar_w, ry + row_h, col_white)
local val_str = DmgMeterFormatVal(dmg_meter.sort, entry) local vw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, val_str) if vw + WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, name_str) + 10 < bar_w then WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, val_str, bar_x + bar_w - vw - 3, ry + 1, bar_x + bar_w, ry + row_h, col_silver) end
-- Crit% is already a percentage; a "share of crit" would mean nothing, -- so that mode leaves the column empty rather than inventing a figure. local pct_str = "" if dmg_meter.sort == "dps" and not entry.dps then pct_str = "--" elseif dmg_meter.sort ~= "crit" then local v = DmgMeterSortVal(dmg_meter.sort, entry) pct_str = string.format("%.1f%%", total_val > 0 and (v / total_val) * 100 or 0) end if pct_str ~= "" then local pw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, pct_str) local pct_x = W - pw - pad - (need_scroll and sb_w + 2 or 0) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, pct_str, pct_x, ry + 1, W, ry + row_h, col_gray) end
local hs_id = "row_" .. vi if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, hs_id, 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, hs_id, bar_x, ry, bar_x + bar_w, ry + row_h, "", "", "DmgMeterRowClick", "", "", "View " .. entry.name, miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, hs_id, "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, hs_id, bar_x, ry, bar_x + bar_w, ry + row_h) end end
local vis_count = math.min(max_rows, total_items - scroll) local prev_rows = dmg_meter.prev_group_rows or 0 for vi = vis_count + 1, prev_rows do local hs_id = "row_" .. vi if WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, hs_id, 1) then WindowDeleteHotspot(dmg_win, hs_id) end end dmg_meter.prev_group_rows = vis_count
if need_scroll then local sb_x = W - sb_w - 1 local track_h = max_rows * row_h local thumb_h = math.max(8, math.floor(track_h * max_rows / total_items)) local thumb_y = y + (scroll_max > 0 and math.floor((track_h - thumb_h) * scroll / scroll_max) or 0) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, sb_x, y, sb_x + sb_w, y + track_h, 0x1a1a1a) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, sb_x, thumb_y, sb_x + sb_w, thumb_y + thumb_h, 0x555555) end
if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "scroll_area", 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, "scroll_area", 0, y, W, y + max_rows * row_h, "", "", "DmgMeterContentClick", "", "", "", miniwin.cursor_arrow, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, "scroll_area", "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, "scroll_area", 0, y, W, y + max_rows * row_h) end end
function DrawDmgMeterDetail(y, W, H, row_h, line_h, pad) local prev_rows = dmg_meter.prev_group_rows or 0 for vi = 1, prev_rows do local hs_id = "row_" .. vi if WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, hs_id, 1) then WindowDeleteHotspot(dmg_win, hs_id) end end dmg_meter.prev_group_rows = 0 local col_white = ColourNameToRGB("white") local col_silver = ColourNameToRGB("silver") local col_gray = ColourNameToRGB("gray") local col_dimgray = ColourNameToRGB("dimgray") local col_tab_active = 0x5b9bd5
local player = nil for _, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do if dmg_meter.detail_player and e.name == dmg_meter.detail_player then player = e break end end if not player then if dmg_meter.data[1] then player = dmg_meter.data[1] dmg_meter.detail_player = player.name end end if not player then local msg = (not dmg_meter.tracking and not dmg_meter.stopped) and "Click Start to begin tracking" or "No damage data yet" local mw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, msg) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, msg, math.floor((W - mw) / 2), y + row_h, W, H, col_gray) return end
-- Player header with nav arrows local hdr_h = line_h + 6 WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, 0, y, W, y + hdr_h, 0x222222) WindowLine(dmg_win, 0, y + hdr_h - 1, W, y + hdr_h - 1, 0x333333, 0, 1)
local arrow_l = "<" local arrow_r = ">" local al_w = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, arrow_l) local pname = player.name if player.is_self then pname = pname .. " (you)" end WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, arrow_l, pad, y + 3, W, y + hdr_h, col_tab_active) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, pname, pad + al_w + 6, y + 3, W, y + hdr_h, col_tab_active) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, arrow_r, pad + al_w + 6 + WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, pname) + 6, y + 3, W, y + hdr_h, col_tab_active)
-- The header's figure follows the tab: DPS, crit %, average hit, or healing. local ds = dmg_meter.detail_sort local dps_str = MeterDpsStr(player.dps) .. " DPS" if ds == "crit" then dps_str = string.format("%.1f%% crit", player.crit_pct or 0) elseif ds == "avg" then dps_str = MeterAvgHitStr(player) .. " avg" elseif ds == "heal" then dps_str = (DmgMeterHealIsEstimate(player) and "~" or "") .. short_value(math.floor(DmgMeterHealVal(player))) .. " healed" end local dsw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, dps_str) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, dps_str, W - dsw - pad, y + 3, W, y + hdr_h, col_gray)
if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "detail_prev", 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, "detail_prev", 0, y, math.floor(W / 2), y + hdr_h, "", "", "DmgMeterDetailPrev", "", "", "Previous player", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, "detail_prev", "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, "detail_prev", 0, y, math.floor(W / 2), y + hdr_h) end if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "detail_next", 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, "detail_next", math.floor(W / 2), y, W, y + hdr_h, "", "", "DmgMeterDetailNext", "", "", "Next player", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, "detail_next", "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, "detail_next", math.floor(W / 2), y, W, y + hdr_h) end y = y + hdr_h
-- Stats lines local stat_h = line_h + 2 -- Only the lines for the tab you're on: damage and time on DPS and Damage, hits -- and crits on Crit% and Avg/Hit, the heals on Healing. Damage taken on every tab. local stats = {} if ds == "dps" or ds == "dmg" then stats[#stats + 1] = {"Dmg / Time / DPS", string.format("%s / %s / %s", short_value(math.floor(player.damage or 0)), FormatMeterTime(player.combat_secs or 0), MeterDpsStr(player.dps))} elseif ds == "crit" or ds == "avg" then stats[#stats + 1] = {"Hits / Crits", string.format("%s / %s (%.1f%%)", comma_value(player.phits or 0), comma_value(player.crits or 0), player.crit_pct or 0)} end local heal_lines = ds == "heal" if heal_lines and (player.heal or 0) > 0 then stats[#stats + 1] = {player.is_self and "Self heals / Casts" or "Healed you / Casts", string.format("%s / %s", short_value(math.floor(player.heal)), comma_value(player.heal_casts or 0))} end if heal_lines and (player.given_total or 0) > 0 then stats[#stats + 1] = {"Healed others / Casts", string.format("%s / %s", short_value(math.floor(player.given_total)), comma_value(player.given_casts or 0))} end if heal_lines and not player.is_self and (player.casts_est or 0) > 0 then stats[#stats + 1] = {"Casts~ / On others~", string.format("%s / %s", comma_value(player.casts_est), comma_value(player.others_est or 0))} end if heal_lines and not player.is_self and (player.regen_casts or 0) > 0 then stats[#stats + 1] = {"Regen~ / HP~", string.format("%s / %s", comma_value(player.regen_casts), short_value(math.floor(player.regen_hp or 0)))} end if heal_lines and not player.is_self and (player.scroll_heals or 0) > 0 then stats[#stats + 1] = {"Scroll heals / HP~", string.format("%s / %s", comma_value(player.scroll_heals), short_value(math.floor(player.scroll_hp or 0)))} end if player.is_self then stats[#stats + 1] = {"Taken / Per min", string.format("%s / %s", short_value(math.floor(player.received or 0)), player.received_pm and short_value(math.floor(player.received_pm)) or "--")} end for _, s in ipairs(stats) do WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, s[1], pad + 2, y + 1, W, y + stat_h, col_gray) local vw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, s[2]) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, s[2], W - vw - pad, y + 1, W, y + stat_h, col_white) y = y + stat_h end
-- Attack bars; by Healing, the heals they cast on you by spell instead. On your -- own row: your heals on yourself, then on each player you healed. local sorted_atks if dmg_meter.detail_sort == "heal" then sorted_atks = DmgMeterHealRows(player) else local attacks = player.attacks or {} sorted_atks = DmgMeterCollapseMinor( DmgMeterSortAttacks(attacks, dmg_meter.detail_sort, player.combat_secs)) end
-- Section label. With nothing to list (someone who healed nobody, or a fresh -- reset), say so in gray instead of a heading over an empty space. local section = "Attack breakdown" if dmg_meter.detail_sort == "heal" then section = player.is_self and "Your heals" or (((player.casts_est or 0) + (player.scroll_heals or 0) + (player.regen_casts or 0) > 0) and "Their heals" or "Heals on you") end if #sorted_atks == 0 then WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, dmg_meter.detail_sort == "heal" and "No heals yet" or "No damage yet", pad + 2, y + 2, W, y + stat_h + 2, col_gray) else WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, section, pad + 2, y + 2, W, y + stat_h + 2, col_tab_active) WindowLine(dmg_win, 0, y + stat_h + 1, W, y + stat_h + 1, 0x333333, 0, 1) end y = y + stat_h + 2
local max_atk_val, total_atk_val = 0, 0 for _, a in ipairs(sorted_atks) do local v = DmgMeterSortVal(dmg_meter.detail_sort, a) if v > max_atk_val then max_atk_val = v end total_atk_val = total_atk_val + v end -- Shares only mean something for quantities that add up to a whole: damage, -- and DPS (every attack shares the player's combat time, so its DPS share is -- its damage share). Avg/Hit and Crit% are rates -- a "share" of those is -- nonsense, so those sorts show the value alone. local show_share = dmg_meter.detail_sort == "dmg" or dmg_meter.detail_sort == "dps" or dmg_meter.detail_sort == "heal"
local btn_h = dmg_meter.minimalist and 0 or (line_h + 6) local status_h = dmg_meter.minimalist and 0 or (line_h + 4) local sb_w = 4 local avail = H - y - btn_h - status_h local max_atk_rows = math.floor(avail / row_h) local total_atks = #sorted_atks local scroll_max = math.max(0, total_atks - max_atk_rows) dmg_meter.scroll_detail = math.min(dmg_meter.scroll_detail, scroll_max) local scroll = dmg_meter.scroll_detail local need_scroll = total_atks > max_atk_rows local bar_col = 0x4a7ab5
for vi = 1, max_atk_rows do local i = vi + scroll if i > total_atks then break end local atk = sorted_atks[i] local ry = y + (vi - 1) * row_h
local rank_w2 = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, "00") + 4 local bar_x = pad + rank_w2 local bar_w = W - bar_x - pad - (need_scroll and sb_w + 2 or 0)
local rs = tostring(i) local rw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, rs) WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, rs, pad + rank_w2 - rw - 2, ry + 1, W, ry + row_h, col_dimgray)
local fill = max_atk_val > 0 and DmgMeterSortVal(dmg_meter.detail_sort, atk) / max_atk_val or 0 local fill_w = math.max(1, math.floor(bar_w * fill)) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, bar_x, ry, bar_x + bar_w, ry + row_h - 1, 0x2a2a2a) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, bar_x, ry, bar_x + fill_w, ry + row_h - 1, bar_col)
WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, atk.name, bar_x + 3, ry + 1, bar_x + bar_w, ry + row_h, col_white)
-- The bar is scaled to the biggest attack; the percentage is its share of -- the player's total. Same quantity, so they always rank alike, but the top -- bar is full while its share may read 40%. Where the name leaves no room -- for "value (share)", fall back to the value alone, then to nothing. local val_str = DmgMeterFormatAtkVal(dmg_meter.detail_sort, atk) local name_w = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, atk.name) local candidates = {} local v = DmgMeterSortVal(dmg_meter.detail_sort, atk) if show_share and total_atk_val > 0 and not (dmg_meter.detail_sort == "dps" and not atk.dps) then candidates[#candidates + 1] = string.format("%s (%.1f%%)", val_str, v / total_atk_val * 100) end -- Avg/Hit: append the true hit count it was averaged over, "4,726 (287)". -- phits is the same denominator MeterAvgHit uses, so avg x count = damage. -- Rows without true hit counts already show "-" and get no count. if dmg_meter.detail_sort == "avg" and (atk.phits or 0) > 0 then candidates[#candidates + 1] = string.format("%s (%s)", val_str, comma_value(atk.phits)) end candidates[#candidates + 1] = val_str for _, text in ipairs(candidates) do local vw = WindowTextWidth(dmg_win, dmg_font, text) if vw + name_w + 10 < bar_w then WindowText(dmg_win, dmg_font, text, bar_x + bar_w - vw - 3, ry + 1, bar_x + bar_w, ry + row_h, col_silver) break end end end
if need_scroll then local sb_x = W - sb_w - 1 local track_h = max_atk_rows * row_h local thumb_h = math.max(8, math.floor(track_h * max_atk_rows / total_atks)) local thumb_y = y + (scroll_max > 0 and math.floor((track_h - thumb_h) * scroll / scroll_max) or 0) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, sb_x, y, sb_x + sb_w, y + track_h, 0x1a1a1a) WindowRectOp(dmg_win, 2, sb_x, thumb_y, sb_x + sb_w, thumb_y + thumb_h, 0x555555) end
if not WindowHotspotInfo(dmg_win, "scroll_area", 1) then WindowAddHotspot(dmg_win, "scroll_area", 0, y, W, y + max_atk_rows * row_h, "", "", "DmgMeterContentClick", "", "", "", miniwin.cursor_arrow, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, "scroll_area", "DmgMeterScrollWheel") else WindowMoveHotspot(dmg_win, "scroll_area", 0, y, W, y + max_atk_rows * row_h) end end
-- Hotspot callbacks function DmgMeterScrollWheel(flags, id) local delta = bit.band(flags, 0x100) ~= 0 and 1 or -1 if dmg_meter.tab == "group" then dmg_meter.scroll_group = math.max(0, dmg_meter.scroll_group + delta) else dmg_meter.scroll_detail = math.max(0, dmg_meter.scroll_detail + delta) end dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end
function DmgMeterTabClick(flags, id) if DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) then return end dmg_meter.tab = dmg_meter.tab == "group" and "detail" or "group" dmg_meter.scroll_group = 0 dmg_meter.scroll_detail = 0 dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end
function DmgMeterSortPrev(flags, id) if DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) then return end local list, key_field if dmg_meter.tab == "group" then list = DMG_SORT_MODES key_field = "sort" else list = DMG_DETAIL_SORTS key_field = "detail_sort" end -- A saved mode that no longer exists would match nothing and leave the -- arrows dead, so fall back to the first entry. local cur = DmgMeterValidSort(dmg_meter[key_field], list) for i, k in ipairs(list) do if k == cur then dmg_meter[key_field] = list[((i - 2) % #list) + 1] break end end dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end
function DmgMeterSortNext(flags, id) if DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) then return end local list, key_field if dmg_meter.tab == "group" then list = DMG_SORT_MODES key_field = "sort" else list = DMG_DETAIL_SORTS key_field = "detail_sort" end local cur = DmgMeterValidSort(dmg_meter[key_field], list) for i, k in ipairs(list) do if k == cur then dmg_meter[key_field] = list[(i % #list) + 1] break end end dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end
function DmgMeterContentClick(flags, id) DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) end
function DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) if ok_bit and bit and bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) ~= 0 then DmgMeterRightClickMenu() return true end return false end
function DmgMeterRowClick(flags, id) if DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) then return end local idx = tonumber(id:match("row_(%d+)")) if not idx then return end local sorted = DmgMeterSortData(dmg_meter.data, dmg_meter.sort) local actual = idx + dmg_meter.scroll_group if sorted[actual] then dmg_meter.detail_player = sorted[actual].name dmg_meter.tab = "detail" -- Same category as the group view you clicked from: Healing opens on Healing. dmg_meter.detail_sort = DmgMeterValidSort(dmg_meter.sort, DMG_DETAIL_SORTS) dmg_meter.scroll_detail = 0 dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end end
function DmgMeterDetailPrev(flags, id) if DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) then return end if #dmg_meter.data < 2 then return end local cur = dmg_meter.detail_player for i, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do if e.name == cur then dmg_meter.detail_player = dmg_meter.data[((i - 2) % #dmg_meter.data) + 1].name break end end dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end
function DmgMeterDetailNext(flags, id) if DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) then return end if #dmg_meter.data < 2 then return end local cur = dmg_meter.detail_player for i, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do if e.name == cur then dmg_meter.detail_player = dmg_meter.data[(i % #dmg_meter.data) + 1].name break end end dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end
function DmgMeterBtnClick(flags, id) if DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) then return end if id == "btn_start" then if not dmg_meter.tracking then if dmg_meter.stopped then dmg_meter.tracking = true dmg_meter.stopped = false dmg_meter.stop_time = 0 dmg_meter.endpoint = nil dmg_meter.group_endpoint = {} EnableTimer("cdt_dmg_tick", dmg_meter.active) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Damage meter resumed.") else DmgMeterStartTracking() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Damage meter tracking started.") end end elseif id == "btn_pause" then if dmg_meter.tracking then dmg_meter.tracking = false dmg_meter.stopped = true dmg_meter.stop_time = os.time() dmg_meter.endpoint = DmgMeterSnapshotSelf() dmg_meter.group_endpoint = DmgMeterSnapshotGroup() EnableTimer("cdt_dmg_tick", false) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Damage meter paused.") end elseif id == "btn_reset" then DmgMeterStartTracking() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Damage meter reset and started.") end dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end
function DmgMeterResizeDrag(flags, id) local posx, posy = WindowInfo(dmg_win, 17), WindowInfo(dmg_win, 18) local winx, winy = WindowInfo(dmg_win, 10), WindowInfo(dmg_win, 11) local new_w = posx - winx local new_h = posy - winy if new_w < dmg_meter.min_w then new_w = dmg_meter.min_w end if new_h < dmg_meter.min_h then new_h = dmg_meter.min_h end dmg_meter.w = new_w dmg_meter.h = new_h WindowResize(dmg_win, new_w, new_h, GetThemeColor("PRIMARY_BODY", "black")) dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() end
function DmgMeterResizeRelease(flags, id) movewindow.save_state(dmg_win) state_save() end
function DmgMeterMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id, win_name) if ok_bit and bit and bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) ~= 0 then DmgMeterRightClickMenu() end end
function DmgMeterRightClickMenu() local min_check = dmg_meter.minimalist and "+" or "" local est_check = dmg_meter.heal_est and "+" or "" local menu = min_check .. "Minimalist Mode|" .. est_check .. "Healing: Include Estimates|-|Change Font|-|" .. "Bring to Front|Send to Back|-|Hide Meter" local result = WindowMenu(dmg_win, WindowInfo(dmg_win, 14), WindowInfo(dmg_win, 15), menu) if not result then return end if result == "Minimalist Mode" then dmg_meter.minimalist = not dmg_meter.minimalist dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() elseif result == "Healing: Include Estimates" then dmg_meter.heal_est = not dmg_meter.heal_est ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Damage meter Healing: " ..
