(dmg_meter.heal_est and "includes groupmates' estimated heals on others (~) and yours on others." or "heals on you only.")) dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() state_save() elseif result == "Change Font" then local dm = config.dmg_meter or {} local wanted = utils.fontpicker(dm.font_name or "Consolas", dm.font_size or 9) if wanted then if not config.dmg_meter then config.dmg_meter = {} end config.dmg_meter.font_name = wanted.name config.dmg_meter.font_size = wanted.size config.dmg_meter.font_bold = wanted.bold ReloadDmgMeterFont() dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() state_save() end elseif result == "Bring to Front" then CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f", "boostMe", dmg_win) elseif result == "Send to Back" then CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f", "dropMe", dmg_win) elseif result == "Hide Meter" then CmdDmgMeter(nil, nil, {"off"}) end end
-- cdt dmg meter customreport <metrics> [player <name>] [channel]: the same figures -- as report, but you choose which and in what order. dps+dmg+crit+avg+healedme+ -- healedall, any combination; the first one sorts. avg is damage per hit with the -- hits in brackets. healedme is their heals on you (yours on yourself), healedall -- adds the heals on others with the estimates; led by either, the breakdown is the -- heals, not attacks. The keys inside are dps, dmg, crit, avg, heal and healest, but -- only the words below are taken as typed. DMG_METRIC_ORDER = {"dps", "dmg", "crit", "avg", "heal", "healest"} DMG_METRIC_WORDS = {dps = "dps", dmg = "dmg", crit = "crit", avg = "avg", healedme = "heal", healedall = "healest", damage = "dmg", crit_pct = "crit", average = "avg", hit = "avg"} DMG_METRIC_COL = {dps = "@G", dmg = "@R", crit = "@Y", avg = "@C", heal = "@M", healest = "@M"} DMG_HEAL_METRIC_MODE = {heal = true, healest = "est"}
-- "dps+dmg", "dps dmg", "dmg,avg" -> {"dps", "dmg"}; nil and the bad word otherwise. function ParseDmgMetrics(text) local out, seen = {}, {} for word in (text or ""):lower():gmatch("[^%+%s,]+") do local key = DMG_METRIC_WORDS[word] if not key then return nil, word end if not seen[key] then seen[key] = true out[#out + 1] = key end end if #out == 0 then return nil, "" end return out end
function DmgMetricsHelp(bad) if bad and bad ~= "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. bad .. " is not one of dps, dmg, crit, avg, healedme, healedall.") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Which figures? dps, dmg, crit, avg, healedme, healedall, joined with +.") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " e.g. cdt dmg meter customreport dps+dmg+avg player me") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt dmg meter customreport healedall+dps player Bob") end
-- One player's figure for one metric. avg carries its hit count: 3,456 (123). function MeterMetricStr(key, e) local heal_mode = DMG_HEAL_METRIC_MODE[key] if heal_mode then return (DmgMeterHealIsEstimate(e, heal_mode) and "~" or "") .. short_value(math.floor(DmgMeterHealVal(e, heal_mode))) end if key == "dps" then return e.dps and comma_value(math.floor(e.dps)) or "--" end if key == "dmg" then return short_value(math.floor(e.damage or 0)) end if key == "crit" then return string.format("%.1f%%", e.crit_pct or 0) end local avg = MeterAvgHit(e) if not avg then return "-" end return string.format("%s @D(@w%s@D)@C", comma_value(math.floor(avg)), comma_value(e.phits or 0)) end
-- The same for one attack of one player, which counts its own hits and crits. function MeterAttackMetricStr(key, atk, combat_secs) if key == "dps" then return MeterDpsStr(MeterDps(atk.dmg, combat_secs)) end if key == "dmg" then return short_value(atk.dmg or 0) end if key == "crit" then return string.format("%.1f%%", (atk.hits or 0) > 0 and (atk.crits or 0) / atk.hits * 100 or 0) end local avg = MeterAvgHit(atk) if not avg then return "-" end return string.format("%s @D(@w%s@D)@C", comma_value(math.floor(avg)), comma_value(atk.phits or 0)) end
-- What the legend calls each figure: its name, but the heals are spelt out -- heal -- is only the heals that landed on you, which a channel's readers can't tell from -- "heal" -- and the estimates' "w/" would read as a separator, so the legend parts the -- figures with commas. DMG_METRIC_LABEL = {healest = "Heals w/ estimates"} function DmgMetricLegend(metrics) local parts = {} for _, k in ipairs(metrics) do local label = DMG_METRIC_LABEL[k] or k if k == "heal" then label = "Heals on " .. DmgMeterSelfName() end parts[#parts + 1] = DMG_METRIC_COL[k] .. label end return table.concat(parts, "@D, ") end
-- Your name, for what goes to a channel: whoever reads it isn't you, and over cdt -- listen the one asking may not be either, so a report names you, not "you". function DmgMeterSelfName() if state.current.name then return state.current.name end for _, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data or {}) do if e.is_self then return e.name end end return "me" end
function MeterElapsed() if dmg_meter.tracking then return os.time() - dmg_meter.start_time end if dmg_meter.stopped and dmg_meter.stop_time > 0 then return dmg_meter.stop_time - dmg_meter.start_time end return 0 end
-- One player only. report player already shows dmg, dps, crit and avg for every -- attack, which is a lot of line; this is that view with only what you asked for. -- Across players, report [dps|dmg|crit|healedme|healedall|healedgrp] is the one to use. function DmgMeterCustomReport(sub, ask_channel) local args = {} for w in sub:gmatch("%S+") do args[#args + 1] = w end local metrics, bad = ParseDmgMetrics(args[2]) if not metrics then if ask_channel then Report(ask_channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wcustomreport takes @Cdps+dmg+crit+avg+healedme+healedall @wand a player.") else DmgMetricsHelp(bad) end return end if (args[3] or ""):lower() ~= "player" or not args[4] then if ask_channel then Report(ask_channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wUsage: @Ccdt customreport " .. table.concat(metrics, "+") .. " player <name>") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] customreport is for one player.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt dmg meter customreport " .. table.concat(metrics, "+") .. " player <name|me> [channel]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt dmg meter report <sort> lists everyone (cdt help dmg).") end return end DmgMeterCustomReportPlayer(metrics, args[4], args[5], ask_channel) end
-- ask_channel: a cdt listen query's channel, used as it is. It isn't checked against -- the report channels: say isn't one, and the query came in on it. function DmgMeterCustomReportPlayer(metrics, pname, chan, ask_channel) pname = pname or "self" local channel = ask_channel or CheckChannel(chan, "Usage: cdt dmg meter customreport <metrics> player <name> [channel]") if not channel then return end
DmgMeterCollectData() if #dmg_meter.data == 0 then Report(channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wNo damage data to report.") return end local player, want = nil, pname:lower() for _, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do if (want == "self" or want == "me") and e.is_self then player = e break end if e.name:lower() == want then player = e break end end if not player then Report(channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wPlayer '" .. pname .. "' not found in damage data.") return end
local head = {} for _, k in ipairs(metrics) do head[#head + 1] = DMG_METRIC_COL[k] .. MeterMetricStr(k, player) end -- With healedme or healedall: the heals on you and on others (all), with casts. With -- damage figures: the attacks, with those figures (heals aren't per attack), sorted -- by the first. Both, in the order the figures were asked for. local heal_mode, atk_metrics = nil, {} for _, k in ipairs(metrics) do local hm = DMG_HEAL_METRIC_MODE[k] if hm then if heal_mode ~= "est" then heal_mode = hm end else atk_metrics[#atk_metrics + 1] = k end end local heal_part = heal_mode and DmgMeterHealText(player, heal_mode) or "" local atk_part = "" if #atk_metrics > 0 then local sorted_atks = DmgMeterCollapseMinor( DmgMeterSortAttacks(player.attacks or {}, atk_metrics[1], player.combat_secs)) local rows, labels = {}, {} for i, atk in ipairs(sorted_atks) do local vals = {} for _, k in ipairs(atk_metrics) do vals[#vals + 1] = DMG_METRIC_COL[k] .. MeterAttackMetricStr(k, atk, player.combat_secs) end rows[#rows + 1] = string.format("@w%d.@W%s @D(%s@D)", i, atk.name, table.concat(vals, "@D/")) end for _, k in ipairs(atk_metrics) do labels[#labels + 1] = DMG_METRIC_COL[k] .. k end atk_part = "@WAttacks @D(" .. table.concat(labels, "@D/") .. "@D): " .. (#rows > 0 and table.concat(rows, " ") or "@wnone") end local parts = {} if heal_part ~= "" and DMG_HEAL_METRIC_MODE[metrics[1]] then parts[#parts + 1] = heal_part end if atk_part ~= "" then parts[#parts + 1] = atk_part end if heal_part ~= "" and not DMG_HEAL_METRIC_MODE[metrics[1]] then parts[#parts + 1] = heal_part end local msg = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @W%s @D[%s @D| @w%s@D] @D[%s@D]", player.name, table.concat(head, "@D/"), FormatMeterTime(MeterElapsed()), DmgMetricLegend(metrics)) if #parts > 0 then msg = msg .. " " .. table.concat(parts, " @D| ") end Report(channel, msg) end
-- Is this word one of the channels a report may go to? CheckChannel says so out -- loud when it isn't; this only asks. function IsChannel(word) local key = (word or ""):lower() return key ~= "" and (CHANNELS[key] or ExtraChannels()[key]) and true or false end
-- No hit/line count: a raw count of damage messages says nothing useful, and -- accuracy is not computable (misses are never attributed to an attack). DMG_REPORT_SORTS = {dps = "dps", dmg = "dmg", damage = "dmg", crit = "crit", healedme = "heal", healedall = "healedall", healedgrp = "healedgrp"}
-- cdt dmg meter report healedme castsonly: how many heals landed on you, by healer -- (yours on yourself, on your row), most first, with each one's share. Exact counts. function DmgMeterHealedMeCastsLine(channel) DmgMeterCollectData() local rows, total = {}, 0 for _, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do local c = e.heal_casts or 0 if c > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = {name = e.name, casts = c}; total = total + c end end local me = DmgMeterSelfName() if #rows == 0 then Report(channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wNo heals on " .. me .. " to report.") return end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.casts ~= b.casts then return a.casts > b.casts end return a.name < b.name end) local parts = {} for i, r in ipairs(rows) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@w%d.@W%s @D(@M%s %s @D- @w%.1f%%@D)", i, r.name, comma_value(r.casts), r.casts == 1 and "cast" or "casts", r.casts / total * 100) end Report(channel, string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@MHeal casts on %s @D| @w%s@D] %s", me, FormatMeterTime(MeterElapsed()), table.concat(parts, " "))) end
-- ask_channel is set when the question came in over a listened channel, so the -- answer (or the usage) goes back there. castsonly, anywhere after report, goes with -- healedme, healedall and healedgrp: only the numbers of casts. healedme is the heals -- on you, exact; healedall each healer's total (~ estimated); healedgrp each healer's -- on self, on the leader and on others. function DmgMeterReport(sub, ask_channel) local args = {} for w in sub:gmatch("%S+") do if w:lower() == "castsonly" then args.casts_only = true else args[#args + 1] = w end end local casts_only = args.casts_only local function refuse_casts() if ask_channel then Report(ask_channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wcastsonly goes with @Chealedme@w, @Chealedall@w or @Chealedgrp@w.") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] castsonly goes with healedme, healedall or healedgrp.") end end local sort_key = (args[2] or "dps"):lower()
if sort_key == "player" then if casts_only then refuse_casts() return end DmgMeterReportPlayer(args, ask_channel) return end
-- The word after report was taken as the sort whatever it was, and anything -- unknown became DPS: "report gt" printed locally and sent nothing, and a -- typo like "report dsp" gave DPS without a word. A channel there now means -- a DPS report to it; anything else is refused. local chan_word = args[3] if not DMG_REPORT_SORTS[sort_key] then if IsChannel(args[2]) and not args[3] then chan_word, sort_key = args[2], "dps" else if ask_channel then Report(ask_channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wcdt report takes @Cdps@w, @Cdmg@w, @Ccrit@w, @Chealedme@w, @Chealedall@w or @Chealedgrp@w, or @Cplayer <name>@w.") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. args[2] .. " is not a sort: dps, dmg, crit, healedme, healedall or healedgrp.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt dmg meter report [dps|dmg|crit|healedme|healedall|healedgrp] [ch]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt dmg meter report player <name|me> [channel]") end return end end
local is_heal = DMG_REPORT_SORTS[sort_key] == "heal" or DMG_REPORT_SORTS[sort_key] == "healedall" or DMG_REPORT_SORTS[sort_key] == "healedgrp" if casts_only and not is_heal then refuse_casts() return end -- A cdt listen query is answered on its own channel, as it is: say isn't one of -- the report channels, and checking it here refused every report asked on say. local channel = ask_channel or CheckChannel(chan_word, "Usage: cdt dmg meter report [sort] [channel]") if not channel then return end sort_key = DMG_REPORT_SORTS[sort_key] if sort_key == "healedall" or sort_key == "healedgrp" then DmgMeterGroupHealLine(channel, casts_only, sort_key == "healedall") return end if casts_only then DmgMeterHealedMeCastsLine(channel) return end
DmgMeterCollectData() -- healedme is exact: the meter's option never decides what goes to a channel. local sorted = DmgMeterSortData(dmg_meter.data, sort_key, true) if #sorted == 0 then Report(channel, sort_key == "heal" and ("@D[@CCDT@D] @wNo heals on " .. DmgMeterSelfName() .. " to report.") or "@D[@CCDT@D] @wNo damage data to report.") return end
local elapsed = 0 if dmg_meter.tracking then elapsed = os.time() - dmg_meter.start_time elseif dmg_meter.stopped and dmg_meter.stop_time > 0 then elapsed = dmg_meter.stop_time - dmg_meter.start_time end
local label_map = {dps = "DPS", dmg = "Damage", crit = "Crit%", heal = "Healing"} local label_col = {dps = "@G", dmg = "@R", hits = "@C", crit = "@Y", heal = "@M"} local total_dmg = 0 local total_dps = 0 local total_heal = 0 for _, e in ipairs(sorted) do total_dmg = total_dmg + (e.damage or 0) total_dps = total_dps + (e.dps or 0) total_heal = total_heal + DmgMeterHealVal(e, true) end local parts = {} for i, e in ipairs(sorted) do local val local dmg_pct = total_dmg > 0 and (e.damage or 0) / total_dmg * 100 or 0 local dps_pct = total_dps > 0 and (e.dps or 0) / total_dps * 100 or 0 if sort_key == "dps" then if e.dps then val = string.format("@G%s @D- @w%.1f%%", comma_value(math.floor(e.dps)), dps_pct) else val = "@G--" end elseif sort_key == "dmg" then val = string.format("@R%s @D- @w%.1f%%", short_value(math.floor(e.damage or 0)), dmg_pct) elseif sort_key == "crit" then val = string.format("@Y%.1f%%", e.crit_pct or 0) elseif sort_key == "heal" then local hv = DmgMeterHealVal(e, true) val = string.format("@M%s @D- @w%.1f%%", short_value(math.floor(hv)), total_heal > 0 and hv / total_heal * 100 or 0) end parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@w%d.@W%s @D(%s@D)", i, e.name, val) end local lc = label_col[sort_key] or "@G" local label = label_map[sort_key] or "DPS" if sort_key == "heal" then label = "Heals on " .. DmgMeterSelfName() end local msg = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @D[%s%s @D| @w%s@D] %s", lc, label, FormatMeterTime(elapsed), table.concat(parts, " ")) Report(channel, msg) end
function DmgMeterReportPlayer(args, ask_channel) local pname = args[3] or "self" local channel = ask_channel or CheckChannel(args[4], "Usage: cdt dmg meter report <player> [channel]") if not channel then return end
DmgMeterCollectData() if #dmg_meter.data == 0 then Report(channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wNo damage data to report.") return end
local player = nil local pname_lower = pname:lower() if pname_lower == "self" or pname_lower == "me" then for _, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do if e.is_self then player = e; break end end else for _, e in ipairs(dmg_meter.data) do if e.name:lower() == pname_lower then player = e; break end end end if not player then Report(channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wPlayer '" .. pname .. "' not found in damage data.") return end
local elapsed = 0 if dmg_meter.tracking then elapsed = os.time() - dmg_meter.start_time elseif dmg_meter.stopped and dmg_meter.stop_time > 0 then elapsed = dmg_meter.stop_time - dmg_meter.start_time end
-- For you, the damage you took and that per minute of combat, as in the Detail view. local taken = "" if player.is_self then taken = string.format(" @D| @rTaken %s @D(@r%s/min@D)", short_value(math.floor(player.received or 0)), player.received_pm and short_value(math.floor(player.received_pm)) or "--") end
-- Their heals, if any: on self, on leader and on others, each with its casts. local heals = "" if DmgMeterHealVal(player, "est") > 0 then heals = DmgMeterHealText(player, "est") end
local attacks = player.attacks or {} local sorted_atks = DmgMeterCollapseMinor( DmgMeterSortAttacks(attacks, "dmg", player.combat_secs)) if #sorted_atks == 0 then local msg = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @W%s @D[@R%s @D| @G%s DPS @D| @w%s%s@D] %s", player.name, short_value(math.floor(player.damage or 0)), MeterDpsStr(player.dps), FormatMeterTime(elapsed), taken, heals ~= "" and heals or "@wNo attack breakdown") Report(channel, msg) return end
local parts = {} local total_atk_dmg = 0 for _, a in ipairs(sorted_atks) do total_atk_dmg = total_atk_dmg + a.dmg end for i, atk in ipairs(sorted_atks) do local pct = total_atk_dmg > 0 and (atk.dmg / total_atk_dmg) * 100 or 0 local dps = MeterDps(atk.dmg, player.combat_secs) local crit_pct = atk.hits > 0 and (atk.crits / atk.hits) * 100 or 0 parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@w%d.@W%s @D(@R%s@D/@G%s@D/@Y%.1f%%@D/@C%s @D- @w%.1f%%@D)", i, atk.name, short_value(atk.dmg), MeterDpsStr(dps), crit_pct, MeterAvgHitStr(atk), pct) end local msg = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @W%s @D[@R%s @D| @G%s DPS @D| @w%s%s@D] @WAttacks @D(@Rdmg@D/@Gdps@D/@Ycrit@D/@Cavg@D): %s%s", player.name, short_value(math.floor(player.damage or 0)), MeterDpsStr(player.dps), FormatMeterTime(elapsed), taken, table.concat(parts, " "), heals ~= "" and (" @D| " .. heals) or "") Report(channel, msg) end
function ReloadDmgMeterFont() local dm = config.dmg_meter or {} WindowFont(dmg_win, dmg_font, dm.font_name or "Consolas", dm.font_size or 9, dm.font_bold or 0, false, false, false, 0) end
-- The damage meter's window settings live in config.dmg_meter with its font, so a -- reload brings it back as it was: shown or hidden, size, tab, sorts, minimalist. -- It comes back ready rather than running: press Start (cdt dmg meter start), or -- turn on cdt dmg meter auto to have it start when play begins. -- A running (or paused) meter measures the session's damage counters against a -- baseline taken when it started. A new session sets those counters back to zero, -- which left the baseline above them: the meter read 0 until you out-damaged the -- old session. Before the reset, remember where the counters were; after it, move -- the baseline (and a pause's endpoint) down by the same amount, so what the meter -- had already counted carries over. local function DmgMeterShift(t, by) if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end local out = {} for k, v in pairs(t) do out[k] = v end for k, v in pairs(by or {}) do if type(v) == "number" then out[k] = (tonumber(out[k]) or 0) - v elseif type(v) == "table" then out[k] = DmgMeterShift(type(out[k]) == "table" and out[k] or {}, v) elseif out[k] == nil then -- A label (a healer's or target's name as printed): kept, so a row that -- now lives only in the baseline still shows its name. out[k] = v end end return out end
function DmgMeterBeforeSessionReset() if not (dmg_meter.tracking or dmg_meter.stopped) then return nil end return {self = DmgMeterSnapshotSelf(), group = DmgMeterSnapshotGroup()} end
function DmgMeterAfterSessionReset(before) if not before then return end dmg_meter.baseline = DmgMeterShift(dmg_meter.baseline or {}, before.self) dmg_meter.group_baseline = DmgMeterShift(dmg_meter.group_baseline or {}, before.group) if dmg_meter.stopped then dmg_meter.endpoint = DmgMeterShift(dmg_meter.endpoint or {}, before.self) dmg_meter.group_endpoint = DmgMeterShift(dmg_meter.group_endpoint or {}, before.group) end dmg_meter.dirty = true end
function DmgMeterSaveSettings() config.dmg_meter = config.dmg_meter or {} local dm = config.dmg_meter dm.active = dmg_meter.active dm.tracking = nil dm.w, dm.h = dmg_meter.w, dmg_meter.h dm.minimalist = dmg_meter.minimalist dm.heal_est = dmg_meter.heal_est dm.tab, dm.sort, dm.detail_sort = dmg_meter.tab, dmg_meter.sort, dmg_meter.detail_sort end
function DmgMeterLoadSettings() local dm = config.dmg_meter or {} if dm.active ~= nil then dmg_meter.active = dm.active and true or false end if tonumber(dm.w) then dmg_meter.w = math.max(dmg_meter.min_w, math.floor(tonumber(dm.w))) end if tonumber(dm.h) then dmg_meter.h = math.max(dmg_meter.min_h, math.floor(tonumber(dm.h))) end if dm.minimalist ~= nil then dmg_meter.minimalist = dm.minimalist and true or false end dmg_meter.heal_est = dm.heal_est and true or false if dm.tab == "group" or dm.tab == "detail" then dmg_meter.tab = dm.tab end dmg_meter.sort = DmgMeterValidSort(dm.sort or dmg_meter.sort, DMG_SORT_MODES) dmg_meter.detail_sort = DmgMeterValidSort(dm.detail_sort or dmg_meter.detail_sort, DMG_DETAIL_SORTS) end
function InitDmgMeterWindow() DmgMeterLoadSettings() local bg = GetThemeColor("PRIMARY_BODY", "black") local windowinfo = movewindow.install(dmg_win, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location, false, nil, {mouseup=DmgMeterMouseUp}) WindowCreate(dmg_win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, dmg_meter.w, dmg_meter.h, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, bg) local dm = config.dmg_meter or {} WindowFont(dmg_win, dmg_font, dm.font_name or "Consolas", dm.font_size or 9, dm.font_bold or 0, false, false, false, 0) movewindow.add_drag_handler(dmg_win, 0, 0, 0, 0)
local mwi = _G["mw_" .. dmg_win .. "_movewindow_info"] if mwi then local orig_mousedown = mwi.mousedown mwi.mousedown = function(flags, id) if DmgMeterRightCheck(flags) then return end if orig_mousedown then orig_mousedown(flags, id) end end local drag_hs = "zz_mw_" .. dmg_win .. "_movewindow_hotspot" WindowScrollwheelHandler(dmg_win, drag_hs, "DmgMeterScrollWheel") end
if IsPluginInstalled("462b665ecb569efbf261422f") then CallPlugin("462b665ecb569efbf261422f", "registerMiniwindow", dmg_win) end
if dmg_meter.active then WindowShow(dmg_win, true) EnableTimer("cdt_dmg_tick", dmg_meter.tracking) dmg_meter.dirty = true DmgMeterDoDraw() else WindowShow(dmg_win, false) end end
-- ============================================================================= -- DAILY TOTALS -- ============================================================================= function UpdateDailyTotals() if not db then return end local today = TZDate("%Y-%m-%d") local day_start = TZTime({year=tonumber(TZDate("%Y")), month=tonumber(TZDate("%m")), day=tonumber(TZDate("%d")), hour=0, min=0, sec=0})
local prev = db_query_one(string.format([[ SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_xp),0) as xp, COALESCE(SUM(total_qp),0) as qp, COALESCE(SUM(total_tp),0) as tp, COALESCE(SUM(total_gold),0) as gold, COALESCE(SUM(total_trains),0) as trains, COALESCE(SUM(total_pracs),0) as pracs, COALESCE(SUM(levels),0) as levels, COALESCE(SUM(pups),0) as pups, COALESCE(SUM(quests_done),0) as quests, COALESCE(SUM(cps_done),0) as cps, COALESCE(SUM(gqs_joined),0) as gqs, COALESCE(SUM(active_secs),0) as active_secs FROM sessions WHERE start_time >= %d AND end_time > 0 AND session_id != %d ]], day_start, state.session.id))
local t_xp = (tonumber(prev.xp) or 0) + state.session.xp local t_qp = (tonumber(prev.qp) or 0) + state.session.qp local t_tp = (tonumber(prev.tp) or 0) + state.session.tp local t_gold = (tonumber(prev.gold) or 0) + state.session.gold local t_trains = (tonumber(prev.trains) or 0) + state.session.trains local t_pracs = (tonumber(prev.pracs) or 0) + state.session.pracs local t_levels = (tonumber(prev.levels) or 0) + state.session.levels local t_pups = (tonumber(prev.pups) or 0) + state.session.pups local t_quests = (tonumber(prev.quests) or 0) + state.session.quests_done local t_cps = (tonumber(prev.cps) or 0) + state.session.cps_done local t_gqs = (tonumber(prev.gqs) or 0) + state.session.gqs_joined local t_kills_row = db_query_one(string.format([[ SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM kills WHERE time >= %d]], day_start)) local t_kills = (t_kills_row and tonumber(t_kills_row.cnt) or 0) local t_active = (tonumber(prev.active_secs) or 0) + GetActiveTime()
db_exec(string.format([[INSERT OR REPLACE INTO daily_totals (date, xp, qp, tp, gold, trains, pracs, levels, pups, quests, campaigns, gquests, kills, active_secs, primary_class) VALUES (%s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s)]], fixsql(today), t_xp, t_qp, t_tp, t_gold, t_trains, t_pracs, t_levels, t_pups, t_quests, t_cps, t_gqs, t_kills, t_active, fixsql(state.current.subclass))) end
-- ============================================================================= -- ESTIMATION ENGINE -- ============================================================================= local DAY_NAMES = {"Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"}
function QueryRawTotals(cutoff, dow_filter) local function tf(col) local f = string.format("%s >= %d", col, cutoff) if dow_filter then f = f .. string.format( " AND CAST(strftime('%%w', datetime(%s, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')) AS INTEGER) = %d", col, dow_filter) end return f end
local val = function(row) return tonumber(row.v) or 0 end
local xp_kill = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus),0) as v FROM kills WHERE %s", tf("time"))) local xp_cp = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp),0) as v FROM campaigns WHERE %s AND failed=0", tf("end_time"))) local xp_earn = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) as v FROM earnings WHERE currency='xp' AND %s", tf("time"))) local total_xp = val(xp_kill) + val(xp_cp) + val(xp_earn)
local qp_q = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(totqp),0) as v FROM quests WHERE %s AND failed=0", tf("end_time"))) local qp_cp = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qp),0) as v FROM campaigns WHERE %s AND failed=0", tf("end_time"))) local qp_gq = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qp_mobs + qp_win),0) as v FROM gquests WHERE %s", tf("end_time"))) local qp_earn = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) as v FROM earnings WHERE currency='qp' AND %s", tf("time"))) local total_qp = val(qp_q) + val(qp_cp) + val(qp_gq) + val(qp_earn)
local tp_q = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tp),0) as v FROM quests WHERE %s AND failed=0", tf("end_time"))) local tp_cp = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tp),0) as v FROM campaigns WHERE %s AND failed=0", tf("end_time"))) local tp_gq = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tp),0) as v FROM gquests WHERE %s", tf("end_time"))) local tp_earn = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) as v FROM earnings WHERE currency='tp' AND %s", tf("time"))) local total_tp = val(tp_q) + val(tp_cp) + val(tp_gq) + val(tp_earn)
local gold_row = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) as v FROM gold_log WHERE %s", tf("time")))
local tr_lvl = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(trains_gain + bonus_trains + blessing_trains + instinct_trains),0) as v FROM levels WHERE %s", tf("end_time"))) local tr_q = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) as v FROM quests WHERE %s AND failed=0", tf("end_time"))) local tr_cp = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) as v FROM campaigns WHERE %s AND failed=0", tf("end_time"))) local tr_gq = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) as v FROM gquests WHERE %s", tf("end_time"))) local tr_earn = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) as v FROM earnings WHERE currency='trains' AND %s", tf("time"))) local total_trains = val(tr_lvl) + val(tr_q) + val(tr_cp) + val(tr_gq) + val(tr_earn)
local kills_row = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COUNT(*) as v FROM kills WHERE %s", tf("time"))) local lvl_row = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COUNT(*) as v FROM levels WHERE type='level' AND %s", tf("end_time"))) local pup_row = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COUNT(*) as v FROM levels WHERE type='pup' AND %s", tf("end_time")))
local active_row = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(active_secs),0) as v, MIN(start_time) as first_start FROM sessions WHERE %s AND end_time > 0", tf("start_time")))
return { xp = total_xp, qp = total_qp, tp = total_tp, gold = val(gold_row), trains = total_trains, kills = val(kills_row), levels = val(lvl_row), pups = val(pup_row), active_secs = val(active_row), first_start = tonumber(active_row.first_start), } end
function GetEstimatePerHour(lookback_days) if not db then return nil end local now = os.time() local dow = tonumber(TZDate("%w")) local dow_name = DAY_NAMES[dow + 1] local cutoff = now - (lookback_days * 86400)
local totals = QueryRawTotals(cutoff, dow) local active_secs = totals.active_secs local dow_count = CountActiveDays(cutoff, dow) local day_specific = true
if active_secs < 3600 or dow_count < 3 then totals = QueryRawTotals(cutoff, nil) active_secs = totals.active_secs day_specific = false end if active_secs < 3600 then return nil end
local active_hours = active_secs / 3600 local fields = {"xp", "qp", "tp", "gold", "trains", "levels", "pups", "kills"} local result = {} for _, f in ipairs(fields) do result[f] = math.floor(totals[f] / active_hours) end result.active_hours = active_hours if day_specific then result.day_specific = true result.day_name = dow_name else result.day_specific = false local first = totals.first_start or cutoff result.data_days = math.floor((now - first) / 86400) end return result end
function GetAvgActiveHours(lookback_days) if not db then return nil end local cutoff = os.time() - (lookback_days * 86400) local rows = db_query(string.format([[ SELECT date(time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') as day, MAX(time) - MIN(time) as span FROM kills WHERE time >= %d GROUP BY date(time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ]], cutoff)) if #rows < 1 then return nil end local total_span = 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do total_span = total_span + (tonumber(r.span) or 0) end return (total_span / #rows) / 3600 end
function GetEstimateForPeriod(lookback_days, period_days) if not db then return nil end local now = os.time() local cutoff = now - (lookback_days * 86400)
local totals = QueryRawTotals(cutoff, nil) if totals.active_secs < 300 then return nil end
local first_start = totals.first_start or cutoff local actual_span = now - first_start if actual_span < 86400 then actual_span = 86400 end local actual_days = actual_span / 86400
local scale = period_days / actual_days local fields = {"xp", "qp", "tp", "gold", "trains", "levels", "pups", "kills"} local result = {} for _, f in ipairs(fields) do result[f] = math.floor(totals[f] * scale) end result.active_hours = (totals.active_secs / 3600) / actual_days result.data_days = math.floor(actual_days) return result end
function CountActiveDays(cutoff, dow_filter) if not db then return 0 end local sql = string.format( "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date(time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')) as c FROM kills WHERE time >= %d", cutoff) if dow_filter then sql = sql .. string.format( " AND CAST(strftime('%%w', datetime(time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')) AS INTEGER) = %d", dow_filter) end local row = db_query_one(sql) return row and (tonumber(row.c) or 0) or 0 end
function BuildDailyResult(totals, num_days, label) if totals.active_secs < 300 then return nil end local fields = {"xp", "qp", "tp", "gold", "trains", "levels", "pups", "kills"} local result = {} for _, f in ipairs(fields) do result[f] = math.floor(totals[f] / num_days) end result.active_hours = (totals.active_secs / 3600) / num_days result.data_days = num_days result.label = label return result end
function GetEstimateDaily(lookback_days) if not db then return nil end local now = os.time() local cutoff = now - (lookback_days * 86400) local dow = tonumber(TZDate("%w")) local dow_name = DAY_NAMES[dow + 1]
local dow_totals = QueryRawTotals(cutoff, dow) local dow_count = CountActiveDays(cutoff, dow) if dow_totals.active_secs >= 3600 and dow_count >= 3 then local result = BuildDailyResult(dow_totals, dow_count, dow_name .. "s") if result then return result end end
local is_weekend = (dow == 0 or dow == 6) local wk_totals if is_weekend then local sat = QueryRawTotals(cutoff, 6) local sun = QueryRawTotals(cutoff, 0) wk_totals = {} for _, f in ipairs({"xp","qp","tp","gold","trains","kills","levels","pups","active_secs"}) do wk_totals[f] = (sat[f] or 0) + (sun[f] or 0) end wk_totals.first_start = math.min(sat.first_start or now, sun.first_start or now) else wk_totals = {xp=0,qp=0,tp=0,gold=0,trains=0,kills=0,levels=0,pups=0,active_secs=0,first_start=now} for d = 1, 5 do local dt = QueryRawTotals(cutoff, d) for _, f in ipairs({"xp","qp","tp","gold","trains","kills","levels","pups","active_secs"}) do wk_totals[f] = wk_totals[f] + (dt[f] or 0) end if dt.first_start then wk_totals.first_start = math.min(wk_totals.first_start, dt.first_start) end end end local wk_label = is_weekend and "weekend" or "weekday" local wk_match_count = 0 if is_weekend then wk_match_count = CountActiveDays(cutoff, 0) + CountActiveDays(cutoff, 6) else for d = 1, 5 do wk_match_count = wk_match_count + CountActiveDays(cutoff, d) end end if wk_totals.active_secs >= 3600 and wk_match_count >= 3 then local result = BuildDailyResult(wk_totals, wk_match_count, wk_label) if result then return result end end
return GetEstimateForPeriod(lookback_days, 1) end
function GetEstimatePastHour() if not db then return nil end local now = os.time() local cutoff = now - 3600
local totals = QueryRawTotals(cutoff, nil) if totals.kills < 1 then return nil end
local first_kill = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT MIN(time) as t FROM kills WHERE time >= %d", cutoff)) local first = first_kill and tonumber(first_kill.t) or cutoff local elapsed = now - first if elapsed < 60 then return nil end
local scale = 3600 / elapsed local fields = {"xp", "qp", "tp", "gold", "trains", "levels", "pups", "kills"} local result = {} for _, f in ipairs(fields) do result[f] = math.floor(totals[f] * scale) end return result end
function ScaleEstimate(daily_est, multiplier) local fields = {"xp", "qp", "tp", "gold", "trains", "levels", "pups", "kills"} local result = {} for _, f in ipairs(fields) do result[f] = math.floor((daily_est[f] or 0) * multiplier) end return result end
function GetEstimates() if not db then return nil end local est = {} est.past_hour = GetEstimatePastHour() est.hourly = GetEstimatePerHour(7) est.daily = GetEstimateDaily(30)
if est.daily then est.weekly = ScaleEstimate(est.daily, 7)
local first_row = db_query_one( "SELECT MIN(time) as t FROM kills") local data_span = 0 if first_row and first_row.t then data_span = (os.time() - (tonumber(first_row.t) or os.time())) / 86400 end
if data_span >= 14 then est.monthly = ScaleEstimate(est.daily, 30) end if data_span >= 60 then est.yearly = ScaleEstimate(est.daily, 365) end end
if not est.past_hour and not est.hourly and not est.daily then return nil end return est end
-- ============================================================================= -- PLAYER TOTALS -- ============================================================================= function GetPlayerTotal(key) if not db then return 0 end local row = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT value FROM player_totals WHERE key = %s", fixsql(key))) return row and (tonumber(row.value) or 0) or 0 end
function SetPlayerTotal(key, value) if not db then return end db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO player_totals (key, value, updated_time) VALUES (%s, %d, %d)", fixsql(key), value, os.time())) end
function TrackPlayerPup(pup_num) state.player_totals.pups = (state.player_totals.pups or 0) + 1 SetPlayerTotal("pups", state.player_totals.pups) CheckMilestones("pup", state.player_totals.pups) DebugNote("Lifetime pups now: " .. state.player_totals.pups .. " (remort pup #" .. (pup_num or 0) .. ")") end
-- ============================================================================= -- WHOIS PARSING (lifetime totals) -- ============================================================================= function RequestWhois() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois", true) AddTimer("cdt_whois_timeout", 0, 0, 5.0, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot, "OnWhoisTimeout") SendNoEcho("whois") DebugNote("Sent whois for lifetime totals") end
function OnWhoisHeader(name, line, wildcards) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_gag", true) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_free", true) -- "[201 T9 Eldar MLT] (OPK) (HARDCORE) pretitle Name title (Male Navigator)": -- the flags come straight after the "]", before the pretitle, so only that run -- is read - a title of someone's own choosing can say anything. local rest = line:match("%]%s*(.*)") or "" local opk, hardcore = 0, 0 while true do local flag, tail = rest:match("^%((%u+)%)%s*(.*)$") if not flag then break end if flag == "OPK" then opk = 1 end if flag == "HARDCORE" then hardcore = 1 end rest = tail end if state.current.opk ~= opk or state.current.hardcore ~= hardcore then DebugNote(string.format("PK flags: OPK=%d HARDCORE=%d", opk, hardcore)) end state.current.opk, state.current.hardcore = opk, hardcore state_save() ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Reading whois...") end
function OnWhoisStatsStart(name, line, wildcards) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_free", false) end
function OnWhoisTimeout() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_gag", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_free", false) DebugNote("Whois timed out") AutoSnapshot() end
function OnWhoisEnd(name, line, wildcards) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_gag", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_free", false) pcall(DeleteTimer, "cdt_whois_timeout") DebugNote("Whois capture complete") DoAfterSpecial(1, "AutoSnapshot()", sendto.script) end
function OnWhoisQPEarned(name, line, wildcards) local qp = tonumber(wildcards.qp_earned) or 0 if qp > 0 then state.player_totals.qp_earned = qp SetPlayerTotal("qp_earned", qp) state.player_totals.whois_seeded = true DebugNote("Whois QP earned: " .. comma_value(qp)) CheckMilestones("qp", qp) GenerateAutoMilestones() end end
function OnWhoisMobsKilled(name, line, wildcards) local mobs = tonumber(wildcards.mobs) or 0 if mobs > 0 then state.player_totals.mobs_killed = mobs SetPlayerTotal("mobs_killed", mobs) DebugNote("Whois mobs killed: " .. comma_value(mobs)) end end
function OnWhoisPowerups(name, line, wildcards) local pups = tonumber(wildcards.pups) or 0 if pups > 0 then state.player_totals.pups = pups SetPlayerTotal("pups", pups) DebugNote("Whois lifetime pups: " .. comma_value(pups)) CheckMilestones("pup", pups) GenerateAutoMilestones() end end
-- ============================================================================= -- MILESTONES (future targets with achievement tracking) -- ============================================================================= function AddMilestone(mtype, name, target_value, auto) if not db then return false end local existing = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT milestone_id FROM milestones WHERE name = %s", fixsql(name))) if existing then return false end db_exec(string.format([[INSERT INTO milestones (type, name, target_value, achieved, achieved_time, created_time, auto_generated) VALUES (%s, %s, %d, 0, 0, %d, %d)]], fixsql(mtype), fixsql(name), target_value, os.time(), auto and 1 or 0)) return true end
function DeleteMilestone(name) if not db then return false end db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM milestones WHERE name = %s", fixsql(name))) return true end
function UpdateMilestone(name, new_target) if not db then return false end db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE milestones SET target_value = %d, achieved = 0, achieved_time = 0 WHERE name = %s", new_target, fixsql(name))) return true end
function CheckMilestones(mtype, current_value) if not db then return end local rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT * FROM milestones WHERE type = %s AND achieved = 0 AND target_value <= %d", fixsql(mtype), current_value)) for _, m in ipairs(rows) do db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE milestones SET achieved = 1, achieved_time = %d WHERE milestone_id = %d", os.time(), m.milestone_id)) if EventOn("milestone") then local chan = EventChannel("milestone") Report(chan, string.format( "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@Y*** @WMILESTONE REACHED @Y*** @D| @w%s @D| @W%s @w%s @D| @w%s@D]", m.name, comma_value(m.target_value), m.type, ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))) end DebugNote("Milestone achieved: " .. m.name) end if #rows > 0 then GenerateAutoMilestones() end end
function GenerateAutoMilestones() if not db then return end local qp_interval = config.auto_milestone_qp or AUTO_MILESTONE_QP_INTERVAL local pup_interval = config.auto_milestone_pup or AUTO_MILESTONE_PUP_INTERVAL
local current_qp = state.player_totals.qp_earned or 0 if current_qp > 0 and qp_interval > 0 then local next_qp = math.ceil(current_qp / qp_interval) * qp_interval for i = 0, 2 do local target = next_qp + (i * qp_interval) local name = string.format("%s QP earned", short_value(target)) AddMilestone("qp", name, target, true) end end
local current_pups = state.player_totals.pups or 0 if current_pups > 0 and pup_interval > 0 then local next_pup = math.ceil(current_pups / pup_interval) * pup_interval for i = 0, 2 do local target = next_pup + (i * pup_interval) local name = string.format("%s powerups", comma_value(target)) AddMilestone("pup", name, target, true) end end
local mob_interval = config.auto_milestone_mob or AUTO_MILESTONE_MOB_INTERVAL local current_mobs = state.player_totals.mobs_killed or 0 if current_mobs > 0 and mob_interval > 0 then local next_mob = math.ceil(current_mobs / mob_interval) * mob_interval for i = 0, 2 do local target = next_mob + (i * mob_interval) local name = string.format("%s mobs killed", short_value(target)) AddMilestone("mob", name, target, true) end end end

Everything goes into the database; 'this"}, {"silver", " session' means since you logged in or reloaded the plugin."}, {"silver", " Type 'cdt gains' for the command list, or 'cdt help <topic>' below."}, {"white", ""}, {"white", " Subcommands (cdt gains <subcommand>, help topic in brackets)"}, {"silver", " report <type> [scope] all time or a span, one kind (report)"}, {"silver", " rate current XP rates and session rates (rate)"}, {"silver", " estimate projected earnings, hourly to yearly (estimate)"}, {"silver", " history <type> [n] the last n events, newest first (history)"}, {"silver", " subclass levels, pups, gold and XP by subclass (subclass)"}, {"silver", " race the same by race (race)"}, {"silver", " combo the same by race + subclass (combo)"}, {"silver", " area [filters] XP and gold rates per area (area)"}, {"silver", " area quest [sort] where quests send you, what they pay (area)"}, {"silver", " area bloot [scope] bloot by area, and the mobs behind it (area)"}, {"silver", " best [scope] personal records: fastest, best day (best)"}, {"silver", " compare <period> this period so far against the last (compare)"}, {"silver", " milestone lifetime targets (QP, pups, mobs) (milestone)"}, {"silver", " goal <type> <n> a target for this session (goal)"}, {"silver", " track record a stretch of play by itself (track)"}, {"silver", " meter the floating gains meter window (meter)"}, {"silver", " 'class' still works in place of 'subclass'."}, {"white", ""}, {"white", " Sessions and Active Time"}, {"silver", " A session starts when you log in or the plugin loads, and ends when you"}, {"silver", " log out, disconnect or reload. Active time is session time minus time"}, {"silver", " spent AFK ('You are now in AFK mode.' to 'AFK mode removed.')."}, {"silver", " Session per-hour figures divide by active time."}, }, }, dmg = { title = "cdt dmg", lines = { {"white", " Damage Tracking"}, {"silver", " Reads every damage line: your hits (by attack and damage type), damage"}, {"silver", " you take, and each groupmate's damage. Dates are in your timezone"}, {"silver", " (cdt config timezone); see 'cdt help config'."}, {"white", ""}, {"white", " Solo and Group"}, {"silver", " solo or group (or grouped) keeps only the damage recorded while you were"}, {"silver", " solo, or in a group. -- Help text colours, applied as a line prints so every topic reads the same way: -- headers yellow, cdt commands cyan with a softer description, option names yellow, -- examples green, sample report lines dim. Commands mentioned in prose are cyan. function HelpSegments(args, text, base) local function add(color, str) args[#args + 1] = color; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = str end local from, pos = 1, 1 while true do local s, e = text:find("cdt [%l_]+", pos) if not s then break end if s > 1 and text:sub(s - 1, s - 1):match("[%w_]") then pos = e + 1 -- part of a longer word: leave it in the plain text else local _, e2 = text:find("^ [%l_]+", e + 1) if e2 then e = e2 end if s > from then add(base, text:sub(from, s - 1)) end add("cyan", text:sub(s, e)) from, pos = e + 1, e + 1 end end if from <= #text then add(base, text:sub(from)) end return args end
-- The ColourNote arguments for one line of help text. function HelpLineArgs(color, text) -- a sample report line after the text: "power up. [Pup lifetime #491686 | ...]" local head, br_gap, bracket = text:match("^(.-%S)(%s%s%s+)(%[[^%]]*%])$") if head and not head:match("^%s*%[") then local args = HelpLineArgs(color, head) args[#args + 1] = "silver"; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = br_gap args[#args + 1] = "gray"; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = bracket return args end -- only a sample line: " [Pup remort #405686 | ...]", "[CDT] [Quest ...]" local br_ind, br = text:match("^(%s+)(%[.*)$") if br_ind then return {"silver", "", br_ind, "gray", "", br} end -- " e.g. cdt events quest channel gt" local eg_ind, eg_rest = text:match("^(%s+)e%.g%.(.*)$") if eg_ind then return {"silver", "", eg_ind, "dimgray", "", "e.g.", "lime", "", eg_rest} end -- " cdt events <event> on : Print this event's line" local ind, cmd, gap, desc = text:match("^(%s+)(cdt .-%S)(%s+: )(.*)$") if cmd then return HelpSegments({"silver", "", ind, "cyan", "", cmd, "dimgray", "", gap}, desc, "silver") end -- " cdt tier [token] a tier in 20-level groups"; two commands side by side are an example ind, cmd, gap, desc = text:match("^(%s+)(cdt .-%S)(%s%s+)(.*)$") if cmd then if desc:match("^cdt ") then return {"lime", "", text} end return HelpSegments({"silver", "", ind, "cyan", "", cmd, "silver", "", gap}, desc, "silver") end -- command syntax on its own: " cdt config timezone [offset|machine]" if text:match("^%s+cdt ") and not text:match("%.%s") and not text:match("%.$") then return {"cyan", "", text} end -- " gains <date> : Archive gains data before date" local k_ind, key, k_gap, k_rest = text:match("^(%s%s%s%s?%s?)(%S.-%S)(%s+: )(.*)$") if key and #key <= 34 then return HelpSegments({"silver", "", k_ind, "yellow", "", key, "dimgray", "", k_gap}, k_rest, color) end -- a description carried onto the next line: " : Add a new milestone" local c_ind, c_rest = text:match("^(%s+): (.*)$") if c_ind then return HelpSegments({"silver", "", c_ind, "dimgray", "", ": "}, c_rest, color) end -- a short key, possibly several words, then a wide gap: " <from> <to> a date ...", -- " report <type> [ch] this session ..." local p_ind, ph, p_gap, p_rest = text:match("^(%s%s%s%s?%s?)(%S.-%S)(%s%s%s+)(.*)$") if ph and #ph <= 32 then return HelpSegments({"silver", "", p_ind, "yellow", "", ph, "silver", "", p_gap}, p_rest, color) end -- " remort This remort's powerup number" local o_ind, word, o_gap, o_rest = text:match("^(%s%s%s%s?%s?)(%S+)(%s%s+)(.*)$") if o_ind and #word <= 14 then return HelpSegments({"silver", "", o_ind, "yellow", "", word, "silver", "", o_gap}, o_rest, color) end -- a list of names: " xp, gold, loot, sac, tax, groupdmg, groupheal, allheal, enemydmg" if text:match("^%s+[%l%d_]+,[%l%d_, ]*$") then return {"yellow", "", text} end return HelpSegments({}, text, color) end
function HelpLine(color, text) text = text or "" if text == "" then Note("") return end if color == "white" then ColourNote("yellow", "", text) return end ColourNote(unpack(HelpLineArgs(color, text))) end

-- ============================================================================= -- GAINS HISTORY: cdt gains history <type> [count] -- The most recent events of one kind, newest first, each laid out for its kind. -- ============================================================================= HISTORY_DEFAULT = 10 HISTORY_MAX = 100 HISTORY_VIEWS = { xp = "HistoryXP", gold = "HistoryGold", qp = "HistoryQP", quest = "HistoryQuest", cp = "HistoryCP", gq = "HistoryGQ", level = "HistoryLevel", powerup = "HistoryPup", pup = "HistoryPup", pups = "HistoryPup", powerups = "HistoryPup", levels = "HistoryLevel", session = "HistorySession", all = "HistoryAll", tp = "HistoryTP", trivia = "HistoryTP", trains = "HistoryTrains", train = "HistoryTrains", } HISTORY_ORDER = {"xp", "gold", "qp", "tp", "trains", "quest", "cp", "gq", "level", "powerup", "session", "all"}
function HistoryWhen(ts) ts = tonumber(ts) or 0 if ts <= 0 then return "-" end return ShowDate("%m/%d %H:%M:%S", ts) end
function HistoryLvl(l) l = tonumber(l) or 0 if l >= 201 then return "SH" end if l <= 0 then return "-" end return tostring(l) end
function HistoryTook(secs) secs = tonumber(secs) or 0 if secs <= 0 then return "-" end -- Whole seconds are shown whole: a quest recorded before v4.0, or one timed on -- the whole-second clock, has no tenths to report. if secs < 60 then if secs == math.floor(secs) then return string.format("%ds", secs) end return string.format("%.1fs", secs) end -- A campaign can run for hours: the column holds 9 characters, so drop to -- hours and minutes rather than let 1h 05m 12s be cut short. if secs >= 86400 then return string.format("%dd %02dh", math.floor(secs / 86400), math.floor((secs % 86400) / 3600)) end if secs >= 3600 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", math.floor(secs / 3600), math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60)) end return FormatTimeShort(secs) end
-- Rows from several queries, newest first, cut to n. function HistoryMerge(n, ...) local all = {} for _, rows in ipairs({...}) do for _, r in ipairs(rows) do all[#all + 1] = r end end table.sort(all, function(a, b) return (tonumber(a.t) or 0) > (tonumber(b.t) or 0) end) local out = {} for i = 1, math.min(n, #all) do out[i] = all[i] end return out end
function HistoryShow(label, cols, grid) local what = label ~= "" and (label .. " ") or "" if #grid == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No " .. what .. "events recorded yet.") return end RenderTable(cols, grid, {indent = 1, title = string.format("Last %d %sevent%s, newest first", #grid, what, #grid == 1 and "" or "s")}) local zone = TZLabel() ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Times are " .. (zone and zone or "this computer's local time") .. ".") end
-- "22+9tier+1opk", with anything GMCP didn't itemise shown as daily/other. function QuestQPBreakdown(r) local base = tonumber(r.qp) or 0 local parts, sum = {tostring(base)}, base for _, b in ipairs({{"tier_qp", "tier"}, {"lucky_qp", "lucky"}, {"mccp_qp", "mccp"}, {"opk_qp", "opk"}, {"hc_qp", "hc"}}) do local v = tonumber(r[b[1]]) or 0 if v > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = v .. b[2] sum = sum + v end end local rest = (tonumber(r.totqp) or 0) - sum if rest > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = rest .. ((tonumber(r.daily) or 0) == 1 and "daily" or "other") end return table.concat(parts, "+") end
function HistoryRewards(r) local parts = {} if (tonumber(r.gold) or 0) > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = comma_value(r.gold) .. "g" end if (tonumber(r.tp) or 0) > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = r.tp .. "tp" end if (tonumber(r.trains) or 0) > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = r.trains .. "tr" end if (tonumber(r.pracs) or 0) > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = r.pracs .. "pr" end return table.concat(parts, " ") end
function HistoryXP(n) local rows = HistoryMerge(n, db_query(string.format("SELECT time AS t, 'kill' AS src, mob_name AS mob, xp, xp_rare, xp_bonus, level_num, area " .. "FROM kills ORDER BY time DESC, kill_id DESC LIMIT %d", n)), db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'cp' AS src, 'campaign reward' AS mob, xp, 0 AS xp_rare, 0 AS xp_bonus, " .. "level_num, '' AS area FROM campaigns WHERE failed = 0 AND xp > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", n))) local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do grid[#grid + 1] = {when = HistoryWhen(r.t), src = r.src, xp = tonumber(r.xp) or 0, rare = tonumber(r.xp_rare) or 0, bonus = tonumber(r.xp_bonus) or 0, lvl = HistoryLvl(r.level_num), mob = (r.mob and r.mob ~= "") and r.mob or "-", area = r.area or ""} end HistoryShow("XP", { {key = "when", title = "Time", w = 14, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "src", title = "From", w = 5, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "xp", title = "XP", w = 7, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "rare", title = "Rare", w = 5, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "bonus", title = "Bonus", w = 5, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "lvl", title = "Lvl", w = 3, align = "r", color = "white"}, {key = "mob", title = "Mob", w = 21, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "area", title = "Area", w = 12, align = "l", color = "dimgray"}, }, grid) end
function HistoryGold(n) local rows = HistoryMerge(n, db_query(string.format("SELECT time AS t, source AS src, amount, area FROM gold_log " .. "ORDER BY time DESC, gold_id DESC LIMIT %d", n)), db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'quest' AS src, gold AS amount, mob_area AS area FROM quests " .. "WHERE failed = 0 AND gold > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", n)), db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'cp' AS src, gold AS amount, '' AS area FROM campaigns " .. "WHERE failed = 0 AND gold > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", n)), db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'gq' AS src, gold AS amount, '' AS area FROM gquests " .. "WHERE gold > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", n))) local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do grid[#grid + 1] = {when = HistoryWhen(r.t), src = r.src or "?", gold = tonumber(r.amount) or 0, area = r.area or ""} end HistoryShow("gold", { {key = "when", title = "Time", w = 14, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "src", title = "Source", w = 9, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "gold", title = "Gold", w = 12, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num"}, {key = "area", title = "Area", w = 41, align = "l", color = "dimgray"}, }, grid) end
function HistoryQP(n) local quests = db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'quest' AS src, totqp AS amount, qp, tier_qp, lucky_qp, " .. "mccp_qp, opk_qp, hc_qp, totqp, daily FROM quests WHERE failed = 0 AND totqp > 0 " .. "ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", n)) for _, r in ipairs(quests) do r.detail = QuestQPBreakdown(r) end local cps = db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'cp' AS src, qp AS amount, daily_qp FROM campaigns " .. "WHERE failed = 0 AND qp > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", n)) for _, r in ipairs(cps) do local d = tonumber(r.daily_qp) or 0 r.detail = d > 0 and string.format("%d+%ddaily", (tonumber(r.amount) or 0) - d, d) or "" end local gqs = db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'gq' AS src, qp_mobs + qp_win AS amount, qp_mobs, qp_win, gq_num " .. "FROM gquests WHERE qp_mobs + qp_win > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", n)) for _, r in ipairs(gqs) do r.detail = string.format("GQ #%s: %d mob + %d win", tostring(r.gq_num or "?"), tonumber(r.qp_mobs) or 0, tonumber(r.qp_win) or 0) end local earned = db_query(string.format("SELECT time AS t, source AS src, amount, '' AS detail FROM earnings " .. "WHERE currency = 'qp' AND amount <> 0 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT %d", n)) local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(HistoryMerge(n, quests, cps, gqs, earned)) do grid[#grid + 1] = {when = HistoryWhen(r.t), src = r.src or "?", qp = tonumber(r.amount) or 0, detail = r.detail or ""} end HistoryShow("QP", { {key = "when", title = "Time", w = 14, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "src", title = "Source", w = 8, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "qp", title = "QP", w = 6, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "detail", title = "Breakdown", w = 48, align = "l", color = "silver"}, }, grid) end
-- Where each trivia point or train came from, newest first: the reward it was part -- of, a level-up or powerup, a trivia mob, or a gain nothing explained ("other"). local HISTORY_EARNING_SRC = {trivia_mob = "mob", other = "other"}
local function HistoryGainRows(n, currency) local col = currency -- quests, campaigns and gquests name the column the same local quests = db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'quest' AS src, %s AS amount, totqp FROM quests " .. "WHERE failed = 0 AND %s > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", col, col, n)) for _, r in ipairs(quests) do r.detail = comma_value(tonumber(r.totqp) or 0) .. " qp quest" end local cps = db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'cp' AS src, %s AS amount, qp FROM campaigns " .. "WHERE failed = 0 AND %s > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", col, col, n)) for _, r in ipairs(cps) do r.detail = comma_value(tonumber(r.qp) or 0) .. " qp campaign" end local gqs = db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, 'gq' AS src, %s AS amount, gq_num, won FROM gquests " .. "WHERE %s > 0 ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", col, col, n)) for _, r in ipairs(gqs) do r.detail = "GQ #" .. tostring(r.gq_num or "?") .. ((tonumber(r.won) or 0) == 1 and ", won" or "") end local earned = db_query(string.format("SELECT time AS t, source AS src, amount FROM earnings " .. "WHERE currency = '%s' AND amount <> 0 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT %d", currency, n)) for _, r in ipairs(earned) do r.detail = r.src == "trivia_mob" and "a trivia point bonus mob" or (r.src == "other" and "not tied to a reward (trivia, a game ...)" or "") r.src = HISTORY_EARNING_SRC[r.src] or r.src end local sets = {quests, cps, gqs, earned} if currency == "trains" then local lv = db_query(string.format("SELECT end_time AS t, type, level_num, trains_gain, bonus_trains, " .. "blessing_trains, instinct_trains, trains_gain + bonus_trains + blessing_trains + instinct_trains AS amount " .. "FROM levels WHERE trains_gain + bonus_trains + blessing_trains + instinct_trains > 0 " .. "ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT %d", n)) for _, r in ipairs(lv) do r.src = r.type == "pup" and "powerup" or "level" -- The split is only worth showing when there were bonus trains in it. local parts = {tostring(tonumber(r.trains_gain) or 0)} for _, b in ipairs({{"bonus_trains", "lucky"}, {"blessing_trains", "bless"}, {"instinct_trains", "inst"}}) do local v = tonumber(r[b[1]]) or 0 if v > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = v .. b[2] end end local split = #parts > 1 and table.concat(parts, "+") or "" if r.type == "pup" then r.detail = split else r.detail = (split ~= "" and (split .. " ") or "") .. "at level " .. tostring(r.level_num or "?") end end sets[#sets + 1] = lv end local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(HistoryMerge(n, unpack(sets))) do grid[#grid + 1] = {when = HistoryWhen(r.t), src = r.src or "?", amount = tonumber(r.amount) or 0, detail = r.detail or ""} end return grid end

function HistorySession(n) local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format("SELECT session_id, start_time AS t, end_time, active_secs, total_xp, total_qp, " .. "total_gold, levels, pups, quests_done, cps_done, gqs_joined FROM sessions WHERE start_time > 0 " .. "ORDER BY start_time DESC, session_id DESC LIMIT %d", n))) do -- The session in progress only writes its totals when it ends; show them live. local live = game_session_started and tonumber(r.session_id) == tonumber(state.session.id) local ss = state.session local start, finish = tonumber(r.t) or 0, tonumber(r.end_time) or 0 grid[#grid + 1] = {when = HistoryWhen(start), length = live and "now" or (finish > start and ProgressTime(finish - start) or "-"), active = ProgressTime(live and GetActiveTime() or r.active_secs), xp = live and ss.xp or (tonumber(r.total_xp) or 0), qp = live and ss.qp or (tonumber(r.total_qp) or 0), gold = live and ss.gold or (tonumber(r.total_gold) or 0), levels = live and ss.levels or (tonumber(r.levels) or 0), pups = live and ss.pups or (tonumber(r.pups) or 0), qcg = string.format("%d/%d/%d", live and ss.quests_done or (tonumber(r.quests_done) or 0), live and ss.cps_done or (tonumber(r.cps_done) or 0), live and ss.gqs_joined or (tonumber(r.gqs_joined) or 0))} end HistoryShow("session", { {key = "when", title = "Started", w = 14, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "length", title = "Length", w = 8, align = "r", color = "white"}, {key = "active", title = "Active", w = 8, align = "r", color = "white"}, {key = "xp", title = "XP", w = 9, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "qp", title = "QP", w = 6, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "gold", title = "Gold", w = 10, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "levels", title = "Lvls", w = 4, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "pups", title = "Pups", w = 5, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "qcg", title = "Q/C/G", w = 7, align = "r", color = "silver"}, }, grid) end
-- The last n kills, each with the mob gold and bonus loot that dropped from it, plus -- any gold that didn't come from a kill. Gold and loot lines follow the kill's XP line, -- so each belongs to the latest kill at most KILL_LOOT_SECS before it. KILL_LOOT_SECS = 15
function HistoryKillRows(n) local kills = db_query(string.format("SELECT kill_id, time AS t, 'kill' AS kind, mob_name, xp, xp_rare, xp_bonus, " .. "vorpal, deathblow, assassinate, slit, disintegrate, banishment FROM kills ORDER BY time DESC, kill_id DESC LIMIT %d", n)) local golds = db_query(string.format("SELECT time AS t, 'gold' AS kind, source, amount FROM gold_log " .. "ORDER BY time DESC, gold_id DESC LIMIT %d", n * 3)) local bloots = db_query(string.format("SELECT time AS t, tier FROM bloot_log ORDER BY time DESC, bloot_id DESC LIMIT %d", n)) table.sort(kills, function(a, b) local ta, tb = tonumber(a.t) or 0, tonumber(b.t) or 0 if ta ~= tb then return ta < tb end return (tonumber(a.kill_id) or 0) < (tonumber(b.kill_id) or 0) end) -- the latest kill at or before ts, within the window, that passes ok() local function owner(ts, ok) ts = tonumber(ts) or 0 for i = #kills, 1, -1 do local kt = tonumber(kills[i].t) or 0 if kt <= ts then if ts - kt > KILL_LOOT_SECS then return nil end if ok(kills[i]) then return kills[i] end end end return nil end local out = {} for _, k in ipairs(kills) do out[#out + 1] = k end for _, g in ipairs(golds) do local k = g.source == "mob" and owner(g.t, function(k) return not k.gold end) if k then k.gold = tonumber(g.amount) or 0 else out[#out + 1] = g end end for _, b in ipairs(bloots) do local k = owner(b.t, function(k) return not k.bloot end) if k then k.bloot = b.tier end end return out end
-- "a sea hag: 106 xp (+250 rare, +106 bonus), 11,824 gold, Godly bloot, vorpal" function HistoryKillText(r) local xp, rare, bonus = tonumber(r.xp) or 0, tonumber(r.xp_rare) or 0, tonumber(r.xp_bonus) or 0 local extra = {} if rare > 0 then extra[#extra + 1] = "+" .. comma_value(rare) .. " rare" end if bonus > 0 then extra[#extra + 1] = "+" .. comma_value(bonus) .. " bonus" end local parts = {string.format("%s: %s xp%s", (r.mob_name and r.mob_name ~= "") and r.mob_name or "a kill", comma_value(xp), #extra > 0 and (" (" .. table.concat(extra, ", ") .. ")") or "")} if (r.gold or 0) > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = comma_value(r.gold) .. " gold" end if r.bloot then parts[#parts + 1] = BlootCode(r.bloot, true) .. " bloot" end for _, sp in ipairs(KILL_SPECIALS) do if (tonumber(r[sp]) or 0) > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = sp end end return table.concat(parts, ", ") end
function HistoryAll(n) local function q(sql) return db_query(string.format(sql, n)) end local rows = HistoryMerge(n, HistoryKillRows(n), q("SELECT end_time AS t, 'quest' AS kind, failed, mob_name, qp, tier_qp, lucky_qp, mccp_qp, opk_qp, hc_qp, totqp, daily, gold " .. "FROM quests ORDER BY end_time DESC, quest_id DESC LIMIT %d"), q("SELECT end_time AS t, 'cp' AS kind, failed, qp, daily_qp, gold FROM campaigns ORDER BY end_time DESC, cp_id DESC LIMIT %d"), q("SELECT end_time AS t, 'gq' AS kind, gq_num, won, qp_mobs, qp_win, gold FROM gquests ORDER BY end_time DESC, gq_id DESC LIMIT %d"), q("SELECT end_time AS t, type AS kind, level_num, duration, trains_gain, bonus_trains, blessing_trains, instinct_trains " .. "FROM levels ORDER BY end_time DESC, level_id DESC LIMIT %d"), q("SELECT time AS t, 'earned' AS kind, source, currency, amount FROM earnings ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT %d")) local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local kind, text = r.kind, "" if kind == "kill" then text = HistoryKillText(r) elseif kind == "gold" then text = string.format("%s: %s gold", r.source or "?", comma_value(r.amount or 0)) elseif kind == "quest" then if (tonumber(r.failed) or 0) == 1 then text = "failed" .. ((r.mob_name and r.mob_name ~= "") and (": " .. r.mob_name) or "") else text = string.format("%s qp (%s)%s", comma_value(r.totqp or 0), QuestQPBreakdown(r), (tonumber(r.gold) or 0) > 0 and (", " .. comma_value(r.gold) .. " gold") or "") end elseif kind == "cp" then if (tonumber(r.failed) or 0) == 1 then text = "failed" else local d = tonumber(r.daily_qp) or 0 text = string.format("%s qp%s%s", comma_value(r.qp or 0), d > 0 and (" (+" .. d .. " daily)") or "", (tonumber(r.gold) or 0) > 0 and (", " .. comma_value(r.gold) .. " gold") or "") end elseif kind == "gq" then local mobs, win = tonumber(r.qp_mobs) or 0, tonumber(r.qp_win) or 0 text = string.format("GQ #%s %s: %d qp (%d mob + %d win)", tostring(r.gq_num or "?"), (tonumber(r.won) or 0) == 1 and "won" or "finished", mobs + win, mobs, win) elseif kind == "level" or kind == "pup" then local extra = (tonumber(r.bonus_trains) or 0) + (tonumber(r.blessing_trains) or 0) + (tonumber(r.instinct_trains) or 0) text = string.format("%s in %s, %d trains%s", kind == "pup" and ("pup #" .. tostring(r.level_num)) or ("level " .. HistoryLvl(r.level_num)), HistoryTook(r.duration), tonumber(r.trains_gain) or 0, extra > 0 and (" +" .. extra) or "") elseif kind == "earned" then text = string.format("%s: %s %s", r.source or "?", comma_value(r.amount or 0), r.currency or "") end grid[#grid + 1] = {when = HistoryWhen(r.t), kind = kind, text = text} end HistoryShow("", { {key = "when", title = "Time", w = 14, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "kind", title = "Type", w = 6, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "text", title = "Event", w = 57, align = "l", color = "silver"}, }, grid) end
function CmdHistory(name, line, wildcards) if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end local raw = ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local kind, count = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(%S*)$") kind = (kind or ""):lower() local fn_name = HISTORY_VIEWS[kind] if not fn_name then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains history <type> [count]") ColourNote("silver", "", " Types: " .. table.concat(HISTORY_ORDER, ", ")) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" count: how many recent events, newest first (default %d, most %d)", HISTORY_DEFAULT, HISTORY_MAX)) return end local n = HISTORY_DEFAULT if count and count ~= "" then n = tonumber(count) if not n or n < 1 or n ~= math.floor(n) then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] The count must be a whole number from 1 to %d.", HISTORY_MAX)) return end if n > HISTORY_MAX then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format("[CDT] Showing the most recent %d (the most it shows).", HISTORY_MAX)) n = HISTORY_MAX end end FlushKillBuffer() if quest_pending then FinalizeQuestRecord() end _G[fn_name](n) end
-- ============================================================================= -- GAINS DISPATCHER -- ============================================================================= local GAINS_DISPATCH = { report = "CmdReport", rate = "CmdRate", estimate = "CmdEstimate", -- 'class' kept as an alias for 'subclass'; the tracked value has always -- been the subclass, the old name just said otherwise. subclass = "CmdClass", class = "CmdClass", race = "CmdRace", combo = "CmdCombo", area = "CmdArea", milestone = "CmdMilestone", track = "CmdTrack", goal = "CmdGoal", meter = "CmdMeter", history = "CmdHistory", best = "CmdBest", records = "CmdBest", compare = "CmdCompare", }
function CmdGains(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local subcmd, rest = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)") if not subcmd or subcmd == "" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", " CDT Gains Commands") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Reporting") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains report <type> [scope]", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "xp qp gold tp trains, quests, levels...") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains rate ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Current XP/gold/QP rates") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains estimate ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Earning projections (hourly to yearly)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains subclass ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Per-subclass performance") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains race ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Per-race performance") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains combo ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Race+subclass combo breakdown") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains area [filters] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Area XP/gold rates") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains area quest [sort] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Where quests send you, what they pay") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains area bloot [scope] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Bloot by area and mob") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains history <type> [n] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Last n events, newest first (default 10)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains best [scope] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Personal records: fastest, best day") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains compare <week> [full]", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "This week against last") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Milestones & Goals") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains milestone ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "List/add/delete milestones") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains goal <type> <count> ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Session goal (pup/level/quest/kill)") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Sessions & Tracking") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains track ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Manual/auto tracked sessions") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains meter ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Miniwindow metrics display") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " 'cdt help <subcommand>' explains each one, e.g. cdt help report.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) return end
local fn_name = GAINS_DISPATCH[subcmd] if fn_name then local fn = _G[fn_name] if fn then fn(name, line, {rest or ""}) end else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown gains command: " .. subcmd) ColourNote("silver", "", " Available: report, rate, estimate, subclass, race, combo, area,") ColourNote("silver", "", " milestone, goal, track, meter, history, best, compare") end end

-- ============================================================================= -- ARCHIVE DISPATCHER -- ============================================================================= -- ============================================================================= -- ARCHIVE -- Moves records from before a date into a separate SQLite file, so the main -- database stays small. Archived records drop out of every view until they are -- brought back with rehydrate. Lifetime summaries (subclass/race/combo/area stats, -- lifetime totals, milestones) are left as they are. -- ============================================================================= ARCHIVE_TABLES = { gains = { {"sessions", "start_time"}, {"levels", "end_time"}, {"kills", "time"}, {"quests", "end_time"}, {"campaigns", "end_time"}, {"gquests", "end_time"}, {"earnings", "time"}, {"gold_log", "time"}, {"bloot_log", "time"}, {"deaths", "time"}, {"unfinished_fights", "time"}, {"double_xp_log", "start_time"}, {"tracked_sessions", "start_time"}, {"daily_totals", "date"}, }, dmg = { {"attack_stats", "slice_start"}, {"damtype_stats", "slice_start"}, {"area_combat_stats", "slice_start"}, {"player_profiles", "slice_start"}, {"player_attack_stats", "slice_start"}, {"legacy_damage", "slice_start"}, {"heal_log", "time"}, {"heal_given", "time"}, {"group_heals", "time"}, {"damage_taken", "slice_start"}, }, }
-- db:exec with its result checked: true, or false and SQLite's message. function DbRun(sql) local rc = db:exec(sql) if rc ~= sqlite3.OK then return false, db:errmsg() end return true end
function DbTableExists(schema, tbl) return db_query_one(string.format("SELECT name FROM %s.sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = %s", schema, fixsql(tbl))) ~= nil end
-- Columns both copies of a table have, in the order of the first. function DbCommonColumns(schema_a, schema_b, tbl) local in_b = {} for _, c in ipairs(db_query(string.format("PRAGMA %s.table_info(%s)", schema_b, fixsql(tbl)))) do in_b[c.name] = true end local cols = {} for _, c in ipairs(db_query(string.format("PRAGMA %s.table_info(%s)", schema_a, fixsql(tbl)))) do if in_b[c.name] then cols[#cols + 1] = '"' .. c.name .. '"' end end return table.concat(cols, ", ") end
-- A folder to write into, without a trailing slash, or nil after saying why not. -- It must already exist: Lua can't create one without opening a console window. function WritableFolder(dir) dir = (dir or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):gsub('^"(.*)"$', "%1"):gsub("[\\/]+$", "") if dir == "" then return nil end local probe = dir .. "\\cdt_write_test.tmp" local f = io.open(probe, "w") if not f then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Can't write to that folder (it must already exist): " .. dir) return nil end f:close() os.remove(probe) return dir end
function ArchiveDir() local dir = config.archive_dir if dir and dir ~= "" then return (dir:gsub("[\\/]+$", "")) end return db_path:match("^(.*)[\\/][^\\/]*$") or "." end
-- The latest date an archive can reach: the start of today (today's daily totals -- are still being worked out) and of this session (it is still being written). function ArchiveLatestCutoff() local latest = LocalDayStart() local started = tonumber(state.session.start_time) or 0 if started > 0 and started < latest then latest = started end return latest end
function ArchiveWhere(tbl, col, cutoff) if col == "date" then return "date < " .. fixsql(TZDate("%Y-%m-%d", cutoff)) -- daily_totals is keyed by local date end local where = string.format("%s < %d", col, cutoff) if tbl == "sessions" then where = where .. " AND session_id <> " .. (tonumber(state.session.id) or 0) elseif tbl == "tracked_sessions" then local busy = {} for _, key in ipairs({"tracked", "tracked_auto"}) do local t = state[key] if t and t.active and (tonumber(t.db_id) or 0) > 0 then busy[#busy + 1] = tostring(t.db_id) end end if #busy > 0 then where = where .. " AND track_id NOT IN (" .. table.concat(busy, ",") .. ")" end end return where end
-- Rows each table would give up, the total, and the earliest time among them. function ArchiveCounts(kind, cutoff) local counts, total, earliest = {}, 0, nil for _, spec in ipairs(ARCHIVE_TABLES[kind]) do local tbl, col = spec[1], spec[2] if DbTableExists("main", tbl) then local min_expr = col == "date" and "NULL" or ("MIN(" .. col .. ")") local r = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, %s AS first FROM %s WHERE %s", min_expr, tbl, ArchiveWhere(tbl, col, cutoff))) or {} local cnt = tonumber(r.n) or 0 counts[#counts + 1] = {tbl = tbl, n = cnt} total = total + cnt local first = tonumber(r.first) if cnt > 0 and first and (not earliest or first < earliest) then earliest = first end end end return counts, total, earliest or 0 end
function ArchiveShowCounts(kind, cutoff, verb, confirm_cmd) local counts, total = ArchiveCounts(kind, cutoff) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" %s %s records before %s", verb, kind, ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", cutoff))) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) for _, c in ipairs(counts) do if c.n > 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", c.tbl), "white", "", comma_value(c.n)) end end ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "total"), "yellow", "", comma_value(total)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) if total > 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", " To go ahead, type: " .. confirm_cmd) end return total end
-- Moves (or with purge, deletes) the records before cutoff. One transaction: on -- any error nothing is removed and a half-written archive file is deleted. function ArchiveRun(kind, cutoff, purge) if migration_blocked then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] The database is blocked after a failed upgrade; see cdt db.") return end if kind == "gains" then FlushKillBuffer() else FlushCombatBuffer() end local _, total, earliest = ArchiveCounts(kind, cutoff) if total == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No " .. kind .. " records before that date.") return end db_exec([[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS archives ( archive_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, filename TEXT NOT NULL, archive_type TEXT NOT NULL, date_from INTEGER NOT NULL, date_to INTEGER NOT NULL, row_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, rehydrated INTEGER DEFAULT 0);]])
local file local ok, err = true, nil if not purge then file = string.format("%s\\cirrus_archive_%s_before_%s_%s.db", ArchiveDir(), kind, TZDate("%Y%m%d", cutoff), os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")) ok, err = DbRun("ATTACH DATABASE " .. fixsql(file) .. " AS arc;") if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Couldn't create the archive file: " .. tostring(err)) ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. file .. " (cdt archive path sets the folder)") return end end
local moved = 0 ok, err = DbRun("BEGIN;") for _, spec in ipairs(ARCHIVE_TABLES[kind]) do if not ok then break end local tbl, col = spec[1], spec[2] if DbTableExists("main", tbl) then local where = ArchiveWhere(tbl, col, cutoff) if not purge then local ddl = db_query_one("SELECT sql FROM main.sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = " .. fixsql(tbl)) local create = ddl and ddl.sql:gsub("^%s*[Cc][Rr][Ee][Aa][Tt][Ee]%s+[Tt][Aa][Bb][Ll][Ee]%s+[^%(]-%(", 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS arc."' .. tbl .. '" (', 1) ok, err = DbRun((create or "") .. ";") if ok then local cols = DbCommonColumns("main", "arc", tbl) ok, err = DbRun(string.format('INSERT INTO arc."%s" (%s) SELECT %s FROM main."%s" WHERE %s;', tbl, cols, cols, tbl, where)) end end if ok then ok, err = DbRun(string.format('DELETE FROM main."%s" WHERE %s;', tbl, where)) if ok then moved = moved + db:changes() end end end end if ok and not purge then ok, err = DbRun(string.format( "INSERT INTO main.archives (filename, archive_type, date_from, date_to, row_count, hash, created_at) " .. "VALUES (%s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %s, %d);", fixsql(file), fixsql(kind), earliest, cutoff, moved, fixsql("rows:" .. moved), os.time())) end if ok then ok, err = DbRun("COMMIT;") else pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) end if file then pcall(function() db:exec("DETACH DATABASE arc;") end) if not ok then os.remove(file) end end
if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] " .. (purge and "Purge" or "Archive") ..
