" failed and was undone: " .. tostring(err)) return end if purge then ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Deleted %s %s records from before %s.", comma_value(moved), kind, ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", cutoff))) else ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Archived %s %s records from before %s to:", comma_value(moved), kind, ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", cutoff))) ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. file) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt archive list shows it; cdt archive rehydrate <id> brings the records back.") end end
function ArchiveRehydrate(target) local file local by_id = tonumber(target) if by_id then local row = db_query_one("SELECT filename FROM archives WHERE archive_id = " .. by_id) if not row then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No archive #" .. by_id .. ". See cdt archive list.") return end file = row.filename else file = target:match("[\\/]") and target or (ArchiveDir() .. "\\" .. target) end if not DbFileExists(file) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Archive file not found: " .. file) return end if migration_blocked then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] The database is blocked after a failed upgrade; see cdt db.") return end local ok, err = DbRun("ATTACH DATABASE " .. fixsql(file) .. " AS arc;") if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Couldn't open the archive: " .. tostring(err)) return end local restored = 0 ok, err = DbRun("BEGIN;") for _, kind in ipairs({"gains", "dmg"}) do for _, spec in ipairs(ARCHIVE_TABLES[kind]) do local tbl = spec[1] if ok and DbTableExists("arc", tbl) and DbTableExists("main", tbl) then local cols = DbCommonColumns("main", "arc", tbl) ok, err = DbRun(string.format('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO main."%s" (%s) SELECT %s FROM arc."%s";', tbl, cols, cols, tbl)) if ok then restored = restored + db:changes() end end end end if ok then ok, err = DbRun("UPDATE main.archives SET rehydrated = 1 WHERE filename = " .. fixsql(file) .. ";") end if ok then ok, err = DbRun("COMMIT;") else pcall(function() db:exec("ROLLBACK;") end) end pcall(function() db:exec("DETACH DATABASE arc;") end) if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Rehydrate failed and was undone: " .. tostring(err)) return end ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Brought back %s records.", comma_value(restored))) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " From " .. (file:match("[^\\/]+$") or file)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Records already in the database were skipped. The archive file is kept.") end
function ArchiveParseDate(tok, usage) local t = tok and ParseDmgDate(tok) if not t then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. (tok and ("'" .. tok .. "' is not a date. ") or "") .. "Usage: " .. usage) ColourNote("silver", "", " Dates are " .. DateFormat().typed .. ", e.g. " .. DateFormat().example .. " (cdt config dateformat).") return nil end local latest = ArchiveLatestCutoff() if t > latest then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] That date is too late: records from today and from this session are still") ColourNote("yellow", "", " being written. The latest date allowed is " .. ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", latest) .. ".") return nil end return t end
function CmdArchive(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if raw == "" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", " CDT Archive Commands") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Archive (move old records to a separate file)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt archive gains <date> [confirm] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Gains records before date") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt archive dmg <date> [confirm] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Damage records before date") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Restore") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt archive rehydrate <id|file> ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Bring an archive's records back") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Purge (delete without archiving)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt archive purge gains <date> [confirm] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Delete gains records") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt archive purge dmg <date> [confirm] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Delete damage records") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Management") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt archive list ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Archives made") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt archive path [dir] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Show or set the archive folder") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Without confirm, each only shows what it would do.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Dates are " .. DateFormat().typed .. ", e.g. " .. DateFormat().example .. ".") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " 'cdt help archive' explains what moves and what stays.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) return end if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end
local words = {} for w in raw:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end local sub = words[1]:lower()
if sub == "gains" or sub == "dmg" then local usage = "cdt archive " .. sub .. " <date> [confirm]" local cutoff = ArchiveParseDate(words[2], usage) if not cutoff then return end if (words[3] or ""):lower() == "confirm" then ArchiveRun(sub, cutoff, false) else if sub == "gains" then FlushKillBuffer() else FlushCombatBuffer() end ArchiveShowCounts(sub, cutoff, "Archive", "cdt archive " .. sub .. " " .. words[2] .. " confirm") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " They move to a new file in " .. ArchiveDir()) end
elseif sub == "purge" then local kind = (words[2] or ""):lower() local usage = "cdt archive purge gains|dmg <date> [confirm]" if kind ~= "gains" and kind ~= "dmg" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: " .. usage) return end local cutoff = ArchiveParseDate(words[3], usage) if not cutoff then return end if (words[4] or ""):lower() == "confirm" then ArchiveRun(kind, cutoff, true) else if kind == "gains" then FlushKillBuffer() else FlushCombatBuffer() end if ArchiveShowCounts(kind, cutoff, "PERMANENTLY DELETE", "cdt archive purge " .. kind .. " " .. words[3] .. " confirm") > 0 then ColourNote("red", "", " Purged records are not archived and can't be brought back. cdt db backup first.") end end
elseif sub == "rehydrate" then local target = raw:match("^%S+%s+(.+)$") if not target then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt archive rehydrate <id|file> (ids from cdt archive list)") return end ArchiveRehydrate(target)
elseif sub == "list" then local rows = DbTableExists("main", "archives") and db_query("SELECT * FROM archives ORDER BY archive_id DESC") or {} if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No archives made yet.") return end local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do grid[#grid + 1] = {id = r.archive_id, kind = r.archive_type, rows = r.row_count or 0, from = (tonumber(r.date_from) or 0) > 0 and ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", r.date_from) or "-", to = ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", r.date_to or 0), made = ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", r.created_at or 0), back = (r.rehydrated or 0) == 1 and "yes" or ""} end RenderTable({ {key = "id", title = "ID", w = 4, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num"}, {key = "kind", title = "Kind", w = 5, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "rows", title = "Records", w = 9, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num"}, {key = "from", title = "From", w = 10, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "to", title = "Before", w = 10, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "made", title = "Made", w = 10, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "back", title = "Back", w = 4, align = "l", color = "lime"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, title = "Archives", width = 70}) ColourNote("gray", "", " ID File") local here = ArchiveDir():lower() for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local file = r.filename or "" local dir, base = file:match("^(.*)[\\/]([^\\/]+)$") ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %4d ", r.archive_id), "dimgray", "", (dir and dir:lower() == here) and base or file) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Folder: " .. ArchiveDir()) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Back = records brought back with cdt archive rehydrate.")
elseif sub == "path" then local dir = raw:match("^%S+%s+(.+)$") if not dir then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Archives go to: ", "cyan", "", ArchiveDir()) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt archive path <folder> changes it; cdt archive path default goes back.") return end if dir:lower() == "default" then config.archive_dir = nil else dir = WritableFolder(dir) if not dir then return end config.archive_dir = dir end state_save() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Archives will go to: " .. ArchiveDir())
else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown archive command: " .. sub .. ". Type cdt archive for the list.") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- DAMAGE COMMANDS -- ============================================================================= function CmdDmgMap(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
if raw == "" or raw == "list" then if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Damage Type Mappings") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) local count = 0 pcall(function() for row in db:nrows("SELECT attack_name, damtype, category, source FROM damtype_map ORDER BY damtype, attack_name") do local src_tag = row.source == "user" and " [user]" or "" ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-30s", row.attack_name), "cyan", "", string.format(" %-12s", row.damtype), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-8s%s", row.category, src_tag)) count = count + 1 end end) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. count .. " mappings. 'cdt dmg map usage' for hit counts, 'unknown' for unmapped.") return end
if raw == "usage" then if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" %-30s %-12s %-8s %10s %12s", "Damage Verb", "Damtype", "Category", "Hits", "Damage")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) local count = 0 pcall(function() for row in db:nrows([[ SELECT m.attack_name, m.damtype, m.category, m.source, COALESCE(a.total_hits, 0) as hits, COALESCE(a.total_damage, 0) as dmg FROM damtype_map m LEFT JOIN (SELECT attack_name, SUM(total_hits) AS total_hits, SUM(total_damage) AS total_damage FROM attack_stats GROUP BY attack_name) a ON a.attack_name = m.attack_name ORDER BY COALESCE(a.total_hits, 0) DESC, m.damtype, m.attack_name ]]) do local src_tag = row.source == "user" and "*" or "" local hit_str = row.hits > 0 and comma_value(row.hits) or "-" local dmg_str = row.hits > 0 and short_value(row.dmg) or "-" local name_col = row.hits > 0 and "silver" or "dimgray" ColourNote(name_col, "", string.format(" %-30s", row.attack_name .. src_tag), "cyan", "", string.format(" %-12s", row.damtype), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-8s", row.category), "white", "", string.format(" %10s", hit_str), "gray", "", string.format(" %12s", dmg_str)) count = count + 1 end end) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. count .. " mappings shown (* = user-defined). Sorted by usage.") return end
if raw == "unknown" then if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Unmapped Attack Names") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) local found = false pcall(function() for row in db:nrows("SELECT DISTINCT attack_name, SUM(total_hits) as hits FROM attack_stats WHERE attack_name NOT IN (SELECT attack_name FROM damtype_map) GROUP BY attack_name ORDER BY hits DESC") do ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format(" %-30s %d hits", row.attack_name, row.hits or 0)) found = true end for row in db:nrows("SELECT DISTINCT attack_name, SUM(total_hits) as hits FROM player_attack_stats WHERE attack_name NOT IN (SELECT attack_name FROM damtype_map) GROUP BY attack_name ORDER BY hits DESC") do ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format(" %-30s %d hits (group)", row.attack_name, row.hits or 0)) found = true end end) if not found then ColourNote("lime", "", " All observed attacks are mapped!") end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) return end
if raw:match("^delete ") then local atk = raw:match("^delete%s+(.+)$") if not atk or atk == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt dmg map delete <attack_name>") return end db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM damtype_map WHERE attack_name = %s", fixsql(atk))) LoadDamtypeCache() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Removed mapping for: " .. atk) return end
local atk, dt, cat = raw:match("^(.+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)$") if not atk then atk, dt = raw:match("^(.+)%s+(%S+)$") end if not atk or not dt then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt dmg map <attack_name> <damtype> [category]") ColourNote("silver", "", " Categories: auto, skill, spell, unknown") ColourNote("silver", "", " Example: cdt dmg map lightning bolt electric spell") ColourNote("silver", "", " Also: cdt dmg map list | usage | unknown | delete <name>") return end atk = atk:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") cat = cat or "unknown"
db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO damtype_map (attack_name, damtype, category, source) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, 'user')", fixsql(atk), fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat))) db_exec(string.format( "UPDATE damtype_map SET damtype=%s, category=%s, source='user' WHERE attack_name=%s", fixsql(dt), fixsql(cat), fixsql(atk))) LoadDamtypeCache() ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Mapped: %s -> %s (%s)", atk, dt, cat)) end
DMG_DISPATCH.map = "CmdDmgMap"
local DTRACK_MELEE_SLOTS = { ["Primary Attack"] = true, ["Second Attack"] = true, ["Third Attack"] = true, ["Fourth Attack"] = true, ["Fifth Attack"] = true, ["Sixth Attack"] = true, ["Haste Attacks"] = true, ["Lightspeed"] = true, ["Dual Wield"] = true, ["Second Dual"] = true, ["Third Dual"] = true, ["Unarmed"] = true, }
-- True when `data` ({name = points}) matches the newest stored snapshot of this -- type exactly, so a redundant snapshot need not be written at all. function SnapshotUnchanged(snap_type, detail_table, key_col, val_col, data) if not db then return false end local latest = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT h.id FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN %s d ON d.header_id = h.id " .. "WHERE h.type = %s GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1", detail_table, fixsql(snap_type))) if not latest then return false end local rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT %s AS k, %s AS v FROM %s WHERE header_id = %d", key_col, val_col, detail_table, latest.id)) local prev, n = {}, 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do prev[tostring(r.k):lower()] = tonumber(r.v) or 0 n = n + 1 end local m = 0 for k, v in pairs(data) do m = m + 1 if prev[tostring(k):lower()] ~= (tonumber(v) or 0) then return false end end return m == n end
-- Walks back through snapshots of one type while the values are identical to the -- newest, and returns the FIRST snapshot of that unchanged run. Damage dealt at -- any point in the run was dealt under the same values, so scoping to the run's -- start keeps that data instead of discarding it on every duplicate snapshot. function EffectiveSnapshotBaseline(snap_type, detail_table, key_col, val_col) if not db then return nil, 0 end local heads = db_query(string.format( "SELECT h.id, h.time FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN %s d ON d.header_id = h.id " .. "WHERE h.type = %s GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 50", detail_table, fixsql(snap_type))) if #heads == 0 then return nil, 0 end
local ids = {} for _, h in ipairs(heads) do ids[#ids + 1] = tostring(h.id) end local rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT header_id, %s AS k, %s AS v FROM %s WHERE header_id IN (%s)", key_col, val_col, detail_table, table.concat(ids, ",")))
local by_head = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local t = by_head[r.header_id] if not t then t = {}; by_head[r.header_id] = t end t[tostring(r.k):lower()] = tonumber(r.v) or 0 end
local function same(a, b) if not a or not b then return false end local na, nb = 0, 0 for k, v in pairs(a) do na = na + 1 if b[k] ~= v then return false end end for _ in pairs(b) do nb = nb + 1 end return na == nb end
local newest = by_head[heads[1].id] local eff_id, eff_time = heads[1].id, heads[1].time for i = 2, #heads do if same(newest, by_head[heads[i].id]) then eff_id, eff_time = heads[i].id, heads[i].time else break end end return eff_id, eff_time end
-- Returns per-attack damage dealt since the latest instinct/mastery snapshot, -- so estimates only cover damage dealt while the current values were in effect. -- Falls back to all recorded damage when no baseline exists yet. function GetScopedDamage(filter) local out = { scoped = {}, total = 0, melee = 0, backstab = 0, baseline_time = 0, have_baseline = false, estimated = 0, } if not db then return out end -- Optional {race=, class=} restricts the sample to one combo, since the -- melee-vs-spell mix differs between them. A blank stored race is treated -- as a wildcard so pre-race history stays usable. -- COLLATE NOCASE: the game reports "Navigator" but an instinct-builder URL -- carries "navigator", and either may end up stored on a build. local where, level_sql = "", "" if filter then if filter.class and filter.class ~= "" then where = where .. " AND class = " .. fixsql(filter.class) .. " COLLATE NOCASE" end if filter.race and filter.race ~= "" then where = where .. " AND (race = " .. fixsql(filter.race) .. " COLLATE NOCASE OR race = '')" end -- Optional {lmin=, lmax=}: only damage recorded at those levels. Old-data -- estimates carry the level of the snapshot that opened their stretch. if filter.lmin and filter.lmax then level_sql = string.format(" AND level BETWEEN %d AND %d", filter.lmin, filter.lmax) out.lmin, out.lmax = filter.lmin, filter.lmax end -- Optional {progress = {tier, redo, remort}}: only damage recorded then. -- Old-data estimates carry the tier/remort of their snapshot and no redo. if filter.progress then level_sql = level_sql .. ProgressSQL(filter.progress) out.progress = filter.progress end end -- Use the START of each unchanged run, not the newest snapshot, so damage -- dealt under the same values is kept rather than discarded. local inst_id, inst_time = EffectiveSnapshotBaseline( "instinct", "instinct_detail", "attack_name", "instinct_count") local mast_id, mast_time = EffectiveSnapshotBaseline( "mastery", "mastery_detail", "skill_name", "mastery_pct") -- The later of the two run-starts is the point after which BOTH are current. if inst_id or mast_id then out.baseline_time = math.max(tonumber(inst_time) or 0, tonumber(mast_time) or 0) out.have_baseline = out.baseline_time > 0 end
local function take(rows, estimated) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local d = tonumber(r.td) or 0 local cat = r.category or "unknown" if d > 0 and cat ~= "epic" then local e = out.scoped[r.attack_name] if not e then e = {damage = 0, damtype = r.damtype or "unknown", category = cat} out.scoped[r.attack_name] = e end e.damage = e.damage + d out.total = out.total + d if cat == "auto" then out.melee = out.melee + d end if r.attack_name == "backstab" then out.backstab = out.backstab + d end if estimated then out.estimated = out.estimated + d end end end end
if out.have_baseline then -- Damage under the current values is read straight from the time slices. -- A snapshot starts a new slice at the moment it is taken, so every slice -- from then on was dealt under these values: nothing is subtracted, and the -- class/race filter applies to the damage itself rather than to a total -- that a snapshot copy summed across every subclass. take(db_query(string.format( "SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS damtype, MAX(category) AS category, " .. "SUM(total_damage) AS td FROM attack_stats WHERE slice_start >= %d%s GROUP BY attack_name", out.baseline_time, where .. level_sql)), false) -- The part of the window from before v3.9 comes from the snapshot-based -- estimate: every old stretch that opened at or after the window's start. take(db_query(string.format( "SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS damtype, MAX(category) AS category, " .. "SUM(damage) AS td FROM legacy_damage WHERE window_start >= %d%s GROUP BY attack_name", out.baseline_time, where .. level_sql)), true) end
-- All recorded damage, for when the window is too thin to estimate from -- (e.g. a snapshot was just taken and little combat has happened since). local alltime_rows = db_query( "SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS damtype, MAX(category) AS category, SUM(total_damage) AS td " .. "FROM attack_stats WHERE 1=1" .. where .. level_sql .. " GROUP BY attack_name") if level_sql ~= "" then -- Pre-v3.9 running totals have no level, so a level range leaves them out; -- their estimate by level stands in. Without a range the running totals -- already hold that damage, and adding the estimate would count it twice. for _, r in ipairs(db_query( "SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS damtype, MAX(category) AS category, SUM(damage) AS td " .. "FROM legacy_damage WHERE 1=1" .. where .. level_sql .. " GROUP BY attack_name")) do r.estimated = true alltime_rows[#alltime_rows + 1] = r end end local alltime, alltime_total, alltime_melee, alltime_bs, alltime_est = {}, 0, 0, 0, 0 for _, r in ipairs(alltime_rows) do local full = tonumber(r.td) or 0 local cat = r.category or "unknown" if full > 0 and cat ~= "epic" then local e = alltime[r.attack_name] if not e then e = {damage = 0, damtype = r.damtype or "unknown", category = cat} alltime[r.attack_name] = e end e.damage = e.damage + full alltime_total = alltime_total + full if cat == "auto" then alltime_melee = alltime_melee + full end if r.attack_name == "backstab" then alltime_bs = alltime_bs + full end if r.estimated then alltime_est = alltime_est + full end end end
-- A window holding under 2% of all recorded damage is too thin a sample; -- prefer all-time and say so rather than showing nothing. if out.total <= 0 or (alltime_total > 0 and out.total < alltime_total * 0.02) then out.scoped = alltime out.total = alltime_total out.melee = alltime_melee out.backstab = alltime_bs out.estimated = alltime_est out.fell_back = out.have_baseline out.have_baseline = false end return out end
-- " (40% estimated from pre-v3.9 data)" when part of a sample is the old-data -- estimate rather than recorded slices; "" when none of it is. function EstimatedShareStr(sc) if not sc or (tonumber(sc.estimated) or 0) <= 0 or (tonumber(sc.total) or 0) <= 0 then return "" end return string.format(" (%.0f%% estimated from pre-v3.9 data)", sc.estimated / sc.total * 100) end
function ScopeNoteStr(sc) local levels = (sc.lmin and string.format(", levels %d-%d", sc.lmin, sc.lmax) or "") .. (sc.progress and (", " .. ProgressLabel(sc.progress)) or "") if sc.have_baseline and sc.baseline_time > 0 then return string.format("since snapshot %s", ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", sc.baseline_time)) .. levels .. EstimatedShareStr(sc) end if sc.fell_back then return "all recorded damage" .. levels .. " (too little since last snapshot)" .. EstimatedShareStr(sc) end return "all recorded damage" .. levels .. " (no snapshot baseline yet)" .. EstimatedShareStr(sc) end
-- instinct-builder.com query param -> in-game instinct skill name. -- Derived from builder URLs for all 20 subclasses. INSTINCT_BUILDER_PARAMS = { -- available to every subclass ed = "enhanced damage", fourth = "fourth attack", dual = "dual wield", third = "third attack", second = "second attack", haste = "haste", sanc = "sanctuary", prote = "protection evil", protg = "protection good", incomp = "incomplete healing", dodge = "dodge", medi = "meditation", heal = "heal", fast = "fast healing", vit = "vitality", renew = "renew", restlife = "restore life", -- subclass specific hr = "holy reprisal", hb = "heavenly balance", tof = "test of faith", apoc = "apocalypse", kf = "knife fighting", sp = "spiral", iron = "ironfist", ham = "hammering blow", erupt = "eruption", gr = "gaias revenge", ef = "elemental focus", immo = "immolate", toxic = "toxic cloud", miasma = "miasma", vs = "void sermon", vog = "voice of god", reg = "regeneration", charge = "charge", des = "desolation", mf = "mindflay", byp = "bypass", nec = "necrocide", ss = "scorpion strike", fs = "foresight", hum = "humility", gf = "gaias fury", prec = "precision", pow = "power projection", spear = "spear of odin", }
-- Skills with no instinct of their own - the game marks these "(Uses X)" and -- they draw on that skill's pool, so points must be read from the owner. INSTINCT_SHARED_POOL = { ["accelerate"] = "haste", ["inertial barrier"] = "protection evil", ["air skewer"] = "immolate", ["earthen hammer"] = "immolate", ["ice daggers"] = "immolate", ["prophecy"] = "foresight", }
function ResolveInstinctPool(skill) if not skill then return skill end return INSTINCT_SHARED_POOL[skill:lower()] or skill:lower() end
-- Which subclasses have each subclass-specific instinct. Universal skills are -- listed separately since every subclass gets them. SUBCLASS_INSTINCTS = { avenger = {"holy reprisal", "heavenly balance", "test of faith", "apocalypse"}, bandit = {"knife fighting", "spiral"}, barbarian = {"ironfist", "hammering blow"}, blacksmith = {"hammering blow"}, crafter = {"eruption", "gaias revenge"}, elementalist = {"elemental focus", "immolate", "miasma"}, enchanter = {"immolate", "miasma"}, harmer = {"void sermon", "voice of god", "regeneration"}, hunter = {"eruption", "gaias revenge"}, knight = {"charge", "heavenly balance", "test of faith", "apocalypse"}, mentalist = {"desolation", "mindflay"}, navigator = {"desolation", "bypass"}, necromancer = {"necrocide", "desolation"}, ninja = {"knife fighting", "scorpion strike", "spiral"}, oracle = {"foresight", "voice of god", "regeneration"}, priest = {"humility", "voice of god", "regeneration"}, shaman = {"gaias fury", "gaias revenge"}, soldier = {"precision", "hammering blow"}, sorcerer = {"power projection", "spear of odin", "immolate", "miasma"}, venomist = {"knife fighting", "scorpion strike", "spiral"}, }
-- Note: instinct-builder only emits 'toxic' for elementalist/enchanter/sorcerer, -- but the in-game skill list shows it at level 85 for every subclass, so the -- URLs under-report it. Game data wins. UNIVERSAL_INSTINCTS = { "enhanced damage", "second attack", "third attack", "fourth attack", "dual wield", "haste", "accelerate", "sanctuary", "protection evil", "protection good", "inertial barrier", "incomplete healing", "dodge", "meditation", "heal", "fast healing", "vitality", "renew", "restore life", "toxic cloud", }
-- skill -> sorted list of subclasses, built once from the tables above. local _subclass_index = nil function SubclassesForInstinct(skill) if not _subclass_index then _subclass_index = {} for sc, skills in pairs(SUBCLASS_INSTINCTS) do for _, s in ipairs(skills) do local t = _subclass_index[s] if not t then t = {}; _subclass_index[s] = t end t[#t + 1] = sc end end -- shared-pool skills belong wherever their owner does for alias, owner in pairs(INSTINCT_SHARED_POOL) do local src = _subclass_index[owner] if src then local t = {} for _, sc in ipairs(src) do t[#t + 1] = sc end _subclass_index[alias] = t end end for _, t in pairs(_subclass_index) do table.sort(t) end end local key = (skill or ""):lower() for _, u in ipairs(UNIVERSAL_INSTINCTS) do if u == key then return nil, true end end return _subclass_index[key], false end
-- Gaias fury and gaias revenge deal one of four elements, chosen by the shaman -- spell "gaias focus". The damage verb never changes, so the element cannot be -- read from the combat line - it has to come from the player's focus setting. -- Crafter and hunter get gaias revenge but no way to focus it, so theirs is -- always an even mix. GAIAS_ELEMENTS = {"earth", "electric", "energy", "cold"} GAIAS_SPELLS = {["gaias fury"] = true, ["gaias revenge"] = true} GAIAS_DAMTYPE = "gaias" -- sentinel: element indeterminate
-- Mastery multiplier for one damtype. The sentinel expands to the expected -- value across the four elements, each equally likely. -- `focus` is only for hypothetical builds: it asks "what if this indeterminate -- gaias damage were focused into element X". Damage already tagged with a real -- element is unaffected, and omitting focus keeps the even-mix expectation, -- which is what recorded unfocused damage actually was. function MasteryMultiplier(damtype, mast, focus) local dt = (damtype or "unknown"):lower() if dt == GAIAS_DAMTYPE then if focus and focus ~= "" then for _, e in ipairs(GAIAS_ELEMENTS) do if focus:lower() == e then return 1 + MasteryToDmgPct(mast[e] or 0) / 100 end end end local sum = 0 for _, e in ipairs(GAIAS_ELEMENTS) do sum = sum + (1 + MasteryToDmgPct(mast[e] or 0) / 100) end return sum / #GAIAS_ELEMENTS end local mp = mast[dt] or 0 if mp <= 0 then return 1 end local pct = MasteryToDmgPct(mp) if pct <= 0 then return 1 end return 1 + pct / 100 end
-- Multiplier a given build applies to ONE attack. Instinct is looked up per -- attack/spell, mastery per damtype; the two stack multiplicatively. function AttackMultiplier(atk_name, info, inst_data, mast_data, focus) local mult = 1 local cat = info.category or "unknown" local dt = (info.damtype or "unknown"):lower()
if cat == "auto" or atk_name == "backstab" then local ed = inst_data["enhanced damage"] or 0 if ed > 0 then local _, pct = InstinctPctEstimate("enhanced damage", ed) if pct and pct > 0 then mult = mult * (1 + pct / 100) end end end if cat == "auto" then local ss = inst_data["scorpion strike"] or 0 if ss > 0 then local _, pct = InstinctPctEstimate("scorpion strike", ss) if pct and pct > 0 then mult = mult * (1 + pct / 100) end end end if (cat == "skill" or cat == "spell") and atk_name ~= "backstab" then local spell = LookupSpellForVerb(atk_name) or atk_name:lower() -- points come from the pool owner for shared-pool spells local pts = inst_data[ResolveInstinctPool(spell)] or 0 if pts > 0 then local _, pct = InstinctPctEstimate(spell, pts) if pct and pct > 0 then mult = mult * (1 + pct / 100) end end end
mult = mult * MasteryMultiplier(dt, mast_data, focus) return mult end
-- Extra-swing instincts add swings per round rather than scaling damage. The -- curves give extra swings; turning that into a damage multiplier needs the -- observed swings-per-round, otherwise it implicitly assumes a base of one -- swing and overstates the benefit several times over. function MeleeSwingMultiplier(inst_data, dtrack) local extra = 0 for skill in pairs(INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES) do local pts = inst_data[skill] or 0 if pts > 0 then extra = extra + (AttackInstinctSwings(skill, pts) or 0) end end if extra <= 0 then return 1 end local spr = dtrack and tonumber(dtrack.spr) or 0 if spr <= 0 or spr <= extra then -- No usable dtrack sample; leave melee unscaled rather than invent a -- number. Callers surface this via DtrackSampleNote(). return 1 end return spr / (spr - extra) end
-- Newest dtrack snapshot that actually captured something. The auto-snapshot -- can fire before the game replies, leaving all-zero rows behind. function GetDtrackSummary() if not db then return nil end return db_query_one( "SELECT s.* FROM dtrack_hits_summary s INNER JOIN snapshot_headers h ON h.id = s.header_id " .. "WHERE h.type = 'dtrack_hits' AND s.spr > 0 ORDER BY s.header_id DESC LIMIT 1") end
function DtrackSampleNote(dtrack) if not dtrack then return "no dtrack sample - melee swing instinct not counted (run 'dtrack hits')" end return string.format("melee base %.2f swings/round", tonumber(dtrack.spr) or 0) end
-- Strips every current bonus back out of observed damage, giving the damage -- that would have been dealt with no instinct and no mastery at all. Both sides -- of a comparison then project forward from this same base. function DeriveBaseDamage(scoped, inst_data, mast_data, dtrack_slots, focus) local base = {} local swing_mult = MeleeSwingMultiplier(inst_data, dtrack_slots) for atk_name, info in pairs(scoped) do local m = AttackMultiplier(atk_name, info, inst_data, mast_data, focus) if info.category == "auto" then m = m * swing_mult end if m <= 0 then m = 1 end base[atk_name] = { damage = info.damage / m, damtype = info.damtype, category = info.category, } end return base end
-- Applies a candidate build to base damage. Returns totals plus the multipliers -- attributable to instinct and to mastery separately. function ProjectBuild(base, inst_data, mast_data, dtrack_slots, focus) local out = {total = 0, base_total = 0, per_attack = {}} local swing_mult = MeleeSwingMultiplier(inst_data, dtrack_slots) local no_inst_total, no_mast_total = 0, 0 for atk_name, info in pairs(base) do local m = AttackMultiplier(atk_name, info, inst_data, mast_data, focus) if info.category == "auto" then m = m * swing_mult end local projected = info.damage * m out.total = out.total + projected out.base_total = out.base_total + info.damage out.per_attack[atk_name] = { damage = projected, mult = m, damtype = info.damtype, category = info.category, } -- Same attack with one side of the build zeroed, to split the credit. local m_ni = AttackMultiplier(atk_name, info, {}, mast_data, focus) local m_nm = AttackMultiplier(atk_name, info, inst_data, {}, focus) if info.category == "auto" then m_nm = m_nm * swing_mult end no_inst_total = no_inst_total + info.damage * m_ni no_mast_total = no_mast_total + info.damage * m_nm end out.inst_mult = no_inst_total > 0 and out.total / no_inst_total or 1 out.mast_mult = no_mast_total > 0 and out.total / no_mast_total or 1 out.combined_mult = out.base_total > 0 and out.total / out.base_total or 1 return out end
-- Training cost to move from one build to another. Only increases are charged; -- points already held cost nothing. function BuildCost(from_inst, to_inst, from_mast, to_mast) local trains, inst_gold, qp, mast_gold = 0, 0, 0, 0 for skill, to_pts in pairs(to_inst) do local from_pts = from_inst[skill] or 0 if to_pts > from_pts then local t, g = InstinctRangeCost(from_pts, to_pts) trains = trains + (t or 0) inst_gold = inst_gold + (g or 0) end end for dt, to_pts in pairs(to_mast) do local from_pts = from_mast[dt] or 0 if to_pts > from_pts then local q, g = MasteryRangeCost(from_pts, to_pts) qp = qp + (q or 0) mast_gold = mast_gold + (g or 0) end end return trains, inst_gold, qp, mast_gold end
-- Alias instincts draw on another skill's points -- "air skewer" spends -- Immolate's. A build carrying points under both names is one pool, not two, so -- fold them before costing or the same trains get charged twice. function FoldInstinctPools(inst) local out = {} for skill, pts in pairs(inst or {}) do pts = tonumber(pts) or 0 if pts > 0 then local pool = ResolveInstinctPool(skill) if pts > (out[pool] or 0) then out[pool] = pts end end end return out end
-- What a build cost to reach from nothing. function BuildTotalCost(inst, mast) return BuildCost({}, FoldInstinctPools(inst), {}, mast or {}) end
-- Rounds-weighted swings per round across every dtrack snapshot, whatever the -- race or subclass. Only used when a comparison has no damage data AND no -- current dtrack to read -- and always stated in the output, never silently. function AverageHistoricalSpr() if not db then return nil, 0 end local r = db_query_one( "SELECT SUM(s.swings) AS sw, SUM(s.rounds) AS rd, COUNT(*) AS n " .. "FROM dtrack_hits_summary s INNER JOIN snapshot_headers h ON h.id = s.header_id " .. "WHERE h.type = 'dtrack_hits' AND s.rounds > 0 AND s.swings > 0") if not r or (tonumber(r.rd) or 0) <= 0 then return nil, 0 end return r.sw / r.rd, tonumber(r.n) or 0 end
-- Which sample can back a projection for one side of a comparison: -- 1 = this race + subclass, 2 = the subclass across every race, 3 = nothing. function BuildSampleTier(side, levels) if (side.class or "") == "" then return 3, nil end local lmin, lmax = levels and levels.lmin, levels and levels.lmax local progress = levels and levels.progress if (side.race or "") ~= "" then local sc = GetScopedDamage({race = side.race, class = side.class, lmin = lmin, lmax = lmax, progress = progress}) if sc.total > 0 then return 1, sc end end local sc2 = GetScopedDamage({class = side.class, lmin = lmin, lmax = lmax, progress = progress}) if sc2.total > 0 then return 2, sc2 end return 3, nil end
-- ============================================================================= -- BUILD OPTIMIZER -- =============================================================================
-- Marginal cost of the (n+1)th point, from InstinctRangeCost's per-point form. function InstinctStepCost(n) return 175 + 25 * (n + 1) end
-- Instincts the optimizer is allowed to spend on: damage-affecting, curve-backed, -- available to this subclass, and not an alias for another skill's pool. function OptimizerCandidates(subclass) local out = {} local function consider(skill) if INSTINCT_NON_DAMAGE[skill] then return end if InstinctExclusionReason(skill) then return end if INSTINCT_SHARED_POOL[skill] then return end -- train the owner instead local pc = INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES[skill] local ac = INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES[skill] if not pc and not ac then return end if pc and pc.label ~= "melee dmg" and pc.label ~= "spell dmg" then return end out[skill] = true end for _, s in ipairs(UNIVERSAL_INSTINCTS) do consider(s) end local sc = subclass and SUBCLASS_INSTINCTS[subclass:lower()] if sc then for _, s in ipairs(sc) do consider(s) end else -- Unknown subclass: allow anything curve-backed rather than refusing. for s in pairs(INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES) do consider(s) end for s in pairs(INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES) do consider(s) end end local list = {} for s in pairs(out) do list[#list + 1] = s end table.sort(list) return list end
-- Collapses per-attack base damage into the few groups that behave identically, -- so the search does not rescan every attack row for every candidate point. function BuildDamageBuckets(scoped, cur_inst, cur_mast, dtrack) local base = DeriveBaseDamage(scoped, cur_inst, cur_mast, dtrack) local keyed = {} for atk_name, info in pairs(base) do local spell = "" if (info.category == "skill" or info.category == "spell") and atk_name ~= "backstab" then spell = ResolveInstinctPool(LookupSpellForVerb(atk_name) or atk_name:lower()) end -- is_backstab is part of the key: it changes whether enhanced damage -- applies, so two attacks differing only in that must not merge. local bs = (atk_name == "backstab") local key = string.format("%s|%s|%s|%s", info.category or "unknown", (info.damtype or "unknown"):lower(), spell, tostring(bs)) local b = keyed[key] if not b then b = {damage = 0, category = info.category, damtype = info.damtype, spell = spell, is_backstab = bs} keyed[key] = b end b.damage = b.damage + info.damage end local out = {} for _, b in pairs(keyed) do out[#out + 1] = b end return out end
-- Total damage for a candidate allocation. Mirrors AttackMultiplier's rules but -- over buckets rather than individual attacks. function BucketDamage(buckets, inst, mast, spr, focus) local extra = 0 for skill in pairs(INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES) do local p = inst[skill] or 0 if p > 0 then extra = extra + (AttackInstinctSwings(skill, p) or 0) end end local swing = 1 if extra > 0 and spr and spr > extra then swing = spr / (spr - extra) end
local ed_pts = inst["enhanced damage"] or 0 local ed = 1 if ed_pts > 0 then local _, p = InstinctPctEstimate("enhanced damage", ed_pts) if p and p > 0 then ed = 1 + p / 100 end end local ss_pts = inst["scorpion strike"] or 0 local ss = 1 if ss_pts > 0 then local _, p = InstinctPctEstimate("scorpion strike", ss_pts) if p and p > 0 then ss = 1 + p / 100 end end
local total = 0 for _, b in ipairs(buckets) do local m = 1 if b.category == "auto" or b.is_backstab then m = m * ed end if b.category == "auto" then m = m * ss * swing end if b.spell and b.spell ~= "" then local p = inst[b.spell] or 0 if p > 0 then local _, pc = InstinctPctEstimate(b.spell, p) if pc and pc > 0 then m = m * (1 + pc / 100) end end end m = m * MasteryMultiplier(b.damtype, mast, focus) total = total + b.damage * m end return total end
-- Greedy: repeatedly buy the point with the best damage-per-train. -- The swing multiplier is convex, so greedy is not provably optimal, but local -- search plus random restarts improved on it by only ~0.006% in testing. function OptimizeInstincts(budget, buckets, mast, spr, candidates, focus) local v = {} for _, s in ipairs(candidates) do v[s] = 0 end local spent = 0 local cur = BucketDamage(buckets, v, mast, spr, focus) while true do local best, best_eff, best_dmg = nil, 0, 0 for _, s in ipairs(candidates) do local p = v[s] if p < 200 then local c = InstinctStepCost(p) if spent + c <= budget then v[s] = p + 1 local d = BucketDamage(buckets, v, mast, spr, focus) v[s] = p local eff = (d - cur) / c if eff > best_eff then best_eff, best, best_dmg = eff, s, d end end end end if not best then break end spent = spent + InstinctStepCost(v[best]) v[best] = v[best] + 1 cur = best_dmg end return v, spent, cur end
-- Current live instinct/mastery values from the newest snapshots. function GetCurrentBuildData() local inst_data, mast_data = {}, {} if not db then return inst_data, mast_data end local li = db_query_one( "SELECT h.id FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN instinct_detail d ON d.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'instinct' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") if li then for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format( "SELECT attack_name, instinct_count FROM instinct_detail WHERE header_id = %d", li.id))) do inst_data[r.attack_name:lower()] = r.instinct_count end end local lm = db_query_one( "SELECT h.id FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN mastery_detail d ON d.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'mastery' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") if lm then for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format( "SELECT skill_name, mastery_pct FROM mastery_detail WHERE header_id = %d", lm.id))) do mast_data[r.skill_name:lower()] = r.mastery_pct end end return inst_data, mast_data end
function DmgReportInstinctEstimate() if not db then return end FlushCombatBuffer() local latest_dtrack = db_query_one( "SELECT h.id FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN dtrack_hits_slots s ON s.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'dtrack_hits' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") local latest_inst = db_query_one( "SELECT h.id, h.time FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN instinct_detail d ON d.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'instinct' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") local latest_mast = db_query_one( "SELECT h.id, h.time FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN mastery_detail d ON d.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'mastery' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") if not latest_dtrack and not latest_inst and not latest_mast then return end
local sc = GetScopedDamage() local scoped = sc.scoped local total_melee, backstab_dmg, total_all_dmg = sc.melee, sc.backstab, sc.total local have_baseline, baseline_time = sc.have_baseline, sc.baseline_time if total_all_dmg <= 0 then return end
local inst_lines = {} local inst_total_bonus = 0
-- Load instinct data local inst_data = {} if latest_inst then local inst_rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT attack_name, instinct_count FROM instinct_detail WHERE header_id = %d", latest_inst.id)) for _, r in ipairs(inst_rows) do inst_data[r.attack_name:lower()] = r.instinct_count end end
-- Load mastery data local mast_data = {} if latest_mast then local mast_rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT skill_name, mastery_pct FROM mastery_detail WHERE header_id = %d", latest_mast.id)) for _, r in ipairs(mast_rows) do mast_data[r.skill_name:lower()] = r.mastery_pct end end
-- Melee extra swings from instinct if latest_dtrack and total_melee > 0 then local slots = db_query(string.format( "SELECT slot_name, hit_count, instinct_count FROM dtrack_hits_slots WHERE header_id = %d", latest_dtrack.id)) local total_hits, total_inst = 0, 0 for _, s in ipairs(slots) do if DTRACK_MELEE_SLOTS[s.slot_name] then total_hits = total_hits + (s.hit_count or 0) total_inst = total_inst + (s.instinct_count or 0) end end if total_hits > 0 and total_inst > 0 then local ratio = total_inst / total_hits local est_dmg = math.floor(total_melee * ratio) inst_lines[#inst_lines + 1] = { label = "Melee extra swings", detail = string.format("~%.1f%% of hits from instinct", ratio * 100), sub_label = "Est. instinct dmg", sub_value = string.format("%s of %s", comma_value(est_dmg), comma_value(total_melee)), } inst_total_bonus = inst_total_bonus + est_dmg end end
-- Enhanced Damage instinct if latest_inst then local ed_pts = inst_data["enhanced damage"] or 0 if ed_pts > 0 and (total_melee + backstab_dmg) > 0 then local _, pct = InstinctPctEstimate("enhanced damage", ed_pts) if pct and pct > 0 then local base = total_melee + backstab_dmg local est = math.floor(base * (pct / 100) / (1 + pct / 100)) inst_lines[#inst_lines + 1] = { label = "Enhanced Damage", detail = string.format("+%.1f%% melee+backstab (%d inst)", pct, ed_pts), sub_label = "Est. bonus dmg", sub_value = comma_value(est), } inst_total_bonus = inst_total_bonus + est end end
-- Scorpion Strike instinct local ss_pts = inst_data["scorpion strike"] or 0 if ss_pts > 0 and total_melee > 0 then local _, pct = InstinctPctEstimate("scorpion strike", ss_pts) if pct and pct > 0 then local est = math.floor(total_melee * (pct / 100) / (1 + pct / 100)) inst_lines[#inst_lines + 1] = { label = "Scorpion Strike", detail = string.format("+%.2f%% melee only (%d inst)", pct, ss_pts), sub_label = "Est. bonus dmg", sub_value = comma_value(est), } inst_total_bonus = inst_total_bonus + est end end
-- Per-spell instinct breakdown (baseline-scoped) local spell_dmg_by_verb = {} for atk_name, sa in pairs(scoped) do if (sa.category == "skill" or sa.category == "spell") and atk_name ~= "backstab" then spell_dmg_by_verb[atk_name] = (spell_dmg_by_verb[atk_name] or 0) + sa.damage end end local spell_inst_lines, unknown_lines = {}, {} for verb, dmg in pairs(spell_dmg_by_verb) do local spell_name = LookupSpellForVerb(verb) or verb:lower() local pts = inst_data[ResolveInstinctPool(spell_name)] if pts and pts > 0 and dmg > 0 then local why = InstinctExclusionReason(spell_name) if why then -- Deliberately excluded. Report it so the omission is visible, -- but contribute nothing to the totals. unknown_lines[#unknown_lines + 1] = { label = spell_name, detail = string.format("excluded - %s (%d inst)", why, pts), dmg = dmg, } else local _, pct = InstinctPctEstimate(spell_name, pts) if pct and pct > 0 then local est = math.floor(dmg * (pct / 100) / (1 + pct / 100)) spell_inst_lines[#spell_inst_lines + 1] = { label = spell_name, detail = string.format("+%.1f%% spell dmg (%d inst, verb: %s)", pct, pts, verb), sub_label = "Est. bonus dmg", sub_value = comma_value(est), est = est, } end end end end table.sort(spell_inst_lines, function(a, b) return a.est > b.est end) for _, sl in ipairs(spell_inst_lines) do inst_lines[#inst_lines + 1] = sl inst_total_bonus = inst_total_bonus + sl.est end table.sort(unknown_lines, function(a, b) return a.dmg > b.dmg end) for _, ul in ipairs(unknown_lines) do inst_lines[#inst_lines + 1] = {label = ul.label, detail = ul.detail} end end
-- Mastery per damtype (DB + session merged) local mast_lines = {} local mast_total_bonus = 0 if latest_mast then local dt_totals = {} for _, sa in pairs(scoped) do if sa.damtype ~= "unknown" and sa.damage > 0 then local dt = sa.damtype:lower() dt_totals[dt] = (dt_totals[dt] or 0) + sa.damage end end local dt_sorted = {} for dt, td in pairs(dt_totals) do dt_sorted[#dt_sorted + 1] = {damtype = dt, td = td} end table.sort(dt_sorted, function(a, b) return a.td > b.td end) for _, dr in ipairs(dt_sorted) do local dt = dr.damtype:lower() if dt == GAIAS_DAMTYPE then -- Element unknown, so the benefit is the expected value across the -- four. Shown separately since 'gaias' is not a real damtype. local mult = MasteryMultiplier(GAIAS_DAMTYPE, mast_data) if mult > 1 then local est = math.floor((dr.td or 0) * (mult - 1) / mult) local parts = {} for _, e in ipairs(GAIAS_ELEMENTS) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s %d", e, mast_data[e] or 0) end mast_lines[#mast_lines + 1] = { label = "gaias (unfocused)", detail = string.format("+%.1f%% avg of %s", (mult - 1) * 100, table.concat(parts, ", ")), sub_label = "Est. bonus dmg", sub_value = string.format("%s of %s gaias dmg", comma_value(est), comma_value(dr.td)), } mast_total_bonus = mast_total_bonus + est end else local pts = mast_data[dt] if pts and pts > 0 then local pct = MasteryToDmgPct(pts) if pct > 0 then local est = math.floor((dr.td or 0) * (pct / 100) / (1 + pct / 100)) mast_lines[#mast_lines + 1] = { label = dr.damtype, detail = string.format("+%.1f%% (%d mastery)", pct, pts), sub_label = "Est. bonus dmg", sub_value = string.format("%s of %s %s dmg", comma_value(est), comma_value(dr.td), dr.damtype), } mast_total_bonus = mast_total_bonus + est end end end end end
if #inst_lines == 0 and #mast_lines == 0 then return end
local scope_note = ScopeNoteStr(sc)
-- Instinct section: multipliers only, no raw amounts (they overlap with mastery) if #inst_lines > 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Instinct Contribution (estimated)") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) for _, l in ipairs(inst_lines) do ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-26s ", l.label), "cyan", "", l.detail) end end
-- Mastery section: multipliers only if #mast_lines > 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Mastery Contribution (estimated)") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) for _, l in ipairs(mast_lines) do ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-26s ", l.label), "cyan", "", l.detail) end end
-- Combined summary. Instinct and mastery are multiplicative, so a raw -- amount is only meaningful for the two together: -- observed = base * i * m -> bonus portion = observed * (1 - 1/(i*m)) if total_all_dmg > 0 and (inst_total_bonus > 0 or mast_total_bonus > 0) then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Combined Bonus Summary") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Scope: " .. scope_note) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Swings: " .. DtrackSampleNote(GetDtrackSummary())) -- Same engine `cdt build compare` uses, so the two always agree. local dtrack_slots = GetDtrackSummary() local base_map = DeriveBaseDamage(scoped, inst_data, mast_data, dtrack_slots) local proj = ProjectBuild(base_map, inst_data, mast_data, dtrack_slots) local inst_mult = proj.inst_mult local mast_mult = proj.mast_mult local combined_mult = proj.combined_mult local base_dmg = math.floor(proj.base_total) local bonus_dmg = math.floor(proj.total - proj.base_total) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 50)) if inst_total_bonus > 0 then ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-26s ", "Instinct multiplier"), "lime", "", string.format("x%.3f (+%.1f%%)", inst_mult, (inst_mult - 1) * 100)) end if mast_total_bonus > 0 then ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-26s ", "Mastery multiplier"), "lime", "", string.format("x%.3f (+%.1f%%)", mast_mult, (mast_mult - 1) * 100)) end ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-26s ", "Combined multiplier"), "yellow", "", string.format("x%.3f (+%.1f%%)", combined_mult, (combined_mult - 1) * 100)) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-26s ", "Damage without bonuses"), "silver", "", string.format("%15s", comma_value(base_dmg))) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-26s ", "Bonus damage gained"), "lime", "", string.format("%15s", comma_value(bonus_dmg))) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-26s ", "Actual damage dealt"), "cyan", "", string.format("%15s", comma_value(total_all_dmg))) end end
-- ============================================================================= -- PROGRESS REPORTS: cdt tier, cdt redo -- Built from the event tables (levels, kills, deaths, quests, campaigns, gquests) -- and area_combat_stats, all stamped with tier/remort/redo. Level groups are 20 -- levels wide; superhero and its powerups are one group, key 10. -- ============================================================================= PROGRESS_GROUP_KEYS = { -- A level-up row stores the level reached, so its time was spent one level below. levels = "CASE WHEN type = 'pup' THEN 10 ELSE (level_num - 2) / 20 END", event = "CASE WHEN level_num >= 201 THEN 10 ELSE (level_num - 1) / 20 END", damage = "CASE WHEN level >= 201 THEN 10 ELSE (level - 1) / 20 END", } PROGRESS_REDO_KEYS = {levels = "redo", event = "redo", damage = "redo"} -- 0 OPK, 1 HARDCORE, 2 neither, 3 not known (recorded before the flags were). -- Both flags at once counts as HARDCORE, the rarer of the two. PROGRESS_FLAG_CASE = "CASE WHEN opk = -1 OR hardcore = -1 THEN 3 WHEN hardcore = 1 THEN 1 WHEN opk = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 2 END" PROGRESS_FLAG_KEYS = {levels = PROGRESS_FLAG_CASE, event = PROGRESS_FLAG_CASE} PROGRESS_FLAG_LABELS = {[0] = "OPK", [1] = "HARDCORE", [2] = "neither", [3] = "unknown"}
function ProgressGroupLabel(k) k = tonumber(k) or 0 if k >= 10 then return "SH (pups)" end return string.format("%d-%d", k * 20 + 1, k * 20 + 20) end
-- "12d 4h", "5h 02m", "45m", "30s". function ProgressTime(secs) secs = math.floor(tonumber(secs) or 0) if secs <= 0 then return "-" end local d, h, m = math.floor(secs / 86400), math.floor(secs % 86400 / 3600), math.floor(secs % 3600 / 60) if d > 0 then return string.format("%dd %dh", d, h) end if h > 0 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", h, m) end if m > 0 then return string.format("%dm", m) end return string.format("%ds", secs) end
-- Sums every source into rows keyed by `keys` (PROGRESS_GROUP_KEYS or -- PROGRESS_REDO_KEYS) within `where`, a ProgressSQL clause. Returns the rows by key -- and how many kill and level-up records carry an estimated tier/remort. function ProgressTotals(keys, where) local rows = {} local est = {kills = 0, kill_n = 0, levels = 0, level_n = 0} local function num(v) return tonumber(v) or 0 end local function row(k) k = tonumber(k) or -1 if not rows[k] then rows[k] = {secs = 0, kills = 0, xp = 0, qp = 0, deaths = 0, quests = 0, cps = 0, gqs = 0, dmg = 0, cs = 0} end return rows[k] end for _, q in ipairs(db_query("SELECT " .. keys.levels .. " AS k, SUM(duration) AS secs, COUNT(*) AS n, " .. "SUM(stamp_estimated) AS est FROM levels WHERE (type = 'pup' OR level_num >= 2)" .. where .. " GROUP BY k")) do local r = row(q.k) r.secs = r.secs + num(q.secs) est.level_n, est.levels = est.level_n + num(q.n), est.levels + num(q.est) end for _, q in ipairs(db_query("SELECT " .. keys.event .. " AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) AS xp, " .. "SUM(stamp_estimated) AS est FROM kills WHERE level_num >= 1" .. where .. " GROUP BY k")) do local r = row(q.k) r.kills, r.xp = r.kills + num(q.n), r.xp + num(q.xp) est.kill_n, est.kills = est.kill_n + num(q.n), est.kills + num(q.est) end for _, src in ipairs({ {tbl = "deaths", field = "deaths", count = "COUNT(*)", qp = "0"}, {tbl = "quests", field = "quests", count = "SUM(failed = 0)", qp = "SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN totqp ELSE 0 END)"}, {tbl = "campaigns", field = "cps", count = "SUM(failed = 0)", qp = "SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN qp ELSE 0 END)"}, {tbl = "gquests", field = "gqs", count = "COUNT(*)", qp = "SUM(qp_mobs + qp_win)"}}) do for _, q in ipairs(db_query("SELECT " .. keys.event .. " AS k, " .. src.count .. " AS n, " .. src.qp .. " AS qp FROM " .. src.tbl .. " WHERE level_num >= 1" .. where .. " GROUP BY k")) do local r = row(q.k) r[src.field] = r[src.field] + num(q.n) r.qp = r.qp + num(q.qp) end end -- Damage carries no PK flags, so a view grouped by them asks for no damage. if keys.damage then for _, q in ipairs(db_query("SELECT " .. keys.damage .. " AS k, SUM(total_damage) AS dmg, SUM(combat_secs) AS cs " .. "FROM area_combat_stats WHERE level >= 1" .. where .. " GROUP BY k")) do local r = row(q.k) r.dmg, r.cs = r.dmg + num(q.dmg), r.cs + num(q.cs) end end return rows, est end
-- `ordered` is a list of {label, row}; a Total row follows when there are several. function RenderProgressTable(label, ordered, title, est) local fields = {"secs", "kills", "xp", "deaths", "quests", "cps", "gqs", "dmg", "cs"} local total = {} for _, fld in ipairs(fields) do total[fld] = 0 end local function cells(lbl, r) return { lbl = lbl, time = ProgressTime(r.secs), kills = r.kills, deaths = r.deaths, xphr = r.secs >= 60 and math.floor(r.xp / (r.secs / 3600)) or 0, quests = r.quests, cps = r.cps, gqs = r.gqs, dmg = r.dmg, dps = r.cs > 0 and math.floor(r.dmg / r.cs) or 0, } end local grid = {} for _, item in ipairs(ordered) do grid[#grid + 1] = cells(item.label, item.row) for _, fld in ipairs(fields) do total[fld] = total[fld] + (item.row[fld] or 0) end end if #ordered > 1 then grid[#grid + 1] = cells("Total", total) end RenderTable({ {key = "lbl", title = label, w = 9, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "time", title = "Time", w = 7, align = "r", color = "gray"}, {key = "kills", title = "Kills", w = 7, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "deaths", title = "Deaths", w = 6, align = "r", color = "red", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "xphr", title = "XP/hr", w = 7, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "quests", title = "Quests", w = 6, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "cps", title = "CPs", w = 5, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "gqs", title = "GQs", w = 5, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "dmg", title = "Damage", w = 11, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "dps", title = "DPS", w = 7, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, }, grid, {title = title, indent = 1}) local function pct(part, whole) return whole > 0 and math.floor(part / whole * 100 + 0.5) or 0 end if (est.kills or 0) > 0 or (est.levels or 0) > 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format( " ~%d%% of these kills and %d%% of these level-ups are from before v3.9:", pct(est.kills, est.kill_n), pct(est.levels, est.level_n))) ColourNote("yellow", "", " their tier and remort are estimated from the session they were in.") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Time is from level-ups and powerups. Deaths, Damage and DPS are from v3.9 on.") end
-- The tier/redo/remort you are on now, or nil when GMCP hasn't sent it yet. function CurrentProgress() local tier = StampTier() if tier < 0 then return nil end local redo, remort = StampRedo(), StampRemort() return {tier = tier, redo = redo >= 0 and redo or nil, remort = remort >= 0 and remort or nil} end
-- The command's token, or where you are now; nil after printing why not. function ProgressArg(wildcards, cmd) local raw = ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if raw == "" then local cur = CurrentProgress() if not cur then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Your tier isn't known yet (GMCP hasn't sent it). Name one, e.g. cdt " .. cmd .. " T9R7.") end return cur end local prog, err = ParseProgressToken(raw) if not prog then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. (err or ("'" .. raw .. "' is not a tier. Use T9, T9R7, T9+3 or T9+3R7."))) ColourNote("silver", "", " Type 'cdt help tier' for the tokens.") return nil end return prog end
function CmdTier(name, line, wildcards) if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end local prog = ProgressArg(wildcards, "tier") if not prog then return end FlushKillBuffer() FlushCombatBuffer() local rows, est = ProgressTotals(PROGRESS_GROUP_KEYS, ProgressSQL(prog)) local ordered = {} for k = 0, 10 do if rows[k] then ordered[#ordered + 1] = {label = ProgressGroupLabel(k), row = rows[k]} end end if #ordered == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Nothing recorded for " .. ProgressLabel(prog) .. ".") return end RenderProgressTable("Levels", ordered, ProgressLabel(prog) .. " - " .. ProgressDescription(prog), est) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt redo " .. ProgressLabel({tier = prog.tier, remort = prog.remort}) .. " compares your redos; 'cdt help tier' explains the tokens.") end
-- XP and QP with and without the PK flags, so their effect can be compared. -- Takes the same optional tier token as cdt tier, e.g. cdt flags T9R7. function CmdFlags(name, line, wildcards) if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end local raw = ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local prog = nil if raw ~= "" then local err prog, err = ParseProgressToken(raw) if not prog then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. (err or ("'" .. raw .. "' is not a tier. Use T9, T9R7, T9+3 or T9+3R7."))) return end end FlushKillBuffer() local rows = ProgressTotals(PROGRESS_FLAG_KEYS, ProgressSQL(prog)) local grid, any = {}, false for k = 0, 3 do local r = rows[k] if r and (r.kills > 0 or r.quests > 0 or r.cps > 0 or r.gqs > 0 or r.secs > 0) then any = true grid[#grid + 1] = { flag = PROGRESS_FLAG_LABELS[k], time = ProgressTime(r.secs), kills = r.kills, xp = r.xp, xphr = r.secs >= 60 and math.floor(r.xp / (r.secs / 3600)) or 0, quests = r.quests + r.cps + r.gqs, qp = r.qp, qphr = r.secs >= 60 and math.floor(r.qp / (r.secs / 3600) * 10) / 10 or 0, } end end if not any then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Nothing recorded" .. (prog and (" for " .. ProgressLabel(prog)) or "") .. ".") return end RenderTable({ {key = "flag", title = "PK flag", w = 9, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "time", title = "Time", w = 8, align = "r", color = "gray"}, {key = "kills", title = "Kills", w = 9, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "xp", title = "XP", w = 11, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "xphr", title = "XP/hr", w = 9, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "quests", title = "Q/CP/GQ", w = 8, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "qp", title = "QP", w = 9, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "qphr", title = "QP/hr", w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "%.1f", blank = "-"}, }, grid, {title = "XP and QP by PK flag" .. (prog and (" - " .. ProgressLabel(prog)) or ""), indent = 1}) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Time is from level-ups and powerups, so rates cover levelling time only.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " 'unknown' is everything recorded before the flags were (v3.9); 'neither' is") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " recorded time with neither flag set. cdt flags T9R7 narrows to one tier.") end
function CmdRedo(name, line, wildcards) if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end local prog = ProgressArg(wildcards, "redo") if not prog then return end if prog.redo and ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("%S") then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] cdt redo compares redos, so leave the redo out, e.g. cdt redo " .. ProgressLabel({tier = prog.tier, remort = prog.remort}) .. ".") return end -- With no token, compare the redos of your current tier across every remort. local scope = {tier = prog.tier, remort = ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("%S") and prog.remort or nil} FlushKillBuffer() FlushCombatBuffer() local rows, est = ProgressTotals(PROGRESS_REDO_KEYS, ProgressSQL(scope)) local keys = {} for k in pairs(rows) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) if (a < 0) ~= (b < 0) then return b < 0 end -- 'unknown' last return a < b end) local ordered = {} for _, k in ipairs(keys) do ordered[#ordered + 1] = { label = k < 0 and "unknown" or ProgressLabel({tier = scope.tier, redo = k, remort = scope.remort}), row = rows[k]} end if #ordered == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Nothing recorded for " .. ProgressLabel(scope) .. ".") return end RenderProgressTable("Redo", ordered, "Redos of " .. ProgressLabel(scope) .. " - " .. ProgressDescription(scope), est) if rows[-1] then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " 'unknown' is data from before v3.9, when redos weren't recorded.") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- DAMAGE VIEW FILTERS -- Every cdt dmg view takes these, anywhere among its own arguments: -- <minlevel> <maxlevel> inclusive, superhero is 201 e.g. 150 201 -- T9 / T9R7 / T9+3 / T9+3R7 a tier, with optional +redo and Rremort -- <from> <to> a date in the cdt config dateformat order, optionally _HHMM -- =============================================================================
-- A tier token: T9 (tier 9), T9R7 (remort 7 of tier 9), T9+3 (redo 3 of tier 9), -- T9+3R7 (both). A remort means nothing without its tier, so "R7" is refused. -- Returns {tier, redo, remort}; false when tok is not a tier token at all; nil -- and a message when it starts like one but is malformed. function ParseProgressToken(tok) tok = tok or "" if tok:match("^[Rr]%d+$") then return nil, "A remort only means something within its tier: add the tier, e.g. T9" .. tok:upper() .. "." end local tier, rest = tok:match("^[Tt](%d+)(.*)$") if not tier then return false end local p = {tier = tonumber(tier)} local redo = rest:match("^%+(%d+)") if redo then p.redo = tonumber(redo) rest = rest:sub(#redo + 2) end local remort = rest:match("^[Rr](%d+)$") if remort then p.remort = tonumber(remort) rest = "" end if rest ~= "" then return nil, "'" .. tok .. "' is not a tier filter. Use T9, T9R7, T9+3 or T9+3R7." end return p end
-- "T9+3R7" for {tier = 9, redo = 3, remort = 7}. function ProgressLabel(p) if not p or not p.tier then return "" end return "T" .. p.tier .. (p.redo and ("+" .. p.redo) or "") .. (p.remort and ("R" .. p.remort) or "") end
-- "tier 9, remort 7 (any redo)" and so on, for report titles. function ProgressDescription(p) local d = "tier " .. p.tier if p.redo then d = d .. ", redo " .. p.redo end if p.remort then d = d .. ", remort " .. p.remort end if not p.redo and not p.remort then d = d .. ", every redo and remort" elseif not p.redo then d = d .. " (any redo)" elseif not p.remort then d = d .. " (every remort)" end return d end
-- " AND tier = 9 AND redo = 3 AND remort = 7": works on every table stamped with -- tier/remort/redo. Rows from before v3.9 have redo -1, so a redo leaves them out. function ProgressSQL(p) if not p or not p.tier then return "" end local sql = string.format(" AND tier = %d", p.tier) if p.redo then sql = sql .. string.format(" AND redo = %d", p.redo) end if p.remort then sql = sql .. string.format(" AND remort = %d", p.remort) end return sql end
-- " at levels 150-201 in T9R7" for a build compare's {lmin, lmax, progress}. function ScopeFilterText(sc) if not sc then return "" end local out = "" if sc.lmin then out = string.format(" at levels %d-%d", sc.lmin, sc.lmax) end if sc.progress then out = out .. " in " .. ProgressLabel(sc.progress) end return out end
-- Returns a timestamp, or nil if the token is not a valid date. -- A typed date in the cdt config dateformat order, optionally with _HHMM. function ParseDmgDate(tok) local a, b, c = tok:match("^(%d+)/(%d+)/(%d+)$") local hh, mi = "0", "0" if not a then a, b, c, hh, mi = tok:match("^(%d+)/(%d+)/(%d+)_(%d%d)(%d%d)$") end if not a then return nil end local mo, dd, yy local order = DateFormatKey() if order == "ymd" then yy, mo, dd = a, b, c elseif order == "dmy" then dd, mo, yy = a, b, c else mo, dd, yy = a, b, c end if #yy ~= 4 or #mo > 2 or #dd > 2 then return nil end mo, dd, yy, hh, mi = tonumber(mo), tonumber(dd), tonumber(yy), tonumber(hh), tonumber(mi) if mo < 1 or mo > 12 or dd < 1 or dd > 31 or hh > 23 or mi > 59 then return nil end local t = TZTime({year = yy, month = mo, day = dd, hour = hh, min = mi, sec = 0}) if not t then return nil end -- os.time quietly rolls 2/30 over into March; reject that instead. local back = TZDate("*t", t) if back.month ~= mo or back.day ~= dd then return nil end return t end
-- Splits a view's arguments into its own words and the filters. Two numbers are -- a level range; views with a row limit (opts.limit) also take one number before -- them, and the level view (opts.single_level) takes one number as one level. -- opts.no_dates refuses date tokens, for commands where a time window is fixed. -- A tier token (T9, T9R7, T9+3, T9+3R7) narrows it to that tier, redo and remort. -- solo, group or grouped narrows it to damage recorded while solo (0) or grouped (1); -- opts.grouped = "refuse" says they can't be used (the player views), "words" leaves -- them as ordinary words (build names). -- Returns the filter, or nil and a message. f.sql_base is the SQL without solo/group -- (for tables that don't have it), f.sql with it. DMG_GROUPED_WORDS = {solo = 0, group = 1, grouped = 1}
function ParseDmgFilter(raw, opts) opts = opts or {} local f = {words = {}} local nums, dates = {}, {} for tok in (raw or ""):gmatch("%S+") do if tok:match("^%d+/") then if opts.no_dates then return nil, "Dates can't be used here: this compares damage dealt since your current instinct/mastery values took effect." end local t = ParseDmgDate(tok) if not t then return nil, "'" .. tok .. "' isn't a date. Use " .. DateFormat().typed .. "[_HHMM], e.g. " .. DateFormat().example .. "_1600." end dates[#dates + 1] = t elseif tok:match("^%d+$") then nums[#nums + 1] = tonumber(tok) elseif opts.grouped ~= "words" and DMG_GROUPED_WORDS[tok:lower()] ~= nil then if opts.grouped == "refuse" then return nil, "solo/group can't be used with cdt dmg player or players." end local g = DMG_GROUPED_WORDS[tok:lower()] if f.grouped ~= nil and f.grouped ~= g then return nil, "Use solo or group, not both." end f.grouped = g else local prog, perr = ParseProgressToken(tok) if prog == nil then return nil, perr end if prog then if f.progress then return nil, "Use one tier filter at a time, e.g. T9R7." end f.progress = prog else f.words[#f.words + 1] = tok end end end if opts.limit and (#nums == 1 or #nums == 3) then f.limit = table.remove(nums, 1) end if opts.single_level and #nums == 1 then f.lmin, f.lmax, f.single = nums[1], nums[1], true elseif #nums == 2 then f.lmin, f.lmax = nums[1], nums[2] elseif #nums > 0 then return nil, "A level range needs two numbers: <minlevel> <maxlevel>, e.g. 150 201." end if f.lmin and (f.lmin < 1 or f.lmax > 201) then return nil, "Levels run from 1 to 201 (201 is superhero)." end if f.lmin and f.lmin > f.lmax then return nil, "The lower level must come first: <minlevel> <maxlevel>." end if #dates == 2 then f.tfrom, f.tto = dates[1], dates[2] if f.tfrom >= f.tto then return nil, "The start date/time must be before the end." end elseif #dates > 0 then return nil, "A date range needs two dates: <from> <to>, e.g. " .. DateFormat().example .. " " .. DateFormat().example2 .. "." end f.name = table.concat(f.words, " ") f.active = f.lmin ~= nil or f.tfrom ~= nil or f.progress ~= nil or f.grouped ~= nil -- A slice covers 30 minutes from its start, so take every slice that overlaps -- the range. Rows from before v3.9 have level 0 and slice 0, and fall outside -- any filter automatically. local sql = "" if f.lmin then sql = sql .. string.format(" AND level BETWEEN %d AND %d", f.lmin, f.lmax) end if f.tfrom then sql = sql .. string.format(" AND slice_start < %d AND slice_start > %d", f.tto, f.tfrom - DAMAGE_SLICE_SECS) end f.sql_base = sql .. ProgressSQL(f.progress) f.sql = f.sql_base .. (f.grouped ~= nil and string.format(" AND grouped = %d", f.grouped) or "") return f end
-- Parses a view's arguments; prints the problem and returns nil if they are bad. function DmgViewFilter(wildcards, opts) local f, err = ParseDmgFilter(wildcards and wildcards[1] or "", opts) if not f then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. err) ColourNote("silver", "", " Filters: <minlevel> <maxlevel>, <from> <to> (" .. DateFormat().typed .. "[_HHMM], your timezone)") ColourNote("silver", "", " and a tier (T9, T9R7, T9+3, T9+3R7). Date order: cdt config dateformat.") ColourNote("silver", "", " solo / group: only damage while solo, or grouped (not for player or players).") ColourNote("silver", "", " for example: cdt dmg attacks T9R7 150 201 " .. DateFormat().example .. " " .. DateFormat().example2 .. "_1600") return nil end return f end
function DmgNoRows(f, msg, legacy) ColourNote("yellow", "", f.grouped ~= nil and ("[CDT] No " .. (f.grouped == 1 and "group" or "solo") .. " damage recorded for that filter.") or f.active and "[CDT] Nothing recorded since v3.9 for that filter." or msg) DmgLegacySection(f, legacy) end
-- Under a filtered view, the pre-v3.9 estimate for the same filter, in a table of -- its own so that approximate numbers never mix into the precise ones above. -- spec.group is the column (or expression) to group by; spec.where narrows it the -- way the view's own name argument does. {unavailable = true} for views whose -- data the old snapshots never recorded. function DmgLegacySection(f, spec) if not f or not f.active or not spec then return end if f.grouped ~= nil then -- legacy_damage is an estimate spread over hours; it can't be split. Say so only -- when the other filters would have shown one. if spec.unavailable or not (f.lmin or f.tfrom or f.progress) then return end local tot = db_query_one("SELECT SUM(damage) AS dmg FROM legacy_damage WHERE category != 'epic'" .. (spec.where or "") .. f.sql_base) if tot and (tonumber(tot.dmg) or 0) >= 1 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " The pre-v3.9 estimate isn't split by solo/group, so it's left out.") end return end if spec.unavailable then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No pre-v3.9 estimate for this view: old snapshots only recorded your damage per attack.") return end local where = " WHERE category != 'epic'" .. (spec.where or "") .. f.sql local tot = db_query_one("SELECT SUM(damage) AS dmg, SUM(est_combat_secs) AS cs FROM legacy_damage" .. where) local tdmg, tcs = tot and tonumber(tot.dmg) or 0, tot and tonumber(tot.cs) or 0 if tdmg < 1 then return end ColourNote("white", "", "") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Damage from before v3.9 isn't in the tables above. Estimated for this filter:") local rows = db_query("SELECT " .. spec.group .. " AS k, SUM(damage) AS dmg, SUM(est_combat_secs) AS cs " .. "FROM legacy_damage" .. where .. " GROUP BY " .. spec.group .. " ORDER BY " .. (spec.order or "dmg DESC") .. (spec.limit and (" LIMIT " .. spec.limit) or "")) local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local k = spec.label_fn and spec.label_fn(r.k) or r.k local dmg, cs = tonumber(r.dmg) or 0, tonumber(r.cs) or 0 grid[#grid + 1] = {k = (k == nil or k == "") and "(unrecorded)" or tostring(k), dmg = math.floor(dmg), dps = cs > 0 and dmg / cs or nil} end ColourNote("white", "", "") RenderTable({ {key = "k", title = spec.label, w = spec.w or 22, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "dmg", title = "Est. Damage", w = 13, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "dps", title = "Est. DPS", w = 9, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "%.1f", blank = "-"}, }, grid, {title = spec.title .. " - estimate from pre-v3.9 data", indent = 1}) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" Estimated total: %s damage%s", comma_value(math.floor(tdmg)), tcs > 0 and string.format(" at %.1f DPS", tdmg / tcs) or "")) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Captured by an older version, so this is an estimate and may not be accurate.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Damage between two snapshots is spread evenly over the hours you were online.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " DPS is each attack's average over all pre-v3.9 combat. Level, subclass") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " and race come from the snapshot at the start of each stretch.") end
function DmgFilterNote(f) if not f or not f.active then return end local parts = {} if f.lmin then parts[#parts + 1] = f.lmin == f.lmax and ("level " .. LevelLabel(f.lmin)) or string.format("levels %d-%d", f.lmin, f.lmax) end if f.tfrom then parts[#parts + 1] = ShowDate("%m/%d/%Y %H:%M", f.tfrom) .. " to " .. ShowDate("%m/%d/%Y %H:%M", f.tto) .. " " .. TZDate("%Z", f.tfrom) end if f.progress then parts[#parts + 1] = ProgressLabel(f.progress) end if f.grouped ~= nil then parts[#parts + 1] = f.grouped == 1 and "group" or "solo" end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Filtered: " .. table.concat(parts, ", ")) if f.tfrom then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " dates match whole 30-minute slices, so up to 30 min either side can be included") end end
-- ---- solo / group (4.4.5) -------------------------------------------------- -- "Damage by Race" -> "Damage by Race - solo"; unchanged without solo/group. function GroupedTitle(f, title) if not f or f.grouped == nil then return title end return title .. (f.grouped == 1 and " - group" or " - solo") end
function GroupedWord(f) return f.grouped == 1 and "Group" or "Solo" end
-- Under solo/group, says the totals just shown are exact. text is a format with one %s -- for "Solo" or "Group". function DmgExactNote(f, text) if not f or f.grouped == nil then return end ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(text or " %s only: damage and time are exact for all your history.", GroupedWord(f))) end
-- Under solo/group, how much of the damage in tbl (matching `where`, and the level, -- date and tier filters) is "not split": recorded before 4.4.5 in a slice that mixed -- solo and group fights, or before v3.9. That damage is in neither the solo nor the -- group figures of the per-attack, damage type and damage taken tables. function DmgNotSplitNote(f, tbl, where) if not f or f.grouped == nil then return end local clause = (where and where ~= "") and where or "1 = 1" local u = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_damage), 0) AS d, " .. "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN slice_start = 0 THEN total_damage ELSE 0 END), 0) AS old " .. "FROM %s WHERE grouped = -1 AND %s%s", tbl, clause, f.sql_base)) or {} local unknown, old = tonumber(u.d) or 0, tonumber(u.old) or 0 if unknown <= 0 then return end local a = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_damage), 0) AS d FROM %s WHERE %s%s", tbl, clause, f.sql_base)) or {} local all = tonumber(a.d) or 0 local pct = all > 0 and math.floor(unknown / all * 100 + 0.5) or 0 local what = tbl == "damage_taken" and "damage taken" or "damage" local head = string.format(" %s only. Not split: %s %s (%s)", GroupedWord(f), comma_value(math.floor(unknown)), what, pct < 1 and "<1%" or (pct .. "%")) local tail = "from before 4.4.5:" if #head + 1 + #tail <= 80 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", head .. " " .. tail) else ColourNote("dimgray", "", head) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. tail) end if old > 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " slices that mixed solo and group fights, and pre-v3.9 data.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " New damage is always split.") else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " slices that mixed solo and group fights. New damage is always split.") end end
-- Column spec for the totals tables of the race, combo and level views under solo/group: -- straight from the area table, so received damage and time are there too. function DmgGroupedCols(title, w, key) return { {key = key, title = title, w = w, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "dmg", title = "Damage", w = 13, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "dps", title = "DPS", w = 9, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "%.1f"}, {key = "recv", title = "Received", w = 12, align = "r", color = "red", fmt = "num"}, {key = "time", title = "Time", w = 11, align = "r", color = "gray"}, } end
-- Damage, received damage and fight time per race (or race + subclass) for a solo or -- group view. The area table has always kept solo and group apart, but has no race: -- a slice's race is the race on its attack rows (any solo/group value, so a slice that -- mixed both before 4.4.5 still has one). A slice with two races (a race change -- mid-slice) is shared between them by their share of its damage. The group's combined -- attack is in the area table's damage; the unfiltered views leave it out, so it comes -- off here too. name narrows to a race (by_class false) or a part of "race/class". -- Returns rows {race, class, td, tr, cs}, biggest damage first. function DmgGroupedRaceRows(f, by_class, name) local key = "class, level, tier, remort, redo, slice_start" local sr = "(SELECT race, " .. key ..
