", SUM(total_damage) AS d FROM attack_stats WHERE 1=1" .. f.sql_base .. " GROUP BY race, " .. key .. ")" local function on(a, b) local c = {} for col in key:gmatch("[%w_]+") do c[#c + 1] = string.format("%s.%s = %s.%s", a, col, b, col) end return table.concat(c, " AND ") end local w = "(CASE WHEN t.d > 0 THEN sr.d * 1.0 / t.d ELSE 1.0 / t.n END)" local sql = "SELECT sr.race AS race, sr.class AS class, SUM(a.td * " .. w .. ") AS td, " .. "SUM(a.tr * " .. w .. ") AS tr, SUM(a.cs * " .. w .. ") AS cs FROM " .. "(SELECT " .. key .. ", SUM(total_damage) AS td, SUM(total_received) AS tr, SUM(combat_secs) AS cs " .. "FROM area_combat_stats WHERE 1=1" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY " .. key .. ") a " .. "JOIN " .. sr .. " sr ON " .. on("sr", "a") .. " " .. "JOIN (SELECT " .. key .. ", SUM(d) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM " .. sr .. " GROUP BY " .. key .. ") t ON " .. on("t", "a") .. " GROUP BY sr.race, sr.class" local acc, order = {}, {} local function slot(race, class) local k = by_class and (race .. "\1" .. class) or race if not acc[k] then acc[k] = {race = race, class = by_class and class or nil, td = 0, tr = 0, cs = 0} order[#order + 1] = acc[k] end return acc[k] end for _, r in ipairs(db_query(sql)) do local a = slot(r.race or "", r.class or "") a.td, a.tr, a.cs = a.td + (tonumber(r.td) or 0), a.tr + (tonumber(r.tr) or 0), a.cs + (tonumber(r.cs) or 0) end for _, e in ipairs(db_query("SELECT race, class, SUM(total_damage) AS d FROM attack_stats " .. "WHERE category = 'epic'" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY race, class")) do local a = slot(e.race or "", e.class or "") a.td = math.max(0, a.td - (tonumber(e.d) or 0)) end local out = {} for _, a in ipairs(order) do local keep = true if name ~= "" then if by_class then keep = (a.race .. "/" .. a.class):lower():find(name:lower(), 1, true) ~= nil else keep = a.race:lower() == name:lower() end end if keep and (a.td > 0 or a.tr > 0) then a.td, a.tr = math.floor(a.td + 0.5), math.floor(a.tr + 0.5) out[#out + 1] = a end end table.sort(out, function(x, y) if x.td ~= y.td then return x.td > y.td end return x.race .. (x.class or "") < y.race .. (y.class or "") end) return out end
-- Damage, received damage and fight time per level for a solo or group view, from the -- area table (the group's combined attack taken off, as in the unfiltered views). function DmgGroupedLevelRows(f) local epic = {} for _, e in ipairs(db_query("SELECT level, SUM(total_damage) AS d FROM attack_stats " .. "WHERE category = 'epic'" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY level")) do epic[tonumber(e.level) or 0] = tonumber(e.d) or 0 end local out = {} for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT level, SUM(total_damage) AS td, SUM(total_received) AS tr, " .. "SUM(combat_secs) AS cs FROM area_combat_stats WHERE 1=1" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY level ORDER BY level")) do local td = math.max(0, (tonumber(r.td) or 0) - (epic[tonumber(r.level) or 0] or 0)) if td > 0 or (tonumber(r.tr) or 0) > 0 then out[#out + 1] = {level = r.level, td = td, tr = tonumber(r.tr) or 0, cs = tonumber(r.cs) or 0} end end return out end
local DMG_BREAKDOWN_FOOTER = "Lines = damage messages, Hits = true hits. Avg/Hit needs data from v3.6 on."
function CmdDmgReport(name, line, wildcards) local f = DmgViewFilter(wildcards) if not f then return end local legacy = {group = "attack_name", label = "Attack", title = "Top attacks", limit = 5} local sd = state.session.dmg -- attack_stats already accumulates every flushed combat, so flush first -- and read all-time totals from the DB alone (adding session would double-count). FlushCombatBuffer() local db_totals = db_query_one("SELECT SUM(total_damage) as td, SUM(combat_secs) as cs, SUM(total_hits) as h, SUM(total_crits) as cr, SUM(COALESCE(precise_hits,0)) as ph, SUM(COALESCE(precise_damage,0)) as pd FROM attack_stats WHERE category != 'epic'" .. f.sql) local db_epic = db_query_one("SELECT SUM(total_damage) as td, SUM(total_hits) as h FROM attack_stats WHERE category = 'epic'" .. f.sql) local db_area = db_query_one("SELECT SUM(total_damage) as td, SUM(total_received) as tr, SUM(combat_secs) as cs FROM area_combat_stats WHERE 1=1" .. f.sql) -- Every attack row holds the whole fight's time, so summing them counts a fight -- once per attack used. The area table records each fight's time once. if db_totals and db_area then db_totals.cs = db_area.cs end -- Solo or group: the area table has always kept them apart, so its damage (less the -- group's combined attack, as the unfiltered figure leaves it out) is exact for all -- history. The attack rows only hold what was split from 4.4.5 on. if f.grouped ~= nil and db_totals and db_area then db_totals.td = math.max(0, (tonumber(db_area.td) or 0) - (db_epic and tonumber(db_epic.td) or 0)) end -- The session lives in memory with no level or time, so a filter skips it. local has_session = not f.active and (sd.damage_dealt > 0 or sd.damage_received > 0) local has_db = db_totals and (db_totals.td or 0) > 0
if not has_session and not has_db then DmgNoRows(f, "[CDT] No combat data recorded yet.", legacy) return end
local function row(label, value, color) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-24s", label), color or "white", "", tostring(value)) end
if has_session then local secs = math.max(1, sd.combat_secs) local sdps = sd.damage_dealt / secs local swings = sd.hits + sd.misses ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Session Damage (Real-Time)") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) row("Damage Dealt", comma_value(sd.damage_dealt), "lime") row("Damage Received", comma_value(sd.damage_received), "red") row("Session DPS", string.format("%.1f", sdps), "cyan") row("Active Combat Time", FormatTime(sd.combat_secs)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) row("Lines / Misses", string.format("%s / %s", comma_value(sd.hits), comma_value(sd.misses))) if (sd.phits or 0) > 0 then row("Hits (true)", string.format("%s (avg %s per hit)", comma_value(sd.phits), comma_value(math.floor(sd.damage_dealt / sd.phits))), "yellow") end if swings > 0 then row("Hit Rate", string.format("%.1f%%", sd.hits / swings * 100), "cyan") end if sd.hits > 0 then row("Crit Rate", string.format("%.1f%% (%s crits)", sd.crits / sd.hits * 100, comma_value(sd.crits)), "magenta") end row("Dodges (mob/self)", string.format("%s / %s", comma_value(sd.dodges_by_mob), comma_value(sd.dodges_by_me))) local epic_dmg = sd.epic_damage or 0 if epic_dmg > 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) row("Epic Combined Attack", string.format("%s dmg %s hits", comma_value(epic_dmg), comma_value(sd.epic_hits or 0)), "yellow") end end
if has_db then local td = db_totals.td or 0 local tr = (db_area and db_area.tr or 0) local cs = math.max(1, (db_totals.cs or 0)) local dps = td / cs ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", GroupedTitle(f, f.active and " Filtered Damage" or " All-Time Damage")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) DmgFilterNote(f) row("Total Damage Dealt", comma_value(td), "lime") row("Total Damage Received", comma_value(tr), "red") row("Overall DPS", string.format("%.1f", dps), "cyan") row("Total Combat Time", FormatTime(cs)) -- Only rows recorded since v16 carry real hit counts. local aph, apd = (db_totals.ph or 0), (db_totals.pd or 0) if aph > 0 then row("Hits (true)", string.format("%s (avg %s per hit)", comma_value(aph), comma_value(math.floor(apd / aph))), "yellow") if apd < td then row("", string.format("from %s of %s damage tracked this way", short_value(apd), short_value(td)), "dimgray") end end local epic_total = (db_epic and db_epic.td or 0) if epic_total > 0 then local epic_hits = (db_epic and db_epic.h or 0) row("Epic Combined Attack", string.format("%s dmg %s lines", comma_value(epic_total), comma_value(epic_hits)), "yellow") end end
-- Avg/Hit only from post-v16 rows, where the hit count is real (DmgLineRows handles it). local top_attacks = DmgLineRows("SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS damtype, MAX(category) AS category, " .. "SUM(total_damage) AS total_damage, SUM(total_hits) AS total_hits, SUM(total_crits) AS total_crits, " .. "SUM(combat_secs) AS combat_secs, SUM(COALESCE(precise_hits,0)) AS ph, SUM(COALESCE(precise_damage,0)) AS pd " .. "FROM attack_stats WHERE category != 'epic'" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY attack_name ORDER BY total_damage DESC LIMIT 5") if #top_attacks > 0 then ColourNote("white", "", "") RenderTable(DMG_LINE_COLS, top_attacks, {title = GroupedTitle(f, "Top 5 Attacks"), indent = 1, footer = DMG_BREAKDOWN_FOOTER}) end DmgNotSplitNote(f, "attack_stats", "category != 'epic'")
DmgLegacySection(f, legacy) if f.grouped ~= nil then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Instinct, mastery and bonus sections aren't shown with solo/group:") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " they're estimated from all your damage and can't be split.") elseif f.active then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " (instinct/mastery estimate skipped: it works from its own snapshot window)") else DmgReportInstinctEstimate() end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) end DMG_DISPATCH.report = "CmdDmgReport"
-- Shared column spec for per-attack breakdowns, used by subclass/race/combo. -- 80 columns. An attack's category (auto/skill/epic) is in cdt dmg map. DMG_LINE_COLS = { {key = "attack", title = "Damage Line", w = 20, align = "l", color = "white"}, {key = "damtype", title = "Damtype", w = 8, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "dmg", title = "Damage", w = 11, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "dps", title = "DPS", w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "%.1f"}, {key = "lines", title = "Lines", w = 6, align = "r", color = "dimgray", fmt = "num"}, {key = "hits", title = "Hits", w = 7, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "avg", title = "Avg/Hit", w = 7, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "crit", title = "Crit%", w = 6, align = "r", color = "magenta", fmt = "pct"}, }
-- Turns attack_stats rows into grid rows, computing DPS, avg/hit and crit%. function DmgLineRows(sql) local out = {} for _, r in ipairs(db_query(sql)) do local ph, pd = r.ph or 0, r.pd or 0 out[#out + 1] = { attack = r.attack_name or "?", damtype = r.damtype or "?", cat = r.category or "?", dmg = r.total_damage or 0, dps = (r.combat_secs or 0) > 0 and (r.total_damage or 0) / r.combat_secs or 0, lines = r.total_hits or 0, hits = ph, avg = ph > 0 and math.floor(pd / ph) or 0, crit = (r.total_hits or 0) > 0 and (r.total_crits or 0) / r.total_hits * 100 or 0, } end return out end

" GROUP BY attack_name ORDER BY total_damage DESC LIMIT %d", limit)) if #rows == 0 then DmgNoRows(f, "[CDT] No attack data recorded yet.", legacy) return end local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local ph, pd = r.ph or 0, r.pd or 0 grid[#grid + 1] = { attack = r.attack_name or "?", damtype = r.damtype or "?", dmg = r.total_damage or 0, dps = (r.combat_secs or 0) > 0 and (r.total_damage or 0) / r.combat_secs or 0, lines = r.total_hits or 0, crit = (r.total_hits or 0) > 0 and (r.total_crits or 0) / r.total_hits * 100 or 0, hits = ph, avg = ph > 0 and math.floor(pd / ph) or 0, } end RenderTable({ {key = "attack", title = "Attack", w = 20, align = "l", color = "white"}, {key = "damtype", title = "Damtype", w = 8, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "dmg", title = "Damage", w = 11, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "dps", title = "DPS", w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "%.1f"}, {key = "lines", title = "Lines", w = 6, align = "r", color = "dimgray", fmt = "num"}, {key = "hits", title = "Hits", w = 7, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "avg", title = "Avg/Hit", w = 7, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "crit", title = "Crit%", w = 6, align = "r", color = "magenta", fmt = "pct"}, }, grid, {title = GroupedTitle(f, "Attack Breakdown (top " .. #rows .. ")"), indent = 1, footer = DMG_BREAKDOWN_FOOTER}) DmgFilterNote(f) DmgNotSplitNote(f, "attack_stats", "1 = 1") DmgLegacySection(f, legacy) end DMG_DISPATCH.attacks = "CmdDmgAttacks"
function CmdDmgTypes(name, line, wildcards) local f = DmgViewFilter(wildcards) if not f then return end local legacy = {group = "damtype", label = "Damtype", title = "Damage by Type", where = f.name ~= "" and (" AND damtype = " .. fixsql(f.name) .. " COLLATE NOCASE") or ""} local rows = db_query("SELECT damtype, SUM(total_damage) as td, SUM(combat_secs) as cs, SUM(total_hits) as th FROM damtype_stats WHERE 1=1" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY damtype ORDER BY td DESC") if #rows == 0 then DmgNoRows(f, "[CDT] No damage type data recorded yet.", legacy) return end local grand_total = 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do grand_total = grand_total + (r.td or 0) end local raw = f.name if raw ~= "" then local kept = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if (r.damtype or ""):lower() == raw:lower() then kept[#kept + 1] = r end end if #kept == 0 then DmgNoRows(f, "[CDT] No damage recorded for damage type: " .. raw, legacy) return end rows = kept end
local summary = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do summary[#summary + 1] = { damtype = r.damtype or "?", dmg = r.td or 0, pct = grand_total > 0 and (r.td or 0) / grand_total * 100 or 0, dps = (r.cs or 0) > 0 and (r.td or 0) / r.cs or 0, lines = r.th or 0, cat = DAMTYPE_BROAD[r.damtype] or "magic", } end local secs_sql = "SELECT SUM(combat_secs) AS cs FROM area_combat_stats WHERE 1=1" .. f.sql if f.grouped ~= nil then -- only the fights that have attack rows with this solo/group value, to match the damage above secs_sql = secs_sql .. " AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attack_stats s WHERE s.class = area_combat_stats.class " .. "AND s.level = area_combat_stats.level AND s.tier = area_combat_stats.tier " .. "AND s.remort = area_combat_stats.remort AND s.redo = area_combat_stats.redo " .. "AND s.slice_start = area_combat_stats.slice_start AND s.grouped = area_combat_stats.grouped)" end local total_secs = tonumber((db_query_one(secs_sql) or {}).cs) or 0 if raw == "" then summary[#summary + 1] = {damtype = "TOTAL", dmg = grand_total, pct = 100.0, dps = total_secs > 0 and grand_total / total_secs or nil} end RenderTable({ {key = "damtype", title = "Damtype", w = 15, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "dmg", title = "Damage", w = 13, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "pct", title = "Pct", w = 7, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "pct"}, {key = "dps", title = "DPS", w = 9, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "%.1f"}, {key = "lines", title = "Lines", w = 8, align = "r", color = "dimgray", fmt = "num"}, {key = "cat", title = "Category", w = 9, align = "l", color = "gray"}, }, summary, {title = GroupedTitle(f, "Damage by Type"), indent = 1}) DmgFilterNote(f)
-- Avg/hit is meaningless for a whole damtype but useful per damage line, -- so the breakdown carries it and the summary above does not. local shown = false for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local dt = r.damtype or "" if dt ~= "" and (raw == "" or raw:lower() == dt:lower()) then local lrows = DmgLineRows(string.format( "SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS damtype, MAX(category) AS category, " .. "SUM(total_damage) AS total_damage, SUM(combat_secs) AS combat_secs, SUM(total_hits) AS total_hits, " .. "SUM(total_crits) AS total_crits, SUM(COALESCE(precise_hits,0)) AS ph, " .. "GROUP BY attack_name ORDER BY total_damage DESC LIMIT 12", fixsql(dt))) if #lrows > 0 then ColourNote("white", "", "") RenderTable(DMG_LINE_COLS, lrows, {title = GroupedTitle(f, dt .. " - damage lines"), indent = 1}) shown = true end end end if shown then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. DMG_BREAKDOWN_FOOTER) end DmgNotSplitNote(f, "attack_stats", "category != 'epic'" .. legacy.where) DmgLegacySection(f, legacy) end DMG_DISPATCH.types = "CmdDmgTypes"
-- ============================================================================= -- A groupmate's damage by kind (melee, spell, skill) and by damage type. Both come -- from the attack mappings as they are now, so a correction made with cdt dmg map -- applies to damage already recorded. Melee is a weapon's damage word, whatever its -- damage type: mind force is melee, even though its damage is mental. -- ============================================================================= PLAYER_KIND = {auto = "Melee", spell = "Spell", skill = "Skill"}
local function PlayerAttackKind(name, stored_dt) local dt, cat = LookupDamtype(name or "") local spell = LookupSpellForVerb(name or "") -- another player's gaias focus is unknowable: keep what was recorded if spell and GAIAS_SPELLS[spell] then dt = stored_dt or dt end if dt == "unknown" and stored_dt and stored_dt ~= "" then dt = stored_dt end return dt or "unknown", PLAYER_KIND[cat] or "Unmapped" end
function SharePct(v, total) if total <= 0 or v <= 0 then return "0%" end local pct = v / total * 100 if pct < 0.1 then return "<0.1%" end return string.format("%.1f%%", pct) end
-- Rows of the player's attacks, grouped by attack, summed into kinds and types. function PlayerDamageSplit(pname, where) local out = {total = 0, kinds = {Melee = 0, Spell = 0, Skill = 0, Unmapped = 0}, types = {}, attacks = {}} for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format("SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS damtype, SUM(total_damage) AS d " .. "FROM player_attack_stats WHERE player = %s COLLATE NOCASE" .. (where or "") .. " GROUP BY attack_name", fixsql(pname)))) do local d = tonumber(r.d) or 0 if d > 0 then local dt, kind = PlayerAttackKind(r.attack_name, r.damtype) out.total = out.total + d out.kinds[kind] = out.kinds[kind] + d out.types[dt] = (out.types[dt] or 0) + d out.attacks[#out.attacks + 1] = {name = r.attack_name or "?", dt = dt, kind = kind, d = d} end end table.sort(out.attacks, function(a, b) return a.d > b.d end) return out end
-- Damage types by share, four to a line; below min_pct left out (and counted). function DamtypeShareLines(types, total, min_pct) local list, left = {}, 0 for dt, d in pairs(types) do if total > 0 and d / total * 100 >= (min_pct or 0) then list[#list + 1] = {dt = dt, d = d} else left = left + 1 end end table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.d > b.d end) if #list == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " none") return end for i = 1, #list, 4 do local segs = {"silver", "", " "} for j = i, math.min(i + 3, #list) do local e = list[j] segs[#segs + 1] = e.dt == "unknown" and "dimgray" or "cyan" segs[#segs + 1] = "" segs[#segs + 1] = string.format(" %-10s", e.dt:sub(1, 10)) segs[#segs + 1] = "white" segs[#segs + 1] = "" segs[#segs + 1] = string.format("%7s ", SharePct(e.d, total)) end ColourNote(unpack(segs)) end return left end
-- What this player healed you for, by spell. function PlayerHealsOnYou(pname, where) if not DbTableExists("main", "heal_log") then return end local rows = db_query(string.format("SELECT spell, SUM(amount) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(amount) AS mx " .. "FROM heal_log WHERE self = 0 AND healer = %s COLLATE NOCASE" .. (where or "") .. " GROUP BY spell ORDER BY h DESC", fixsql(pname))) if #rows == 0 then return end local total, count, biggest = 0, 0, 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do total = total + (tonumber(r.h) or 0) count = count + (tonumber(r.n) or 0) biggest = math.max(biggest, tonumber(r.mx) or 0) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("white", "", " Heals on you", "lime", "", string.format(" %s over %s heal%s, %s each on average, biggest %s", comma_value(total), comma_value(count), count == 1 and "" or "s", comma_value(count > 0 and math.floor(total / count + 0.5) or 0), comma_value(biggest))) for i = 1, (#rows > 1) and math.min(5, #rows) or 0 do local r = rows[i] local h, c = tonumber(r.h) or 0, tonumber(r.n) or 0 ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-26s", (r.spell or "?"):sub(1, 25)), "white", "", string.format("%14s%8s %7s", comma_value(h), comma_value(c), SharePct(h, total))) end if #rows > 5 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" ... and %d more (cdt heal report player %s)", #rows - 5, pname)) end end
-- The last day this player was seen fighting (in your timezone): the attacks and -- damage types that made up at least 1% of that day's damage. PLAYER_RECENT_MIN_PCT = 1
function PlayerRecentDay(pname, where) local last = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT MAX(slice_start) AS s FROM player_attack_stats " .. "WHERE player = %s COLLATE NOCASE AND slice_start > 0" .. (where or ""), fixsql(pname))) local s = last and tonumber(last.s) if not s or s <= 0 then return end local day0 = LocalPeriodStart("day", s) local day1 = LocalPeriodStart("day", day0 + 30 * 3600) local day = PlayerDamageSplit(pname, (where or "") .. string.format(" AND slice_start >= %d AND slice_start < %d", day0, day1)) if day.total <= 0 then return end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) local title = " Most recent day: " .. ShowDate("%a %m/%d", day0) .. " (your time)" local right = short_value(day.total) .. " damage" ColourNote("white", "", title .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, 79 - #title - #right)), "lime", "", right) ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-26s%-11s%-7s%8s%13s", "Damage line", "Damtype", "Kind", "Share", "Damage")) local shown, hidden = 0, 0 for _, a in ipairs(day.attacks) do if a.d / day.total * 100 >= PLAYER_RECENT_MIN_PCT then ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-26s", a.name:sub(1, 25)), a.dt == "unknown" and "dimgray" or "cyan", "", string.format("%-11s", a.dt:sub(1, 10)), a.kind == "Unmapped" and "dimgray" or "yellow", "", string.format("%-7s", a.kind), "white", "", string.format("%8s%13s", SharePct(a.d, day.total), comma_value(a.d))) shown = shown + 1 else hidden = hidden + 1 end end ColourNote("white", "", " Damage types that day") local left = DamtypeShareLines(day.types, day.total, PLAYER_RECENT_MIN_PCT) if hidden + (left or 0) > 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" Left out, under 1%% of the day: %d line%s, %d type%s.", hidden, hidden == 1 and "" or "s", left or 0, left == 1 and "" or "s")) end end
function CmdDmgPlayer(name, line, wildcards) local f = DmgViewFilter(wildcards, {grouped = "refuse"}) if not f then return end local pname = f.name local legacy = {unavailable = true} if pname == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt dmg player <name>") return end local profile = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT player, SUM(total_damage) AS total_damage, SUM(combat_secs) AS combat_secs, " .. "SUM(melee_damage) AS melee_damage, SUM(spell_damage) AS spell_damage, " .. "SUM(total_hits) AS total_hits, SUM(total_crits) AS total_crits, " .. "MIN(first_seen) AS first_seen, MAX(last_seen) AS last_seen " .. "FROM player_profiles WHERE player=%s COLLATE NOCASE" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY player COLLATE NOCASE", fixsql(pname))) if not profile then -- A groupmate who only heals has no damage, but their heals are still worth showing. local healed = DbTableExists("main", "heal_log") and db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM heal_log WHERE self = 0 AND healer = %s COLLATE NOCASE" .. f.sql, fixsql(pname))) if healed and (tonumber(healed.n) or 0) > 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Player Scouting: " .. pname) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No damage recorded" .. (f.active and " for that filter." or ".")) PlayerHealsOnYou(pname, f.sql) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) DmgFilterNote(f) return end ColourNote("yellow", "", (f.active and "[CDT] Nothing recorded since v3.9 for that level/date filter for player: " or "[CDT] No data for player: ") .. pname) DmgLegacySection(f, legacy) return end local dps = (profile.combat_secs or 1) > 0 and (profile.total_damage or 0) / profile.combat_secs or 0 local total_dmg = profile.total_damage or 0 local split = PlayerDamageSplit(pname, f.sql)
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Player Scouting: " .. pname) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) local function row(label, value, color) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", label), color or "white", "", tostring(value)) end row("Total Damage", comma_value(total_dmg), "lime") row("DPS", string.format("%.1f", dps), "cyan") row("Combat Time", FormatTime(profile.combat_secs or 0)) row("Total Hits", comma_value(profile.total_hits or 0)) if (profile.total_hits or 0) > 0 then row("Crit Rate", string.format("%.1f%% (%s crits)", (profile.total_crits or 0) / profile.total_hits * 100, comma_value(profile.total_crits or 0)), "magenta") end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) local function share(v) return string.format("%s (%s)", comma_value(v), SharePct(v, split.total)) end row("Melee Damage", share(split.kinds.Melee), "yellow") row("Spell Damage", share(split.kinds.Spell), "cyan") row("Skill Damage", share(split.kinds.Skill), "lime") if split.kinds.Unmapped > 0 then row("Unmapped", share(split.kinds.Unmapped) .. " (cdt dmg map unknown)", "dimgray") end row("First Seen", ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", profile.first_seen or 0), "gray") row("Last Seen", ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", profile.last_seen or 0), "gray") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("white", "", " Damage types") DamtypeShareLines(split.types, split.total, 0) PlayerHealsOnYou(pname, f.sql) PlayerRecentDay(pname, f.sql) DmgFilterNote(f)
local attacks = db_query(string.format( "SELECT attack_name, MAX(damtype) AS damtype, MAX(category) AS category, SUM(total_damage) AS total_damage, SUM(total_hits) AS total_hits, SUM(total_crits) AS total_crits, SUM(combat_secs) AS combat_secs, MIN(min_hit) AS min_hit, MAX(max_hit) AS max_hit, SUM(COALESCE(precise_hits,0)) AS ph, SUM(COALESCE(precise_damage,0)) AS pd FROM player_attack_stats WHERE player=%s COLLATE NOCASE" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY attack_name ORDER BY total_damage DESC LIMIT 15", fixsql(pname))) if #attacks > 0 then local grid = {} for _, a in ipairs(attacks) do local ph, pd = a.ph or 0, a.pd or 0 grid[#grid + 1] = { attack = a.attack_name or "?", damtype = a.damtype or "?", dmg = a.total_damage or 0, dps = (a.combat_secs or 0) > 0 and (a.total_damage or 0) / a.combat_secs or 0, lines = a.total_hits or 0, crit = (a.total_hits or 0) > 0 and (a.total_crits or 0) / a.total_hits * 100 or 0, hits = ph, avg = ph > 0 and math.floor(pd / ph) or 0, } end RenderTable(DMG_LINE_COLS, grid, {title = pname .. " - attacks", indent = 1, footer = DMG_BREAKDOWN_FOOTER}) else ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) end DmgLegacySection(f, legacy) end DMG_DISPATCH.player = "CmdDmgPlayer"
function CmdDmgPlayers(name, line, wildcards) local f = DmgViewFilter(wildcards, {grouped = "refuse"}) if not f then return end local legacy = {unavailable = true} local rows = db_query("SELECT player, SUM(total_damage) AS total_damage, SUM(combat_secs) AS combat_secs, SUM(total_hits) AS total_hits, SUM(total_crits) AS total_crits, MIN(first_seen) AS first_seen, MAX(last_seen) AS last_seen FROM player_profiles WHERE 1=1" .. f.sql .. -- ============================================================================= -- cdt dmg taken [filters] / taken player <name> [filters] / taken players [filters] -- ============================================================================= local function TakenUsage() ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage:") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt dmg taken [filters]", "silver", "", " damage you took") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt dmg taken player <name> [filters]", "silver", "", " damage a groupmate took") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt dmg taken players [filters]", "silver", "", " everyone, by damage taken") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " filters: <minlevel> <maxlevel>, <from> <to>, T9R7 ... (cdt help dmg)") end
local function TakenTable(title, rows, label_fn, total, second) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-30s%14s%9s%10s%8s", title, "Damage", "Hits", second, "Share")) for i = 1, math.min(10, #rows) do local r = rows[i] local d, h = tonumber(r.d) or 0, tonumber(r.h) or 0 local sv = second == "Biggest" and comma_value(tonumber(r.mx) or 0) or comma_value(h > 0 and math.floor(d / h + 0.5) or 0) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" %-30s", label_fn(r):sub(1, 29)), "white", "", string.format("%14s%9s%10s", comma_value(d), comma_value(h), sv), "silver", "", string.format("%8s", SharePct(d, total))) end if #rows > 10 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" ... and %d more", #rows - 10)) end end
function TakenReport(where, title, is_self, f) local base_where = where -- without solo/group, for the 'not split' note where = where .. f.sql local tot = db_query_one("SELECT SUM(total_damage) AS d, SUM(lines) AS l, SUM(hits) AS h, SUM(crits) AS c, " .. "MAX(max_hit) AS mx FROM damage_taken WHERE " .. where) or {} local total = tonumber(tot.d) or 0 ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", " " .. GroupedTitle(f, title)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) if total <= 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No damage taken recorded" .. (f.active and " for that filter." or " yet (it's recorded from 4.3 on).")) DmgNotSplitNote(f, "damage_taken", base_where) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) return end local function row(label, value) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", label), "white", "", value) end row("Damage taken", comma_value(total)) row("Hits", string.format("%s (in %s lines)", comma_value(tonumber(tot.h) or 0), comma_value(tonumber(tot.l) or 0))) row("Biggest hit", comma_value(tonumber(tot.mx) or 0)) local by = function(col, extra) return db_query("SELECT " .. col .. " AS k" .. (extra or "") .. ", SUM(total_damage) AS d, SUM(hits) AS h, " .. "MAX(max_hit) AS mx FROM damage_taken WHERE " .. where .. " GROUP BY " .. col .. " ORDER BY d DESC") end TakenTable("Hit by", by("attacker"), function(r) return r.k or "?" end, total, "Biggest") TakenTable("Attack", by("attack_name", ", MAX(damtype) AS dt"), function(r) return (r.k or "?") .. ((r.dt and r.dt ~= "unknown") and (" (" .. r.dt .. ")") or "") end, total, "Avg/Hit") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("white", "", " Damage types") local types = {} for _, r in ipairs(by("damtype")) do types[r.k or "unknown"] = tonumber(r.d) or 0 end DamtypeShareLines(types, total, 0) if is_self then for _, g in ipairs({{"race", "By race"}, {"class", "By subclass"}}) do local parts = {} for _, r in ipairs(by(g[1])) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s %s", (r.k and r.k ~= "") and r.k or "?", SharePct(tonumber(r.d) or 0, total)) end ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-12s", g[2]), "silver", "", table.concat(parts, ", ")) end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) DmgNotSplitNote(f, "damage_taken", base_where) DmgFilterNote(f) end
function TakenPlayers(f) local rows = db_query("SELECT is_self, MAX(victim) AS victim, SUM(total_damage) AS d, SUM(hits) AS h, MAX(max_hit) AS mx " .. "FROM damage_taken WHERE 1 = 1" .. f.sql .. " GROUP BY is_self, CASE WHEN is_self = 1 THEN '' ELSE victim COLLATE NOCASE END ORDER BY d DESC") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", GroupedTitle(f, " Damage taken, by player")) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No damage taken recorded" .. (f.active and " for that filter." or " yet.")) One player: cdt dmg taken player <name>") DmgNotSplitNote(f, "damage_taken", "1 = 1") DmgFilterNote(f) end

function CreateSnapshotHeader(snap_type) local now = os.time() local cls = state.current.subclass or state.current.class or "" local race = state.current.race or "" local qp = state.player_totals.qp_earned or 0 local pups = state.player_totals.pups or 0 local tier = state.current.tier or 0 local remort = state.current.remort or 0 local level = state.current.level or 0 db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO snapshot_headers (time, type, class, race, total_qp, total_pups, tier, remort, level) VALUES (%d, %s, %s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d)", now, fixsql(snap_type), fixsql(cls), fixsql(race), qp, pups, tier, remort, level)) local header_id = 0 pcall(function() for row in db:nrows("SELECT last_insert_rowid() as id") do header_id = row.id end end) -- Record a damage baseline so estimates can be scoped to damage dealt -- while these instinct/mastery values were actually in effect. if header_id > 0 and (snap_type == "instinct" or snap_type == "mastery") then FlushCombatBuffer() -- A new slice starts here, as it does on a level change: damage before this -- moment was dealt under the old values, damage after it under the new ones. state.current.dmg_slice_start = now db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO snapshot_dmg_baseline (header_id, attack_name, damtype, category, total_damage) " .. "SELECT %d, attack_name, damtype, category, SUM(total_damage) FROM attack_stats GROUP BY attack_name", header_id)) end return header_id end
local MASTERY_SPLINE = { {x0=0, x1=16, a=0, b=0.327054606057, c=0, d=-0.000056853930}, {x0=16, x1=37, a=5, b=0.283390787886, c=-0.002728988636, d=0.000027240843}, {x0=37, x1=65, a=10, b=0.204812899865, c=-0.001012815556, d=0.000002700720}, {x0=65, x1=104, a=15, b=0.154447321545, c=-0.000785955099, d=0.000002899445}, {x0=104, x1=163, a=20, b=0.106372990370, c=-0.000446720060, d=0.000001358591}, {x0=163, x1=260, a=25, b=0.067847790921, c=-0.000206249422, d=0.000000393750}, {x0=260, x1=455, a=30, b=0.038949787390, c=-0.000091668140, d=0.000000120093}, {x0=455, x1=1039, a=35, b=0.016898789393, c=-0.000021413901, d=0.000000012223}, }
function MasteryToDmgPct(pts) if pts <= 0 then return 0 end if pts >= 1039 then return 40 end for _, s in ipairs(MASTERY_SPLINE) do if pts <= s.x1 then local dx = pts - s.x0 return s.a + s.b * dx + s.c * dx * dx + s.d * dx * dx * dx end end return 40 end
-- Global: the optimizer helpers are defined earlier in the file and index this -- directly, which would resolve to nil if it were a local. INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES = { ["sanctuary"] = {max200 = 45, label = "mitigation", base_pct = true}, ["enhanced damage"] = {max200 = 11, label = "melee dmg"}, ["scorpion strike"] = {max200 = 8.69, label = "melee dmg"}, ["protection good"] = {max200 = 37.88, label = "mitigation"}, ["protection evil"] = {max200 = 37.88, label = "mitigation"}, ["incomplete healing"] = {max200 = 48.47, label = "healing", base_heal = 3400}, }
local SANCT_WIS_TABLE = { {14, 25}, {29, 26}, {44, 27}, {59, 28}, {74, 29}, {79, 30}, {89, 31}, {104, 32}, {119, 33}, {134, 34}, {149, 35}, {159, 36}, {164, 37}, {179, 38}, {194, 39}, {209, 40}, {224, 41}, {239, 42}, {319, 43}, {399, 44}, {479, 45}, {559, 46}, {600, 47}, }
function SanctBaseMit(wis) for _, entry in ipairs(SANCT_WIS_TABLE) do if wis <= entry[1] then return entry[2] end end return 47 end
function ExtractWis(query) if not query then return query, nil end local wis = query:match("(%d+)wis") if not wis then return query, nil end local clean = query:gsub("%d+wis", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") return clean, tonumber(wis) end
local INSTINCT_ATTACK_SPELLS = { ["desolation"] = true, ["spear of odin"] = true, ["gaias fury"] = true, ["apocalypse"] = true, ["heavenly balance"] = true, ["voice of god"] = true, ["eruption"] = true, ["air skewer"] = true, ["ice daggers"] = true, ["immolate"] = true, ["miasma"] = true, ["earthen hammer"] = true, ["test of faith"] = true, ["gaias revenge"] = true, -- Standard spell curve. necrocide's damage line is its own name (negative); void -- sermon's is 'wail', recorded as void sermon (negative) by cdt wail. ["void sermon"] = true, ["necrocide"] = true, }
for spell in pairs(INSTINCT_ATTACK_SPELLS) do INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES[spell] = {max200 = 40, label = "spell dmg"} end
-- Instincts deliberately left out of every damage calculation, each with the -- reason shown to the user. Two distinct failures: -- * physical attack skills that do not follow the spell curve -- * spells whose damage verb is unknown, so damage cannot be attributed -- Excluding them loudly beats scoring them at zero silently, which would make -- an optimizer recommend against them with false confidence. INSTINCT_UNKNOWN_CURVE = { ["hammering blow"] = "physical attack skill, curve not verified", ["spiral"] = "physical attack skill, curve not verified", ["charge"] = "physical attack skill, curve not verified", ["toxic cloud"] = "curve not verified, damage verb unmapped", }
-- These DO follow the standard spell curve, so benefit tables are meaningful. -- What is missing is the damage verb, so their damage cannot be found in -- attack_stats and no damage estimate or projection is possible. Kept out of -- the optimizer, which would otherwise score them at zero and quietly advise -- against training them. INSTINCT_UNMAPPED_VERB = { }
-- Any reason this instinct is left out of damage calculations, or nil. function InstinctExclusionReason(skill) if not skill then return nil end local k = skill:lower() return INSTINCT_UNKNOWN_CURVE[k] or INSTINCT_UNMAPPED_VERB[k] end
-- Maps damage verbs (from attack_stats) to spell names (from instinct) -- gaias fury verb changes based on gaias focus element - "fury" is the common suffix local DAMAGE_VERB_TO_SPELL = { ["anguish"] = "desolation", ["spear of odin"] = "spear of odin", ["apocalyptic force"] = "apocalypse", ["heavenly balance"] = "heavenly balance", ["piercing sound"] = "voice of god", ["eruption"] = "eruption", ["skewer of air"] = "air skewer", ["icy daggers"] = "ice daggers", ["shroud of flame"] = "immolate", ["miasma of pain"] = "miasma", ["earthen hammer"] = "earthen hammer", ["fury"] = "gaias fury", ["spiralling force"] = "spiral", ["faith"] = "test of faith", ["frenzied attack"] = "charge", ["hammering blow"] = "hammering blow", ["wrath of gaia"] = "gaias revenge", -- void sermon's word is "wail", shared with sonic weapons; cdt wail files it under -- its own name. ["void sermon"] = "void sermon", ["necrocide"] = "necrocide", }
function LookupSpellForVerb(attack_name) return DAMAGE_VERB_TO_SPELL[attack_name] or DAMAGE_VERB_TO_SPELL[attack_name:lower()] end
-- A spell's damage verb and damtype without needing any recorded damage: -- invert the verb map, then ask damtype_map about the verb. Returns nil damtype -- for a spell whose verb has never been seen and was not seeded -- normal for -- another subclass's spells, and the reason mastery is shown as unknown there. function SpellVerbAndDamtype(spell) for verb, sp in pairs(DAMAGE_VERB_TO_SPELL) do if sp == spell then local dt = LookupDamtype(verb) if dt and dt ~= "unknown" then return verb, dt end return verb, nil end end return nil, nil end
function InstinctPctEstimate(skill_name, pts) if pts <= 0 then return nil end local curve = INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES[skill_name:lower()] if not curve then return nil end local scale = 1.65 * curve.max200 return curve, pts / (130 + pts) * scale end
-- Global (not local): referenced by the projection helpers defined earlier in -- the file, which would otherwise resolve this to nil. INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES = { ["second attack"] = {C = 114.2, A = 0.6364}, ["third attack"] = {C = 118.2, A = 0.6436}, ["fourth attack"] = {C = 119.5, A = 0.7984}, ["dual wield"] = {C = 111.1, A = 0.7039}, ["haste"] = {C = 109.8, A = 0.6024}, ["knife fighting"] = {C = 119.5, A = 0.8434}, }
function AttackInstinctSwings(attack_name, pts) if pts <= 0 then return nil end local curve = INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES[attack_name:lower()] if not curve then return nil end return curve.A * pts / (curve.C + pts) end
function InstinctBenefitStr(skill_name, pts, wis) local pct_curve, pct_val = InstinctPctEstimate(skill_name, pts) local swings = AttackInstinctSwings(skill_name, pts) if pct_curve and pct_curve.base_heal then local hp = math.floor(pct_curve.base_heal * (1 + pct_val / 100)) return string.format("~%.1f%% %s, %dhp @600wis", pct_val, pct_curve.label, hp) elseif pct_curve and pct_curve.label == "mitigation" then if pct_curve.base_pct then local use_wis = wis or 600 local base = SanctBaseMit(use_wis) return string.format("~%.1f%% incr. (%d%%*%.3f=%.1f%% mit. @%dwis)", pct_val, base, 1 + pct_val / 100, base * (1 + pct_val / 100), use_wis) else return string.format("~%.1f%% incr.", pct_val) end elseif pct_curve then return string.format("~%.1f%% %s", pct_val, pct_curve.label) elseif swings then return string.format("~%.2f swings/rd", swings) end return nil end
function InstinctBenefitStrColor(skill_name, pts, wis) local pct_curve, pct_val = InstinctPctEstimate(skill_name, pts) local swings = AttackInstinctSwings(skill_name, pts) if pct_curve and pct_curve.base_heal then local hp = math.floor(pct_curve.base_heal * (1 + pct_val / 100)) return string.format("@C~%.1f%% @w%s@D, @G%dhp @D@@600wis", pct_val, pct_curve.label, hp) elseif pct_curve and pct_curve.label == "mitigation" then if pct_curve.base_pct then local use_wis = wis or 600 local base = SanctBaseMit(use_wis) return string.format("@C~%.1f%% @wincr. @D(@W%d%%@D*%.3f@D=@G%.1f%% @wmit. @D@@%dwis@D)", pct_val, base, 1 + pct_val / 100, base * (1 + pct_val / 100), use_wis) else return string.format("@C~%.1f%% @wincr.", pct_val) end elseif pct_curve then return string.format("@C~%.1f%% @w%s", pct_val, pct_curve.label) elseif swings then return string.format("@C~%.2f @wswg/rd", swings) end return nil end
function InstinctTrainCost(n) return 175 + 25 * n end
function InstinctGoldCost(n) return 1900000 + 100000 * n end
function InstinctRangeCost(from, to) local trains, gold = 0, 0 local count = to - from local nsum = to * (to + 1) / 2 - from * (from + 1) / 2 trains = 175 * count + 25 * nsum gold = 1900000 * count + 100000 * nsum return trains, gold end
function MasteryQpCost(n) return 80 + 20 * n end
function MasteryGoldCost(n) return 1750000 + 250000 * n end
function MasteryRangeCost(from, to) local count = to - from local nsum = to * (to + 1) / 2 - from * (from + 1) / 2 local qp = 80 * count + 20 * nsum local gold = 1750000 * count + 250000 * nsum return qp, gold end
function FindInstinctMatch(query) local q = query:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local all_names = {} for k in pairs(INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES) do all_names[#all_names + 1] = k end for k in pairs(INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES) do all_names[#all_names + 1] = k end -- Matchable so commands can explain why there is no curve, rather than -- claiming the skill does not exist. -- INSTINCT_UNMAPPED_VERB entries are already in INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES (they -- have a real curve), so only the curve-less ones need adding here. for k in pairs(INSTINCT_UNKNOWN_CURVE) do all_names[#all_names + 1] = k end
local exact = {} for _, name in ipairs(all_names) do if name == q then exact[#exact + 1] = name end end if #exact > 0 then return exact end
local words = {} for w in q:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end
local partial = {} for _, name in ipairs(all_names) do local match = true for _, w in ipairs(words) do if not name:find(w, 1, true) then match = false; break end end if match then partial[#partial + 1] = name end end return partial end
-- ============================================================================= -- INSTINCT DISPATCHER (cdt instinct) -- ============================================================================= function CmdInstinct(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if raw == "" then inst_capture.data = {} inst_capture.mode = "table" inst_capture.channel = nil EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_inst_cap", true) SendNoEcho("instinct") return end
local subcmd, rest = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)") subcmd = (subcmd or ""):lower()
if subcmd == "report" or subcmd == "fullreport" then local ch = CheckChannel(rest ~= "" and rest or nil, "Usage: cdt instinct " .. subcmd .. " [channel]") if not ch then return end inst_capture.data = {} inst_capture.mode = subcmd inst_capture.channel = ch EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_inst_cap", true) SendNoEcho("instinct") elseif subcmd == "benefit" then CmdInstinctBenefit(rest) elseif subcmd == "project" then CmdInstinctProject(rest) elseif subcmd == "help" then CmdInstinctHelp() else local lo = tonumber(subcmd) if lo then local hi_str, skill_query = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(.*)") local hi = tonumber(hi_str) if hi and skill_query and skill_query ~= "" then CmdInstinctCost(lo, hi, skill_query) else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt instinct <from> <to> <skill name>") end else CmdInstinctHelp() end end end
-- Global for the same reason as INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES above. INSTINCT_NON_DAMAGE = { ["sanctuary"] = true, ["protection good"] = true, ["protection evil"] = true, ["incomplete healing"] = true, }
function CmdInstinctProject(rest) if not rest or rest == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt instinct project <points> <skill>") ColourNote("silver", "", " Example: cdt instinct project 10 deso") return end local pts_str, skill_query = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(.*)") local add_pts = tonumber(pts_str) if not add_pts or not skill_query or skill_query == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt instinct project <points> <skill>") return end if add_pts <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Points must be positive.") return end if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end FlushCombatBuffer()
local matches = FindInstinctMatch(skill_query) if #matches == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct skill matching '" .. skill_query .. "'.") return end local skill = matches[1]
if INSTINCT_NON_DAMAGE[skill] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Projection only supports damage instincts. " .. skill .. " is mitigation/healing.") return end local why_unknown = InstinctExclusionReason(skill) if why_unknown then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. skill .. ": " .. why_unknown .. ".") ColourNote("silver", "", " It is excluded from projections and from the report's instinct") ColourNote("silver", "", " totals, rather than being scored at zero.") return end
local latest_inst = db_query_one( "SELECT h.id FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN instinct_detail d ON d.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'instinct' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") if not latest_inst then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct snapshot found. Run 'cdt instinct' first.") return end local inst_data = {} local inst_rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT attack_name, instinct_count FROM instinct_detail WHERE header_id = %d", latest_inst.id)) for _, r in ipairs(inst_rows) do inst_data[r.attack_name:lower()] = r.instinct_count end
-- Shared-pool skills are trained through their owner, so project that instead. local pool = ResolveInstinctPool(skill) if pool ~= skill then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format("[CDT] %s draws on %s's instinct pool - projecting %s.", skill, pool, pool)) end local cur_pts = inst_data[pool] or 0 local new_pts = cur_pts + add_pts if new_pts > 200 then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] %s: %d + %d = %d exceeds cap of 200. Max you can add: %d.", pool, cur_pts, add_pts, new_pts, math.max(0, 200 - cur_pts))) return end
local sc = GetScopedDamage() local total_all_dmg = sc.total local total_melee = sc.melee local backstab_dmg = sc.backstab if total_all_dmg <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No damage data recorded in the current snapshot window.") return end
local delta_dmg = 0 local detail = ""
if skill == "enhanced damage" then local base = total_melee + backstab_dmg if base <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No melee/backstab damage recorded.") return end local _, cur_pct = InstinctPctEstimate(skill, cur_pts) local _, new_pct = InstinctPctEstimate(skill, new_pts) cur_pct = cur_pct or 0 new_pct = new_pct or 0 local cur_base = base / (1 + cur_pct / 100) local new_total = cur_base * (1 + new_pct / 100) delta_dmg = math.floor(new_total - base) detail = string.format("melee+backstab: +%.1f%% -> +%.1f%%", cur_pct, new_pct)
elseif skill == "scorpion strike" then if total_melee <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No melee damage recorded.") return end local _, cur_pct = InstinctPctEstimate(skill, cur_pts) local _, new_pct = InstinctPctEstimate(skill, new_pts) cur_pct = cur_pct or 0 new_pct = new_pct or 0 local cur_base = total_melee / (1 + cur_pct / 100) local new_total = cur_base * (1 + new_pct / 100) delta_dmg = math.floor(new_total - total_melee) detail = string.format("melee only: +%.2f%% -> +%.2f%%", cur_pct, new_pct)
elseif INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES[skill] then local latest_dtrack = db_query_one( "SELECT h.id FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN dtrack_hits_slots s ON s.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'dtrack_hits' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") if not latest_dtrack or total_melee <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Need dtrack snapshot and melee data. Run 'dtrack hits' first.") return end local slots = db_query(string.format( "SELECT slot_name, hit_count, instinct_count FROM dtrack_hits_slots WHERE header_id = %d", latest_dtrack.id)) local total_hits, total_inst = 0, 0 for _, s in ipairs(slots) do if DTRACK_MELEE_SLOTS[s.slot_name] then total_hits = total_hits + (s.hit_count or 0) total_inst = total_inst + (s.instinct_count or 0) end end if total_hits <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No melee hit data in dtrack snapshot.") return end local cur_extra = AttackInstinctSwings(skill, cur_pts) or 0 local new_extra = AttackInstinctSwings(skill, new_pts) or 0 local extra_ratio = new_extra - cur_extra local avg_dmg_per_hit = total_melee / total_hits delta_dmg = math.floor(avg_dmg_per_hit * total_hits * extra_ratio) detail = string.format("extra swing ratio: %.4f -> %.4f (+%.4f)", cur_extra, new_extra, extra_ratio)
elseif INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES[skill] and INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES[skill].label == "spell dmg" then local spell_dmg = 0 local verb_found = nil local spell_rows = {} for atk_name, sa in pairs(sc.scoped) do if (sa.category == "skill" or sa.category == "spell") and atk_name ~= "backstab" then spell_rows[#spell_rows + 1] = {attack_name = atk_name, total_damage = sa.damage} end end for _, sr in ipairs(spell_rows) do local mapped = LookupSpellForVerb(sr.attack_name) or sr.attack_name:lower() if mapped == skill then spell_dmg = spell_dmg + (sr.total_damage or 0) verb_found = sr.attack_name end end if spell_dmg <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] No damage data for spell '%s'. (No matching verb in attack_stats.)", skill)) return end local _, cur_pct = InstinctPctEstimate(skill, cur_pts) local _, new_pct = InstinctPctEstimate(skill, new_pts) cur_pct = cur_pct or 0 new_pct = new_pct or 0 local cur_base = spell_dmg / (1 + cur_pct / 100) local new_total = cur_base * (1 + new_pct / 100) delta_dmg = math.floor(new_total - spell_dmg) detail = string.format("%s: +%.1f%% -> +%.1f%%", verb_found or skill, cur_pct, new_pct) else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No damage projection formula for: " .. skill) return end
local pct_of_total = total_all_dmg > 0 and delta_dmg / total_all_dmg * 100 or 0 local trains, gold = InstinctRangeCost(cur_pts, new_pts)
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Instinct Projection: %s +%d pts", skill, add_pts)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Based on: " .. ScopeNoteStr(sc)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Sample damage:"), "silver", "", comma_value(total_all_dmg)) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Current points:"), "white", "", string.format("%d", cur_pts)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Projected points:"), "white", "", string.format("%d", new_pts)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Mechanic:"), "cyan", "", detail) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Est. extra damage:"), "lime", "", string.format("+%s", comma_value(delta_dmg))) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Overall dmg increase:"), "yellow", "", string.format("+%.2f%%", pct_of_total)) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Training cost:"), "cyan", "", string.format("%s trains, %s gold", comma_value(trains), comma_value(gold))) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) end
function CmdMasteryProject(rest) if not rest or rest == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt mastery project <points> <damtype>") ColourNote("silver", "", " Example: cdt mastery project 50 fire") return end local pts_str, dtype_query = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(.*)") local add_pts = tonumber(pts_str) if not add_pts or not dtype_query or dtype_query == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt mastery project <points> <damtype>") return end if add_pts <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Points must be positive.") return end if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end FlushCombatBuffer()
local dtype = dtype_query:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
local latest_mast = db_query_one( "SELECT h.id FROM snapshot_headers h INNER JOIN mastery_detail d ON d.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'mastery' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") if not latest_mast then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No mastery snapshot found. Run 'cdt mastery' first.") return end local mast_data = {} local mast_rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT skill_name, mastery_pct FROM mastery_detail WHERE header_id = %d", latest_mast.id)) for _, r in ipairs(mast_rows) do mast_data[r.skill_name:lower()] = r.mastery_pct end
local cur_pts = mast_data[dtype] if not cur_pts then local avail = {} for k in pairs(mast_data) do avail[#avail + 1] = k end table.sort(avail) ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No mastery data for damtype '" .. dtype .. "'.") if #avail > 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", " Available: " .. table.concat(avail, ", ")) end return end
local new_pts = cur_pts + add_pts if new_pts > 1039 then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] %s: %d + %d = %d exceeds cap of 1039. Max you can add: %d.", dtype, cur_pts, add_pts, new_pts, math.max(0, 1039 - cur_pts))) return end
local sc = GetScopedDamage() local total_all_dmg = sc.total local dt_dmg = 0 for _, sa in pairs(sc.scoped) do if sa.damtype and sa.damtype:lower() == dtype then dt_dmg = dt_dmg + sa.damage end end
if dt_dmg <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] No %s damage recorded in the current snapshot window.", dtype)) return end
local cur_pct = MasteryToDmgPct(cur_pts) local new_pct = MasteryToDmgPct(new_pts) local cur_base = dt_dmg / (1 + cur_pct / 100) local new_total = cur_base * (1 + new_pct / 100) local delta_dmg = math.floor(new_total - dt_dmg) local pct_of_total = total_all_dmg > 0 and delta_dmg / total_all_dmg * 100 or 0
local qp, gold = MasteryRangeCost(cur_pts, new_pts)
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Mastery Projection: %s +%d pts", dtype, add_pts)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Based on: " .. ScopeNoteStr(sc)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Sample damage:"), "silver", "", comma_value(total_all_dmg)) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Current points:"), "white", "", string.format("%d", cur_pts)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Projected points:"), "white", "", string.format("%d", new_pts)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Dmg bonus:"), "cyan", "", string.format("+%.1f%% -> +%.1f%%", cur_pct, new_pct)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Affected damage:"), "silver", "", string.format("%s (%s dmg)", comma_value(dt_dmg), dtype)) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Est. extra damage:"), "lime", "", string.format("+%s", comma_value(delta_dmg))) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Overall dmg increase:"), "yellow", "", string.format("+%.2f%%", pct_of_total)) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Training cost:"), "cyan", "", string.format("%s QP, %s gold", comma_value(qp), comma_value(gold))) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) end

function OnInstinctCapture(name, line, wildcards) local skill = (wildcards.skill or ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1") local amount = tonumber(wildcards.amount) if skill == "" or not amount or amount <= 0 then return end inst_capture.data[skill] = amount SnapshotStepActivity() if IsTimer("cdt_inst_done") ~= error_code.eOK then AddTimer("cdt_inst_done", 0, 0, SNAPSHOT_LINE_GAP, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot, "OnInstinctComplete") else ResetTimer("cdt_inst_done") end end
function OnInstinctComplete() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_inst_cap", false) local count = 0 for _ in pairs(inst_capture.data) do count = count + 1 end if count == 0 then if inst_capture.mode ~= "snapshot" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct data captured.") end if inst_capture.on_complete then local cb = inst_capture.on_complete inst_capture.on_complete = nil cb() end return end
-- Only store a snapshot when something actually changed; an identical one -- adds no information and would needlessly reset the damage baseline. if db and not SnapshotUnchanged("instinct", "instinct_detail", "attack_name", "instinct_count", inst_capture.data) then local header_id = CreateSnapshotHeader("instinct") if header_id > 0 then db_exec("BEGIN;") for skill, ic in pairs(inst_capture.data) do db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO instinct_detail (header_id, attack_name, instinct_count) VALUES (%d, %s, %d)", header_id, fixsql(skill), ic)) end db_exec("COMMIT;") end end
local sorted = {} for skill, ic in pairs(inst_capture.data) do sorted[#sorted + 1] = {name = skill, count = ic} end table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.count > b.count end)
if inst_capture.mode == "report" or inst_capture.mode == "fullreport" then local full = inst_capture.mode == "fullreport" local parts = {} for _, s in ipairs(sorted) do if full then local ben = InstinctBenefitStrColor(s.name, s.count) if ben then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@D[@W%s@D|@C%d %s@D]", s.name, s.count, ben) else parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@D[@W%s@D|@C%d@D]", s.name, s.count) end else parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@D[@W%s@D|@C%d@D]", s.name, s.count) end end Report(inst_capture.channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wInstinct " .. table.concat(parts, " ")) elseif inst_capture.mode == "snapshot" then DebugNote(string.format("Instinct snapshot saved: %d skills", count)) else ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Instinct snapshot: %d skills", count)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-22s %5s %s", "Skill", "Count", "Estimated Benefit")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) for _, s in ipairs(sorted) do local ben = InstinctBenefitStr(s.name, s.count) if ben then ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s ", s.name), "cyan", "", string.format("%4d", s.count), "gray", "", " " .. ben) else ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s ", s.name), "cyan", "", string.format("%4d", s.count)) end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) end
if inst_capture.on_complete then local cb = inst_capture.on_complete inst_capture.on_complete = nil cb() end end
function CmdInstinctCost(from, to, query) if from < 0 or from > 200 or to < 0 or to > 200 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Instinct values must be between 0 and 200.") return end if from >= to then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] <from> must be less than <to>.") return end local clean_query, wis = ExtractWis(query) local matches = FindInstinctMatch(clean_query) if #matches == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct skill matching '" .. clean_query .. "'.") return end
local trains, gold = InstinctRangeCost(from, to) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" Instinct Cost: %d -> %d", from, to)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Trains: ", "cyan", "", string.format("%s", comma_value(trains))) ColourNote("silver", "", " Gold: ", "cyan", "", string.format("%s", comma_value(gold)))
for _, skill in ipairs(matches) do local ben_before = InstinctBenefitStr(skill, from, wis) local ben_after = InstinctBenefitStr(skill, to, wis) if ben_before or ben_after then ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 40)) ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. skill .. ":") ColourNote("silver", "", " Before (" .. from .. "): ", "gray", "", ben_before or "n/a") ColourNote("silver", "", " After (" .. to .. "): ", "lime", "", ben_after or "n/a") else ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. skill .. ": ", "dimgray", "", "no benefit data") end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) end
function CmdInstinctBenefit(query) if not query or query == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt instinct benefit <skill name> [<N>wis]") return end local clean_query, wis = ExtractWis(query) local matches = FindInstinctMatch(clean_query) if #matches == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct skill matching '" .. clean_query .. "'.") return end
for _, skill in ipairs(matches) do local has_pct = INSTINCT_PCT_CURVES[skill] local has_atk = INSTINCT_ATTACK_CURVES[skill] if INSTINCT_UNKNOWN_CURVE[skill] then ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. skill .. ": ", "yellow", "", INSTINCT_UNKNOWN_CURVE[skill]) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Excluded from damage calculations.") elseif not has_pct and not has_atk then ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. skill .. ": ", "dimgray", "", "benefit data not present") else local wis_label = wis and string.format(" (@%dwis)", wis) or "" ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("white", "", " " .. skill .. " - Instinct Benefit Table" .. wis_label) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %5s %s", "Inst", "Benefit")) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 40)) for pts = 0, 200, 5 do local ben = InstinctBenefitStr(skill, pts, wis) if ben then local color = pts % 25 == 0 and "cyan" or "silver" ColourNote(color, "", string.format(" %5d ", pts), "gray", "", ben) end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) -- Curve is real, but its damage cannot be located in attack_stats. if INSTINCT_UNMAPPED_VERB[skill] then ColourNote("yellow", "", " Note: " .. INSTINCT_UNMAPPED_VERB[skill] .. ".") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " The percentages above are correct, but this skill is left out of") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " damage reports, projections and the optimizer until its verb is known.") end end end end
-- ============================================================================= -- MASTERY DISPATCHER (cdt mastery) -- ============================================================================= function CmdMastery(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if raw == "" then mast_capture.data = {} mast_capture.mode = "table" mast_capture.channel = nil EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_mast_cap", true) SendNoEcho("mastery") return end
local subcmd, rest = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)") subcmd = (subcmd or ""):lower()
if subcmd == "report" or subcmd == "fullreport" then local ch = CheckChannel(rest ~= "" and rest or nil, "Usage: cdt mastery " .. subcmd .. " [channel]") if not ch then return end mast_capture.data = {} mast_capture.mode = subcmd mast_capture.channel = ch EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_mast_cap", true) SendNoEcho("mastery") elseif subcmd == "benefit" then CmdMasteryBenefit() elseif subcmd == "project" then CmdMasteryProject(rest) elseif subcmd == "help" then CmdMasteryHelp() else local lo = tonumber(subcmd) if lo then local hi = tonumber(rest) if hi then CmdMasteryCost(lo, hi) else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt mastery <from> <to>") end else CmdMasteryHelp() end end end
