if mast_capture.on_complete then local cb = mast_capture.on_complete mast_capture.on_complete = nil cb() end end
function CmdMasteryCost(from, to) if from < 0 or from > 1039 or to < 0 or to > 1039 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Mastery values must be between 0 and 1039.") return end if from >= to then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] <from> must be less than <to>.") return end local qp, gold = MasteryRangeCost(from, to) local pct_before = MasteryToDmgPct(from) local pct_after = MasteryToDmgPct(to) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 55)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" Mastery Cost: %d -> %d pts", from, to)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 55)) ColourNote("silver", "", " QP: ", "cyan", "", string.format("%s", comma_value(qp))) ColourNote("silver", "", " Gold: ", "cyan", "", string.format("%s", comma_value(gold))) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 40)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Dmg before: ", "gray", "", string.format("~%.1f%%", pct_before)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Dmg after: ", "lime", "", string.format("~%.1f%%", pct_after)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Increase: ", "cyan", "", string.format("+%.1f%%", pct_after - pct_before)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 55)) end
function CmdMasteryBenefit() ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 40)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Mastery Benefit Table") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 40)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %5s %8s", "Pts", "Dmg Inc%")) ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 30)) local steps = {0,1,2,3,4,5,10,16,20,25,30,37,40,50,65,75,100,104,125,150,163,175,200,250,260,300,350,400,455,500,600,700,800,900,1000,1039} for _, pts in ipairs(steps) do local pct = MasteryToDmgPct(pts) local marker = "" for _, bp in ipairs(MASTERY_SPLINE) do if pts == bp.x0 or pts == bp.x1 then marker = " *" end end local color = marker ~= "" and "cyan" or "silver" ColourNote(color, "", string.format(" %5d %7.2f%%%s", pts, pct, marker)) end ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. string.rep("-", 30)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " * = known breakpoint from game data") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 40)) end
-- ============================================================================= -- BUILD SAVE / COMPARE -- ============================================================================= function BuildFind(name) if not db or not name or name == "" then return nil end return db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT build_id, name, race, class, created, modified, " .. "COALESCE(gaias_focus,'') AS gaias_focus FROM builds WHERE name = %s COLLATE NOCASE", fixsql(name))) end
function BuildLoadData(build_id) local inst_data, mast_data = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format( "SELECT kind, name, points FROM build_detail WHERE build_id = %d", build_id))) do if r.kind == "instinct" then inst_data[r.name:lower()] = r.points elseif r.kind == "mastery" then mast_data[r.name:lower()] = r.points end end return inst_data, mast_data end
function BuildStoreData(build_id, inst_data, mast_data) db_exec("BEGIN;") db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM build_detail WHERE build_id = %d", build_id)) for k, v in pairs(inst_data) do db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO build_detail (build_id, kind, name, points) VALUES (%d, 'instinct', %s, %d)", build_id, fixsql(k), math.floor(v))) end for k, v in pairs(mast_data) do db_exec(string.format( "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO build_detail (build_id, kind, name, points) VALUES (%d, 'mastery', %s, %d)", build_id, fixsql(k), math.floor(v))) end db_exec(string.format("UPDATE builds SET modified = %d WHERE build_id = %d", os.time(), build_id)) db_exec("COMMIT;") end
function BuildCreate(name, race, cls, focus) db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO builds (name, race, class, created, modified, gaias_focus) " .. "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %d, %d, %s)", fixsql(name), fixsql(race or ""), fixsql(cls or ""), os.time(), os.time(), fixsql(focus or ""))) local row = db_query_one("SELECT last_insert_rowid() as id") return row and row.id or 0 end
function CmdBuildSave(rest) local name = (rest or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if name == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt build save <name>") return end if BuildFind(name) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Build '" .. name .. "' already exists. Use a different name or delete it first.") return end local inst_data, mast_data = GetCurrentBuildData() if not next(inst_data) and not next(mast_data) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct/mastery snapshot found. Run 'cdt instinct' and 'cdt mastery' first.") return end local cls = state.current.subclass or state.current.class or "" local race = state.current.race or "" local focus = config.gaias_focus or "" local id = BuildCreate(name, race, cls, focus) if id > 0 then BuildStoreData(id, inst_data, mast_data) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Saved build '%s' (%s / %s) from current values.", name, race ~= "" and race or "?", cls ~= "" and cls or "?")) if SubclassCanFocusGaias(cls) then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Gaias focus: " .. GaiasFocusLabel(focus)) end end end
function CmdBuildNew(rest) local name, race, cls = (rest or ""):match("^(%S+)%s*(%S*)%s*(%S*)$") if not name or name == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt build new <name> [race] [subclass]") return end if BuildFind(name) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Build '" .. name .. "' already exists.") return end if race == "" then race = state.current.race or "" end if cls == "" then cls = state.current.subclass or state.current.class or "" end local id = BuildCreate(name, race, cls, SubclassCanFocusGaias(cls) and (config.gaias_focus or "") or "") if id > 0 then ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Created empty build '%s' (%s / %s).", name, race ~= "" and race or "?", cls ~= "" and cls or "?")) ColourNote("silver", "", " Add values with: cdt build set " .. name .. " inst|mast <name> <points>") end end
function CmdBuildCopy(rest) local src, dst = (rest or ""):match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)$") if not src then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt build copy <source> <newname>") return end local b = BuildFind(src) if not b then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No build named '" .. src .. "'."); return end if BuildFind(dst) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Build '" .. dst .. "' already exists."); return end local inst_data, mast_data = BuildLoadData(b.build_id) local id = BuildCreate(dst, b.race, b.class, b.gaias_focus) if id > 0 then BuildStoreData(id, inst_data, mast_data) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Copied '%s' to '%s'.", src, dst)) end end
function CmdBuildList() local rows = db_query("SELECT name, race, class, created, modified FROM builds ORDER BY name") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" %-20s %-12s %-14s %s", "Build", "Race", "Subclass", "Saved")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No builds saved. Use 'cdt build save <name>'.") else for _, r in ipairs(rows) do ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-20s ", r.name), "cyan", "", string.format("%-12s ", r.race ~= "" and r.race or "-"), "cyan", "", string.format("%-14s ", r.class ~= "" and r.class or "-"), "dimgray", "", ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", r.created or 0)) end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) end
function CmdBuildShow(rest) local name = (rest or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local b = BuildFind(name) if not b then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No build named '" .. name .. "'."); return end local inst_data, mast_data = BuildLoadData(b.build_id) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Build: %s (%s / %s)", b.name, b.race ~= "" and b.race or "?", b.class ~= "" and b.class or "?")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) local gf = b.gaias_focus or "" if gf ~= "" or SubclassGetsGaias(b.class) then ColourNote("silver", "", " Gaias focus: ", "cyan", "", GaiasFocusLabel(gf)) end local si = {} for k, v in pairs(inst_data) do if v > 0 then si[#si + 1] = {k = k, v = v} end end table.sort(si, function(a, b2) return a.v > b2.v end) if #si > 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", " Instinct") for _, e in ipairs(si) do ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-28s", e.k), "cyan", "", string.format("%5d", e.v)) end end local sm = {} for k, v in pairs(mast_data) do if v > 0 then sm[#sm + 1] = {k = k, v = v} end end table.sort(sm, function(a, b2) return a.v > b2.v end) if #sm > 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", " Mastery") for _, e in ipairs(sm) do ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-28s", e.k), "cyan", "", string.format("%5d", e.v)) end end if #si == 0 and #sm == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " (empty build)") end
-- Cost to reach these values from nothing, so two builds can be compared on -- what they actually take to train rather than only on what they produce. local trains, inst_gold, qp, mast_gold = BuildTotalCost(inst_data, mast_data) if trains > 0 or qp > 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", " Cost from scratch") RenderTable({ {key = "side", title = "", w = 12, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "cost", title = "Trains", w = 12, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "qp", title = "QP", w = 10, align = "r", color = "magenta", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "gold", title = "Gold", w = 16, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num"}, }, { {side = "Instinct", cost = trains, qp = nil, gold = inst_gold}, {side = "Mastery", cost = nil, qp = qp, gold = mast_gold}, {side = "Total", cost = trains, qp = qp, gold = inst_gold + mast_gold}, }, {indent = 1, width = 60, no_bottom = true}) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) end
function BuildSetValue(rest, relative) local name, kind, skill, val = (rest or ""):match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(.-)%s+([%+%-]?%d+)$") if not name then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] Usage: cdt build %s <name> inst|mast <skill> %s", relative and "add" or "set", relative and "<+/-points>" or "<points>")) return end local b = BuildFind(name) if not b then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No build named '" .. name .. "'."); return end kind = kind:lower() if kind == "inst" or kind == "instinct" then kind = "instinct" elseif kind == "mast" or kind == "mastery" then kind = "mastery" else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Kind must be 'inst' or 'mast'."); return end
local cap = kind == "instinct" and 200 or 1039 local inst_data, mast_data = BuildLoadData(b.build_id) local target = kind == "instinct" and inst_data or mast_data
local key = skill:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if kind == "instinct" then local matches = FindInstinctMatch(key) if #matches == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct skill matching '" .. key .. "'.") return end key = matches[1] end
local n = tonumber(val) or 0 local new_val = relative and ((target[key] or 0) + n) or n if new_val < 0 then new_val = 0 end if new_val > cap then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] %s caps at %d (tried %d).", kind, cap, new_val)) return end target[key] = new_val BuildStoreData(b.build_id, inst_data, mast_data) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] %s: %s %s = %d", b.name, kind, key, new_val)) end
-- Imports an instinct-builder.com share URL into a build. The URL carries a -- complete instinct spread, so it replaces the build's instinct side entirely; -- any mastery values already on the build are left alone. function BuildImportInstinctBuilder(build_name, url) if not url or url == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt build set <name> instinctbuilderstring <url>") return end local qs = url:match("%?(.*)$") or url if qs == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No query string found in that URL.") return end
local inst_new, unknown, subclass = {}, {}, nil local count = 0 for k, v in qs:gmatch("([^&=]+)=([^&]*)") do local key = k:lower() if key == "subclass" then if v ~= "" then subclass = v:sub(1, 1):upper() .. v:sub(2):lower() end elseif key ~= "hide" then local n = tonumber(v) if n then if n < 0 then n = 0 end if n > 200 then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] %s=%d exceeds the instinct cap; clamped to 200.", key, n)) n = 200 end local skill = INSTINCT_BUILDER_PARAMS[key] if skill then inst_new[skill] = n else -- Keep the value under its raw param name rather than dropping it. inst_new[key] = n unknown[#unknown + 1] = key end count = count + 1 end end end
if count == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct values parsed from that URL.") return end
local b = BuildFind(build_name) local created = false if not b then local id = BuildCreate(build_name, state.current.race or "", subclass or "") if id <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Could not create build."); return end b = BuildFind(build_name) created = true end
local _, mast_data = BuildLoadData(b.build_id) BuildStoreData(b.build_id, inst_new, mast_data) if subclass then db_exec(string.format("UPDATE builds SET class = %s WHERE build_id = %d", fixsql(subclass), b.build_id)) end
local nonzero = 0 for _, v in pairs(inst_new) do if v > 0 then nonzero = nonzero + 1 end end
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Imported instinct-builder into '%s'%s", b.name, created and " (created)" or "")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s ", "Subclass:"), "cyan", "", subclass or "(not in URL)") ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s ", "Values parsed:"), "cyan", "", string.format("%d (%d non-zero)", count, nonzero)) if #unknown > 0 then table.sort(unknown) ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format(" %-22s ", "Unmapped params:"), "yellow", "", table.concat(unknown, ", ")) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Stored under their raw names. Tell me the skill they map to.") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Mastery values on this build were left unchanged.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt build show " .. b.name .. " | cdt build compare " .. b.name) end
-- cdt build set <name> subclass|race <value>: which subclass and race a build is -- for, so a comparison projects it against the right recorded damage. function BuildSetIdentity(build_name, column, value) local b = BuildFind(build_name) if not b then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No build named '" .. build_name .. "'."); return end value = value:sub(1, 1):upper() .. value:sub(2):lower() if column == "class" and not SUBCLASS_INSTINCTS[value:lower()] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] '" .. value .. "' is not a subclass. cdt build subclass lists them.") return end db_exec(string.format("UPDATE builds SET %s = %s WHERE build_id = %d", column, fixsql(value), b.build_id)) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] %s: %s set to %s.", b.name, column == "class" and "subclass" or "race", value)) end
function BuildSetGaiasFocus(build_name, element) local b = BuildFind(build_name) if not b then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No build named '" .. build_name .. "'."); return end local e = (element or ""):lower() if e == "clear" or e == "none" or e == "unset" then db_exec(string.format("UPDATE builds SET gaias_focus = '' WHERE build_id = %d", b.build_id)) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] " .. b.name .. ": gaias focus cleared - " .. GaiasFocusLabel("") .. ".") return end for _, valid in ipairs(GAIAS_ELEMENTS) do if e == valid then db_exec(string.format("UPDATE builds SET gaias_focus = %s WHERE build_id = %d", fixsql(e), b.build_id)) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] " .. b.name .. ": gaias focus set to " .. e .. ".") if not SubclassCanFocusGaias(b.class) then ColourNote("yellow", "", " Note: " .. (b.class ~= "" and b.class or "this subclass") .. " cannot actually focus gaias in game - only shaman can.") end return end end ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown element '" .. e .. "'. Use: " .. table.concat(GAIAS_ELEMENTS, ", ") .. ", or clear.") end
function CmdBuildDelete(rest) local raw = (rest or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local confirm = false local name = raw if raw:match("%s+confirm$") then confirm = true name = raw:match("^(.-)%s+confirm$") end local b = BuildFind(name) if not b then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No build named '" .. tostring(name) .. "'."); return end if not confirm then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] Delete build '%s' (%s / %s)?", b.name, b.race, b.class)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Type: cdt build delete " .. b.name .. " confirm") return end db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM build_detail WHERE build_id = %d", b.build_id)) db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM builds WHERE build_id = %d", b.build_id)) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Deleted build '" .. b.name .. "'.") end
-- No recorded damage for either side's subclass, so there is nothing to scale. -- What can still be compared is the MULTIPLIERS themselves: melee as one -- combined figure (every extra-swing instinct together) and each damage spell -- on its own. Race is irrelevant here -- it only ever mattered for the -- melee-vs-spell mix, which needs data to know. function CompareWithoutData(A, B, tierA, tierB, levels) if levels then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format( "[CDT] No damage recorded%s for these builds; a comparison without damage data ignores that filter.", ScopeFilterText(levels))) end if (A.class or "") == "" or (B.class or "") == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] A build with no subclass recorded cannot be compared without damage data.") ColourNote("silver", "", " Set one with: cdt build set <name> subclass <subclass>") return end if A.class:lower() ~= B.class:lower() then local missing = {} if tierA >= 3 then missing[#missing + 1] = A.class end if tierB >= 3 and B.class:lower() ~= A.class:lower() then missing[#missing + 1] = B.class end ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] Can't compare %s (%s) with %s (%s).", A.label, A.class, B.label, B.class)) local who = table.concat(missing, " or ") ColourNote("silver", "", " No damage is recorded as " .. who .. ", and builds of different subclasses") ColourNote("silver", "", " share no spells to compare on multipliers alone. Record some damage as") ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. who .. " and compare again.") return end
-- Melee needs swings per round. Prefer the live tracker; otherwise fall back -- to the rounds-weighted average of every dtrack snapshot ever taken, across -- all races and subclasses -- and say so. local dtrack = GetDtrackSummary() local spr, spr_note = nil, nil if dtrack and (tonumber(dtrack.spr) or 0) > 0 then spr = tonumber(dtrack.spr) spr_note = string.format("current dtrack (%.2f swings/round)", spr) else local avg, cnt = AverageHistoricalSpr() if avg and avg > 0 then spr = avg spr_note = string.format( "assumed %.2f swings/round -- historical average of %d dtrack snapshot%s across all races/subclasses", avg, cnt, cnt == 1 and "" or "s") end end
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Build Comparison: %s vs %s", A.label, B.label)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("white", "", " Basis: ", "orange", "", "no damage data -- multipliers only, not projected damage") ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format( " no recorded damage for subclass %s, so race is ignored entirely", A.class)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " figures below are relative multipliers, not a total") if spr_note then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " melee: " .. spr_note) else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " melee: unavailable -- no dtrack data at all (run 'cdt dtrack')") end if SubclassGetsGaias(A.class) or SubclassGetsGaias(B.class) then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" gaias focus: %s vs %s", GaiasFocusLabel(A.focus), GaiasFocusLabel(B.focus))) end
local rows = {}
-- Melee as ONE figure, every melee instinct together: extra swings from the -- attack curves, plus the flat damage instincts that only apply to autohits. -- Mastery is left out on purpose -- which damtype your weapons hit for is -- only knowable from recorded damage, and there is none here. if spr then local melee_info = {damtype = "unknown", category = "auto"} local ma = MeleeSwingMultiplier(A.inst, {spr = spr}) * AttackMultiplier("hit", melee_info, A.inst, {}, A.focus) local mb = MeleeSwingMultiplier(B.inst, {spr = spr}) * AttackMultiplier("hit", melee_info, B.inst, {}, B.focus) rows[#rows + 1] = {name = "melee (all combined)", dmtype = "n/a", a = ma, b = mb, delta = mb - ma} end
-- One row per damage SPELL. A candidate with no damage verb is a melee -- instinct (enhanced damage, scorpion strike, dual wield) and is already -- inside the melee figure above, so it is skipped rather than double-counted. -- Instinct always applies; mastery only where the verb's damtype is known. local unknown_dt = {} for _, spell in ipairs(OptimizerCandidates(A.class)) do local verb, dt = SpellVerbAndDamtype(spell) if verb then local info = {damtype = dt or "unknown", category = "skill"} local ma = AttackMultiplier(verb, info, A.inst, dt and A.mast or {}, A.focus) local mb = AttackMultiplier(verb, info, B.inst, dt and B.mast or {}, B.focus) if ma ~= 1 or mb ~= 1 then if not dt then unknown_dt[#unknown_dt + 1] = spell end rows[#rows + 1] = {name = spell, dmtype = dt or "?", a = ma, b = mb, delta = mb - ma} end end end
if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Neither build puts points into anything that affects damage.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) return end
table.sort(rows, function(x, y) return math.abs(y.delta) < math.abs(x.delta) end) local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do grid[#grid + 1] = { name = r.name, dmtype = r.dmtype, a = string.format("x%.3f", r.a), b = string.format("x%.3f", r.b), delta = string.format("%+.1f%%", r.a > 0 and (r.b / r.a - 1) * 100 or 0), } end RenderTable({ {key = "name", title = "Source", w = 22, align = "l", color = "white"}, {key = "dmtype", title = "Damtype", w = 9, align = "l", color = "dimgray"}, {key = "a", title = FitText(A.label, 9), w = 9, align = "r", color = "cyan"}, {key = "b", title = FitText(B.label, 9), w = 9, align = "r", color = "cyan"}, {key = "delta", title = "Change", w = 9, align = "r", color = "white"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 66, no_bottom = true})
if #unknown_dt > 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format( " Mastery excluded for %d spell%s with an unrecorded damtype: %s", #unknown_dt, #unknown_dt == 1 and "" or "s", FitText(table.concat(unknown_dt, ", "), 44))) end
local tA, gA, qA, mgA = BuildTotalCost(A.inst, A.mast) local tB, gB, qB, mgB = BuildTotalCost(B.inst, B.mast) local dt_, dg_, dq_, dmg_ = BuildCost(FoldInstinctPools(A.inst), FoldInstinctPools(B.inst), A.mast, B.mast) BuildCostSection(A, B, tA, gA, qA, mgA, tB, gB, qB, mgB, dt_, dg_, dq_, dmg_) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Record damage on this subclass for a projected-damage comparison.") end
-- The Cost section of a build comparison: what each build takes to hold, and what -- going from the first to the second costs on top of what is already trained. function BuildCostSection(A, B, tA, gA, qA, mgA, tB, gB, qB, mgB, dt_, dg_, dq_, dmg_) RenderTable({ {key = "what", title = "", w = 22, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "trains", title = "Trains", w = 12, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "qp", title = "QP", w = 10, align = "r", color = "magenta", fmt = "num"}, {key = "gold", title = "Gold", w = 16, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num"}, }, { {what = FitText(A.label, 16) .. " total", trains = tA, qp = qA, gold = gA + mgA}, {what = FitText(B.label, 16) .. " total", trains = tB, qp = qB, gold = gB + mgB}, {what = FitText(A.label, 9) .. " -> " .. FitText(B.label, 9), trains = dt_, qp = dq_, gold = dg_ + dmg_}, }, {title = "Cost", indent = 1, width = 66}) end
function CmdBuildCompare(rest) -- Same parser as the cdt dmg views: two numbers are a level range. Dates are -- refused, because the projection is tied to the window since the current -- instinct/mastery values took effect. local f, err = ParseDmgFilter(rest or "", {no_dates = true, grouped = "words"}) if not f then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. err) ColourNote("silver", "", " Usage: cdt build compare <build> [other] [minlevel maxlevel] [T9R7] [full]") return end local levels = (f.lmin or f.progress) and {lmin = f.lmin, lmax = f.lmax, progress = f.progress} or nil local range_note = ScopeFilterText(levels) local args = {} for _, w in ipairs(f.words) do args[#args + 1] = w end local full = false if args[#args] and args[#args]:lower() == "full" then full = true table.remove(args) end if #args == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt build compare <build> [other] [minlevel maxlevel] [T9R7] [full]") ColourNote("silver", "", " With one build, compares against your current values.") ColourNote("silver", "", " A level range, e.g. 150 201, compares on damage recorded at those levels.") ColourNote("silver", "", " A tier, e.g. T9R7, compares on damage recorded in that tier/redo/remort.") return end FlushCombatBuffer()
local function load_side(nm) if not nm or nm:lower() == "current" then local i, m = GetCurrentBuildData() return {label = "Current", race = state.current.race or "", class = state.current.subclass or state.current.class or "", inst = i, mast = m, focus = config.gaias_focus or ""} end local b = BuildFind(nm) if not b then return nil, nm end local i, m = BuildLoadData(b.build_id) return {label = b.name, race = b.race or "", class = b.class or "", inst = i, mast = m, focus = b.gaias_focus or ""} end
local A, badA = load_side(args[1]) if not A then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No build named '" .. badA .. "'."); return end local B, badB = load_side(args[2]) if not B then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No build named '" .. badB .. "'."); return end
local dtrack_slots = GetDtrackSummary() local cur_inst, cur_mast = GetCurrentBuildData()
-- Both sides must be measured the same way or the difference reports the -- change of sample as well as the change of build, so the weaker side sets -- the tier for both: 1 = race+subclass, 2 = subclass only, 3 = no data. local tierA = BuildSampleTier(A, levels) local tierB = BuildSampleTier(B, levels) local tier = math.max(tierA, tierB)
if tier == 3 then return CompareWithoutData(A, B, tierA, tierB, levels) end
-- Each side is projected against damage recorded for its own scope. At tier -- 1 that is its own race+subclass, since the melee/spell mix differs between -- combos; at tier 2 race is dropped and the whole subclass is used. local function project(side) local filter = {class = side.class, lmin = levels and levels.lmin, lmax = levels and levels.lmax, progress = levels and levels.progress} if tier == 1 then filter.race = side.race end local sc = GetScopedDamage(filter) if sc.total <= 0 then return nil, sc end -- Base is derived with no focus (recorded gaias damage really was an even -- mix); the side's own focus is applied when projecting forward. local base = DeriveBaseDamage(sc.scoped, cur_inst, cur_mast, dtrack_slots) return ProjectBuild(base, side.inst, side.mast, dtrack_slots, side.focus), sc end
local pA, scA = project(A) local pB, scB = project(B) if not pA or not pB then local bad = (not pA) and A or B ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format( "[CDT] No recorded damage for %s (%s / %s)%s - cannot project.", bad.label, bad.race ~= "" and bad.race or "?", bad.class ~= "" and bad.class or "?", range_note)) return end
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Build Comparison: %s vs %s", A.label, B.label)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) -- Say plainly what kind of comparison this is; the number means something -- different at each tier and the reader cannot tell them apart otherwise. if tier == 1 then ColourNote("white", "", " Basis: ", "lime", "", "race + subclass -- projected from each side's own recorded damage") else ColourNote("white", "", " Basis: ", "yellow", "", "subclass only -- race ignored, damage pooled across all races") local why = (tierA > 1 and tierB > 1) and "neither build has race-specific data" or string.format("%s has no race-specific data", (tierA > 1 and A or B).label) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. why .. ", so both sides use the wider sample") end if levels and levels.lmin then ColourNote("white", "", " Levels: ", "cyan", "", string.format("%d-%d", levels.lmin, levels.lmax), "dimgray", "", " only damage recorded at these levels") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " (older data counts by its snapshot's level)") end if levels and levels.progress then ColourNote("white", "", " Tier: ", "cyan", "", ProgressLabel(levels.progress), "dimgray", "", " only damage recorded then") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " (older data counts by its snapshot's tier and remort)") end ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-14s", A.label), "cyan", "", string.format("%-10s %-12s", A.race ~= "" and A.race or "?", A.class ~= "" and A.class or "?"), "dimgray", "", "sample: " .. comma_value(math.floor(scA.total)) .. EstimatedShareStr(scA)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-14s", B.label), "cyan", "", string.format("%-10s %-12s", B.race ~= "" and B.race or "?", B.class ~= "" and B.class or "?"), "dimgray", "", "sample: " .. comma_value(math.floor(scB.total)) .. EstimatedShareStr(scB)) if SubclassGetsGaias(A.class) or SubclassGetsGaias(B.class) then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" gaias focus: %s vs %s", GaiasFocusLabel(A.focus), GaiasFocusLabel(B.focus))) end
-- Changed values local changed = {} local function diff_kind(kind, a, b) local keys = {} for k in pairs(a) do keys[k] = true end for k in pairs(b) do keys[k] = true end for k in pairs(keys) do local va, vb = a[k] or 0, b[k] or 0 if va ~= vb then changed[#changed + 1] = {kind = kind, name = k, a = va, b = vb} end end end diff_kind("inst", A.inst, B.inst) diff_kind("mast", A.mast, B.mast) table.sort(changed, function(x, y) return math.abs(y.b - y.a) < math.abs(x.b - x.a) end)
if #changed > 0 then local grid = {} for _, c in ipairs(changed) do local d = c.b - c.a grid[#grid + 1] = {name = c.name, kind = c.kind, a = c.a, b = c.b, delta = (d > 0 and "+" or "") .. tostring(d)} end RenderTable({ {key = "name", title = "Change", w = 24, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "kind", title = "Kind", w = 8, align = "l", color = "dimgray"}, {key = "a", title = FitText(A.label, 8), w = 8, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "b", title = FitText(B.label, 8), w = 8, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "delta", title = "Delta", w = 8, align = "r", color = "white"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 66, no_bottom = true}) else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " (no differences in instinct or mastery values)") end
-- What each build costs to hold, and what switching would cost on top of -- what is already trained. local tA, gA, qA, mgA = BuildTotalCost(A.inst, A.mast) local tB, gB, qB, mgB = BuildTotalCost(B.inst, B.mast) local dt_, dg_, dq_, dmg_ = BuildCost(FoldInstinctPools(A.inst), FoldInstinctPools(B.inst), A.mast, B.mast) BuildCostSection(A, B, tA, gA, qA, mgA, tB, gB, qB, mgB, dt_, dg_, dq_, dmg_) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " The -> row costs only the increases; points already held are free.")
-- Headline: overall damage difference ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Projected Damage") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-24s ", A.label), "cyan", "", string.format("x%.3f %16s", pA.combined_mult, comma_value(math.floor(pA.total)))) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-24s ", B.label), "cyan", "", string.format("x%.3f %16s", pB.combined_mult, comma_value(math.floor(pB.total)))) local delta = pB.total - pA.total local pct = pA.total > 0 and (delta / pA.total * 100) or 0 local dcol = delta >= 0 and "lime" or "red" ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-24s ", "Difference"), dcol, "", string.format("%+.2f%% %16s", pct, comma_value(math.floor(delta))))
local trains, igold, qp, mgold = BuildCost(A.inst, B.inst, A.mast, B.mast) if full then local rows = {} for atk, pa in pairs(pA.per_attack) do local pb = pB.per_attack[atk] if pb then rows[#rows + 1] = {name = atk, a = pa.damage, b = pb.damage, d = pb.damage - pa.damage} end end table.sort(rows, function(x, y) return math.abs(y.d) < math.abs(x.d) end) local grid = {} for i, r in ipairs(rows) do if i > 12 then break end grid[#grid + 1] = {name = r.name, a = math.floor(r.a), b = math.floor(r.b), delta = math.floor(r.d)} end RenderTable({ {key = "name", title = "Attack", w = 24, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "a", title = FitText(A.label, 12), w = 12, align = "r", color = "gray", fmt = "num"}, {key = "b", title = FitText(B.label, 12), w = 12, align = "r", color = "gray", fmt = "num"}, {key = "delta", title = "Delta", w = 11, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num"}, }, grid, {title = "Per-Attack Breakdown", indent = 1, width = 66, no_bottom = trains > 0 or qp > 0}) end
-- Training cost to go from A to B if trains > 0 or qp > 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Cost to go %s -> %s", A.label, B.label)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) if trains > 0 then ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-24s ", "Instinct"), "cyan", "", string.format("%12s trains %16s gold", comma_value(trains), comma_value(igold))) end if qp > 0 then ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-24s ", "Mastery"), "cyan", "", string.format("%12s qp %16s gold", comma_value(qp), comma_value(mgold))) end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) end
function CmdBuildOptimize(rest) if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end FlushCombatBuffer()
local args = {} for w in (rest or ""):gmatch("%S+") do args[#args + 1] = w end local budget, save_name = nil, nil local i = 1 if args[i] and tonumber(args[i]) then budget = math.floor(tonumber(args[i])) i = i + 1 end if args[i] and args[i]:lower() == "save" then save_name = args[i + 1] if not save_name then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt build optimize [trains] save <name>") return end end
local cur_inst, cur_mast = GetCurrentBuildData() if not next(cur_inst) and not next(cur_mast) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No instinct/mastery snapshot found.") ColourNote("silver", "", " Run 'cdt instinct' and 'cdt mastery' first.") return end
local subclass = state.current.subclass or state.current.class or "" local race = state.current.race or "" local sc = GetScopedDamage({race = race, class = subclass}) if sc.total < 10000000 then ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format( "[CDT] Only %s damage recorded for %s/%s: too little to optimize.", comma_value(math.floor(sc.total)), race ~= "" and race or "?", subclass ~= "" and subclass or "?")) ColourNote("silver", "", " At least 10,000,000 is needed for a meaningful result.") return end
local candidates = OptimizerCandidates(subclass) if #candidates == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No optimizable damage instincts for subclass '" .. subclass .. "'.") return end
-- Default budget: whatever is already invested in the optimizable set. if not budget then budget = 0 for _, s in ipairs(candidates) do local t = InstinctRangeCost(0, cur_inst[s] or 0) budget = budget + t end end if budget < InstinctStepCost(0) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Budget too small - one point costs " .. InstinctStepCost(0) .. " trains.") return end
local dtrack = GetDtrackSummary() local spr = dtrack and tonumber(dtrack.spr) or nil local focus = config.gaias_focus or "" local buckets = BuildDamageBuckets(sc.scoped, cur_inst, cur_mast, dtrack) local best, spent, proj = OptimizeInstincts(budget, buckets, cur_mast, spr, candidates, focus) local cur_proj = BucketDamage(buckets, cur_inst, cur_mast, spr, focus)
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 68)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Optimal Damage Build - %s trains", comma_value(budget))) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 68)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-12s", "Subclass:"), "cyan", "", subclass ~= "" and subclass or "?") ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-12s", "Sample:"), "white", "", comma_value(math.floor(sc.total)) .. " damage", "dimgray", "", " (" .. ScopeNoteStr(sc) .. ")") ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-12s", "Swings:"), "dimgray", "", DtrackSampleNote(dtrack)) if SubclassGetsGaias(subclass) then ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-12s", "Gaias:"), "dimgray", "", GaiasFocusLabel(focus)) end local sorted = {} for _, s in ipairs(candidates) do sorted[#sorted + 1] = s end table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return (best[a] or 0) > (best[b] or 0) end) local grid = {} for _, s in ipairs(sorted) do local now, opt = cur_inst[s] or 0, best[s] or 0 local d = opt - now grid[#grid + 1] = {inst = s, cur = now, opt = opt, delta = d ~= 0 and string.format("%+d", d) or "-"} end RenderTable({ {key = "inst", title = "Instinct", w = 22, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "cur", title = "Current", w = 9, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "opt", title = "Optimal", w = 9, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num"}, {key = "delta", title = "Delta", w = 9, align = "r", color = "yellow"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 68})
local delta = proj - cur_proj local pct = cur_proj > 0 and (delta / cur_proj * 100) or 0 ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-22s ", "Projected damage"), "lime", "", string.format("%16s", comma_value(math.floor(proj)))) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-22s ", "Current allocation"), "cyan", "", string.format("%16s", comma_value(math.floor(cur_proj)))) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-22s ", "Difference"), delta >= 0 and "lime" or "red", "", string.format("%16s (%+.2f%%)", comma_value(math.floor(delta)), pct)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-22s ", "Trains used"), "silver", "", string.format("%16s (%s unspent)", comma_value(spent), comma_value(budget - spent)))
if math.abs(pct) < 1.0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 68)) ColourNote("lime", "", " Your current allocation is already within 1% of optimal.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Reshuffling is unlikely to be worth the trains.") end
-- Always name what the optimizer could not see. local excluded = {} local all_excluded = {} for s in pairs(INSTINCT_UNKNOWN_CURVE) do all_excluded[s] = true end for s in pairs(INSTINCT_UNMAPPED_VERB) do all_excluded[s] = true end for s in pairs(all_excluded) do local subs, universal = SubclassesForInstinct(s) local mine = universal if not mine and subs then for _, x in ipairs(subs) do if x == subclass:lower() then mine = true; break end end end if mine then excluded[#excluded + 1] = s end end table.sort(excluded) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 68)) if #excluded > 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Not modelled: " .. table.concat(excluded, ", ")) end if not dtrack then ColourNote("yellow", "", " No dtrack sample - extra-swing instincts were excluded.") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Damage only - ignores mitigation, healing and utility.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 68))
if save_name then local b = BuildFind(save_name) local created = false if not b then local id = BuildCreate(save_name, race, subclass, focus) if id <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Could not create build."); return end b = BuildFind(save_name) created = true end -- Merge: overwrite only the optimizable instincts, keep everything else. local inst, mast = BuildLoadData(b.build_id) if created then for k, v in pairs(cur_inst) do inst[k] = v end for k, v in pairs(cur_mast) do mast[k] = v end end for _, s in ipairs(candidates) do inst[s] = best[s] or 0 end BuildStoreData(b.build_id, inst, mast) db_exec(string.format("UPDATE builds SET notes = %s WHERE build_id = %d", fixsql(string.format("optimized for %s trains on %s", comma_value(budget), TZDate("%Y-%m-%d"))), b.build_id)) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] Saved as '%s'%s - %d instincts set, others preserved.", b.name, created and " (created)" or "", #candidates)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt build compare " .. b.name) end end
function CmdBuildSubclass(rest) local q = (rest or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower() if q ~= "" and SUBCLASS_INSTINCTS[q] then local skills = SUBCLASS_INSTINCTS[q] ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Subclass: " .. q) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Unique to this subclass:") local sorted = {} for _, s in ipairs(skills) do sorted[#sorted + 1] = s end table.sort(sorted) for _, s in ipairs(sorted) do local owner = INSTINCT_SHARED_POOL[s] ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. s, "dimgray", "", owner and (" (uses " .. owner .. ")") or "") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Plus the " .. #UNIVERSAL_INSTINCTS .. " instincts every subclass has.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) return end
if q ~= "" then local subs, universal = SubclassesForInstinct(q) if universal then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] '" .. q .. "' is available to every subclass.") return end if subs and #subs > 0 then ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format("[CDT] '%s': %s", q, table.concat(subs, ", "))) local owner = INSTINCT_SHARED_POOL[q] if owner then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Draws on " .. owner .. "'s instinct pool.") end return end ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No subclass or instinct matching '" .. q .. "'.") return end
local names = {} for sc in pairs(SUBCLASS_INSTINCTS) do names[#names + 1] = sc end table.sort(names) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Subclass Instincts (beyond the universal set)") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) for _, sc in ipairs(names) do local skills = {} for _, s in ipairs(SUBCLASS_INSTINCTS[sc]) do skills[#skills + 1] = s end table.sort(skills) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-14s", sc), "silver", "", table.concat(skills, ", ")) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) local line = " Every subclass also has:" for i, skill in ipairs(UNIVERSAL_INSTINCTS) do local piece = " " .. skill .. (i < #UNIVERSAL_INSTINCTS and "," or "") if #line + #piece > 66 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", line) line = " " end line = line .. piece end ColourNote("dimgray", "", line) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) end
function GaiasFocusLabel(focus) if focus and focus ~= "" then return focus end return "unfocused (even mix of " .. table.concat(GAIAS_ELEMENTS, "/") .. ")" end
-- Only shaman can focus; crafter and hunter have gaias revenge but no way to -- direct it, so they are permanently on the mix. function SubclassCanFocusGaias(subclass) return (subclass or ""):lower() == "shaman" end
-- Crafter and hunter get gaias revenge, shaman gets both. Only shaman can focus. function SubclassGetsGaias(subclass) local s = (subclass or ""):lower() return s == "shaman" or s == "crafter" or s == "hunter" end
-- Escape hatch. If a snapshot ever stalls with the gag enabled, MUD output -- disappears but plugin messages still print, so this command remains usable. -- cdt reload: reloads CDT, after a new version is deployed say, without File -> -- Plugins. A plugin can't reload itself (ReloadPlugin refuses its caller), so the -- reload is handed to the world's script space a moment later, as the Aardwolf -- package's own plugins do: Execute() with the script prefix runs it there. The -- prefix is set to "/" for that one line and put back. function CmdReload(name, line, wildcards) if (tonumber(GetOption("enable_scripts")) or 0) == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Scripting is off for this world, so CDT can't reload itself.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Reload it from File -> Plugins, or turn scripting on.") return end state_save() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Reloading CDT...") local prefix = GetAlphaOption("script_prefix") SetAlphaOption("script_prefix", "/") Execute(string.format("/DoAfterSpecial(0.1, 'ReloadPlugin(\"%s\")', sendto.script)", GetPluginID())) SetAlphaOption("script_prefix", prefix) end
function CmdUnstick(name, line, wildcards) ResetTransientTriggerGroups() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Cleared snapshot and whois gags, and all capture triggers.") ColourNote("silver", "", " If game output had stopped, it should return now.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Re-run 'cdt snapshot' when you are not AFK to capture properly.") end
function CmdGaias(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower() local subclass = state.current.subclass or state.current.class or ""
if raw == "" or raw == "help" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 64)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Gaias Focus") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 64)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Current: ", "cyan", "", GaiasFocusLabel(config.gaias_focus)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Subclass: ", "cyan", "", subclass ~= "" and subclass or "?") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 64)) if SubclassCanFocusGaias(subclass) then ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gaias <element> ", "gray", "", ": Set focus (" .. table.concat(GAIAS_ELEMENTS, ", ") .. ")") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gaias clear ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Back to unfocused") else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Only shaman can focus gaias. Crafter and hunter have gaias") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " revenge but no way to direct it, so it stays an even mix.") end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 64)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Affects how gaias fury / gaias revenge damage is tagged from now on.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Damage already recorded keeps the element it was tagged with.") return end
if raw == "clear" or raw == "none" or raw == "unset" then config.gaias_focus = "" state_save() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Gaias focus cleared: " .. GaiasFocusLabel("") .. ".") return end
if not SubclassCanFocusGaias(subclass) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Only shaman can focus gaias (you are " .. (subclass ~= "" and subclass or "?") .. ").") return end
for _, e in ipairs(GAIAS_ELEMENTS) do if raw == e then config.gaias_focus = e state_save() ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Gaias focus set to " .. e .. ".") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " gaias fury / gaias revenge damage will be tagged " .. e .. " from now on.") return end end ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown element '" .. raw .. "'. Use: " .. table.concat(GAIAS_ELEMENTS, ", ") .. ", or clear.") end
WAIL_MODE_TEXT = { weapon = "weapon (all wail is melee, sonic)", sermon = "sermon (all wail is void sermon, negative)", }
function CmdWail(name, line, wildcards) local raw = ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower() local cost = WailSermonCost() local race = state.current.race or "" if raw == "" or raw == "help" then local mode = WailMode() ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 64)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Wail Tracking (your own damage lines)") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 64)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Current: ", "cyan", "", WAIL_MODE_TEXT[mode] or string.format("both (by your mana: a cast costs %d)", cost)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Race: ", "cyan", "", race:lower() == "eldar" and string.format("Eldar (void sermon costs %d mana)", cost) or string.format("%s (void sermon costs %d mana; Eldar %d)", race ~= "" and race or "?", cost, WAIL_SERMON_COST * 0.75)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 64)) ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt wail sermon ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "all wail is void sermon (spell, negative)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt wail weapon ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "all wail is a melee weapon hit (sonic)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt wail both ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "told apart by your mana (see the warning)") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 64)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " 'wail' is the damage word of both void sermon and sonic weapons.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Groupmates' wail is always counted as a sonic weapon.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Damage already recorded keeps the name and type it was given.") return end if not WAIL_MODES[raw] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt wail [sermon|weapon|both]") return end if raw ~= "both" and #wail_pending > 0 then ResolveWailPending("mode") end config.wail_mode = raw state_save() if raw == "sermon" then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Wail tracking: sermon. Your wail is recorded as void sermon (negative).") elseif raw == "weapon" then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Wail tracking: weapon. Your wail is recorded as a sonic weapon hit.") else ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Wail tracking: both. A wail line counts as void sermon when your mana") ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" drops by at least %d (the cost of a cast) by the next mana update, and as", cost)) ColourNote("cyan", "", " a weapon hit when it doesn't.") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Warning: this only works if nothing else gives you mana while you fight.") -- ============================================================================= -- cdt db verify: looks, never changes anything. -- Two things have inflated reports before (v22, v29): a reward also recorded as an -- "other" earning a moment later. The first part looks for exactly those rows. The -- second compares each finished session's saved totals -- counted as play happened -- -- with the records that session holds, which is what reports add up. They should -- match; where they don't, one of the two was counted wrongly. -- ============================================================================= VERIFY_DAYS = 30
VERIFY_METRICS = { {"xp", "XP", "total_xp"}, {"qp", "QP", "total_qp"}, {"gold", "Gold", "total_gold"}, {"tp", "TP", "total_tp"}, {"trains", "Trains", "total_trains"}, {"pracs", "Pracs", "total_pracs"}, {"levels", "Levels", "levels"}, {"pups", "Powerups", "pups"}, {"quests", "Quests done", "quests_done"}, {"quests_fail", "Quests failed", "quests_fail"}, {"cps", "Campaigns done", "cps_done"}, {"cps_fail", "Campaigns failed", "cps_fail"}, {"gq_won", "GQs won", "gqs_won"}, }
-- What each session's records add up to, keyed by session and then by metric. function VerifyRecordTotals(since) local w = since > 0 and (" AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE start_time >= " .. since .. ")") or "" local rec = {} local function add(sid, key, v) sid = tonumber(sid) or 0 rec[sid] = rec[sid] or {} rec[sid][key] = (rec[sid][key] or 0) + (tonumber(v) or 0) end local function each(sql, fields) for _, r in ipairs(db_query(sql)) do for key, col in pairs(fields) do add(r.sid, key, r[col]) end end end each([[SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN totqp ELSE 0 END) AS qp, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN tp ELSE 0 END) AS tp, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN trains ELSE 0 END) AS trains, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN pracs ELSE 0 END) AS pracs, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN gold ELSE 0 END) AS gold, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail FROM quests WHERE 1 = 1]] .. w .. " GROUP BY session_id", {qp = "qp", tp = "tp", trains = "trains", pracs = "pracs", gold = "gold", quests = "done", quests_fail = "fail"}) each([[SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN qp ELSE 0 END) AS qp, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN tp ELSE 0 END) AS tp, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN trains ELSE 0 END) AS trains, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN pracs ELSE 0 END) AS pracs, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN gold ELSE 0 END) AS gold, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN xp ELSE 0 END) AS xp, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail FROM campaigns WHERE 1 = 1]] .. w .. " GROUP BY session_id", {qp = "qp", tp = "tp", trains = "trains", pracs = "pracs", gold = "gold", xp = "xp", cps = "done", cps_fail = "fail"}) each([[SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(qp_mobs + qp_win) AS qp, SUM(tp) AS tp, SUM(trains) AS trains, SUM(pracs) AS pracs, SUM(gold) AS gold, SUM(CASE WHEN won = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won FROM gquests WHERE 1 = 1]] .. w .. " GROUP BY session_id", {qp = "qp", tp = "tp", trains = "trains", pracs = "pracs", gold = "gold", gq_won = "won"}) for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT session_id AS sid, currency, SUM(amount) AS v FROM earnings WHERE 1 = 1" .. w .. " GROUP BY session_id, currency")) do add(r.sid, r.currency, r.v) end each([[SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'level' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS levels, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'pup' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pups, SUM(trains_gain + bonus_trains + blessing_trains + instinct_trains) AS trains, SUM(pracs_gain) AS pracs FROM levels WHERE 1 = 1]] .. w .. " GROUP BY session_id", {levels = "levels", pups = "pups", trains = "trains", pracs = "pracs"}) each("SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) AS xp FROM kills WHERE 1 = 1" .. w .. " GROUP BY session_id", {xp = "xp"}) each("SELECT session_id AS sid, SUM(amount) AS gold FROM gold_log WHERE 1 = 1" .. w .. " GROUP BY session_id", {gold = "gold"}) return rec end
-- The two ways a reward has been recorded twice before, counted but left in place. function VerifyDuplicates(since) local t = since > 0 and (" AND earnings.time >= " .. since) or "" local qp = {n = 0, v = 0} for _, f in ipairs(MatchRewardDoubles(since, {"qp"})) do qp.n, qp.v = qp.n + 1, qp.v + f.amount end -- v27's rule: an "other" trains gain the size of a level-up's trains, 3s before to 5s after it. -- Level-ups only: powerups come too close together to tell a copy from a real gain. -- Driven from levels through the earnings time index: asked the other way round, -- SQLite compared every 'other' row with every level (a minute on a big database). -- The + signs keep it off an index on amount, which matches nearly everything. local lt = since > 0 and (" AND l.end_time >= " .. (since - 5)) or "" local tr = db_query_one([[SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS v FROM earnings WHERE source = 'other' AND currency = 'trains' AND amount > 0]] .. t .. [[ AND earning_id IN ( SELECT e.earning_id FROM levels l CROSS JOIN earnings e WHERE e.time BETWEEN l.end_time - 5 AND l.end_time + 3 AND +e.source = 'other' AND +e.currency = 'trains' AND +e.amount > 0 AND +e.amount = l.trains_gain + l.bonus_trains + l.blessing_trains + l.instinct_trains AND l.type = 'level']] .. lt .. ")") or {} local out = {qp_n = tonumber(qp.n) or 0, qp_v = tonumber(qp.v) or 0, tr_n = tonumber(tr.n) or 0, tr_v = tonumber(tr.v) or 0, reward = {}} -- The v31 rule, exactly as the migration applies it. for _, cur in ipairs({"tp", "trains", "pracs"}) do out.reward[cur] = {n = 0, v = 0} end for _, f in ipairs(MatchRewardDoubles(since)) do local r = out.reward[f.currency] r.n, r.v = r.n + 1, r.v + f.amount end return out end
function DbVerify(arg) arg = ((arg or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""):lower() local days = VERIFY_DAYS if arg == "all" then days = 0 elseif arg ~= "" then days = tonumber(arg:match("^(%d+)$") or "") if not days or days < 1 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt db verify [days|all] (the last " .. VERIFY_DAYS .. " days if left out)") return end end local since = days > 0 and (os.time() - days * 86400) or 0 FlushKillBuffer() if quest_pending then FinalizeQuestRecord() end
local W = REPORT_W ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) local right = days > 0 and string.format("last %d days", days) or "everything" ColourNote("gold", "", " Database check" .. string.rep(" ", W - 15 - #right), "white", "", right) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Reads only: nothing is changed. cdt db verify all checks every session.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W))
local d = VerifyDuplicates(since) ColourNote("white", "", " Rewards possibly recorded twice (same size, within seconds of the reward)") ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-44s%10s%12s", "'other' QP matching a quest, CP or GQ", comma_value(d.qp_n), d.qp_v > 0 and (comma_value(d.qp_v) .. " qp") or "")) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-44s%10s%12s", "'other' trains matching a level-up", comma_value(d.tr_n), d.tr_v > 0 and (comma_value(d.tr_v) .. " tr") or "")) local reward_n = 0 for _, row in ipairs({{"tp", "TP", "tp"}, {"trains", "trains", "tr"}, {"pracs", "pracs", "pr"}}) do local r = d.reward[row[1]] reward_n = reward_n + r.n ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-44s%10s%12s", "'other' " .. row[2] .. " matching a quest, CP or GQ", comma_value(r.n), r.v > 0 and (comma_value(r.v) .. " " .. row[3]) or "")) end if d.qp_n + d.tr_n + reward_n == 0 then ColourNote("lime", "", " None found.") end
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("white", "", " Finished sessions: saved totals against their own records") local sessions = db_query(string.format([[SELECT session_id, start_time, total_xp, total_qp, total_gold, total_tp, total_trains, total_pracs, levels, pups, quests_done, quests_fail, cps_done, cps_fail, gqs_won FROM sessions WHERE end_time > 0 AND start_time >= %d ORDER BY start_time]], since)) local rec = VerifyRecordTotals(since) local stats, worst = {}, {} for _, m in ipairs(VERIFY_METRICS) do stats[m[1]] = {differ = 0, net = 0} end for _, sr in ipairs(sessions) do local sid = tonumber(sr.session_id) or 0 local r = rec[sid] or {} for _, m in ipairs(VERIFY_METRICS) do local saved, found = tonumber(sr[m[3]]) or 0, r[m[1]] or 0 if saved ~= found then stats[m[1]].differ = stats[m[1]].differ + 1 stats[m[1]].net = stats[m[1]].net + (saved - found) worst[#worst + 1] = {sid = sid, t = tonumber(sr.start_time) or 0, label = m[2], saved = saved, found = found, size = math.abs(saved - found) / math.max(1, math.abs(found))} end end end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-20s%10s%10s%16s", "", "sessions", "differ", "saved - records")) local any = false for _, m in ipairs(VERIFY_METRICS) do local st = stats[m[1]] local col = st.differ > 0 and "yellow" or "silver" ColourNote(col, "", string.format(" %-20s%10s%10s%16s", m[2], comma_value(#sessions), comma_value(st.differ), st.differ > 0 and ((st.net > 0 and "+" or "") .. comma_value(st.net)) or "-")) if st.differ > 0 then any = true end end for _, m in ipairs(VERIFY_METRICS) do local st = stats[m[1]] if st.differ > 1 and st.net == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format( " %s: the differences cancel out, so none were lost; each was counted", m[2])) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " in one session and recorded in the next (a reload in between).") end end if #sessions == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No finished sessions in this span.") elseif not any then ColourNote("lime", "", " Every session matches its records.") else table.sort(worst, function(a, b) return a.size > b.size end) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("white", "", " Largest differences") for i = 1, math.min(8, #worst) do local x = worst[i] ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" #%-5s %-11s %-14s saved %10s records %10s", tostring(x.sid), ShowDate("%m/%d %H:%M", x.t), x.label, comma_value(x.saved), comma_value(x.found))) end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " saved: counted as you played. records: what reports add up.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " A session that ran across a reload or a GQ that spanned two sessions") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " can differ by that much without anything being wrong.") end VerifyAgainstGame(since, rec) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) end
-- Sessions from 4.2 on also kept what the game's worth updates showed them gain. -- What was recorded for each (the records reports add up) must equal it exactly: -- more means a gain counted twice, less a gain missed. VERIFY_GAME = {{"qp", "QP", "worth_qp"}, {"tp", "TP", "worth_tp"}, {"trains", "Trains", "worth_trains"}, {"pracs", "Pracs", "worth_pracs"}}
function VerifyAgainstGame(since, rec) local W = REPORT_W ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("white", "", " Sessions since 4.2: records against what the game showed gained") if not ColumnExists("sessions", "worth_qp") then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Not available until the database is upgraded.") return end local rows = db_query(string.format("SELECT session_id, start_time, worth_qp, worth_tp, worth_trains, worth_pracs " .. "FROM sessions WHERE end_time > 0 AND worth_qp IS NOT NULL AND start_time >= %d ORDER BY start_time", since)) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " None yet: a session is checked here once it has ended.") return end local stats, worst, any = {}, {}, false for _, m in ipairs(VERIFY_GAME) do stats[m[1]] = {differ = 0, net = 0} end for _, sr in ipairs(rows) do local sid = tonumber(sr.session_id) or 0 local r = rec[sid] or {} for _, m in ipairs(VERIFY_GAME) do local game, found = tonumber(sr[m[3]]) or 0, r[m[1]] or 0 if game ~= found then any = true stats[m[1]].differ = stats[m[1]].differ + 1 stats[m[1]].net = stats[m[1]].net + (found - game) worst[#worst + 1] = {sid = sid, t = tonumber(sr.start_time) or 0, label = m[2], game = game, found = found, size = math.abs(found - game)} end end end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-20s%10s%10s%16s", "", "sessions", "differ", "records - game")) for _, m in ipairs(VERIFY_GAME) do local st = stats[m[1]] ColourNote(st.differ > 0 and "yellow" or "silver", "", string.format(" %-20s%10s%10s%16s", m[2], comma_value(#rows), comma_value(st.differ), st.differ > 0 and ((st.net > 0 and "+" or "") .. comma_value(st.net)) or "-")) end if not any then ColourNote("lime", "", " Every session's records match what the game showed.") return end table.sort(worst, function(a, b) return a.size > b.size end) for i = 1, math.min(5, #worst) do local x = worst[i] ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" #%-5s %-11s %-8s game %10s records %10s", tostring(x.sid), ShowDate("%m/%d %H:%M", x.t), x.label, comma_value(x.game), comma_value(x.found))) end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " + a gain recorded twice, - one missed. A session cut short by a crash, or a") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " reward whose lines came after the session ended, can also differ.") end
function CmdDb(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local subcmd, rest = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)") subcmd = (subcmd or ""):lower() local marker = ReadMigrationMarker()
if subcmd == "" or subcmd == "help" or subcmd == "status" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", " CDT Database") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Path: ", "cyan", "", db_path) local ver = "?" pcall(function() for row in db:nrows("PRAGMA user_version;") do ver = tostring(row.user_version) end end) ColourNote("silver", "", " Version: ", "cyan", "", ver .. " (plugin expects " .. DB_VERSION .. ")") if marker then ColourNote("red", "", " State: INCOMPLETE MIGRATION") ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format(" was v%s -> v%s", marker.from or "?", marker.to or "?")) ColourNote("yellow", "", " backup: " .. tostring(marker.backup)) elseif migration_blocked then ColourNote("red", "", " State: MIGRATION BLOCKED (see messages above)") else ColourNote("lime", "", " State: OK") end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt db verify [days|all]", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Check the records (changes nothing)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt db backup ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Make a backup now") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt db backups ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "List backups found") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt db restore [file] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Restore from backup (asks to confirm)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt db keep ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Clear an incomplete-migration warning") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) return end
if subcmd == "verify" or subcmd == "check" then DbVerify(rest) return end
if subcmd == "backup" then pcall(function() db:exec("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);") end) local dst = string.format("%s.manual-%s.bak", db_path, os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")) local ok, err = DbFileCopy(db_path, dst) if ok then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Backup written: " .. (dst:match("[^\\/]+$") or dst)) else ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Backup failed: " .. tostring(err)) end return end
if subcmd == "backups" and (rest or ""):match("^%s*prune%s*$") then PruneMigrationBackups(true) return end
if subcmd == "backups" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Backups") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) local found = 0 -- Only the names this plugin creates are predictable; probe for those. for v = 2, DB_VERSION do local p = DbBackupPath(v) if DbFileExists(p) then ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. (p:match("[^\\/]+$") or p), "dimgray", "", " (pre-migration)") found = found + 1 end end if marker and marker.backup and DbFileExists(marker.backup) then ColourNote("yellow", "", " " .. (marker.backup:match("[^\\/]+$") or marker.backup), "yellow", "", " <- from the incomplete migration") end if found == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No pre-migration backups found.") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" The newest %d are kept automatically; cdt db backups prune", DB_BACKUPS_KEPT)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " clears older ones now. Backups you make with cdt db backup are") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " timestamped, kept separately and never removed; they are in the") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " database folder.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) return end
if subcmd == "keep" then if not marker then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No incomplete-migration marker to clear.") return end EndMigrationGuard() migration_blocked = false ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Marker cleared. Reload the plugin to continue migrating.") return end
if subcmd == "restore" then local arg, confirm = rest, false if rest:match("%s*confirm%s*$") then confirm = true arg = rest:gsub("%s*confirm%s*$", "") end arg = arg:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
local target if arg ~= "" then target = arg:match("[\\/]") and arg or (db_path:match("^(.*[\\/])") or "") .. arg elseif marker and marker.backup then target = marker.backup else for v = DB_VERSION, 2, -1 do local p = DbBackupPath(v) if DbFileExists(p) then target = p; break end end end
if not target or not DbFileExists(target) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No backup found to restore from.") ColourNote("silver", "", " Use 'cdt db backups' to see what exists, or pass a filename.") return end
if not confirm then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Restore database from backup") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Replacing: " .. db_path) ColourNote("yellow", "", " With: " .. target) ColourNote("red", "", " Everything recorded since that backup will be lost.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 66)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Type: cdt db restore " .. (arg ~= "" and (arg .. " ") or "") .. "confirm") return end
-- Preserve the current state before overwriting it, in case the restore -- turns out to be the wrong call. local aside = string.format("%s.before-restore-%s.bak", db_path, os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")) pcall(function() db:exec("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);") end) DbFileCopy(db_path, aside)
local ok, err = RestoreDbFromBackup(target) if not ok then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Restore failed: " .. tostring(err)) return end migration_blocked = false ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Restored from " .. (target:match("[^\\/]+$") or target)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Previous state saved as " .. (aside:match("[^\\/]+$") or aside)) ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Reload the plugin now to reopen the restored database.") return end
ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown db command: " .. subcmd) ColourNote("silver", "", " Available: status, backup, backups, restore, keep") end
