function CmdBuild(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local subcmd, rest = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)") subcmd = (subcmd or ""):lower() if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end
if subcmd == "" or subcmd == "help" then CmdBuildHelp() elseif subcmd == "save" then CmdBuildSave(rest) elseif subcmd == "new" then CmdBuildNew(rest) elseif subcmd == "copy" then CmdBuildCopy(rest) elseif subcmd == "list" then CmdBuildList() elseif subcmd == "show" then CmdBuildShow(rest) elseif subcmd == "set" then -- `<name> instinctbuilderstring <url>` takes a whole spread at once local nm, url = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+instinctbuilderstring%s+(.+)$") local gn, gv = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+gaias%s+(%S+)$") local sn, sv = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+subclass%s+(%a+)$") local rn, rv = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+race%s+(%a+)$") if nm then BuildImportInstinctBuilder(nm, url) elseif gn then BuildSetGaiasFocus(gn, gv) elseif sn then BuildSetIdentity(sn, "class", sv) elseif rn then BuildSetIdentity(rn, "race", rv) else BuildSetValue(rest, false) end elseif subcmd == "add" then BuildSetValue(rest, true) elseif subcmd == "delete" then CmdBuildDelete(rest) elseif subcmd == "compare" then CmdBuildCompare(rest) elseif subcmd == "optimize" or subcmd == "optimise" then CmdBuildOptimize(rest) elseif subcmd == "subclass" or subcmd == "subclasses" then CmdBuildSubclass(rest) else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown build command: " .. subcmd) ColourNote("silver", "", " Available: save, new, copy, list, show, set, add, delete, compare,") ColourNote("silver", "", " optimize, subclass") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- DTRACK HITS CAPTURE & DISPLAY -- =============================================================================
function OnDtrackCapture(name, line, wildcards) dtrack_capture.lines[#dtrack_capture.lines + 1] = line SnapshotStepActivity() if IsTimer("cdt_dtrack_done") ~= error_code.eOK then AddTimer("cdt_dtrack_done", 0, 0, SNAPSHOT_LINE_GAP, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot, "OnDtrackComplete") else ResetTimer("cdt_dtrack_done") end end
function ParseBracketNum(s) if not s then return 0 end local cleaned = s:gsub(",", "") return tonumber(cleaned) or 0 end
function ParseDtrackHits(lines) local data = { rounds = 0, dpr = 0, swings = 0, spr = 0, pri_swings = 0, sec_swings = 0, pri_spr = 0, sec_spr = 0, hits = 0, hit_pct = 0, pri_hits = 0, sec_hits = 0, pri_hit_pct = 0, sec_hit_pct = 0, crits = 0, crit_pct = 0, slots = {}, } local in_breakdown = false local context = "" local slot_order = 0
for _, raw_line in ipairs(lines) do local l = raw_line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if l:find("Hit Breakdown") then in_breakdown = true elseif in_breakdown then local slot_name = l:match("^(.-)%s*:%s*%[") if slot_name then slot_name = slot_name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local count_str = l:match("%[%s*([%d,%.]+)%s*%]") local inst_str = l:match("%(Instinct%s+([%d,]+)%)") slot_order = slot_order + 1 data.slots[#data.slots + 1] = { name = slot_name, count = ParseBracketNum(count_str), instinct = ParseBracketNum(inst_str), order = slot_order, } end else local vals = {} for v in l:gmatch("%[%s*([%d,%.]+)%s*%]") do vals[#vals + 1] = ParseBracketNum(v) end
if l:find("^Rounds") and #vals >= 2 then data.rounds = vals[1]; data.dpr = vals[2] elseif l:find("^Swings") and #vals >= 2 then data.swings = vals[1]; data.spr = vals[2] elseif l:find("^Hits") and #vals >= 2 then data.hits = vals[1]; data.hit_pct = vals[2] context = "hits" elseif l:find("^Primary") and #vals >= 2 then if context == "hits" then data.pri_hits = vals[1]; data.pri_hit_pct = vals[2] else data.pri_swings = vals[1]; data.pri_spr = vals[2] end elseif l:find("^Secondary") and #vals >= 2 then if context == "hits" then data.sec_hits = vals[1]; data.sec_hit_pct = vals[2] else data.sec_swings = vals[1]; data.sec_spr = vals[2] end context = "" elseif l:find("^Crits") and #vals >= 2 then data.crits = vals[1]; data.crit_pct = vals[2] elseif l:find("^Swings") and #vals == 1 then context = "swings" elseif l:find("^Hits") and #vals == 1 then context = "hits" end end end return data end
function DisplayDtrackHits(data) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Dtrack Hits Snapshot") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Rounds"), "white", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.rounds)), "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Dmg/Round"), "white", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.dpr))) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Swings"), "white", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.swings)), "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Swings/Round"), "white", "", string.format("%8.2f", data.spr)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Primary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.pri_swings)), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Primary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8.2f", data.pri_spr)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Secondary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.sec_swings)), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Secondary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8.2f", data.sec_spr)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Hits"), "white", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.hits)), "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Hit %"), "white", "", string.format("%7.2f%%", data.hit_pct)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Primary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.pri_hits)), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Primary"), "gray", "", string.format("%7.2f%%", data.pri_hit_pct)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Secondary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.sec_hits)), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Secondary"), "gray", "", string.format("%7.2f%%", data.sec_hit_pct)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Crits"), "magenta", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(data.crits)), "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Crit %"), "magenta", "", string.format("%7.2f%%", data.crit_pct))
if #data.slots > 0 then local grid = {} for _, s in ipairs(data.slots) do grid[#grid + 1] = {slot = s.name, swings = s.count, inst = s.instinct, pct = s.count > 0 and (s.instinct / s.count * 100) or 0} end RenderTable({ {key = "slot", title = "Slot", w = 20, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "swings", title = "Swings", w = 9, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "inst", title = "Instinct", w = 9, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "pct", title = "Inst%", w = 7, align = "r", color = "gray", fmt = "pct"}, }, grid, {title = "Hit Breakdown", indent = 1}) else ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) end end
-- True when a capture matches the newest stored dtrack snapshot: same totals and -- the same per-slot counts. The counters only move while fighting, so this is a -- repeat taken with no combat in between. function DtrackSameAsLast(parsed) local last = db_query_one("SELECT h.id, s.rounds, s.swings, s.hits, s.crits FROM snapshot_headers h " .. "JOIN dtrack_hits_summary s ON s.header_id = h.id WHERE h.type = 'dtrack_hits' ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT 1") if not last then return false end for _, f in ipairs({"rounds", "swings", "hits", "crits"}) do if (tonumber(last[f]) or 0) ~= (tonumber(parsed[f]) or 0) then return false end end local slots = db_query(string.format("SELECT slot_name, hit_count, instinct_count FROM dtrack_hits_slots " .. "WHERE header_id = %d ORDER BY sort_order", last.id)) if #slots ~= #parsed.slots then return false end for i, sl in ipairs(slots) do local ps = parsed.slots[i] if sl.slot_name ~= ps.name or (tonumber(sl.hit_count) or 0) ~= ps.count or (tonumber(sl.instinct_count) or 0) ~= ps.instinct then return false end end return true end
function OnDtrackComplete() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_dtrack_cap", false) if #dtrack_capture.lines == 0 then if dtrack_capture.mode ~= "snapshot" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No dtrack data captured.") end if dtrack_capture.on_complete then local cb = dtrack_capture.on_complete dtrack_capture.on_complete = nil cb() end return end
local parsed = ParseDtrackHits(dtrack_capture.lines)
-- The in-game tracker can be reset, and then every figure reads zero. That -- is not a measurement, it is the absence of one: storing it adds a snapshot -- that no consumer can use and that shows up in every listing and pairing. if (parsed.rounds or 0) == 0 and (parsed.swings or 0) == 0 then if dtrack_capture.mode ~= "snapshot" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] dtrack reads all zero - the tracker was reset. Snapshot not stored.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Fight for a while, then run 'cdt dtrack' again.") else DebugNote("[CDT] dtrack all zero (tracker reset) - snapshot skipped") end if dtrack_capture.on_complete then local cb = dtrack_capture.on_complete dtrack_capture.on_complete = nil cb() end return end
if db and DtrackSameAsLast(parsed) then if dtrack_capture.mode ~= "snapshot" then DisplayDtrackHits(parsed) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Dtrack hits unchanged since the last snapshot - not saved again.") end if dtrack_capture.on_complete then local cb = dtrack_capture.on_complete dtrack_capture.on_complete = nil cb() end return end
if db then local header_id = CreateSnapshotHeader("dtrack_hits") if header_id > 0 then db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO dtrack_hits_summary (header_id, rounds, dpr, swings, spr, pri_swings, sec_swings, pri_spr, sec_spr, hits, hit_pct, pri_hits, sec_hits, pri_hit_pct, sec_hit_pct, crits, crit_pct) VALUES (%d, %d, %.2f, %d, %.2f, %d, %d, %.2f, %.2f, %d, %.2f, %d, %d, %.2f, %.2f, %d, %.2f)", header_id, parsed.rounds, parsed.dpr, parsed.swings, parsed.spr, parsed.pri_swings, parsed.sec_swings, parsed.pri_spr, parsed.sec_spr, parsed.hits, parsed.hit_pct, parsed.pri_hits, parsed.sec_hits, parsed.pri_hit_pct, parsed.sec_hit_pct, parsed.crits, parsed.crit_pct)) if #parsed.slots > 0 then db_exec("BEGIN;") for _, s in ipairs(parsed.slots) do db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO dtrack_hits_slots (header_id, slot_name, sort_order, hit_count, instinct_count) VALUES (%d, %s, %d, %d, %d)", header_id, fixsql(s.name), s.order, s.count, s.instinct)) end db_exec("COMMIT;") end end end
if dtrack_capture.mode == "snapshot" then DebugNote(string.format("Dtrack hits snapshot saved: %d slots", #parsed.slots)) else DisplayDtrackHits(parsed) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Dtrack hits snapshot saved.") end
if dtrack_capture.on_complete then local cb = dtrack_capture.on_complete dtrack_capture.on_complete = nil cb() end end
function CmdDtrack(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if raw == "" or raw == "hits" then dtrack_capture.lines = {} dtrack_capture.mode = "table" dtrack_capture.on_complete = nil EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_dtrack_cap", true) SendNoEcho("dtrack hits") elseif raw == "help" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 55)) ColourNote("gold", "", " CDT Dtrack Commands") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 55)) ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt dtrack ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Capture dtrack hits & save snapshot") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt dtrack help ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "This help") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 55)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Use 'cdt snapshot' to capture all (instinct+mastery+dtrack).") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Use 'cdt snapshot list' to view saved snapshots.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 55)) else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown dtrack command: " .. raw) end end
-- ============================================================================= -- SNAPSHOT CHAIN & COMMANDS -- =============================================================================
-- A capture is finished SNAPSHOT_LINE_GAP after its last line (a reply can arrive -- in more than one packet). A chain step gives up after SNAPSHOT_STEP_SECS with no -- line at all -- counted from the last line, not from when the command was sent: right -- after a reload the reply can be held back by combat lag or a burst of output, and -- the old 3s limit gave up on it, printed "Done", and let the reply scroll by unsaved. SNAPSHOT_LINE_GAP = 0.5 SNAPSHOT_STEP_SECS = 15 SNAPSHOT_STEP_COMMANDS = {instinct = "instinct", mastery = "mastery", dtrack = "dtrack hits"} SNAPSHOT_RETRY = {instinct = "cdt instinct", mastery = "cdt mastery", dtrack = "cdt dtrack"} SNAPSHOT_ORDER = {"instinct", "mastery", "dtrack"}
function SnapshotStepActivity() if snapshot_chain.active and IsTimer("cdt_snap_step") == error_code.eOK then ResetTimer("cdt_snap_step") end end
function SnapshotStepDone() pcall(DeleteTimer, "cdt_snap_step") EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_snapshot_gag", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_snapshot_afk", false) end
-- The MUD refuses instinct/mastery/dtrack while AFK, so no capture trigger can -- ever fire. Without this the chain would sit through a timeout per step with -- output gagged, which is exactly what an AFK login looked like. function OnSnapshotAfkRefused(name, line, wildcards) if not snapshot_chain.active then return end local was_silent = snapshot_chain.silent snapshot_chain.queue = {} snapshot_chain.active = false ResetTransientTriggerGroups() ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Snapshot skipped - the game refuses those commands while AFK.") if not was_silent then ColourNote("silver", "", " Run 'cdt snapshot' again once you are no longer AFK.") end if was_silent then ColourNote("silver", "", " Run 'cdt snapshot' once you are unflagged to capture instinct,") ColourNote("silver", "", " mastery and dtrack hits.") end end
function OnSnapStepTimeout() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_snapshot_gag", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_inst_cap", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_mast_cap", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_dtrack_cap", false) -- Nothing half-captured may be saved: stop any pending finish and drop the lines. for _, t in ipairs({"cdt_inst_done", "cdt_mast_done", "cdt_dtrack_done"}) do pcall(DeleteTimer, t) end inst_capture.data, mast_capture.data, dtrack_capture.lines = {}, {}, {} inst_capture.on_complete = nil mast_capture.on_complete = nil dtrack_capture.on_complete = nil if snapshot_chain.step then snapshot_chain.results[snapshot_chain.step] = "missed" end RunNextInChain() end
-- What a finished chain captured, and when a step got no reply, what to run. function SnapshotChainSummary() local got, missed = {}, {} for _, step in ipairs(SNAPSHOT_ORDER) do local r = snapshot_chain.results[step] if r == "missed" then missed[#missed + 1] = step elseif r then got[#got + 1] = SNAPSHOT_STEP_COMMANDS[step] end end if #missed == 0 then return true end local names, retry = {}, {} for _, step in ipairs(missed) do names[#names + 1] = SNAPSHOT_STEP_COMMANDS[step] retry[#retry + 1] = SNAPSHOT_RETRY[step] end ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] Snapshot incomplete: no reply to %s within %ds.", table.concat(names, ", "), SNAPSHOT_STEP_SECS)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Captured: ", "lime", "", #got > 0 and table.concat(got, ", ") or "nothing") ColourNote("silver", "", " Not captured: ", "red", "", table.concat(names, ", ")) ColourNote("silver", "", " To retry, type: ", "cyan", "", table.concat(retry, " / "), "dimgray", "", #missed > 1 and " (or cdt snapshot for all three)" or "") return false end
function RunNextInChain() SnapshotStepDone() -- The step that just ended without timing out got its reply. if snapshot_chain.step and not snapshot_chain.results[snapshot_chain.step] then snapshot_chain.results[snapshot_chain.step] = "captured" end
if #snapshot_chain.queue == 0 then snapshot_chain.active = false local complete = SnapshotChainSummary() snapshot_chain.step = nil if snapshot_chain.silent then ColourNote("cornflowerblue", "", "Done. cirrus_data_tracker plugin is ready for use.") elseif complete then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Snapshot complete (instinct + mastery + dtrack hits).") end -- Subclass is known by now, so this is the point to ask a shaman to set -- their gaias focus if they have not. MaybePromptGaiasFocus() return end
local next_type = table.remove(snapshot_chain.queue, 1) snapshot_chain.step = next_type
if snapshot_chain.silent then EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_snapshot_gag", true) end EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_snapshot_afk", true) AddTimer("cdt_snap_step", 0, 0, SNAPSHOT_STEP_SECS, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot, "OnSnapStepTimeout")
if next_type == "instinct" then inst_capture.data = {} inst_capture.mode = "snapshot" inst_capture.on_complete = RunNextInChain EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_inst_cap", true) SendNoEcho("instinct") elseif next_type == "mastery" then mast_capture.data = {} mast_capture.mode = "snapshot" mast_capture.on_complete = RunNextInChain EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_mast_cap", true) SendNoEcho("mastery") elseif next_type == "dtrack" then dtrack_capture.lines = {} dtrack_capture.mode = "snapshot" dtrack_capture.on_complete = RunNextInChain EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_dtrack_cap", true) SendNoEcho("dtrack hits") end end
function StartSnapshotChain(silent) if snapshot_chain.active then if not silent then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Snapshot already in progress.") end return end snapshot_chain.queue = {"instinct", "mastery", "dtrack"} snapshot_chain.results, snapshot_chain.step = {}, nil snapshot_chain.active = true snapshot_chain.silent = silent if not silent then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] Capturing snapshot (instinct + mastery + dtrack hits)...") end RunNextInChain() end
function AutoSnapshot() if not IsConnected() or not db then return end ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Auto-capturing snapshots (instinct + mastery + dtrack)...") StartSnapshotChain(true) end
function CmdSnapshot(name, line, wildcards) local raw = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if raw == "" then StartSnapshotChain(false) return end
local subcmd, rest = raw:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)") subcmd = (subcmd or ""):lower()
if subcmd == "list" then local type_filter = rest:match("^(%S+)") if type_filter then type_filter = type_filter:lower() if type_filter == "dtrack" then type_filter = "dtrack_hits" end if type_filter ~= "instinct" and type_filter ~= "mastery" and type_filter ~= "dtrack_hits" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown snapshot type '" .. type_filter .. "'. Use instinct, mastery or dtrack_hits.") return end end local sql = "SELECT id, time, type, class, race, total_qp, total_pups, tier, remort, level FROM snapshot_headers" if type_filter and type_filter ~= "" then sql = sql .. " WHERE type=" .. fixsql(type_filter) end sql = sql .. " ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50" local rows = db_query(sql) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No snapshots found.") return end local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do grid[#grid + 1] = { id = r.id, type = r.type or "", sub = r.class or "", race = r.race or "", qp = r.total_qp or 0, pups = r.total_pups or 0, time = ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", r.time or 0), } end RenderTable({ {key = "id", title = "ID", w = 5, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num"}, {key = "type", title = "Type", w = 12, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "sub", title = "Subclass", w = 12, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "race", title = "Race", w = 9, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "qp", title = "QP", w = 10, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "pups", title = "Pups", w = 7, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num"}, {key = "time", title = "Time", w = 16, align = "l", color = "gray"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, title = "Snapshots (" .. #rows .. (type_filter and ", filter: " .. type_filter or "") .. ")"})
elseif subcmd == "show" then local sid = tonumber(rest) if not sid then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt snapshot show <id>") return end local header = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT * FROM snapshot_headers WHERE id=%d", sid)) if not header then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Snapshot #" .. sid .. " not found.") return end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Snapshot #%d (%s)", sid, header.type or "")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-14s", "Time"), "white", "", ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", header.time or 0)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-14s", "Subclass"), "cyan", "", header.class or "") ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-14s", "Race"), "white", "", header.race or "") ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-14s", "Total QP"),"lime", "", comma_value(header.total_qp or 0)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-14s", "Pups"), "yellow", "", comma_value(header.total_pups or 0)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-14s", "Tier/Rem"),"white", "", string.format("T%d R%d L%d", header.tier or 0, header.remort or 0, header.level or 0))
if header.type == "instinct" then local details = db_query(string.format( "SELECT attack_name, instinct_count FROM instinct_detail WHERE header_id=%d ORDER BY instinct_count DESC", sid)) local grid = {} for _, d in ipairs(details) do grid[#grid + 1] = {skill = d.attack_name, n = d.instinct_count} end RenderTable({ {key = "skill", title = "Skill", w = 24, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "n", title = "Count", w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 60}) elseif header.type == "mastery" then local details = db_query(string.format( "SELECT skill_name, mastery_pct FROM mastery_detail WHERE header_id=%d ORDER BY mastery_pct DESC", sid)) local grid = {} for _, d in ipairs(details) do if (d.mastery_pct or 0) > 0 then grid[#grid + 1] = {dtype = d.skill_name, n = d.mastery_pct, pct = string.format("~%.1f%%", MasteryToDmgPct(d.mastery_pct))} end end RenderTable({ {key = "dtype", title = "Type", w = 24, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "n", title = "Pts", w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "pct", title = "Dmg Inc%", w = 9, align = "r", color = "gray"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 60}) elseif header.type == "dtrack_hits" then local s = db_query_one(string.format( "SELECT * FROM dtrack_hits_summary WHERE header_id=%d", sid)) if s then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Rounds"), "white", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.rounds or 0)), "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Dmg/Round"), "white", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.dpr or 0))) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Swings"), "white", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.swings or 0)), "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Swings/Round"), "white", "", string.format("%8.2f", s.spr or 0)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Primary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.pri_swings or 0)), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Primary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8.2f", s.pri_spr or 0)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Secondary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.sec_swings or 0)), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Secondary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8.2f", s.sec_spr or 0)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Hits"), "white", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.hits or 0)), "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Hit %"), "white", "", string.format("%7.2f%%", s.hit_pct or 0)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Primary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.pri_hits or 0)), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Primary"), "gray", "", string.format("%7.2f%%", s.pri_hit_pct or 0)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Secondary"), "gray", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.sec_hits or 0)), "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-16s", "Secondary"), "gray", "", string.format("%7.2f%%", s.sec_hit_pct or 0)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Crits"), "magenta", "", string.format("%8s", comma_value(s.crits or 0)), "silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Crit %"), "magenta", "", string.format("%7.2f%%", s.crit_pct or 0)) end local slots = db_query(string.format( "SELECT slot_name, hit_count, instinct_count FROM dtrack_hits_slots WHERE header_id=%d ORDER BY sort_order", sid)) if #slots > 0 then local grid = {} for _, sl in ipairs(slots) do local hc, ic = sl.hit_count or 0, sl.instinct_count or 0 grid[#grid + 1] = {slot = sl.slot_name, swings = hc, inst = ic, pct = hc > 0 and (ic / hc * 100) or 0} end RenderTable({ {key = "slot", title = "Slot", w = 20, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "swings", title = "Swings", w = 9, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "inst", title = "Instinct", w = 9, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "pct", title = "Inst%", w = 7, align = "r", color = "gray", fmt = "pct"}, }, grid, {title = "Hit Breakdown", indent = 1, width = 60}) else ColourNote("yellow", "", " No hit breakdown data (snapshot may predate the fix).") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) end else ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) end
elseif subcmd == "compare" then local id1, id2 = rest:match("^(%d+)%s+(%d+)") if not id1 or not id2 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt snapshot compare <id1> <id2>") return end id1, id2 = tonumber(id1), tonumber(id2) local h1 = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT * FROM snapshot_headers WHERE id=%d", id1)) local h2 = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT * FROM snapshot_headers WHERE id=%d", id2)) if not h1 or not h2 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] One or both snapshot IDs not found.") return end if h1.type ~= h2.type then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Can only compare snapshots of the same type (got " .. h1.type .. " vs " .. h2.type .. ").") return end
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Compare %s #%d vs #%d", h1.type, id1, id2)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 65)) ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" #%-5d ", id1), "white", "", ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", h1.time or 0)) ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" #%-5d ", id2), "white", "", ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", h2.time or 0))
local function delta_str(v1, v2) local d = v2 - v1 if d > 0 then return string.format(" @G+%s", comma_value(d)) elseif d < 0 then return string.format(" @R%s", comma_value(d)) else return "" end end
if h1.type == "instinct" then local d1 = db_query(string.format("SELECT attack_name, instinct_count FROM instinct_detail WHERE header_id=%d", id1)) local d2 = db_query(string.format("SELECT attack_name, instinct_count FROM instinct_detail WHERE header_id=%d", id2)) local map1, map2 = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(d1) do map1[r.attack_name] = r.instinct_count end for _, r in ipairs(d2) do map2[r.attack_name] = r.instinct_count end local all_skills = {} for k in pairs(map1) do all_skills[k] = true end for k in pairs(map2) do all_skills[k] = true end local sorted = {} for k in pairs(all_skills) do sorted[#sorted + 1] = k end table.sort(sorted) local grid = {} for _, skill in ipairs(sorted) do local v1, v2 = map1[skill] or 0, map2[skill] or 0 local diff = v2 - v1 grid[#grid + 1] = {skill = skill, a = v1, b = v2, delta = diff ~= 0 and string.format("%+d", diff) or "-"} end RenderTable({ {key = "skill", title = "Skill", w = 22, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "a", title = "#" .. id1, w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "b", title = "#" .. id2, w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "delta", title = "Delta", w = 7, align = "r", color = "yellow"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 65}) elseif h1.type == "mastery" then local d1 = db_query(string.format("SELECT skill_name, mastery_pct FROM mastery_detail WHERE header_id=%d", id1)) local d2 = db_query(string.format("SELECT skill_name, mastery_pct FROM mastery_detail WHERE header_id=%d", id2)) local map1, map2 = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(d1) do map1[r.skill_name] = r.mastery_pct end for _, r in ipairs(d2) do map2[r.skill_name] = r.mastery_pct end local all_types = {} for k in pairs(map1) do all_types[k] = true end for k in pairs(map2) do all_types[k] = true end local sorted = {} for k in pairs(all_types) do sorted[#sorted + 1] = k end table.sort(sorted) local grid = {} for _, dtype in ipairs(sorted) do local v1, v2 = map1[dtype] or 0, map2[dtype] or 0 if v1 > 0 or v2 > 0 then local diff = v2 - v1 grid[#grid + 1] = {dtype = dtype, a = v1, b = v2, delta = diff ~= 0 and string.format("%+d", diff) or "-"} end end RenderTable({ {key = "dtype", title = "Type", w = 14, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "a", title = "#" .. id1, w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "b", title = "#" .. id2, w = 7, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "delta", title = "Delta", w = 7, align = "r", color = "yellow"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 65}) elseif h1.type == "dtrack_hits" then local s1 = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT * FROM dtrack_hits_summary WHERE header_id=%d", id1)) local s2 = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT * FROM dtrack_hits_summary WHERE header_id=%d", id2)) if s1 and s2 then -- dtrack counters only ever climb, so a later snapshot holding -- FEWER rounds means the in-game tracker was reset in between. The -- deltas below are then differences between two unrelated runs, not -- progress, and reading them as progress is worse than not showing -- them at all. local was_reset = (tonumber(s2.rounds) or 0) < (tonumber(s1.rounds) or 0) if was_reset then ColourNote("yellow", "", " The damage tracker was reset between these two snapshots.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format( " Rounds went %s -> %s, so these are separate runs: the deltas below", comma_value(tonumber(s1.rounds) or 0), comma_value(tonumber(s2.rounds) or 0))) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " are differences between two samples, not change over time.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Per-round figures (DPR, SPR, hit%) remain comparable.") end local grid = {} local function cmp_row(label, v1, v2, dec) v1, v2 = tonumber(v1) or 0, tonumber(v2) or 0 local diff = v2 - v1 local function fmt(v) if dec then return comma_value(string.format("%." .. dec .. "f", v)) end return comma_value(math.floor(v)) end grid[#grid + 1] = { metric = label, a = fmt(v1), b = fmt(v2), delta = diff == 0 and "-" or ((diff > 0 and "+" or "-") .. fmt(math.abs(diff))), } end -- Cumulative counters get their delta blanked across a reset; -- ratios stay, since those are comparable between runs. local function cumulative_row(label, v1, v2) cmp_row(label, v1, v2) if was_reset then grid[#grid].delta = "n/a" end end cumulative_row("Rounds", s1.rounds, s2.rounds) cmp_row("DPR", s1.dpr, s2.dpr, 1) cumulative_row("Swings", s1.swings, s2.swings) cmp_row("SPR", s1.spr, s2.spr, 2) cumulative_row("Hits", s1.hits, s2.hits) cmp_row("Hit %", s1.hit_pct, s2.hit_pct, 2) cumulative_row("Crits", s1.crits, s2.crits) cmp_row("Crit %", s1.crit_pct, s2.crit_pct, 2) RenderTable({ {key = "metric", title = "", w = 16, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "a", title = "#" .. id1, w = 10, align = "r", color = "white"}, {key = "b", title = "#" .. id2, w = 10, align = "r", color = "white"}, {key = "delta", title = "Delta", w = 10, align = "r", color = "yellow"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 65, no_bottom = true}) end local sl1 = db_query(string.format("SELECT * FROM dtrack_hits_slots WHERE header_id=%d ORDER BY sort_order", id1)) local sl2 = db_query(string.format("SELECT * FROM dtrack_hits_slots WHERE header_id=%d ORDER BY sort_order", id2)) local m1, m2 = {}, {} for _, s in ipairs(sl1) do m1[s.slot_name] = s end for _, s in ipairs(sl2) do m2[s.slot_name] = s end local all_slots = {} local slot_order = {} for _, s in ipairs(sl1) do if not all_slots[s.slot_name] then all_slots[s.slot_name] = true; slot_order[#slot_order + 1] = s.slot_name end end for _, s in ipairs(sl2) do if not all_slots[s.slot_name] then all_slots[s.slot_name] = true; slot_order[#slot_order + 1] = s.slot_name end end if #slot_order > 0 then local grid = {} for _, sn in ipairs(slot_order) do local v1 = m1[sn] and m1[sn].hit_count or 0 local v2 = m2[sn] and m2[sn].hit_count or 0 if v1 > 0 or v2 > 0 then local diff = v2 - v1 grid[#grid + 1] = {slot = sn, a = v1, b = v2, delta = diff ~= 0 and string.format("%+d", diff) or "-"} end end RenderTable({ {key = "slot", title = "Slot", w = 18, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "a", title = "#" .. id1, w = 10, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "b", title = "#" .. id2, w = 10, align = "r", color = "cyan", fmt = "num"}, {key = "delta", title = "Delta", w = 10, align = "r", color = "yellow"}, }, grid, {indent = 1, width = 65}) end end
elseif subcmd == "clear" then if rest:lower() == "confirm" then db_exec("DELETE FROM dtrack_hits_slots") db_exec("DELETE FROM dtrack_hits_summary") db_exec("DELETE FROM mastery_detail") db_exec("DELETE FROM instinct_detail") db_exec("DELETE FROM snapshot_headers") ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] All snapshots cleared.") else local count_rows = db_query("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM snapshot_headers") local cnt = count_rows[1] and count_rows[1].cnt or 0 ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format("[CDT] This will delete all %d snapshots.", cnt)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Type 'cdt snapshot clear confirm' to proceed.") end
elseif subcmd == "help" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("gold", "", " CDT Snapshot Commands") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt snapshot ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Capture all (instinct+mastery+dtrack)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt snapshot list [type] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "List snapshots") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " type: instinct, mastery, dtrack_hits") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt snapshot show <id> ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "View a snapshot") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt snapshot compare <id1> <id2> ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Compare two snapshots") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt snapshot clear ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Delete all snapshots (requires confirm)") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Snapshots are auto-captured on login/reload.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Individual captures: cdt instinct, cdt mastery, cdt dtrack") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 60)) else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown snapshot command: " .. subcmd) ColourNote("silver", "", " Available: list, show, compare, clear, help") end end
-- ============================================================================= -- GAINS COMMANDS -- ============================================================================= -- ============================================================================= -- GAINS REPORTS (cdt gains report <type> [scope] [channel]) -- Every figure comes from the database, for one scope: all time, this session, -- or so far today/this week/month/year by your clock or by Aardwolf's (US -- Eastern). The in-memory session counters stay for the events, meter and goals. -- ============================================================================= REPORT_TYPES = {xp = true, gold = true, qp = true, quest = true, cp = true, gq = true, level = true, powerup = true, bloot = true, tp = true, trains = true} REPORT_TYPE_ALIASES = {pup = "powerup", pups = "powerup", powerups = "powerup", levels = "level", quests = "quest", campaign = "cp", campaigns = "cp", gqs = "gq", exp = "xp", trivia = "tp", train = "trains"} -- Where TP and trains not tied to a quest, campaign, GQ or level came from. EARNING_SOURCE_NAMES = {trivia_mob = "trivia mob kills", other = "other (unexplained gains)"} REPORT_SCOPE_ORDER = {"all", "session", "day", "week", "month", "year", "aardday", "aardweek", "aardmonth", "aardyear"} REPORT_SCOPES = { all = {label = "All time", line = "all time"}, session = {label = "This session", line = "this session"}, day = {label = "Today", line = "today", clock = "local", period = "day"}, week = {label = "This week", line = "this week", clock = "local", period = "week"}, month = {label = "This month", line = "this month", clock = "local", period = "month"}, year = {label = "This year", line = "this year", clock = "local", period = "year"}, aardday = {label = "Aardwolf day", line = "aard day", clock = "aard", period = "day"}, aardweek = {label = "Aardwolf week", line = "aard week", clock = "aard", period = "week"}, aardmonth = {label = "Aardwolf month", line = "aard month", clock = "aard", period = "month"}, aardyear = {label = "Aardwolf year", line = "aard year", clock = "aard", period = "year"}, } REPORT_PERIOD_ROWS = { {"day", "aardday", "Today"}, {"week", "aardweek", "This week"}, {"month", "aardmonth", "This month"}, {"year", "aardyear", "This year"}, } GOLD_SOURCE_NAMES = { mob = "mob gold", crumble = "crumble", sell = "sales", fence = "fence", sac = "sacrifices", haggle = "haggle", shared = "shared", tax = "clan tax", quest = "quests", cp = "campaigns", gq = "GQs", other = "other", } KILL_SPECIALS = {"vorpal", "deathblow", "assassinate", "slit", "disintegrate", "banishment"} -- "today" was the day scope's name before 4.0; it still works. REPORT_SCOPE_ALIASES = {today = "day"} -- A number in front of a scope (7day, 10 aardweek) lists that many of them, newest -- first, one row each. This many rows at most. REPORT_MAX_PERIODS = 60
-- Reads a scope starting at words[i]: "week", "7week" or "7 week". Returns the scope, -- how many periods were asked for (nil for one plain scope) and the next word's index. -- nil, message when it looks like a scope but isn't a usable one; nil alone when the -- word isn't a scope at all. function ParseReportScope(words, i) local function norm(w) w = (w or ""):lower() return REPORT_SCOPE_ALIASES[w] or w end local w = norm(words[i]) if w == "" then return nil end local num, rest = w:match("^(%d+)(%a*)$") local key, count, nxt if num and rest ~= "" then key, count, nxt = norm(rest), tonumber(num), i + 1 elseif num then key, count, nxt = norm(words[i + 1]), tonumber(num), i + 2 if not REPORT_SCOPES[key] then return nil, "A number needs a scope after it: 7day, 7 week, 10aardmonth ..." end elseif REPORT_SCOPES[w] then return w, nil, i + 1 else return nil end if not REPORT_SCOPES[key] then return nil end if not REPORT_SCOPES[key].period then return nil, "Only day, week, month, year and the aard ones take a number, not " .. key .. "." end if count < 1 or count > REPORT_MAX_PERIODS then return nil, string.format("Between 1 and %d %ss at a time.", REPORT_MAX_PERIODS, REPORT_SCOPES[key].period) end return key, count, nxt end
function ReportScope(key) local info = REPORT_SCOPES[key] local sc = {key = key, label = info.label, line = info.line, clock = info.clock} if key == "session" then sc.session_id = tonumber(state.session.id) or 0 sc.start = tonumber(state.session.start_time) or os.time() elseif info.period then sc.start = info.clock == "aard" and EasternPeriodStart(info.period) or LocalPeriodStart(info.period) end return sc end
-- The SQL condition that picks a table's rows for a scope; col is its time column. -- A scope for a past period also has a stop: the moment the next one began. function ScopeWhere(sc, col) if sc.key == "all" then return "1 = 1" end if sc.key == "session" then return "session_id = " .. sc.session_id end if sc.stop then return string.format("%s >= %d AND %s < %d", col, sc.start, col, sc.stop) end return string.format("%s >= %d", col, sc.start) end
-- Active (non-AFK) time in a scope. A session that started before the scope began -- counts in proportion to how much of it falls inside; the second result says so. function ScopeActiveSecs(sc) local live = GetActiveTime() if sc.key == "session" then return live, false end local now = os.time() local cur_id = tonumber(state.session.id) or 0 local cur_start = tonumber(state.session.start_time) or now local from, to = sc.start or 0, sc.stop or math.huge local total, approx = 0, false -- A session only partly inside the span counts for the share of it that is. local function add(st, en, act) if en <= st then if st >= from and st < to then total = total + act end return end local inside = math.min(en, to) - math.max(st, from) if inside <= 0 then return end if inside < en - st then approx = true end total = total + act * inside / (en - st) end local where = {"end_time > 0", "session_id <> " .. cur_id} if sc.start then where[#where + 1] = "end_time > " .. sc.start end if sc.stop then where[#where + 1] = "start_time < " .. sc.stop end for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT start_time, end_time, active_secs FROM sessions WHERE " .. table.concat(where, " AND "))) do add(tonumber(r.start_time) or 0, tonumber(r.end_time) or 0, tonumber(r.active_secs) or 0) end add(cur_start, now, live) return math.floor(total), approx end
-- Seconds of double XP inside a scope, from the double XP log. function ScopeDoubleSecs(sc) local now, from = os.time(), sc.start or 0 local to = sc.stop or now local total = 0 for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format( "SELECT start_time, end_time FROM double_xp_log WHERE end_time = 0 OR end_time > %d", from))) do local st, en = tonumber(r.start_time) or 0, tonumber(r.end_time) or 0 if en == 0 then en = state.current.double_active and now or st end st, en = math.max(st, from), math.min(en, to) if en > st then total = total + (en - st) end end return total end
-- The date a newer kind of record started, or 0 (see the v27 upgrade). function RecordedSince(key) local r = db_query_one("SELECT value FROM player_totals WHERE key = " .. fixsql(key)) return r and tonumber(r.value) or 0 end
-- Everything the reports need for one scope. want names the parts to work out: -- xp, gold, qp (also quests/campaigns/GQs), level, pup, bloot, extras (TP/trains/pracs). function ScopeTotals(sc, want) local t = {} local function one(sql) local r = db_query_one(sql) or {} local out = {} for k, v in pairs(r) do out[k] = tonumber(v) or 0 end return setmetatable(out, {__index = function() return 0 end}) end local W = function(col) return ScopeWhere(sc, col) end
if want.xp then local cols = {"COUNT(*) AS kills", "COALESCE(SUM(xp),0) AS base", "COALESCE(SUM(xp_rare),0) AS rare", "COALESCE(SUM(xp_bonus),0) AS bonus", "COALESCE(SUM(xp_double),0) AS dbl", "COALESCE(SUM(xp_blessing),0) AS bless", "COALESCE(SUM(xp_honor),0) AS honor"} for _, sp in ipairs(KILL_SPECIALS) do cols[#cols + 1] = string.format("COALESCE(SUM(%s),0) AS %s", sp, sp) end local k = one("SELECT " .. table.concat(cols, ", ") .. " FROM kills WHERE " .. W("time")) local cp = one("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp),0) AS v FROM campaigns WHERE failed = 0 AND " .. W("end_time")) local other = one("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) AS v FROM earnings WHERE currency = 'xp' AND " .. W("time")) local x = {kills = k.kills, base = k.base, rare = k.rare, double = k.dbl, blessing = k.bless, honor = k.honor, unsplit = math.max(0, k.bonus - k.dbl - k.bless - k.honor), cp = cp.v, other = other.v, specials = {}} x.total = x.base + x.rare + x.double + x.blessing + x.honor + x.unsplit + x.cp + x.other for _, sp in ipairs(KILL_SPECIALS) do x.specials[sp] = k[sp] end t.xp = x end
if want.gold then local g = {sources = {}, total = 0} local function add(src, v) v = tonumber(v) or 0 if v ~= 0 then g.sources[src] = (g.sources[src] or 0) + v; g.total = g.total + v end end for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT source, SUM(amount) AS v FROM gold_log WHERE " .. W("time") .. " GROUP BY source")) do add(r.source or "other", r.v) end add("quest", one("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) AS v FROM quests WHERE failed = 0 AND " .. W("end_time")).v) add("cp", one("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) AS v FROM campaigns WHERE failed = 0 AND " .. W("end_time")).v) add("gq", one("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) AS v FROM gquests WHERE " .. W("end_time")).v) add("other", one("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) AS v FROM earnings WHERE currency = 'gold' AND " .. W("time")).v) t.gold = g end
if want.qp or want.extras then local q = one([[SELECT COUNT(*) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(qp),0) AS base, COALESCE(SUM(tier_qp),0) AS tier, COALESCE(SUM(lucky_qp),0) AS lucky, COALESCE(SUM(mccp_qp),0) AS mccp, COALESCE(SUM(opk_qp),0) AS opk, COALESCE(SUM(hc_qp),0) AS hc, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN daily = 1 THEN totqp - qp - tier_qp - lucky_qp - mccp_qp - opk_qp - hc_qp ELSE 0 END),0) AS daily, COALESCE(SUM(totqp),0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) AS gold, COALESCE(SUM(tp),0) AS tp, COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) AS trains, COALESCE(SUM(pracs),0) AS pracs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN double_xp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS doubled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN daily = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS daily_quests, COALESCE(AVG(duration),0) AS avg_secs FROM quests WHERE failed = 0 AND ]] .. W("end_time")) q.failed = one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM quests WHERE failed = 1 AND " .. W("end_time")).n q.other = q.total - q.base - q.tier - q.lucky - q.mccp - q.opk - q.hc - q.daily t.quests = q
local c = one([[SELECT COUNT(*) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(qp),0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(daily_qp),0) AS daily, COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) AS gold, COALESCE(SUM(tp),0) AS tp, COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) AS trains, COALESCE(SUM(pracs),0) AS pracs, COALESCE(SUM(xp),0) AS xp FROM campaigns WHERE failed = 0 AND ]] .. W("end_time")) c.failed = one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM campaigns WHERE failed = 1 AND " .. W("end_time")).n c.base = c.total - c.daily t.cps = c
local g = one([[SELECT COUNT(*) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN won = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS won, COALESCE(SUM(qp_mobs),0) AS mobs, COALESCE(SUM(qp_win),0) AS win, COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) AS gold, COALESCE(SUM(tp),0) AS tp, COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) AS trains, COALESCE(SUM(pracs),0) AS pracs FROM gquests WHERE ]] .. W("end_time")) -- Mob QP from a GQ still running has no record yet. It belongs to any scope -- that reaches now; a past period doesn't. g.running = (not sc.stop and state.gq_tracking and state.gq_tracking.active) and (tonumber(state.gq_tracking.mob_qp) or 0) or 0 g.total = g.mobs + g.win + g.running if sc.key == "session" then g.joined = tonumber(state.session.gqs_joined) or 0 elseif sc.key == "all" then g.joined = one(string.format("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gqs_joined),0) AS v FROM sessions WHERE session_id <> %d", tonumber(state.session.id) or 0)).v + (tonumber(state.session.gqs_joined) or 0) else g.joined = one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM gq_joins WHERE " .. W("time")).v end t.gqs = g
local o = {qp = 0, tp = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, sources = {}, by = {tp = {}, trains = {}}} for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT currency, source, SUM(amount) AS v FROM earnings WHERE " .. W("time") .. " GROUP BY currency, source ORDER BY v DESC")) do local v = tonumber(r.v) or 0 if o[r.currency] then o[r.currency] = o[r.currency] + v end if r.currency == "qp" then o.sources[#o.sources + 1] = {source = r.source or "other", v = v} end if o.by[r.currency] then o.by[r.currency][#o.by[r.currency] + 1] = {source = r.source or "other", v = v} end end t.other = o t.qp = q.total + c.total + g.total + o.qp end
for _, ltype in ipairs({"level", "pup"}) do if want[ltype] or want.extras then local l = one(string.format([[SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN grouped = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS grouped, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN duration > 0 THEN duration END),0) AS avg, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN duration > 0 THEN duration END),0) AS best, COALESCE(SUM(trains_gain),0) AS trains, COALESCE(SUM(bonus_trains),0) AS lucky, COALESCE(SUM(blessing_trains),0) AS bless, COALESCE(SUM(instinct_trains),0) AS inst, COALESCE(SUM(pracs_gain),0) AS pracs, COALESCE(SUM(hp_gain),0) AS hp, COALESCE(SUM(mp_gain),0) AS mp, COALESCE(SUM(mv_gain),0) AS mv FROM levels WHERE type = '%s' AND ]], ltype) .. W("end_time")) l.solo = l.n - l.grouped l.all_trains = l.trains + l.lucky + l.bless + l.inst t[ltype] = l end end
if want.extras then local q, c, g, o = t.quests, t.cps, t.gqs, t.other t.tp = q.tp + c.tp + g.tp + o.tp t.trains = q.trains + c.trains + g.trains + o.trains + t.level.all_trains + t.pup.all_trains t.pracs = q.pracs + c.pracs + g.pracs + o.pracs + t.level.pracs + t.pup.pracs end
if want.bloot then local b = {tiers = {}, total = 0, areas = {}} for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bloot_log WHERE " .. W("time") .. -- ------------------------------------------------------------------ text helpers function QuestQPParts(q) local parts = {comma_value(q.base)} for _, b in ipairs({{"tier", "tier"}, {"lucky", "lucky"}, {"mccp", "mccp"}, {"opk", "opk"}, {"hc", "hc"}, {"daily", "daily"}, {"other", "other"}}) do if (q[b[1]] or 0) > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = comma_value(q[b[1]]) .. b[2] end end return table.concat(parts, "+") end

function PerHourText(value, active, decimals) if active < 60 then return nil end local v = value / active * 3600 if decimals then return string.format("%." .. decimals .. "f", v) end return short_value(math.floor(v)) end
function AvgTimeText(secs) secs = tonumber(secs) or 0 if secs <= 0 then return "-" end if secs < 60 then return string.format("%.2fs", secs) end return FormatTimeShort(math.floor(secs)) end
REPORT_W = 78
-- One line of a report: an indented label, a right-aligned value, an optional note. function ReportRow(label, value, color, indent, note) indent = indent or 0 local base, lw = indent > 0 and "gray" or "silver", 34 - indent * 3 local args if tostring(label):find(CODED_END, 1, true) then args = CodedArgs(" " .. string.rep(" ", indent) .. CodedPad(label, lw), base) else args = {base, "", string.format(" %s%-" .. lw .. "s", string.rep(" ", indent), label)} end args[#args + 1] = color or "white"; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = string.format("%14s", tostring(value)) if note and note ~= "" then args[#args + 1] = "dimgray"; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = " " .. note end ColourNote(unpack(args)) end
-- Title and scope on one line, the span and active time on the next. function ReportHeader(title, sc, active, approx) local right = sc.label if sc.clock == "local" then right = right .. " (your time)" end if sc.clock == "aard" then right = right .. " (US Eastern)" end local span if sc.key == "all" then local first = db_query_one("SELECT MIN(start_time) AS t FROM sessions") local t0 = first and tonumber(first.t) or 0 span = t0 > 0 and (ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", t0) .. " - now") or "everything recorded" elseif sc.key == "session" then span = "since " .. ShowDate("%m/%d %H:%M", sc.start) .. " (login or reload)" else -- Aardwolf scopes show their start in US Eastern, where it is always 00:00. span = "since " .. (sc.clock == "aard" and (os.date("!" .. DateFmt("%m/%d %H:%M"), sc.start + EasternOffsetHours(sc.start) * 3600) .. " ET") or ShowDate("%m/%d %H:%M", sc.start)) end local act = FormatTimeShort(active) if approx then act = "~" .. act end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("gold", "", " " .. title .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, REPORT_W - #title - #right - 1)), "white", "", right) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. span .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, REPORT_W - #span - #act - 8)), "gray", "", "active " .. act) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) end

"s", "Your time"), "dimgray", "", " |", "cyan", "", string.format("%" .. span .. "s", "Aardwolf")) local head = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do head[#head + 1] = string.format("%" .. w .. "s", c) end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-12s", ""), "gray", "", table.concat(head), "dimgray", "", " |", "gray", "", table.concat(head)) for _, row in ipairs(REPORT_PERIOD_ROWS) do local cells = {} for side = 1, 2 do local sc = ReportScope(row[side]) local vals = fetch(sc, ScopeTotals(sc, want)) local out = {} for i = 1, #cols do -- keep a space between cells: "1h 02m 03s" drops its seconds to fit local v = vals[i] v = type(v) == "number" and FitNum(v, w - 1) or tostring(v or "") if #v >= w then v = v:gsub(" %d+s$", "") end out[i] = string.format("%" .. w .. -- ============================================================================= -- cdt gains best [scope]: personal records, from what is already recorded. -- ============================================================================= -- The calendar day a time column falls on, in the timezone reports use. function SqlDayExpr(col) local off = TZOffsetSeconds() if off then return string.format("date(%s + %d, 'unixepoch')", col, off) end return string.format("date(%s, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')", col) end
-- "2026-09-20" -> "Sat 09/20/2026", in the date order you chose. function BestDayText(day) local y, m, d = (day or ""):match("^(%d+)-(%d+)-(%d+)$") if not y then return tostring(day or "-") end return ShowDate("%a %m/%d/%Y", TZTime({year = tonumber(y), month = tonumber(m), day = tonumber(d), hour = 12})) end

ColourNote("white", "", " Best day") -- Rows are first added up by quarter hour -- integer arithmetic -- and only those -- sums are turned into dates: working out a date for each of a million kills made -- this lag. Every timezone's midnight falls on a quarter hour, so no bucket spans -- two days. The kills are read once, into a temporary table (in memory, never in -- the database file), for both the XP day and the kills day. local BUCKET = 900 db_exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp.best_kills;") db_exec(string.format("CREATE TEMP TABLE best_kills AS SELECT CAST(time AS INTEGER) / %d AS b, " .. "SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) AS xp, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) AS top " .. "FROM kills WHERE %s GROUP BY b;", BUCKET, W("time"))) local function best_day(label, parts, fmt) local union = {} for _, part in ipairs(parts) do if part[1] == "best_kills" then union[#union + 1] = "SELECT b, " .. part[2] .. " AS v FROM temp.best_kills" else union[#union + 1] = string.format("SELECT CAST(%s AS INTEGER) / %d AS b, SUM(%s) AS v FROM %s WHERE %s%s GROUP BY b", part[3], BUCKET, part[2], part[1], W(part[3]), part[4] and (" AND " .. part[4]) or "") end end local r = one("SELECT " .. SqlDayExpr("b * " .. BUCKET) .. " AS d, SUM(v) AS v FROM (" .. table.concat(union, " UNION ALL ") .. ") GROUP BY d ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1") local v = r and tonumber(r.v) or 0 if v > 0 then BestRow(label, fmt(v), BestDayText(r.d)) end end best_day("XP", {{"best_kills", "xp"}, {"campaigns", "xp", "end_time", "failed = 0"}, {"earnings", "amount", "time", "currency = 'xp'"}}, short_value) best_day("QP", {{"quests", "totqp", "end_time", "failed = 0"}, {"campaigns", "qp", "end_time", "failed = 0"}, {"gquests", "qp_mobs + qp_win", "end_time"}, {"earnings", "amount", "time", "currency = 'qp'"}}, comma_value) best_day("gold", {{"gold_log", "amount", "time"}, {"quests", "gold", "end_time", "failed = 0"}, {"campaigns", "gold", "end_time", "failed = 0"}, {"gquests", "gold", "end_time"}, {"earnings", "amount", "time", "currency = 'gold'"}}, short_value) best_day("kills", {{"best_kills", "n"}}, comma_value) best_day("powerups", {{"levels", "1", "end_time", "type = 'pup'"}}, comma_value) best_day("quests", {{"quests", "1", "end_time", "failed = 0"}}, comma_value)

-- ============================================================================= -- cdt gains compare <day|week|month|year|aard...> [full] -- This period so far against the last one up to the same point: a Wednesday -- compared with all of last week would always look behind. full compares the two -- most recent finished periods instead. -- ============================================================================= COMPARE_NAMES = { day = {"Today", "Yesterday", "Yesterday", "Day before"}, week = {"This week", "Last week", "Last week", "Week before"}, month = {"This month", "Last month", "Last month", "Month before"}, year = {"This year", "Last year", "Last year", "Year before"}, } COMPARE_WANT = {xp = true, gold = true, qp = true, extras = true, level = true, pup = true}
local function CompareSpan(sc) local t = ScopeTotals(sc, COMPARE_WANT) local active = ScopeActiveSecs(sc) return {t = t, active = active} end
local function ChangeText(a, b) if type(a) ~= "number" or type(b) ~= "number" then return "-", "dimgray" end if a == 0 and b == 0 then return "-", "dimgray" end if b == 0 then return "new", "lime" end local pct = (a - b) / b * 100 if math.abs(pct) < 0.5 then return "same", "silver" end return string.format("%+.0f%%", pct), pct > 0 and "lime" or "red" end
function CmdCompare(name, line, wildcards) local words = {} for w in ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w:lower() end local full = false for i = #words, 1, -1 do if words[i] == "full" then full = true; table.remove(words, i) end end local key = REPORT_SCOPE_ALIASES[words[1] or "week"] or words[1] or "week" local info = REPORT_SCOPES[key] if not info or not info.period or words[2] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains compare <day|week|month|year> [full]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " aardday, aardweek, aardmonth and aardyear work too.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Without full: this one so far against the last one up to the same point.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " With full: the last finished one against the one before it.") return end FlushKillBuffer() if quest_pending then FinalizeQuestRecord() end
local start_of = info.clock == "aard" and EasternPeriodStart or LocalPeriodStart local now = os.time() local cur = start_of(info.period, now) local prev = start_of(info.period, cur - 1) local names = COMPARE_NAMES[info.period] local a_sc, b_sc, whole_sc, a_name, b_name if full then local before = start_of(info.period, prev - 1) a_sc = {key = "range", clock = info.clock, start = prev, stop = cur} b_sc = {key = "range", clock = info.clock, start = before, stop = prev} a_name, b_name = names[3], names[4] else -- The same stretch of the last one; a shorter month simply ends at its end. local stop = math.min(prev + (now - cur), cur) a_sc = {key = "range", clock = info.clock, start = cur} b_sc = {key = "range", clock = info.clock, start = prev, stop = stop} whole_sc = {key = "range", clock = info.clock, start = prev, stop = cur} a_name, b_name = names[1], names[2] end local A, B = CompareSpan(a_sc), CompareSpan(b_sc) local WHOLE = whole_sc and CompareSpan(whole_sc)

(sc.stop and at(sc.stop) or "now") end local clock = info.clock == "aard" and "(US Eastern)" or "(your time)" local title = full and string.format(" Compare: %s with the %s before it", a_name:lower(), info.period) or string.format(" Compare: %s so far with %s to the same point", a_name:lower(), b_name:lower()) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("gold", "", title .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, REPORT_W - #title - #clock)), "white", "", clock) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. a_name .. ": " .. shown(a_sc)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. b_name .. ": " .. shown(b_sc)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-18s%14s%14s%10s%16s", "", a_name, b_name, "Change", WHOLE and ("All " .. b_name:lower()) or ""))
local function cell(v, short) if type(v) ~= "number" then return tostring(v or "-") end if short then return ShortCell(v) end return string.format("%d", math.floor(v + 0.5)) end local rows = { {"XP", function(x) return x.t.xp.total end, true}, {"QP", function(x) return x.t.qp end}, {"Gold", function(x) return x.t.gold.total end, true}, {"TP", function(x) return x.t.tp end}, {"Trains", function(x) return x.t.trains end}, {"Levels", function(x) return x.t.level.n end}, {"Powerups", function(x) return x.t.pup.n end}, {"Kills", function(x) return x.t.xp.kills end}, {"Quests", function(x) return x.active * 3600 or "-" end, true}, {"QP per hour", function(x) return x.active >= 60 and x.t.qp / x.active * 3600 or "-" end}, } for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local a, b = r[2](A), r[2](B) local change, col = ChangeText(a, b) local av = cell(a, r[3]) if r[1] == "QP per hour" and type(a) == "number" then av = string.format("%.1f", a) end local bv = cell(b, r[3]) if r[1] == "QP per hour" and type(b) == ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", r[1]), "white", "", string.format("%14s%14s", av, bv), col, "", string.format("%10s", change), "gray", "", string.format("%16s", wv)) end local ca, ccol = ChangeText(A.active, B.active) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", "Active time"), "white", "", string.format("%14s%14s", ActiveShort(A.active), ActiveShort(B.active)), ccol, "", string.format("%10s", ca), "gray", "", string.format("%16s", WHOLE and ActiveShort(WHOLE.active) or "")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) if not full then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt gains compare " .. key .. " full: the last two finished " .. info.period .. "s.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) end end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ period tables -- The last n days/weeks/months/years of one scope, newest first: {start, stop} each, -- the newest with no stop because it is still running. function ScopePeriods(key, count) local info = REPORT_SCOPES[key] local start_of = info.clock == "aard" and EasternPeriodStart or LocalPeriodStart local out = {} local start, stop = start_of(info.period), nil for i = 1, count do out[i] = {start = start, stop = stop} stop = start start = start_of(info.period, start - 1) end return out end
-- What a row is called: "Mon 09/21", "wk 09/15", "Sep 2026", "2026". function PeriodRowLabel(info, start) local fmt = ({day = "%a %m/%d", week = "wk %m/%d", month = "%b %Y", year = "%Y"})[info.period] if info.clock == "aard" then return os.date("!" .. DateFmt(fmt), start + EasternOffsetHours(start) * 3600) end return ShowDate(fmt, start) end
-- Active time in a cell: "12h 05m", "45m", "-" under a minute; "~" when estimated. function ActiveShort(secs, approx) secs = math.floor(tonumber(secs) or 0) if secs < 60 then return "-" end local h, m = math.floor(secs / 3600), math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60) local s = h > 0 and string.format("%dh %02dm", h, m) or string.format("%dm", m) return (approx and "~" or "") .. s end
local function PerHourCell(v, a, d) return PerHourText(v, a, d) or "-" end -- A rate as a number, for the short-form XP and gold columns; "-" under a minute. local function PerHourNum(v, a) return a >= 60 and math.floor(v / a * 3600) or "-" end
-- XP and gold in a period table: 950, 11.5k, 12m, 1.2b. Negative when clan tax -- outweighed the gold coming in. -- Global: cdt gains compare, defined above, uses it too. function ShortCell(v) v = math.floor(tonumber(v) or 0) local s = short_value(math.abs(v)):gsub("%.0([kmb])$", "%1") return (v < 0 and "-" or "") .. s end
local function TopBlootTier(b) for i = #BLOOT_TIERS, 1, -1 do if (b.tiers[BLOOT_TIERS[i]] or 0) > 0 then return BlootCode(BLOOT_TIERS[i], true) end end return "-" end

PERIOD_TABLES = { overview = {want = {xp = true, gold = true, qp = true, level = true, pup = true}, cols = { {"XP", 9, function(t) return t.xp.total end, "short"}, {"QP", 8, function(t) return t.qp end}, {"Gold", 9, function(t) return t.gold.total end, "short"}, {"Levels", 7, function(t) return t.level.n end}, {"Pups", 7, function(t) return t.pup.n end}, {"Kills", 8, function(t) return t.xp.kills end}}}, xp = {want = {xp = true}, cols = { {"XP", 9, function(t) return t.xp.total end, "short"}, {"Kills", 8, function(t) return t.xp.kills end}, {"Double", 9, function(t) return t.xp.double + t.xp.unsplit end, "short"}, {"XP/kill", 8, function(t) return t.xp.kills > 0 and math.floor(t.xp.base / t.xp.kills) or "-" end}, {"XP/hr", 9, function(t, a) return PerHourNum(t.xp.total, a) end, "short"}}}, gold = {want = {gold = true}, cols = { {"Gold", 9, function(t) return t.gold.total end, "short"}, {"Mob gold", 10, function(t) return t.gold.sources.mob or 0 end, "short"}, {"Rewards", 9, function(t) local g = t.gold.sources; return (g.quest or 0) + (g.cp or 0) + (g.gq or 0) end, "short"}, {"Gold/hr", 9, function(t, a) return PerHourNum(t.gold.total, a) end, "short"}}}, -- Each source's QP with how many were done beside it; GQs also count their wins. -- No Active column, so a year of QP still fits every column. qp = {want = {qp = true}, no_active = true, cols = { {"QP", 8, function(t) return t.qp end}, {"Quest", 8, function(t) return t.quests.total end}, {"#Q", 6, function(t) return t.quests.done end}, {"CP", 7, function(t) return t.cps.total end}, {"#CP", 5, function(t) return t.cps.done end}, {"GQ", 7, function(t) return t.gqs.total end}, {"#GQ", 5, function(t) return t.gqs.finished end}, {"Won", 5, function(t) return t.gqs.won end}, {"Other", 7, function(t) return t.other.qp end}, {"QP/hr", 7, function(t, a) return PerHourCell(t.qp, a, 1) end}}}, quest = {want = {qp = true}, cols = { {"Done", 6, function(t) return t.quests.done end}, {"Failed", 7, function(t) return t.quests.failed end}, {"QP", 8, function(t) return t.quests.total end}, {"Gold", 8, function(t) return t.quests.gold end, "short"}, {"Avg time", 10, function(t) return t.quests.done > 0 and AvgTimeText(t.quests.avg_secs) or "-" end}, {"Per hr", 7, function(t, a) return t.quests.done > 0 and PerHourCell(t.quests.done, a, 1) or "-" end}}}, cp = {want = {qp = true}, cols = { {"Done", 6, function(t) return t.cps.done end}, {"Failed", 7, function(t) return t.cps.failed end}, {"QP", 8, function(t) return t.cps.total end}, {"Gold", 8, function(t) return t.cps.gold end, "short"}, {"XP", 8, function(t) return t.cps.xp end, "short"}}}, gq = {want = {qp = true}, cols = { {"Joined", 7, function(t) return t.gqs.joined end}, {"Done", 6, function(t) return t.gqs.finished end}, {"Won", 5, function(t) return t.gqs.won end}, {"QP", 7, function(t) return t.gqs.total end}, {"Gold", 8, function(t) return t.gqs.gold end, "short"}}}, tp = {want = {qp = true, extras = true}, no_active = true, cols = { {"TP", 8, function(t) return t.tp end}, {"Quest", 8, function(t) return t.quests.tp end}, {"CP", 7, function(t) return t.cps.tp end}, {"GQ", 7, function(t) return t.gqs.tp end}, {"Mob", 8, function(t) local v = 0; for _, e in ipairs(t.other.by.tp) do if e.source == "trivia_mob" then v = v + e.v end end; return v end}, {"Other", 8, function(t) local v = 0; for _, e in ipairs(t.other.by.tp) do if e.source ~= "trivia_mob" then v = v + e.v end end; return v end}, {"TP/hr", 7, function(t, a) return PerHourCell(t.tp, a, 1) end}}}, trains = {want = {qp = true, extras = true}, no_active = true, cols = { {"Trains", 8, function(t) return t.trains end}, {"Levels", 8, function(t) return t.level.all_trains end}, {"Pups", 8, function(t) return t.pup.all_trains end}, {"Quest", 7, function(t) return t.quests.trains end}, {"CP", 7, function(t) return t.cps.trains end}, {"GQ", 7, function(t) return t.gqs.trains end}, {"Other", 7, function(t) return t.other.trains end}, {"Tr/hr", 7, function(t, a) return PerHourCell(t.trains, a, 1) end}}}, bloot = {want = {bloot = true}, cols = { {"Bloot", 7, function(t) return t.bloot.total end}, {"Kills", 9, function(t) return t.kills or 0 end}, {"1 per", 8, function(t) return t.bloot.total > 0 and math.floor((t.kills or 0) / t.bloot.total) or "-" end}, {"Best tier", 14, function(t) return TopBlootTier(t.bloot) end}}}, } for _, lt in ipairs({{"level", "level", "Levels"}, {"powerup", "pup", "Pups"}}) do local k = lt[2] PERIOD_TABLES[lt[1]] = {want = {[k] = true}, cols = { {lt[3], 7, function(t) return t[k].n end}, {"Solo", 6, function(t) return t[k].solo end}, {"Grouped", 8, function(t) return t[k].grouped end}, {"Avg time", 10, function(t) return AvgTimeText(t[k].avg) end}, {"Fastest", 10, function(t) return AvgTimeText(t[k].best) end}, {"Trains", 8, function(t) return t[k].all_trains end}}} end
PERIOD_ROW_W = 12 -- the label column: " Mon 09/21 *"
-- Columns that are a rate, a ratio or a time. Averaging them period by period would -- be wrong (a quiet day's XP/hr counts as much as a long one's), so the Average row -- shows them worked out over the whole span instead. PERIOD_RATE_COLS = {["XP/kill"] = true, ["XP/hr"] = true, ["Gold/hr"] = true, ["QP/hr"] = true, ["TP/hr"] = true, ["Tr/hr"] = true, ["Per hr"] = true, ["Avg time"] = true, ["Fastest"] = true, ["1 per"] = true, ["Best tier"] = true}
-- Which column decides the best row: the headline figure, or QP where the first -- column is only a count. PERIOD_BEST_COL = {quest = 3, cp = 3, gq = 4} PERIOD_NAMES = {day = "day", week = "week", month = "month", year = "year"}
-- cdt gains report [type] <n><scope>: one row per period, the total underneath. function ReportPeriodTable(kind, key, count, channel) local info = REPORT_SCOPES[key] local spec = PERIOD_TABLES[kind] local cols = spec.cols local unit = PERIOD_NAMES[info.period] .. (count == 1 and "" or "s") local periods = ScopePeriods(key, count) local range = {key = "range", clock = info.clock, start = periods[count].start, label = "Last " .. count .. " " .. (info.clock == "aard" and "Aardwolf " or "") .. unit, line = "last " .. count .. " " .. (info.clock == "aard" and "aard " or "") .. unit} -- The total row and the channel line both come from this; REPORT_WANT covers both. local totals = ScopeTotals(range, REPORT_WANT[kind]) local range_active, range_approx = ScopeActiveSecs(range)
ReportHeader(REPORT_TITLES[kind], range, range_active, range_approx) local head = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do head[#head + 1] = string.format("%" .. c[2] .. "s", c[1]) end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-" .. (PERIOD_ROW_W - 1) .. "s", ""), "gray", "", table.concat(head) .. (spec.no_active and "" or string.format("%10s", "Active")))
-- per: when set, this is the Average row, and figures that add up are divided by it. local function cells(t, active, approx, per) local out = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do local v = c[3](t, active) if per and type(v) == "number" and not PERIOD_RATE_COLS[c[1]] then v = v / per end -- No commas: counts and QP as plain digits, XP and gold in short form. if type(v) == "number" and c[4] == "short" then v = ShortCell(v) elseif type(v) == "number" and per and v < 100 and v ~= math.floor(v) then v = string.format("%.1f", v) elseif type(v) == "number" then local digits = string.format("%d", math.floor(v + (per and 0.5 or 0))) v = #digits <= c[2] - 1 and digits or ShortCell(v) else v = tostring(v or "") end if v:find(CODED_END, 1, true) then out[#out + 1] = CodedPad(v, c[2], true) else if #v >= c[2] then v = v:sub(1, c[2] - 1) end out[#out + 1] = string.format("%" .. c[2] .. "s", v) end end if spec.no_active then return table.concat(out) end return table.concat(out) .. string.format("%10s", ActiveShort(per and active / per or active, approx)) end local function label_cell(text) return string.format(" %-" .. (PERIOD_ROW_W - 1) .. "s", text) end local function row_note(label_colour, label, colour, text) ColourNote(unpack(CodedArgs(text, colour, {label_colour, "", label_cell(label)}))) end
-- Every row first, so the best one is known before anything is printed. local rows, any_approx = {}, range_approx for i, per in ipairs(periods) do local sc = {key = "range", clock = info.clock, start = per.start, stop = per.stop} local t = ScopeTotals(sc, spec.want) local active, approx = ScopeActiveSecs(sc) any_approx = any_approx or approx rows[i] = {t = t, active = active, approx = approx, label = PeriodRowLabel(info, per.start) .. (i == 1 and " *" or "")} end local best_col = cols[PERIOD_BEST_COL[kind] or 1] local best_i, best_v = nil, 0 if count > 1 then for i, r in ipairs(rows) do local v = best_col[3](r.t, r.active) if type(v) == "number" and v > best_v then best_i, best_v = i, v end end end for i, r in ipairs(rows) do local best = i == best_i row_note(best and "lime" or (i == 1 and "white" or "silver"), r.label, best and "lime" or "white", cells(r.t, r.active, r.approx)) end
-- The average is over the finished periods you played in: the one still running -- would drag it down, and so would days off. local played = 0 for i = 2, #rows do if rows[i].active >= 60 then played = played + 1 end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) if played > 0 then local done = {key = "range", clock = info.clock, start = periods[count].start, stop = periods[1].start} local dt = ScopeTotals(done, spec.want) local da, dapprox = ScopeActiveSecs(done) row_note("cyan", "Average", "cyan", cells(dt, da, dapprox, played)) end row_note("gold", "Total", "yellow", cells(totals, range_active, range_approx)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) local unit_one = PERIOD_NAMES[info.period] if played > 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" Average: per %s, over the %d finished %s%s you played.%s", unit_one, played, unit_one, played == 1 and "" or "s", best_i and (" Best " .. unit_one .. " in green.") or "")) elseif best_i then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Best " .. unit_one .. " in green.") end local notes = "* so far. " if info.clock == "aard" then notes = notes .. "Aardwolf's clock: US Eastern, weeks from Monday." else local ws = WeekStartName() notes = notes .. string.format("Your time: %s, weeks from %s.", TZLabel() or "this computer's timezone", ws:sub(1, 1):upper() .. ws:sub(2)) end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. notes) if any_approx and not spec.no_active then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " ~ a session ran across a period's edge: its active time is split by clock time.") end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W))
if channel then Report(channel, BuildGainsReportLine(kind, range, totals, range_active)) end end
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ report bodies function ReportXP(sc, t, active, approx) local x = t.xp ReportRow("Total XP", comma_value(x.total), "lime") ReportRow("kills", comma_value(x.base), "white", 1) local since = RecordedSince("report_split_since") for _, part in ipairs({{"rare kill bonus", x.rare}, {"double XP bonus", x.double}, {"daily blessing", x.blessing}, {"bonus (before the split)", x.unsplit, "double + blessing"}, {"superhero honour", x.honor}, {"campaigns", x.cp}, {"other", x.other}}) do if part[2] > 0 then ReportRow(part[1], comma_value(part[2]), "white", 1, part[3]) end end ReportRow("Kills", comma_value(x.kills), "white") if x.kills > 0 then ReportRow("average XP per kill", comma_value(math.floor(x.base / x.kills)), "white", 1) ReportRow("with rare and bonus XP", comma_value(math.floor((x.base + x.rare + x.double + x.unsplit) / x.kills)), "white", 1) end local any = false for _, sp in ipairs(KILL_SPECIALS) do if x.specials[sp] > 0 then any = true end end ReportRow("Kill specials", any and "" or "none", "white", 0, (since > 0 and (sc.start or 0) < since) and ("recorded from " .. ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", since)) or nil) for _, sp in ipairs(KILL_SPECIALS) do if x.specials[sp] > 0 then ReportRow(sp, comma_value(x.specials[sp]), "white", 1) end end local dbl = ScopeDoubleSecs(sc) if dbl > 0 then ReportRow("Double XP time", FormatTimeShort(dbl), "white") end local ph = PerHourText(x.total, active) if ph then ReportRow("XP per hour", ph, "lime", 0, approx and "approximate" or nil) end if sc.key == "all" then ReportPeriodSideBySide({"XP", "Kills", "XP/hr"}, {xp = true}, function(s2, t2) local a = ScopeActiveSecs(s2) return {t2.xp.total, t2.xp.kills, PerHourText(t2.xp.total, a) or "-"} end) end end
function GoldSourceList(g) local list = {} for src, v in pairs(g.sources) do list[#list + 1] = {src = src, v = v} end table.sort(list, function(a, b) return math.abs(a.v) > math.abs(b.v) end) return list end
function ReportGold(sc, t, active, approx) local g = t.gold ReportRow("Total gold", comma_value(g.total), "yellow") for _, e in ipairs(GoldSourceList(g)) do ReportRow(GOLD_SOURCE_NAMES[e.src] or e.src, comma_value(e.v), e.v < 0 and "red" or "white", 1) end local ph = PerHourText(g.total, active) if ph then ReportRow("Gold per hour", ph, "yellow", 0, approx and "approximate" or nil) end if sc.key == "all" then ReportPeriodSideBySide({"Gold", "Gold/hr"}, {gold = true}, function(s2, t2) return {t2.gold.total, PerHourText(t2.gold.total, (ScopeActiveSecs(s2))) or "-"} end) end end
function ReportQuestQPRows(q, indent) ReportRow("base", comma_value(q.base), "white", indent) for _, b in ipairs({{"tier", "tier bonus"}, {"lucky", "lucky bonus"}, {"mccp", "MCCP bonus"}, {"opk", "OPK bonus"}, {"hc", "hardcore bonus"}, {"daily", "daily blessing"}, {"other", "other (not itemised)"}}) do if (q[b[1]] or 0) ~= 0 then ReportRow(b[2], comma_value(q[b[1]]), "white", indent) end end end
function ReportRewardRows(r) if (r.gold or 0) ~= 0 then ReportRow("Gold", comma_value(r.gold), "yellow") end if (r.tp or 0) > 0 then ReportRow("Trivia points", comma_value(r.tp), "magenta") end if (r.trains or 0) > 0 then ReportRow("Trains", comma_value(r.trains), "lime") end if (r.pracs or 0) > 0 then ReportRow("Pracs", comma_value(r.pracs), "lime") end end
function ReportQP(sc, t, active, approx) local q, c, g, o = t.quests, t.cps, t.gqs, t.other ReportRow("Total QP", comma_value(t.qp), "cyan") ReportRow(string.format("Quests (%s done)", comma_value(q.done)), comma_value(q.total), "cyan") if q.total > 0 then ReportQuestQPRows(q, 1) end ReportRow(string.format("Campaigns (%s done)", comma_value(c.done)), comma_value(c.total), "cyan") if c.total > 0 then ReportRow("base", comma_value(c.base), "white", 1) ReportRow("first of the day bonus", comma_value(c.daily), "white", 1) end ReportRow(string.format("GQs (%s finished, %s won)", comma_value(g.finished), comma_value(g.won)), comma_value(g.total), "cyan") if g.total > 0 then ReportRow("mob kills", comma_value(g.mobs + g.running), "white", 1, g.running > 0 and (g.running .. " from the GQ running now") or nil) ReportRow("winning", comma_value(g.win), "white", 1) end ReportRow("Other", comma_value(o.qp), "cyan") for _, src in ipairs(o.sources) do ReportRow(src.source, comma_value(src.v), "white", 1) end local ph = PerHourText(t.qp, active, 1) if ph then ReportRow("QP per hour", ph, "cyan", 0, approx and "approximate" or nil) end if sc.key == "all" then if (tonumber(state.player_totals.qp_earned) or 0) > 0 then ReportRow("Lifetime QP (whois)", comma_value(state.player_totals.qp_earned), "white") end ReportPeriodSideBySide({"QP", "Quest", "CP", "GQ"}, {qp = true}, function(_, t2) return {t2.qp, t2.quests.total, t2.cps.total, t2.gqs.total} end) end end
function ReportQuest(sc, t, active, approx) local q = t.quests ReportRow("Completed", comma_value(q.done), "lime") ReportRow("Failed", comma_value(q.failed), q.failed > 0 and "red" or "white") if q.doubled > 0 then ReportRow("Double QP quests", comma_value(q.doubled), "white") end if q.daily_quests > 0 then ReportRow("Daily blessing quests", comma_value(q.daily_quests), "white") end ReportRow("Quest points", comma_value(q.total), "cyan") if q.total > 0 then ReportQuestQPRows(q, 1) end ReportRewardRows(q) if q.done > 0 then ReportRow("Average QP per quest", string.format("%.1f", q.total / q.done), "white") ReportRow("Average time", AvgTimeText(q.avg_secs), "white") end local ph = PerHourText(q.done, active, 1) if ph and q.done > 0 then ReportRow("Quests per hour", ph, "white", 0, approx and "approximate" or nil) end if sc.key == "all" then ReportPeriodSideBySide({"Done", "QP", "Gold"}, {qp = true}, function(_, t2) return {t2.quests.done, t2.quests.total, t2.quests.gold} end) end end
function ReportCP(sc, t, active, approx) local c = t.cps ReportRow("Completed", comma_value(c.done), "lime") ReportRow("Failed", comma_value(c.failed), c.failed > 0 and "red" or "white") ReportRow("Quest points", comma_value(c.total), "cyan") if c.total > 0 then ReportRow("base", comma_value(c.base), "white", 1) ReportRow("first of the day bonus", comma_value(c.daily), "white", 1) end ReportRewardRows(c) if c.xp > 0 then ReportRow("Experience", comma_value(c.xp), "lime") end if c.done > 0 then ReportRow("Average QP per campaign", string.format("%.1f", c.total / c.done), "white") end if sc.key == "all" then ReportPeriodSideBySide({"Done", "QP", "Gold"}, {qp = true}, function(_, t2) return {t2.cps.done, t2.cps.total, t2.cps.gold} end) end end
function ReportGQ(sc, t, active, approx) local g = t.gqs local since = RecordedSince("report_split_since") ReportRow("Joined", comma_value(g.joined), "white", 0, (sc.clock and since > 0 and sc.start < since) and ("recorded from " ..
