ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d", since)) or nil) ReportRow("Finished", comma_value(g.finished), "white") ReportRow("Won", comma_value(g.won), "lime") ReportRow("Quest points", comma_value(g.total), "cyan") ReportRow("mob kills", comma_value(g.mobs + g.running), "white", 1, g.running > 0 and (g.running .. " from the GQ running now") or nil) ReportRow("winning", comma_value(g.win), "white", 1) ReportRewardRows(g) if sc.key == "all" then ReportPeriodSideBySide({"Done", "Won", "QP"}, {qp = true}, function(_, t2) return {t2.gqs.finished, t2.gqs.won, t2.gqs.total} end) end end
function ReportLevels(sc, t, active, approx, ltype) local l = t[ltype] local pup = ltype == "pup" ReportRow(pup and "Powerups" or "Level-ups", comma_value(l.n), "white") ReportRow("solo / grouped", comma_value(l.solo) .. " / " .. comma_value(l.grouped), "white", 1) if l.n > 0 then ReportRow("average time", AvgTimeText(l.avg), "white", 1) ReportRow("fastest", AvgTimeText(l.best), "white", 1) ReportRow("trains", comma_value(l.all_trains), "lime", 1) if l.lucky > 0 then ReportRow("lucky", comma_value(l.lucky), "white", 2) end if l.bless > 0 then ReportRow("daily blessing", comma_value(l.bless), "white", 2) end if l.inst > 0 then ReportRow("instinct", comma_value(l.inst), "white", 2) end if not pup then ReportRow("HP / MP / MV", short_value(l.hp) .. "/" .. short_value(l.mp) .. "/" .. short_value(l.mv), "white", 1) if l.pracs > 0 then ReportRow("pracs", comma_value(l.pracs), "white", 1) end end local ph = PerHourText(l.n, active, 1) if ph then ReportRow("per hour", ph, "white", 1, approx and "approximate" or nil) end end if sc.key == "all" then if pup and (tonumber(state.player_totals.pups) or 0) > 0 then ReportRow("Lifetime powerups (whois)", comma_value(state.player_totals.pups), "yellow") elseif not pup then local total = TotalLevels(state.current.level) if total then ReportRow("Total levels (all tiers)", comma_value(total), "yellow") end end ReportPeriodSideBySide({pup and "Pups" or "Levels", "Avg time"}, {[ltype] = true}, function(_, t2) return {t2[ltype].n, AvgTimeText(t2[ltype].avg)} end) end end
function ReportBloot(sc, t, active, approx) local b = t.bloot if sc.key ~= "all" then local kills = t.kills or 0 ReportRow("Total", comma_value(b.total), "white", 0, (b.total > 0 and kills > 0) and ("1 per " .. comma_value(math.floor(kills / b.total)) .. " kills") or nil) for i = #BLOOT_TIERS, 1, -1 do local n = b.tiers[BLOOT_TIERS[i]] if n and n > 0 then ReportRow(BlootCode(BLOOT_TIERS[i], true), comma_value(n), "white", 1) end end if #b.areas > 0 then ReportRow("By area", "", "white") for _, a in ipairs(b.areas) do ReportRow(a.area, comma_value(a.n), "white", 1) end end return end local periods = {} for _, row in ipairs(REPORT_PERIOD_ROWS) do periods[#periods + 1] = {ScopeTotals(ReportScope(row[1]), {bloot = true}).bloot, ScopeTotals(ReportScope(row[2]), {bloot = true}).bloot} end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-12s %6s", "", ""), "white", "", string.format("%14s%14s%14s%14s", "Today", "This week", "This month", "This year")) local sub = {} for _ = 1, 4 do sub[#sub + 1] = string.format("%7s%7s", "yours", "aard") end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-12s %6s", "Tier", "All"), "gray", "", table.concat(sub)) local shown = 0 for i = #BLOOT_TIERS, 1, -1 do local tier = BLOOT_TIERS[i] if (b.tiers[tier] or 0) > 0 then local cells = {} for _, per in ipairs(periods) do cells[#cells + 1] = string.format("%7s%7s", comma_value(per[1].tiers[tier] or 0), comma_value(per[2].tiers[tier] or 0)) end local args = CodedArgs(" " .. CodedPad(BlootCode(tier, true), 12) .. " ", "white") args[#args + 1] = "white"; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = string.format("%6s", comma_value(b.tiers[tier])) args[#args + 1] = "silver"; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = table.concat(cells) ColourNote(unpack(args)) shown = shown + 1 end end if shown == 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", " No bloot recorded yet.") end local cells = {} for _, per in ipairs(periods) do cells[#cells + 1] = string.format("%7s%7s", comma_value(per[1].total), comma_value(per[2].total)) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-12s ", "Total"), "white", "", string.format("%6s", comma_value(b.total)), "yellow", "", table.concat(cells)) local ws = WeekStartName() ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" yours: %s, weeks from %s.", TZLabel() or "this computer's timezone", ws:sub(1, 1):upper() .. ws:sub(2))) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " aard: US Eastern, weeks from Monday.") end
-- The earnings rows for one currency, largest first, under its "other" heading. local function EarningRows(list, indent) local shown = {} for _, e in ipairs(list or {}) do if e.v ~= 0 then shown[#shown + 1] = e end end -- One unexplained source alone would only repeat the line above it. if #shown == 1 and shown[1].source == "other" then return end for _, e in ipairs(shown) do ReportRow(EARNING_SOURCE_NAMES[e.source] or e.source, comma_value(e.v), "white", indent or 2) end end
function ReportTP(sc, t, active, approx) local q, c, g, o = t.quests, t.cps, t.gqs, t.other ReportRow("Total TP", comma_value(t.tp), "magenta") ReportRow("quests", comma_value(q.tp), "white", 1) ReportRow("campaigns", comma_value(c.tp), "white", 1) ReportRow("GQs", comma_value(g.tp), "white", 1) if o.tp ~= 0 then ReportRow("other sources", comma_value(o.tp), "white", 1) EarningRows(o.by.tp, 2) end local ph = PerHourText(t.tp, active, 1) if ph then ReportRow("TP per hour", ph, "magenta", 0, approx and "approximate" or nil) end if sc.key == "all" then ReportPeriodSideBySide({"TP", "Quest", "CP", "GQ"}, REPORT_WANT.tp, function(_, t2) return {t2.tp, t2.quests.tp, t2.cps.tp, t2.gqs.tp} end) end end
function ReportTrains(sc, t, active, approx) local q, c, g, o = t.quests, t.cps, t.gqs, t.other ReportRow("Total trains", comma_value(t.trains), "lime") for _, lt in ipairs({{"level", "Level-ups", "level-up"}, {"pup", "Powerups", "powerup"}}) do local l = t[lt[1]] ReportRow(lt[2], comma_value(l.all_trains), "white", 0, l.n > 0 and string.format("from %s %s%s", comma_value(l.n), lt[3], l.n == 1 and "" or "s") or nil) -- Split out only when there is a bonus; base alone would repeat the line above. if l.lucky + l.bless + l.inst > 0 then for _, part in ipairs({{"base", l.trains}, {"lucky", l.lucky}, {"daily blessing", l.bless}, {"instinct", l.inst}}) do if part[2] > 0 then ReportRow(part[1], comma_value(part[2]), "gray", 1) end end end end ReportRow("Quests", comma_value(q.trains), "white") ReportRow("Campaigns", comma_value(c.trains), "white") ReportRow("GQs", comma_value(g.trains), "white") if o.trains ~= 0 then ReportRow("Other", comma_value(o.trains), "white") EarningRows(o.by.trains, 1) end local ph = PerHourText(t.trains, active, 1) if ph then ReportRow("Trains per hour", ph, "lime", 0, approx and "approximate" or nil) end if sc.key == "all" then ReportPeriodSideBySide({"Trains", "Levels", "Pups", "Rewards"}, REPORT_WANT.trains, function(_, t2) return {t2.trains, t2.level.all_trains, t2.pup.all_trains, t2.quests.trains + t2.cps.trains + t2.gqs.trains + t2.other.trains} end) end end
function OverviewRow(label, value, note) local args = {"silver", "", string.format(" %-21s", label), "white", "", string.format("%14s", value)} if note and note ~= "" then if note:find(CODED_END, 1, true) then CodedArgs(" " .. note, "dimgray", args) else args[#args + 1] = "dimgray"; args[#args + 1] = ""; args[#args + 1] = " " .. note end end ColourNote(unpack(args)) end
function PercentText(parts, total) if total <= 0 then return "" end local out = {} for _, p in ipairs(parts) do if p[2] > 0 then out[#out + 1] = string.format("%s %d%%", p[1], math.floor(p[2] / total * 100 + 0.5)) end end return table.concat(out, " ") end
function TopTiersText(b, count) local out = {} for i = #BLOOT_TIERS, 1, -1 do local n = b.tiers[BLOOT_TIERS[i]] if n and n > 0 and #out < count then out[#out + 1] = BlootCode(BLOOT_TIERS[i], true) .. " " .. comma_value(n) end end return table.concat(out, " ") end
OVERVIEW_WANT = {xp = true, gold = true, qp = true, extras = true, level = true, pup = true, bloot = true}
function ReportOverview(sc, t, active, approx) local all = sc.key == "all" local x, g, q, c, gq = t.xp, t.gold, t.quests, t.cps, t.gqs local sources = GoldSourceList(g) local gold_note = {} for i = 1, math.min(2, #sources) do if sources[i].v > 0 then gold_note[#gold_note + 1] = {GOLD_SOURCE_NAMES[sources[i].src] or sources[i].src, sources[i].v} end end local specials = {} for _, sp in ipairs(KILL_SPECIALS) do if x.specials[sp] > 0 and #specials < 2 then specials[#specials + 1] = sp .. " " .. comma_value(x.specials[sp]) end end local ph = function(v, d) local s = PerHourText(v, active, d); return s and (s .. "/hr") or "" end OverviewRow("XP", comma_value(x.total), all and PercentText({{"kills", x.base}, {"double", x.double + x.unsplit}, {"cp", x.cp}}, x.total) or ph(x.total)) OverviewRow("QP", comma_value(t.qp), all and PercentText({{"quest", q.total}, {"cp", c.total}, {"gq", gq.total}}, t.qp) or ph(t.qp, 1)) OverviewRow("Gold", comma_value(g.total), all and PercentText(gold_note, g.total) or ph(g.total)) OverviewRow("Trivia points", comma_value(t.tp)) OverviewRow("Trains", comma_value(t.trains), "pracs " .. comma_value(t.pracs)) OverviewRow("Levels", comma_value(t.level.n), all and string.format("solo %s grouped %s", comma_value(t.level.solo), comma_value(t.level.grouped)) or ph(t.level.n, 1)) OverviewRow("Powerups", comma_value(t.pup.n), all and string.format("solo %s grouped %s", comma_value(t.pup.solo), comma_value(t.pup.grouped)) or ph(t.pup.n, 1)) local kpm = (not all and active >= 60) and string.format("%.1f/min", x.kills / active * 60) or "" OverviewRow("Kills", comma_value(x.kills), all and table.concat(specials, " ") or kpm) OverviewRow("Quests", comma_value(q.done), q.failed > 0 and (comma_value(q.failed) .. " failed") or "") OverviewRow("Campaigns", comma_value(c.done), c.failed > 0 and (comma_value(c.failed) .. " failed") or "") OverviewRow("GQs", comma_value(gq.finished), comma_value(gq.won) .. " won") OverviewRow("Bloot", comma_value(t.bloot.total), TopTiersText(t.bloot, all and 2 or 3)) if not all then return end
for side = 1, 2 do ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) local ws = WeekStartName() if side == 1 then ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" Your time (%s, weeks from %s)", TZLabel() or "this computer's timezone", ws:sub(1, 1):upper() .. ws:sub(2))) else ColourNote("cyan", "", " Aardwolf (US Eastern, weeks from Monday)") end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-11s%12s%8s%12s%8s%8s%9s", "", "XP", "QP", "Gold", "Levels", "Pups", "Kills")) for _, row in ipairs(REPORT_PERIOD_ROWS) do local s2 = ReportScope(row[side]) local t2 = ScopeTotals(s2, {xp = true, gold = true, qp = true, level = true, pup = true}) local label = side == 1 and row[3] or ("Aard " .. row[3]:gsub("^This ", ""):gsub("^Today$", "day")) ColourNote(side == 1 and "silver" or "cyan", "", string.format(" %-11s", label), side == 1 and "white" or "cyan", "", string.format("%12s%8s%12s%8s%8s%9s", FitNum(t2.xp.total, 11), FitNum(t2.qp, 7), FitNum(t2.gold.total, 11), FitNum(t2.level.n, 7), FitNum(t2.pup.n, 7), FitNum(t2.xp.kills, 8))) end end end
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ channel lines function BuildGainsReportLine(kind, sc, t, active) local parts = {} local function add(txt) parts[#parts + 1] = "@D| " .. txt end local names = {overview = "", xp = "XP ", gold = "Gold ", qp = "QP ", quest = "Quests ", cp = "Campaigns ", gq = "GQs ", level = "Levels ", powerup = "Powerups ", bloot = "Bloot ", tp = "TP ", trains = "Trains "} local scope_text = kind == "overview" and sc.label or sc.line local title = "@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@w" .. names[kind] .. scope_text if sc.key ~= "all" then title = title .. " @D(@w" .. FormatTimeShort(active) .. "@D)" end local function ph(v, d) local s = PerHourText(v, active, d) if s then add("@W" .. s .. "@w/hr") end end
if kind == "overview" then local x = t.xp add("@W" .. short_value(x.total) .. " @wxp") add("@W" .. comma_value(t.qp) .. "@wqp") add("@Y" .. short_value(t.gold.total) .. "@wg") if t.tp > 0 then add("@W" .. comma_value(t.tp) .. "@wtp") end if t.trains > 0 then add("@W" .. comma_value(t.trains) .. "@wtr") end if t.level.n > 0 then add("@W" .. comma_value(t.level.n) .. " @wlvl") end if t.pup.n > 0 then add("@W" .. short_value(t.pup.n) .. " @wpup") end add("@W" .. short_value(x.kills) .. " @wkills") add(string.format("@W%s@wq @W%s@wcp @W%s@wgq", comma_value(t.quests.done), comma_value(t.cps.done), comma_value(t.gqs.finished))) if t.bloot.total > 0 then add("@M" .. comma_value(t.bloot.total) .. " @wbloot") end
elseif kind == "xp" then local x = t.xp add("@W" .. short_value(x.total) .. " @wxp") if x.base > 0 then add("@wkills @W" .. short_value(x.base)) end if x.rare > 0 then add("@wrare @W" .. short_value(x.rare)) end if x.double > 0 then add("@wdouble @W" .. short_value(x.double)) end if x.blessing > 0 then add("@wblessing @W" .. short_value(x.blessing)) end if x.unsplit > 0 then add("@wbonus before split @W" .. short_value(x.unsplit)) end if x.honor > 0 then add("@whonour @W" .. short_value(x.honor)) end if x.cp > 0 then add("@wcp @W" .. short_value(x.cp)) end add("@W" .. short_value(x.kills) .. " @wkills") if x.kills > 0 then add("@W" .. comma_value(math.floor(x.base / x.kills)) .. "@w/kill") end if sc.key ~= "all" then local sp = {} for _, name in ipairs(KILL_SPECIALS) do if x.specials[name] > 0 then sp[#sp + 1] = "@w" .. name .. " @W" .. comma_value(x.specials[name]) end end if #sp > 0 then add(table.concat(sp, " ")) end end ph(x.total)
elseif kind == "gold" then local g = t.gold add("@Y" .. short_value(g.total) .. "@wg") for _, e in ipairs(GoldSourceList(g)) do add("@w" .. (GOLD_SOURCE_NAMES[e.src] or e.src) .. " " .. (e.v < 0 and "@R" or "@Y") .. short_value(e.v)) end ph(g.total)
elseif kind == "qp" then local q, c, g, o = t.quests, t.cps, t.gqs, t.other add("@W" .. comma_value(t.qp) .. "@wqp") if q.total > 0 then add("@wquests @W" .. comma_value(q.total) .. " @D(@w" .. QuestQPParts(q) .. "@D)") end if c.total > 0 then add("@wcp @W" .. comma_value(c.total) .. " @D(@w" .. comma_value(c.base) .. "+" .. comma_value(c.daily) .. "daily@D)") end if g.total > 0 then add(string.format("@wgq @W%s @D(@w%smob+%swin@D)", comma_value(g.total), comma_value(g.mobs + g.running), comma_value(g.win))) end if o.qp > 0 then add("@wother @W" .. comma_value(o.qp)) end ph(t.qp, 1)
elseif kind == "quest" then local q = t.quests add("@W" .. comma_value(q.done) .. " @wdone @W" .. comma_value(q.failed) .. " @wfailed") if q.total > 0 then add("@W" .. comma_value(q.total) .. "@wqp @D(@w" .. QuestQPParts(q) .. "@D)") end if q.gold > 0 then add("@Y" .. short_value(q.gold) .. "@wg") end local extras = TrainsTPText(q) if extras ~= "" then add("@M" .. extras) end if q.done > 0 then add(string.format("@wavg @W%.1f@wqp", q.total / q.done) .. (q.avg_secs > 0 and (" @W" .. AvgTimeText(q.avg_secs)) or "")) end if sc.key ~= "all" then ph(q.done, 1) end
elseif kind == "cp" then local c = t.cps add("@W" .. comma_value(c.done) .. " @wdone @W" .. comma_value(c.failed) .. " @wfailed") if c.total > 0 then add("@W" .. comma_value(c.total) .. "@wqp @D(@w" .. comma_value(c.base) .. "+" .. comma_value(c.daily) .. "daily@D)") end if c.gold > 0 then add("@Y" .. short_value(c.gold) .. "@wg") end local extras = TrainsTPText(c) if extras ~= "" then add("@M" .. extras) end if c.xp > 0 then add("@G" .. short_value(c.xp) .. " @wxp") end
elseif kind == "gq" then local g = t.gqs local counts = "@W" .. comma_value(g.finished) .. " @wfinished @W" .. comma_value(g.won) .. " @wwon" if sc.key == "session" then counts = "@W" .. comma_value(g.joined) .. " @wjoined " .. counts end add(counts) if g.total > 0 then add(string.format("@W%s@wqp @D(@w%smob+%swin@D)", comma_value(g.total), comma_value(g.mobs + g.running), comma_value(g.win))) end if g.gold > 0 then add("@Y" .. short_value(g.gold) .. "@wg") end local extras = TrainsTPText(g) if extras ~= "" then add("@M" .. extras) end
elseif kind == "tp" then add("@M" .. comma_value(t.tp) .. "@wtp") for _, part in ipairs({{"quests", t.quests.tp}, {"cp", t.cps.tp}, {"gq", t.gqs.tp}, {"other", t.other.tp}}) do if part[2] ~= 0 then add("@w" .. part[1] .. " @W" .. comma_value(part[2])) end end ph(t.tp, 1)
elseif kind == "trains" then add("@G" .. comma_value(t.trains) .. "@wtr") for _, part in ipairs({{"levels", t.level.all_trains}, {"pups", t.pup.all_trains}, {"quests", t.quests.trains}, {"cp", t.cps.trains}, {"gq", t.gqs.trains}, {"other", t.other.trains}}) do if part[2] ~= 0 then add("@w" .. part[1] .. " @W" .. comma_value(part[2])) end end ph(t.trains, 1)
elseif kind == "level" or kind == "powerup" then local ltype = kind == "powerup" and "pup" or "level" local l = t[ltype] add(string.format("@W%s @D(@wsolo %s grp %s@D)", comma_value(l.n), comma_value(l.solo), comma_value(l.grouped))) if l.n > 0 then if l.avg > 0 then add("@wavg @W" .. AvgTimeText(l.avg)) end if l.best > 0 then add("@wfastest @W" .. AvgTimeText(l.best)) end local bonus = l.lucky + l.bless + l.inst add("@G" .. comma_value(l.all_trains) .. "@wtr" .. (bonus > 0 and (" @D(@w+" .. comma_value(bonus) .. " bonus@D)") or "")) end if sc.key == "all" then if ltype == "pup" and (tonumber(state.player_totals.pups) or 0) > 0 then add("@wlifetime @W" .. comma_value(state.player_totals.pups)) elseif ltype == "level" then local total = TotalLevels(state.current.level) if total then add("@wtotal levels @W" .. comma_value(total)) end end else ph(l.n, 1) end
elseif kind == "bloot" then local b = t.bloot add("@W" .. comma_value(b.total)) local tiers = {} for i = #BLOOT_TIERS, 1, -1 do local n = b.tiers[BLOOT_TIERS[i]] if n and n > 0 then tiers[#tiers + 1] = BlootCode(BLOOT_TIERS[i]) .. " @W" .. comma_value(n) end end if #tiers > 0 then add(table.concat(tiers, "@D, ")) end local kills = t.kills or 0 if b.total > 0 and kills > 0 then add("@w1 per @W" .. comma_value(math.floor(kills / b.total)) .. " @wkills") end if sc.key ~= "all" and #b.areas > 0 then local areas = {} for i = 1, math.min(3, #b.areas) do areas[#areas + 1] = "@w" .. b.areas[i].area .. " @W" .. b.areas[i].n end add(table.concat(areas, "@D, ")) end end return title .. " " .. table.concat(parts, " ") .. "@D]" end
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ command function ReportUsage() ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Gains Reports") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Usage") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains report <type> [scope] [channel] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "one kind, all time by default") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt gains report <scope> [channel] ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "overview of everything") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Types") for _, row in ipairs({ {"xp", "XP by source, kills, kill specials, XP/hr"}, {"gold", "gold by source (mobs, sales, quests, tax ...)"}, {"qp", "QP by source and bonus"}, {"quest", "quests: QP bonuses, rewards, times"}, {"cp", "campaigns: QP, first-of-day bonus, rewards"}, {"gq", "global quests: mob and win QP, rewards"}, {"level", "level-ups: times, trains, HP/MP/MV"}, {"powerup", "powerups: times, trains"}, {"bloot", "bonus loot by tier"}, {"tp", "trivia points by source (trivia also works)"}, {"trains", "trains from levels, powerups and rewards"}}) do ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format(" %-9s", row[1]), "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", row[2]) end ColourNote("yellow", "", " Scopes", "dimgray", "", " (a type without a scope shows all)") local ws = WeekStartName() for _, row in ipairs({ {"all", "everything recorded, plus the period tables"}, {"session", "since you logged in or reloaded"}, {"day", "since midnight, your timezone"}, {"week", "since 00:00 on your week start day (" .. ws:sub(1, 1):upper() .. ws:sub(2) .. ")"}, {"month", "since the 1st"}, {"year", "since January 1st"}, {"aardday", "Aardwolf's day, from midnight US Eastern"}, {"aardweek", "Aardwolf's week, from Monday 00:00 US Eastern"}, {"aardmonth", "Aardwolf's month (US Eastern)"}, {"aardyear", "Aardwolf's year (US Eastern)"}}) do ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format(" %-10s", row[1]), "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", row[2]) end ColourNote("silver", "", " A number first makes a table of that many, newest first (up to 60).") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " e.g.", "lime", "", " cdt gains report qp cdt gains report qp week") ColourNote("lime", "", " cdt gains report all cdt gains report day gt") ColourNote("lime", "", " cdt gains report qp 7day cdt gains report 12 month") ColourNote("lime", "", " cdt gains report bloot aardmonth gt") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt help report explains every report in full.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) end
REPORT_TITLES = {overview = "Gains Overview", xp = "XP", gold = "Gold", qp = "QP", quest = "Quests", cp = "Campaigns", gq = "Global Quests", level = "Levels", powerup = "Powerups", bloot = "Bonus Loot", tp = "Trivia Points", trains = "Trains"} REPORT_WANT = { overview = OVERVIEW_WANT, xp = {xp = true}, gold = {gold = true}, qp = {qp = true}, quest = {qp = true}, cp = {qp = true}, gq = {qp = true}, level = {level = true}, powerup = {pup = true}, bloot = {bloot = true}, tp = {qp = true, extras = true}, trains = {qp = true, extras = true}, }
function CmdReport(name, line, wildcards) local raw = ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local words = {} for w in raw:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end if #words == 0 then ReportUsage() return end if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available."); return end
local first = words[1]:lower() first = REPORT_TYPE_ALIASES[first] or first local kind, scope_key, count, next_word, err if REPORT_TYPES[first] then kind = first scope_key, count, next_word = ParseReportScope(words, 2) if not scope_key then err = count scope_key, count, next_word = "all", nil, 2 end else kind = "overview" scope_key, count, next_word = ParseReportScope(words, 1) if not scope_key then err = count end end if err then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. err) return end if not scope_key then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown report or scope: " .. words[1]) ColourNote("silver", "", " Types: xp, gold, qp, quest, cp, gq, level, powerup, bloot, tp, trains") ColourNote("silver", "", " Scopes: " .. table.concat(REPORT_SCOPE_ORDER, " ")) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt gains report shows how to use it.") return end local channel = words[next_word] if words[next_word + 1] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Too many words. Usage: cdt gains report <type> [scope] [channel]") return end -- Checked before the report is printed: a typo here shouldn't cost you the screen. if channel then channel = CheckChannel(channel, "Usage: cdt gains report <type> [scope] [channel]") if not channel then return end end if count then FlushKillBuffer() if quest_pending then FinalizeQuestRecord() end ReportPeriodTable(kind, scope_key, count, channel) return end
FlushKillBuffer() if quest_pending then FinalizeQuestRecord() end local sc = ReportScope(scope_key) local t = ScopeTotals(sc, REPORT_WANT[kind]) local active, approx = ScopeActiveSecs(sc)
ReportHeader(REPORT_TITLES[kind], sc, active, approx) if kind == "overview" then ReportOverview(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "xp" then ReportXP(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "gold" then ReportGold(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "qp" then ReportQP(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "quest" then ReportQuest(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "cp" then ReportCP(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "gq" then ReportGQ(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "level" then ReportLevels(sc, t, active, approx, "level") elseif kind == "powerup" then ReportLevels(sc, t, active, approx, "pup") elseif kind == "bloot" then ReportBloot(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "tp" then ReportTP(sc, t, active, approx) elseif kind == "trains" then ReportTrains(sc, t, active, approx) end if sc.key ~= "all" or kind == "overview" then ReportScopeHint() end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W))
if channel then Report(channel, BuildGainsReportLine(kind, sc, t, active)) end end
function CmdRate(name, line, wildcards) local active = GetActiveTime()
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Current Rates") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50))
local r60 = CalculateXPRate(60) local r300 = CalculateXPRate(300) local r900 = CalculateXPRate(900) local uptime = GetMonitorUptime()
local function rate_color(secs) return uptime >= secs and "lime" or "red" end
ColourNote("silver", "", " XP/hr: ", rate_color(60), "", "1m:" .. short_value(r60) .. " ", rate_color(300), "", "5m:" .. short_value(r300) .. " ", rate_color(900), "", "15m:" .. short_value(r900))
if active > 60 then local sess_rate = math.floor((state.session.xp / active) * 3600) ColourNote("silver", "", " Session XP/hr: ", "white", "", short_value(sess_rate)) end
if active > 60 then local gold_rate = math.floor((state.session.gold / active) * 3600) ColourNote("silver", "", " Gold/hr: ", "yellow", "", comma_value(gold_rate)) end
if state.session.kills > 0 and active > 0 then local kpm = state.session.kills / (active / 60) ColourNote("silver", "", " Kills/min: ", "white", "", string.format("%.1f", kpm)) local avg_xp = state.session.xp / state.session.kills ColourNote("silver", "", " Avg XP/kill: ", "white", "", comma_value(math.floor(avg_xp))) end
if state.session.quests_done > 0 and active > 0 then local qph = state.session.quests_done / (active / 3600) local qp_rate = state.session.qp / (active / 3600) ColourNote("silver", "", " Quests/hr: ", "cyan", "", string.format("%.1f", qph)) ColourNote("silver", "", " QP/hr: ", "cyan", "", string.format("%.1f", qp_rate)) end
if state.session.qp > 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", " Total QP: ", "cyan", "", comma_value(state.session.qp)) end if state.session.gold > 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", " Total Gold: ", "yellow", "", comma_value(state.session.gold)) end
ColourNote("silver", "", " Levels: ", "white", "", tostring(state.session.levels), "silver", "", " Pups: ", "white", "", tostring(state.session.pups), "silver", "", " Active: ", "white", "", (FormatTime(active))) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) end
function CmdEstimate(name, line, wildcards) local est = GetEstimates() if not est then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Not enough data yet. Play for at least one session to generate estimates.") return end
local periods = {} local headers = {} if est.past_hour then periods[#periods+1] = est.past_hour headers[#headers+1] = "Hourly (Live)" end if est.hourly then periods[#periods+1] = est.hourly headers[#headers+1] = "Hourly (Hist)" end if est.daily then periods[#periods+1] = est.daily headers[#headers+1] = "Daily (Hist)" end if est.weekly then periods[#periods+1] = est.weekly headers[#headers+1] = "Weekly (Hist)" end if est.monthly then periods[#periods+1] = est.monthly headers[#headers+1] = "Monthly (Hist)" end if est.yearly then periods[#periods+1] = est.yearly headers[#headers+1] = "Yearly (Hist)" end if #periods == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Not enough data yet.") return end
local col_w = 16 local label_w = 10 local total_w = label_w + col_w * #periods
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", total_w)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Earning Estimates") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", total_w))
local hdr = string.format(" %-" .. label_w .. "s", "") for _, h in ipairs(headers) do hdr = hdr .. string.format("%-" .. col_w .. "s", h) end ColourNote("silver", "", hdr)
local function est_row(label, field, color) local has_data = false for _, p in ipairs(periods) do if p[field] and p[field] ~= 0 then has_data = true end end if not has_data then return end local args = {"silver", "", string.format(" %-" .. label_w .. "s", label)} for _, p in ipairs(periods) do args[#args+1] = color args[#args+1] = "" args[#args+1] = string.format("%-" .. col_w .. "s", comma_value(p[field] or 0)) end ColourNote(unpack(args)) end
est_row("XP", "xp", "lime") est_row("QP", "qp", "cyan") est_row("TP", "tp", "magenta") est_row("Gold", "gold", "yellow") est_row("Trains", "trains", "lime") est_row("Levels", "levels", "white") est_row("Pups", "pups", "white") est_row("Kills", "kills", "white")
local avg_active = GetAvgActiveHours(30) if avg_active and avg_active > 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", total_w)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" Avg active: ~%.1fh/day", avg_active)) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", total_w)) end
function CmdEventsMoved(name, line, wildcards) ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] cdt toggle and cdt channel are now one command: cdt events.") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt events <event> on|off, cdt events <event> channel <ch>.") ColourNote("silver", "", " gag_channel_echo moved to: cdt config gag_channel_echo [on|off]") end
function ShowEvents() local W = 78 ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Events - automatic reports") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-10s %-4s %-10s %-10s %s", "Event", "On", "Channel", "Number", "Reports")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) for _, evt in ipairs(EVENT_ORDER) do local e = EventSettings(evt) local on = e.on ~= false ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %-10s ", evt), on and "lime" or "red", "", string.format("%-4s ", on and "on" or "off"), "cyan", "", string.format("%-10s ", EventChannel(evt)), "yellow", "", string.format("%-10s ", EVENT_COUNTS[evt] and (e.count or "remort") or "-"), "silver", "", EVENT_INFO[evt]) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt events <event> on|off ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "report it or not") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt events <event> channel <ch> ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "echo (local), gt, ct, ft, spouse") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt events level <number> ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "remort, total, (aard)daily, (aard)weekly") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt events powerup <number> ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "remort, lifetime, (aard)daily, (aard)weekly") ColourNote("silver", "", " Channel command echo: ", config.gag_channel_echo and "lime" or "red", "", config.gag_channel_echo and "hidden" or "shown", "gray", "", " (cdt config gag_channel_echo)") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " See 'cdt help events'.") end
function CmdEvents(name, line, wildcards) local raw = ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if raw == "" then ShowEvents() return end local words = {} for w in raw:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end local evt = words[1]:lower() if evt == "pup" or evt == "powerups" then evt = "powerup" end if evt == "levels" then evt = "level" end if not EVENT_INFO[evt] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown event: " .. words[1]) ColourNote("silver", "", " Events: " .. table.concat(EVENT_ORDER, ", ")) return end local e = config.events[evt] local what = (words[2] or ""):lower()
if what == "" then local on = e.on ~= false ColourNote("white", "", " " .. evt, "silver", "", " - " .. EVENT_INFO[evt]) ColourNote("silver", "", " on: ", on and "lime" or "red", "", on and "on" or "off") ColourNote("silver", "", " channel: ", "cyan", "", EventChannel(evt)) local counts = EVENT_COUNTS[evt] if counts then ColourNote("silver", "", " number: ", "yellow", "", e.count or "remort") for _, mode in ipairs(counts.order) do ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-10s ", mode), "gray", "", counts[mode]) end end return end
if what == "on" or what == "off" then e.on = what == "on" state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wEvent @W" .. evt .. "@D: " .. (e.on and "@GON" or "@ROFF") .. "@D]") return end
if what == "channel" then local ch = words[3] if not ch or words[4] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt events " .. evt .. " channel <channel>") ShowChannelList(" ") return end local checked = CheckChannel(ch, "Usage: cdt events " .. evt .. " channel <channel>") if not checked then return end e.channel = checked state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wEvent @W" .. evt .. "@w goes to @C" .. e.channel .. "@D]") return end
local counts = EVENT_COUNTS[evt] if counts and IsCountMode(evt, what) and not words[3] then e.count = what state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wEvent @W" .. evt .. "@w shows @Y" .. what .. "@D: @w" .. counts[what] .. "@D]") return end
ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt events " .. evt .. " on|off | channel <channel>" .. (counts and (" | " .. table.concat(counts.order, "|")) or "")) end
-- Subclass, race and combo performance in two tables that fit 80 columns: powerups -- and levels (all, then solo and grouped rows), then gold and XP. rows come from -- class_stats, race_stats or combo_stats; label_of names each one. function RenderPerformance(title, rows, label_of, label_title) local function t(v) v = tonumber(v) or 0 return (v > 0 and v < 999999) and AvgTimeText(v) or "-" end local times, money = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local name = label_of(r) times[#times + 1] = {name = name, split = "all", pups = r.total_pups, pavg = t(r.avg_pup_secs), pbest = t(r.fastest_pup), lvls = r.total_levels, lavg = t(r.avg_lvl_secs), lbest = t(r.fastest_lvl)} if (tonumber(r.solo_pups) or 0) > 0 or (tonumber(r.solo_levels) or 0) > 0 then times[#times + 1] = {name = "", split = "solo", pups = r.solo_pups, pavg = t(r.avg_solo_pup_secs), pbest = t(r.fastest_solo_pup), lvls = r.solo_levels, lavg = t(r.avg_solo_lvl_secs), lbest = t(r.fastest_solo_lvl)} end if (tonumber(r.group_pups) or 0) > 0 or (tonumber(r.group_levels) or 0) > 0 then times[#times + 1] = {name = "", split = "group", pups = r.group_pups, pavg = t(r.avg_group_pup_secs), pbest = t(r.fastest_group_pup), lvls = r.group_levels, lavg = t(r.avg_group_lvl_secs), lbest = t(r.fastest_group_lvl)} end local function amount(v) v = tonumber(v) or 0 return math.abs(v) < 100000 and comma_value(math.floor(v)) or short_value(v) end money[#money + 1] = {name = name, gold = amount(r.total_gold), gsolo = amount(r.solo_gold), ggrp = amount(r.group_gold), xp = amount((tonumber(r.solo_xp) or 0) + (tonumber(r.group_xp) or 0)), xsolo = amount(r.solo_xp), xgrp = amount(r.group_xp)} end RenderTable({ {key = "name", title = label_title, w = 20, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "split", title = "", w = 5, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "pups", title = "Pups", w = 8, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "pavg", title = "Avg", w = 7, align = "r", color = "silver"}, {key = "pbest", title = "Best", w = 7, align = "r", color = "lime"}, {key = "lvls", title = "Levels", w = 6, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num", blank = "-"}, {key = "lavg", title = "Avg", w = 8, align = "r", color = "silver"}, {key = "lbest", title = "Best", w = 8, align = "r", color = "lime"}, }, times, {title = title .. ": powerups and levels", indent = 1}) RenderTable({ {key = "name", title = label_title, w = 20, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "gold", title = "Gold", w = 8, align = "r", color = "yellow"}, {key = "gsolo", title = "solo", w = 8, align = "r", color = "silver"}, {key = "ggrp", title = "group", w = 8, align = "r", color = "silver"}, {key = "xp", title = "XP", w = 9, align = "r", color = "lime"}, {key = "xsolo", title = "solo", w = 9, align = "r", color = "silver"}, {key = "xgrp", title = "group", w = 8, align = "r", color = "silver"}, }, money, {title = title .. ": gold and XP", indent = 1}) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Gold is mob, crumble and shared gold. Times are per powerup and per level.") end
function CmdClass(name, line, wildcards) if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available.") return end local rows = db_query("SELECT * FROM class_stats ORDER BY total_pups DESC") if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No subclass data yet.") return end RenderPerformance("Subclass performance", rows, function(r) return r.class or "?" end, "Subclass") end
-- cdt gains area quest [count|qp|time] [scope]: the areas quests send you to. -- Every quest has recorded its area all along; nothing reported it until now. -- Every area is listed, with a total line under them.
function AreaQuestReport(words) local sort, scope_words = "count", {} for _, w in ipairs(words) do local lw = w:lower() if lw == "count" or lw == "qp" or lw == "time" then sort = lw else scope_words[#scope_words + 1] = w end end local key = "all" if scope_words[1] then local k, c = ParseReportScope(scope_words, 1) if not k or c or scope_words[2] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains area quest [count|qp|time] [scope]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " count: where you're sent most. qp: best paying. time: quickest.") return end key = k end if quest_pending then FinalizeQuestRecord() end local sc = ReportScope(key) local rows = db_query([[SELECT mob_area AS area, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, AVG(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN qp END) AS base, SUM(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN totqp ELSE 0 END) AS qp, AVG(CASE WHEN failed = 0 AND duration > 0 THEN duration END) AS secs FROM quests WHERE mob_area <> '' AND ]] .. ScopeWhere(sc, "end_time") .. " GROUP BY mob_area") for _, r in ipairs(rows) do r.done, r.failed = tonumber(r.done) or 0, tonumber(r.failed) or 0 r.base, r.qp, r.secs = tonumber(r.base) or 0, tonumber(r.qp) or 0, tonumber(r.secs) or 0 end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if sort == "qp" and a.base ~= b.base then return a.base > b.base end if sort == "time" and a.secs ~= b.secs then if a.secs <= 0 then return false end if b.secs <= 0 then return true end return a.secs < b.secs end if a.done ~= b.done then return a.done > b.done end return a.area < b.area end)
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) local right = sc.label .. (sc.clock == "local" and " (your time)" or sc.clock == "aard" and " (US Eastern)" or "") local title = "Quest Areas, by " .. ({count = "how often", qp = "base QP", time = "time taken"})[sort] ColourNote("gold", "", " " .. title .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, REPORT_W - #title - #right - 1)), "white", "", right) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No quests with an area recorded in this span.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) return end -- Area names run long ("Andolor's Ocean Adventure Park" is 30), so they get the room. ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-33s%6s%8s%9s%10s%10s", "Area", "Done", "Failed", "Base QP", "Avg time", "QP")) local shown_done = 0 local shown_failed, shown_qp = 0, 0 for i = 1, #rows do local r = rows[i] ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" %-33s", r.area:sub(1, 32)), "white", "", string.format("%6s%8s%9s%10s%10s", comma_value(r.done), r.failed > 0 and comma_value(r.failed) or "-", r.done > 0 and string.format("%.1f", r.base) or "-", r.secs > 0 and AvgTimeText(r.secs) or "-", comma_value(r.qp))) shown_done = shown_done + r.done shown_failed = shown_failed + r.failed shown_qp = shown_qp + r.qp end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-33s%6s%8s%9s%10s%10s", string.format("%d area%s", #rows, #rows == 1 and "" or "s"), comma_value(shown_done), shown_failed > 0 and comma_value(shown_failed) or "-", "", "", comma_value(shown_qp))) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Base QP: the quest's own points, before tier, lucky, OPK and daily bonuses,") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " which don't depend on the area. QP: everything those quests paid.") local none = db_query_one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM quests WHERE mob_area = '' AND " .. ScopeWhere(sc, "end_time")) if none and (tonumber(none.n) or 0) > 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" %s quest%s had no area recorded.", comma_value(tonumber(none.n)), tonumber(none.n) == 1 and "" or "s")) end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Sort: cdt gains area quest qp | time. A scope narrows it: ... quest week") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) end
-- ============================================================================= -- cdt gains area bloot [scope]: bonus loot by area, then the mobs that dropped it. -- The area is the game's short area name; the mob is the corpse the bloot came -- from, recorded with every drop. -- ============================================================================= function AreaBlootReport(words) local key = "all" if words[1] then local k, c = ParseReportScope(words, 1) if not k or c or words[2] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains area bloot [scope]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " scope: all, session, day, week, month, year, aardday ... aardyear") return end key = k end FlushKillBuffer() local sc = ReportScope(key) local rank = {} for i, tier in ipairs(BLOOT_TIERS) do rank[tier] = i end
local areas, order, total = {}, {}, 0 for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT area, corpse, tier, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bloot_log WHERE " .. ScopeWhere(sc, "time") .. " GROUP BY area, corpse, tier")) do local n = tonumber(r.n) or 0 local rk = rank[r.tier] or 0 local aname = (r.area and r.area ~= "") and r.area or "(area not recorded)" local a = areas[aname] if not a then a = {name = aname, n = 0, best = 0, kills = 0, mobs = {}, list = {}} areas[aname] = a order[#order + 1] = a end a.n, total = a.n + n, total + n if rk > a.best then a.best = rk end local mname = r.corpse or "" local m = a.mobs[mname:lower()] if not m then m = {name = mname, n = 0, best = 0, tiers = {}, spellings = {}} a.mobs[mname:lower()] = m a.list[#a.list + 1] = m end -- The same mob can be spelled with a capital (it starts a sentence in some -- messages): the spelling with the most drops names it. m.spellings[mname] = (m.spellings[mname] or 0) + n if m.spellings[mname] > (m.spellings[m.name] or 0) then m.name = mname end m.n = m.n + n if rk > m.best then m.best = rk end m.tiers[rk] = (m.tiers[rk] or 0) + n end if #order > 0 then for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT area, COUNT(*) AS n FROM kills WHERE " .. ScopeWhere(sc, "time") .. " GROUP BY area")) do local a = areas[r.area or ""] if a then a.kills = tonumber(r.n) or 0 end end end local function by_drops(x, y) if x.n ~= y.n then return x.n > y.n end if x.best ~= y.best then return x.best > y.best end return x.name:lower() < y.name:lower() end table.sort(order, by_drops)
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) local right = sc.label .. (sc.clock == "local" and " (your time)" or sc.clock == "aard" and " (US Eastern)" or "") ColourNote("gold", "", " Bloot by Area" .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, REPORT_W - 14 - #right)), "white", "", right) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) if #order == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No bloot recorded in this span.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) return end -- name 35 | drops 6 | tiers 35 = 78. A mob's tiers run highest first, so the first -- is its best; an area's line gives its best tier and how often it drops. local NAME, DETAIL = 35, REPORT_W - 1 - 35 - 6 - 2 ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-" .. NAME .. "s%6s %s", "Area / mob", "Drops", "Tiers")) for i, a in ipairs(order) do if i > 1 then Note("") end ColourNote(unpack(CodedArgs("best " .. BlootCode(BLOOT_TIERS[a.best] or "?", true) .. (a.kills > 0 and (a.kills / a.n < 1.5 and ", 1 per kill" or (", 1 per " .. comma_value(math.floor(a.kills / a.n + 0.5)) .. " kills")) or ""), "dimgray", {"cyan", "", string.format(" %-" .. NAME .. "s", a.name:sub(1, NAME - 1)), "white", "", string.format("%6s ", comma_value(a.n))}))) table.sort(a.list, by_drops) for _, m in ipairs(a.list) do local parts, kinds = {}, 0 for _ in pairs(m.tiers) do kinds = kinds + 1 end for rk = #BLOOT_TIERS, 0, -1 do if m.tiers[rk] then parts[#parts + 1] = BlootCode(BLOOT_TIERS[rk] or "?", true) .. (kinds > 1 and (" " .. comma_value(m.tiers[rk])) or "") end end local lines, cur = {}, "" for _, piece in ipairs(parts) do local add = cur == "" and piece or (cur .. ", " .. piece) if CodedLen(add) > DETAIL and cur ~= "" then lines[#lines + 1] = cur .. ","; cur = piece else cur = add end end if cur ~= "" then lines[#lines + 1] = cur end local shown = m.name ~= "" and m.name or "(mob not recorded)" ColourNote(unpack(CodedArgs(lines[1] or "", "silver", {m.name ~= "" and "silver" or "dimgray", "", string.format(" %-" .. (NAME - 2) .. "s", shown:sub(1, NAME - 3)), "white", "", string.format("%6s ", comma_value(m.n))}))) for j = 2, #lines do ColourNote(unpack(CodedArgs(string.rep(" ", REPORT_W - DETAIL) .. lines[j], "silver"))) end end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %s drop%s in %d area%s", comma_value(total), total == 1 and "" or "s", #order, #order == 1 and "" or "s")) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Area: the game's short area name. Mob: the corpse the bloot came from.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Rate: drops against every kill recorded in that area.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) end
function CmdArea(name, line, wildcards) if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available.") return end do local words = {} for w in (wildcards[1] or ""):gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end local first = (words[1] or ""):lower() if first == "quest" or first == "quests" then table.remove(words, 1) AreaQuestReport(words) return end if first == "bloot" or first == "bloots" then table.remove(words, 1) AreaBlootReport(words) return end end
local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower() local filters = {} local labels = {} for word in arg:gmatch("%S+") do if word == "nodbl" then table.insert(filters, "double_active = 0") table.insert(labels, "no double") elseif word == "dbl" then table.insert(filters, "double_active = 1") table.insert(labels, "double only") else local found = false local cap = word:sub(1,1):upper() .. word:sub(2) local row = db_query_one("SELECT DISTINCT class FROM kills WHERE class != '' AND LOWER(class) = " .. fixsql(word) .. " LIMIT 1") if row then table.insert(filters, "class = " .. fixsql(row.class)) table.insert(labels, row.class) found = true end if not found then row = db_query_one("SELECT DISTINCT race FROM kills WHERE race != '' AND LOWER(race) = " .. fixsql(word) .. " LIMIT 1") if row then table.insert(filters, "race = " .. fixsql(row.race)) table.insert(labels, row.race) found = true end end if not found then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown filter: " .. word .. " (use: nodbl, dbl, or a subclass/race name)") return end end end local dbl_filter = "" local dbl_label = "" if #filters > 0 then dbl_filter = " AND " .. table.concat(filters, " AND ") dbl_label = ", " .. table.concat(labels, ", ") end
local kill_rows = db_query([[ SELECT area, grouped, SUM(xp + xp_rare + xp_bonus) as total_xp, COUNT(*) as kills FROM kills WHERE area != '']] .. dbl_filter .. [[ GROUP BY area, grouped ]])
local gold_rows = db_query([[ SELECT area, grouped, SUM(amount) as total_gold FROM gold_log WHERE area != '' AND source IN ('mob', 'crumble', 'shared') GROUP BY area, grouped ]]) local area_gold = {[0] = {}, [1] = {}} for _, row in ipairs(gold_rows) do local g = tonumber(row.grouped) or 0 area_gold[g][row.area] = tonumber(row.total_gold) or 0 end
local time_rows = db_query([[ SELECT area, time, grouped FROM kills WHERE area != '']] .. dbl_filter .. [[ ORDER BY grouped, area, time ]])
local AREA_GAP_THRESHOLD = 60 local BURST_BASE_SECS = 3 local active_time = {[0] = {}, [1] = {}} local prev_key, prev_time = nil, 0 for _, row in ipairs(time_rows) do local area = row.area local t = tonumber(row.time) or 0 local g = tonumber(row.grouped) or 0 local key = area .. "|" .. g if not active_time[g][area] then active_time[g][area] = 0 end local delta = BURST_BASE_SECS if key == prev_key and (t - prev_time) >= 0 and (t - prev_time) < AREA_GAP_THRESHOLD then delta = t - prev_time end active_time[g][area] = active_time[g][area] + delta prev_key = key prev_time = t end
local level_rows = db_query([[ SELECT area, type, grouped, COUNT(*) as total FROM levels WHERE area != '' GROUP BY area, type, grouped ]])
local data = {[0] = {}, [1] = {}} for _, row in ipairs(kill_rows) do local g = tonumber(row.grouped) or 0 local kills = tonumber(row.kills) or 0 local active = (active_time[g] or {})[row.area] or (kills * BURST_BASE_SECS) if not data[g][row.area] then data[g][row.area] = {xp = 0, gold = 0, kills = 0, active = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0} end local a = data[g][row.area] a.xp = a.xp + (tonumber(row.total_xp) or 0) a.gold = (area_gold[g] or {})[row.area] or 0 a.kills = a.kills + kills a.active = active end
for _, row in ipairs(level_rows) do local g = tonumber(row.grouped) or 0 local a = (data[g] or {})[row.area] if a then local total = tonumber(row.total) or 0 if row.type == "level" then a.levels = a.levels + total elseif row.type == "pup" then a.pups = a.pups + total end end end
local function build_sorted(tbl, min_kills) local sorted = {} for area, d in pairs(tbl) do if d.kills >= min_kills then local active = d.active table.insert(sorted, { area = area, xp = d.xp, gold = d.gold, kills = d.kills, xp_pm = active > 0 and (d.xp / active) * 60 or 0, gold_pm = active > 0 and (d.gold / active) * 60 or 0, kills_pm = active > 0 and (d.kills / active) * 60 or 0, levels = d.levels, pups = d.pups, }) end end table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.xp > b.xp end) return sorted end
local function print_table(title, color, sorted) local shown = {} for i = 1, math.min(20, #sorted) do shown[i] = sorted[i] end if #shown == 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote(color, "", " " .. title) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("silver", "", " No data.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) return end RenderTable({ {key = "area", title = "Area", w = 16, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "xp_pm", title = "XP/min", w = 8, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "gold_pm", title = "Gold/min", w = 8, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num"}, {key = "kills_pm", title = "K/min", w = 5, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "%.1f"}, {key = "kills", title = "Kills", w = 7, align = "r", color = "white", fmt = "num"}, {key = "xp", title = "XP", w = 8, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, {key = "gold", title = "Gold", w = 8, align = "r", color = "yellow", fmt = "num"}, {key = "levels", title = "Lvls", w = 5, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "num"}, {key = "pups", title = "Pups", w = 6, align = "r", color = "silver", fmt = "num"}, }, shown, {title = title, indent = 1}) end
local solo_sorted = build_sorted(data[0], 5) local group_sorted = build_sorted(data[1], 5)
print_table("Solo Area Rates (all-time, min 5 kills" .. dbl_label .. ")", "gold", solo_sorted) Note("") print_table("Group Area Rates (all-time, min 5 kills" .. dbl_label .. ")", "magenta", group_sorted) end
function CmdMilestone(name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.*)") if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available.") return end
if not arg or arg == "" then local rows = db_query("SELECT * FROM milestones ORDER BY achieved ASC, target_value ASC") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Milestones") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", " No milestones set. Auto-milestones generate once GMCP data arrives.") ColourNote("silver", "", " Add manually: cdt gains milestone add <type> <name> <target>") end local pending, achieved = {}, {} for _, m in ipairs(rows) do if m.achieved == 1 then table.insert(achieved, m) else table.insert(pending, m) end end if #pending > 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", " Pending:") for _, m in ipairs(pending) do local current = 0 if m.type == "qp" then current = state.player_totals.qp_earned or 0 elseif m.type == "pup" then current = state.player_totals.pups or 0 elseif m.type == "mob" then current = state.player_totals.mobs_killed or 0 end local pct = m.target_value > 0 and math.floor((current / m.target_value) * 100) or 0 if pct > 100 then pct = 100 end local auto_tag = m.auto_generated == 1 and " (auto)" or "" ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-25s %-6s target:%-10s progress:%d%%%s", m.name, m.type, comma_value(m.target_value), pct, auto_tag)) end end if #achieved > 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", " Achieved:") for _, m in ipairs(achieved) do local auto_tag = m.auto_generated == 1 and " (auto)" or "" ColourNote("lime", "", string.format(" %-25s %-6s target:%-10s %s%s", m.name, m.type, comma_value(m.target_value), ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", m.achieved_time), auto_tag)) end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Tracking: QP earned=" .. comma_value(state.player_totals.qp_earned or 0) .. " Pups=" .. comma_value(state.player_totals.pups or 0) .. " Mobs=" .. comma_value(state.player_totals.mobs_killed or 0)) return end
local subcmd = arg:match("^(%S+)")
if subcmd == "add" then local mtype, mname, target_str = arg:match("^add%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%d+)") if not mtype or not mname or not target_str then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains milestone add <type> <name> <target>") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Types: qp, pup, mob") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Example: cdt gains milestone add qp 2m_qp 2000000") return end local target = tonumber(target_str) or 0 if target <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Target must be a positive number.") return end if AddMilestone(mtype, mname, target, false) then EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@wMilestone added: @W%s @D(@w%s %s@D)]", mname, mtype, comma_value(target))) else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Milestone '" .. mname .. "' already exists.") end
elseif subcmd == "del" or subcmd == "delete" or subcmd == "rm" then local mname = arg:match("^%S+%s+(%S+)") if not mname then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains milestone del <name>") return end DeleteMilestone(mname) EchoLocal("@D[@wMilestone deleted: @W" .. mname .. "@D]")
elseif subcmd == "update" then local mname, new_target = arg:match("^update%s+(%S+)%s+(%d+)") if not mname or not new_target then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains milestone update <name> <new_target>") return end UpdateMilestone(mname, tonumber(new_target) or 0) EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@wMilestone updated: @W%s @wto %s@D]", mname, comma_value(tonumber(new_target) or 0)))
else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains milestone [add|del|update]") ColourNote("yellow", "", " cdt gains milestone : List all milestones") ColourNote("yellow", "", " cdt gains milestone add <type> <name> <target>") ColourNote("yellow", "", " cdt gains milestone del <name>") ColourNote("yellow", "", " cdt gains milestone update <name> <new_target>") end end
function CmdReset(name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if arg == "" then arg = "session" end
if arg == "session" then -- Close the running session properly, so its totals stay in the history. -- A double's tracked session closes with the session (it used to be dropped -- unsaved); DoubleResume starts the next one if the double runs on. if state.tracked_auto.active then FinalizeAutoTrack() end if game_session_started then EndSession() end -- The whole state is replaced here, before StartSession runs, so StartSession -- would read the meter's counts from the new, empty session and shift by -- nothing: a meter started mid-session then read 0 until the counts from -- before Start were passed. Read them from the old state instead. local meter_before = DmgMeterBeforeSessionReset() local new = default_state() new.current = state.current new.worth_last = state.worth_last state = new DmgMeterAfterSessionReset(meter_before) xp_events = {} kill_buffer = {} area_rates = {} monitor_start = Now() StartSession() DoubleResume() state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wSession reset.@D]") elseif arg == "db" then ColourNote("red", "", string.rep("=", 60)) ColourNote("red", "", " WARNING: This will permanently delete ALL tracked data!") ColourNote("red", "", " - All sessions, levels, powerups, kills") ColourNote("red", "", " - All quests, campaigns, global quests") ColourNote("red", "", " - All milestones, subclass/race/combo stats") ColourNote("red", "", " - All lifetime totals (QP earned, pups, mobs)") ColourNote("red", "", " - All earnings, gold log, daily totals, bloot log") ColourNote("red", "", " - All damage stats, player profiles, deaths, fight logs") ColourNote("red", "", " - All heals (on you, by you, by groupmates) and damage taken") ColourNote("red", "", " - Double XP log, GQ joins, pre-v3.9 damage estimates") ColourNote("silver", "", " Kept: snapshots, builds, damage type mappings, archives, settings.") ColourNote("red", "", string.rep("=", 60)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " To confirm, type: cdt reset db confirm") elseif arg == "db confirm" then if db then local tables = { "sessions", "levels", "kills", "quests", "campaigns", "gquests", "earnings", "gold_log", "daily_totals", "milestones", "class_stats", "race_stats", "combo_stats", "bloot_log", "player_totals", "tracked_sessions", "attack_stats", "damtype_stats", "area_combat_stats", "player_profiles", "player_attack_stats", "heal_log", "heal_given", "group_heals", "damage_taken", "deaths", "unfinished_fights", "double_xp_log", "gq_joins", "legacy_damage", "worth_trace", } for _, t in ipairs(tables) do if DbTableExists("main", t) then db_exec("DELETE FROM " .. t) end end db_exec("PRAGMA user_version=" .. DB_VERSION) db_exec("VACUUM") end state = default_state() xp_events = {} kill_buffer = {} area_rates = {} current_combat = nil group_combat = {} monitor_start = Now() StartSession() state_save() ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Database wiped. All data has been cleared.") ColourNote("silver", "", " Sending whois to re-seed lifetime totals...") RequestWhois() else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt reset [session|db]") ColourNote("silver", "", " session : Reset current session counters") ColourNote("silver", "", " db : Wipe entire database (requires confirmation)") end end
-- The line categories cdt gag hides. groupdmg, groupheal, allheal and enemydmg are -- removed by their handlers (allheal also has triggers for the heals naming no one); the others have hide-only triggers in cdt_gag_<category>. GAG_ORDER = {"xp", "gold", "loot", "sac", "tax", "groupdmg", "groupheal", "allheal", "enemydmg"} GAG_INFO = { xp = "XP lines: kill, rare kill, bonus and superhero honour XP", gold = "gold from corpses, crumble, sales, fence, haggle, splits", loot = "items you get from a corpse", sac = "the gold you're given for a sacrifice", tax = "clan tax taken from your gold", groupdmg = "groupmates' damage lines, and 'X is unaffected by' them", groupheal = "heals on you by players in your group only", allheal = "every heal on you (includes groupheal's)", enemydmg = "mobs hitting your groupmates (hits on you always show)", } GAG_TRIGGER_GROUPS = {xp = true, gold = true, loot = true, sac = true, tax = true, allheal = true} -- One of each pair at a time: allheal hides everything groupheal does, and more. GAG_EXCLUSIVE = {groupheal = "allheal", allheal = "groupheal"}
function ApplyGags() for cat in pairs(GAG_TRIGGER_GROUPS) do EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_gag_" .. cat, (config.gags and config.gags[cat]) and true or false) end end
-- ============================================================================= -- cdt heal report [player <name>] / cdt heal history all|self|player <name> [n] -- From heal_log: your own heals (self) and heals other players cast on you. -- ============================================================================= HEAL_HISTORY_DEFAULT, HEAL_HISTORY_MAX = 10, 100
local function HealUsage() ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage:") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt heal report [scope] [ch]", "silver", "", " your own heals") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt heal report player <name> [scope] [ch]", "silver", "", " <name>'s heals") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt heal report healedme [scope]", "silver", "", " everyone who healed you") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt heal report healedall [scope] [ch]", "silver", "", " groupmates' healing") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt heal history all|self|player <name> [n]", "silver", "", " the last n heals (10, max 100)") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " scope: all, session, day, week, month, year, aardday ... aardyear") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " ch: a channel (gt, ct ...) sends one line there instead of the table") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " castsonly: with healedall and a ch, only the casts, ranked") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " the damage meter's heals (healedme, healedall, healedgrp): cdt help dmg") end
-- The report's scope and channel from the words after the command: [scope] [channel]. -- nil when they aren't one; the channel is nil when none was given. local function HealScope(words, i) local chan if #words >= i and IsChannel(words[#words]) then chan = words[#words] local w = {} for j = 1, #words - 1 do w[j] = words[j] end words = w end if not words[i] then return ReportScope("all"), chan end local k, c, nxt = ParseReportScope(words, i) if not k or c or words[nxt or (i + 1)] then return nil end return ReportScope(k), chan end
local function HealHeader(title, sc) local W = REPORT_W local right = sc.label .. (sc.clock == "local" and " (your time)" or sc.clock == "aard" and " (US Eastern)" or "") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("gold", "", " " .. title .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, W - #title - #right - 1)), "white", "", right) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) end
function HealReport(where, title, empty, sc) sc = sc or ReportScope("all") where = where .. " AND " .. ScopeWhere(sc, "time") local rows = db_query("SELECT spell, SUM(amount) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(amount) AS mx FROM heal_log WHERE " .. where .. " GROUP BY spell ORDER BY h DESC") local W = REPORT_W HealHeader(title, sc) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " " .. empty) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) return end local total, casts = 0, 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do total = total + (tonumber(r.h) or 0) casts = casts + (tonumber(r.n) or 0) end local top = db_query_one("SELECT amount, time, spell FROM heal_log WHERE " .. where .. " ORDER BY amount DESC, time DESC LIMIT 1") or {} local function row(label, value, note) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", label), "white", "", string.format("%12s", value), "dimgray", "", note and (" " .. note) or "") end row("Total healed", comma_value(total)) row("Casts", comma_value(casts)) row("Average per cast", comma_value(casts > 0 and math.floor(total / casts + 0.5) or 0)) row("Highest heal", comma_value(tonumber(top.amount) or 0), top.time and ShowDate("%m/%d %H:%M", tonumber(top.time) or 0) or nil) -- Normally there is one spell (incomplete healing names its caster; no other heal -- does), so it is named here, and a table by spell appears only if there are more. if #rows == 1 then ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Spell"), "cyan", "", string.format("%12s", rows[1].spell or "?")) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) return end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-30s%12s%8s%10s%10s%7s", "Spell", "Healed", "Casts", "Average", "Highest", "Share")) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local h, c = tonumber(r.h) or 0, tonumber(r.n) or 0 ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" %-30s", (r.spell or "?"):sub(1, 29)), "white", "", string.format("%12s%8s%10s%10s", comma_value(h), comma_value(c), comma_value(c > 0 and math.floor(h / c + 0.5) or 0), comma_value(tonumber(r.mx) or 0)), "silver", "", string.format("%7s", SharePct(h, total))) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) end
-- cdt heal report healedme: everyone who healed you, most first, you included. -- Each groupmate's heals that didn't land on you, from group_heals: casts seen in their -- mana, less their cast heals on you, and scrolls read on others. local function GroupHealTotals(sc, healer) local by, order = {}, {} if not DbTableExists("main", "group_heals") then return by, order end local where = ScopeWhere(sc, "time") .. (healer and (" AND healer = " .. fixsql(healer) .. " COLLATE NOCASE") or "") for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT MAX(healer) AS healer, source, spell, SUM(heals) AS n, SUM(amount) AS hp " .. "FROM group_heals WHERE " .. where .. " GROUP BY healer COLLATE NOCASE, source, spell")) do local key = (r.healer or ""):lower() local e = by[key] if not e then e = {name = r.healer, casts = 0, on_you = 0, scroll = 0, scroll_hp = 0, regen = 0, regen_hp = 0} by[key] = e; order[#order + 1] = e end if r.source == "cast" and r.spell == "regeneration" then e.regen, e.regen_hp = e.regen + (tonumber(r.n) or 0), e.regen_hp + (tonumber(r.hp) or 0) elseif r.source == "cast" then e.casts = e.casts + (tonumber(r.n) or 0) else e.scroll, e.scroll_hp = e.scroll + (tonumber(r.n) or 0), e.scroll_hp + (tonumber(r.hp) or 0) end end -- Who their casts most likely healed (a guess from hp jumps), and their scrolls' targets. local me = (state.current.name or ""):lower() for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT MAX(healer) AS healer, MAX(target) AS target, source, SUM(heals) AS n " .. "FROM group_heals WHERE " .. where .. " GROUP BY healer COLLATE NOCASE, target COLLATE NOCASE, source")) do local e = by[(r.healer or ""):lower()] if e then local tname = r.target or "" if tname == "" then tname = "?" elseif tname:lower() == me then tname = "you" elseif tname:lower() == (r.healer or ""):lower() then tname = "self" end e.targets = e.targets or {} e.targets[tname] = (e.targets[tname] or 0) + (tonumber(r.n) or 0) end end for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT MAX(healer) AS healer, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heal_log WHERE self = 0 AND " .. "spell = 'incomplete healing' AND " .. where .. " GROUP BY healer COLLATE NOCASE")) do local e = by[(r.healer or ""):lower()] if e then e.on_you = tonumber(r.n) or 0 end end for _, e in ipairs(order) do e.others = math.max(0, e.casts - e.on_you) e.size, e.size_kind = HealerSize(e.name) e.size_text = HealerSizeText(e.name) e.healed = e.others * e.size + e.scroll_hp + e.regen_hp end table.sort(order, function(a, b) if a.healed ~= b.healed then return a.healed > b.healed end return a.casts > b.casts end) return by, order end
-- "Bob 40, Alice 12, ? 5": a healer's likely targets, most first, to fit width. local function HealTargetsText(e, width) local list = {} for tname, c in pairs(e.targets or {}) do list[#list + 1] = {tname, c} end table.sort(list, function(a, b) if (a[1] == "?") ~= (b[1] == "?") then return b[1] == "?" end if a[2] ~= b[2] then return a[2] > b[2] end return a[1] < b[1] end) local out = "" for i, t in ipairs(list) do local piece = t[1] .. " " .. comma_value(t[2]) local add = out == "" and piece or (out .. ", " .. piece) -- leave room for ", ..." unless this is the last name if #add > (i < #list and width - 5 or width) then return out .. (out ~= "" and ", ..." or "...") end out = add end return out end
local GROUP_HEAL_NOTES = { " ~ Casts: incomplete healing, their mana dropping by 950 (712 or 713 for an", " Eldar) in the group data, or near it once they're known to heal. An", " estimate: some are missed, and wasted heals count. Others~: casts less their", " heals on you. Size: their heal on you; ~ from the hp jumps their casts", " caused; 3,400? assumed. Regen~: regeneration on others, their mana dropping", " by 1,100 (825), each the hp gain of who it likely healed (4,600 if none).", " Scroll: scrolls read on others in your room, each its target's hp gain", " (3,400 / 4,600 a heal when it can't be measured). Healed~: others~ x size,", " plus regeneration and scroll heals. Likely healed: who each cast went to,", " from the biggest hp jump in the healer's room in the same update (right", " about 3 times in 4; ? when no one's hp jumped).", }
function GroupHealReport(sc) local W = REPORT_W HealHeader("Groupmates' healing on others", sc) local _, order = GroupHealTotals(sc) if #order == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No groupmates' healing recorded in this span.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) return end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-15s%8s%7s%8s%8s%8s%7s%12s", "Healer", "Casts~", "On you", "Others~", "Size", "Regen~", "Scroll", "Healed~")) local t = {casts = 0, on_you = 0, others = 0, regen = 0, scroll = 0, healed = 0} for _, e in ipairs(order) do ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" %-15s", e.name:sub(1, 14)), "white", "", string.format("%8s%7s%8s%8s%8s%7s%12s", comma_value(e.casts), comma_value(e.on_you), comma_value(e.others), e.size_text, comma_value(e.regen), comma_value(e.scroll), comma_value(e.healed))) for k in pairs(t) do t[k] = t[k] + (e[k] or 0) end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-15s%8s%7s%8s%8s%8s%7s%12s", "Total", comma_value(t.casts), comma_value(t.on_you), comma_value(t.others), "", comma_value(t.regen), comma_value(t.scroll), comma_value(t.healed))) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Likely healed") for _, e in ipairs(order) do if e.targets then ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" %-16s", e.name:sub(1, 15)), "silver", "", HealTargetsText(e, REPORT_W - 18)) end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) for _, l in ipairs(GROUP_HEAL_NOTES) do ColourNote("dimgray", "", l) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) end
-- After cdt heal report player <name>: their heals that didn't land on you. function GroupHealPlayer(name, sc) local by = GroupHealTotals(sc, name) local e = by[(name or ""):lower()] if not e then return end local function row(label, value, note) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", label), "white", "", string.format("%12s", value), "dimgray", "", note and (" " .. note) or "") end ColourNote("gold", "", " Their heals on others (from the group data)") row("Casts~", comma_value(e.casts), comma_value(e.on_you) .. " of them on you") row("Casts on others~", comma_value(e.others), e.size_text .. " a heal" .. (e.size_kind == "est" and " (from hp jumps)" or e.size_kind == "assumed" and " (assumed)" or "")) if e.regen > 0 then row("Regeneration on others~", comma_value(e.regen), comma_value(e.regen_hp) .. " hp (their targets' hp gain)") end if e.scroll > 0 then row("Scroll heals on others", comma_value(e.scroll), comma_value(e.scroll_hp) .. " hp (their targets' hp gain)") end row("Healed others~", comma_value(e.healed)) if e.targets then ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-22s", "Likely healed"), "white", "", " " .. HealTargetsText(e, REPORT_W - 24)) end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " ~ estimated from their mana: cdt heal report healedall explains it.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", REPORT_W)) end
-- ============================================================================= -- cdt heal report ... <channel>: each report as one line, for a channel or a cdt -- listen query. Names, never "you": whoever reads it isn't you. -- ============================================================================= local function HealCasts(c) return comma_value(c) .. (c == 1 and " cast" or " casts") end
-- A healer's heals in the span, by player healed. Exact on you, from your heal lines -- (with average and highest). Their other casts, seen in their mana, by the target -- guessed for each (the biggest hp jump in their room), times their heal size: ~, -- estimated; scroll lines by their own target, exact. Casts with no guess, and any -- difference from their cast count, are "unknown". Biggest first. local function HealBreakdown(name, sc) local me_name = state.current.name or "me" local me, key = me_name:lower(), (name or ""):lower() local where = ScopeWhere(sc, "time") local mine = db_query_one("SELECT SUM(amount) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(amount) AS mx, " .. "SUM(CASE WHEN spell = 'incomplete healing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cast_n FROM heal_log WHERE self = 0 AND healer = " .. fixsql(name) .. " COLLATE NOCASE AND " .. where) or {} local on_you_casts = tonumber(mine.cast_n) or 0 local list, by = {}, {} local function entry(tname) local k = tname:lower() if not by[k] then by[k] = {name = tname, c = 0, sc = 0, shp = 0, rc = 0, rhp = 0, hp = 0, casts = 0}; list[#list + 1] = by[k] end return by[k] end if (tonumber(mine.n) or 0) > 0 then local e = entry(me_name) e.hp, e.casts, e.exact = tonumber(mine.h) or 0, tonumber(mine.n) or 0, true e.avg = e.casts > 0 and e.hp / e.casts or 0 e.high = tonumber(mine.mx) or 0 end local total_casts, guessed = 0, 0 if DbTableExists("main", "group_heals") then for _, r in ipairs(db_query("SELECT MAX(target) AS target, source, spell, SUM(heals) AS n, SUM(amount) AS hp " .. "FROM group_heals WHERE healer = " .. fixsql(name) .. " COLLATE NOCASE AND " .. where .. " GROUP BY target COLLATE NOCASE, source, spell")) do local t, cnt = r.target or "", tonumber(r.n) or 0 if r.source == "cast" and r.spell == "regeneration" then local e = entry(t ~= "" and t or "unknown") e.rc, e.rhp = e.rc + cnt, e.rhp + (tonumber(r.hp) or 0) elseif r.source == "cast" then total_casts = total_casts + cnt if t ~= "" and t:lower() ~= me then local e = entry(t); e.c = e.c + cnt; guessed = guessed + cnt end elseif t:lower() ~= me then local e = entry(t ~= "" and t or "unknown") e.sc, e.shp = e.sc + cnt, e.shp + (tonumber(r.hp) or 0) end end end -- Their casts not on you, less those put on someone: unknown. Guessed too many -- (some of their casts on you were put on others): taken off the smallest first. local left = math.max(0, total_casts - on_you_casts) - guessed if left > 0 then local e = entry("unknown"); e.c = e.c + left end local size = HealerSize(name) for _, e in ipairs(list) do if not e.exact then e.hp, e.casts, e.est = e.c * size + e.shp + e.rhp, e.c + e.sc + e.rc, e.c + e.sc + e.rc > 0 end end if left < 0 then table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.c < b.c end) for _, e in ipairs(list) do if left >= 0 then break end local take = math.min(e.c, -left) e.c, left = e.c - take, left + take e.hp, e.casts, e.est = e.c * size + e.shp + e.rhp, e.c + e.sc + e.rc, e.c + e.sc + e.rc > 0 end end local out, total, casts, est = {}, 0, 0, false for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e.hp > 0 or e.casts > 0 then out[#out + 1] = e total, casts, est = total + e.hp, casts + e.casts, est or e.est end end table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.hp > b.hp end) return out, total, casts, est end
-- "Cirrus 95.2k (20, avg 4.8k, high 4.9k), Alice ~47.6k (10), unknown ~4.8k (1)" local function HealBreakdownText(list) local parts = {} for _, e in ipairs(list) do local detail = comma_value(e.casts) if e.exact then detail = detail .. ", avg " .. short_value(math.floor(e.avg + 0.5)) .. ", high " .. short_value(e.high) end parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@W%s @M%s%s @D(@w%s@D)", e.name, e.est and "~" or "", short_value(math.floor(e.hp)), detail) end return table.concat(parts, "@D, ") end
local function HealLineHead(title, sc) return string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@M%s @D| @w%s@D] ", title, sc.line or sc.label or "") end
-- cdt heal report [scope] <channel>: your own heals on yourself. local function HealLineOwn(sc, channel) local me = state.current.name or "me" local r = db_query_one("SELECT SUM(amount) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(amount) AS mx FROM heal_log WHERE self = 1 AND " .. ScopeWhere(sc, "time")) or {} local h, c = tonumber(r.h) or 0, tonumber(r.n) or 0 local head = HealLineHead(me .. "'s heals on " .. me, sc) if c == 0 then Report(channel, head .. "@wnone") return end Report(channel, head .. string.format("@M%s @whealed@D, @w%s@D, @wavg @M%s@D, @whigh @M%s", short_value(h), HealCasts(c), short_value(math.floor(h / c + 0.5)), short_value(tonumber(r.mx) or 0))) end
-- A healer's name as recorded (a cdt listen query arrives lowercased). local function HealerProperName(name) for _, t in ipairs({{"heal_log", "self = 0 AND "}, {"group_heals", ""}}) do if DbTableExists("main", t[1]) then local r = db_query_one("SELECT healer FROM " .. t[1] .. " WHERE " .. t[2] .. "healer = " .. fixsql(name) .. " COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 1") if r and r.healer and r.healer ~= "" then return r.healer end end end return name end
-- cdt heal report player <name> [scope] <channel>: their heals, by player healed. local function HealLinePlayer(name, sc, channel) name = HealerProperName(name) local list, total, casts, est = HealBreakdown(name, sc) local head = HealLineHead(name .. "'s heals", sc) if #list == 0 then Report(channel, head .. "@wnone") return end Report(channel, head .. string.format("@M%s%s @win %s: ", est and "~" or "", short_value(math.floor(total)), HealCasts(casts)) .. HealBreakdownText(list)) end
-- cdt heal report player <name> [scope] <channel>: their heals in two totals, on -- themselves and on everyone else. Over a long span who each was doesn't fit a line. local function HealLineSelfOthers(name, sc, channel) name = HealerProperName(name) local list, total, casts, est = HealBreakdown(name, sc) local head = HealLineHead(name .. "'s heals", sc) if #list == 0 then Report(channel, head .. "@wnone") return end local me, them = {hp = 0, casts = 0}, {hp = 0, casts = 0} for _, e in ipairs(list) do local p = e.name:lower() == name:lower() and me or them p.hp, p.casts, p.est = p.hp + e.hp, p.casts + e.casts, p.est or e.est end local parts = {} for _, l in ipairs({{me, "on self"}, {them, "on others"}}) do if l[1].hp > 0 or l[1].casts > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@M%s%s @w%s @D(@w%s@D)", l[1].est and "~" or "", short_value(math.floor(l[1].hp)), l[2], comma_value(l[1].casts)) end end Report(channel, head .. string.format("@M%s%s @win %s: ", est and "~" or "", short_value(math.floor(total)), HealCasts(casts)) .. table.concat(parts, "@D, ")) end
-- cdt heal report healedall [scope] <channel>: each groupmate's total healed and casts. -- casts_only: just each one's number of casts, ranked by casts. local function HealLineAll(sc, channel, casts_only) local _, order = GroupHealTotals(sc) local head = HealLineHead(casts_only and "Groupmates' heal casts" or "Groupmates' healing", sc) local rows = {} for _, g in ipairs(order) do local list, total, casts, est = HealBreakdown(g.name, sc) if #list > 0 and (not casts_only or casts > 0) then rows[#rows + 1] = {name = g.name, total = total, casts = casts, est = est} end end if #rows == 0 then Report(channel, head .. "@wnone") return end if casts_only then table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.casts ~= b.casts then return a.casts > b.casts end if a.total ~= b.total then return a.total > b.total end return a.name < b.name end) else table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.total > b.total end) end local parts = {} for i, r in ipairs(rows) do if casts_only then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@w%d.@W%s @M%s%s", i, r.name, r.est and "~" or "", HealCasts(r.casts)) else parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@w%d.@W%s @M%s%s @D(@w%s@D)", i, r.name, r.est and "~" or "", short_value(math.floor(r.total)), HealCasts(r.casts)) end end Report(channel, head .. table.concat(parts, " ")) end
-- The span the damage meter has counted, as a report scope: from Start (or Reset) to -- now, or to the pause. nil when it isn't counting. function DmgMeterScope() if not (dmg_meter.tracking or dmg_meter.stopped) or (dmg_meter.start_time or 0) <= 0 then return nil end local sc = {key = "meter", start = dmg_meter.start_time, line = "meter " .. FormatMeterTime(MeterElapsed())} if dmg_meter.stopped and (dmg_meter.stop_time or 0) > 0 then sc.stop = dmg_meter.stop_time + 1 end return sc end
