-- cdt heal report, from the words from "report" on. ask_channel: a cdt listen query, -- answered there, in one line, whatever channel the words name. -- [scope], player <name> [scope], healedall [scope]: a table on your screen; with -- a channel, one line over the scope (all time unless one is given). -- healedme [scope]: who healed you, a table on your screen only. -- Over cdt listen only player <name>, over the meter's count: their heals broken down -- by player healed. (The meter's own heal lines are cdt dmg meter report healedall -- and healedgrp.) function HealReportCommand(words, ask_channel) -- castsonly, anywhere after report: only the casts, for healedall. local casts_only = false do local rest = {words[1]} for i = 2, #words do if words[i]:lower() == "castsonly" then casts_only = true else rest[#rest + 1] = words[i] end end words = rest end local function usage() if ask_channel then Report(ask_channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wUsage: @Ccdt heal report player <name>") else HealUsage() end end local what = (words[2] or ""):lower() local sc, chan if what == "player" and words[3] then sc, chan = HealScope(words, 4) elseif what == "healedme" or what == "healedall" then sc, chan = HealScope(words, 3) elseif what == "player" then usage() return else what = "own" sc, chan = HealScope(words, 2) end if not sc then usage() return end if casts_only and what ~= "healedall" then usage() return end if ask_channel then if what ~= "player" then usage() return end local msc = DmgMeterScope() if not msc then Report(ask_channel, "@D[@CCDT@D] @wNo heals to report: the damage meter isn't running.") return end HealLinePlayer(words[3], msc, ask_channel) return end local channel if chan then channel = CheckChannel(chan) if not channel then return end end -- Who healed you stays on your screen. if what == "healedme" and channel then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] cdt heal report healedme is a table on your screen only; nothing was sent.") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " To a channel: cdt heal report [player <name>|healedall] ... <channel>") return end if channel then if what == "player" then HealLineSelfOthers(words[3], sc, channel) elseif what == "healedall" then HealLineAll(sc, channel, casts_only) else HealLineOwn(sc, channel) end return end if casts_only then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] castsonly is for the one-line reports: add a channel (or echo)") return end if what == "player" then HealReport(string.format("self = 0 AND healer = %s COLLATE NOCASE", fixsql(words[3])), "Heals on you by " .. words[3], "No heals on you by " .. words[3] .. " in this span.", sc) GroupHealPlayer(words[3], sc) elseif what == "healedme" then HealPlayers(sc) elseif what == "healedall" then GroupHealReport(sc) else HealReport("self = 1", "Your own heals", "No heals of your own in this span.", sc) end end
function HealPlayers(sc) local rows = db_query("SELECT self, MAX(healer) AS healer, SUM(amount) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(amount) AS mx " .. "FROM heal_log WHERE " .. ScopeWhere(sc, "time") .. " GROUP BY self, CASE WHEN self = 1 THEN '' ELSE healer COLLATE NOCASE END ORDER BY h DESC") local W = REPORT_W HealHeader("Who healed you", sc) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No heals recorded in this span.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) return end local total, casts = 0, 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do total = total + (tonumber(r.h) or 0) casts = casts + (tonumber(r.n) or 0) end ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-24s%14s%8s%10s%10s%8s", "Healer", "Healed", "Casts", "Average", "Highest", "Share")) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local h, c = tonumber(r.h) or 0, tonumber(r.n) or 0 local who = (tonumber(r.self) or 0) == 1 and "(you)" or (r.healer or "?") ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" %-24s", who:sub(1, 23)), "white", "", string.format("%14s%8s%10s%10s", comma_value(h), comma_value(c), comma_value(c > 0 and math.floor(h / c + 0.5) or 0), comma_value(tonumber(r.mx) or 0)), "silver", "", string.format("%8s", SharePct(h, total))) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-24s%14s%8s", "Total", comma_value(total), comma_value(casts))) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) end
function HealHistory(where, label, n) local grid = {} for _, r in ipairs(db_query(string.format("SELECT time, healer, self, spell, amount FROM heal_log WHERE %s " .. "ORDER BY time DESC, heal_id DESC LIMIT %d", where, n))) do grid[#grid + 1] = {when = HistoryWhen(r.time), healer = (tonumber(r.self) or 0) == 1 and "you" or (r.healer or "?"), spell = r.spell or "?", amount = tonumber(r.amount) or 0} end HistoryShow(label, { {key = "when", title = "Time", w = 14, align = "l", color = "gray"}, {key = "healer", title = "Healer", w = 16, align = "l", color = "cyan"}, {key = "spell", title = "Spell", w = 30, align = "l", color = "silver"}, {key = "amount", title = "Healed", w = 12, align = "r", color = "lime", fmt = "num"}, }, grid) end
function CmdHeal(name, line, wildcards) if not db or not DbTableExists("main", "heal_log") then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available.") return end local words = {} for w in ((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end local sub = (words[1] or ""):lower()
if sub == "report" then HealReportCommand(words) return end
if sub == "history" then local who = (words[2] or ""):lower() local where, label, count_at if who == "all" then where, label, count_at = "1 = 1", "heal", 3 elseif who == "self" then where, label, count_at = "self = 1", "self heal", 3 elseif who == "player" and words[3] then where = string.format("self = 0 AND healer = %s COLLATE NOCASE", fixsql(words[3])) label, count_at = words[3] .. " heal", 4 else HealUsage() return end local count = HEAL_HISTORY_DEFAULT if words[count_at] then count = tonumber(words[count_at]:match("^(%d+)$") or "") if not count or count < 1 or words[count_at + 1] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] The count must be a whole number from 1 to " .. HEAL_HISTORY_MAX .. ".") return end if count > HEAL_HISTORY_MAX then ColourNote("dimgray", "", "[CDT] Showing the most recent " .. HEAL_HISTORY_MAX .. " (the most it shows).") count = HEAL_HISTORY_MAX end end HealHistory(where, label, count) return end
HealUsage() end
function CmdGag(name, line, wildcards) local arg = ((wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(%S*)") or ""):lower() if arg == "" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Gag Settings") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) for _, cat in ipairs(GAG_ORDER) do local on = config.gags[cat] ColourNote("yellow", "", string.format(" %-9s ", cat), on and "red" or "lime", "", string.format("%-7s", on and "hidden" or "shown"), "silver", "", GAG_INFO[cat]) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gag <category> hides or shows it. Hidden lines are still tracked.") return end
if config.gags[arg] ~= nil then config.gags[arg] = not config.gags[arg] local other = GAG_EXCLUSIVE[arg] local switched = other and config.gags[arg] and config.gags[other] if switched then config.gags[other] = false end ApplyGags() state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wGag @W" .. arg .. "@D: " .. (config.gags[arg] and "@Rhidden" or "@Gshown") .. "@D]") if switched then EchoLocal("@D[@wGag @W" .. other .. "@D: @Gshown@D -- only one of groupheal and allheal can be on]") end else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown gag category: " .. arg) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Valid: " .. table.concat(GAG_ORDER, ", ")) end end
-- cdt config channels [add|remove] <name>: the channels a report may be sent to. -- The built-in list is short on purpose, so a mistyped scope can't become a game -- command; anything else you use goes here. function CmdConfigChannels(val) -- The name keeps the case it was typed in: it is sent to the game verbatim. local verb, name = (val or ""):match("^(%S*)%s*(.-)%s*$") verb, name = (verb or ""):lower(), (name or "") local extra = ExtraChannels()
if verb == "" or verb == "list" then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Channels a report can be sent to:") ColourNote("white", "", " built in: ", "cyan", "", CHANNEL_LIST) local names = {} for _, c in pairs(extra) do names[#names + 1] = c end table.sort(names) if #names > 0 then ColourNote("white", "", " yours: ", "cyan", "", table.concat(names, " ")) else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " You haven't added any.") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config channels add <name> | remove <name>") return end
if verb ~= "add" and verb ~= "remove" and verb ~= "rm" and verb ~= "del" then -- "cdt config channels ct" reads as adding it name, verb = verb, "add" end if name == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt config channels add <name> | remove <name>") return end
if verb == "add" then if CHANNELS[name:lower()] then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] " .. name .. " is already one of the built-in channels.") return end -- A channel is a command word, and it must not be a scope: that is what the -- check is for ("cdt gains report qp daily" used to reach the game). if not name:match("^%a[%w_]*$") or #name > 20 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] A channel is one word of letters or digits, up to 20.") return end if REPORT_SCOPES[name:lower()] or REPORT_SCOPE_ALIASES[name:lower()] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. name .. " is a report scope, so it can't also be a channel.") return end if REPORT_TYPES[name:lower()] or REPORT_TYPE_ALIASES[name:lower()] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. name .. " is a report type, so it can't also be a channel.") return end if extra[name:lower()] then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] " .. extra[name:lower()] .. " is already on your list.") return end extra[name:lower()] = name SetExtraChannels(extra) state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wChannel @C" .. name .. "@w added. Reports can go there now.@D]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Type it in any case; the game gets it as " .. name .. ".") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Nothing checks that the game has a " .. name .. " channel; try it once.") return end
if not extra[name:lower()] then if CHANNELS[name:lower()] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. name .. " is built in and can't be removed.") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. name .. " isn't on your list.") end return end local gone = extra[name:lower()] extra[name:lower()] = nil SetExtraChannels(extra) state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wChannel @C" .. gone .. "@w removed.@D]") end
function CmdConfig(name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.*)") if not arg or arg == "" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Configuration") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Current subclass: ", "cyan", "", state.current.subclass or "?") ColourNote("silver", "", " Current race: ", "cyan", "", state.current.race or "?") ColourNote("silver", "", " Level: ", "white", "", tostring(state.current.level), "silver", "", " Tier: ", "white", "", tostring(state.current.tier), "silver", "", " Remort: ", "white", "", tostring(state.current.remort)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Area: ", "cyan", "", state.current.area or "?") ColourNote("silver", "", " Lifetime QP: ", "cyan", "", comma_value(state.player_totals.qp_earned or 0), "silver", "", " Pups: ", "cyan", "", comma_value(state.player_totals.pups or 0), "silver", "", " Mobs: ", "cyan", "", comma_value(state.player_totals.mobs_killed or 0)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Double XP: ", state.current.double_active and "lime" or "red", "", state.current.double_active and "ACTIVE" or "inactive") ColourNote("silver", "", " Debug: ", config.debug_mode and "lime" or "red", "", config.debug_mode and "ON" or "OFF") ColourNote("orange", "", " Settings") ColourNote("silver", "", " gag_channel_echo: ", config.gag_channel_echo and "lime" or "red", "", config.gag_channel_echo and "on" or "off", "gray", "", " (hide the command when a report goes to a channel)") ColourNote("silver", "", " update_notice: ", config.update_notice ~= false and "lime" or "red", "", config.update_notice ~= false and "on" or "off", "gray", "", " (say when a newer plugin file is on disk)") ColourNote("silver", "", " update_check: ", config.update_check and "lime" or "red", "", config.update_check and "on" or "off", "gray", "", " (look for a newer public version at load)") local zone = TZLabel() ColourNote("silver", "", " timezone: ", "cyan", "", zone or ("this computer's (" .. os.date("%Z") .. ")"), "gray", "", " (times and dates)") local ws = WeekStartName() ColourNote("silver", "", " weeklystart: ", "cyan", "", ws:sub(1, 1):upper() .. ws:sub(2), "gray", "", " (first day of the week for 'weekly' counts)") ColourNote("silver", "", " dateformat: ", "cyan", "", DateFormat().label, "gray", "", " (today reads " .. ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d") .. ")") local extra = {} for _, c in pairs(ExtraChannels()) do extra[#extra + 1] = c end table.sort(extra) ColourNote("silver", "", " channels: ", "cyan", "", #extra > 0 and table.concat(extra, " ") or "the built-in ones", "gray", "", " (where reports can be sent)") ColourNote("silver", "", " Set elsewhere") ColourNote("gray", "", " automatic reports cdt events") ColourNote("gray", "", " hidden game lines cdt gag") ColourNote("gray", "", " channel queries cdt listen") ColourNote("gray", "", " the gains meter cdt gains meter") ColourNote("gray", "", " archive folder cdt archive path") ColourNote("gray", "", " export folder cdt export path") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 50)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config gag_channel_echo [on|off]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config update_notice [on|off]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config update_check [on|off]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config timezone [UTC-8|+5:30|0|machine]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config weeklystart <monday|tuesday|...|sunday>") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config dateformat <M/D/Y|D/M/Y|Y/M/D>") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config channels [add|remove <name>]") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " See 'cdt help config'.") return end
local key, val = arg:lower():match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)%s*$") if key == "channels" or key == "channel" then -- from the untouched text: a channel of your own keeps the case you typed CmdConfigChannels((arg:match("^%S+%s*(.-)%s*$")) or "") return end if key == "timezone" then CmdTimezone(name, line, {val}) return end if key == "dateformat" then if val == "" then local f = DateFormat() ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Date format: ", "cyan", "", f.label, "silver", "", " - today reads " .. ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d") .. ".") ColourNote("silver", "", " Type dates as " .. f.typed .. ", e.g. " .. f.example .. ".") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config dateformat M/D/Y | D/M/Y | Y/M/D") return end local order = val:gsub("[^%a]", "") if order == "mmddyyyy" then order = "mdy" elseif order == "ddmmyyyy" then order = "dmy" elseif order == "yyyymmdd" then order = "ymd" end if not DATE_FORMATS[order] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] '" .. val .. "' is not a date format. Use M/D/Y, D/M/Y or Y/M/D.") return end config.date_format = order state_save() local f = DateFormat() EchoLocal("@D[@wDate format @C" .. f.label .. "@D: @wtype @W" .. f.typed .. "@w, e.g. @W" .. f.example .. "@w; today reads @W" .. ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d") .. "@D]") return end if key == "weeklystart" then if val == "" then local ws = WeekStartName() ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Weekly counts start on ", "cyan", "", ws:sub(1, 1):upper() .. ws:sub(2), "silver", "", " at 00:00 (your timezone).") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt config weeklystart <day>, the day written in full, e.g. sunday.") return end if not WEEK_DAYS[val] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] '" .. val .. "' is not a day. Write it in full:") ColourNote("yellow", "", " " .. table.concat(WEEK_DAY_ORDER, ", ") .. ".") return end config.week_start = val state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wWeekly counts start @C" .. val:sub(1, 1):upper() .. val:sub(2) .. " @w00:00 your time@D; @waardweekly stays Monday ET@D]") return end if key == "gag_channel_echo" then if val == "on" then config.gag_channel_echo = true elseif val == "off" then config.gag_channel_echo = false elseif val == "" then config.gag_channel_echo = not config.gag_channel_echo else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt config gag_channel_echo [on|off]") return end state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wgag_channel_echo@D: " .. (config.gag_channel_echo and "@GON" or "@ROFF") .. "@D]") return end if key == "update_check" then if val == "on" then config.update_check = true elseif val == "off" then config.update_check = false elseif val == "" then config.update_check = not config.update_check else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt config update_check [on|off]") return end state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wupdate_check@D: " .. (config.update_check and "@GON" or "@ROFF") .. "@D]") if config.update_check then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " CDT will look for a newer public version 20 seconds after it loads.") end return end if key == "update_notice" then if val == "on" then config.update_notice = true elseif val == "off" then config.update_notice = false elseif val == "" then config.update_notice = not DiskNoticeOn() else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt config update_notice [on|off]") return end state_save() DiskApplyConfig() EchoLocal("@D[@wupdate_notice@D: " .. (config.update_notice and "@GON" or "@ROFF") .. "@D]") if config.update_notice then DiskCheck() end return end ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown setting: " .. (key or arg)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Settings: gag_channel_echo, update_notice, update_check, timezone, weeklystart, dateformat") end
local track_gen_auto = 0 local track_gen_manual = 0
function NewTrackedState() return { active = false, db_id = 0, name = "", start_time = 0, max_duration = 0, gen = 0, xp = 0, qp = 0, tp = 0, gold = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, kills = 0, quests = 0, cps = 0, gqs = 0, } end
function StartTracking(ts_key, session_name, max_minutes, auto_flag) if state[ts_key].active then FinalizeTracking(ts_key) end local now = os.time() local gen if ts_key == "tracked_auto" then track_gen_auto = track_gen_auto + 1 gen = track_gen_auto else track_gen_manual = track_gen_manual + 1 gen = track_gen_manual end state[ts_key] = { active = true, db_id = 0, name = session_name, start_time = now, max_duration = (max_minutes or 0) * 60, gen = gen, xp = 0, qp = 0, tp = 0, gold = 0, trains = 0, pracs = 0, levels = 0, pups = 0, kills = 0, quests = 0, cps = 0, gqs = 0, } if db then db_exec(string.format( "INSERT INTO tracked_sessions (name, start_time, auto) VALUES (%s, %d, %d)", fixsql(session_name), now, auto_flag and 1 or 0)) local row = db_query_one("SELECT last_insert_rowid() as id") if row then state[ts_key].db_id = row.id end end if max_minutes and max_minutes > 0 then local callback if ts_key == "tracked_auto" then callback = string.format('FinalizeAutoTrackIfGen(%d)', gen) else callback = string.format('FinalizeManualTrackIfGen(%d)', gen) end DoAfterSpecial(max_minutes * 60, callback, 12) end state_save() local time_str = max_minutes and max_minutes > 0 and (max_minutes .. " min") or "indefinite" local auto_tag = auto_flag and " (auto)" or "" EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@GTrack started: @W%s @D(@w%s@D)%s@D]", session_name, time_str, auto_tag)) end
function FinalizeTracking(ts_key) local t = state[ts_key] if not t or not t.active then return end t.active = false local elapsed = os.time() - t.start_time
if db and t.db_id > 0 then db_exec(string.format([[UPDATE tracked_sessions SET end_time=%d, duration=%d, xp=%d, qp=%d, tp=%d, gold=%d, trains=%d, pracs=%d, levels=%d, pups=%d, kills=%d, quests=%d, cps=%d, gqs=%d WHERE track_id=%d]], os.time(), elapsed, t.xp, t.qp, t.tp, t.gold, t.trains, t.pracs, t.levels, t.pups, t.kills, t.quests, t.cps, t.gqs, t.db_id)) end
DisplayTrackedReport(t.name, elapsed, t)
if EventOn("session") then local chan = EventChannel("session") if chan ~= "echo" then Report(chan, BuildSessionSummary(t.name, elapsed, t)) end end
state_save() PruneTrackedSessions() end
function StartManualTrack(session_name, max_minutes) StartTracking("tracked", session_name, max_minutes, false) end
function FinalizeManualTrack() FinalizeTracking("tracked") end
function StartAutoTrack(session_name, max_minutes) StartTracking("tracked_auto", session_name, max_minutes, true) end
function FinalizeAutoTrack() FinalizeTracking("tracked_auto") end
function FinalizeAutoTrackIfGen(gen) if state.tracked_auto.gen == gen then FinalizeAutoTrack() end end
-- A double session with a length runs to until_t now, if that's later than its end -- (or, exact, whenever it is): its old timer is retired (a new gen) and a new one set. -- One with no length (it ends with the double) is left alone. function ExtendAutoTrack(until_t, exact) local t = state.tracked_auto if not t or not t.active or (t.max_duration or 0) <= 0 then return end local new_dur = until_t - t.start_time if new_dur == t.max_duration or (new_dur < t.max_duration and not exact) then return end track_gen_auto = track_gen_auto + 1 t.gen, t.max_duration = track_gen_auto, new_dur DoAfterSpecial(math.max(1, until_t - os.time()), string.format('FinalizeAutoTrackIfGen(%d)', t.gen), 12) state_save() EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@GTrack now runs until %s: @W%s@D]", TZDate("%H:%M", until_t), t.name or "?")) end
function FinalizeManualTrackIfGen(gen) if state.tracked.gen == gen then FinalizeManualTrack() end end
function PruneTrackedSessions() if not db then return end local limit = config.track_retention or 20 local count_row = db_query("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tracked_sessions WHERE end_time > 0") local cnt = (count_row[1] and count_row[1].cnt) or 0 if cnt > limit then db_exec(string.format( "DELETE FROM tracked_sessions WHERE end_time > 0 AND track_id NOT IN (SELECT track_id FROM tracked_sessions WHERE end_time > 0 ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT %d)", limit)) end end
function DisplayTrackedReport(title, elapsed, d) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Tracked Session: %s", title)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" Duration: %s", FormatTimeShort(elapsed)))
local function row(label, val, color) if tonumber(val) and tonumber(val) == 0 then return end ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", label), color or "white", "", tostring(val)) end
row("XP", short_value(d.xp), "white") row("QP", comma_value(d.qp), "cyan") row("TP", d.tp, "magenta") row("Gold", short_value(d.gold), "yellow") row("Trains", d.trains, "lime") row("Pracs", d.pracs, "green") row("Levels", d.levels, "white") row("Powerups", d.pups, "white") row("Kills", comma_value(d.kills), "white") row("Quests", d.quests, "cyan") row("Campaigns", d.cps, "red") row("Global Quests", d.gqs, "yellow")
local earned = 0 for _, k in ipairs({"xp", "qp", "tp", "gold", "trains", "pracs", "levels", "pups", "kills", "quests", "cps", "gqs"}) do earned = earned + (tonumber(d[k]) or 0) end if earned == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Nothing was earned while it ran.") elseif elapsed > 0 then ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Rates (per hour):") local hr = elapsed / 3600 if d.xp > 0 then row("XP/hr", short_value(math.floor(d.xp / hr)), "white") end if d.qp > 0 then row("QP/hr", comma_value(math.floor(d.qp / hr)), "cyan") end if d.gold > 0 then row("Gold/hr", short_value(math.floor(d.gold / hr)), "yellow") end if d.kills > 0 then row("Kills/hr", comma_value(math.floor(d.kills / hr)), "white") end if d.pups > 0 then local avg = elapsed / d.pups row("Avg per pup", FormatTimePrecise(avg), "white") end if d.levels > 0 then local avg = elapsed / d.levels row("Avg per level", FormatTimePrecise(avg), "white") end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 70)) end
function CmdTrack(name, line, wildcards) local arg = ((wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")) or ""
if arg == "" then local any = false if state.tracked.active then local elapsed = os.time() - state.tracked.start_time EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@wManual: @W%s @D(@w%s@D)]", state.tracked.name, FormatTimeShort(elapsed))) if state.tracked.max_duration > 0 then local remaining = state.tracked.max_duration - elapsed EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@w%s remaining@D]", FormatTimeShort(math.max(0, remaining)))) end any = true end if state.tracked_auto.active then local elapsed = os.time() - state.tracked_auto.start_time EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@wAuto: @W%s @D(@w%s@D)]", state.tracked_auto.name, FormatTimeShort(elapsed))) if state.tracked_auto.max_duration > 0 then local remaining = state.tracked_auto.max_duration - elapsed EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@w%s remaining@D]", FormatTimeShort(math.max(0, remaining)))) end any = true end if not any then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No tracked session active.") ColourNote("silver", "", " Usage:") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gains track start [name] [minutes]") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gains track stop") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gains track list") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gains track show <id|name>") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gains track del <id>") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gains track rename <id> <name>") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gains track retention <number>") end return end
local subcmd = arg:match("^(%S+)")
if subcmd == "start" then local rest = arg:match("^start%s+(.*)") local sname, minutes if rest then -- Minutes are a separate last word: "start run 30". A name that ends in a -- number ("t1") keeps it. local name_part, mins = rest:match("^(.-)%s+(%d+)%s*$") if not name_part then mins = rest:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$") name_part = mins and "" or rest end sname = name_part ~= "" and name_part or nil minutes = tonumber(mins) end sname = sname or TZDate("Session %Y-%m-%d %H:%M") StartManualTrack(sname, minutes)
elseif subcmd == "stop" then if state.tracked.active then FinalizeManualTrack() else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No manual tracked session active.") end
elseif subcmd == "list" then if not db then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Database not available.") return end local rows = db_query("SELECT * FROM tracked_sessions ORDER BY start_time DESC") if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No tracked sessions recorded.") return end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("gold", "", string.format(" Tracked Sessions (%d saved, retention: %d)", #rows, config.track_retention or 20)) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local dur = r.duration > 0 and FormatTimeShort(r.duration) or "running" local auto_tag = r.auto == 1 and " (auto)" or "" local date = ShowDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", r.start_time) ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" #%-4d ", r.track_id), "cyan", "", string.format("%-28s", r.name:sub(1, 28)), "silver", "", string.format(" %s %s%s", date, dur, auto_tag)) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 80)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Use: cdt gains track show|del <id>, cdt gains track rename <id> <name>")
elseif subcmd == "show" then local id_or_name = arg:match("^show%s+(.+)") if not id_or_name or id_or_name == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains track show <id|name>") return end if not db then return end local row local num = tonumber(id_or_name) if num then row = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT * FROM tracked_sessions WHERE track_id = %d", num)) end if not row then row = db_query_one(string.format("SELECT * FROM tracked_sessions WHERE name = %s ORDER BY start_time DESC", fixsql(id_or_name))) end if not row then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Tracked session not found: " .. id_or_name) return end DisplayTrackedReport(row.name .. " (#" .. row.track_id .. ")", row.duration, row)
elseif subcmd == "del" or subcmd == "delete" or subcmd == "rm" then local id = tonumber(arg:match("^%S+%s+(%d+)")) if not id then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains track del <id>") return end if db then db_exec(string.format("DELETE FROM tracked_sessions WHERE track_id = %d", id)) end EchoLocal("@D[@wTracked session #" .. id .. " deleted.@D]")
elseif subcmd == "rename" then local id, newname = arg:match("^rename%s+(%d+)%s+(.+)") if not id or not newname or newname == "" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains track rename <id> <name>") return end if db then db_exec(string.format("UPDATE tracked_sessions SET name = %s WHERE track_id = %d", fixsql(newname), tonumber(id))) end EchoLocal("@D[@wSession #" .. id .. " renamed to @W" .. newname .. "@D]")
elseif subcmd == "retention" then local val = tonumber(arg:match("retention%s+(%d+)")) if not val then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Track retention: " .. (config.track_retention or 20)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Usage: cdt gains track retention <number> (1-100, default 20)") return end local asked = val val = math.max(1, math.min(100, val)) config.track_retention = val state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wTrack retention set to @W" .. val .. (asked ~= val and ("@w, the " .. (val == 100 and "most" or "least") .. " it keeps") or "") .. "@D]") PruneTrackedSessions()
else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains track [start|stop|list|show|del|rename|retention]") end end
function CmdGoal(name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.*)") if not arg or arg == "" then local g = state.goal if g and g.type and g.type ~= "" and g.target > 0 then local current = 0 if g.type == "pup" then current = state.session.pups elseif g.type == "level" then current = state.session.levels elseif g.type == "quest" then current = state.session.quests_done elseif g.type == "kill" then current = state.session.kills end local done = current - g.start_count local remaining = g.target - done if remaining < 0 then remaining = 0 end EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@wGoal: @W%d@w/%d %ss @D(@W%d@w remaining@D)]", done, g.target, g.type, remaining)) else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No active goal.") end ColourNote("yellow", "", " Usage: cdt gains goal <pup|level|quest|kill> <count>") ColourNote("silver", "", " Goals track progress within the current session.") ColourNote("silver", "", " They are cleared once reached. For persistent targets,") ColourNote("silver", "", " use milestones: cdt gains milestone add <type> <name> <target>") ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt gains goal clear removes the current goal.") return end
if arg:lower():match("^%s*clear%s*$") then state.goal = {type = "", target = 0, start_count = 0} state_save() EchoLocal("@D[@wGoal cleared.@D]") return end
local gtype, target_str = arg:match("^(%S+)%s+(%d+)") if not gtype or not target_str then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains goal <pup|level|quest|kill> <count>, or cdt gains goal clear") return end
local target = tonumber(target_str) or 0 if target <= 0 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Count must be a positive number.") return end
local current = 0 if gtype == "pup" then current = state.session.pups elseif gtype == "level" then current = state.session.levels elseif gtype == "quest" then current = state.session.quests_done elseif gtype == "kill" then current = state.session.kills else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Valid goal types: pup, level, quest, kill") return end
state.goal = {type = gtype, target = target, start_count = current} state_save() EchoLocal(string.format("@D[@wGoal set: @W%d @w%ss @D(@W%d@w remaining@D)]", target, gtype, target)) end
function CheckGoal() local g = state.goal if not g or not g.type or g.type == "" or g.target <= 0 then return end
local current = 0 if g.type == "pup" then current = state.session.pups elseif g.type == "level" then current = state.session.levels elseif g.type == "quest" then current = state.session.quests_done elseif g.type == "kill" then current = state.session.kills end
local done = current - g.start_count if done >= g.target then local msg = string.format("@D[@CCDT@D] @D[@GGOAL REACHED! @W%d@w/%d %ss@D]", done, g.target, g.type) if EventOn("goal") then Report(EventChannel("goal"), msg) end state.goal = {type = "", target = 0, start_count = 0} state_save() end end
function CmdMeter(name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
if arg == "" then ColourNote("gold", "", "[CDT] Meter Configuration:") local m = config.meter or {} local intervals = m.intervals or {300, 900, 3600} local show = m.show_intervals or {true, true, false} local rows = SortMetricRows(m.rows or {"pup_avg", "xp_rate"})
ColourNote("silver", "", " Intervals:") for i, iv in ipairs(intervals) do local status = show[i] and "ON" or "OFF" local col = show[i] and "lime" or "red" ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %d. %s ", i, FormatIntervalLabel(iv)), col, "", status) end ColourNote("silver", "", " Active rows:") for i, rk in ipairs(rows) do local def = METER_METRICS[rk] ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" %d. %s", i, def and def.label or rk), "gray", "", string.format(" (%s)", rk)) end ColourNote("silver", "", " Font: ", "white", "", string.format("%s %d%s", m.font_name or "Verdana", m.font_size or 9, (m.font_bold or 0) >= 700 and " bold" or (m.font_bold or 0) >= 500 and " medium" or "")) local sess_label = MeterSessionLabel() ColourNote("silver", "", " Session filter: ", "white", "", sess_label) ColourNote("silver", "", " Available metrics:") for _, group in ipairs(METER_METRIC_ORDER) do ColourNote("dimgray", "", " -- " .. group.header .. " --") for _, key in ipairs(group.keys) do local def = METER_METRICS[key] if def then ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-12s %s", key, def.label)) end end end ColourNote("silver", "", " Commands:") ColourNote("gray", "", " cdt gains meter on|off|toggle - show or hide the meter") ColourNote("gray", "", " cdt gains meter show <metric> - add a row") ColourNote("gray", "", " cdt gains meter hide <metric> - remove a row") ColourNote("gray", "", " cdt gains meter interval <1-3> <secs> - set interval") ColourNote("gray", "", " cdt gains meter interval <1-3> on|off - toggle interval") ColourNote("gray", "", " cdt gains meter session <arg> - all|current|tracking|double|track:<id>") ColourNote("gray", "", " cdt gains meter resetpos - reset window position") ColourNote("gray", "", " Right-click the meter for font, metrics, intervals, session.") return end
if not config.meter then config.meter = {intervals = {300, 900, 3600}, show_intervals = {true, true, false}, rows = {"pup_avg", "xp_rate"}} end
local subcmd, rest = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)") subcmd = (subcmd or ""):lower()
-- What cdt gains xpmeter used to do, in the command the rest of the meter uses. if subcmd == "toggle" then subcmd = config.xpmeter_active and "off" or "on" end
if subcmd == "on" then if not config.xpmeter_active then config.xpmeter_active = true monitor_start = Now() EnableTimer("cdt_rate_tick", true) WindowShow(win, true) BoostMeterWindow(win) DrawMeterWindow() end ColourNote("gold", "", "[CDT] Meter: ", "lime", "", "ON") state_save() return elseif subcmd == "off" then if config.xpmeter_active then config.xpmeter_active = false EnableTimer("cdt_rate_tick", false) WindowShow(win, false) end ColourNote("gold", "", "[CDT] Meter: ", "red", "", "OFF") state_save() return end
if subcmd == "show" or subcmd == "add" then local metric = rest:match("^(%S+)") if not metric or not METER_METRICS[metric] then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown metric. Available: ") for key, def in pairs(METER_METRICS) do ColourNote("gray", "", " " .. key .. " - " .. def.label) end return end for _, rk in ipairs(config.meter.rows) do if rk == metric then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. metric .. " is already shown.") return end end config.meter.rows[#config.meter.rows + 1] = metric ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Added " .. METER_METRICS[metric].label .. " to meter.") RecalcMeterSize() if config.xpmeter_active then DrawMeterWindow() end state_save()
elseif subcmd == "hide" or subcmd == "remove" or subcmd == "rm" then local metric = rest:match("^(%S+)") if not metric then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains meter hide <metric>") return end local new_rows = {} local found = false for _, rk in ipairs(config.meter.rows) do if rk == metric then found = true else new_rows[#new_rows + 1] = rk end end if not found then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] " .. metric .. " is not currently shown.") return end config.meter.rows = new_rows ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Removed " .. metric .. " from meter.") RecalcMeterSize() if config.xpmeter_active then DrawMeterWindow() end state_save()
elseif subcmd == "interval" then local slot, val = rest:match("^(%d)%s+(.+)") slot = tonumber(slot) if not slot or slot < 1 or slot > 3 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains meter interval <1-3> <seconds|on|off>") return end val = val:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if val == "on" then config.meter.show_intervals[slot] = true ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Interval " .. slot .. " enabled.") elseif val == "off" then config.meter.show_intervals[slot] = false ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Interval " .. slot .. " disabled.") else local secs = tonumber(val) if not secs or secs < 10 then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Interval must be at least 10 seconds.") return end config.meter.intervals[slot] = math.floor(secs) ColourNote("lime", "", string.format("[CDT] Interval %d set to %s (%ds).", slot, FormatIntervalLabel(secs), secs)) end RecalcMeterSize() if config.xpmeter_active then DrawMeterWindow() end state_save()
elseif subcmd == "session" then local val = rest:match("^%s*(%S+)") if not val then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Meter session filter: ", "white", "", MeterSessionLabel()) return end val = val:lower() if val == "all" or val == "0" then meter_session_id = 0 meter_track_range = nil ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Meter showing all data.") elseif val == "current" then meter_session_id = -1 meter_track_range = nil ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Meter showing current session.") elseif val == "tracking" then meter_session_id = -2 meter_track_range = nil ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Meter showing current tracking.") elseif val == "double" then meter_session_id = -4 meter_track_range = nil ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Meter showing current double XP.") else local tid = val:match("^track:?(%d+)$") or val:match("^t(%d+)$") if tid then tid = tonumber(tid) if db and tid then local rows = db_query(string.format( "SELECT track_id, name, start_time, end_time FROM tracked_sessions WHERE track_id = %d", tid)) if rows[1] then meter_session_id = -3 meter_track_range = {track_id = rows[1].track_id, start_time = rows[1].start_time, end_time = rows[1].end_time} ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Meter showing tracked session #" .. tid .. " (" .. rows[1].name .. ").") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Tracked session #" .. tid .. " not found.") return end end else local sid = tonumber(val) if sid and sid > 0 then meter_session_id = sid meter_track_range = nil ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Meter showing session " .. sid .. ".") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt gains meter session <all|current|tracking|double|track:<id>|session_id>") return end end end if config.xpmeter_active then DrawMeterWindow() end
elseif subcmd == "resetpos" then WindowPosition(win, 0, 0, 0, miniwin.pos_top_left) movewindow.save_state(win) if config.xpmeter_active then DrawMeterWindow() end ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Meter position reset to top-left.")
else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Unknown meter command: " .. subcmd) end end
function JsonString(v) local escaped = tostring(v):gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c) if c == '"' then return '\\"' elseif c == "\\" then return "\\\\" elseif c == "\n" then return "\\n" elseif c == "\r" then return "\\r" elseif c == "\t" then return "\\t" end return string.format("\\u%04x", c:byte()) end) return '"' .. escaped .. '"' end
-- Numbers use %.0f / %.17g: MUSHclient's Lua is 32-bit, so %d would overflow on -- big totals. function JsonValue(v) if v == nil then return "null" end if type(v) == "number" then if v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then return "null" end if v == math.floor(v) and math.abs(v) < 2^53 then return string.format("%.0f", v) end return string.format("%.17g", v) end if type(v) == "boolean" then return v and "true" or "false" end return JsonString(v) end
-- One CSV field: numbers as plain digits (no 1e+15), nil as empty, and text quoted -- when it holds a comma, quote, line break or edge spaces, quotes doubled (RFC 4180). function CsvValue(v) if v == nil then return "" end if type(v) == "number" then if v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then return "" end if v == math.floor(v) and math.abs(v) < 2^53 then return string.format("%.0f", v) end return string.format("%.17g", v) end if type(v) == "boolean" then return v and "1" or "0" end local str = tostring(v) if str:find('[,"\r\n]') or str:match("^%s") or str:match("%s$") then return '"' .. str:gsub('"', '""') .. '"' end return str end
function CsvRow(values) local out = {} for i, v in ipairs(values) do out[i] = CsvValue(v) end return table.concat(out, ",") .. "\r\n" end
-- cdt export csv [<table> ...]: one file per table, cirrus_tracker_export_<table>.csv, -- plus cirrus_tracker_export_totals.csv with the export details, session and lifetime. function ExportCsv(tables, dir) local function size_str(bytes) return bytes >= 1048576 and string.format("%.1f MB", bytes / 1048576) or string.format("%.0f KB", bytes / 1024) end local base = dir .. "\\cirrus_tracker_export_" local f = io.open(base .. "totals.csv", "wb") if not f then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Could not open file for writing: " .. base .. "totals.csv") return end f:write(CsvRow({"section", "key", "value"})) f:write(CsvRow({"export", "exported_at", TZDate("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")})) f:write(CsvRow({"export", "exported_at_unix", os.time()})) f:write(CsvRow({"export", "plugin_version", PLUGIN_VERSION})) f:write(CsvRow({"export", "db_version", DB_VERSION})) for _, section in ipairs({{"session", state.session}, {"lifetime", state.player_totals}}) do local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(section[2] or {}) do if type(v) ~= "table" and type(v) ~= "function" then keys[#keys + 1] = k end end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end) for _, k in ipairs(keys) do f:write(CsvRow({section[1], k, section[2][k]})) end end local total_bytes = f:seek("end") or 0 f:close()
local total_rows, counts = 0, {} for _, t in ipairs(tables) do local tf = io.open(base .. t .. ".csv", "wb") if not tf then ColourNote("red", "", "[CDT] Could not open file for writing: " .. base .. t .. ".csv") return end local rows = 0 local stmt = db:prepare('SELECT * FROM "' .. t .. '"') if stmt then local names = stmt:get_names() local ncol = stmt:columns() local header = {} for i = 1, ncol do header[i] = names[i] end tf:write(CsvRow(header)) local buf = {} while stmt:step() == sqlite3.ROW do local vals = {} for i = 0, ncol - 1 do vals[i + 1] = stmt:get_value(i) end buf[#buf + 1] = CsvRow(vals) rows = rows + 1 if #buf >= 500 then tf:write(table.concat(buf)); buf = {} end end tf:write(table.concat(buf)) stmt:finalize() end total_bytes = total_bytes + (tf:seek("end") or 0) tf:close() counts[#counts + 1] = {t, rows} total_rows = total_rows + rows end
ColourNote("lime", "", string.format("[CDT] Exported %s rows from %d table%s as CSV (%s) to:", comma_value(total_rows), #tables, #tables == 1 and "" or "s", size_str(total_bytes))) ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. dir) if #tables <= 8 then for _, c in ipairs(counts) do ColourNote("dimgray", "", string.format(" cirrus_tracker_export_%-26s %10s", c[1] .. ".csv", comma_value(c[2]))) end else ColourNote("dimgray", "", " one file per table, named cirrus_tracker_export_<table>.csv") end ColourNote("dimgray", "", " plus cirrus_tracker_export_totals.csv (session and lifetime totals)") end

TRACE_CURRENCIES = {"qp", "tp", "trains", "pracs"} TRACE_BUCKETS = { {">3s", function(g) return g > 3 end}, {"1.5-3", function(g) return g > 1.5 and g <= 3 end}, {"0-1.5", function(g) return g >= 0 and g <= 1.5 end}, {"-1.5-0", function(g) return g < 0 and g >= -1.5 end}, {"<-1.5", function(g) return g < -1.5 end}, }
function WorthTraceReport() local rows = db_query("SELECT t, kind, source, qp, tp, trains, pracs, gold FROM worth_trace ORDER BY t, trace_id") local W = REPORT_W ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Worth trace") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) if #rows == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Nothing recorded yet. cdt debug worthtrace on, then play a while.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) return end local worth, claims, others, reclaims = {}, {}, {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do r.t = tonumber(r.t) or 0 for _, c in ipairs(TRACE_CURRENCIES) do r[c] = tonumber(r[c]) or 0 end r.gold = tonumber(r.gold) or 0 if r.kind == "worth" then worth[#worth + 1] = r elseif r.kind == "claim" then claims[#claims + 1] = r elseif r.kind == "other" then others[#others + 1] = r elseif r.kind == "reclaim" then reclaims[#reclaims + 1] = r end end
-- how often worth updates come, and what they carry local gains, spends, mixed, gold_only, gaps = 0, 0, 0, 0, {} for i, w in ipairs(worth) do local up, down = false, false for _, c in ipairs(TRACE_CURRENCIES) do if w[c] > 0 then up = true elseif w[c] < 0 then down = true end end if up then gains = gains + 1 end if down then spends = spends + 1 end if up and down then mixed = mixed + 1 end if not up and not down then gold_only = gold_only + 1 end if i > 1 and w.t - worth[i - 1].t < 600 then gaps[#gaps + 1] = w.t - worth[i - 1].t end end table.sort(gaps) local span = rows[#rows].t - rows[1].t ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %s rows over %s. Worth updates: %s, %s with a QP/TP/train/prac", comma_value(#rows), ActiveShort(span), comma_value(#worth), comma_value(gains))) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" gain, %s gold only. Median gap between updates: %s.", comma_value(gold_only), #gaps > 0 and string.format("%.2fs", gaps[math.floor((#gaps + 1) / 2)]) or "-")) ColourNote(mixed > 0 and "yellow" or "silver", "", string.format( " Updates with a spend: %s; with a spend and a gain together: %s.", comma_value(spends), comma_value(mixed)))
-- for each claim, when its worth gain came: + means before the claim local function nearest(c, t) local best for _, w in ipairs(worth) do if w[c] > 0 and math.abs(w.t - t) <= 30 and (not best or math.abs(w.t - t) < math.abs(best.t - t)) then best = w end end return best end local by, order = {}, {} for _, cl in ipairs(claims) do local cur for _, c in ipairs(TRACE_CURRENCIES) do if cl[c] > 0 then cur = c; break end end if cur then local b = by[cl.source] if not b then b = {n = 0, none = 0, twice = 0, fixed = 0, worst = nil, buckets = {}} for i = 1, #TRACE_BUCKETS do b.buckets[i] = 0 end by[cl.source] = b order[#order + 1] = cl.source end b.n = b.n + 1 local w = nearest(cur, cl.t) if not w then b.none = b.none + 1 else local g = cl.t - w.t if g > 0 and (not b.worst or g > b.worst) then b.worst = g end for i, bk in ipairs(TRACE_BUCKETS) do if bk[2](g) then b.buckets[i] = b.buckets[i] + 1; break end end end -- a claim that took its gain back from 'other' fixed it; one that didn't, counted it twice local fixed = false for _, rc in ipairs(reclaims) do if rc.source == cl.source and rc[cur] > 0 and math.abs(rc.t - cl.t) <= 0.5 then fixed = true; break end end if fixed then b.fixed = b.fixed + 1 else for _, o in ipairs(others) do if o[cur] == cl[cur] and math.abs(o.t - cl.t) <= 10 then b.twice = b.twice + 1; break end end end end end table.sort(order) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("white", "", " When the worth gain came, against the claim (+ before, - after), seconds") ColourNote("gray", "", string.format(" %-11s%6s%6s%6s%6s%7s%6s%6s%6s%6s%6s", "Claim", "Count", TRACE_BUCKETS[1][1], TRACE_BUCKETS[2][1], TRACE_BUCKETS[3][1], TRACE_BUCKETS[4][1], TRACE_BUCKETS[5][1], "none", "fixed", "twice", "worst")) for _, src in ipairs(order) do local b = by[src] local cells = {} for i = 1, #TRACE_BUCKETS do cells[i] = b.buckets[i] > 0 and comma_value(b.buckets[i]) or "-" end ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" %-11s", src), "white", "", string.format("%6s", comma_value(b.n)), (b.buckets[1] > 0) and "yellow" or "silver", "", string.format("%6s", cells[1]), "silver", "", string.format("%6s%6s%7s%6s%6s", cells[2], cells[3], cells[4], cells[5], b.none > 0 and comma_value(b.none) or "-"), b.fixed > 0 and "lime" or "silver", "", string.format("%6s", b.fixed > 0 and comma_value(b.fixed) or "-"), b.twice > 0 and "red" or "silver", "", string.format("%6s", b.twice > 0 and comma_value(b.twice) or "-"), "white", "", string.format("%6s", b.worst and string.format("%.1f", b.worst) or "-")) end if #order == 0 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " No claims recorded yet.") end
local oc = {} for _, o in ipairs(others) do for _, c in ipairs(TRACE_CURRENCIES) do if o[c] ~= 0 then oc[c] = (oc[c] or 0) + 1 end end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" Booked as 'other': %d QP, %d TP, %d trains, %d pracs rows.", oc.qp or 0, oc.tp or 0, oc.trains or 0, oc.pracs or 0)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " >3s: the gain waited 3s unclaimed and went to 'other' first. fixed: the") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " claim took it back. twice: an 'other' row of the same size within 10s that") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " wasn't taken back. none: no worth gain within 30s. worst: the longest the") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " worth gain came before its claim, in seconds.") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", W)) end
