CHANGELOG = { {version = "4.5.0", db = 39, title = "cdt update gets the newest public version", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.4.9.", }}, {"New", { "cdt update looks up the newest public version of CDT (the version.json in its GitHub repository) and says whether you have it. cdt update install downloads that version, checks it against the repository's checksum and that it is CDT, and puts it in place; your current file is kept beside it as cirrus_data_tracker.xml.<date>-update.bak. Type cdt reload to load it. It never reloads by itself, the web requests run in the background, and if anything does not check out or the file cannot be written, nothing changes.", "A copy running ahead of the public version (your own build) is left alone: cdt update install force installs the public one anyway.", "cdt config update_check [on|off]: on makes CDT look once, 20 seconds after it loads, and say if a newer version exists. Off by default, because it contacts GitHub.", "cdt help update explains it.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.9", db = 39, title = "Tells you when a new version is waiting", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.4.8.", }}, {"New", { "A deploy replaces the plugin file on disk, but the client keeps running the copy it loaded, so nothing said a new version was waiting. CDT now reads its own file when it loads and again every 5 minutes. If the file on disk differs from the one that loaded, it says so once: 'CDT 4.4.10 is on disk; you're running 4.4.9. Type cdt reload to load it.', or, when the version number is the same (a fix inside a version), 'The CDT file on disk has changed since it loaded (still 4.4.9)'. cdt help repeats it under its header until you reload, or the file is put back. It never reloads anything by itself, and waits for the next check if you are in a fight.", "cdt config update_notice [on|off] turns this on (the default) or off. Off, the 5-minute timer is stopped and the file is not read again; the notice and the cdt help reminder go with it.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.8", db = 39, title = "Hiding never takes the wrong line", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.4.7.", }}, {"Fixes", { "With cdt gag groupdmg, enemydmg, groupheal or allheal on, CDT hid a line by deleting the last line in the output. If another plugin had already hidden that line, the delete took the visible line above it instead. In a big group, with a damage line every moment, this ate the output from the bottom: text slid back up the screen and new lines never appeared, until a reconnect. The ASCII map's capture does this while it waits for the end of a map, so a missed map end set it off. CDT now deletes only when the last line in the output is the one it matched (all of its rows if it wrapped, where before only the last row went), and otherwise leaves the output alone and says so once a session.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.7", db = 39, title = "Regeneration, and scrolls by what they healed", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "Database version 38 to 39: the groupmates' heals table gets a spell column (everything already in it is incomplete healing). A backup is made first, as with every upgrade.", }}, {"New", { "Regeneration is tracked. On you, 'A great healing power courses through your veins leaving you greatly regenerated. [N]' is the same line whoever cast it, so its caster is whoever's mana dropped by regeneration's cost (1,100, an Eldar's 825) in the next group update: you, a groupmate, or 'unknown' when no one's did; solo, it's yours. Yours on another player ('...courses through the veins of Bob leaving him greatly regenerated. [N]') is recorded like your incomplete healing on them. A groupmate's regeneration on anyone else shows no line: it's found in their mana, and counts the hp gain of the player it most likely healed (the biggest hp jump in their room in that update), or 4,600 when no one's hp jumped.", "Regeneration counts in the damage meter's Healing (with estimates), its detail view (Regen~ / HP~), healedall, healedgrp and castsonly, and in cdt heal report (a Regen~ column in healedall; their regeneration on others in player). Scrolls of regeneration are read like scrolls of incomplete healing.", }}, {"Improvements", { "A heal scroll read on someone else counted 3,400 a heal, but a scroll's heals depend on the reader's stats. It now counts what its target's hp rose by in the next group update (for incomplete healing, at most 3,400 a heal), and only when that can't be measured (the target isn't in your group data), 3,400 a heal (regeneration 4,600). A scroll's heals on you were, and are, exact from their lines.", "A groupmate's heal size, worked out from the hp jumps their casts caused, now comes from their incomplete healing casts only.", }}, {"Fixes", { "necrocide's instinct was left out of the damage estimates as an unmapped damage word, though its damage has been mapped since 4.4.3.", "The group's combined attack ('Your group's combined attack ...') showed in your own attacks in the damage meter's detail view and in cdt dmg meter report player, though it is the whole group's and was already left out of your damage and DPS. It no longer does, so your attacks' shares add up to your own damage.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.6", db = 38, title = "Void sermon or a sonic weapon", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.4.5. void sermon is added to the built-in damage type mappings (negative, spell) when CDT loads.", }}, {"New", { "cdt wail: the harmer spell void sermon shows its damage as 'Your wail ...', the word sonic weapons use, so it was all counted as sonic melee. cdt wail weapon keeps that (the default); cdt wail sermon records all your wail as void sermon, negative spell damage, under its own name in every damage table, the meter and mastery; cdt wail both tells them apart by your mana: a wail line counts as void sermon when your mana drops by a cast's cost (80, Eldar 60) by the next mana update. 'both' needs nothing else to give you mana while you fight: consume (corpses for mana) or regen hides a cast, and another spell cast at the same moment can make a weapon hit count as void sermon. cdt wail on its own shows the setting.", "Groupmates' wail, and a mob's wail on you, are always a sonic weapon: there is no way to tell. Damage already recorded keeps the name and type it was given.", "void sermon's instinct is no longer left out of the damage estimates for an unmapped damage word.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.5", db = 38, title = "Solo and group damage", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "Database version 37 to 38. The tables holding damage by attack, by damage type and damage taken are rebuilt with a solo/group column; a backup is made first, as with every upgrade, and it takes a moment on a large database.", "Damage already recorded is labelled solo or group where its 30-minute slice was all one or the other, and 'not split' where the slice mixed both or is from before v3.9. The group's combined attack is labelled group, and so is a groupmate's damage taken.", }}, {"New", { "Add solo or group (or grouped) to a cdt dmg view to see only the damage recorded while you were solo, or in a group: cdt dmg combo gargoyle/necromancer solo, cdt dmg area 10 group, cdt dmg report solo, cdt dmg taken group. It goes with the level, date and tier filters, on report, subclass, race, combo, level, area, attacks, types and taken. It isn't for cdt dmg player or players, and the pre-v3.9 estimate and the instinct and mastery sections of report can't be split, so they're left out.", "What is exact: the totals in report, subclass, race, combo, level and area (damage, damage received and time) are exact for all your history, because the area table has always kept solo and group fights apart. Race and combo take each slice's race from its attack rows; a slice with two races (a race change partway) is shared between them by their damage.", "The breakdowns by attack, damage type and damage taken are exact from 4.4.5 on. Older damage in a slice that mixed solo and group fights can't be split, and is shown under the table as 'not split', with how much it is and what share of the total. New damage is always split.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.4", db = 37, title = "A lighter XP meter", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database version change from 4.4.3. On first load CDT adds one index to the levels table, which takes a moment on a large database.", }}, {"Fixes", { "The XP meter's Pup avg and Pups rows read the whole levels table on every refresh (every 3 seconds), and Pup avg for a window with no pups in it on every second. With many pups recorded and the database on a network drive this froze the client for a fraction of a second every few seconds. The levels table now has an index on type and end time, so each query reads only the pups in its window, and a window with no value is remembered until the next refresh like any other.", "CDT's database connection keeps 16 MB of pages in memory instead of SQLite's default 2 MB, so reports and the meter don't fetch the same pages from disk over and over.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.3", db = 37, title = "Heal reports for a channel", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.4.2.", }}, {"New", { "cdt dmg meter auto [on|off]: the damage meter starts counting by itself when play begins, after a reload, a restart or a reconnect, instead of waiting for Start. Off by default and saved with the meter's settings; with no on/off it flips. Turned on while the meter is idle, it starts now. A meter already counting or paused is left alone.", "cdt reload reloads CDT from the command line, e.g. after a new version is deployed, instead of going to File -> Plugins.", }}, {"Improvements", { "The damage meter's heal reports are three: cdt dmg meter report healedme [ch] sends the heals that landed on you, exact (titled Heals on <your name>); healedall [ch] sends everyone's heals in the meter's count, each healer's total and casts, biggest first (titled Heals w/ estimates, ~ where estimated); healedgrp [ch] sends each healer's heals on self, on the leader and on others as three figures, self/leader/others (titled Group heals). The leader is whoever leads the group when it's sent. Each takes castsonly. The older names (heal, healing, healest) are gone, and so is cdt heal report group.", "customreport takes healedme and healedall as figures, e.g. cdt dmg meter customreport healedall+dps player Bob: Heals: ~9.5k on self (2 casts), ~14.3k on leader (3 casts), ~23.8k on others (5 casts) | Attacks (dps): .... report player adds the same heals after the attacks. The sections are labelled and come in the order asked for.", "The damage meter's detail view by Healing splits a groupmate's heals by who they landed on: on self, on leader, on others - you and on others - not you (on leader - you when you lead); your own row, on self, on leader and on others. A cast's target is the biggest hp jump in the healer's room when their mana drops, as guessed since 4.4. Estimates show ~.", "cdt heal report's commands are named for what they show: healedme (who healed you; was players) and healedall (groupmates' healing, estimated from the group data; was group). The damage meter's count, each healer's heals on self, the leader and others, is cdt dmg meter report healedgrp (or cdt report healedgrp over cdt listen).", "cdt heal report sends one line to a channel, put last: your own heals; player <name>, their heals on self and on others; healedall, each groupmate's total healed and casts. Over the scope, all time by default. healedme stays on your screen. The tables on your screen are as before.", "Over cdt listen: cdt report healedme|healedall|healedgrp [castsonly], customreport with healedme and healedall, and cdt heal report player <name> (the meter's count, broken down by player healed: on you exactly, the rest by each cast's likely target, ~), on say, gtell and spouse. The cdt help reply lists them.", "castsonly: add it to a heal report that shows several players, sent as one line (to a channel, echo or over cdt listen), for just the numbers of casts, no hp healed: cdt dmg meter report healedme castsonly [ch] (Heal casts on <you>, each healer's casts on you and your own on yourself, with their share), cdt dmg meter report healedall castsonly [ch] (Heal casts w/ estimates: each healer's total casts), cdt dmg meter report healedgrp castsonly [ch] (Group heal casts: each healer's casts on self, on leader and on others), and cdt heal report healedall castsonly [scope] <ch> (Groupmates' heal casts). Ranked by casts; a ~ marks an estimated count (a groupmate's casts seen only in their mana; casts on you, your own and scrolls are exact). The word can come anywhere after the report name. The tables on your screen, and the single-player reports, don't take it. Allowed players can ask for it over cdt listen: cdt report healedme castsonly, cdt report healedall castsonly, cdt report healedgrp castsonly.", "A line CDT sends to a channel is at most 999 characters: a longer report goes on to a second line (and a third), split between entries, each follow-on line starting [CDT]; past three, the last is cut, ending .... A very long line can get you disconnected; if the connection drops within 10 seconds of CDT sending to a channel, a [CDT debug] note says what was sent and how long each line was.", "Reports name you rather than saying 'you', since whoever reads the channel, or asked over cdt listen, isn't you.", "cdt report and cdt customreport asked over cdt listen on say were never answered: CDT checked say against its report channels, which it isn't one of, and printed 'say is not a channel' instead. A listen query is now answered on its own channel.", "Clicking a player in the damage meter's group view opens their detail view on the same category: from Healing, their heals; from DPS, their DPS.", "Every line CDT sends ends with a colour reset, so a report's last colour no longer bleeds into what follows: $C on the game's channels (gtell, clantalk, ftalk, spouse), which puts the channel back to its own colour for everyone (help colors); @C on say, its bright cyan; @w, plain grey, everywhere else (echo, tells, a channel added with cdt config channels add), where $C would show as text.", "healedgrp reads Name: self/leader/others, e.g. 1.Bob: ~9.5k/~14.3k/~23.8k. Each figure is in the colour of its word in the header (self yellow, leader green, others cyan), names in bright white, always three figures with 0 where there were none, and no per-player total: shorter and easier to read. castsonly is the same with casts. A group of many players still splits between rows.", }}, {"Fixes", { "necrocide is mapped to negative; its damage showed as unknown.", "A built-in damage type mapping added in a new version now reaches an existing database when CDT loads, and damage already recorded as unknown under that attack is filed under its type (the damage type totals follow). A mapping you set yourself with cdt dmg map is left alone.", "The million monsters double ('You hear a loud roar from <player> and the world appears calmer for a while. Aardwolf rejoices in the death of another MILLION monsters.') wasn't recognised: CDT looked for the sentence only at the start of a line. The hour then ran under whatever double came along next, and with a superhero's 15 minutes the double session ended at 15. A copy of the line in someone's whois history doesn't count.", "The million monsters' hour replaces any double running, as the game does: the double, and its session, now end an hour after it, not when the double it replaced would have (a superhero's 15 minutes ended the session at 15). Another double that runs longer than the one on moves the session's end out too.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.2", db = 37, title = "A tidier damage meter", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.4.1.", }}, {"Improvements", { "Right-click the damage meter for 'Healing: Include Estimates'. With it on, the Healing tab adds each groupmate's estimated healing on others (their casts on others times their heal size, plus scrolls; shown with ~) to their heals on you, and your own heals on others to your row. It's off by default and remembered. Channel reports stay exact.", "The detail view shows only the lines for the tab you're on: Dmg / Time / DPS on DPS and Damage, Hits / Crits on Crit% and Avg/Hit, the heals on Healing. Taken / Per min shows on every tab. The figure in the header and the window's total follow the tab too: on Healing, the total is the healing.", "A detail page with nothing to list (a groupmate who healed nobody, or just after a reset) says 'No heals yet' or 'No damage yet' instead of an empty heading.", "The total at the bottom right no longer runs into the resize corner.", "cdt dmg's command list now includes heal as a meter report sort, and mentions the meter's right-click options.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4.1", db = 37, title = "Healers without pretitles", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.4. The first time 4.4.1 loads, it puts right the heals already recorded (below).", }}, {"Fixes", { "A healer or heal target with a pretitle ('Dark Lord Bob', 'Ranger Alice') was recorded under the whole pretitle, apart from the player's other heals, and their known heal size wasn't found. They're recorded by name now, and heals already recorded under a pretitle are moved to the name.", "Heals recorded in a quiet stretch with no fighting could be filed under an earlier half hour, which the level and tier filters go by. They're filed under the half hour they happened in now, and heals already recorded are put right.", "cdt heal report group's Likely healed list could run past 80 columns.", "With the gains meter open, CDT could go on seeing its database as it was a moment before, missing changes another program made to it (such as the one-off group log import) until reloaded, and its own records could fail to save meanwhile.", }}, }}, {version = "4.4", db = 37, title = "Groupmates' healing", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "Your database upgrades to v37 the first time 4.4 loads, after a backup is made (cdt db restore rolls it back).", }}, {"New", { "Groupmates' heals on other players are counted. A cast shows in the group data as their mana dropping by 950 (712 or 713 for an Eldar, learned per player, and a race change is noticed), or by close to it once they're known to heal: an estimate, as some are missed and wasted heals count. A healer's heal size is their heal on you, or else worked out from the hp jumps their casts cause. A heal scroll read in your room ('X recites a scroll of 3*incomplete healing on Y') counts exactly: 3 heals of 3,400.", "cdt heal report group [scope] lists each groupmate's casts, how many were on others, their heal size, their healing on others, and who each cast most likely healed (a best guess from the biggest hp jump in the healer's room, right about 3 times in 4). cdt heal report player <name> adds the same for one player, and the damage meter's detail view by Healing shows it per groupmate.", "A heal scroll's heals on you are recorded as 'incomplete healing (scroll)', apart from cast heals, and count in every total.", }}, {"Fixes", { "A heal on you from a groupmate with a title before their name ('Dark Lord Bob') was recorded under the whole title, apart from that player's other heals.", }}, }}, {version = "4.3.1", db = 36, title = "Bloot colours, and doubles that ended early", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.3.", }}, {"New", { "Bloot tiers show in the game's colours and brackets in every bloot report, ((Godly)) included, and rank in the game's order: Mythical is now below Fabled.", "cdt debug double on|off: a diagnostic that records each double to a file, silently, from its start to 20 seconds after CDT decides it ended: every game line, and why CDT ended it.", }}, {"Fixes", { "A superhero's double ('experience is doubled in honor of the new superhero') could end early in CDT, the sooner the faster you kill. Its bonus line ('... in honor of <player> reaching superhero') wasn't taken as the double's bonus, and with kills under half a second apart, one kill's bonus check could judge the next kill before its bonus line arrived. A double the game gave a length for is also no longer ended by kills without a bonus line before that time is up.", "A reload, a disconnect or cdt reset session no longer ends a double in CDT; the game's double carries on, and so does CDT's. If its time ran out while you were away, it's recorded as ending then. With no length known, your next kills decide.", "A double's end time was never saved: its record stayed open until the session ended. A double CDT ends because kills show no bonus is now recorded as ending at the last bonus.", "When CDT decided on its own that a double was over, its messages could cut a line that was still arriving in two, and neither half was then recognised (a bonus XP line went uncounted). They now wait for the line to finish.", "cdt reset session during a double no longer drops the double's tracked session unsaved.", }}, }}, {version = "4.3", db = 36, title = "Heals and damage taken", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "Your database upgrades to v36 the first time 4.3 loads, after a backup is made (cdt db restore rolls it back).", }}, {"New", { "Incomplete healing on you is recorded, yours ('You are healed by your magic touch') and other players' ('You feel healed by <player>'s magic'). It is the only heal whose line names the caster.", "cdt heal report shows your own heals: total healed, casts, average per cast and highest heal. cdt heal report player <name> shows the same for <name>'s heals on you.", "cdt heal history all|self|player <name> [n] lists the last heals (10 by default, up to 100), with time, healer, spell and amount.", "cdt dmg player <name> shows what <name> healed you for.", "cdt heal report players lists everyone who healed you, most first. Every heal report takes a scope: session, day, week, month, year, or the Aardwolf ones.", "Damage taken is recorded by who hit you and with what: cdt dmg taken shows it by mob, attack, damage type, race and subclass. Hits on your groupmates are recorded too: cdt dmg taken player <name>, and cdt dmg taken players to see who takes the most.", "An attack the game prints capitalised ('Wrath', 'Colourful Spray') now finds its lower-case damage type mapping.", "The damage meter has a Healing category beside DPS, Total Dmg and Crit%: in the group view, each player's heals on you (yours on yourself on your row); in the detail view, a player's heals on you by spell, with casts. cdt dmg meter report heal sends it to a channel.", "cdt debug grouplog on|off: a diagnostic that writes every GMCP group update, game line and command to a file, to study whether groupmates' heals on others can be detected from their mana.", "Your heals on other players ('Bob is healed by your magic touch') are recorded too, and the meter's detail view by Healing lists them on your row, by player, under your heals on yourself.", "Two new gags for heals on you, no longer hidden by cdt gag groupdmg. cdt gag groupheal hides 'You feel healed by <player>'s <spell>' when the player is in your group. cdt gag allheal hides that line from anyone, plus 'The life within you is renewed', 'You feel your life restored' and 'A warm feeling fills your body'. Only one of the two can be on; cdt help gag lists exactly what each covers.", }}, {"Fixes", { "A heal from a groupmate was read as a damage line: it was recorded as their damage, and hidden by the groupdmg gag.", "After a new session started (a reload or relog) with the damage meter running, groupmates' rows disappeared from the meter until they dealt damage again.", "cdt reset session with the damage meter running, if the meter was started partway through the session: the meter read 0 until you had dealt more than the session had before Start. What it had counted now carries over.", }}, }}, {version = "4.2", db = 33, title = "More reliable gains tracking; melee, spell and skill", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "Your database upgrades to v33 the first time 4.2 loads, after a backup is made (cdt db restore rolls it back).", }}, {"New", { "QP, TP, trains and pracs tracking is more reliable: rewards are matched to the game's updates however their messages are ordered or delayed.", "cdt db verify checks each session's QP, TP, trains and pracs against what the game reported, for sessions from 4.2 on.", "cdt dmg player <name> shows melee, spell and skill damage, each damage type's share, and the most recent day's damage lines and types.", "The damage meter shows your damage taken and damage taken per minute, in your Detail view and in cdt dmg meter report player.", "cdt debug worthtrace on|off|report|clear: a diagnostic that records how the game's reward messages are timed.", }}, {"Fixes", { "The snapshot at load (instinct, mastery, dtrack hits) could give up on a slow reply and let it scroll by unsaved. It now waits up to 15 seconds, and if something still doesn't reply, it says what was missed and the command to retry.", "cdt dmg player counted mind force, mental energy and backstab as spell damage.", "Spells and skills are told apart. cdt dmg map <attack> <damtype> <category> corrects any attack.", "A spell you had mapped yourself (cdt dmg map ... spell) wasn't boosted by its own instinct in instinct estimates and projections.", }}, {"Data repaired on upgrade", { "v32: attacks get their spell or skill category (backstab, spiral and counter strike added as skills), including damage already recorded. Mappings you made yourself are kept.", }}, }}, {version = "4.1.2", db = 31, title = "Bloot by area, doubled rewards removed", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "Your database upgrades to v31 the first time 4.1.2 loads (from 4.1, through v30 on the way), after a backup is made (cdt db restore rolls it back).", }}, {"New", { "New cdt gains area bloot [scope]: bonus loot by area, with its best tier and drop rate, and under each area the mobs that dropped it, by tier. Every drop ever recorded has its mob.", }}, {"Fixes", { "cdt gains best is faster again: the biggest kill comes out of the same pass over your kills as the best days, instead of reading them all a second time.", "cdt help gains was missing area quest, best and compare. They are listed, with area bloot.", "cdt gains compare ... full ended with two separator lines.", "cdt db verify also looks for a quest, campaign or GQ's TP, trains and pracs recorded a second time as 'other'. Its QP check matches within seconds instead of two minutes, like the others, and its trains check looks at level-ups only.", }}, {"Data repaired on upgrade", { "v31: before 4.0, a quest, campaign or GQ's TP, trains and pracs could also be recorded as 'other' a moment before the reward line, counting them twice. v29 cleared the QP; the rest go now: an 'other' row the same size as the reward, booked from 3 seconds before it to 1 second after, one per reward, with the session and daily totals that counted it.", }}, }}, {version = "4.1.1", db = 30, title = "Doubled level-up trains, and fixes to 4.1", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "Your database upgrades from v29 to v30 the first time 4.1.1 or later loads, after a backup is made (cdt db restore rolls it back).", }}, {"Fixes", { "Level-up and powerup trains and pracs were still sometimes recorded a second time as 'other': when the worth update came more than 1.5 seconds before the level line, it was booked before the level-up claimed it. Each gains line now claims its own amount as it arrives.", "cdt db verify ran for up to a minute on a large database. Its trains check now uses the time index and takes a moment.", "The day's wrap-up left out kills from the last half minute before Aardwolf's midnight (still unsaved), and could say nothing for a day that had only those.", "cdt gains best ignored a word after the scope (cdt gains best week gt), and cdt db verify read a count it couldn't make sense of as 30 days. Both show their usage now.", "cdt gains compare month: the last column's heading ran into Change.", "cdt gains area quest listed only the 15 most visited areas. It lists them all, with a total.", "cdt gains best lagged on a big database: it worked out a date for every kill. It now adds the kills up by quarter hour first.", }}, {"Data repaired on upgrade", { "v30: the 'other' trains and pracs that doubled a level-up since v27 are removed, by v27's rule, with the session and daily totals that counted them. Powerups are left alone: they come seconds apart, too close to tell a copy from a real gain.", }}, }}, {version = "4.1", db = 29, title = "Records, comparisons and the daily wrap-up", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "No database change from 4.0. Coming from 3.9, the upgrade described under 4.0 runs first.", }}, {"New", { "New cdt db verify [days|all]: looks for rewards recorded twice, and compares each session's saved totals with the records it holds. It changes nothing.", "New cdt gains best [scope]: your fastest quest, campaign, GQ win, powerup and level-up, your best day for XP, QP, gold, kills, powerups and quests, and your biggest kill and richest quest.", "The tables (cdt gains report qp 7day ...) have an Average row, per day or week you played, and show the best one in green.", "New cdt gains area quest [count|qp|time] [scope]: the areas your quests send you to, how often, their base QP, how long they take and what they paid.", "cdt gains history tp and cdt gains history trains: where each trivia point and train came from, newest first.", "New cdt gains compare <day|week|month|year|aard...> [full]: this period so far against the last one up to the same point, with the change and the last one's full total; full compares the last two finished periods.", "New event: wrapup, one line with the day's totals when Aardwolf's day ends (or when you next play, if you were offline). cdt events wrapup channel gt, or off.", }}, {"Fixes", { "cdt dmg meter report <channel> sends a DPS report there; before, it printed locally and sent nothing. An unknown sort is refused instead of quietly becoming DPS.", "cdt gains meter named the Current Double filter 'Session -4' (and a saved track 'Session -3').", }}, }}, {version = "4.0", db = 29, title = "Reports, automatic events, archive and export", sections = { {"Upgrading", { "Your database upgrades from v23 to v29 the first time 4.0 or later loads, after a backup is made (cdt db restore rolls it back).", }}, {"New", { "cdt events replaces cdt toggle and cdt channel: every automatic report in one list, each with on/off and a channel.", "Powerups are their own event, separate from levels. Your old settings carry over.", "Level and powerup lines can number by total, lifetime, daily or weekly count, in your time or Aardwolf's.", "Double XP alerts can go to a channel.", "cdt config holds gag_channel_echo, timezone (was cdt timezone), weeklystart and dateformat (M/D/Y, D/M/Y or Y/M/D), and lists where the other settings live.", "cdt gains history <type> [n] lists recent events. 'all' shows a kill with its gold, bloot and specials on one row.", "cdt flags compares XP and QP with and without OPK/HARDCORE, for any tier.", "cdt archive now works: move records before a date to an archive file, list, rehydrate and purge them, and pick the folder with cdt archive path.", "cdt export writes JSON, cdt export csv writes one CSV file per table, and cdt export path sets the folder.", "cdt build set <name> subclass|race <x> sets who a build is for.", "The damage meter window comes back after a reload if it was on, with its size, tab, sorts and minimalist mode. (day was today; today still works.)", "A number before a scope shows a table of that many, newest first, with the total underneath: cdt gains report qp 7day, cdt gains report 12 month, cdt gains report xp 10aardweek.", "When one kill finished a campaign and won a GQ, the GQ's win rewards were counted as the campaign's. Each now gets its own.", "New cdt gains report tp and cdt gains report trains: where your trivia points and trains came from, with every scope and the tables.", "cdt gains xpmeter is gone: it only turned the same window on and off. -- One bullet, wrapped to 78 columns: " - " then text, continuation lines indented -- to match. cdt commands show in cyan, as in help. function ChangelogBullet(text) local width, first, line = 74, true, "" local function flush() ColourNote(unpack(HelpSegments({"silver", "", first and " - " or " "}, line, "silver"))) first, line = false, "" end for word in text:gmatch("%S+") do if line ~= "" and #line + 1 + #word > width then flush() end line = line == "" and word or (line .. " " .. word) end if line ~= "" then flush() end end
function ChangelogShow(entry) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 78)) ColourNote("gold", "", " v" .. entry.version, "dimgray", "", " (DB v" .. entry.db .. ") ", "white", "", entry.title) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 78)) for i, section in ipairs(entry.sections) do if i > 1 then Note("") end ColourNote("yellow", "", " " .. section[1]) for _, bullet in ipairs(section[2]) do ChangelogBullet(bullet) end end end
-- cdt version [<version>|all]: plugin and database details with the newest -- changes; a version number shows that release's notes, all shows every one. function CmdVersion(name, line, wildcards) local arg = (((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""):lower():gsub("^v", "") if arg == "all" then for _, entry in ipairs(CHANGELOG) do ChangelogShow(entry) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 78)) return end if arg ~= "" then for _, entry in ipairs(CHANGELOG) do if entry.version == arg then ChangelogShow(entry) ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 78)) return end end ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] No version " .. arg .. " in the history. cdt version lists them.") return end
ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 78)) ColourNote("gold", "", " Cirrus Data Tracker") ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 78)) ColourNote("silver", "", " Plugin version: ", "white", "", PLUGIN_VERSION) ColourNote("silver", "", " DB version: ", "white", "", tostring(DB_VERSION)) ColourNote("silver", "", " DB path: ", "cyan", "", db_path) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " 'class' still works wherever 'subclass' is used.") ColourNote("yellow", "", " Database commands") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt reset session ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Reset current session counters") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt reset db ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Wipe ALL data (asks for confirmation)") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt db ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Backup/restore, migration status") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt debug sql ... ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Run raw SQL on the database") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt rebuild [gains|dmg]", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Rebuild summary stats from raw data") ColourNote("cyan", "", " cdt archive ", "dimgray", "", ": ", "silver", "", "Archive/restore/purge old data")
ColourNote("white", "", "") ColourNote("gold", "", " What's new") -- Every release of the current minor version, newest first: 4.1.2, 4.1.1 and 4.1 -- all show, so a patch release doesn't hide what its minor version brought. local function minor(v) return (tostring(v):match("^(%d+%.%d+)")) end local current, first_earlier = minor(CHANGELOG[1].version), #CHANGELOG + 1 for i, e in ipairs(CHANGELOG) do if minor(e.version) ~= current then first_earlier = i break end if i > 1 then Note("") end ChangelogShow(e) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 78)) ColourNote("yellow", "", " Earlier versions") for i = first_earlier, #CHANGELOG do local e = CHANGELOG[i] ColourNote("white", "", string.format(" v%-7s", e.version), "dimgray", "", string.format("DB v%-3d ", e.db), "silver", "", e.title) end ColourNote("orange", "", string.rep("-", 78)) ColourNote("dimgray", "", " cdt version 3.9 shows one release's notes; cdt version all shows them all.") end
function CmdInvalid(name, line, wildcards) local typed = (line or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local rest = typed:match("^[Cc][Dd][Tt]%s+(.*)$") or "" local first = (rest:match("^(%S+)") or ""):lower() ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Not a command: " .. typed) local near = {} for _, cmd in ipairs(CDT_COMMANDS) do if first ~= "" and (cmd:sub(1, #first) == first or first:sub(1, #cmd) == cmd) then near[#near + 1] = cmd end end if #near > 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", " Did you mean: " .. table.concat(near, ", ") .. "?") end ColourNote("silver", "", " cdt help lists every command.") end
-- ============================================================================= -- LIFECYCLE -- ============================================================================= function LoadPlayerTotals() if not db then return end local qp = GetPlayerTotal("qp_earned") if qp > 0 then state.player_totals.qp_earned = qp state.player_totals.whois_seeded = true end local pups = GetPlayerTotal("pups") if pups > 0 then state.player_totals.pups = pups end local mobs = GetPlayerTotal("mobs_killed") if mobs > 0 then state.player_totals.mobs_killed = mobs end end
-- Capture and gag groups are transient: they belong to a snapshot that is -- currently running. MushClient saves trigger-group state with the plugin, so a -- chain interrupted part-way (logging in AFK, a disconnect mid-capture) leaves -- the gag enabled, and it comes back enabled on reload with no chain to ever -- turn it off - swallowing every line until the plugin is removed. Never trust -- the persisted state for these; force them off at every entry point. function ResetTransientTriggerGroups() EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_snapshot_gag", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_snapshot_afk", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_inst_cap", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_mast_cap", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_dtrack_cap", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_roster_cap", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_gag", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_free", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_double_log", false) -- Reward and gains captures open for a second or two after a level, campaign -- or GQ; left on, they would credit unrelated lines in every later session. EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_linfo", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_cp_rewards", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_gq_rewards", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_gq_mob_rewards", false) pcall(DeleteTimer, "cdt_snap_step") pcall(DeleteTimer, "cdt_whois_timeout") snapshot_chain.active = false snapshot_chain.queue = {} inst_capture.on_complete = nil mast_capture.on_complete = nil dtrack_capture.on_complete = nil end
-- ============================================================================= -- A different version on disk (4.4.9) -- A deploy replaces the plugin file, but MUSHclient keeps running what it loaded, so nothing -- says a new version is waiting. At load the file is read and hashed; every 5 minutes it is -- read again, and when it differs the player is told once (and cdt help says so until the -- plugin is reloaded or the file is put back). It never reloads anything itself. -- ============================================================================= DISK_QUIET_SECS = 10 -- no notice within this long of a combat hit; it waits for the next check
disk_loaded = nil -- {hash, version} of the plugin file as it was when this copy loaded disk_seen = nil -- {hash, version} of the file now on disk, when it differs from that disk_told = nil -- the hash the player was last told about
-- The file now on disk: {hash, version}, or nil when it can't be read (no path, no hash -- function, the file busy or missing). Never raises. function DiskRead() local ok, got = pcall(function() local path = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) local hasher = utils and (utils.sha256 or utils.md5) if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" or not hasher then return nil end local f = io.open(path, "rb") if not f then return nil end local data = f:read("*a") f:close() if not data or #data < 1000 then return nil end return {hash = tostring(hasher(data)), version = data:match('local PLUGIN_VERSION = "([^"]+)"')} end) return ok and got or nil end
-- What cdt help adds under its header, or nil when the file on disk is the one that loaded. function DiskPendingText() local s = disk_seen if not s or not DiskNoticeOn() then return nil end if s.version and s.version ~= PLUGIN_VERSION then return "CDT " .. s.version .. " is on disk (this is " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ")" end return "The CDT file on disk has changed since it loaded" end
function DiskNotice(s) if s.version and s.version ~= PLUGIN_VERSION then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] CDT " .. s.version .. " is on disk; you're running " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ".") else ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] The CDT file on disk has changed since it loaded (still " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ").") end ColourNote("cyan", "", " Type ", "white", "", "cdt reload", "cyan", "", " to load it.") end
-- cdt config update_notice. Off stops the timer, so the file is not read again. function DiskNoticeOn() return not config or config.update_notice ~= false end
function DiskApplyConfig() local on = DiskNoticeOn() EnableTimer("cdt_disk_check", on) if not on then disk_seen, disk_told = nil, nil end end
function DiskCheck() if not disk_loaded or not DiskNoticeOn() then return end if current_combat and (os.time() - (current_combat.last_hit_time or 0)) < DISK_QUIET_SECS then return end local now = DiskRead() if not now then return end -- unreadable this time: say nothing if now.hash == disk_loaded.hash then disk_seen, disk_told = nil, nil -- put back, or reloaded: nothing waiting, and a return -- later change is news again end disk_seen = now if disk_told == now.hash then return end disk_told = now.hash DiskNotice(now) end
function OnDiskCheck(name) pcall(DiskCheck) end
-- ============================================================================= -- cdt update (4.5.0) -- Looks for a newer public release and installs it. The public repository holds version.json -- (version, sha256, plugin id) and, under the tag v<version>, the plugin file. Nothing here -- blocks the game: the requests are MUSHclient's async ones. An install downloads the file for -- the version version.json names, checks its sha256 against version.json and that it is this -- plugin, writes it beside the current file, keeps a backup of the current one, and swaps them. -- It never reloads anything: the player types cdt reload. -- ============================================================================= UPDATE_REPO = "aard-cirrus/cirrus-data-tracker" UPDATE_INFO_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. UPDATE_REPO .. "/main/version.json" UPDATE_FILE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. UPDATE_REPO .. "/v%s/cirrus_data_tracker.xml" UPDATE_NEWS = "github.com/" .. UPDATE_REPO UPDATE_FILE_NAME = "cirrus_data_tracker.xml" UPDATE_MIN_BYTES = 200000 -- a CDT file is over a megabyte; anything this small is not one UPDATE_MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024 UPDATE_BUSY_SECS = 200 -- a request that never answered stops blocking the next after this long update_busy = nil -- os.time() while a request is out
function UpdateVersionParts(v) local a, b, c = tostring(v or ""):match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)$") if not a then return nil end return {tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c)} end
-- -1: a is older than b, 0: the same, 1: newer; nil when either is not a version function UpdateCompare(a, b) local x, y = UpdateVersionParts(a), UpdateVersionParts(b) if not x or not y then return nil end for i = 1, 3 do if x[i] ~= y[i] then return x[i] < y[i] and -1 or 1 end end return 0 end
-- version.json -> {version, sha256, plugin_id, file, published, db}, or nil and why function UpdateParseInfo(page) if type(page) ~= "string" or #page > 4096 then return nil, "the version file is not what was expected" end local function str(k) return page:match('"' .. k .. '"%s*:%s*"([^"]*)"') end local info = { version = str("version"), sha256 = (str("sha256") or ""):lower(), plugin_id = str("plugin_id"), file = str("file"), published = str("published"), db = tonumber(page:match('"db"%s*:%s*(%d+)')), } if not UpdateVersionParts(info.version) then return nil, "its version is missing or not like 4.5.0" end if #info.sha256 ~= 64 or info.sha256:find("%X") then return nil, "its checksum is missing or not a sha256" end if info.plugin_id ~= GetPluginID() then return nil, "it is for a different plugin" end if info.file ~= UPDATE_FILE_NAME then return nil, "it names an unexpected file" end return info end
function UpdateBegin() if update_busy and os.time() - update_busy < UPDATE_BUSY_SECS then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] An update request is already running; wait for it to finish.") return false end update_busy = os.time() return true end
function UpdateEnd() update_busy = nil end
function UpdateFail(why) ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Update: " .. why) end
-- Fetch a URL without blocking. done(page) on HTTP 200 (page is the body), else done(nil, why). -- done is called once, whatever happens. function UpdateFetch(url, timeout, done) local answered = false local function answer(page, why) if answered then return end answered = true local ok, err = pcall(done, page, why) if not ok then update_busy = nil UpdateFail("something went wrong (" .. tostring(err) .. ")") end end local ok_async, async = pcall(require, "async") if not ok_async or type(async) ~= "table" or type(async.doAsyncRemoteRequest) ~= "function" then answer(nil, "this client can't make web requests (no async module).") return end local started = pcall(async.doAsyncRemoteRequest, url, function(_, page, status) if status == 200 and type(page) == "string" then answer(page) elseif type(status) == "number" then answer(nil, "GitHub answered " .. status .. ".") elseif status == "timeout" then answer(nil, "the request timed out.") else answer(nil, "could not reach GitHub.") end end, "HTTPS", timeout, function() answer(nil, "the request timed out.") end) if not started then answer(nil, "could not start the web request.") end end
function UpdateTellNewer(info) ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] CDT " .. info.version .. " is available (you have " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ").") ColourNote("cyan", "", " Type ", "white", "", "cdt update install", "cyan", "", ", then ", "white", "", "cdt reload", "cyan", "", ".") ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Changes: " .. UPDATE_NEWS) end
function UpdateReport(info, cmp) if cmp == 1 then UpdateTellNewer(info) elseif cmp == 0 then ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] You have the newest public version (" .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ").") else ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] You are running " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ", ahead of the newest public version (" .. info.version .. ").") end end
-- Check, write, swap, verify. Returns true and the backup's file name, or false and why. A failure -- leaves the plugin file as it was (or puts the old one back). function UpdateInstall(info, page) local hasher = utils and utils.sha256 if type(page) ~= "string" or #page < UPDATE_MIN_BYTES or #page > UPDATE_MAX_BYTES then return false, "the download is the wrong size; nothing was installed." end if not hasher then return false, "this client can't check a download (no sha256); nothing was installed." end if tostring(hasher(page)):lower() ~= info.sha256 then return false, "the download does not match its checksum; nothing was installed." end if not page:find('id="' .. GetPluginID() .. '"', 1, true) or not page:find('local PLUGIN_VERSION = "' .. info.version .. '"', 1, true) then return false, "the download is not CDT " .. info.version .. "; nothing was installed." end local path = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return false, "can't tell where the plugin file is." end
local new_path = path .. ".new" local backup = path .. "." .. os.date("!%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") .. "-update.bak" local f = io.open(new_path, "wb") if not f then return false, "can't write next to the plugin file; nothing was changed." end local wrote = f:write(page) f:close() local back = io.open(new_path, "rb") local data = back and back:read("*a") if back then back:close() end if not wrote or not data or #data ~= #page or tostring(hasher(data)):lower() ~= info.sha256 then os.remove(new_path) return false, "the new file did not write correctly; nothing was changed." end
local copied, why = DbFileCopy(path, backup) if not copied then os.remove(new_path) os.remove(backup) return false, "can't back up the current file (" .. tostring(why) .. "); nothing was changed." end if not os.remove(path) then os.remove(new_path) os.remove(backup) return false, "can't replace the plugin file (read-only?); nothing was changed." end if not os.rename(new_path, path) then local restored = DbFileCopy(backup, path) os.remove(new_path) if restored then os.remove(backup) end return false, "could not move the new file into place; " .. (restored and "the old file was put back." or "RESTORE IT FROM " .. backup) end local check = io.open(path, "rb") local landed = check and check:read("*a") if check then check:close() end if not landed or tostring(hasher(landed)):lower() ~= info.sha256 then local restored = DbFileCopy(backup, path) if restored then os.remove(backup) end return false, "the installed file did not verify; " .. (restored and "the old file was put back." or "RESTORE IT FROM " .. backup) end return true, backup:match("[^\\/]+$") end
function UpdateDownload(info) ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Downloading CDT " .. info.version .. "...") UpdateFetch(string.format(UPDATE_FILE_URL, info.version), 180, function(page, why) if not page then UpdateEnd() UpdateFail("the download failed: " .. why) return end local ok, installed, detail = pcall(UpdateInstall, info, page) UpdateEnd() if not ok then UpdateFail("the install failed (" .. tostring(installed) .. "); the plugin file should be as it was.") elseif not installed then UpdateFail(detail) else ColourNote("lime", "", "[CDT] Installed CDT " .. info.version .. " (this copy is still " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ").") ColourNote("silver", "", " The old file is kept as " .. detail) ColourNote("cyan", "", " Type ", "white", "", "cdt reload", "cyan", "", " to load it.") local now = DiskRead() if now then disk_seen, disk_told = now, now.hash end -- already said; cdt help still reminds end end) end
-- cdt update [install [force]] function CmdUpdate(name, line, wildcards) local arg = Trim(wildcards[1] or ""):lower() local install, force = false, false if arg == "" then elseif arg == "install" then install = true elseif arg == "install force" then install, force = true, true else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[CDT] Usage: cdt update or cdt update install (cdt help update)") return end if not UpdateBegin() then return end ColourNote("silver", "", "[CDT] Looking up the newest public version...") UpdateFetch(UPDATE_INFO_URL, 30, function(page, why) local info, bad if page then info, bad = UpdateParseInfo(page) else bad = why end if not info then UpdateEnd() UpdateFail("could not check: " .. tostring(bad)) return end local cmp = UpdateCompare(info.version, PLUGIN_VERSION) if not install or (cmp ~= 1 and not force) then UpdateEnd() UpdateReport(info, cmp) if install and cmp ~= 1 then ColourNote("dimgray", "", " Nothing to install. cdt update install force installs it anyway.") end return end UpdateDownload(info) end) end
-- With cdt config update_check on: once, 20 seconds after CDT loads. Says something only when a -- newer public version exists; stays quiet when it is current, ahead, or GitHub can't be reached. function UpdateAutoCheck() if not config or not config.update_check then return end if not UpdateBegin() then return end UpdateFetch(UPDATE_INFO_URL, 30, function(page) UpdateEnd() local info = page and UpdateParseInfo(page) if info and UpdateCompare(info.version, PLUGIN_VERSION) == 1 then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[CDT] CDT " .. info.version .. " is available (you have " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. "). Type cdt update.") end end) end
function OnPluginInstall() disk_loaded = DiskRead() ResetTransientTriggerGroups() state_load() DiskApplyConfig() if config.update_check then DoAfterSpecial(20, "UpdateAutoCheck()", sendto.script) end ApplyGags() db_init() LoadDamtypeCache() FoldBrokenSessionAttacks() LoadPlayerTotals() LoadClanAllowlist() InitMeterWindow() InitDmgMeterWindow()
-- Loaded while connected (a reload): connected doesn't mean logged in, so send -- nothing yet. GMCP's last known state says whether a character was in play; -- the session starts on the next GMCP message of any kind (see OnPluginBroadcast). game_session_started = false game_state = nil if IsConnected() then local ok, st = pcall(gmcp, "char.status") if ok and type(st) == "table" then game_state = tonumber(st.state) end end
ColourNote("cornflowerblue", "", "Cirrus Data Tracker v" .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. " loaded. Type ", "white", "", "cdt help", "cornflowerblue", "", ".") end
function OnPluginConnect() ResetTransientTriggerGroups() state_load() ApplyGags() if not db then db_init() end LoadDamtypeCache() LoadPlayerTotals() LoadClanAllowlist() -- Nothing is sent yet: the name and password prompts may still be ahead. -- OnPluginBroadcast starts the session once GMCP shows a character in play. game_session_started = false game_state = nil end
function OnPluginDisconnect() NoteChannelSendBeforeDrop() GroupLogFlush() -- A chain cannot survive the connection dropping, so tear it down rather -- than leaving the gag enabled for the next session to inherit. ResetTransientTriggerGroups() if state.tracked.active then FinalizeManualTrack() end if state.tracked_auto.active then FinalizeAutoTrack() end if quest_pending then FinalizeQuestRecord() end FlushWorthOther() -- A connection that never got past the login prompts had no session to end. if game_session_started then EndSession() end game_session_started = false game_state = nil end
function OnPluginClose() GroupLogClose() WindowShow(win, false) WindowShow(dmg_win, false) if state.tracked.active then FinalizeManualTrack() end if state.tracked_auto.active then FinalizeAutoTrack() end if game_session_started then EndSession() end if double_log.file then DoubleLogWrite("CDT ", "capture closed: plugin closed") DoubleLogClose() end db_close() end
function OnPluginEnable() if not db then db_init() end end
function OnPluginSaveState() -- Last line of defence: whatever happens, an enabled gag must never reach -- the saved state, or the next load starts with output already suppressed. EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_snapshot_gag", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_gag", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois_free", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cdt_whois", false) state_save() movewindow.save_state(win) movewindow.save_state(dmg_win) end
